book.title: Tanakh
book.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)
book.license: Hebrew: Miqra according to the Masorah via Sefaria, CC BY-SA. English: JPS 1917, public domain.
book.notes: Torah, Nevi’im and Ketuvim in the Hebrew order. Hebrew verse numbering is retained; a few books (e.g. Joel) differ from Christian numbering.

verses.original: וַאֲנִי֙ בִּשְׁנַ֣ת אַחַ֔ת לְדָרְיָ֖וֶשׁ הַמָּדִ֑י עׇמְדִ֛י לְמַחֲזִ֥יק וּלְמָע֖וֹז לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'ny bshnt 'cht ldryvsh hmdy 'mdy lmchzyq vlm'vz lv
verses.translation: And as for me, in the first year of Darius the Mede, I stood up to be a supporter and a stronghold unto him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֕ה אֱמֶ֖ת אַגִּ֣יד לָ֑ךְ הִנֵּה־עוֹד֩ שְׁלֹשָׁ֨ה מְלָכִ֜ים עֹמְדִ֣ים לְפָרַ֗ס וְהָֽרְבִיעִי֙ יַעֲשִׁ֤יר עֹֽשֶׁר־גָּדוֹל֙ מִכֹּ֔ל וּכְחֶזְקָת֣וֹ בְעׇשְׁר֔וֹ יָעִ֣יר הַכֹּ֔ל אֵ֖ת מַלְכ֥וּת יָוָֽן׃
verses.translit: v'th 'mt 'gyd lkh hnh'vd shlshh mlkhym 'mdym lprs vhrby'y y'shyr 'shrgdvl mkhl vkhchzqtv b'shrv y'yr hkhl 't mlkhvt yvn
verses.translation: And now will I declare unto thee the truth. Behold, there shall stand up yet three kings in Persia; and the fourth shall be far richer than they all; and when he is waxed strong through his riches, he shall stir up all against the realm of Greece.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָמַ֖ד מֶ֣לֶךְ גִּבּ֑וֹר וּמָשַׁל֙ מִמְשָׁ֣ל רַ֔ב וְעָשָׂ֖ה כִּרְצוֹנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'md mlkh gbvr vmshl mmshl rb v'shh khrtsvnv
verses.translation: And a mighty king shall stand up, that shall rule with great dominion, and do according to his will.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּכְעׇמְדוֹ֙ תִּשָּׁבֵ֣ר מַלְכוּת֔וֹ וְתֵחָ֕ץ לְאַרְבַּ֖ע רוּח֣וֹת הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְלֹ֣א לְאַחֲרִית֗וֹ וְלֹ֤א כְמׇשְׁלוֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר מָשָׁ֔ל כִּ֤י תִנָּתֵשׁ֙ מַלְכוּת֔וֹ וְלַאֲחֵרִ֖ים מִלְּבַד־אֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.translit: vkh'mdv tshbr mlkhvtv vtchts l'rb' rvchvt hshmym vl' l'chrytv vl' khmshlv 'shr mshl khy tntsh mlkhvtv vl'chrym mlbd'lh
verses.translation: And when he shall stand up, his kingdom shall be broken, and shall be divided toward the four winds of heaven; but not to his posterity, nor according to his dominion wherewith he ruled; for his kingdom shall be plucked up, even for others beside those.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיֶחֱזַ֥ק מֶֽלֶךְ־הַנֶּ֖גֶב וּמִן־שָׂרָ֑יו וְיֶחֱזַ֤ק עָלָיו֙ וּמָשָׁ֔ל מִמְשָׁ֥ל רַ֖ב מֶמְשַׁלְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vychzq mlkhhngb vmnshryv vychzq 'lyv vmshl mmshl rb mmshltv
verses.translation: And the king of the south shall be strong, and one of his princes; and he shall be strong above him, and have dominion; his dominion shall be a great dominion.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְקֵ֤ץ שָׁנִים֙ יִתְחַבָּ֔רוּ וּבַ֣ת מֶֽלֶךְ־הַנֶּ֗גֶב תָּבוֹא֙ אֶל־מֶ֣לֶךְ הַצָּפ֔וֹן לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת מֵישָׁרִ֑ים וְלֹֽא־תַעְצֹ֞ר כּ֣וֹחַ הַזְּר֗וֹעַ וְלֹ֤א יַעֲמֹד֙ וּזְרֹע֔וֹ וְתִנָּתֵ֨ן הִ֤יא וּמְבִיאֶ֙יהָ֙ וְהַיֹּ֣לְדָ֔הּ וּמַחֲזִקָ֖הּ בָּעִתִּֽים׃
verses.translit: vlqts shnym ytchbrv vbt mlkhhngb tbv' 'lmlkh htspvn l'shvt myshrym vl't'tsr khvch hzrv' vl' y'md vzr'v vtntn hy' vmby'yh vhyldh vmchzqh b'tym
verses.translation: And at the end of years they shall join themselves together; and the daughter of the king of the south shall come to the king of the north to make an agreement; but she shall not retain the strength of her arm; neither shall he stand, nor his arm; but she shall be given up, and they that brought her, and he that begot her, and he that obtained her in those times.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָמַ֛ד מִנֵּ֥צֶר שׇׁרָשֶׁ֖יהָ כַּנּ֑וֹ וְיָבֹ֣א אֶל־הַחַ֗יִל וְיָבֹא֙ בְּמָעוֹז֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הַצָּפ֔וֹן וְעָשָׂ֥ה בָהֶ֖ם וְהֶחֱזִֽיק׃
verses.translit: v'md mntsr shrshyh khnv vyb' 'lhchyl vyb' bm'vz mlkh htspvn v'shh bhm vhchzyq
verses.translation: But one of the shoots of her roots shall stand up in his place, and shall come unto the army, and shall enter into the stronghold of the king of the north, and shall deal with them, and shall prevail;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגַ֣ם אֱֽלֹהֵיהֶ֡ם עִם־נְסִֽכֵיהֶם֩ עִם־כְּלֵ֨י חֶמְדָּתָ֜ם כֶּ֧סֶף וְזָהָ֛ב בַּשְּׁבִ֖י יָבִ֣א מִצְרָ֑יִם וְהוּא֙ שָׁנִ֣ים יַעֲמֹ֔ד מִמֶּ֖לֶךְ הַצָּפֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: vgm 'lhyhm 'mnskhyhm 'mkhly chmdtm khsf vzhb bshby yb' mtsrym vhv' shnym y'md mmlkh htspvn
verses.translation: and also their gods, with their molten images, and with their precious vessels of silver and of gold, shall he bring into captivity into Egypt; and he shall desist some years from the king of the north.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבָ֗א בְּמַלְכוּת֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הַנֶּ֔גֶב וְשָׁ֖ב אֶל־אַדְמָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vb' bmlkhvt mlkh hngb vshb 'l'dmtv
verses.translation: And he shall come into the kingdom of the king of the south, but he shall return into his own land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבָנָ֣ו יִתְגָּר֗וּ וְאָסְפוּ֙ הֲמוֹן֙ חֲיָלִ֣ים רַבִּ֔ים וּבָ֥א ב֖וֹא וְשָׁטַ֣ף וְעָבָ֑ר וְיָשֹׁ֥ב (ויתגרו) [וְיִתְגָּרֶ֖ה] עַד־מָעֻזֹּֽה׃
verses.translit: vbnv ytgrv v'spv hmvn chylym rbym vb' bv' vshtf v'br vyshb (vytgrv) [vytgrh] 'dm'zh
verses.translation: And his sons shall stir themselves up, and shall assemble a multitude of great forces, and he shall come on, and overflow, as he passes through; and he shall return and stir himself up, even to his stronghold.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיִתְמַרְמַר֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הַנֶּ֔גֶב וְיָצָ֕א וְנִלְחַ֥ם עִמּ֖וֹ עִם־מֶ֣לֶךְ הַצָּפ֑וֹן וְהֶעֱמִיד֙ הָמ֣וֹן רָ֔ב וְנִתַּ֥ן הֶהָמ֖וֹן בְּיָדֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vytmrmr mlkh hngb vyts' vnlchm 'mv 'mmlkh htspvn vh'myd hmvn rb vntn hhmvn bydv
verses.translation: And the king of the south shall be moved with choler, and shall come forth and fight with him, even with the king of the north; and he shall set forth a great multitude, but the multitude shall be given into his hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנִשָּׂ֥א הֶהָמ֖וֹן (ירום) [וְרָ֣ם] לְבָב֑וֹ וְהִפִּ֥יל רִבֹּא֖וֹת וְלֹ֥א יָעֽוֹז׃
verses.translit: vnsh' hhmvn (yrvm) [vrm] lbbv vhpyl rb'vt vl' y'vz
verses.translation: and the multitude shall be carried away, and his heart shall be lifted up; and he shall cast down tens of thousands; but he shall not prevail.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׁב֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הַצָּפ֔וֹן וְהֶעֱמִ֣יד הָמ֔וֹן רַ֖ב מִן־הָרִאשׁ֑וֹן וּלְקֵ֨ץ הָֽעִתִּ֤ים שָׁנִים֙ יָ֣בוֹא ב֔וֹא בְּחַ֥יִל גָּד֖וֹל וּבִרְכ֥וּשׁ רָֽב׃
verses.translit: vshb mlkh htspvn vh'myd hmvn rb mnhr'shvn vlqts h'tym shnym ybv' bv' bchyl gdvl vbrkhvsh rb
verses.translation: And the king of the north shall again set forth a multitude, greater than the former; and he shall come on at the end of the times, even of years, with a great army and with much substance.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבָעִתִּ֣ים הָהֵ֔ם רַבִּ֥ים יַֽעַמְד֖וּ עַל־מֶ֣לֶךְ הַנֶּ֑גֶב וּבְנֵ֣י  פָּרִיצֵ֣י עַמְּךָ֗ יִֽנַּשְּׂא֛וּ לְהַעֲמִ֥יד חָז֖וֹן וְנִכְשָֽׁלוּ׃
verses.translit: vb'tym hhm rbym y'mdv 'lmlkh hngb vbny  prytsy 'mkh ynsh'v lh'myd chzvn vnkhshlv
verses.translation: And in those times there shall many stand up against the king of the south; also the children of the violent among thy people shall lift themselves up to establish the vision; but they shall stumble.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָבֹא֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הַצָּפ֔וֹן וְיִשְׁפֹּךְ֙ סֽוֹלְלָ֔ה וְלָכַ֖ד עִ֣יר מִבְצָר֑וֹת וּזְרֹע֤וֹת הַנֶּ֙גֶב֙ לֹ֣א יַעֲמֹ֔דוּ וְעַם֙ מִבְחָרָ֔יו וְאֵ֥ין כֹּ֖חַ לַעֲמֹֽד׃
verses.translit: vyb' mlkh htspvn vyshpkh svllh vlkhd 'yr mbtsrvt vzr'vt hngb l' y'mdv v'm mbchryv v'yn khch l'md
verses.translation: And the king of the north shall come, and cast up a mound, and take a well-fortified city; and the arms of the south shall not withstand; and as for his chosen people, there shall be no strength in them to withstand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיַ֨עַשׂ הַבָּ֤א אֵלָיו֙ כִּרְצוֹנ֔וֹ וְאֵ֥ין עוֹמֵ֖ד לְפָנָ֑יו וְיַעֲמֹ֥ד בְּאֶֽרֶץ־הַצְּבִ֖י וְכָלָ֥ה בְיָדֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vy'sh hb' 'lyv khrtsvnv v'yn 'vmd lpnyv vy'md b'rtshtsby vkhlh bydv
verses.translation: But he that cometh against him shall do according to his own will, and none shall stand before him; and he shall stand in the beauteous land, and in his hand shall be extermination.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָשֵׂ֣ם ׀ פָּ֠נָ֠יו לָב֞וֹא בְּתֹ֧קֶף כׇּל־מַלְכוּת֛וֹ וִישָׁרִ֥ים עִמּ֖וֹ וְעָשָׂ֑ה וּבַ֤ת הַנָּשִׁים֙ יִתֶּן־ל֣וֹ לְהַשְׁחִיתָ֔הּ וְלֹ֥א תַעֲמֹ֖ד וְלֹא־ל֥וֹ תִהְיֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vyshm  pnyv lbv' btqf khlmlkhvtv vyshrym 'mv v'shh vbt hnshym ytnlv lhshchyth vl' t'md vl'lv thyh
verses.translation: And he shall set his face to come with the strength of his whole kingdom, but shall make an agreement with him; and he shall give him the daughter of women, to destroy it; but it shall not stand, neither be for him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (וישב) [וְיָשֵׂ֧ם] ׀ פָּנָ֛יו לְאִיִּ֖ים וְלָכַ֣ד רַבִּ֑ים וְהִשְׁבִּ֨ית קָצִ֤ין חֶרְפָּתוֹ֙ ל֔וֹ בִּלְתִּ֥י חֶרְפָּת֖וֹ יָשִׁ֥יב לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: (vyshb) [vyshm]  pnyv l'yym vlkhd rbym vhshbyt qtsyn chrptv lv blty chrptv yshyb lv
verses.translation: After this shall he set his face unto the isles, and shall take many; but a captain shall cause the reproach offered by him to cease; yea, he shall cause his own reproach to return upon him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָשֵׁ֣ב פָּנָ֔יו לְמָעוּזֵּ֖י אַרְצ֑וֹ וְנִכְשַׁ֥ל וְנָפַ֖ל וְלֹ֥א יִמָּצֵֽא׃
verses.translit: vyshb pnyv lm'vzy 'rtsv vnkhshl vnpl vl' ymts'
verses.translation: Then he shall turn his face toward the strongholds of his own land; but he shall stumble and fall, and shall not be found.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָמַ֧ד עַל־כַּנּ֛וֹ מַעֲבִ֥יר נוֹגֵ֖שׂ הֶ֣דֶר מַלְכ֑וּת וּבְיָמִ֤ים אֲחָדִים֙ יִשָּׁבֵ֔ר וְלֹ֥א בְאַפַּ֖יִם וְלֹ֥א בְמִלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'md 'lkhnv m'byr nvgsh hdr mlkhvt vbymym 'chdym yshbr vl' b'pym vl' bmlchmh
verses.translation: Then shall stand up in his place one that shall cause an exactor to pass through the glory of the kingdom; but within few days he shall be destroyed, neither in anger, nor in battle.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָמַ֤ד עַל־כַּנּוֹ֙ נִבְזֶ֔ה וְלֹא־נָתְנ֥וּ עָלָ֖יו ה֣וֹד מַלְכ֑וּת וּבָ֣א בְשַׁלְוָ֔ה וְהֶחֱזִ֥יק מַלְכ֖וּת בַּחֲלַקְלַקּֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: v'md 'lkhnv nbzh vl'ntnv 'lyv hvd mlkhvt vb' bshlvh vhchzyq mlkhvt bchlqlqvt
verses.translation: And in his place shall stand up a contemptible person, upon whom had not been conferred the majesty of the kingdom; but he shall come in time of security, and shall obtain the kingdom by blandishments.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּזְרֹע֥וֹת הַשֶּׁ֛טֶף יִשָּׁטְפ֥וּ מִלְּפָנָ֖יו וְיִשָּׁבֵ֑רוּ וְגַ֖ם נְגִ֥יד בְּרִֽית׃
verses.translit: vzr'vt hshtf yshtpv mlpnyv vyshbrv vgm ngyd bryt
verses.translation: And the arms of the flood shall be swept away from before him, and shall be broken; yea, also the prince of the covenant.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִן־הִֽתְחַבְּר֥וּת אֵלָ֖יו יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה מִרְמָ֑ה וְעָלָ֥ה וְעָצַ֖ם בִּמְעַט־גּֽוֹי׃
verses.translit: vmnhtchbrvt 'lyv y'shh mrmh v'lh v'tsm bm'tgvy
verses.translation: And after the league made with him he shall work deceitfully; and he shall come up and become strong, with a little nation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּשַׁלְוָ֞ה וּבְמִשְׁמַנֵּ֣י מְדִינָה֮ יָבוֹא֒ וְעָשָׂ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹא־עָשׂ֤וּ אֲבֹתָיו֙ וַאֲב֣וֹת אֲבֹתָ֔יו בִּזָּ֧ה וְשָׁלָ֛ל וּרְכ֖וּשׁ לָהֶ֣ם יִבְז֑וֹר וְעַ֧ל מִבְצָרִ֛ים יְחַשֵּׁ֥ב מַחְשְׁבֹתָ֖יו וְעַד־עֵֽת׃
verses.translit: bshlvh vbmshmny mdynh ybv' v'shh 'shr l''shv 'btyv v'bvt 'btyv bzh vshll vrkhvsh lhm ybzvr v'l mbtsrym ychshb mchshbtyv v'd't
verses.translation: In time of security shall he come even upon the fattest places of the province; and he shall do that which his fathers have not done, nor his fathers’fathers: he shall scatter among them prey, and spoil, and substance; yea, he shall devise his devices against fortresses, but only until the time.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָעֵר֩ כֹּח֨וֹ וּלְבָב֜וֹ עַל־מֶ֣לֶךְ הַנֶּ֘גֶב֮ בְּחַ֣יִל גָּדוֹל֒ וּמֶ֣לֶךְ הַנֶּ֗גֶב יִתְגָּרֶה֙ לַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה בְּחַֽיִל־גָּד֥וֹל וְעָצ֖וּם עַד־מְאֹ֑ד וְלֹ֣א יַעֲמֹ֔ד כִּֽי־יַחְשְׁב֥וּ עָלָ֖יו מַחֲשָׁבֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vy'r khchv vlbbv 'lmlkh hngb bchyl gdvl vmlkh hngb ytgrh lmlchmh bchylgdvl v'tsvm 'dm'd vl' y'md khyychshbv 'lyv mchshbvt
verses.translation: And he shall stir up his power and his courage against the king of the south with a great army; and the king of the south shall stir himself up to battle with a very great and mighty army; but he shall not stand, for they shall devise devices against him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֹכְלֵ֧י פַת־בָּג֛וֹ יִשְׁבְּר֖וּהוּ וְחֵיל֣וֹ יִשְׁט֑וֹף וְנָפְל֖וּ חֲלָלִ֥ים רַבִּֽים׃
verses.translit: v'khly ptbgv yshbrvhv vchylv yshtvf vnplv chllym rbym
verses.translation: Yea, they that eat of his food shall destroy him, and his army shall be swept away; and many shall fall down slain.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׁנֵיהֶ֤ם הַמְּלָכִים֙ לְבָבָ֣ם לְמֵרָ֔ע וְעַל־שֻׁלְחָ֥ן אֶחָ֖ד כָּזָ֣ב יְדַבֵּ֑רוּ וְלֹ֣א תִצְלָ֔ח כִּי־ע֥וֹד קֵ֖ץ לַמּוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.translit: vshnyhm hmlkhym lbbm lmr' v'lshlchn 'chd khzb ydbrv vl' ttslch khy'vd qts lmv'd
verses.translation: And as for both these kings, their hearts shall be to do mischief, and they shall speak lies at one table; but it shall not prosper, for the end remaineth yet for the time appointed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָשֹׁ֤ב אַרְצוֹ֙ בִּרְכ֣וּשׁ גָּד֔וֹל וּלְבָב֖וֹ עַל־בְּרִ֣ית קֹ֑דֶשׁ וְעָשָׂ֖ה וְשָׁ֥ב לְאַרְצֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyshb 'rtsv brkhvsh gdvl vlbbv 'lbryt qdsh v'shh vshb l'rtsv
verses.translation: And he shall return to his own land with great substance; and his heart shall be against the holy covenant; and he shall do his pleasure, and return to his own land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַמּוֹעֵ֥ד יָשׁ֖וּב וּבָ֣א בַנֶּ֑גֶב וְלֹֽא־תִהְיֶ֥ה כָרִאשֹׁנָ֖ה וְכָאַחֲרוֹנָֽה׃
verses.translit: lmv'd yshvb vb' bngb vl'thyh khr'shnh vkh'chrvnh
verses.translation: At the time appointed he shall return, and come into the south; but it shall not be in the latter time as it was in the former.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבָ֨אוּ ב֜וֹ צִיִּ֤ים כִּתִּים֙ וְנִכְאָ֔ה וְשָׁ֛ב וְזָעַ֥ם עַל־בְּרִֽית־ק֖וֹדֶשׁ וְעָשָׂ֑ה וְשָׁ֣ב וְיָבֵ֔ן עַל־עֹזְבֵ֖י בְּרִ֥ית קֹֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: vb'v bv tsyym khtym vnkh'h vshb vz'm 'lbrytqvdsh v'shh vshb vybn 'l'zby bryt qdsh
verses.translation: For ships of Kittim shall come against him, and he shall be cowed, and he shall return, and have indignation against the holy covenant, and shall do his pleasure; and he shall return, and have regard unto them that forsake the holy covenant.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּזְרֹעִ֖ים מִמֶּ֣נּוּ יַעֲמֹ֑דוּ וְחִלְּל֞וּ הַמִּקְדָּ֤שׁ הַמָּעוֹז֙ וְהֵסִ֣ירוּ הַתָּמִ֔יד וְנָתְנ֖וּ הַשִּׁקּ֥וּץ מְשֹׁמֵֽם׃
verses.translit: vzr'ym mmnv y'mdv vchllv hmqdsh hm'vz vhsyrv htmyd vntnv hshqvts mshmm
verses.translation: And arms shall stand on his part, and they shall profane the sanctuary, even the stronghold, and shall take away the continual burnt-offering, and they shall set up the detestable thing that causeth appalment.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמַרְשִׁיעֵ֣י בְרִ֔ית יַחֲנִ֖יף בַּחֲלַקּ֑וֹת וְעַ֛ם יֹדְעֵ֥י אֱלֹהָ֖יו יַחֲזִ֥קוּ וְעָשֽׂוּ׃
verses.translit: vmrshy'y bryt ychnyf bchlqvt v'm yd'y 'lhyv ychzqv v'shv
verses.translation: And such as do wickedly against the covenant shall be corrupt by blandishments; but the people that know their God shall show strength, and prevail.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמַשְׂכִּ֣ילֵי עָ֔ם יָבִ֖ינוּ לָֽרַבִּ֑ים וְנִכְשְׁל֞וּ בְּחֶ֧רֶב וּבְלֶהָבָ֛ה בִּשְׁבִ֥י וּבְבִזָּ֖ה יָמִֽים׃
verses.translit: vmshkhyly 'm ybynv lrbym vnkhshlv bchrb vblhbh bshby vbbzh ymym
verses.translation: And they that are wise among the people shall cause the many to understand; yet they shall stumble by the sword and by flame, by captivity and by spoil, many days.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְהִכָּ֣שְׁלָ֔ם יֵעָזְר֖וּ עֵ֣זֶר מְעָ֑ט וְנִלְו֧וּ עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם רַבִּ֖ים בַּחֲלַקְלַקּֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vbhkhshlm y'zrv 'zr m't vnlvv 'lyhm rbym bchlqlqvt
verses.translation: Now when they shall stumble, they shall be helped with a little help; but many shall join themselves unto them with blandishments.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִן־הַמַּשְׂכִּילִ֣ים יִכָּֽשְׁל֗וּ לִצְר֥וֹף בָּהֶ֛ם וּלְבָרֵ֥ר וְלַלְבֵּ֖ן עַד־עֵ֣ת קֵ֑ץ כִּי־ע֖וֹד לַמּוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.translit: vmnhmshkhylym ykhshlv ltsrvf bhm vlbrr vllbn 'd't qts khy'vd lmv'd
verses.translation: And some of them that are wise shall stumble, to refine among them, and to purify, and to make white, even to the time of the end; for it is yet for the time appointed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשָׂ֨ה כִרְצֹנ֜וֹ הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ וְיִתְרוֹמֵ֤ם וְיִתְגַּדֵּל֙ עַל־כׇּל־אֵ֔ל וְעַל֙ אֵ֣ל אֵלִ֔ים יְדַבֵּ֖ר נִפְלָא֑וֹת וְהִצְלִ֙יחַ֙ עַד־כָּ֣לָה זַ֔עַם כִּ֥י נֶחֱרָצָ֖ה נֶעֱשָֽׂתָה׃
verses.translit: v'shh khrtsnv hmlkh vytrvmm vytgdl 'lkhl'l v'l 'l 'lym ydbr npl'vt vhtslych 'dkhlh z'm khy nchrtsh n'shth
verses.translation: And the king shall do according to his will; and he shall exalt himself, and magnify himself above every god, and shall speak strange things against the God of gods; and he shall prosper till the indignation be accomplished; for that which is determined shall be done.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַל־אֱלֹהֵ֤י אֲבֹתָיו֙ לֹ֣א יָבִ֔ין וְעַל־חֶמְדַּ֥ת נָשִׁ֛ים וְעַֽל־כׇּל־אֱל֖וֹהַּ לֹ֣א יָבִ֑ין כִּ֥י עַל־כֹּ֖ל יִתְגַּדָּֽל׃
verses.translit: v'l'lhy 'btyv l' ybyn v'lchmdt nshym v'lkhl'lvh l' ybyn khy 'lkhl ytgdl
verses.translation: Neither shall he regard the gods of his fathers; and neither the desire of women, nor any god, shall he regard; for he shall magnify himself above all.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֶאֱלֹ֙הַּ֙ מָֽעֻזִּ֔ים עַל־כַּנּ֖וֹ יְכַבֵּ֑ד וְלֶאֱל֜וֹהַּ אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹא־יְדָעֻ֣הוּ אֲבֹתָ֗יו יְכַבֵּ֛ד בְּזָהָ֥ב וּבְכֶ֛סֶף וּבְאֶ֥בֶן יְקָרָ֖ה וּבַחֲמֻדֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vl'lh m'zym 'lkhnv ykhbd vl'lvh 'shr l'yd'hv 'btyv ykhbd bzhb vbkhsf vb'bn yqrh vbchmdvt
verses.translation: But in his place shall he honour the god of strongholds; and a god whom his fathers knew not shall he honour with gold, and silver, and with precious stones, and costly things. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשָׂ֞ה לְמִבְצְרֵ֤י מָֽעֻזִּים֙ עִם־אֱל֣וֹהַּ נֵכָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר (הכיר) [יַכִּ֖יר] יַרְבֶּ֣ה כָב֑וֹד וְהִמְשִׁילָם֙ בָּֽרַבִּ֔ים וַאֲדָמָ֖ה יְחַלֵּ֥ק בִּמְחִֽיר׃
verses.translit: v'shh lmbtsry m'zym 'm'lvh nkhr 'shr (hkhyr) [ykhyr] yrbh khbvd vhmshylm brbym v'dmh ychlq bmchyr
verses.translation: And he shall deal with the strongest fortresses with the help of a foreign god; whom he shall acknowledge, shall increase glory; and he shall cause them to rule over many, and shall divide the land for a price.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְעֵ֣ת קֵ֗ץ יִתְנַגַּ֤ח עִמּוֹ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הַנֶּ֔גֶב וְיִשְׂתָּעֵ֨ר עָלָ֜יו מֶ֣לֶךְ הַצָּפ֗וֹן בְּרֶ֙כֶב֙ וּבְפָ֣רָשִׁ֔ים וּבׇאֳנִיּ֖וֹת רַבּ֑וֹת וּבָ֥א בַאֲרָצ֖וֹת וְשָׁטַ֥ף וְעָבָֽר׃
verses.translit: vb't qts ytngch 'mv mlkh hngb vysht'r 'lyv mlkh htspvn brkhb vbprshym vb'nyvt rbvt vb' b'rtsvt vshtf v'br
verses.translation: And at the time of the end shall the king of the south push at him; and the king of the north shall come against him like a whirlwind, with chariots, and with horsemen, and with many ships; and he shall enter into the countries, and shall overflow, as he passes through.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבָא֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ הַצְּבִ֔י וְרַבּ֖וֹת יִכָּשֵׁ֑לוּ וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ יִמָּלְט֣וּ מִיָּד֔וֹ אֱד֣וֹם וּמוֹאָ֔ב וְרֵאשִׁ֖ית בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: vb' b'rts htsby vrbvt ykhshlv v'lh ymltv mydv 'dvm vmv'b vr'shyt bny 'mvn
verses.translation: He shall enter also into the beauteous land, and many countries shall be overthrown; but these shall be delivered out of his hand, Edom, and Moab, and the chief of the children of Ammon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיִשְׁלַ֥ח יָד֖וֹ בַּאֲרָצ֑וֹת וְאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם לֹ֥א תִהְיֶ֖ה לִפְלֵיטָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyshlch ydv b'rtsvt v'rts mtsrym l' thyh lplyth
verses.translation: He shall stretch forth his hand also upon the countries; and the land of Egypt shall not escape.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמָשַׁ֗ל בְּמִכְמַנֵּי֙ הַזָּהָ֣ב וְהַכֶּ֔סֶף וּבְכֹ֖ל חֲמֻד֣וֹת מִצְרָ֑יִם וְלֻבִ֥ים וְכֻשִׁ֖ים בְּמִצְעָדָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vmshl bmkhmny hzhb vhkhsf vbkhl chmdvt mtsrym vlbym vkhshym bmts'dyv
verses.translation: But he shall have power over the treasures of gold and silver, and over all the precious things of Egypt; and the Libyans and the Ethiopians shall be at his steps.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׁמֻע֣וֹת יְבַהֲלֻ֔הוּ מִמִּזְרָ֖ח וּמִצָּפ֑וֹן וְיָצָא֙ בְּחֵמָ֣א גְדֹלָ֔ה לְהַשְׁמִ֥יד וּֽלְהַחֲרִ֖ים רַבִּֽים׃
verses.translit: vshm'vt ybhlhv mmzrch vmtspvn vyts' bchm' gdlh lhshmyd vlhchrym rbym
verses.translation: But tidings out of the east and out of the north shall affright him; and he shall go forth with great fury to destroy and utterly to take away many.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיִטַּע֙ אׇהֳלֵ֣י אַפַּדְנ֔וֹ בֵּ֥ין יַמִּ֖ים לְהַר־צְבִי־קֹ֑דֶשׁ וּבָא֙ עַד־קִצּ֔וֹ וְאֵ֥ין עוֹזֵ֖ר לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyt' 'hly 'pdnv byn ymym lhrtsbyqdsh vb' 'dqtsv v'yn 'vzr lv
verses.translation: And he shall plant the tents of his palace between the seas and the beauteous holy mountain; and he shall come to his end, and none shall help him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבָעֵ֣ת הַהִיא֩ יַעֲמֹ֨ד מִֽיכָאֵ֜ל הַשַּׂ֣ר הַגָּד֗וֹל הָעֹמֵד֮ עַל־בְּנֵ֣י עַמֶּ֒ךָ֒ וְהָיְתָה֙ עֵ֣ת צָרָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־נִהְיְתָה֙ מִֽהְי֣וֹת גּ֔וֹי עַ֖ד הָעֵ֣ת הַהִ֑יא וּבָעֵ֤ת הַהִיא֙ יִמָּלֵ֣ט עַמְּךָ֔ כׇּל־הַנִּמְצָ֖א כָּת֥וּב בַּסֵּֽפֶר׃
verses.translit: vb't hhy' y'md mykh'l hshr hgdvl h'md 'lbny 'mkh vhyth 't tsrh 'shr l'nhyth mhyvt gvy 'd h't hhy' vb't hhy' ymlt 'mkh khlhnmts' khtvb bspr
verses.translation: And at that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince who standeth for the children of thy people; and there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time; and at that time thy people shall be delivered, every one that shall be found written in the book.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרַבִּ֕ים מִיְּשֵׁנֵ֥י אַדְמַת־עָפָ֖ר יָקִ֑יצוּ אֵ֚לֶּה לְחַיֵּ֣י עוֹלָ֔ם וְאֵ֥לֶּה לַחֲרָפ֖וֹת לְדִרְא֥וֹן עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: vrbym myshny 'dmt'pr yqytsv 'lh lchyy 'vlm v'lh lchrpvt ldr'vn 'vlm
verses.translation: And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to reproaches and everlasting abhorrence.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַ֨מַּשְׂכִּלִ֔ים יַזְהִ֖רוּ כְּזֹ֣הַר הָרָקִ֑יעַ וּמַצְדִּיקֵי֙ הָֽרַבִּ֔ים כַּכּוֹכָבִ֖ים לְעוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhmshkhlym yzhrv khzhr hrqy' vmtsdyqy hrbym khkhvkhbym l'vlm v'd {p}
verses.translation: And they that are wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn the many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה דָֽנִיֵּ֗אל סְתֹ֧ם הַדְּבָרִ֛ים וַחֲתֹ֥ם הַסֵּ֖פֶר עַד־עֵ֣ת קֵ֑ץ יְשֹׁטְט֥וּ רַבִּ֖ים וְתִרְבֶּ֥ה הַדָּֽעַת׃
verses.translit: v'th dny'l stm hdbrym vchtm hspr 'd't qts yshttv rbym vtrbh hd't
verses.translation: But thou, O Daniel, shut up the words, and seal the book, even to the time of the end; many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall be increased.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרָאִ֙יתִי֙ אֲנִ֣י דָנִיֵּ֔אל וְהִנֵּ֛ה שְׁנַ֥יִם אֲחֵרִ֖ים עֹמְדִ֑ים אֶחָ֥ד הֵ֙נָּה֙ לִשְׂפַ֣ת הַיְאֹ֔ר וְאֶחָ֥ד הֵ֖נָּה לִשְׂפַ֥ת הַיְאֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vr'yty 'ny dny'l vhnh shnym 'chrym 'mdym 'chd hnh lshpt hy'r v'chd hnh lshpt hy'r
verses.translation: Then I Daniel looked, and, behold, there stood other two, the one on the bank of the river on this side, and the other on the bank of the river on that side.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר לָאִישׁ֙ לְב֣וּשׁ הַבַּדִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר מִמַּ֖עַל לְמֵימֵ֣י הַיְאֹ֑ר עַד־מָתַ֖י קֵ֥ץ הַפְּלָאֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vy'mr l'ysh lbvsh hbdym 'shr mm'l lmymy hy'r 'dmty qts hpl'vt
verses.translation: And one said to the man clothed in linen, who was above the waters of the river: ‘How long shall it be to the end of the wonders?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֶשְׁמַ֞ע אֶת־הָאִ֣ישׁ  לְב֣וּשׁ הַבַּדִּ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר מִמַּ֘עַל֮ לְמֵימֵ֣י הַיְאֹר֒ וַיָּ֨רֶם יְמִינ֤וֹ וּשְׂמֹאלוֹ֙ אֶל־הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וַיִּשָּׁבַ֖ע בְּחֵ֣י הָעוֹלָ֑ם כִּי֩ לְמוֹעֵ֨ד מֽוֹעֲדִ֜ים וָחֵ֗צִי וּכְכַלּ֛וֹת נַפֵּ֥ץ יַד־עַם־קֹ֖דֶשׁ תִּכְלֶ֥ינָה כׇל־אֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.translit: v'shm' 'th'ysh  lbvsh hbdym 'shr mm'l lmymy hy'r vyrm ymynv vshm'lv 'lhshmym vyshb' bchy h'vlm khy lmv'd mv'dym vchtsy vkhkhlvt npts yd'mqdsh tkhlynh khl'lh
verses.translation: And I heard the man clothed in linen, who was above the waters of the river, when he lifted up his right hand and his left hand unto heaven, and swore by Him that liveth for ever that it shall be for a time, times, and a half; and when they have made an end of breaking in pieces the power of the holy people, all these things shall be finished.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֥י שָׁמַ֖עְתִּי וְלֹ֣א אָבִ֑ין וָאֹ֣מְרָ֔ה אֲדֹנִ֕י מָ֥ה אַחֲרִ֖ית אֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.translit: v'ny shm'ty vl' 'byn v'mrh 'dny mh 'chryt 'lh
verses.translation: And I heard, but I understood not; then said I: ‘O my Lord, what shall be the latter end of these things?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר לֵ֣ךְ דָּנִיֵּ֑אל כִּֽי־סְתֻמִ֧ים וַחֲתֻמִ֛ים הַדְּבָרִ֖ים עַד־עֵ֥ת קֵֽץ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr lkh dny'l khystmym vchtmym hdbrym 'd't qts
verses.translation: And he said: ‘Go thy way, Daniel; for the words are shut up and sealed till the time of the end.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִ֠תְבָּֽרְר֠וּ וְיִֽתְלַבְּנ֤וּ וְיִצָּֽרְפוּ֙ רַבִּ֔ים וְהִרְשִׁ֣יעוּ רְשָׁעִ֔ים וְלֹ֥א יָבִ֖ינוּ כׇּל־רְשָׁעִ֑ים וְהַמַּשְׂכִּלִ֖ים יָבִֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: ytbrrv vytlbnv vytsrpv rbym vhrshy'v rsh'ym vl' ybynv khlrsh'ym vhmshkhlym ybynv
verses.translation: Many shall purify themselves, and make themselves white, and be refined; but the wicked shall do wickedly; and none of the wicked shall understand; but they that are wise shall understand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמֵעֵת֙ הוּסַ֣ר הַתָּמִ֔יד וְלָתֵ֖ת שִׁקּ֣וּץ שֹׁמֵ֑ם יָמִ֕ים אֶ֖לֶף מָאתַ֥יִם וְתִשְׁעִֽים׃
verses.translit: vm't hvsr htmyd vltt shqvts shmm ymym 'lf m'tym vtsh'ym
verses.translation: And from the time that the continual burnt-offering shall be taken away, and the detestable thing that causes appalment set up, there shall be a thousand two hundred and ninety days.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַשְׁרֵ֥י הַֽמְחַכֶּ֖ה וְיַגִּ֑יעַ לְיָמִ֕ים אֶ֕לֶף שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וַחֲמִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.translit: 'shry hmchkhh vygy' lymym 'lf shlsh m'vt shlshym vchmshh
verses.translation: Happy is he that waiteth, and cometh to the thousand three hundred and five and thirty days.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֖ה לֵ֣ךְ לַקֵּ֑ץ וְתָנ֛וּחַ וְתַעֲמֹ֥ד לְגֹרָלְךָ֖ לְקֵ֥ץ הַיָּמִֽין׃
verses.translit: v'th lkh lqts vtnvch vt'md lgrlkh lqts hymyn
verses.translation: But go thou thy way till the end be; and thou shalt rest, and shalt stand up to thy lot, at the end of the days.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבִשְׁנַ֣ת אַחַ֗ת לְכ֙וֹרֶשׁ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ פָּרַ֔ס לִכְל֥וֹת דְּבַר־יְהֹוָ֖ה מִפִּ֣י יִרְמְיָ֑ה הֵעִ֣יר יְהֹוָ֗ה אֶת־ר֙וּחַ֙ כֹּ֣רֶשׁ מֶֽלֶךְ־פָּרַ֔ס וַיַּֽעֲבֶר־קוֹל֙ בְּכׇל־מַלְכוּת֔וֹ וְגַם־בְּמִכְתָּ֖ב לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vbshnt 'cht lkhvrsh mlkh prs lkhlvt dbryhvh mpy yrmyh h'yr yhvh 'trvch khrsh mlkhprs vy'brqvl bkhlmlkhvtv vgmbmkhtb l'mr
verses.translation: NOW IN the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that the word of the LORD by the mouth of Jeremiah might be accomplished, the LORD stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה אָמַ֗ר כֹּ֚רֶשׁ מֶ֣לֶךְ פָּרַ֔ס כֹּ֚ל מַמְלְכ֣וֹת הָאָ֔רֶץ נָ֣תַן לִ֔י יְהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְהֽוּא־פָקַ֤ד עָלַי֙ לִבְנֽוֹת־ל֣וֹ בַ֔יִת בִּירוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּֽיהוּדָֽה׃
verses.translit: khh 'mr khrsh mlkh prs khl mmlkhvt h'rts ntn ly yhvh 'lhy hshmym vhv'pqd 'ly lbnvtlv byt byrvshl͏m 'shr byhvdh
verses.translation: ’Thus saith Cyrus king of Persia: All the kingdoms of the earth hath the LORD, the God of heaven, given me; and He hath charged me to build Him a house in Jerusalem, which is in Judah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִֽי־בָכֶ֣ם מִכׇּל־עַמּ֗וֹ יְהִ֤י אֱלֹהָיו֙ עִמּ֔וֹ וְיַ֕עַל לִירוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּיהוּדָ֑ה וְיִ֗בֶן אֶת־בֵּ֤ית יְהֹוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל ה֥וּא הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּירוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: mybkhm mkhl'mv yhy 'lhyv 'mv vy'l lyrvshl͏m 'shr byhvdh vybn 'tbyt yhvh 'lhy yshr'l hv' h'lhym 'shr byrvshl͏m
verses.translation: Whosoever there is among you of all His people—his God be with him—let him go up to Jerusalem, which is in Judah, and build the house of the LORD, the God of Israel, He is the God who is in Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכׇל־הַנִּשְׁאָ֗ר מִֽכׇּל־הַמְּקֹמוֹת֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר ה֣וּא גָֽר־שָׁם֒ יְנַשְּׂא֙וּהוּ֙ אַנְשֵׁ֣י מְקֹמ֔וֹ בְּכֶ֥סֶף וּבְזָהָ֖ב וּבִרְכ֣וּשׁ וּבִבְהֵמָ֑ה עִ֨ם־הַנְּדָבָ֔ה לְבֵ֥ית הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּירוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: vkhlhnsh'r mkhlhmqmvt 'shr hv' grshm ynsh'vhv 'nshy mqmv bkhsf vbzhb vbrkhvsh vbbhmh 'mhndbh lbyt h'lhym 'shr byrvshl͏m
verses.translation: And whosoever is left, in any place where he sojourneth, let the men of his place help him with silver, and with gold, and with goods, and with beasts, beside the freewill-offering for the house of God which is in Jerusalem.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּק֜וּמוּ רָאשֵׁ֣י הָאָב֗וֹת לִֽיהוּדָה֙ וּבִנְיָמִ֔ן וְהַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֑ם לְכֹ֨ל הֵעִ֤יר הָאֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת־רוּח֔וֹ לַעֲל֣וֹת לִבְנ֔וֹת אֶת־בֵּ֥ית יְהֹוָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּירוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: vyqvmv r'shy h'bvt lyhvdh vbnymn vhkhhnym vhlvym lkhl h'yr h'lhym 'trvchv l'lvt lbnvt 'tbyt yhvh 'shr byrvshl͏m
verses.translation: Then rose up the heads of fathers’houses of Judah and Benjamin, and the priests, and the Levites, even all whose spirit God had stirred to go up to build the house of the LORD which is in Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכׇל־סְבִיבֹֽתֵיהֶם֙ חִזְּק֣וּ בִֽידֵיהֶ֔ם בִּכְלֵי־כֶ֧סֶף בַּזָּהָ֛ב בָּרְכ֥וּשׁ וּבַבְּהֵמָ֖ה וּבַמִּגְדָּנ֑וֹת לְבַ֖ד עַל־כׇּל־הִתְנַדֵּֽב׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vkhlsbybtyhm chzqv bydyhm bkhlykhsf bzhb brkhvsh vbbhmh vbmgdnvt lbd 'lkhlhtndb {p}
verses.translation: And all they that were round about them strengthened their hands with vessels of silver, with gold, with goods, and with beasts, and with precious things, beside all that was willingly offered.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַמֶּ֣לֶךְ כּ֔וֹרֶשׁ הוֹצִ֖יא אֶת־כְּלֵ֣י בֵית־יְהֹוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר הוֹצִ֤יא נְבֽוּכַדְנֶצַּר֙ מִיר֣וּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם וַֽיִּתְּנֵ֖ם בְּבֵ֥ית אֱלֹהָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vhmlkh khvrsh hvtsy' 'tkhly bytyhvh 'shr hvtsy' nbvkhdntsr myrvshl͏m vytnm bbyt 'lhyv
verses.translation: Also Cyrus the king brought forth the vessels of the house of the LORD, which Nebuchadnezzar had brought forth out of Jerusalem, and had put them in the house of his gods;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיּֽוֹצִיאֵ֗ם כּ֚וֹרֶשׁ מֶ֣לֶךְ פָּרַ֔ס עַל־יַ֖ד מִתְרְדָ֣ת הַגִּזְבָּ֑ר וַֽיִּסְפְּרֵם֙ לְשֵׁשְׁבַּצַּ֔ר הַנָּשִׂ֖יא לִיהוּדָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyvtsy'm khvrsh mlkh prs 'lyd mtrdt hgzbr vysprm lshshbtsr hnshy' lyhvdh {s}
verses.translation: even those did Cyrus king of Persia bring forth by the hand of Mithredath the treasurer, and numbered them unto Sheshbazzar, the prince of Judah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֖לֶּה מִסְפָּרָ֑ם אֲגַרְטְלֵ֨י זָהָ֜ב שְׁלֹשִׁ֗ים אֲגַרְטְלֵי־כֶ֙סֶף֙ אָ֔לֶף מַחֲלָפִ֖ים תִּשְׁעָ֥ה וְעֶשְׂרִֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'lh msprm 'grtly zhb shlshym 'grtlykhsf 'lf mchlpym tsh'h v'shrym {s}
verses.translation: And this is the number of them: thirty basins of gold, a thousand basins of silver, nine and twenty knives;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּפוֹרֵ֤י זָהָב֙ שְׁלֹשִׁ֔ים כְּפ֤וֹרֵי כֶ֙סֶף֙ מִשְׁנִ֔ים אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וַעֲשָׂרָ֑ה כֵּלִ֥ים אֲחֵרִ֖ים אָֽלֶף׃
verses.translit: khpvry zhb shlshym khpvry khsf mshnym 'rb' m'vt v'shrh khlym 'chrym 'lf
verses.translation: thirty bowls of gold, silver bowls of a second sort four hundred and ten, and other vessels a thousand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־כֵּלִים֙ לַזָּהָ֣ב וְלַכֶּ֔סֶף חֲמֵ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֖ים וְאַרְבַּ֣ע מֵא֑וֹת הַכֹּ֞ל הֶעֱלָ֣ה שֵׁשְׁבַּצַּ֗ר עִ֚ם הֵעָל֣וֹת הַגּוֹלָ֔ה מִבָּבֶ֖ל לִירוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khlkhlym lzhb vlkhsf chmsht 'lpym v'rb' m'vt hkhl h'lh shshbtsr 'm h'lvt hgvlh mbbl lyrvshl͏m {p}
verses.translation: All the vessels of gold and of silver were five thousand and four hundred. All these did Sheshbazzar bring up, when they of the captivity were brought up from Babylon unto Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֣לֶּה  בְּנֵ֣י הַמְּדִינָ֗ה הָֽעֹלִים֙ מִשְּׁבִ֣י הַגּוֹלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶגְלָ֛ה (נבוכדנצור) [נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֥ר] מֶֽלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֖ל לְבָבֶ֑ל וַיָּשׁ֛וּבוּ לִירוּשָׁלַ֥͏ִם וִֽיהוּדָ֖ה אִ֥ישׁ לְעִירֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'lh  bny hmdynh h'lym mshby hgvlh 'shr hglh (nbvkhdntsvr) [nbvkhdntsr] mlkhbbl lbbl vyshvbv lyrvshl͏m vyhvdh 'ysh l'yrv
verses.translation: Now these are the children of the province, that went up out of the captivity of those that had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away unto Babylon, and that returned unto Jerusalem and Judah, every one unto his city;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר־בָּ֣אוּ עִם־זְרֻבָּבֶ֗ל יֵשׁ֡וּעַ נְ֠חֶמְיָ֠ה שְׂרָיָ֨ה רְֽעֵלָיָ֜ה מׇרְדֳּכַ֥י בִּלְשָׁ֛ן מִסְפָּ֥ר בִּגְוַ֖י רְח֣וּם בַּעֲנָ֑ה מִסְפַּ֕ר אַנְשֵׁ֖י עַ֥ם יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'shrb'v 'mzrbbl yshv' nchmyh shryh r'lyh mrdkhy blshn mspr bgvy rchvm b'nh mspr 'nshy 'm yshr'l {s}
verses.translation: who came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, Reelaiah, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispar, Bigvai, Rehum, Baanah. The number of the men of the people of Israel: .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֔שׁ אַלְפַּ֕יִם מֵאָ֖ה שִׁבְעִ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny pr'sh 'lpym m'h shb'ym vshnym {s}
verses.translation: The children of Parosh, two thousand a hundred seventy and two.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י שְׁפַטְיָ֔ה שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שִׁבְעִ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny shptyh shlsh m'vt shb'ym vshnym {s}
verses.translation: The children of Shephatiah, three hundred seventy and two.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י אָרַ֔ח שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת חֲמִשָּׁ֥ה וְשִׁבְעִֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny 'rch shb' m'vt chmshh vshb'ym {s}
verses.translation: The children of Arah, seven hundred seventy and five.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵֽי־פַחַ֥ת מוֹאָ֛ב לִבְנֵ֥י יֵשׁ֖וּעַ יוֹאָ֑ב אַלְפַּ֕יִם שְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵא֖וֹת וּשְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bnypcht mv'b lbny yshv' yv'b 'lpym shmnh m'vt vshnym 'shr {s}
verses.translation: The children of Pahath-moab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab, two thousand eight hundred and twelve.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י עֵילָ֔ם אֶ֕לֶף מָאתַ֖יִם חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny 'ylm 'lf m'tym chmshym v'rb'h {s}
verses.translation: The children of Elam, a thousand two hundred fifty and four.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י זַתּ֔וּא תְּשַׁ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וְאַרְבָּעִ֥ים וַחֲמִשָּֽׁה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny ztv' tsh' m'vt v'rb'ym vchmshh {s}
verses.translation: The children of Zattu, nine hundred forty and five.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י זַכָּ֔י שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וְשִׁשִּֽׁים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny zkhy shb' m'vt vshshym {s}
verses.translation: The children of Zaccai, seven hundred and threescore.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י בָנִ֔י שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny bny shsh m'vt 'rb'ym vshnym {s}
verses.translation: The children of Bani, six hundred forty and two.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י בֵבָ֔י שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny bby shsh m'vt 'shrym vshlshh {s}
verses.translation: The children of Bebai, six hundred twenty and three.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י עַזְגָּ֔ד אֶ֕לֶף מָאתַ֖יִם עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny 'zgd 'lf m'tym 'shrym vshnym {s}
verses.translation: The children of Azgad, a thousand two hundred twenty and two.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵי֙ אֲדֹ֣נִיקָ֔ם שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שִׁשִּׁ֥ים וְשִׁשָּֽׁה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny 'dnyqm shsh m'vt shshym vshshh {s}
verses.translation: The children of Adonikam, six hundred sixty and six.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י בִגְוָ֔י אַלְפַּ֖יִם חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וְשִׁשָּֽׁה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny bgvy 'lpym chmshym vshshh {s}
verses.translation: The children of Bigvai, two thousand fifty and six.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י עָדִ֔ין אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny 'dyn 'rb' m'vt chmshym v'rb'h {s}
verses.translation: The children of Adin, four hundred fifty and four.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵֽי־אָטֵ֥ר לִֽיחִזְקִיָּ֖ה תִּשְׁעִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny'tr lychzqyh tsh'ym vshmnh {s}
verses.translation: The children of Ater, of Hezekiah, ninety and eight.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י בֵצָ֔י שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny btsy shlsh m'vt 'shrym vshlshh {s}
verses.translation: The children of Bezai, three hundred twenty and three.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י יוֹרָ֔ה מֵאָ֖ה וּשְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny yvrh m'h vshnym 'shr {s}
verses.translation: The children of Jorah, a hundred and twelve.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י חָשֻׁ֔ם מָאתַ֖יִם עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny chshm m'tym 'shrym vshlshh {s}
verses.translation: The children of Hashum, two hundred twenty and three.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֥י גִבָּ֖ר תִּשְׁעִ֥ים וַחֲמִשָּֽׁה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny gbr tsh'ym vchmshh {s}
verses.translation: The children of Gibbar, ninety and five.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י בֵֽית־לָ֔חֶם מֵאָ֖ה עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny bytlchm m'h 'shrym vshlshh {s}
verses.translation: The children of Beth-lehem, a hundred twenty and three.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַנְשֵׁ֥י נְטֹפָ֖ה חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וְשִׁשָּֽׁה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'nshy ntph chmshym vshshh {s}
verses.translation: The men of Netophah, fifty and six.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַנְשֵׁ֣י עֲנָת֔וֹת מֵאָ֖ה עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'nshy 'ntvt m'h 'shrym vshmnh {s}
verses.translation: The men of Anathoth, a hundred twenty and eight.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֥י עַזְמָ֖וֶת אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny 'zmvt 'rb'ym vshnym {s}
verses.translation: The children of Azmaveth, forty and two.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֨י קִרְיַ֤ת עָרִים֙ כְּפִירָ֣ה וּבְאֵר֔וֹת שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וְאַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּשְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny qryt 'rym khpyrh vb'rvt shb' m'vt v'rb'ym vshlshh {s}
verses.translation: The children of Kiriath-arim, Chephirah, and Beeroth, seven hundred and forty and three.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֤י הָרָמָה֙ וָגָ֔בַע שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאֶחָֽד׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny hrmh vgb' shsh m'vt 'shrym v'chd {s}
verses.translation: The children of Ramah and Geba, six hundred twenty and one.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַנְשֵׁ֣י מִכְמָ֔ס מֵאָ֖ה עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'nshy mkhms m'h 'shrym vshnym {s}
verses.translation: The men of Michmas, a hundred twenty and two.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַנְשֵׁ֤י בֵֽית־אֵל֙ וְהָעָ֔י מָאתַ֖יִם עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'nshy byt'l vh'y m'tym 'shrym vshlshh {s}
verses.translation: The men of Beth-el and Ai, two hundred twenty and three.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֥י נְב֖וֹ חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny nbv chmshym vshnym {s}
verses.translation: The children of Nebo, fifty and two.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י מַגְבִּ֔ישׁ מֵאָ֖ה חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וְשִׁשָּֽׁה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny mgbysh m'h chmshym vshshh {s}
verses.translation: The children of Magbish, a hundred fifty and six.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵי֙ עֵילָ֣ם אַחֵ֔ר אֶ֕לֶף מָאתַ֖יִם חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny 'ylm 'chr 'lf m'tym chmshym v'rb'h {s}
verses.translation: The children of the other Elam, a thousand two hundred fifty and four.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י חָרִ֔ם שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת וְעֶשְׂרִֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny chrm shlsh m'vt v'shrym {s}
verses.translation: The children of Harim, three hundred and twenty.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵי־לֹד֙ חָדִ֣יד וְאוֹנ֔וֹ שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וַחֲמִשָּֽׁה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bnyld chdyd v'vnv shb' m'vt 'shrym vchmshh {s}
verses.translation: The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono, seven hundred twenty and five.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י יְרֵח֔וֹ שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וַחֲמִשָּֽׁה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny yrchv shlsh m'vt 'rb'ym vchmshh {s}
verses.translation: The children of Jericho, three hundred forty and five.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י סְנָאָ֔ה שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֔ים וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת וּשְׁלֹשִֽׁים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny sn'h shlsht 'lpym vshsh m'vt vshlshym {s}
verses.translation: The children of Senaah, three thousand and six hundred and thirty.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַֽכֹּהֲנִ֑ים {פ} בְּנֵ֤י יְדַֽעְיָה֙ לְבֵ֣ית יֵשׁ֔וּעַ תְּשַׁ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שִׁבְעִ֥ים וּשְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hkhhnym {p} bny yd'yh lbyt yshv' tsh' m'vt shb'ym vshlshh {s}
verses.translation: The priests: The children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua, nine hundred seventy and three.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י אִמֵּ֔ר אֶ֖לֶף חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny 'mr 'lf chmshym vshnym {s}
verses.translation: The children of Immer, a thousand fifty and two.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י פַשְׁח֔וּר אֶ֕לֶף מָאתַ֖יִם אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וְשִׁבְעָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny pshchvr 'lf m'tym 'rb'ym vshb'h {s}
verses.translation: The children of Pashhur, a thousand two hundred forty and seven. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י חָרִ֔ם אֶ֖לֶף וְשִׁבְעָ֥ה עָשָֽׂר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny chrm 'lf vshb'h 'shr {s}
verses.translation: The children of Harim, a thousand and seventeen.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַלְוִיִּ֑ם בְּנֵי־יֵשׁ֧וּעַ וְקַדְמִיאֵ֛ל לִבְנֵ֥י הוֹדַוְיָ֖ה שִׁבְעִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hlvym bnyyshv' vqdmy'l lbny hvdvyh shb'ym v'rb'h {s}
verses.translation: The Levites: the children of Jeshua and Kadmiel, of the children of Hodaviah, seventy and four.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַֽמְשֹׁרְרִ֑ים בְּנֵ֣י אָסָ֔ף מֵאָ֖ה עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hmshrrym bny 'sf m'h 'shrym vshmnh {s}
verses.translation: The singers: the children of Asaph, a hundred twenty and eight.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י הַשֹּֽׁעֲרִ֗ים בְּנֵי־שַׁלּ֤וּם בְּנֵֽי־אָטֵר֙ בְּנֵי־טַלְמֹ֣ן בְּנֵי־עַקּ֔וּב בְּנֵ֥י חֲטִיטָ֖א בְּנֵ֣י שֹׁבָ֑י הַכֹּ֕ל מֵאָ֖ה שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וְתִשְׁעָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny hsh'rym bnyshlvm bny'tr bnytlmn bny'qvb bny chtyt' bny shby hkhl m'h shlshym vtsh'h {s}
verses.translation: The children of the porters: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai, in all a hundred thirty and nine.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַנְּתִינִ֑ים בְּנֵי־צִיחָ֥א בְנֵי־חֲשׂוּפָ֖א בְּנֵ֥י טַבָּעֽוֹת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hntynym bnytsych' bnychshvp' bny tb'vt {s}
verses.translation: The Nethinim: the children of Ziha, the children of Hasupha, the children of Tabbaoth;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵי־קֵרֹ֥ס בְּֽנֵי־סִֽיעֲהָ֖א בְּנֵ֥י פָדֽוֹן׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bnyqrs bnysy'h' bny pdvn {s}
verses.translation: the children of Keros, the children of Siaha, the children of Padon;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵי־לְבָנָ֥ה בְנֵי־חֲגָבָ֖ה בְּנֵ֥י עַקּֽוּב׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bnylbnh bnychgbh bny 'qvb {s}
verses.translation: the children of Lebanah, the children of Hagabah, the children of Akkub;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵי־חָגָ֥ב בְּנֵי־[שַׁלְמַ֖י] (שמלי) בְּנֵ֥י חָנָֽן׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bnychgb bny[shlmy] (shmly) bny chnn {s}
verses.translation: the children of Hagab, the children of Salmai, the children of Hanan;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵי־גִדֵּ֥ל בְּנֵי־גַ֖חַר בְּנֵ֥י רְאָיָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bnygdl bnygchr bny r'yh {s}
verses.translation: the children of Giddel, the children of Gahar, the children of Reaiah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵי־רְצִ֥ין בְּנֵי־נְקוֹדָ֖א בְּנֵ֥י גַזָּֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bnyrtsyn bnynqvd' bny gzm {s}
verses.translation: the children of Rezin, the children of Nekoda, the children of Gazzam;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵי־עֻזָּ֥א בְנֵי־פָסֵ֖חַ בְּנֵ֥י בֵסָֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny'z' bnypsch bny bsy {s}
verses.translation: the children of Uzza, the children of Paseah, the children of Besai;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵי־אַסְנָ֥ה בְנֵי־מְעוּנִ֖ים בְּנֵ֥י (נפיסים) [נְפוּסִֽים]׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny'snh bnym'vnym bny (npysym) [npvsym] {s}
verses.translation: the children of Asnah, the children of Meunim, the children of Nephusim;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵי־בַקְבּ֥וּק בְּנֵי־חֲקוּפָ֖א בְּנֵ֥י חַרְחֽוּר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bnybqbvq bnychqvp' bny chrchvr {s}
verses.translation: the children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵי־בַצְל֥וּת בְּנֵי־מְחִידָ֖א בְּנֵ֥י חַרְשָֽׁא׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bnybtslvt bnymchyd' bny chrsh' {s}
verses.translation: the children of Bazluth, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵי־בַרְק֥וֹס בְּֽנֵי־סִֽיסְרָ֖א בְּנֵי־תָֽמַח׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bnybrqvs bnysysr' bnytmch {s}
verses.translation: the children of Barkos, the children of Sisera, the children of Temah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֥י נְצִ֖יחַ בְּנֵ֥י חֲטִיפָֽא׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny ntsych bny chtyp' {s}
verses.translation: the children of Neziah, the children of Hatipha.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֖י עַבְדֵ֣י שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה בְּנֵי־סֹטַ֥י בְּנֵי־הַסֹּפֶ֖רֶת בְּנֵ֥י פְרוּדָֽא׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny 'bdy shlmh bnysty bnyhsprt bny prvd' {s}
verses.translation: The children of Solomon’s servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Hassophereth, the children of Peruda;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵי־יַעְלָ֥ה בְנֵי־דַרְק֖וֹן בְּנֵ֥י גִדֵּֽל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bnyy'lh bnydrqvn bny gdl {s}
verses.translation: the children of Jaalah, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֧י שְׁפַטְיָ֣ה בְנֵֽי־חַטִּ֗יל בְּנֵ֛י פֹּכֶ֥רֶת הַצְּבָיִ֖ים בְּנֵ֥י אָמִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny shptyh bnychtyl bny pkhrt htsbyym bny 'my {s}
verses.translation: the children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth-hazzebaim, the children of Ami.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּ֨ל־הַנְּתִינִ֔ים וּבְנֵ֖י עַבְדֵ֣י שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת תִּשְׁעִ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khlhntynym vbny 'bdy shlmh shlsh m'vt tsh'ym vshnym {p}
verses.translation: All the Nethinim, and the children of Solomon’s servants, were three hundred ninety and two.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֗לֶּה הָֽעֹלִים֙ מִתֵּ֥ל מֶ֙לַח֙ תֵּ֣ל חַרְשָׁ֔א כְּר֥וּב אַדָּ֖ן אִמֵּ֑ר וְלֹ֣א יָֽכְל֗וּ לְהַגִּ֤יד בֵּית־אֲבוֹתָם֙ וְזַרְעָ֔ם אִ֥ם מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הֵֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'lh h'lym mtl mlch tl chrsh' khrvb 'dn 'mr vl' ykhlv lhgyd byt'bvtm vzr'm 'm myshr'l hm {s}
verses.translation: And these were they that went up from Tel-melah, Tel-harsa, Cherub, Addan, and Immer; but they could not tell their fathers’houses, and their seed, whether they were of Israel:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵי־דְלָיָ֥ה בְנֵי־טוֹבִיָּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י נְקוֹדָ֑א שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bnydlyh bnytvbyh bny nqvd' shsh m'vt chmshym vshnym {s}
verses.translation: the children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred fifty and two.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִבְּנֵי֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים בְּנֵ֥י חֳבַיָּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י הַקּ֑וֹץ בְּנֵ֣י בַרְזִלַּ֗י אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָ֠קַ֠ח מִבְּנ֞וֹת בַּרְזִלַּ֤י הַגִּלְעָדִי֙ אִשָּׁ֔ה וַיִּקָּרֵ֖א עַל־שְׁמָֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vmbny hkhhnym bny chbyh bny hqvts bny brzly 'shr lqch mbnvt brzly hgl'dy 'shh vyqr' 'lshmm {s}
verses.translation: And of the children of the priests: the children of Habaiah, the children of Hakkoz, the children of Barzillai, who took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and was called after their name.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֗לֶּה בִּקְשׁ֧וּ כְתָבָ֛ם הַמִּתְיַחְשִׂ֖ים וְלֹ֣א נִמְצָ֑אוּ וַֽיְגֹאֲל֖וּ מִן־הַכְּהֻנָּֽה׃
verses.translit: 'lh bqshv khtbm hmtychshym vl' nmts'v vyg'lv mnhkhhnh
verses.translation: These sought their register, that is, the genealogy, but it was not found; therefore were they deemed polluted and put from the priesthood.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר הַתִּרְשָׁ֙תָא֙ לָהֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־יֹאכְל֖וּ מִקֹּ֣דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁ֑ים עַ֛ד עֲמֹ֥ד כֹּהֵ֖ן לְאוּרִ֥ים וּלְתֻמִּֽים׃
verses.translit: vy'mr htrsht' lhm 'shr l'y'khlv mqdsh hqdshym 'd 'md khhn l'vrym vltmym
verses.translation: And the Tirshatha said unto them, that they should not eat of the most holy things, till there stood up a priest with Urim and with Thummim. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־הַקָּהָ֖ל כְּאֶחָ֑ד אַרְבַּ֣ע רִבּ֔וֹא אַלְפַּ֖יִם שְׁלֹשׁ־מֵא֥וֹת שִׁשִּֽׁים׃
verses.translit: khlhqhl kh'chd 'rb' rbv' 'lpym shlshm'vt shshym
verses.translation: The whole congregation together was forty and two thousand three hundred and threescore,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִ֠לְּבַ֠ד עַבְדֵיהֶ֤ם וְאַמְהֹֽתֵיהֶם֙ אֵ֔לֶּה שִׁבְעַ֣ת אֲלָפִ֔ים שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים וְשִׁבְעָ֑ה וְלָהֶ֛ם מְשֹׁרְרִ֥ים וּֽמְשֹׁרְר֖וֹת מָאתָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: mlbd 'bdyhm v'mhtyhm 'lh shb't 'lpym shlsh m'vt shlshym vshb'h vlhm mshrrym vmshrrvt m'tym
verses.translation: beside their men-servants and their maid-servants, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty and seven; and they had two hundred singing men and singing women.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: סוּסֵיהֶ֕ם שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים וְשִׁשָּׁ֑ה פִּרְדֵיהֶ֕ם מָאתַ֖יִם אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וַחֲמִשָּֽׁה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: svsyhm shb' m'vt shlshym vshshh prdyhm m'tym 'rb'ym vchmshh {s}
verses.translation: Their horses were seven hundred thirty and six; their mules, two hundred forty and five;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גְּמַ֨לֵּיהֶ֔ם אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים וַחֲמִשָּׁ֑ה חֲמֹרִ֕ים שֵׁ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֔ים שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וְעֶשְׂרִֽים׃ {פ}
verses.translit: gmlyhm 'rb' m'vt shlshym vchmshh chmrym shsht 'lpym shb' m'vt v'shrym {p}
verses.translation: their camels, four hundred thirty and five; their asses, six thousand seven hundred and twenty.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמֵרָאשֵׁי֙ הָֽאָב֔וֹת בְּבוֹאָ֕ם לְבֵ֥ית יְהֹוָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּירוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם הִֽתְנַדְּבוּ֙ לְבֵ֣ית הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים לְהַעֲמִיד֖וֹ עַל־מְכוֹנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vmr'shy h'bvt bbv'm lbyt yhvh 'shr byrvshl͏m htndbv lbyt h'lhym lh'mydv 'lmkhvnv
verses.translation: And some of the heads of fathers’houses, when they came to the house of the LORD which is in Jerusalem, offered willingly for the house of God to set it up in its place;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּכֹחָ֗ם נָתְנוּ֮ לְאוֹצַ֣ר הַמְּלָאכָה֒ זָהָ֗ב דַּרְכְּמוֹנִים֙ שֵׁשׁ־רִבֹּ֣אות וָאֶ֔לֶף וְכֶ֕סֶף מָנִ֖ים חֲמֵ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֑ים וְכׇתְנֹ֥ת כֹּהֲנִ֖ים מֵאָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khkhchm ntnv l'vtsr hml'khh zhb drkhmvnym shshrb'vt v'lf vkhsf mnym chmsht 'lpym vkhtnt khhnym m'h {s}
verses.translation: they gave after their ability into the treasury of the work threescore and one thousand darics of gold, and five thousand pounds of silver, and one hundred priests’tunics.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּשְׁב֣וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְ֠הַלְוִיִּ֠ם וּֽמִן־הָעָ֞ם וְהַמְשֹׁרְרִ֧ים וְהַשּׁוֹעֲרִ֛ים וְהַנְּתִינִ֖ים בְּעָרֵיהֶ֑ם וְכׇל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּעָרֵיהֶֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyshbv hkhhnym vhlvym vmnh'm vhmshrrym vhshv'rym vhntynym b'ryhm vkhlyshr'l b'ryhm {s}
verses.translation: So the priests, and the Levites, and some of the people, and the singers, and the porters, and the Nethinim, dwelt in their cities, and all Israel in their cities.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּגַּע֙ הַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י וּבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בֶּעָרִ֑ים {ס} וַיֵּאָסְפ֥וּ הָעָ֛ם כְּאִ֥ישׁ אֶחָ֖ד אֶל־יְרוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyg' hchdsh hshby'y vbny yshr'l b'rym {s} vy'spv h'm kh'ysh 'chd 'lyrvshl͏m {s}
verses.translation: And when the seventh month was come, and the children of Israel were in the cities, the people gathered themselves together as one man to Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֩קׇם֩ יֵשׁ֨וּעַ בֶּן־יֽוֹצָדָ֜ק וְאֶחָ֣יו הַכֹּהֲנִ֗ים וּזְרֻבָּבֶ֤ל בֶּן־שְׁאַלְתִּיאֵל֙ וְאֶחָ֔יו וַיִּבְנ֕וּ אֶת־מִזְבַּ֖ח אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לְהַעֲל֤וֹת עָלָיו֙ עֹל֔וֹת כַּכָּת֕וּב בְּתוֹרַ֖ת מֹשֶׁ֥ה אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyqm yshv' bnyvtsdq v'chyv hkhhnym vzrbbl bnsh'lty'l v'chyv vybnv 'tmzbch 'lhy yshr'l lh'lvt 'lyv 'lvt khkhtvb btvrt mshh 'yshh'lhym
verses.translation: Then stood up Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and his brethren the priests, and Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and his brethren, and builded the altar of the God of Israel, to offer burnt-offerings thereon, as it is written in the Law of Moses the man of God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּכִ֤ינוּ הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ עַל־מְכ֣וֹנֹתָ֔יו כִּ֚י בְּאֵימָ֣ה עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם מֵעַמֵּ֖י הָאֲרָצ֑וֹת (ויעל) [וַיַּעֲל֨וּ] עָלָ֤יו עֹלוֹת֙ לַֽיהֹוָ֔ה עֹל֖וֹת לַבֹּ֥קֶר וְלָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.translit: vykhynv hmzbch 'lmkhvntyv khy b'ymh 'lyhm m'my h'rtsvt (vy'l) [vy'lv] 'lyv 'lvt lyhvh 'lvt lbqr vl'rb
verses.translation: And they set the altar upon its bases; for fear was upon them because of the people of the countries, and they offered burnt-offerings thereon unto the LORD, even burnt-offerings morning and evening.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֛וּ אֶת־חַ֥ג הַסֻּכּ֖וֹת כַּכָּת֑וּב וְעֹלַ֨ת י֤וֹם בְּיוֹם֙ בְּמִסְפָּ֔ר כְּמִשְׁפַּ֖ט דְּבַר־י֥וֹם בְּיוֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vy'shv 'tchg hskhvt khkhtvb v'lt yvm byvm bmspr khmshpt dbryvm byvmv
verses.translation: And they kept the feast of tabernacles, as it is written, and offered the daily burnt-offerings by number, according to the ordinance, as the duty of every day required;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַחֲרֵי־כֵ֞ן עֹלַ֤ת תָּמִיד֙ וְלֶ֣חֳדָשִׁ֔ים וּלְכׇל־מוֹעֲדֵ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה הַמְקֻדָּשִׁ֑ים וּלְכֹ֛ל מִתְנַדֵּ֥ב נְדָבָ֖ה לַיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'chrykhn 'lt tmyd vlchdshym vlkhlmv'dy yhvh hmqdshym vlkhl mtndb ndbh lyhvh
verses.translation: and afterward the continual burnt-offering, and the offerings of the new moons, and of all the appointed seasons of the LORD that were hallowed, and of every one that willingly offered a freewill-offering unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִיּ֤וֹם אֶחָד֙ לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י הֵחֵ֕לּוּ לְהַעֲל֥וֹת עֹל֖וֹת לַיהֹוָ֑ה וְהֵיכַ֥ל יְהֹוָ֖ה לֹ֥א יֻסָּֽד׃
verses.translit: myvm 'chd lchdsh hshby'y hchlv lh'lvt 'lvt lyhvh vhykhl yhvh l' ysd
verses.translation: From the first day of the seventh month began they to offer burnt-offerings unto the LORD; but the foundation of the temple of the LORD was not yet laid.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּ֨תְּנוּ־כֶ֔סֶף לַחֹצְבִ֖ים וְלֶחָרָשִׁ֑ים וּמַאֲכָ֨ל וּמִשְׁתֶּ֜ה וָשֶׁ֗מֶן לַצִּֽדֹנִים֙ וְלַצֹּרִ֔ים לְהָבִיא֩ עֲצֵ֨י אֲרָזִ֤ים מִן־הַלְּבָנוֹן֙ אֶל־יָ֣ם יָפ֔וֹא כְּרִשְׁי֛וֹן כּ֥וֹרֶשׁ מֶֽלֶךְ־פָּרַ֖ס עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vytnvkhsf lchtsbym vlchrshym vm'khl vmshth vshmn ltsdnym vltsrym lhby' 'tsy 'rzym mnhlbnvn 'lym ypv' khrshyvn khvrsh mlkhprs 'lyhm {p}
verses.translation: They gave money also unto the hewers, and to the carpenters; and food, and drink, and oil, unto them of Zidon, and to them of Tyre, to bring cedar-trees from Lebanon to the sea, unto Joppa, according to the grant that they had of Cyrus king of Persia.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבַשָּׁנָ֣ה הַשֵּׁנִ֗ית לְבוֹאָ֞ם אֶל־בֵּ֤ית הָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ לִיר֣וּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם בַּחֹ֖דֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִ֑י הֵחֵ֡לּוּ זְרֻבָּבֶ֣ל בֶּן־שְׁ֠אַלְתִּיאֵ֠ל וְיֵשׁ֨וּעַ בֶּן־יֽוֹצָדָ֜ק וּשְׁאָ֥ר אֲחֵיהֶ֣ם  הַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֗ם וְכׇל־הַבָּאִים֙ מֵהַשְּׁבִ֣י יְרֽוּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם וַיַּעֲמִ֣ידוּ אֶת־הַלְוִיִּ֗ם מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה לְנַצֵּ֖חַ עַל־מְלֶ֥אכֶת בֵּית־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vbshnh hshnyt lbv'm 'lbyt h'lhym lyrvshl͏m bchdsh hshny hchlv zrbbl bnsh'lty'l vyshv' bnyvtsdq vsh'r 'chyhm  hkhhnym vhlvym vkhlhb'ym mhshby yrvshl͏m vy'mydv 'thlvym mbn 'shrym shnh vm'lh lntsch 'lml'kht bytyhvh
verses.translation: Now in the second year of their coming unto the house of God at Jerusalem, in the second month, began Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and the rest of their brethren the priests and the Levites, and all they that were come out of the captivity unto Jerusalem; and appointed the Levites, from twenty years old and upward, to have the oversight of the work of the house of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּעֲמֹ֣ד יֵשׁ֡וּעַ בָּנָ֣יו וְ֠אֶחָ֠יו קַדְמִיאֵ֨ל וּבָנָ֤יו בְּנֵֽי־יְהוּדָה֙ כְּאֶחָ֔ד לְנַצֵּ֛חַ עַל־עֹשֵׂ֥ה הַמְּלָאכָ֖ה בְּבֵ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים {ס} בְּנֵי֙ חֵֽנָדָ֔ד בְּנֵיהֶ֥ם וַאֲחֵיהֶ֖ם הַלְוִיִּֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'md yshv' bnyv v'chyv qdmy'l vbnyv bnyyhvdh kh'chd lntsch 'l'shh hml'khh bbyt h'lhym {s} bny chndd bnyhm v'chyhm hlvym
verses.translation: Then stood Jeshua with his sons and his brethren, and Kadmiel and his sons, the sons of Judah, together, to have the oversight of the workmen in the house of God; the sons of Henadad also, with their sons and their brethren the Levites.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיִסְּד֥וּ הַבֹּנִ֖ים אֶת־הֵיכַ֣ל יְהֹוָ֑ה וַיַּעֲמִ֩ידוּ֩ הַכֹּהֲנִ֨ים מְלֻבָּשִׁ֜ים בַּחֲצֹֽצְר֗וֹת וְהַלְוִיִּ֤ם בְּנֵֽי־אָסָף֙ בַּֽמְצִלְתַּ֔יִם לְהַלֵּל֙ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֔ה עַל־יְדֵ֖י דָּוִ֥יד מֶֽלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vysdv hbnym 'thykhl yhvh vy'mydv hkhhnym mlbshym bchtstsrvt vhlvym bny'sf bmtsltym lhll 'tyhvh 'lydy dvyd mlkhyshr'l
verses.translation: And when the builders laid the foundation of the temple of the LORD, they set the priests in their apparel with trumpets, and the Levites the sons of Asaph with cymbals, to praise the LORD, according to the direction of David king of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽ֠יַּעֲנ֠וּ בְּהַלֵּ֨ל וּבְהוֹדֹ֤ת לַֽיהֹוָה֙ כִּ֣י ט֔וֹב כִּֽי־לְעוֹלָ֥ם חַסְדּ֖וֹ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְכׇל־הָעָ֡ם הֵרִ֩יעוּ֩ תְרוּעָ֨ה גְדוֹלָ֤ה בְהַלֵּל֙ לַֽיהֹוָ֔ה עַ֖ל הוּסַ֥ד בֵּית־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'nv bhll vbhvdt lyhvh khy tvb khyl'vlm chsdv 'lyshr'l vkhlh'm hry'v trv'h gdvlh bhll lyhvh 'l hvsd bytyhvh
verses.translation: And they sang one to another in praising and giving thanks unto the LORD: ‘for He is good, for His mercy endureth for ever toward Israel.’ And all the people shouted with a great shout, when they praised the LORD, because the foundation of the house of the LORD was laid.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרַבִּ֡ים מֵהַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְהַלְוִיִּם֩ וְרָאשֵׁ֨י הָאָב֜וֹת הַזְּקֵנִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר רָא֜וּ אֶת־הַבַּ֤יִת הָֽרִאשׁוֹן֙ בְּיׇסְד֔וֹ זֶ֤ה הַבַּ֙יִת֙ בְּעֵ֣ינֵיהֶ֔ם בֹּכִ֖ים בְּק֣וֹל גָּד֑וֹל וְרַבִּ֛ים בִּתְרוּעָ֥ה בְשִׂמְחָ֖ה לְהָרִ֥ים קֽוֹל׃
verses.translit: vrbym mhkhhnym vhlvym vr'shy h'bvt hzqnym 'shr r'v 'thbyt hr'shvn bysdv zh hbyt b'ynyhm bkhym bqvl gdvl vrbym btrv'h bshmchh lhrym qvl
verses.translation: But many of the priests and Levites and heads of fathers’houses, the old men that had seen the first house standing on its foundation, wept with a loud voice, when this house was before their eyes; and many shouted aloud for joy;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֣ין הָעָ֗ם מַכִּירִים֙ ק֚וֹל תְּרוּעַ֣ת הַשִּׂמְחָ֔ה לְק֖וֹל בְּכִ֣י הָעָ֑ם כִּ֣י הָעָ֗ם מְרִיעִים֙ תְּרוּעָ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֔ה וְהַקּ֥וֹל נִשְׁמַ֖ע עַד־לְמֵרָחֽוֹק׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'yn h'm mkhyrym qvl trv't hshmchh lqvl bkhy h'm khy h'm mry'ym trv'h gdvlh vhqvl nshm' 'dlmrchvq {p}
verses.translation: so that the people could not discern the noise of the shout of joy from the noise of the weeping of the people; for the people shouted with a loud shout, and the noise was heard afar off.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיִּשְׁמְע֔וּ צָרֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה וּבִנְיָמִ֑ן כִּֽי־בְנֵ֤י הַגּוֹלָה֙ בּוֹנִ֣ים הֵיכָ֔ל לַיהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vyshm'v tsry yhvdh vbnymn khybny hgvlh bvnym hykhl lyhvh 'lhy yshr'l
verses.translation: Now when the adversaries of Judah and Benjamin heard that the children of the captivity were building a temple unto the LORD, the God of Israel;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּגְּשׁ֨וּ אֶל־זְרֻבָּבֶ֜ל וְאֶל־רָאשֵׁ֣י הָֽאָב֗וֹת וַיֹּאמְר֤וּ לָהֶם֙ נִבְנֶ֣ה עִמָּכֶ֔ם כִּ֣י כָכֶ֔ם נִדְר֖וֹשׁ לֵֽאלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם (ולא) [וְל֣וֹ ] אֲנַ֣חְנוּ זֹבְחִ֗ים מִימֵי֙ אֵסַ֤ר חַדֹּן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר הַמַּעֲלֶ֥ה אֹתָ֖נוּ פֹּֽה׃
verses.translit: vygshv 'lzrbbl v'lr'shy h'bvt vy'mrv lhm nbnh 'mkhm khy khkhm ndrvsh l'lhykhm (vl') [vlv ] 'nchnv zbchym mymy 'sr chdn mlkh 'shvr hm'lh 'tnv ph
verses.translation: then they drew near to Zerubbabel, and to the heads of fathers’houses, and said unto them: ‘Let us build with you; for we seek your God, as ye do; and we do sacrifice unto Him since the days of Esarhaddon king of Assyria, who brought us up hither.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֩אמֶר֩ לָהֶ֨ם זְרֻבָּבֶ֜ל וְיֵשׁ֗וּעַ וּשְׁאָ֨ר רָאשֵׁ֤י הָֽאָבוֹת֙ לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לֹֽא־לָכֶ֣ם וָלָ֔נוּ לִבְנ֥וֹת בַּ֖יִת לֵאלֹהֵ֑ינוּ כִּי֩ אֲנַ֨חְנוּ יַ֜חַד נִבְנֶ֗ה לַֽיהֹוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֔נוּ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ כּ֥וֹרֶשׁ מֶֽלֶךְ־פָּרָֽס׃
verses.translit: vy'mr lhm zrbbl vyshv' vsh'r r'shy h'bvt lyshr'l l'lkhm vlnv lbnvt byt l'lhynv khy 'nchnv ychd nbnh lyhvh 'lhy yshr'l kh'shr tsvnv hmlkh khvrsh mlkhprs
verses.translation: But Zerubbabel, and Jeshua, and the rest of the heads of fathers’houses of Israel, said unto them: ‘Ye have nothing to do with us to build a house unto our God; but we ourselves together will build unto the LORD, the God of Israel, as king Cyrus the king of Persia hath commanded us.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִי֙ עַם־הָאָ֔רֶץ מְרַפִּ֖ים יְדֵ֣י עַם־יְהוּדָ֑ה (ומבלהים) [וּֽמְבַהֲלִ֥ים] אוֹתָ֖ם לִבְנֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vyhy 'mh'rts mrpym ydy 'myhvdh (vmblhym) [vmbhlym] 'vtm lbnvt
verses.translation: Then the people of the land weakened the hands of the people of Judah, and harried them while they were building,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְסֹכְרִ֧ים עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם יוֹעֲצִ֖ים לְהָפֵ֣ר עֲצָתָ֑ם כׇּל־יְמֵ֗י כּ֚וֹרֶשׁ מֶ֣לֶךְ פָּרַ֔ס וְעַד־מַלְכ֖וּת דָּרְיָ֥וֶשׁ מֶֽלֶךְ־פָּרָֽס׃
verses.translit: vskhrym 'lyhm yv'tsym lhpr 'tstm khlymy khvrsh mlkh prs v'dmlkhvt dryvsh mlkhprs
verses.translation: and hired counsellors against them, to frustrate their purpose, all the days of Cyrus king of Persia, even until the reign of Darius king of Persia.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְמַלְכוּת֙ אֲחַשְׁוֵר֔וֹשׁ בִּתְחִלַּ֖ת מַלְכוּת֑וֹ כָּתְב֣וּ שִׂטְנָ֔ה עַל־יֹשְׁבֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה וִירוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vbmlkhvt 'chshvrvsh btchlt mlkhvtv khtbv shtnh 'lyshby yhvdh vyrvshl͏m {s}
verses.translation: And in the reign of Ahasuerus, in the beginning of his reign, wrote they an accusation against the inhabitants of Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבִימֵ֣י אַרְתַּחְשַׁ֗שְׂתָּא כָּתַ֨ב בִּשְׁלָ֜ם מִתְרְדָ֤ת טָֽבְאֵל֙ וּשְׁאָ֣ר כְּנָוֺתָ֔ו עַל־אַרְתַּחְשַׁ֖שְׂתְּא מֶ֣לֶךְ פָּרָ֑ס וּכְתָב֙ הַֽנִּשְׁתְּוָ֔ן כָּת֥וּב אֲרָמִ֖ית וּמְתֻרְגָּ֥ם אֲרָמִֽית׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vbymy 'rtchshsht' khtb bshlm mtrdt tb'l vsh'r khnvtv 'l'rtchshsht' mlkh prs vkhtb hnshtvn khtvb 'rmyt vmtrgm 'rmyt {p}
verses.translation: And in the days of Artaxerxes wrote Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel, and the rest of his companions, unto Artaxerxes king of Persia; and the writing of the letter was written in the Aramaic character, and set forth in the Aramaic tongue.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רְח֣וּם בְּעֵל־טְעֵ֗ם וְשִׁמְשַׁי֙ סָֽפְרָ֔א כְּתַ֛בוּ אִגְּרָ֥ה חֲדָ֖ה עַל־יְרוּשְׁלֶ֑ם לְאַרְתַּחְשַׁ֥שְׂתְּא מַלְכָּ֖א כְּנֵֽמָא׃
verses.translit: rchvm b'lt'm vshmshy spr' khtbv 'grh chdh 'lyrvshlm l'rtchshsht' mlkh' khnm'
verses.translation: Rehum the commander and Shimshai the scribe wrote a letter against Jerusalem to Artaxerxes the king in this sort—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱדַ֜יִן רְח֣וּם בְּעֵל־טְעֵ֗ם וְשִׁמְשַׁי֙ סָֽפְרָ֔א וּשְׁאָ֖ר כְּנָוָתְה֑וֹן דִּ֠ינָיֵ֠א וַאֲפַרְסַתְכָיֵ֞א טַרְפְּלָיֵ֣א אֲפָֽרְסָיֵ֗א (ארכוי) [אַרְכֳּוָיֵ֤א] בָבְלָיֵא֙ שֽׁוּשַׁנְכָיֵ֔א (דהוא) [דֶּהָיֵ֖א] עֵלְמָיֵֽא׃
verses.translit: 'dyn rchvm b'lt'm vshmshy spr' vsh'r khnvthvn dyny' v'prstkhy' trply' 'prsy' ('rkhvy) ['rkhvy'] bbly' shvshnkhy' (dhv') [dhy'] 'lmy'
verses.translation: then wrote Rehum the commander, and Shimshai the scribe, and the rest of their companions; the Dinites, and the Apharesattechites, the Tarpelites, the Apharesites, the Archevites, the Babylonians, the Shushanchites, the Dehites, the Elamites,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׁאָ֣ר אֻמַּיָּ֗א דִּ֤י הַגְלִי֙ אׇסְנַפַּר֙ רַבָּ֣א וְיַקִּירָ֔א וְהוֹתֵ֣ב הִמּ֔וֹ בְּקִרְיָ֖ה דִּ֣י שָׁמְרָ֑יִן וּשְׁאָ֥ר עֲבַֽר־נַהֲרָ֖ה וּכְעֶֽנֶת׃
verses.translit: vsh'r 'my' dy hgly 'snpr rb' vyqyr' vhvtb hmv bqryh dy shmryn vsh'r 'brnhrh vkh'nt
verses.translation: and the rest of the nations whom the great and noble Asenappar brought over, and set in the city of Samaria, and the rest that are in the country beyond the River:— ‘And now—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דְּנָה֙ פַּרְשֶׁ֣גֶן אִגַּרְתָּ֔א דִּ֚י שְׁלַ֣חוּ עֲל֔וֹהִי עַל־אַרְתַּחְשַׁ֖שְׂתְּא מַלְכָּ֑א (עבדיך) [עַבְדָ֛ךְ] אֱנָ֥שׁ עֲבַֽר־נַהֲרָ֖ה וּכְעֶֽנֶת׃ {פ}
verses.translit: dnh prshgn 'grt' dy shlchv 'lvhy 'l'rtchshsht' mlkh' ('bdykh) ['bdkh] 'nsh 'brnhrh vkh'nt {p}
verses.translation: this is the copy of the letter that they sent unto him, even unto Artaxerxes the king—thy servants the men beyond the River—and now
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְדִ֙יעַ֙ לֶהֱוֵ֣א לְמַלְכָּ֔א דִּ֣י יְהוּדָיֵ֗א דִּ֤י סְלִ֙קוּ֙ מִן־לְוָתָ֔ךְ עֲלֶ֥ינָא אֲת֖וֹ לִירוּשְׁלֶ֑ם קִרְיְתָ֨א מָֽרָדְתָּ֤א וּבִֽאישְׁתָּא֙ בָּנַ֔יִן (ושורי) [וְשׁוּרַיָּ֣א] (אשכללו) [שַׁכְלִ֔ילוּ] וְאֻשַּׁיָּ֖א יַחִֽיטוּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: ydy' lhv' lmlkh' dy yhvdy' dy slqv mnlvtkh 'lyn' 'tv lyrvshlm qryt' mrdt' vb'ysht' bnyn (vshvry) [vshvry'] ('shkhllv) [shkhlylv] v'shy' ychytv {s}
verses.translation: be it known unto the king, that the Jews that came up from thee are come to us unto Jerusalem; they are building the rebellious and the bad city, and have finished the walls, and are digging out the foundations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּעַ֗ן יְדִ֙יעַ֙ לֶהֱוֵ֣א לְמַלְכָּ֔א דִּ֠י הֵ֣ן קִרְיְתָ֥א דָךְ֙ תִּתְבְּנֵ֔א וְשׁוּרַיָּ֖א יִֽשְׁתַּכְלְל֑וּן מִנְדָּֽה־בְל֤וֹ וַהֲלָךְ֙ לָ֣א יִנְתְּנ֔וּן וְאַפְּתֹ֥ם מַלְכִ֖ים תְּהַנְזִֽק׃ {ס}
verses.translit: kh'n ydy' lhv' lmlkh' dy hn qryt' dkh ttbn' vshvry' yshtkhllvn mndhblv vhlkh l' yntnvn v'ptm mlkhym thnzq {s}
verses.translation: Be it known now unto the king, that, if this city be builded, and the walls finished, they will not pay tribute, impost, or toll, and so thou wilt endamage the revenue of the kings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּעַ֗ן כׇּל־קֳבֵל֙ דִּֽי־מְלַ֤ח הֵֽיכְלָא֙ מְלַ֔חְנָא וְעַרְוַ֣ת מַלְכָּ֔א לָ֥א אֲֽרִֽיךְ־לַ֖נָא לְמֶֽחֱזֵ֑א עַ֨ל־דְּנָ֔ה שְׁלַ֖חְנָא וְהוֹדַ֥עְנָא לְמַלְכָּֽא׃
verses.translit: kh'n khlqbl dymlch hykhl' mlchn' v'rvt mlkh' l' 'rykhln' lmchz' 'ldnh shlchn' vhvd'n' lmlkh'
verses.translation: Now because we eat the salt of the palace, and it is not meet for us to see the king’s dishonour, therefore have we sent and announced to the king,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דִּ֡י יְבַקַּר֩ בִּֽסְפַר־דׇּכְרָ֨נַיָּ֜א דִּ֣י אֲבָהָתָ֗ךְ וּ֠תְהַשְׁכַּ֠ח בִּסְפַ֣ר דׇּכְרָנַיָּא֮ וְתִנְדַּע֒ דִּי֩ קִרְיְתָ֨א דָ֜ךְ קִרְיָ֣א מָֽרָדָ֗א וּֽמְהַנְזְקַ֤ת מַלְכִין֙ וּמְדִנָ֔ן וְאֶשְׁתַּדּוּר֙ עָבְדִ֣ין בְּגַוַּ֔הּ מִן־יוֹמָ֖ת עָלְמָ֑א עַ֨ל־דְּנָ֔ה קִרְיְתָ֥א דָ֖ךְ הׇֽחָרְבַֽת׃
verses.translit: dy ybqr bsprdkhrny' dy 'bhtkh vthshkhch bspr dkhrny' vtnd' dy qryt' dkh qry' mrd' vmhnzqt mlkhyn vmdnn v'shtdvr 'bdyn bgvh mnyvmt 'lm' 'ldnh qryt' dkh hchrbt
verses.translation: that search may be made in the book of the records of thy fathers; so shalt thou find in the book of the records, and know that this city is a rebellious city, and hurtful unto kings and provinces, and that they have moved sedition within the same of old time; for which cause was this city laid waste.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מְהוֹדְעִ֤ין אֲנַ֙חְנָה֙ לְמַלְכָּ֔א דִּ֠י הֵ֣ן קִרְיְתָ֥א דָךְ֙ תִּתְבְּנֵ֔א וְשׁוּרַיָּ֖ה יִֽשְׁתַּכְלְל֑וּן לׇקֳבֵ֣ל דְּנָ֔ה חֲלָק֙ בַּעֲבַ֣ר נַהֲרָ֔א לָ֥א אִיתַ֖י לָֽךְ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: mhvd'yn 'nchnh lmlkh' dy hn qryt' dkh ttbn' vshvryh yshtkhllvn lqbl dnh chlq b'br nhr' l' 'yty lkh {p}
verses.translation: We announce to the king that, if this city be builded, and the walls finished, by this means thou shalt have no portion beyond the River.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פִּתְגָמָ֞א שְׁלַ֣ח מַלְכָּ֗א עַל־רְח֤וּם בְּעֵל־טְעֵם֙ וְשִׁמְשַׁ֣י סָֽפְרָ֔א וּשְׁאָר֙ כְּנָוָ֣תְה֔וֹן דִּ֥י יָתְבִ֖ין בְּשָֽׁמְרָ֑יִן וּשְׁאָ֧ר עֲבַֽר־נַהֲרָ֛ה שְׁלָ֖ם וּכְעֶֽת׃ {פ}
verses.translit: ptgm' shlch mlkh' 'lrchvm b'lt'm vshmshy spr' vsh'r khnvthvn dy ytbyn bshmryn vsh'r 'brnhrh shlm vkh't {p}
verses.translation: Then sent the king an answer unto Rehum the commander, and to Shimshai the scribe, and to the rest of their companions that dwell in Samaria, and unto the rest beyond the River: ‘Peace, and now
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נִשְׁתְּוָנָ֕א דִּ֥י שְׁלַחְתּ֖וּן עֲלֶ֑ינָא מְפָרַ֥שׁ קֱרִ֖י קׇדָמָֽי׃
verses.translit: nshtvn' dy shlchtvn 'lyn' mprsh qry qdmy
verses.translation: the letter which ye sent unto us hath been plainly read before me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִנִּי֮ שִׂ֣ים טְעֵם֒ וּבַקַּ֣רוּ וְהַשְׁכַּ֔חוּ דִּ֚י קִרְיְתָ֣א דָ֔ךְ מִן־יוֹמָת֙ עָֽלְמָ֔א עַל־מַלְכִ֖ין מִֽתְנַשְּׂאָ֑ה וּמְרַ֥ד וְאֶשְׁתַּדּ֖וּר מִתְעֲבֶד־בַּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vmny shym t'm vbqrv vhshkhchv dy qryt' dkh mnyvmt 'lm' 'lmlkhyn mtnsh'h vmrd v'shtdvr mt'bdbh
