verses.translation: And I decreed, and search hath been made, and it is found that this city of old time hath made insurrection against kings, and that rebellion and sedition have been made therein.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמַלְכִ֣ין תַּקִּיפִ֗ין הֲווֹ֙ עַל־יְר֣וּשְׁלֶ֔ם וְשַׁ֨לִּיטִ֔ין בְּכֹ֖ל עֲבַ֣ר נַהֲרָ֑ה וּמִדָּ֥ה בְל֛וֹ וַהֲלָ֖ךְ מִתְיְהֵ֥ב לְהֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: vmlkhyn tqypyn hvv 'lyrvshlm vshlytyn bkhl 'br nhrh vmdh blv vhlkh mtyhb lhvn
verses.translation: There have been mighty kings also over Jerusalem, who have ruled over all the country beyond the River; and tribute, impost, and toll, was paid unto them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּעַן֙ שִׂ֣ימוּ טְּעֵ֔ם לְבַטָּלָ֖א גֻּבְרַיָּ֣א אִלֵּ֑ךְ וְקִרְיְתָ֥א דָךְ֙ לָ֣א תִתְבְּנֵ֔א עַד־מִנִּ֖י טַעְמָ֥א יִתְּשָֽׂם׃
verses.translit: kh'n shymv t'm lbtl' gbry' 'lkh vqryt' dkh l' ttbn' 'dmny t'm' ytshm
verses.translation: Make ye now a decree to cause these men to cease, and that this city be not builded, until a decree shall be made by me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּזְהִירִ֥ין הֱו֛וֹ שָׁל֖וּ לְמֶעְבַּ֣ד עַל־דְּנָ֑ה לְמָה֙ יִשְׂגֵּ֣א חֲבָלָ֔א לְהַנְזָקַ֖ת מַלְכִֽין׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vzhyryn hvv shlv lm'bd 'ldnh lmh yshg' chbl' lhnzqt mlkhyn {s}
verses.translation: And take heed that ye be not slack herein; why should damage grow to the hurt of the kings?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱדַ֗יִן מִן־דִּ֞י פַּרְשֶׁ֤גֶן נִשְׁתְּוָנָא֙ דִּ֚י אַרְתַּחְשַׁ֣שְׂתְּא מַלְכָּ֔א קֱרִ֧י קֳדָם־רְח֛וּם וְשִׁמְשַׁ֥י סָפְרָ֖א וּכְנָוָתְה֑וֹן אֲזַ֨לוּ בִבְהִיל֤וּ לִירֽוּשְׁלֶם֙ עַל־יְה֣וּדָיֵ֔א וּבַטִּ֥לוּ הִמּ֖וֹ בְּאֶדְרָ֥ע וְחָֽיִל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'dyn mndy prshgn nshtvn' dy 'rtchshsht' mlkh' qry qdmrchvm vshmshy spr' vkhnvthvn 'zlv bbhylv lyrvshlm 'lyhvdy' vbtlv hmv b'dr' vchyl {s}
verses.translation: Then when the copy of king Artaxerxes’letter was read before Rehum, and Shimshai the scribe, and their companions, they went in haste to Jerusalem unto the Jews, and made them to cease by force and power.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֵּאדַ֗יִן בְּטֵלַת֙ עֲבִידַ֣ת בֵּית־אֱלָהָ֔א דִּ֖י בִּירוּשְׁלֶ֑ם וַהֲוָת֙ בָּֽטְלָ֔א עַ֚ד שְׁנַ֣ת תַּרְתֵּ֔ין לְמַלְכ֖וּת דָּרְיָ֥וֶשׁ מֶֽלֶךְ־פָּרָֽס׃ {פ}
verses.translit: b'dyn btlt 'bydt byt'lh' dy byrvshlm vhvt btl' 'd shnt trtyn lmlkhvt dryvsh mlkhprs {p}
verses.translation: Then ceased the work of the house of God which is at Jerusalem; and it ceased unto the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִתְנַבִּ֞י חַגַּ֣י (נביאה) [נְבִיָּ֗א] וּזְכַרְיָ֤ה בַר־עִדּוֹא֙ נְבִיַּאיָּ֔א עַל־יְה֣וּדָיֵ֔א דִּ֥י בִיה֖וּד וּבִירוּשְׁלֶ֑ם בְּשֻׁ֛ם אֱלָ֥הּ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עֲלֵיהֽוֹן׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vhtnby chgy (nby'h) [nby'] vzkhryh br'dv' nby'y' 'lyhvdy' dy byhvd vbyrvshlm bshm 'lh yshr'l 'lyhvn {s}
verses.translation: Now the prophets, Haggai the prophet, and Zechariah the son of Iddo, prophesied unto the Jews that were in Judah and Jerusalem; in the name of the God of Israel prophesied they unto them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֵּאדַ֡יִן קָ֠מוּ זְרֻבָּבֶ֤ל בַּר־שְׁאַלְתִּיאֵל֙ וְיֵשׁ֣וּעַ בַּר־יֽוֹצָדָ֔ק וְשָׁרִ֣יו לְמִבְנֵ֔א בֵּ֥ית אֱלָהָ֖א דִּ֣י בִירֽוּשְׁלֶ֑ם וְעִמְּה֛וֹן נְבִיַּאיָּ֥א דִֽי־אֱלָהָ֖א מְסָעֲדִ֥ין לְהֽוֹן׃ {פ}
verses.translit: b'dyn qmv zrbbl brsh'lty'l vyshv' bryvtsdq vshryv lmbn' byt 'lh' dy byrvshlm v'mhvn nby'y' dy'lh' ms'dyn lhvn {p}
verses.translation: Then rose up Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and began to build the house of God which is at Jerusalem; and with them were the prophets of God, helping them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֵּהּ־זִמְנָא֩ אֲתָ֨ה עֲלֵיה֜וֹן תַּ֠תְּנַ֠י פַּחַ֧ת עֲבַֽר־נַהֲרָ֛ה וּשְׁתַ֥ר בּוֹזְנַ֖י וּכְנָוָתְה֑וֹן וְכֵן֙ אָמְרִ֣ין לְהֹ֔ם מַן־שָׂ֨ם לְכֹ֜ם טְעֵ֗ם בַּיְתָ֤א דְנָה֙ לִבְּנֵ֔א וְאֻשַּׁרְנָ֥א דְנָ֖ה לְשַׁכְלָלָֽה׃
verses.translit: bhzmn' 'th 'lyhvn ttny pcht 'brnhrh vshtr bvzny vkhnvthvn vkhn 'mryn lhm mnshm lkhm t'm byt' dnh lbn' v'shrn' dnh lshkhllh
verses.translation: At the same time came to them Tattenai, the governor beyond the River, and Shethar-bozenai, and their companions, and said thus unto them: ‘Who gave you a decree to build this house, and to finish this structure?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱדַ֥יִן כְּנֵ֖מָא אֲמַ֣רְנָא לְּהֹ֑ם מַן־אִנּוּן֙ שְׁמָהָ֣ת גֻּבְרַיָּ֔א דִּֽי־דְנָ֥ה בִנְיָנָ֖א בָּנַֽיִן׃
verses.translit: 'dyn khnm' 'mrn' lhm mn'nvn shmht gbry' dydnh bnyn' bnyn
verses.translation: ’Then spoke we unto them after this manner [, wrote they]: What are the names of the men that build this building?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעֵ֣ין אֱלָהֲהֹ֗ם הֲוָת֙ עַל־שָׂבֵ֣י יְהוּדָיֵ֔א וְלָא־בַטִּ֣לוּ הִמּ֔וֹ עַד־טַעְמָ֖א לְדָרְיָ֣וֶשׁ יְהָ֑ךְ וֶאֱדַ֛יִן יְתִיב֥וּן נִשְׁתְּוָנָ֖א עַל־דְּנָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'yn 'lhhm hvt 'lshby yhvdy' vl'btlv hmv 'dt'm' ldryvsh yhkh v'dyn ytybvn nshtvn' 'ldnh {p}
verses.translation: But the eye of their God was upon the elders of the Jews, and they did not make them cease, till the matter should come to Darius, and then answer should be returned by letter concerning it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פַּרְשֶׁ֣גֶן אִ֠גַּרְתָּ֠א דִּֽי־שְׁלַ֞ח תַּתְּנַ֣י  פַּחַ֣ת עֲבַֽר־נַהֲרָ֗ה וּשְׁתַ֤ר בּוֹזְנַי֙ וּכְנָ֣וָתֵ֔הּ אֲפַ֨רְסְכָיֵ֔א דִּ֖י בַּעֲבַ֣ר נַהֲרָ֑ה עַל־דָּרְיָ֖וֶשׁ מַלְכָּֽא׃
verses.translit: prshgn 'grt' dyshlch ttny  pcht 'brnhrh vshtr bvzny vkhnvth 'prskhy' dy b'br nhrh 'ldryvsh mlkh'
verses.translation: The copy of the letter that Tattenai, the governor beyond the River, and Shethar-bozenai, and his companions the Apharesachites, who were beyond the River, sent unto Darius the king;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פִּתְגָמָ֖א שְׁלַ֣חוּ עֲל֑וֹהִי וְכִדְנָה֙ כְּתִ֣יב בְּגַוֵּ֔הּ לְדָרְיָ֥וֶשׁ מַלְכָּ֖א שְׁלָמָ֥א כֹֽלָּא׃ {ס}
verses.translit: ptgm' shlchv 'lvhy vkhdnh khtyb bgvh ldryvsh mlkh' shlm' khl' {s}
verses.translation: they sent a letter unto him, wherein was written thus: ‘Unto Darius the king, all peace.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְדִ֣יעַ  לֶהֱוֵ֣א לְמַלְכָּ֗א דִּֽי־אֲזַ֜לְנָא לִיה֤וּד מְדִֽינְתָּא֙ לְבֵית֙ אֱלָהָ֣א רַבָּ֔א וְה֤וּא מִתְבְּנֵא֙ אֶ֣בֶן גְּלָ֔ל וְאָ֖ע מִתְּשָׂ֣ם בְּכֻתְלַיָּ֑א וַעֲבִ֥ידְתָּא דָ֛ךְ אׇסְפַּ֥רְנָא מִתְעַבְדָ֖א וּמַצְלַ֥ח בְּיֶדְהֹֽם׃
verses.translit: ydy'  lhv' lmlkh' dy'zln' lyhvd mdynt' lbyt 'lh' rb' vhv' mtbn' 'bn gll v'' mtshm bkhtly' v'bydt' dkh 'sprn' mt'bd' vmtslch bydhm
verses.translation: Be it known unto the king, that we went into the province of Judah, to the house of the great God, which is builded with great stones, and timber is laid in the walls, and this work goeth on with diligence and prospereth in their hands.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱדַ֗יִן שְׁאֵ֙לְנָא֙ לְשָׂבַיָּ֣א אִלֵּ֔ךְ כְּנֵ֖מָא אֲמַ֣רְנָא לְּהֹ֑ם מַן־שָׂ֨ם לְכֹ֜ם טְעֵ֗ם בַּיְתָ֤א דְנָה֙ לְמִבְנְיָ֔ה וְאֻשַּׁרְנָ֥א דְנָ֖ה לְשַׁכְלָלָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'dyn sh'ln' lshby' 'lkh khnm' 'mrn' lhm mnshm lkhm t'm byt' dnh lmbnyh v'shrn' dnh lshkhllh
verses.translation: Then asked we those elders, and said unto them thus: Who gave you a decree to build this house, and to finish this wall?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַ֧ף שְׁמָהָתְהֹ֛ם שְׁאֵ֥לְנָא לְּהֹ֖ם לְהוֹדָעוּתָ֑ךְ דִּ֛י נִכְתֻּ֥ב שֻׁם־גֻּבְרַיָּ֖א דִּ֥י בְרָאשֵׁיהֹֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'f shmhthm sh'ln' lhm lhvd'vtkh dy nkhtb shmgbry' dy br'shyhm {p}
verses.translation: We asked them their names also, to announce to thee, that we might write the names of the men that were at the head of them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּכְנֵ֥מָא פִתְגָמָ֖א הֲתִיב֣וּנָא לְמֵמַ֑ר אֲנַ֣חְנָא הִמּ֡וֹ עַבְד֩וֹהִי֩ דִֽי־אֱלָ֨הּ שְׁמַיָּ֜א וְאַרְעָ֗א וּבָנַ֤יִן בַּיְתָא֙ דִּֽי־הֲוָ֨א בְנֵ֜ה מִקַּדְמַ֤ת דְּנָה֙ שְׁנִ֣ין שַׂגִּיאָ֔ן וּמֶ֤לֶךְ לְיִשְׂרָאֵל֙ רַ֔ב בְּנָ֖הִי וְשַׁכְלְלֵֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vkhnm' ptgm' htybvn' lmmr 'nchn' hmv 'bdvhy dy'lh shmy' v'r'' vbnyn byt' dyhv' bnh mqdmt dnh shnyn shgy'n vmlkh lyshr'l rb bnhy vshkhllh
verses.translation: And thus they returned us answer, saying: We are the servants of the God of heaven and earth, and build the house that was builded these many years ago, which a great king of Israel builded and finished.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָהֵ֗ן מִן־דִּ֨י הַרְגִּ֤זוּ אֲבָהָתַ֙נָא֙ לֶאֱלָ֣הּ שְׁמַיָּ֔א יְהַ֣ב הִמּ֔וֹ בְּיַ֛ד נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֥ר מֶֽלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֖ל (כסדיא) [כַּסְדָּאָ֑ה] וּבַיְתָ֤ה דְנָה֙ סַתְרֵ֔הּ וְעַמָּ֖ה הַגְלִ֥י לְבָבֶֽל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: lhn mndy hrgzv 'bhtn' l'lh shmy' yhb hmv byd nbvkhdntsr mlkhbbl (khsdy') [khsd'h] vbyth dnh strh v'mh hgly lbbl {p}
verses.translation: But because that our fathers had provoked the God of heaven, He gave them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, the Chaldean, who destroyed this house, and carried the people away into Babylon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּרַם֙ בִּשְׁנַ֣ת חֲדָ֔ה לְכ֥וֹרֶשׁ מַלְכָּ֖א דִּ֣י בָבֶ֑ל כּ֤וֹרֶשׁ מַלְכָּא֙ שָׂ֣ם טְעֵ֔ם בֵּית־אֱלָהָ֥א דְנָ֖ה לִבְּנֵֽא׃
verses.translit: brm bshnt chdh lkhvrsh mlkh' dy bbl khvrsh mlkh' shm t'm byt'lh' dnh lbn'
verses.translation: But in the first year of Cyrus king of Babylon, Cyrus the king made a decree to build this house of God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֠אַ֠ף מָאנַיָּ֣א דִֽי־בֵית־אֱלָהָא֮ דִּ֣י דַהֲבָ֣ה וְכַסְפָּא֒ דִּ֣י נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֗ר הַנְפֵּק֙ מִן־הֵֽיכְלָא֙ דִּ֣י בִֽירוּשְׁלֶ֔ם וְהֵיבֵ֣ל הִמּ֔וֹ לְהֵיכְלָ֖א דִּ֣י בָבֶ֑ל הַנְפֵּ֨ק הִמּ֜וֹ כּ֣וֹרֶשׁ מַלְכָּ֗א מִן־הֵֽיכְלָא֙ דִּ֣י בָבֶ֔ל וִיהִ֙יבוּ֙ לְשֵׁשְׁבַּצַּ֣ר שְׁמֵ֔הּ דִּ֥י פֶחָ֖ה שָׂמֵֽהּ׃
verses.translit: v'f m'ny' dybyt'lh' dy dhbh vkhsp' dy nbvkhdntsr hnpq mnhykhl' dy byrvshlm vhybl hmv lhykhl' dy bbl hnpq hmv khvrsh mlkh' mnhykhl' dy bbl vyhybv lshshbtsr shmh dy pchh shmh
verses.translation: And the gold and silver vessels also of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took out of the temple that was in Jerusalem, and brought them into the temple of Babylon, those did Cyrus the king take out of the temple of Babylon, and they were delivered unto one whose name was Sheshbazzar, whom he had made governor;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲמַר־לֵ֓הּ  (אלה) [אֵ֚ל] מָֽאנַיָּ֔א שֵׂ֚א אֵֽזֶל־אֲחֵ֣ת הִמּ֔וֹ בְּהֵיכְלָ֖א דִּ֣י בִירוּשְׁלֶ֑ם וּבֵ֥ית אֱלָהָ֖א יִתְבְּנֵ֥א עַל־אַתְרֵֽהּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'mrlh  ('lh) ['l] m'ny' sh' 'zl'cht hmv bhykhl' dy byrvshlm vbyt 'lh' ytbn' 'l'trh {p}
verses.translation: and he said unto him: Take these vessels, go, put them in the temple that is in Jerusalem, and let the house of God be builded in its place.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱדַ֙יִן֙ שֵׁשְׁבַּצַּ֣ר דֵּ֔ךְ אֲתָ֗א יְהַ֧ב אֻשַּׁיָּ֛א דִּי־בֵ֥ית אֱלָהָ֖א דִּ֣י בִירוּשְׁלֶ֑ם וּמִן־אֱדַ֧יִן וְעַד־כְּעַ֛ן מִתְבְּנֵ֖א וְלָ֥א שְׁלִֽם׃
verses.translit: 'dyn shshbtsr dkh 't' yhb 'shy' dybyt 'lh' dy byrvshlm vmn'dyn v'dkh'n mtbn' vl' shlm
verses.translation: Then came the same Sheshbazzar, and laid the foundations of the house of God which is in Jerusalem; and since that time even until now hath it been in building, and yet it is not completed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּכְעַ֞ן הֵ֧ן עַל־מַלְכָּ֣א טָ֗ב יִ֠תְבַּקַּ֠ר בְּבֵ֨ית גִּנְזַיָּ֜א דִּי־מַלְכָּ֣א תַמָּה֮ דִּ֣י בְּבָבֶל֒ הֵ֣ן אִיתַ֗י דִּֽי־מִן־כּ֤וֹרֶשׁ מַלְכָּא֙ שִׂ֣ים טְעֵ֔ם לְמִבְנֵ֛א בֵּית־אֱלָהָ֥א דֵ֖ךְ בִּירוּשְׁלֶ֑ם וּרְע֥וּת מַלְכָּ֛א עַל־דְּנָ֖ה יִשְׁלַ֥ח עֲלֶֽינָא׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vkh'n hn 'lmlkh' tb ytbqr bbyt gnzy' dymlkh' tmh dy bbbl hn 'yty dymnkhvrsh mlkh' shym t'm lmbn' byt'lh' dkh byrvshlm vr'vt mlkh' 'ldnh yshlch 'lyn' {p}
verses.translation: Now therefore, if it seem good to the king, let search be made in the king’s treasure-house there, which is at Babylon, whether it be so, that a decree was made of Cyrus the king to build this house of God at Jerusalem, and let the king send his pleasure to us concerning this matter.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֵּאדַ֛יִן דָּרְיָ֥וֶשׁ מַלְכָּ֖א שָׂ֣ם טְעֵ֑ם וּבַקַּ֣רוּ  בְּבֵ֣ית סִפְרַיָּ֗א דִּ֧י גִנְזַיָּ֛א מְהַחֲתִ֥ין תַּמָּ֖ה בְּבָבֶֽל׃
verses.translit: b'dyn dryvsh mlkh' shm t'm vbqrv  bbyt spry' dy gnzy' mhchtyn tmh bbbl
verses.translation: Then Darius the king made a decree, and search was made in the house of the archives, where the treasures were laid up, in Babylon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִשְׁתְּכַ֣ח בְּאַחְמְתָ֗א בְּבִ֥ירְתָ֛א דִּ֛י בְּמָדַ֥י מְדִינְתָּ֖א מְגִלָּ֣ה חֲדָ֑ה וְכֵן־כְּתִ֥יב בְּגַוַּ֖הּ דִּכְרוֹנָֽהֿ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhshtkhch b'chmt' bbyrt' dy bmdy mdynt' mglh chdh vkhnkhtyb bgvh dkhrvnh {p}
verses.translation: And there was found at Ahmetha, in the palace that is in the province of Media, a roll, and therein was thus written: ‘A record.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּשְׁנַ֨ת חֲדָ֜ה לְכ֣וֹרֶשׁ מַלְכָּ֗א כּ֣וֹרֶשׁ מַלְכָּא֮ שָׂ֣ם טְעֵם֒ בֵּית־אֱלָהָ֤א בִֽירוּשְׁלֶם֙ בַּיְתָ֣א יִתְבְּנֵ֔א אֲתַר֙ דִּֽי־דָבְחִ֣ין דִּבְחִ֔ין וְאֻשּׁ֖וֹהִי מְסֽוֹבְלִ֑ין רוּמֵהּ֙ אַמִּ֣ין שִׁתִּ֔ין פְּתָיֵ֖הּ אַמִּ֥ין שִׁתִּֽין׃
verses.translit: bshnt chdh lkhvrsh mlkh' khvrsh mlkh' shm t'm byt'lh' byrvshlm byt' ytbn' 'tr dydbchyn dbchyn v'shvhy msvblyn rvmh 'myn shtyn ptyh 'myn shtyn
verses.translation: In the first year of Cyrus the king, Cyrus the king made a decree: Concerning the house of God at Jerusalem, let the house be builded, the place where they offer sacrifices, and let the foundations thereof be strongly laid; the height thereof threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof threescore cubits;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נִדְבָּכִ֞ין דִּי־אֶ֤בֶן גְּלָל֙ תְּלָתָ֔א וְנִדְבָּ֖ךְ דִּי־אָ֣ע חֲדַ֑ת וְנִ֨פְקְתָ֔א מִן־בֵּ֥ית מַלְכָּ֖א תִּתְיְהִֽב׃ {ס}
verses.translit: ndbkhyn dy'bn gll tlt' vndbkh dy'' chdt vnpqt' mnbyt mlkh' ttyhb {s}
verses.translation: with three rows of great stones, and a row of new timber, and let the expenses be given out of the king’s house;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֠אַ֠ף מָאנֵ֣י בֵית־אֱלָהָא֮ דִּ֣י דַהֲבָ֣ה וְכַסְפָּא֒ דִּ֣י נְבֽוּכַדְנֶצַּ֗ר הַנְפֵּ֛ק מִן־הֵיכְלָ֥א דִי־בִירוּשְׁלֶ֖ם וְהֵיבֵ֣ל לְבָבֶ֑ל יַהֲתִיב֗וּן וִ֠יהָ֠ךְ לְהֵיכְלָ֤א דִי־בִירֽוּשְׁלֶם֙ לְאַתְרֵ֔הּ וְתַחֵ֖ת בְּבֵ֥ית אֱלָהָֽא׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'f m'ny byt'lh' dy dhbh vkhsp' dy nbvkhdntsr hnpq mnhykhl' dybyrvshlm vhybl lbbl yhtybvn vyhkh lhykhl' dybyrvshlm l'trh vtcht bbyt 'lh' {s}
verses.translation: and also let the gold and silver vessels of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took forth out of the temple which is at Jerusalem, and brought unto Babylon, be restored, and brought back unto the temple which is at Jerusalem, every one to its place, and thou shalt put them in the house of God.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּעַ֡ן תַּ֠תְּנַ֠י פַּחַ֨ת עֲבַֽר־נַהֲרָ֜ה שְׁתַ֤ר בּוֹזְנַי֙ וּכְנָוָ֣תְה֔וֹן אֲפַ֨רְסְכָיֵ֔א דִּ֖י בַּעֲבַ֣ר נַהֲרָ֑ה רַחִיקִ֥ין הֲו֖וֹ מִן־תַּמָּֽה׃
verses.translit: kh'n ttny pcht 'brnhrh shtr bvzny vkhnvthvn 'prskhy' dy b'br nhrh rchyqyn hvv mntmh
verses.translation: ’Now therefore, Tattenai, governor beyond the River, Shethar-bozenai, and your companions the Apharesachites, who are beyond the River, be ye far from thence;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁבֻ֕קוּ לַעֲבִידַ֖ת בֵּית־אֱלָהָ֣א דֵ֑ךְ פַּחַ֤ת יְהוּדָיֵא֙ וּלְשָׂבֵ֣י יְהוּדָיֵ֔א בֵּית־אֱלָהָ֥א דֵ֖ךְ יִבְנ֥וֹן עַל־אַתְרֵֽהּ׃
verses.translit: shbqv l'bydt byt'lh' dkh pcht yhvdy' vlshby yhvdy' byt'lh' dkh ybnvn 'l'trh
verses.translation: let the work of this house of God alone; let the governor of the Jews and the elders of the Jews build this house of God in its place.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִנִּי֮ שִׂ֣ים טְעֵם֒ לְמָ֣א דִֽי־תַֽעַבְד֗וּן עִם־שָׂבֵ֤י יְהוּדָיֵא֙ אִלֵּ֔ךְ לְמִבְנֵ֖א בֵּית־אֱלָהָ֣א דֵ֑ךְ וּמִנִּכְסֵ֣י מַלְכָּ֗א דִּ֚י מִדַּת֙ עֲבַ֣ר נַהֲרָ֔ה אׇסְפַּ֗רְנָא נִפְקְתָ֛א תֶּהֱוֵ֧א מִֽתְיַהֲבָ֛א לְגֻבְרַיָּ֥א אִלֵּ֖ךְ דִּי־לָ֥א לְבַטָּלָֽא׃
verses.translit: vmny shym t'm lm' dyt'bdvn 'mshby yhvdy' 'lkh lmbn' byt'lh' dkh vmnkhsy mlkh' dy mdt 'br nhrh 'sprn' npqt' thv' mtyhb' lgbry' 'lkh dyl' lbtl'
verses.translation: Moreover I make a decree concerning what ye shall do to these elders of the Jews for the building of this house of God; that of the king’s goods, even of the tribute beyond the River, expenses be given with all diligence unto these men, that they be not hindered.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמָ֣ה חַשְׁחָ֡ן וּבְנֵ֣י תוֹרִ֣ין וְדִכְרִ֣ין וְאִמְּרִ֣ין ׀ לַעֲלָוָ֣ן ׀ לֶאֱלָ֪הּ שְׁמַיָּ֟א חִנְטִ֞ין מְלַ֣ח  חֲמַ֣ר וּמְשַׁ֗ח כְּמֵאמַ֨ר כָּהֲנַיָּ֤א דִי־בִירֽוּשְׁלֶם֙ לֶהֱוֵ֨א מִתְיְהֵ֥ב לְהֹ֛ם י֥וֹם ׀ בְּי֖וֹם דִּי־לָ֥א שָׁלֽוּ׃
verses.translit: vmh chshchn vbny tvryn vdkhryn v'mryn  l'lvn  l'lh shmy' chntyn mlch  chmr vmshch khm'mr khhny' dybyrvshlm lhv' mtyhb lhm yvm  byvm dyl' shlv
verses.translation: And that which they have need of, both young bullocks, and rams, and lambs, for burnt-offerings to the God of heaven, wheat, salt, wine, and oil, according to the word of the priests that are at Jerusalem, let it be given them day by day without fail;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דִּֽי־לֶהֱוֺ֧ן מְהַקְרְבִ֛ין נִיחוֹחִ֖ין לֶאֱלָ֣הּ שְׁמַיָּ֑א וּמְצַלַּ֕יִן לְחַיֵּ֥י מַלְכָּ֖א וּבְנֽוֹהִי׃
verses.translit: dylhvn mhqrbyn nychvchyn l'lh shmy' vmtslyn lchyy mlkh' vbnvhy
verses.translation: that they may offer sacrifices of sweet savour unto the God of heaven, and pray for the life of the king, and of his sons.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִנִּי֮ שִׂ֣ים טְעֵם֒ דִּ֣י כׇל־אֱנָ֗שׁ דִּ֤י יְהַשְׁנֵא֙ פִּתְגָמָ֣א דְנָ֔ה יִתְנְסַ֥ח אָע֙ מִן־בַּיְתֵ֔הּ וּזְקִ֖יף יִתְמְחֵ֣א עֲלֹ֑הִי וּבַיְתֵ֛הּ נְוָל֥וּ יִתְעֲבֵ֖ד עַל־דְּנָֽה׃
verses.translit: vmny shym t'm dy khl'nsh dy yhshn' ptgm' dnh ytnsch '' mnbyth vzqyf ytmch' 'lhy vbyth nvlv yt'bd 'ldnh
verses.translation: Also I have made a decree, that whosoever shall alter this word, let a beam be pulled out from his house, and let him be lifted up and fastened thereon; and let his house be made a dunghill for this;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וֵֽאלָהָ֞א דִּ֣י שַׁכִּ֧ן שְׁמֵ֣הּ תַּמָּ֗ה יְמַגַּ֞ר כׇּל־מֶ֤לֶךְ וְעַם֙ דִּ֣י  יִשְׁלַ֣ח יְדֵ֗הּ לְהַשְׁנָיָ֛ה לְחַבָּלָ֛ה בֵּית־אֱלָהָ֥א דֵ֖ךְ דִּ֣י בִירוּשְׁלֶ֑ם אֲנָ֤ה דָרְיָ֙וֶשׁ֙ שָׂ֣מֶת טְעֵ֔ם אׇסְפַּ֖רְנָא יִתְעֲבִֽד׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'lh' dy shkhn shmh tmh ymgr khlmlkh v'm dy  yshlch ydh lhshnyh lchblh byt'lh' dkh dy byrvshlm 'nh dryvsh shmt t'm 'sprn' yt'bd {p}
verses.translation: and may the God that hath caused His name to dwell there overthrow all kings and peoples, that shall put forth their hand to alter the same, to destroy this house of God which is at Jerusalem. I Darius have made a decree; let it be done with all diligence.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱ֠דַ֠יִן תַּתְּנַ֞י פַּחַ֧ת עֲבַֽר־נַהֲרָ֛ה שְׁתַ֥ר בּוֹזְנַ֖י וּכְנָוָתְה֑וֹן לׇקֳבֵ֗ל דִּֽי־שְׁלַ֞ח דָּרְיָ֧וֶשׁ מַלְכָּ֛א כְּנֵ֖מָא אׇסְפַּ֥רְנָא עֲבַֽדוּ׃
verses.translit: 'dyn ttny pcht 'brnhrh shtr bvzny vkhnvthvn lqbl dyshlch dryvsh mlkh' khnm' 'sprn' 'bdv
verses.translation: Then Tattenai, the governor beyond the River, Shethar-bozenai, and their companions, because that Darius the king had thus sent, acted with all diligence.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׂבֵ֤י יְהוּדָיֵא֙ בָּנַ֣יִן וּמַצְלְחִ֔ין בִּנְבוּאַת֙ חַגַּ֣י (נביאה) [נְבִיָּ֔א] וּזְכַרְיָ֖ה בַּר־עִדּ֑וֹא וּבְנ֣וֹ וְשַׁכְלִ֗לוּ מִן־טַ֙עַם֙ אֱלָ֣הּ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וּמִטְּעֵם֙ כּ֣וֹרֶשׁ וְדָרְיָ֔וֶשׁ וְאַרְתַּחְשַׁ֖שְׂתְּא מֶ֥לֶךְ פָּרָֽס׃
verses.translit: vshby yhvdy' bnyn vmtslchyn bnbv't chgy (nby'h) [nby'] vzkhryh br'dv' vbnv vshkhllv mnt'm 'lh yshr'l vmt'm khvrsh vdryvsh v'rtchshsht' mlkh prs
verses.translation: And the elders of the Jews builded and prospered, through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo. And they builded and finished it, according to the commandment of the God of Israel, and according to the decree of Cyrus, and Darius, and Artaxerxes king of Persia.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשֵׁיצִיא֙ בַּיְתָ֣ה דְנָ֔ה עַ֛ד י֥וֹם תְּלָתָ֖ה לִירַ֣ח אֲדָ֑ר דִּי־הִ֣יא שְׁנַת־שֵׁ֔ת לְמַלְכ֖וּת דָּרְיָ֥וֶשׁ מַלְכָּֽא׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vshytsy' byth dnh 'd yvm tlth lyrch 'dr dyhy' shntsht lmlkhvt dryvsh mlkh' {p}
verses.translation: And this house was finished on the third day of the month Adar, which was in the sixth year of the reign of Darius the king.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַעֲבַ֣דוּ בְנֵֽי־יִ֠שְׂרָאֵ֠ל כָּהֲנַיָּ֨א וְלֵוָיֵ֜א וּשְׁאָ֣ר בְּנֵי־גָלוּתָ֗א חֲנֻכַּ֛ת בֵּית־אֱלָהָ֥א דְנָ֖ה בְּחֶדְוָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'bdv bnyyshr'l khhny' vlvy' vsh'r bnyglvt' chnkht byt'lh' dnh bchdvh
verses.translation: And the children of Israel, the priests and the Levites, and the rest of the children of the captivity, kept the dedication of this house of God with joy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַקְרִ֗בוּ לַחֲנֻכַּת֮ בֵּית־אֱלָהָ֣א דְנָה֒ תּוֹרִ֣ין מְאָ֔ה דִּכְרִ֣ין מָאתַ֔יִן אִמְּרִ֖ין אַרְבַּ֣ע מְאָ֑ה וּצְפִירֵ֨י עִזִּ֜ין (לחטיא) [לְחַטָּאָ֤ה] עַל־כׇּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ תְּרֵֽי־עֲשַׂ֔ר לְמִנְיָ֖ן שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vhqrbv lchnkht byt'lh' dnh tvryn m'h dkhryn m'tyn 'mryn 'rb' m'h vtspyry 'zyn (lchty') [lcht'h] 'lkhlyshr'l try'shr lmnyn shbty yshr'l
verses.translation: And they offered at the dedication of this house of God a hundred bullocks, two hundred rams, four hundred lambs; and for a sin-offering for all Israel, twelve he-goats, according to the number of the tribes of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַהֲקִ֨ימוּ כָהֲנַיָּ֜א בִּפְלֻגָּתְה֗וֹן וְלֵוָיֵא֙ בְּמַחְלְקָ֣תְה֔וֹן עַל־עֲבִידַ֥ת אֱלָהָ֖א דִּ֣י בִירוּשְׁלֶ֑ם כִּכְתָ֖ב סְפַ֥ר מֹשֶֽׁה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhqymv khhny' bplgthvn vlvy' bmchlqthvn 'l'bydt 'lh' dy byrvshlm khkhtb spr mshh {p}
verses.translation: And they set the priests in their divisions, and the Levites in their courses, for the service of God, which is at Jerusalem; as it is written in the book of Moses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּעֲשׂ֥וּ בְנֵי־הַגּוֹלָ֖ה אֶת־הַפָּ֑סַח בְּאַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר לַחֹ֥דֶשׁ הָרִאשֽׁוֹן׃
verses.translit: vy'shv bnyhgvlh 'thpsch b'rb'h 'shr lchdsh hr'shvn
verses.translation: And the children of the captivity kept the passover upon the fourteenth day of the first month.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י הִֽטַּהֲר֞וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֧ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֛ם כְּאֶחָ֖ד כֻּלָּ֣ם טְהוֹרִ֑ים וַיִּשְׁחֲט֤וּ הַפֶּ֙סַח֙ לְכׇל־בְּנֵ֣י הַגּוֹלָ֔ה וְלַאֲחֵיהֶ֥ם הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְלָהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: khy hthrv hkhhnym vhlvym kh'chd khlm thvrym vyshchtv hpsch lkhlbny hgvlh vl'chyhm hkhhnym vlhm
verses.translation: For the priests and the Levites had purified themselves together; all of them were pure; and they killed the passover lamb for all the children of the captivity, and for their brethren the priests, and for themselves.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאכְל֣וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל הַשָּׁבִים֙ מֵֽהַגּוֹלָ֔ה וְכֹ֗ל הַנִּבְדָּ֛ל מִטֻּמְאַ֥ת גּוֹיֵֽ־הָאָ֖רֶץ אֲלֵהֶ֑ם לִדְרֹ֕שׁ לַֽיהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vy'khlv bnyyshr'l hshbym mhgvlh vkhl hnbdl mtm't gvyh'rts 'lhm ldrsh lyhvh 'lhy yshr'l
verses.translation: And the children of Israel, that were come back out of the captivity, and all such as had separated themselves unto them from the filthiness of the nations of the land, to seek the LORD, the God of Israel, did eat,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּֽעֲשׂ֧וּ חַג־מַצּ֛וֹת שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים בְּשִׂמְחָ֑ה כִּ֣י  שִׂמְּחָ֣ם יְהֹוָ֗ה וְֽהֵסֵ֞ב לֵ֤ב מֶֽלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר֙ עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם לְחַזֵּ֣ק יְדֵיהֶ֔ם בִּמְלֶ֥אכֶת בֵּית־הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vy'shv chgmtsvt shb't ymym bshmchh khy  shmchm yhvh vhsb lb mlkh'shvr 'lyhm lchzq ydyhm bml'kht byth'lhym 'lhy yshr'l {p}
verses.translation: and kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with joy; for the LORD had made them joyful, and had turned the heart of the king of Assyria unto them, to strengthen their hands in the work of the house of God, the God of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַחַר֙ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה בְּמַלְכ֖וּת אַרְתַּחְשַׁ֣סְתְּא מֶֽלֶךְ־פָּרָ֑ס עֶזְרָא֙ בֶּן־שְׂרָיָ֔ה בֶּן־עֲזַרְיָ֖ה בֶּן־חִלְקִיָּֽה׃
verses.translit: v'chr hdbrym h'lh bmlkhvt 'rtchshst' mlkhprs 'zr' bnshryh bn'zryh bnchlqyh
verses.translation: Now after these things, in the reign of Artaxerxes king of Persia, Ezra the son of Seraiah, the son of Azariah, the son of Hilkiah,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֶּן־שַׁלּ֥וּם בֶּן־צָד֖וֹק בֶּן־אֲחִיטֽוּב׃
verses.translit: bnshlvm bntsdvq bn'chytvb
verses.translation: the son of Shallum, the son of Zadok, the son of Ahitub,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֶּן־אֲמַרְיָ֥ה בֶן־עֲזַרְיָ֖ה בֶּן־מְרָיֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: bn'mryh bn'zryh bnmryvt
verses.translation: the son of Amariah, the son of Azariah, the son of Meraioth,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֶּן־זְרַֽחְיָ֥ה בֶן־עֻזִּ֖י בֶּן־בֻּקִּֽי׃
verses.translit: bnzrchyh bn'zy bnbqy
verses.translation: the son of Zerahiah, the son of Uzzi, the son of Bukki,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֶּן־אֲבִישׁ֗וּעַ בֶּן־פִּֽינְחָס֙ בֶּן־אֶלְעָזָ֔ר בֶּן־אַהֲרֹ֥ן הַכֹּהֵ֖ן הָרֹֽאשׁ׃
verses.translit: bn'byshv' bnpynchs bn'l'zr bn'hrn hkhhn hr'sh
verses.translation: the son of Abishua, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the chief priest—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֤וּא עֶזְרָא֙ עָלָ֣ה מִבָּבֶ֔ל וְהֽוּא־סֹפֵ֤ר מָהִיר֙ בְּתוֹרַ֣ת מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־נָתַ֥ן יְהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּתֶּן־ל֣וֹ הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ כְּיַד־יְהֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹהָיו֙ עָלָ֔יו כֹּ֖ל בַּקָּשָׁתֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: hv' 'zr' 'lh mbbl vhv'spr mhyr btvrt mshh 'shrntn yhvh 'lhy yshr'l vytnlv hmlkh khydyhvh 'lhyv 'lyv khl bqshtv {p}
verses.translation: this Ezra went up from Babylon; and he was a ready scribe in the Law of Moses, which the LORD, the God of Israel, had given; and the king granted him all his request, according to the hand of the LORD his God upon him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּֽעֲל֣וּ מִבְּנֵֽי־יִ֠שְׂרָאֵ֠ל וּמִן־הַכֹּהֲנִ֨ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֜ם וְהַמְשֹׁרְרִ֧ים וְהַשֹּׁעֲרִ֛ים וְהַנְּתִינִ֖ים אֶל־יְרוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם בִּשְׁנַת־שֶׁ֖בַע לְאַרְתַּחְשַׁ֥סְתְּא הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.translit: vy'lv mbnyyshr'l vmnhkhhnym vhlvym vhmshrrym vhsh'rym vhntynym 'lyrvshl͏m bshntshb' l'rtchshst' hmlkh
verses.translation: And there went up some of the children of Israel, and of the priests, and the Levites, and the singers, and the porters, and the Nethinim, unto Jerusalem, in the seventh year of Artaxerxes the king.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֥א יְרוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם בַּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַחֲמִישִׁ֑י הִ֛יא שְׁנַ֥ת הַשְּׁבִיעִ֖ית לַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.translit: vyb' yrvshl͏m bchdsh hchmyshy hy' shnt hshby'yt lmlkh
verses.translation: And he came to Jerusalem in the fifth month, which was in the seventh year of the king.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֗י בְּאֶחָד֙ לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֔וֹן ה֣וּא יְסֻ֔ד הַֽמַּעֲלָ֖ה מִבָּבֶ֑ל וּבְאֶחָ֞ד לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַחֲמִישִׁ֗י בָּ֚א אֶל־יְר֣וּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם כְּיַד־אֱלֹהָ֖יו הַטּוֹבָ֥ה עָלָֽיו׃
verses.translit: khy b'chd lchdsh hr'shvn hv' ysd hm'lh mbbl vb'chd lchdsh hchmyshy b' 'lyrvshl͏m khyd'lhyv htvbh 'lyv
verses.translation: For upon the first day of the first month began he to go up from Babylon, and on the first day of the fifth month came he to Jerusalem, according to the good hand of his God upon him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י עֶזְרָא֙ הֵכִ֣ין לְבָב֔וֹ לִדְרֹ֛שׁ אֶת־תּוֹרַ֥ת יְהֹוָ֖ה וְלַעֲשֹׂ֑ת וּלְלַמֵּ֥ד בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל חֹ֥ק וּמִשְׁפָּֽט׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khy 'zr' hkhyn lbbv ldrsh 'ttvrt yhvh vl'sht vllmd byshr'l chq vmshpt {s}
verses.translation: For Ezra had set his heart to seek the law of the LORD, and to do it, and to teach in Israel statutes and ordinances.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְזֶ֣ה  פַּרְשֶׁ֣גֶן הַֽנִּשְׁתְּוָ֗ן אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָתַן֙ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ אַרְתַּחְשַׁ֔סְתְּא לְעֶזְרָ֥א הַכֹּהֵ֖ן הַסֹּפֵ֑ר סֹפֵ֞ר דִּבְרֵ֧י מִצְוֺת־יְהֹוָ֛ה וְחֻקָּ֖יו עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vzh  prshgn hnshtvn 'shr ntn hmlkh 'rtchshst' l'zr' hkhhn hspr spr dbry mtsvtyhvh vchqyv 'lyshr'l {p}
verses.translation: Now this is the copy of the letter that the king Artaxerxes gave unto Ezra the priest, the scribe, even the scribe of the words of the commandments of the LORD, and of His statutes to Israel:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֨רְתַּחְשַׁ֔סְתְּא מֶ֖לֶךְ מַלְכַיָּ֑א לְעֶזְרָ֣א כָ֠הֲנָ֠א סָפַ֨ר דָּתָ֜א דִּֽי־אֱלָ֧הּ שְׁמַיָּ֛א גְּמִ֖יר וּכְעֶֽנֶת׃
verses.translit: 'rtchshst' mlkh mlkhy' l'zr' khhn' spr dt' dy'lh shmy' gmyr vkh'nt
verses.translation: ’Artaxerxes, king of kings, unto Ezra the priest, the scribe of the Law of the God of heaven, and so forth. And now
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִנִּי֮ שִׂ֣ים טְעֵם֒ דִּ֣י כׇל־מִתְנַדַּ֣ב בְּמַלְכוּתִי֩ מִן־עַמָּ֨א יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל וְכָהֲנ֣וֹהִי וְלֵוָיֵ֗א לִמְהָ֧ךְ לִֽירוּשְׁלֶ֛ם עִמָּ֖ךְ יְהָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: mny shym t'm dy khlmtndb bmlkhvty mn'm' yshr'l vkhhnvhy vlvy' lmhkh lyrvshlm 'mkh yhkh
verses.translation: I make a decree, that all they of the people of Israel, and their priests and the Levites, in my realm, that are minded of their own free will to go with thee to Jerusalem, go.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־קֳבֵ֗ל דִּי֩ מִן־קֳדָ֨ם מַלְכָּ֜א וְשִׁבְעַ֤ת יָעֲטֹ֙הִי֙ שְׁלִ֔יחַ לְבַקָּרָ֥ה עַל־יְה֖וּד וְלִֽירוּשְׁלֶ֑ם בְּדָ֥ת אֱלָהָ֖ךְ דִּ֥י בִידָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: khlqbl dy mnqdm mlkh' vshb't y'thy shlych lbqrh 'lyhvd vlyrvshlm bdt 'lhkh dy bydkh
verses.translation: Forasmuch as thou art sent of the king and his seven counsellors, to inquire concerning Judah and Jerusalem, according to the law of thy God which is in thy hand;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְהֵיבָלָ֖ה כְּסַ֣ף וּדְהַ֑ב דִּֽי־מַלְכָּ֣א וְיָעֲט֗וֹהִי הִתְנַדַּ֙בוּ֙ לֶאֱלָ֣הּ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל דִּ֥י בִֽירוּשְׁלֶ֖ם מִשְׁכְּנֵֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vlhyblh khsf vdhb dymlkh' vy'tvhy htndbv l'lh yshr'l dy byrvshlm mshkhnh
verses.translation: and to carry the silver and gold, which the king and his counsellors have freely offered unto the God of Israel, whose habitation is in Jerusalem,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכֹל֙ כְּסַ֣ף וּדְהַ֔ב דִּ֣י תְהַשְׁכַּ֔ח בְּכֹ֖ל מְדִינַ֣ת בָּבֶ֑ל עִם֩ הִתְנַדָּב֨וּת עַמָּ֤א וְכָֽהֲנַיָּא֙ מִֽתְנַדְּבִ֔ין לְבֵ֥ית אֱלָהֲהֹ֖ם דִּ֥י בִירוּשְׁלֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vkhl khsf vdhb dy thshkhch bkhl mdynt bbl 'm htndbvt 'm' vkhhny' mtndbyn lbyt 'lhhm dy byrvshlm
verses.translation: and all the silver and gold that thou shalt find in all the province of Babylon, with the freewill-offering of the people, and of the priests, offering willingly for the house of their God which is in Jerusalem;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־קֳבֵ֣ל דְּנָה֩ אׇסְפַּ֨רְנָא תִקְנֵ֜א בְּכַסְפָּ֣א דְנָ֗ה תּוֹרִ֤ין ׀ דִּכְרִין֙ אִמְּרִ֔ין וּמִנְחָתְה֖וֹן וְנִסְכֵּיה֑וֹן וּתְקָרֵ֣ב הִמּ֔וֹ עַֽל־מַדְבְּחָ֔ה דִּ֛י בֵּ֥ית אֱלָהֲכֹ֖ם דִּ֥י בִירוּשְׁלֶֽם׃
verses.translit: khlqbl dnh 'sprn' tqn' bkhsp' dnh tvryn  dkhryn 'mryn vmnchthvn vnskhyhvn vtqrb hmv 'lmdbchh dy byt 'lhkhm dy byrvshlm
verses.translation: therefore thou shalt with all diligence buy with this money bullocks, rams, lambs, with their meal-offerings and their drink-offerings, and shalt offer them upon the altar of the house of your God which is in Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמָ֣ה דִי֩ (עליך) [עֲלָ֨ךְ] וְעַל־[אֶחָ֜ךְ] (אחיך) יֵיטַ֗ב בִּשְׁאָ֛ר כַּסְפָּ֥א וְדַהֲבָ֖ה לְמֶעְבַּ֑ד כִּרְע֥וּת אֱלָהֲכֹ֖ם תַּעַבְדֽוּן׃
verses.translit: vmh dy ('lykh) ['lkh] v'l['chkh] ('chykh) yytb bsh'r khsp' vdhbh lm'bd khr'vt 'lhkhm t'bdvn
verses.translation: And whatsoever shall seem good to thee and to thy brethren to do with the rest of the silver and the gold, that do ye after the will of your God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמָֽאנַיָּא֙ דִּֽי־מִתְיַהֲבִ֣ין לָ֔ךְ לְפׇלְחָ֖ן בֵּ֣ית אֱלָהָ֑ךְ הַשְׁלֵ֕ם קֳדָ֖ם אֱלָ֥הּ יְרוּשְׁלֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vm'ny' dymtyhbyn lkh lplchn byt 'lhkh hshlm qdm 'lh yrvshlm
verses.translation: And the vessels that are given thee for the service of the house of thy God, deliver thou before the God of Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׁאָ֗ר חַשְׁחוּת֙ בֵּ֣ית אֱלָהָ֔ךְ דִּ֥י יִפֶּל־לָ֖ךְ לְמִנְתַּ֑ן תִּנְתֵּ֕ן מִן־בֵּ֖ית גִּנְזֵ֥י מַלְכָּֽא׃
verses.translit: vsh'r chshchvt byt 'lhkh dy ypllkh lmntn tntn mnbyt gnzy mlkh'
verses.translation: And whatsoever more shall be needful for the house of thy God, which thou shalt have occasion to bestow, bestow it out of the king’s treasure-house.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּ֠מִנִּ֠י אֲנָ֞ה אַרְתַּחְשַׁ֤סְתְּא מַלְכָּא֙ שִׂ֣ים טְעֵ֔ם לְכֹל֙ גִּזַּֽבְרַיָּ֔א דִּ֖י בַּעֲבַ֣ר נַהֲרָ֑ה דִּ֣י כׇל־דִּ֣י יִ֠שְׁאֲלֶנְכ֠וֹן עֶזְרָ֨א כָהֲנָ֜א סָפַ֤ר דָּתָא֙ דִּֽי־אֱלָ֣הּ שְׁמַיָּ֔א אׇסְפַּ֖רְנָא יִתְעֲבִֽד׃
verses.translit: vmny 'nh 'rtchshst' mlkh' shym t'm lkhl gzbry' dy b'br nhrh dy khldy ysh'lnkhvn 'zr' khhn' spr dt' dy'lh shmy' 'sprn' yt'bd
verses.translation: And I, even I Artaxerxes the king, do make a decree to all the treasurers that are beyond the River, that whatsoever Ezra the priest, the scribe of the Law of the God of heaven, shall require of you, it be done with all diligence,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַד־כְּסַף֮ כַּכְּרִ֣ין מְאָה֒ וְעַד־חִנְטִין֙ כּוֹרִ֣ין מְאָ֔ה וְעַד־חֲמַר֙ בַּתִּ֣ין מְאָ֔ה וְעַד־בַּתִּ֥ין מְשַׁ֖ח מְאָ֑ה וּמְלַ֖ח דִּי־לָ֥א כְתָֽב׃
verses.translit: 'dkhsf khkhryn m'h v'dchntyn khvryn m'h v'dchmr btyn m'h v'dbtyn mshch m'h vmlch dyl' khtb
verses.translation: unto a hundred talents of silver, and to a hundred measures of wheat, and to a hundred baths of wine, and to a hundred baths of oil, and salt without prescribing how much.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־דִּ֗י מִן־טַ֙עַם֙ אֱלָ֣הּ שְׁמַיָּ֔א יִתְעֲבֵד֙ אַדְרַזְדָּ֔א לְבֵ֖ית אֱלָ֣הּ שְׁמַיָּ֑א דִּֽי־לְמָ֤ה לֶֽהֱוֵא֙ קְצַ֔ף עַל־מַלְכ֥וּת מַלְכָּ֖א וּבְנֽוֹהִי׃
verses.translit: khldy mnt'm 'lh shmy' yt'bd 'drzd' lbyt 'lh shmy' dylmh lhv' qtsf 'lmlkhvt mlkh' vbnvhy
verses.translation: Whatsoever is commanded by the God of heaven, let it be done exactly for the house of the God of heaven; for why should there be wrath against the realm of the king and his sons?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְכֹ֣ם מְהוֹדְעִ֗ין דִּ֣י כׇל־כָּהֲנַיָּ֣א וְ֠לֵוָיֵ֠א זַמָּ֨רַיָּ֤א תָרָֽעַיָּא֙ נְתִ֣ינַיָּ֔א וּפָ֣לְחֵ֔י בֵּ֖ית אֱלָהָ֣א דְנָ֑ה מִנְדָּ֤ה בְלוֹ֙ וַהֲלָ֔ךְ לָ֥א שַׁלִּ֖יט לְמִרְמֵ֥א עֲלֵיהֹֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vlkhm mhvd'yn dy khlkhhny' vlvy' zmry' tr'y' ntyny' vplchy byt 'lh' dnh mndh blv vhlkh l' shlyt lmrm' 'lyhm {p}
verses.translation: Also we announce to you, that touching any of the priests and Levites, the singers, porters, Nethinim, or servants of this house of God, it shall not be lawful to impose tribute, impost, or toll, upon them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַ֣נְתְּ עֶזְרָ֗א כְּחׇכְמַ֨ת אֱלָהָ֤ךְ דִּֽי־בִידָךְ֙ מֶ֣נִּי שָׁפְטִ֞ין וְדַיָּנִ֗ין דִּי־לֶהֱוֺ֤ן (דאנין) [דָּאיְנִין֙] לְכׇל־עַמָּא֙ דִּ֚י בַּעֲבַ֣ר נַהֲרָ֔ה לְכׇל־יָדְעֵ֖י דָּתֵ֣י אֱלָהָ֑ךְ וְדִ֧י לָ֦א יָדַ֖ע תְּהוֹדְעֽוּן׃
verses.translit: v'nt 'zr' khchkhmt 'lhkh dybydkh mny shptyn vdynyn dylhvn (d'nyn) [d'ynyn] lkhl'm' dy b'br nhrh lkhlyd'y dty 'lhkh vdy l' yd' thvd'vn
verses.translation: And thou, Ezra, after the wisdom of thy God that is in thy hand, appoint magistrates and judges, who may judge all the people that are beyond the River, all such as know the laws of thy God; and teach ye him that knoweth them not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכׇל־דִּי־לָא֩ לֶהֱוֵ֨א עָבֵ֜ד דָּתָ֣א דִֽי־אֱלָהָ֗ךְ וְדָתָא֙ דִּ֣י מַלְכָּ֔א אׇסְפַּ֕רְנָא דִּינָ֕ה לֶהֱוֵ֥א מִתְעֲבֵ֖ד מִנֵּ֑הּ הֵ֤ן לְמוֹת֙ הֵ֣ן (לשרשו) [לִשְׁרֹשִׁ֔י] הֵן־לַעֲנָ֥שׁ נִכְסִ֖ין וְלֶאֱסוּרִֽין׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vkhldyl' lhv' 'bd dt' dy'lhkh vdt' dy mlkh' 'sprn' dynh lhv' mt'bd mnh hn lmvt hn (lshrshv) [lshrshy] hnl'nsh nkhsyn vl'svryn {p}
verses.translation: And whosoever will not do the law of thy God, and the law of the king, let judgment be executed upon him with all diligence, whether it be unto death, or to banishment, or to confiscation of goods, or to imprisonment.’ .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּר֥וּךְ יְהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבֹתֵ֑ינוּ אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֤ן כָּזֹאת֙ בְּלֵ֣ב הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ לְפָאֵ֕ר אֶת־בֵּ֥ית יְהֹוָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּירוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: brvkh yhvh 'lhy 'btynv 'shr ntn khz't blb hmlkh lp'r 'tbyt yhvh 'shr byrvshl͏m
verses.translation: Blessed be the LORD, the God of our fathers, who hath put such a thing as this in the king’s heart, to beautify the house of the LORD which is in Jerusalem;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָלַ֣י הִטָּה־חֶ֗סֶד לִפְנֵ֤י הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ וְיֽוֹעֲצָ֔יו וּלְכׇל־שָׂרֵ֥י הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ הַגִּבֹּרִ֑ים וַאֲנִ֣י הִתְחַזַּ֗קְתִּי כְּיַד־יְהֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹהַי֙ עָלַ֔י וָאֶקְבְּצָ֧ה מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֛ל רָאשִׁ֖ים לַעֲל֥וֹת עִמִּֽי׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'ly hthchsd lpny hmlkh vyv'tsyv vlkhlshry hmlkh hgbrym v'ny htchzqty khydyhvh 'lhy 'ly v'qbtsh myshr'l r'shym l'lvt 'my {p}
verses.translation: and hath extended mercy unto me before the king, and his counsellors, and before all the king’s mighty princes. And I was strengthened according to the hand of the LORD my God upon me, and I gathered together out of Israel chief men to go up with me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֛לֶּה רָאשֵׁ֥י אֲבֹתֵיהֶ֖ם וְהִתְיַחְשָׂ֑ם הָעֹלִ֣ים עִמִּ֗י בְּמַלְכ֛וּת אַרְתַּחְשַׁ֥סְתְּא הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ מִבָּבֶֽל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'lh r'shy 'btyhm vhtychshm h'lym 'my bmlkhvt 'rtchshst' hmlkh mbbl {s}
verses.translation: Now these are the heads of their fathers’houses, and this is the genealogy of them that went up with me from Babylon, in the reign of Artaxerxes the king.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִבְּנֵ֤י פִֽינְחָס֙ גֵּֽרְשֹׁ֔ם {ס} מִבְּנֵ֥י אִיתָמָ֖ר דָּנִיֵּ֑אל {ס} מִבְּנֵ֥י דָוִ֖יד חַטּֽוּשׁ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: mbny pynchs grshm {s} mbny 'ytmr dny'l {s} mbny dvyd chtvsh {s}
verses.translation: Of the sons of Phinehas, Gershom; of the sons of Ithamar, Daniel; of the sons of David, Hattush.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִבְּנֵ֣י שְׁכַנְיָ֔ה {ס} מִבְּנֵ֥י פַרְעֹ֖שׁ זְכַרְיָ֑ה וְעִמּ֛וֹ הִתְיַחֵ֥שׂ לִזְכָרִ֖ים מֵאָ֥ה וַחֲמִשִּֽׁים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: mbny shkhnyh {s} mbny pr'sh zkhryh v'mv htychsh lzkhrym m'h vchmshym {s}
verses.translation: Of the sons of Shecaniah: of the sons of Parosh, Zechariah; and with him were reckoned by genealogy of the males a hundred and fifty.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִבְּנֵי֙ פַּחַ֣ת מוֹאָ֔ב אֶלְיְהֽוֹעֵינַ֖י בֶּן־זְרַֽחְיָ֑ה וְעִמּ֖וֹ מָאתַ֥יִם הַזְּכָרִֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: mbny pcht mv'b 'lyhv'yny bnzrchyh v'mv m'tym hzkhrym {s}
verses.translation: Of the sons of Pahath-moab, Eliehoenai the son of Zerahiah; and with him two hundred males.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִבְּנֵ֥י שְׁכַנְיָ֖ה בֶּן־יַחֲזִיאֵ֑ל וְעִמּ֕וֹ שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת הַזְּכָרִֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: mbny shkhnyh bnychzy'l v'mv shlsh m'vt hzkhrym {s}
verses.translation: Of the sons of Shechaniah, the son of Jahaziel; and with him three hundred males.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִבְּנֵ֣י עָדִ֔ין עֶ֖בֶד בֶּן־יוֹנָתָ֑ן וְעִמּ֖וֹ חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים הַזְּכָרִֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vmbny 'dyn 'bd bnyvntn v'mv chmshym hzkhrym {s}
verses.translation: And of the sons of Adin, Ebed the son of Jonathan; and with him fifty males.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִבְּנֵ֣י עֵילָ֔ם יְשַֽׁעְיָ֖ה בֶּן־עֲתַלְיָ֑ה וְעִמּ֖וֹ שִׁבְעִ֥ים הַזְּכָרִֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vmbny 'ylm ysh'yh bn'tlyh v'mv shb'ym hzkhrym {s}
verses.translation: And of the sons of Elam, Jeshaiah the son of Athaliah; and with him seventy males.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִבְּנֵ֣י שְׁפַטְיָ֔ה זְבַדְיָ֖ה בֶּן־מִֽיכָאֵ֑ל וְעִמּ֖וֹ שְׁמֹנִ֥ים הַזְּכָרִֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vmbny shptyh zbdyh bnmykh'l v'mv shmnym hzkhrym {s}
verses.translation: And of the sons of Shephatiah, Zebadiah the son of Michael; and with him fourscore males.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִבְּנֵ֣י יוֹאָ֔ב עֹבַדְיָ֖ה בֶּן־יְחִיאֵ֑ל וְעִמּ֕וֹ מָאתַ֛יִם וּשְׁמֹנָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר הַזְּכָרִֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: mbny yv'b 'bdyh bnychy'l v'mv m'tym vshmnh 'shr hzkhrym {s}
verses.translation: Of the sons of Joab, Obadiah the son of Jehiel; and with him two hundred and eighteen males.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִבְּנֵ֥י שְׁלוֹמִ֖ית בֶּן־יוֹסִפְיָ֑ה וְעִמּ֕וֹ מֵאָ֥ה וְשִׁשִּׁ֖ים הַזְּכָרִֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vmbny shlvmyt bnyvspyh v'mv m'h vshshym hzkhrym {s}
verses.translation: And of the sons of Shelomith, the son of Josiphiah; and with him a hundred and threescore males.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִבְּנֵ֣י בֵבַ֔י זְכַרְיָ֖ה בֶּן־בֵּבָ֑י וְעִמּ֕וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנָ֖ה הַזְּכָרִֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vmbny bby zkhryh bnbby v'mv 'shrym vshmnh hzkhrym {s}
verses.translation: And of the sons of Bebai, Zechariah the son of Bebai; and with him twenty and eight males.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִבְּנֵ֣י עַזְגָּ֔ד יוֹחָנָ֖ן בֶּן־הַקָּטָ֑ן וְעִמּ֕וֹ מֵאָ֥ה וַעֲשָׂרָ֖ה הַזְּכָרִֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vmbny 'zgd yvchnn bnhqtn v'mv m'h v'shrh hzkhrym {s}
verses.translation: And of the sons of Azgad, Johanan the son of Hakkatan; and with him a hundred and ten males.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִבְּנֵ֣י אֲדֹנִיקָם֮ אַחֲרֹנִים֒ וְאֵ֣לֶּה שְׁמוֹתָ֔ם אֱלִיפֶ֖לֶט יְעִיאֵ֣ל וּֽשְׁמַעְיָ֑ה וְעִמָּהֶ֖ם שִׁשִּׁ֥ים הַזְּכָרִֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vmbny 'dnyqm 'chrnym v'lh shmvtm 'lyplt y'y'l vshm'yh v'mhm shshym hzkhrym {s}
verses.translation: And of the sons of Adonikam, that were the last; and these are their names, Eliphelet, Jeiel, and Shemaiah; and with them threescore males.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִבְּנֵ֥י בִגְוַ֖י עוּתַ֣י (וזבוד) [וְזַכּ֑וּר] וְעִמּ֖וֹ שִׁבְעִ֥ים הַזְּכָרִֽים׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vmbny bgvy 'vty (vzbvd) [vzkhvr] v'mv shb'ym hzkhrym {p}
verses.translation: And of the sons of Bigvai, Uthai and Zaccur; and with him seventy males.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָֽאֶקְבְּצֵ֗ם אֶל־הַנָּהָר֙ הַבָּ֣א אֶֽל־אַהֲוָ֔א וַנַּחֲנֶ֥ה שָׁ֖ם יָמִ֣ים שְׁלֹשָׁ֑ה וָאָבִ֤ינָה בָעָם֙ וּבַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים וּמִבְּנֵ֥י לֵוִ֖י לֹא־מָצָ֥אתִי שָֽׁם׃
verses.translit: v'qbtsm 'lhnhr hb' 'l'hv' vnchnh shm ymym shlshh v'bynh b'm vbkhhnym vmbny lvy l'mts'ty shm
verses.translation: And I gathered them together to the river that runneth to Ahava; and there we encamped three days; and I viewed the people, and the priests, and found there none of the sons of Levi.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֶשְׁלְחָ֡ה לֶאֱלִיעֶ֡זֶר לַאֲרִיאֵ֡ל לִֽ֠שְׁמַעְיָ֠ה וּלְאֶלְנָתָ֨ן וּלְיָרִ֜יב וּלְאֶלְנָתָ֧ן וּלְנָתָ֛ן וְלִזְכַרְיָ֥ה וְלִמְשֻׁלָּ֖ם רָאשִׁ֑ים וּלְיוֹיָרִ֥יב וּלְאֶלְנָתָ֖ן מְבִינִֽים׃
verses.translit: v'shlchh l'ly'zr l'ry'l lshm'yh vl'lntn vlyryb vl'lntn vlntn vlzkhryh vlmshlm r'shym vlyvyryb vl'lntn mbynym
verses.translation: Then sent I for Eliezer, for Ariel, for Shemaiah, and for Elnathan, and for Jarib, and for Elnathan, and for Nathan, and for Zechariah, and for Meshullam, chief men; also for Joiarib, and for Elnathan, teachers.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (ואוצאה) [וָאֲצַוֶּ֤ה] אוֹתָם֙ עַל־אִדּ֣וֹ הָרֹ֔אשׁ בְּכָסִפְיָ֖א הַמָּק֑וֹם וָאָשִׂ֩ימָה֩ בְּפִיהֶ֨ם דְּבָרִ֜ים לְ֠דַבֵּ֠ר אֶל־אִדּ֨וֹ אָחִ֤יו (הנתונים) [הַנְּתִינִים֙] בְּכָסִפְיָ֣א הַמָּק֔וֹם לְהָֽבִיא־לָ֥נוּ מְשָׁרְתִ֖ים לְבֵ֥ית אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: (v'vts'h) [v'tsvh] 'vtm 'l'dv hr'sh bkhspy' hmqvm v'shymh bpyhm dbrym ldbr 'l'dv 'chyv (hntvnym) [hntynym] bkhspy' hmqvm lhby'lnv mshrtym lbyt 'lhynv
verses.translation: And I gave them commandment unto Iddo the chief at the place Casiphia; and I told them what they should say unto Iddo [and] his brother, who were set over the place Casiphia, that they should bring unto us ministers for the house of our God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבִ֨יאּוּ לָ֜נוּ כְּיַד־אֱלֹהֵ֨ינוּ הַטּוֹבָ֤ה עָלֵ֙ינוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ שֶׂ֔כֶל {ס} מִבְּנֵ֣י מַחְלִ֔י בֶּן־לֵוִ֖י בֶּן־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְשֵׁרֵ֥בְיָ֛ה וּבָנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁמֹנָ֥ה עָשָֽׂר׃
verses.translit: vyby'v lnv khyd'lhynv htvbh 'lynv 'ysh shkhl {s} mbny mchly bnlvy bnyshr'l vshrbyh vbnyv v'chyv shmnh 'shr
verses.translation: And according to the good hand of our God upon us they brought us a man of discretion, of the sons of Mahli, the son of Levi, the son of Israel; and Sherebiah, with his sons and his brethren, eighteen;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶ֨ת־חֲשַׁבְיָ֔ה וְאִתּ֥וֹ יְשַֽׁעְיָ֖ה מִבְּנֵ֣י מְרָרִ֑י אֶחָ֥יו וּבְנֵיהֶ֖ם עֶשְׂרִֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'tchshbyh v'tv ysh'yh mbny mrry 'chyv vbnyhm 'shrym {s}
verses.translation: and Hashabiah, and with him Jeshaiah of the sons of Merari, his brethren and their sons, twenty;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִן־הַנְּתִינִ֗ים שֶׁנָּתַ֨ן דָּוִ֤יד וְהַשָּׂרִים֙ לַעֲבֹדַ֣ת הַלְוִיִּ֔ם נְתִינִ֖ים מָאתַ֣יִם וְעֶשְׂרִ֑ים כֻּלָּ֖ם נִקְּב֥וּ בְשֵׁמֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vmnhntynym shntn dvyd vhshrym l'bdt hlvym ntynym m'tym v'shrym khlm nqbv bshmvt
verses.translation: and of the Nethinim, whom David and the princes had given for the service of the Levites, two hundred and twenty Nethinim; all of them were mentioned by name.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֶקְרָ֨א שָׁ֥ם צוֹם֙ עַל־הַנָּהָ֣ר אַהֲוָ֔א לְהִתְעַנּ֖וֹת לִפְנֵ֣י אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ לְבַקֵּ֤שׁ מִמֶּ֙נּוּ֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ יְשָׁרָ֔ה לָ֥נוּ וּלְטַפֵּ֖נוּ וּלְכׇל־רְכוּשֵֽׁנוּ׃
verses.translit: v'qr' shm tsvm 'lhnhr 'hv' lht'nvt lpny 'lhynv lbqsh mmnv drkh yshrh lnv vltpnv vlkhlrkhvshnv
verses.translation: Then I proclaimed a fast there, at the river Ahava, that we might humble ourselves before our God, to seek of Him a straight way, for us, and for our little ones, and for all our substance.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י בֹ֗שְׁתִּי לִשְׁא֤וֹל מִן־הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ חַ֣יִל וּפָרָשִׁ֔ים לְעׇזְרֵ֥נוּ מֵאוֹיֵ֖ב בַּדָּ֑רֶךְ כִּֽי־אָמַ֨רְנוּ לַמֶּ֜לֶךְ לֵאמֹ֗ר יַד־אֱלֹהֵ֤ינוּ עַל־כׇּל־מְבַקְשָׁיו֙ לְטוֹבָ֔ה וְעֻזּ֣וֹ וְאַפּ֔וֹ עַ֖ל כׇּל־עֹזְבָֽיו׃
verses.translit: khy bshty lsh'vl mnhmlkh chyl vprshym l'zrnv m'vyb bdrkh khy'mrnv lmlkh l'mr yd'lhynv 'lkhlmbqshyv ltvbh v'zv v'pv 'l khl'zbyv
verses.translation: For I was ashamed to ask of the king a band of soldiers and horsemen to help us against the enemy in the way; because we had spoken unto the king, saying: ‘The hand of our God is upon all them that seek Him, for good; but His power and His wrath is against all them that forsake Him.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַנָּצ֛וּמָה וַנְּבַקְשָׁ֥ה מֵאֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ עַל־זֹ֑את וַיֵּעָתֵ֖ר לָֽנוּ׃
verses.translit: vntsvmh vnbqshh m'lhynv 'lz't vy'tr lnv
verses.translation: So we fasted and besought our God for this; and He was entreated of us.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאַבְדִּ֛ילָה מִשָּׂרֵ֥י הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים שְׁנֵ֣ים עָשָׂ֑ר לְשֵׁרֵֽבְיָ֣ה חֲשַׁבְיָ֔ה וְעִמָּהֶ֥ם מֵאֲחֵיהֶ֖ם עֲשָׂרָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'bdylh mshry hkhhnym shnym 'shr lshrbyh chshbyh v'mhm m'chyhm 'shrh
verses.translation: Then I separated twelve of the chiefs of the priests, besides Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of their brethren with them,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (ואשקולה) [וָאֶשְׁקֳלָ֣ה] לָהֶ֔ם אֶת־הַכֶּ֥סֶף וְאֶת־הַזָּהָ֖ב וְאֶת־הַכֵּלִ֑ים תְּרוּמַ֣ת בֵּית־אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ הַהֵרִ֙ימוּ֙ הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ וְיֹעֲצָ֣יו וְשָׂרָ֔יו וְכׇל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הַנִּמְצָאִֽים׃
verses.translit: (v'shqvlh) [v'shqlh] lhm 'thkhsf v'thzhb v'thkhlym trvmt byt'lhynv hhrymv hmlkh vy'tsyv vshryv vkhlyshr'l hnmts'ym
verses.translation: and weighed unto them the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, even the offering for the house of our God, which the king, and his counsellors, and his princes, and all Israel there present, had offered;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֶשְׁקְלָ֨ה עַל־יָדָ֜ם כֶּ֗סֶף כִּכָּרִים֙ שֵֽׁשׁ־מֵא֣וֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁ֔ים וּכְלֵי־כֶ֥סֶף מֵאָ֖ה לְכִכָּרִ֑ים זָהָ֖ב מֵאָ֥ה כִכָּֽר׃
verses.translit: v'shqlh 'lydm khsf khkhrym shshm'vt vchmshym vkhlykhsf m'h lkhkhrym zhb m'h khkhr
verses.translation: I even weighed into their hand six hundred and fifty talents of silver, and silver vessels a hundred talents; of gold a hundred talents;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּכְפֹרֵ֤י זָהָב֙ עֶשְׂרִ֔ים לַאֲדַרְכֹנִ֖ים אָ֑לֶף וּכְלֵ֨י נְחֹ֜שֶׁת מֻצְהָ֤ב טוֹבָה֙ שְׁנַ֔יִם חֲמוּדֹ֖ת כַּזָּהָֽב׃
verses.translit: vkhpry zhb 'shrym l'drkhnym 'lf vkhly nchsht mtshb tvbh shnym chmvdt khzhb
verses.translation: and twenty bowls of gold, of a thousand darics; and two vessels of fine bright brass, precious as gold.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֹמְרָ֣ה אֲלֵהֶ֗ם אַתֶּ֥ם קֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ לַיהֹוָ֔ה וְהַכֵּלִ֖ים קֹ֑דֶשׁ וְהַכֶּ֤סֶף וְהַזָּהָב֙ נְדָבָ֔ה לַיהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v'mrh 'lhm 'tm qdsh lyhvh vhkhlym qdsh vhkhsf vhzhb ndbh lyhvh 'lhy 'btykhm
verses.translation: And I said unto them: ‘Ye are holy unto the LORD, and the vessels are holy; and the silver and the gold are a freewill-offering unto the LORD, the God of your fathers.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁקְד֣וּ וְשִׁמְר֗וּ עַֽד־תִּשְׁקְל֡וּ לִפְנֵי֩ שָׂרֵ֨י הַכֹּהֲנִ֧ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֛ם וְשָׂרֵֽי־הָאָב֥וֹת לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בִּירוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם הַלִּשְׁכ֖וֹת בֵּ֥ית יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: shqdv vshmrv 'dtshqlv lpny shry hkhhnym vhlvym vshryh'bvt lyshr'l byrvshl͏m hlshkhvt byt yhvh
verses.translation: Watch ye, and keep them, until ye weigh them before the chiefs of the priests and the Levites, and the princes of the fathers’houses of Israel, at Jerusalem, in the chambers of the house of the LORD.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְקִבְּלוּ֙ הַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֔ם מִשְׁקַ֛ל הַכֶּ֥סֶף וְהַזָּהָ֖ב וְהַכֵּלִ֑ים לְהָבִ֥יא לִירוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם לְבֵ֥ית אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vqblv hkhhnym vhlvym mshql hkhsf vhzhb vhkhlym lhby' lyrvshl͏m lbyt 'lhynv {p}
verses.translation: So the priests and the Levites received the weight of the silver and the gold, and the vessels, to bring them to Jerusalem unto the house of our God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽנִּסְּעָ֞ה מִנְּהַ֣ר אַֽהֲוָ֗א בִּשְׁנֵ֤ים עָשָׂר֙ לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֔וֹן לָלֶ֖כֶת יְרוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם וְיַד־אֱלֹהֵ֙ינוּ֙ הָיְתָ֣ה עָלֵ֔ינוּ וַיַּ֨צִּילֵ֔נוּ מִכַּ֥ף אוֹיֵ֛ב וְאוֹרֵ֖ב עַל־הַדָּֽרֶךְ׃
verses.translit: vns'h mnhr 'hv' bshnym 'shr lchdsh hr'shvn llkht yrvshl͏m vyd'lhynv hyth 'lynv vytsylnv mkhf 'vyb v'vrb 'lhdrkh
verses.translation: Then we departed from the river of Ahava on the twelfth day of the first month, to go unto Jerusalem; and the hand of our God was upon us, and He delivered us from the hand of the enemy and lier-in-wait by the way.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַנָּב֖וֹא יְרוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם וַנֵּ֥שֶׁב שָׁ֖ם יָמִ֥ים שְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃
verses.translit: vnbv' yrvshl͏m vnshb shm ymym shlshh
verses.translation: And we came to Jerusalem, and abode there three days.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבַיּ֣וֹם הָרְבִיעִ֡י נִשְׁקַ֣ל הַכֶּ֩סֶף֩ וְהַזָּהָ֨ב וְהַכֵּלִ֜ים בְּבֵ֣ית אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ עַ֠ל יַד־מְרֵמ֤וֹת בֶּן־אֽוּרִיָּה֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְעִמּ֖וֹ אֶלְעָזָ֣ר בֶּן־פִּֽינְחָ֑ס וְעִמָּהֶ֞ם יוֹזָבָ֧ד בֶּן־יֵשׁ֛וּעַ וְנֽוֹעַדְיָ֥ה בֶן־בִּנּ֖וּי הַלְוִיִּֽם׃
verses.translit: vbyvm hrby'y nshql hkhsf vhzhb vhkhlym bbyt 'lhynv 'l ydmrmvt bn'vryh hkhhn v'mv 'l'zr bnpynchs v'mhm yvzbd bnyshv' vnv'dyh bnbnvy hlvym
verses.translation: And on the fourth day was the silver and the gold and the vessels weighed in the house of our God into the hand of Meremoth the son of Uriah the priest; and with him was Eleazar the son of Phinehas; and with them was Jozabad the son of Jeshua, and Noadiah the son of Binnui, the Levites;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּמִסְפָּ֥ר בְּמִשְׁקָ֖ל לַכֹּ֑ל וַיִּכָּתֵ֥ב כׇּֽל־הַמִּשְׁקָ֖ל בָּעֵ֥ת הַהִֽיא׃ {פ}
verses.translit: bmspr bmshql lkhl vykhtb khlhmshql b't hhy' {p}
verses.translation: the whole by number and by weight; and all the weight was written at that time.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַ֠בָּאִ֠ים מֵֽהַשְּׁבִ֨י בְנֵֽי־הַגּוֹלָ֜ה הִקְרִ֥יבוּ עֹל֣וֹת  לֵאלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל פָּרִ֨ים שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂ֤ר עַל־כׇּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֵילִ֣ים  תִּשְׁעִ֣ים וְשִׁשָּׁ֗ה כְּבָשִׂים֙ שִׁבְעִ֣ים וְשִׁבְעָ֔ה צְפִירֵ֥י חַטָּ֖את שְׁנֵ֣ים עָשָׂ֑ר הַכֹּ֖ל עוֹלָ֥ה לַיהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: hb'ym mhshby bnyhgvlh hqrybv 'lvt  l'lhy yshr'l prym shnym'shr 'lkhlyshr'l 'ylym  tsh'ym vshshh khbshym shb'ym vshb'h tspyry cht't shnym 'shr hkhl 'vlh lyhvh {p}
verses.translation: The children of the captivity, that were come out of exile, offered burnt-offerings unto the God of Israel, twelve bullocks for all Israel, ninety and six rams, seventy and seven lambs, twelve he-goats for a sin-offering; all this was a burnt-offering unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיִּתְּנ֣וּ  אֶת־דָּתֵ֣י הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ לַאֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנֵי֙ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וּפַחֲו֖וֹת עֵ֣בֶר הַנָּהָ֑ר וְנִשְּׂא֥וּ אֶת־הָעָ֖ם וְאֶת־בֵּ֥ית הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vytnv  'tdty hmlkh l'chshdrpny hmlkh vpchvvt 'br hnhr vnsh'v 'th'm v'tbyt h'lhym {s}
verses.translation: And they delivered the king’s commissions unto the king’s satraps, and to the governors beyond the River; and they furthered the people and the house of God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּכְכַלּ֣וֹת אֵ֗לֶּה נִגְּשׁ֨וּ אֵלַ֤י הַשָּׂרִים֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לֹֽא־נִבְדְּל֞וּ הָעָ֤ם יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְהַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֔ם מֵעַמֵּ֖י הָאֲרָצ֑וֹת כְּ֠תֹעֲבֹֽתֵיהֶ֠ם לַכְּנַעֲנִ֨י הַחִתִּ֜י הַפְּרִזִּ֣י הַיְבוּסִ֗י הָֽעַמֹּנִי֙ הַמֹּ֣אָבִ֔י הַמִּצְרִ֖י וְהָאֱמֹרִֽי׃
verses.translit: vkhkhlvt 'lh ngshv 'ly hshrym l'mr l'nbdlv h'm yshr'l vhkhhnym vhlvym m'my h'rtsvt kht'btyhm lkhn'ny hchty hprzy hybvsy h'mny hm'by hmtsry vh'mry
verses.translation: Now when these things were done, the princes drew near unto me, saying: ‘The people of Israel, and the priests and the Levites, have not separated themselves from the peoples of the lands, doing according to their abominations, even of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Jebusites, the Ammonites, the Moabites, the Egyptians, and the Amorites.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־נָשְׂא֣וּ מִבְּנֹֽתֵיהֶ֗ם לָהֶם֙ וְלִבְנֵיהֶ֔ם וְהִתְעָֽרְבוּ֙ זֶ֣רַע הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ בְּעַמֵּ֖י הָאֲרָצ֑וֹת וְיַ֧ד הַשָּׂרִ֣ים וְהַסְּגָנִ֗ים הָ֥יְתָ֛ה בַּמַּ֥עַל הַזֶּ֖ה רִאשׁוֹנָֽה׃
verses.translit: khynsh'v mbntyhm lhm vlbnyhm vht'rbv zr' hqdsh b'my h'rtsvt vyd hshrym vhsgnym hyth bm'l hzh r'shvnh
verses.translation: For they have taken of their daughters for themselves and for their sons; so that the holy seed have mingled themselves with the peoples of the lands; yea, the hand of the princes and rulers hath been first in this faithlessness.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּכְשׇׁמְעִי֙ אֶת־הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֔ה קָרַ֥עְתִּי אֶת־בִּגְדִ֖י וּמְעִילִ֑י וָאֶמְרְטָ֞ה מִשְּׂעַ֤ר רֹאשִׁי֙ וּזְקָנִ֔י וָאֵשְׁבָ֖ה מְשׁוֹמֵֽם׃
verses.translit: vkhshm'y 'thdbr hzh qr'ty 'tbgdy vm'yly v'mrth msh'r r'shy vzqny v'shbh mshvmm
verses.translation: And when I heard this thing, I rent my garment and my mantle, and plucked off the hair of my head and of my beard, and sat down appalled.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵלַ֣י יֵאָסְפ֗וּ כֹּ֚ל חָרֵד֙ בְּדִבְרֵ֣י אֱלֹהֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עַ֖ל מַ֣עַל הַגּוֹלָ֑ה וַאֲנִי֙ יֹשֵׁ֣ב מְשׁוֹמֵ֔ם עַ֖ד לְמִנְחַ֥ת הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.translit: v'ly y'spv khl chrd bdbry 'lhyyshr'l 'l m'l hgvlh v'ny yshb mshvmm 'd lmncht h'rb
verses.translation: Then were assembled unto me every one that trembled at the words of the God of Israel, because of the faithlessness of them of the captivity; and I sat appalled until the evening offering.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְמִנְחַ֣ת הָעֶ֗רֶב קַ֚מְתִּי מִתַּֽעֲנִיתִ֔י וּבְקׇרְעִ֥י בִגְדִ֖י וּמְעִילִ֑י וָֽאֶכְרְעָה֙ עַל־בִּרְכַּ֔י וָאֶפְרְשָׂ֥ה כַפַּ֖י אֶל־יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽי׃
verses.translit: vbmncht h'rb qmty mt'nyty vbqr'y bgdy vm'yly v'khr'h 'lbrkhy v'prshh khpy 'lyhvh 'lhy
verses.translation: And at the evening offering I arose up from my fasting, even with my garment and my mantle rent; and I fell upon my knees, and spread out my hands unto the LORD my God;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֹמְרָ֗ה אֱלֹהַי֙ בֹּ֣שְׁתִּי וְנִכְלַ֔מְתִּי לְהָרִ֧ים אֱלֹהַ֛י פָּנַ֖י אֵלֶ֑יךָ כִּ֣י עֲוֺנֹתֵ֤ינוּ רָבוּ֙ לְמַ֣עְלָה רֹּ֔אשׁ וְאַשְׁמָתֵ֥נוּ גָדְלָ֖ה עַ֥ד לַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: v'mrh 'lhy bshty vnkhlmty lhrym 'lhy pny 'lykh khy 'vntynv rbv lm'lh r'sh v'shmtnv gdlh 'd lshmym
verses.translation: and I said: ‘O my God, I am ashamed and blush to lift up my face to Thee, my God; for our iniquities are increased over our head, and our guiltiness is grown up unto the heavens.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִימֵ֣י אֲבֹתֵ֗ינוּ אֲנַ֙חְנוּ֙ בְּאַשְׁמָ֣ה גְדֹלָ֔ה עַ֖ד הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה וּבַעֲוֺנֹתֵ֡ינוּ נִתַּ֡נּוּ אֲנַ֩חְנוּ֩ מְלָכֵ֨ינוּ כֹהֲנֵ֜ינוּ בְּיַ֣ד  מַלְכֵ֣י הָאֲרָצ֗וֹת בַּחֶ֜רֶב בַּשְּׁבִ֧י וּבַבִּזָּ֛ה וּבְבֹ֥שֶׁת פָּנִ֖ים כְּהַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: mymy 'btynv 'nchnv b'shmh gdlh 'd hyvm hzh vb'vntynv ntnv 'nchnv mlkhynv khhnynv byd  mlkhy h'rtsvt bchrb bshby vbbzh vbbsht pnym khhyvm hzh
verses.translation: Since the days of our fathers we have been exceeding guilty unto this day; and for our iniquities have we, our kings, and our priests, been delivered into the hand of the kings of the lands, to the sword, to captivity, and to spoiling, and to confusion of face, as it is this day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֡ה כִּמְעַט־רֶ֩גַע֩ הָיְתָ֨ה תְחִנָּ֜ה מֵאֵ֣ת  יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ לְהַשְׁאִ֥יר לָ֙נוּ֙ פְּלֵיטָ֔ה וְלָתֶת־לָ֥נוּ יָתֵ֖ד בִּמְק֣וֹם קׇדְשׁ֑וֹ לְהָאִ֤יר עֵינֵ֙ינוּ֙ אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ וּלְתִתֵּ֛נוּ מִֽחְיָ֥ה מְעַ֖ט בְּעַבְדֻתֵֽנוּ׃
verses.translit: v'th khm'trg' hyth tchnh m't  yhvh 'lhynv lhsh'yr lnv plyth vlttlnv ytd bmqvm qdshv lh'yr 'ynynv 'lhynv vlttnv mchyh m't b'bdtnv
verses.translation: And now for a little moment grace hath been shown from the LORD our God, to leave us a remnant to escape, and to give us a nail in His holy place, that our God may lighten our eyes, and give us a little reviving in our bondage.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־עֲבָדִ֣ים אֲנַ֔חְנוּ וּ֨בְעַבְדֻתֵ֔נוּ לֹ֥א עֲזָבָ֖נוּ אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ וַֽיַּט־עָלֵ֣ינוּ חֶ֡סֶד לִפְנֵי֩ מַלְכֵ֨י פָרַ֜ס לָֽתֶת־לָ֣נוּ מִֽחְיָ֗ה לְרוֹמֵ֞ם אֶת־בֵּ֤ית אֱלֹהֵ֙ינוּ֙ וּלְהַעֲמִ֣יד אֶת־חׇרְבֹתָ֔יו וְלָֽתֶת־לָ֣נוּ גָדֵ֔ר בִּֽיהוּדָ֖ה וּבִירוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khy'bdym 'nchnv vb'bdtnv l' 'zbnv 'lhynv vyt'lynv chsd lpny mlkhy prs lttlnv mchyh lrvmm 'tbyt 'lhynv vlh'myd 'tchrbtyv vlttlnv gdr byhvdh vbyrvshl͏m {s}
verses.translation: For we are bondmen; yet our God hath not forsaken us in our bondage, but hath extended mercy unto us in the sight of the kings of Persia, to give us a reviving, to set up the house of our God, and to repair the ruins thereof, and to give us a fence in Judah and in Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֛ה מַה־נֹּאמַ֥ר אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ אַֽחֲרֵי־זֹ֑את כִּ֥י עָזַ֖בְנוּ מִצְוֺתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: v'th mhn'mr 'lhynv 'chryz't khy 'zbnv mtsvtykh
verses.translation: And now, O our God, what shall we say after this? for we have forsaken Thy commandments,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוִּ֗יתָ בְּיַ֨ד עֲבָדֶ֣יךָ הַנְּבִיאִים֮ לֵאמֹר֒ הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַתֶּ֤ם בָּאִים֙ לְרִשְׁתָּ֔הּ אֶ֤רֶץ נִדָּה֙ הִ֔יא בְּנִדַּ֖ת עַמֵּ֣י הָאֲרָצ֑וֹת בְּתוֹעֲבֹֽתֵיהֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר מִלְא֛וּהָ מִפֶּ֥ה אֶל־פֶּ֖ה בְּטֻמְאָתָֽם׃
verses.translit: 'shr tsvyt byd 'bdykh hnby'ym l'mr h'rts 'shr 'tm b'ym lrshth 'rts ndh hy' bndt 'my h'rtsvt btv'btyhm 'shr ml'vh mph 'lph btm'tm
verses.translation: which Thou hast commanded by Thy servants the prophets, saying: The land, unto which ye go to possess it, is an unclean land through the uncleanness of the peoples of the lands, through their abominations, wherewith they have filled it from one end to another with their filthiness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֠עַתָּ֠ה בְּֽנוֹתֵיכֶ֞ם אַל־תִּתְּנ֣וּ לִבְנֵיהֶ֗ם וּבְנֹֽתֵיהֶם֙ אַל־תִּשְׂא֣וּ לִבְנֵיכֶ֔ם וְלֹֽא־תִדְרְשׁ֧וּ שְׁלֹמָ֛ם וְטוֹבָתָ֖ם עַד־עוֹלָ֑ם לְמַ֣עַן תֶּחֶזְק֗וּ וַאֲכַלְתֶּם֙ אֶת־ט֣וּב הָאָ֔רֶץ וְהוֹרַשְׁתֶּ֥ם לִבְנֵיכֶ֖ם עַד־עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: v'th bnvtykhm 'lttnv lbnyhm vbntyhm 'ltsh'v lbnykhm vl'tdrshv shlmm vtvbtm 'd'vlm lm'n tchzqv v'khltm 'ttvb h'rts vhvrshtm lbnykhm 'd'vlm
verses.translation: Now therefore give not your daughters unto their sons, neither take their daughters unto your sons, nor seek their peace or their prosperity for ever; that ye may be strong, and eat the good of the land, and leave it for an inheritance to your children for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַֽחֲרֵי֙ כׇּל־הַבָּ֣א עָלֵ֔ינוּ בְּמַעֲשֵׂ֙ינוּ֙ הָרָעִ֔ים וּבְאַשְׁמָתֵ֖נוּ הַגְּדֹלָ֑ה כִּ֣י  אַתָּ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ חָשַׂ֤כְתָּֽ לְמַ֙טָּה֙ מֵֽעֲוֺנֵ֔נוּ וְנָתַ֥תָּה לָּ֛נוּ פְּלֵיטָ֖ה כָּזֹֽאת׃
verses.translit: v'chry khlhb' 'lynv bm'shynv hr'ym vb'shmtnv hgdlh khy  'th 'lhynv chshkht lmth m'vnnv vntth lnv plyth khz't
verses.translation: And after all that is come upon us for our evil deeds, and for our great guilt, seeing that Thou our God hast punished us less than our iniquities deserve, and hast given us such a remnant,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲנָשׁוּב֙ לְהָפֵ֣ר מִצְוֺתֶ֔יךָ וּ֨לְהִתְחַתֵּ֔ן בְּעַמֵּ֥י הַתֹּעֵב֖וֹת הָאֵ֑לֶּה הֲל֤וֹא תֶֽאֱנַף־בָּ֙נוּ֙ עַד־כַּלֵּ֔ה לְאֵ֥ין שְׁאֵרִ֖ית וּפְלֵיטָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hnshvb lhpr mtsvtykh vlhtchtn b'my ht'bvt h'lh hlv' t'nfbnv 'dkhlh l'yn sh'ryt vplyth {s}
verses.translation: shall we again break Thy commandments, and make marriages with the peoples that do these abominations? wouldest not Thou be angry with us till Thou hadst consumed us, so that there should be no remnant, nor any to escape?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ צַדִּ֣יק אַ֔תָּה כִּֽי־נִשְׁאַ֥רְנוּ פְלֵיטָ֖ה כְּהַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה הִנְנ֤וּ לְפָנֶ֙יךָ֙ בְּאַשְׁמָתֵ֔ינוּ כִּ֣י אֵ֥ין לַעֲמ֛וֹד לְפָנֶ֖יךָ עַל־זֹֽאת׃ {פ}
verses.translit: yhvh 'lhy yshr'l tsdyq 'th khynsh'rnv plyth khhyvm hzh hnnv lpnykh b'shmtynv khy 'yn l'mvd lpnykh 'lz't {p}
verses.translation: O LORD, the God of Israel, Thou art righteous; for we are left a remnant that is escaped, as it is this day; behold, we are before Thee in our guiltiness; for none can stand before Thee because of this.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּכְהִתְפַּלֵּ֤ל עֶזְרָא֙ וּכְהִתְוַדֹּת֔וֹ בֹּכֶה֙ וּמִתְנַפֵּ֔ל לִפְנֵ֖י בֵּ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים נִקְבְּצוּ֩ אֵלָ֨יו מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֜ל קָהָ֣ל רַב־מְאֹ֗ד אֲנָשִׁ֤ים וְנָשִׁים֙ וִֽילָדִ֔ים כִּֽי־בָכ֥וּ הָעָ֖ם הַרְבֵּה־בֶֽכֶה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vkhhtpll 'zr' vkhhtvdtv bkhh vmtnpl lpny byt h'lhym nqbtsv 'lyv myshr'l qhl rbm'd 'nshym vnshym vyldym khybkhv h'm hrbhbkhh {p}
verses.translation: Now while Ezra prayed, and made confession, weeping and casting himself down before the house of God, there was gathered together unto him out of Israel a very great congregation of men and women and children; for the people wept very sore.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֩עַן֩ שְׁכַנְיָ֨ה בֶן־יְחִיאֵ֜ל מִבְּנֵ֤י (עולם) [עֵילָם֙] וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לְעֶזְרָ֔א אֲנַ֙חְנוּ֙ מָעַ֣לְנוּ בֵאלֹהֵ֔ינוּ וַנֹּ֛שֶׁב נָשִׁ֥ים נׇכְרִיּ֖וֹת מֵעַמֵּ֣י הָאָ֑רֶץ וְעַתָּ֛ה יֵשׁ־מִקְוֶ֥ה לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עַל־זֹֽאת׃
verses.translit: vy'n shkhnyh bnychy'l mbny ('vlm) ['ylm] vy'mr l'zr' 'nchnv m'lnv b'lhynv vnshb nshym nkhryvt m'my h'rts v'th yshmqvh lyshr'l 'lz't
verses.translation: And Shecaniah the son of Jehiel, one of the sons of Elam, answered and said unto Ezra: ‘We have broken faith with our God, and have married foreign women of the peoples of the land; yet now there is hope for Israel concerning this thing.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֣ה נִֽכְרׇת־בְּרִ֣ית לֵ֠אלֹהֵ֠ינוּ לְהוֹצִ֨יא כׇל־נָשִׁ֜ים וְהַנּוֹלָ֤ד מֵהֶם֙ בַּעֲצַ֣ת אֲדֹנָ֔י וְהַחֲרֵדִ֖ים בְּמִצְוַ֣ת אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ וְכַתּוֹרָ֖ה יֵעָשֶֽׂה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'th nkhrtbryt l'lhynv lhvtsy' khlnshym vhnvld mhm b'tst 'dny vhchrdym bmtsvt 'lhynv vkhtvrh y'shh {p}
verses.translation: Now therefore let us make a covenant with our God to put away all the wives, and such as are born of them, according to the counsel of the LORD, and of those that tremble at the commandment of our God; and let it be done according to the law.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ק֛וּם כִּֽי־עָלֶ֥יךָ הַדָּבָ֖ר וַאֲנַ֣חְנוּ עִמָּ֑ךְ חֲזַ֖ק וַעֲשֵֽׂה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: qvm khy'lykh hdbr v'nchnv 'mkh chzq v'shh {p}
verses.translation: Arise; for the matter belongeth unto thee, and we are with thee; be of good courage, and do it.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֣קׇם עֶזְרָ֡א וַיַּשְׁבַּ֣ע אֶת־שָׂרֵי֩ הַכֹּהֲנִ֨ים הַלְוִיִּ֜ם וְכׇל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לַעֲשׂ֛וֹת כַּדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּ֖ה וַיִּשָּׁבֵֽעוּ׃
verses.translit: vyqm 'zr' vyshb' 'tshry hkhhnym hlvym vkhlyshr'l l'shvt khdbr hzh vyshb'v
verses.translation: Then arose Ezra, and made the chiefs of the priests, the Levites, and all Israel, to swear that they would do according to this word. So they swore.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֣קׇם עֶזְרָ֗א מִלִּפְנֵי֙ בֵּ֣ית הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים וַיֵּ֕לֶךְ אֶל־לִשְׁכַּ֖ת יְהוֹחָנָ֣ן בֶּן־אֶלְיָשִׁ֑יב וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ שָׁ֗ם לֶ֤חֶם לֹֽא־אָכַל֙ וּמַ֣יִם לֹֽא־שָׁתָ֔ה כִּ֥י מִתְאַבֵּ֖ל עַל־מַ֥עַל הַגּוֹלָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyqm 'zr' mlpny byt h'lhym vylkh 'llshkht yhvchnn bn'lyshyb vylkh shm lchm l''khl vmym l'shth khy mt'bl 'lm'l hgvlh
verses.translation: Then Ezra rose up from before the house of God, and went into the chamber of Jehohanan the son of Eliashib; and when he came thither, he did eat no bread, nor drink water; for he mourned because of the faithlessness of them of the captivity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּעֲבִ֨ירוּ ק֜וֹל בִּיהוּדָ֣ה וִירֽוּשָׁלַ֗͏ִם לְכֹל֙ בְּנֵ֣י הַגּוֹלָ֔ה לְהִקָּבֵ֖ץ יְרוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: vy'byrv qvl byhvdh vyrvshl͏m lkhl bny hgvlh lhqbts yrvshl͏m
verses.translation: And they made proclamation throughout Judah and Jerusalem unto all the children of the captivity, that they should gather themselves together unto Jerusalem;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכֹל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא־יָב֜וֹא לִשְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת הַיָּמִ֗ים כַּעֲצַ֤ת הַשָּׂרִים֙ וְהַזְּקֵנִ֔ים יׇחֳרַ֖ם כׇּל־רְכוּשׁ֑וֹ וְה֥וּא יִבָּדֵ֖ל מִקְּהַ֥ל הַגּוֹלָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vkhl 'shr l'ybv' lshlsht hymym kh'tst hshrym vhzqnym ychrm khlrkhvshv vhv' ybdl mqhl hgvlh {p}
verses.translation: and that whosoever came not within three days, according to the counsel of the princes and the elders, all his substance should be forfeited, and himself separated from the congregation of the captivity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקָּבְצ֣וּ כׇל־אַנְשֵֽׁי־יְהוּדָה֩ וּבִנְיָמִ֨ן ׀ יְרוּשָׁלַ֜͏ִם לִשְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת הַיָּמִ֗ים ה֛וּא חֹ֥דֶשׁ הַתְּשִׁיעִ֖י בְּעֶשְׂרִ֣ים בַּחֹ֑דֶשׁ וַיֵּשְׁב֣וּ כׇל־הָעָ֗ם בִּרְחוֹב֙ בֵּ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים מַרְעִידִ֥ים עַל־הַדָּבָ֖ר וּמֵהַגְּשָׁמִֽים׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyqbtsv khl'nshyyhvdh vbnymn  yrvshl͏m lshlsht hymym hv' chdsh htshy'y b'shrym bchdsh vyshbv khlh'm brchvb byt h'lhym mr'ydym 'lhdbr vmhgshmym {p}
verses.translation: Then all the men of Judah and Benjamin gathered themselves together unto Jerusalem within the three days; it was the ninth month, on the twentieth day of the month; and all the people sat in the broad place before the house of God, trembling because of this matter, and for the great rain.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֨קׇם עֶזְרָ֤א הַכֹּהֵן֙ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֔ם אַתֶּ֣ם מְעַלְתֶּ֔ם וַתֹּשִׁ֖יבוּ נָשִׁ֣ים נׇכְרִיּ֑וֹת לְהוֹסִ֖יף עַל־אַשְׁמַ֥ת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vyqm 'zr' hkhhn vy'mr 'lhm 'tm m'ltm vtshybv nshym nkhryvt lhvsyf 'l'shmt yshr'l
verses.translation: And Ezra the priest stood up, and said unto them: ‘Ye have broken faith, and have married foreign women, to increase the guilt of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה תְּנ֥וּ תוֹדָ֛ה לַיהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי־אֲבֹתֵיכֶ֖ם וַעֲשׂ֣וּ רְצוֹנ֑וֹ וְהִבָּֽדְלוּ֙ מֵעַמֵּ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ וּמִן־הַנָּשִׁ֖ים הַנׇּכְרִיּֽוֹת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'th tnv tvdh lyhvh 'lhy'btykhm v'shv rtsvnv vhbdlv m'my h'rts vmnhnshym hnkhryvt {s}
verses.translation: Now therefore make confession unto the LORD, the God of your fathers, and do His pleasure; and separate yourselves from the peoples of the land, and from the foreign women.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּֽעֲנ֧וּ כׇֽל־הַקָּהָ֛ל וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ ק֣וֹל גָּד֑וֹל כֵּ֛ן (כדבריך) [כִּדְבָרְךָ֥] עָלֵ֖ינוּ לַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃
verses.translit: vy'nv khlhqhl vy'mrv qvl gdvl khn (khdbrykh) [khdbrkh] 'lynv l'shvt
verses.translation: Then all the congregation answered and said with a loud voice: ‘As thou hast said, so it is for us to do.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲבָ֞ל הָעָ֥ם רָב֙ וְהָעֵ֣ת גְּשָׁמִ֔ים וְאֵ֥ין כֹּ֖חַ לַעֲמ֣וֹד בַּח֑וּץ וְהַמְּלָאכָ֗ה לֹֽא־לְי֤וֹם אֶחָד֙ וְלֹ֣א לִשְׁנַ֔יִם כִּֽי־הִרְבִּ֥ינוּ לִפְשֹׁ֖עַ בַּדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: 'bl h'm rb vh't gshmym v'yn khch l'mvd bchvts vhml'khh l'lyvm 'chd vl' lshnym khyhrbynv lpsh' bdbr hzh
verses.translation: But the people are many, and it is a time of much rain, and we are not able to stand without, neither is this a work of one day or two; for we have greatly transgressed in this matter.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַֽעַמְדוּ־נָ֣א שָׂ֠רֵ֠ינוּ לְֽכׇל־הַקָּהָ֞ל וְכֹ֣ל  אֲשֶׁ֣ר בֶּעָרֵ֗ינוּ הַהֹשִׁ֞יב נָשִׁ֤ים נׇכְרִיּוֹת֙ יָבֹא֙ לְעִתִּ֣ים מְזֻמָּנִ֔ים וְעִמָּהֶ֛ם זִקְנֵי־עִ֥יר וָעִ֖יר וְשֹׁפְטֶ֑יהָ עַ֠ד לְהָשִׁ֞יב חֲר֤וֹן אַף־אֱלֹהֵ֙ינוּ֙ מִמֶּ֔נּוּ עַ֖ד לַדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: y'mdvn' shrynv lkhlhqhl vkhl  'shr b'rynv hhshyb nshym nkhryvt yb' l'tym mzmnym v'mhm zqny'yr v'yr vshptyh 'd lhshyb chrvn 'f'lhynv mmnv 'd ldbr hzh {s}
verses.translation: Let now our princes of all the congregation stand, and let all them that are in our cities that have married foreign women come at appointed times, and with them the elders of every city, and the judges thereof, until the fierce wrath of our God be turned from us, as touching this matter.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ יוֹנָתָ֧ן בֶּן־עֲשָׂהאֵ֛ל וְיַחְזְיָ֥ה בֶן־תִּקְוָ֖ה עָמְד֣וּ עַל־זֹ֑את וּמְשֻׁלָּ֛ם וְשַׁבְּתַ֥י הַלֵּוִ֖י עֲזָרֻֽם׃
verses.translit: 'kh yvntn bn'shh'l vychzyh bntqvh 'mdv 'lz't vmshlm vshbty hlvy 'zrm
verses.translation: Only Jonathan the son of Asahel and Jahzeiah the son of Tikvah stood up against this matter; and Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite helped them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּֽעֲשׂוּ־כֵן֮ בְּנֵ֣י הַגּוֹלָה֒ וַיִּבָּדְלוּ֩ עֶזְרָ֨א הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֲנָשִׁ֨ים רָאשֵׁ֧י הָאָב֛וֹת לְבֵ֥ית אֲבֹתָ֖ם וְכֻלָּ֣ם בְּשֵׁמ֑וֹת וַיֵּשְׁב֗וּ בְּי֤וֹם אֶחָד֙ לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָעֲשִׂירִ֔י לְדַרְי֖וֹשׁ הַדָּבָֽר׃
verses.translit: vy'shvkhn bny hgvlh vybdlv 'zr' hkhhn 'nshym r'shy h'bvt lbyt 'btm vkhlm bshmvt vyshbv byvm 'chd lchdsh h'shyry ldryvsh hdbr
verses.translation: And the children of the captivity did so. And Ezra the priest, with certain heads of fathers’houses, after their fathers’houses, and all of them by their names, were separated; and they sat down in the first day of the tenth month to examine the matter.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְכַלּ֣וּ בַכֹּ֔ל אֲנָשִׁ֕ים הַהֹשִׁ֖יבוּ נָשִׁ֣ים נׇכְרִיּ֑וֹת עַ֛ד י֥וֹם אֶחָ֖ד לַחֹ֥דֶשׁ הָרִאשֽׁוֹן׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vykhlv bkhl 'nshym hhshybv nshym nkhryvt 'd yvm 'chd lchdsh hr'shvn {p}
verses.translation: And they were finished with all the men that had married foreign women by the first day of the first month.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּמָּצֵא֙ מִבְּנֵ֣י הַכֹּהֲנִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֹשִׁ֖יבוּ נָשִׁ֣ים נׇכְרִיּ֑וֹת מִבְּנֵ֨י יֵשׁ֤וּעַ בֶּן־יֽוֹצָדָק֙ וְאֶחָ֔יו מַֽעֲשֵׂיָה֙ וֶֽאֱלִיעֶ֔זֶר וְיָרִ֖יב וּגְדַלְיָֽה׃
verses.translit: vymts' mbny hkhhnym 'shr hshybv nshym nkhryvt mbny yshv' bnyvtsdq v'chyv m'shyh v'ly'zr vyryb vgdlyh
verses.translation: And among the sons of the priests there were found that had married foreign women, namely: of the sons of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and his brethren, Maaseiah, and Eliezer, and Jarib, and Gedaliah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתְּנ֥וּ יָדָ֖ם לְהוֹצִ֣יא נְשֵׁיהֶ֑ם וַאֲשֵׁמִ֥ים אֵֽיל־צֹ֖אן עַל־אַשְׁמָתָֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vytnv ydm lhvtsy' nshyhm v'shmym 'ylts'n 'l'shmtm {s}
verses.translation: And they gave their hand that they would put away their wives; and being guilty, [they offered] a ram of the flock for their guilt.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִבְּנֵ֣י אִמֵּ֔ר חֲנָ֖נִי וּזְבַדְיָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vmbny 'mr chnny vzbdyh {s}
verses.translation: And of the sons of Immer: Hanani and Zebadiah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִבְּנֵ֖י חָרִ֑ם מַעֲשֵׂיָ֤ה וְאֵֽלִיָּה֙ וּֽשְׁמַֽעְיָ֔ה וִיחִיאֵ֖ל וְעֻזִּיָּֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vmbny chrm m'shyh v'lyh vshm'yh vychy'l v'zyh {s}
verses.translation: And of the sons of Harim: Maaseiah, and Elijah, and Shemaiah, and Jehiel, and Uzziah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִבְּנֵ֖י פַּשְׁח֑וּר אֶלְיוֹעֵינַ֤י מַֽעֲשֵׂיָה֙ יִשְׁמָעֵ֣אל נְתַנְאֵ֔ל יוֹזָבָ֖ד וְאֶלְעָשָֽׂה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vmbny pshchvr 'lyv'yny m'shyh yshm''l ntn'l yvzbd v'l'shh {s}
