verses.translation: And of the sons of Pashhur: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad, and Elasah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִֽן־הַלְוִיִּ֑ם יוֹזָבָ֣ד וְשִׁמְעִ֗י וְקֵֽלָיָה֙ ה֣וּא קְלִיטָ֔א פְּתַֽחְיָ֥ה יְהוּדָ֖ה וֶאֱלִיעֶֽזֶר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vmnhlvym yvzbd vshm'y vqlyh hv' qlyt' ptchyh yhvdh v'ly'zr {s}
verses.translation: And of the Levites: Jozabad, and Shimei, and Kelaiah—the same is Kelita—Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִן־הַמְשֹׁרְרִ֖ים אֶלְיָשִׁ֑יב וּמִן־הַשֹּׁ֣עֲרִ֔ים שַׁלֻּ֥ם וָטֶ֖לֶם וְאוּרִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vmnhmshrrym 'lyshyb vmnhsh'rym shlm vtlm v'vry {s}
verses.translation: And of the singers: Eliashib; and of the porters: Shallum, and Telem, and Uri.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִֽיִּשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מִבְּנֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֡שׁ רַ֠מְיָ֠ה וְיִזִּיָּ֤ה וּמַלְכִּיָּה֙ וּמִיָּמִ֣ן וְאֶלְעָזָ֔ר וּמַלְכִּיָּ֖ה וּבְנָיָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vmyshr'l mbny pr'sh rmyh vyzyh vmlkhyh vmymn v'l'zr vmlkhyh vbnyh {s}
verses.translation: And of Israel: of the sons of Parosh: Ramiah, and Izziah, and Malchijah, and Mijamin, and Eleazar, and Malchijah, and Benaiah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִבְּנֵ֖י עֵילָ֑ם מַתַּנְיָ֤ה זְכַרְיָה֙ וִיחִיאֵ֣ל וְעַבְדִּ֔י וִירֵמ֖וֹת וְאֵלִיָּֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vmbny 'ylm mtnyh zkhryh vychy'l v'bdy vyrmvt v'lyh {s}
verses.translation: And of the sons of Elam: Mattaniah, Zechariah, and Jehiel, and Abdi, and Jeremoth, and Elijah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִבְּנֵ֖י זַתּ֑וּא אֶלְיוֹעֵנַ֤י אֶלְיָשִׁיב֙ מַתַּנְיָ֣ה וִֽירֵמ֔וֹת וְזָבָ֖ד וַעֲזִיזָֽא׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vmbny ztv' 'lyv'ny 'lyshyb mtnyh vyrmvt vzbd v'zyz' {s}
verses.translation: And of the sons of Zattu: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, and Jeremoth, and Zabad, and Aziza.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִבְּנֵ֖י בֵּבָ֑י יְהוֹחָנָ֥ן חֲנַנְיָ֖ה זַבַּ֥י עַתְלָֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vmbny bby yhvchnn chnnyh zby 'tly {s}
verses.translation: And of the sons of Bebai: Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, Athlai.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִבְּנֵ֖י בָּנִ֑י מְשֻׁלָּ֤ם מַלּוּךְ֙ וַעֲדָיָ֔ה יָשׁ֖וּב וּשְׁאָ֥ל (ירמות) [וְרָמֽוֹת]׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vmbny bny mshlm mlvkh v'dyh yshvb vsh'l (yrmvt) [vrmvt] {s}
verses.translation: And of the sons of Bani: Meshullam, Malluch, and Adaiah, Jashub, and Sheal, and Ramoth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִבְּנֵ֛י פַּחַ֥ת מוֹאָ֖ב עַדְנָ֣א וּכְלָ֑ל בְּנָיָ֤ה מַעֲשֵׂיָה֙ מַתַּנְיָ֣ה בְצַלְאֵ֔ל וּבִנּ֖וּי וּמְנַשֶּֽׁה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vmbny pcht mv'b 'dn' vkhll bnyh m'shyh mtnyh btsl'l vbnvy vmnshh {s}
verses.translation: And of the sons of Pahath-moab: Adna, and Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, and Binnui, and Manasseh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֖י חָרִ֑ם אֱלִיעֶ֧זֶר יִשִּׁיָּ֛ה מַלְכִּיָּ֖ה שְׁמַֽעְיָ֥ה שִׁמְעֽוֹן׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vbny chrm 'ly'zr yshyh mlkhyh shm'yh shm'vn {s}
verses.translation: And of the sons of Harim: Eliezer, Isshijah, Malchijah, Shemaiah, Shimeon;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּנְיָמִ֥ן מַלּ֖וּךְ שְׁמַרְיָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bnymn mlvkh shmryh {s}
verses.translation: Benjamin, Malluch, Shemariah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִבְּנֵ֖י חָשֻׁ֑ם מַתְּנַ֤י מַתַּתָּה֙ זָבָ֣ד אֱלִיפֶ֔לֶט יְרֵמַ֥י מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה שִׁמְעִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: mbny chshm mtny mtth zbd 'lyplt yrmy mnshh shm'y {s}
verses.translation: Of the sons of Hashum: Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, Shimei.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִבְּנֵ֣י בָנִ֔י מַעֲדַ֥י עַמְרָ֖ם וְאוּאֵֽל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: mbny bny m'dy 'mrm v'v'l {s}
verses.translation: Of the sons of Bani: Maadai, Amram, and Uel;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנָיָ֥ה בֵדְיָ֖ה (כלוהי) [כְּלֽוּהוּ]׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bnyh bdyh (khlvhy) [khlvhv] {s}
verses.translation: Benaiah, Bedeiah, Cheluhu;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַנְיָ֥ה מְרֵמ֖וֹת אֶלְיָשִֽׁיב׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vnyh mrmvt 'lyshyb {s}
verses.translation: Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַתַּנְיָ֥ה מַתְּנַ֖י (ויעשו) [וְיַעֲשָֽׂי]׃ {ס}
verses.translit: mtnyh mtny (vy'shv) [vy'shy] {s}
verses.translation: Mattaniah, Mattenai, and Jaasai;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבָנִ֥י וּבִנּ֖וּי שִׁמְעִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vbny vbnvy shm'y {s}
verses.translation: and Bani, and Binnui, Shimei;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשֶֽׁלֶמְיָ֥ה וְנָתָ֖ן וַעֲדָיָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vshlmyh vntn v'dyh {s}
verses.translation: Shelemiah, and Nathan, and Adaiah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַכְנַדְבַ֥י שָׁשַׁ֖י שָׁרָֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: mkhndby shshy shry {s}
verses.translation: Machnadebai, Shashai, Sharai;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֲזַרְאֵ֥ל וְשֶׁלֶמְיָ֖הוּ שְׁמַרְיָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'zr'l vshlmyhv shmryh {s}
verses.translation: Azarel, and Shelemiah, Shemariah; .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שַׁלּ֥וּם אֲמַרְיָ֖ה יוֹסֵֽף׃ {ס}
verses.translit: shlvm 'mryh yvsf {s}
verses.translation: Shallum, Amariah, Joseph.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִבְּנֵ֖י נְב֑וֹ יְעִיאֵ֤ל מַתִּתְיָה֙ זָבָ֣ד זְבִינָ֔א (ידו) [יַדַּ֥י] וְיוֹאֵ֖ל בְּנָיָֽה׃
verses.translit: mbny nbv y'y'l mttyh zbd zbyn' (ydv) [ydy] vyv'l bnyh
verses.translation: Of the sons of Nebo: Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jaddai, and Joel, Benaiah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־אֵ֕לֶּה (נשאי) [נָשְׂא֖וּ] נָשִׁ֣ים נׇכְרִיּ֑וֹת וְיֵ֣שׁ מֵהֶ֣ם נָשִׁ֔ים וַיָּשִׂ֖ימוּ בָּנִֽים׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khl'lh (nsh'y) [nsh'v] nshym nkhryvt vysh mhm nshym vyshymv bnym {p}
verses.translation: All these had taken foreign wives; and some of them had wives by whom they had children.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דִּבְרֵ֥י נְחֶמְיָ֖ה בֶּן־חֲכַלְיָ֑ה וַיְהִ֤י בְחֹֽדֶשׁ־כִּסְלֵו֙ שְׁנַ֣ת עֶשְׂרִ֔ים וַאֲנִ֥י הָיִ֖יתִי בְּשׁוּשַׁ֥ן הַבִּירָֽה׃
verses.translit: dbry nchmyh bnchkhlyh vyhy bchdshkhslv shnt 'shrym v'ny hyyty bshvshn hbyrh
verses.translation: THE WORDS of Nehemiah the son of Hacaliah. Now it came to pass in the month Chislev, in the twentieth year, as I was in Shushan the castle,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֨א חֲנָ֜נִי אֶחָ֧ד מֵאַחַ֛י ה֥וּא וַאֲנָשִׁ֖ים מִֽיהוּדָ֑ה וָאֶשְׁאָלֵ֞ם עַל־הַיְּהוּדִ֧ים הַפְּלֵיטָ֛ה אֲשֶֽׁר־נִשְׁאֲר֥וּ מִן־הַשֶּׁ֖בִי וְעַל־יְרוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: vyb' chnny 'chd m'chy hv' v'nshym myhvdh v'sh'lm 'lhyhvdym hplyth 'shrnsh'rv mnhshby v'lyrvshl͏m
verses.translation: that Hanani, one of my brethren, came out of Judah, he and certain men; and I asked them concerning the Jews that had escaped, that were left of the captivity, and concerning Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְרוּ֮ לִי֒ הַֽנִּשְׁאָרִ֞ים אֲשֶֽׁר־נִשְׁאֲר֤וּ מִן־הַשְּׁבִי֙ שָׁ֣ם בַּמְּדִינָ֔ה בְּרָעָ֥ה גְדֹלָ֖ה וּבְחֶרְפָּ֑ה וְחוֹמַ֤ת יְרוּשָׁלַ֙͏ִם֙ מְפֹרָ֔צֶת וּשְׁעָרֶ֖יהָ נִצְּת֥וּ בָאֵֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv ly hnsh'rym 'shrnsh'rv mnhshby shm bmdynh br'h gdlh vbchrph vchvmt yrvshl͏m mprtst vsh'ryh ntstv b'sh
verses.translation: And they said unto me: ‘The remnant that are left of the captivity there in the province are in great affliction and reproach; the wall of Jerusalem also is broken down, and the gates thereof are burned with fire.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֞י כְּשׇׁמְעִ֣י  אֶת־הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֗לֶּה יָשַׁ֙בְתִּי֙ וָֽאֶבְכֶּ֔ה וָאֶתְאַבְּלָ֖ה יָמִ֑ים וָֽאֱהִ֥י צָם֙ וּמִתְפַּלֵּ֔ל לִפְנֵ֖י אֱלֹהֵ֥י הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vyhy khshm'y  'thdbrym h'lh yshbty v'bkhh v't'blh ymym v'hy tsm vmtpll lpny 'lhy hshmym
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when I heard these words, that I sat down and wept, and mourned certain days; and I fasted and prayed before the God of heaven,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֗ר אָֽנָּ֤א יְהֹוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם הָאֵ֥ל הַגָּד֖וֹל וְהַנּוֹרָ֑א שֹׁמֵ֤ר הַבְּרִית֙ וָחֶ֔סֶד לְאֹהֲבָ֖יו וּלְשֹׁמְרֵ֥י מִצְוֺתָֽיו׃
verses.translit: v'mr 'n' yhvh 'lhy hshmym h'l hgdvl vhnvr' shmr hbryt vchsd l'hbyv vlshmry mtsvtyv
verses.translation: and said: ‘I beseech Thee, O LORD, the God of heaven, the great and awful God, that keepeth covenant and mercy with them that love Him and keep His commandments;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תְּהִ֣י נָ֣א אׇזְנְךָֽ־קַשֶּׁ֣בֶת וְֽעֵינֶ֪יךָ פְתוּח֟וֹת לִשְׁמֹ֣עַ אֶל־תְּפִלַּ֣ת עַבְדְּךָ֡ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָנֹכִי֩ מִתְפַּלֵּ֨ל לְפָנֶ֤יךָ הַיּוֹם֙ יוֹמָ֣ם וָלַ֔יְלָה עַל־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עֲבָדֶ֑יךָ וּמִתְוַדֶּ֗ה עַל־חַטֹּ֤אות בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָטָ֣אנוּ לָ֔ךְ וַאֲנִ֥י וּבֵית־אָבִ֖י חָטָֽאנוּ׃
verses.translit: thy n' 'znkhqshbt v'ynykh ptvchvt lshm' 'ltplt 'bdkh 'shr 'nkhy mtpll lpnykh hyvm yvmm vlylh 'lbny yshr'l 'bdykh vmtvdh 'lcht'vt bnyyshr'l 'shr cht'nv lkh v'ny vbyt'by cht'nv
verses.translation: let Thine ear now be attentive, and Thine eyes open, that Thou mayest hearken unto the prayer of Thy servant, which I pray before Thee at this time, day and night, for the children of Israel Thy servants, while I confess the sins of the children of Israel, which we have sinned against Thee; yea, I and my father’s house have sinned.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֲבֹ֖ל חָבַ֣לְנוּ לָ֑ךְ וְלֹא־שָׁמַ֣רְנוּ אֶת־הַמִּצְוֺ֗ת וְאֶת־הַֽחֻקִּים֙ וְאֶת־הַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּ֖יתָ אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֥ה עַבְדֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translit: chbl chblnv lkh vl'shmrnv 'thmtsvt v'thchqym v'thmshptym 'shr tsvyt 'tmshh 'bdkh
verses.translation: We have dealt very corruptly against Thee, and have not kept the commandments, nor the statutes, nor the ordinances which Thou didst command Thy servant Moses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זְכׇר־נָא֙ אֶת־הַדָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּ֛יתָ אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֥ה עַבְדְּךָ֖ לֵאמֹ֑ר אַתֶּ֣ם תִּמְעָ֔לוּ אֲנִ֕י אָפִ֥יץ אֶתְכֶ֖ם בָּעַמִּֽים׃
verses.translit: zkhrn' 'thdbr 'shr tsvyt 'tmshh 'bdkh l'mr 'tm tm'lv 'ny 'pyts 'tkhm b'mym
verses.translation: Remember, I beseech Thee, the word that Thou didst command Thy servant Moses, saying: If ye deal treacherously, I will scatter you abroad among the peoples;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשַׁבְתֶּ֣ם אֵלַ֔י וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם֙ מִצְוֺתַ֔י וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָ֑ם אִם־יִהְיֶ֨ה נִֽדַּחֲכֶ֜ם בִּקְצֵ֤ה הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ מִשָּׁ֣ם אֲקַבְּצֵ֔ם (והבואתים) [וַהֲבִֽיאוֹתִים֙] אֶל־הַמָּק֔וֹם אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּחַ֔רְתִּי לְשַׁכֵּ֥ן אֶת־שְׁמִ֖י שָֽׁם׃
verses.translit: vshbtm 'ly vshmrtm mtsvty v'shytm 'tm 'myhyh ndchkhm bqtsh hshmym mshm 'qbtsm (vhbv'tym) [vhby'vtym] 'lhmqvm 'shr bchrty lshkhn 'tshmy shm
verses.translation: but if ye return unto Me, and keep My commandments and do them, though your dispersed were in the uttermost part of the heaven, yet will I gather them from thence, and will bring them unto the place that I have chosen to cause My name to dwell there.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֵ֥ם עֲבָדֶ֖יךָ וְעַמֶּ֑ךָ אֲשֶׁ֤ר פָּדִ֙יתָ֙ בְּכֹחֲךָ֣ הַגָּד֔וֹל וּבְיָדְךָ֖ הַחֲזָקָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhm 'bdykh v'mkh 'shr pdyt bkhchkh hgdvl vbydkh hchzqh
verses.translation: Now these are Thy servants and Thy people, whom Thou hast redeemed by Thy great power, and by Thy strong hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָנָּ֣א אֲדֹנָ֗י תְּהִ֣י נָ֣א אׇזְנְךָֽ־קַ֠שֶּׁ֠בֶת אֶל־תְּפִלַּ֨ת עַבְדְּךָ֜ וְאֶל־תְּפִלַּ֣ת עֲבָדֶ֗יךָ הַֽחֲפֵצִים֙ לְיִרְאָ֣ה אֶת־שְׁמֶ֔ךָ וְהַצְלִֽיחָה־נָּ֤א לְעַבְדְּךָ֙ הַיּ֔וֹם וּתְנֵ֣הוּ לְרַחֲמִ֔ים לִפְנֵ֖י הָאִ֣ישׁ הַזֶּ֑ה וַאֲנִ֛י הָיִ֥יתִי מַשְׁקֶ֖ה לַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'n' 'dny thy n' 'znkhqshbt 'ltplt 'bdkh v'ltplt 'bdykh hchptsym lyr'h 'tshmkh vhtslychhn' l'bdkh hyvm vtnhv lrchmym lpny h'ysh hzh v'ny hyyty mshqh lmlkh {p}
verses.translation: O Lord, I beseech Thee, let now Thine ear be attentive to the prayer of Thy servant, and to the prayer of Thy servants, who delight to fear Thy name; and prosper, I pray Thee, Thy servant this day, and grant him mercy in the sight of this man.’ Now I was cupbearer to the king.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י  בְּחֹ֣דֶשׁ נִיסָ֗ן שְׁנַ֥ת עֶשְׂרִ֛ים לְאַרְתַּחְשַׁ֥סְתְּא הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ יַ֣יִן לְפָנָ֑יו וָאֶשָּׂ֤א אֶת־הַיַּ֙יִן֙ וָאֶתְּנָ֣ה לַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וְלֹא־הָיִ֥יתִי רַ֖ע לְפָנָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vyhy  bchdsh nysn shnt 'shrym l'rtchshst' hmlkh yyn lpnyv v'sh' 'thyyn v'tnh lmlkh vl'hyyty r' lpnyv
verses.translation: And it came to pass in the month Nisan, in the twentieth year of Artaxerxes the king, when wine was before him, that I took up the wine, and gave it unto the king. Now I had not been beforetime sad in his presence.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֩אמֶר֩ לִ֨י הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ מַדּ֣וּעַ  פָּנֶ֣יךָ רָעִ֗ים וְאַתָּה֙ אֵֽינְךָ֣ חוֹלֶ֔ה אֵ֣ין זֶ֔ה כִּי־אִ֖ם רֹ֣עַֽ לֵ֑ב וָאִירָ֖א הַרְבֵּ֥ה מְאֹֽד׃
verses.translit: vy'mr ly hmlkh mdv'  pnykh r'ym v'th 'ynkh chvlh 'yn zh khy'm r' lb v'yr' hrbh m'd
verses.translation: And the king said unto me: ‘Why is thy countenance sad, seeing thou art not sick? this is nothing else but sorrow of heart.’ Then I was very sore afraid.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֣ר לַמֶּ֔לֶךְ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ לְעוֹלָ֣ם יִחְיֶ֑ה מַדּ֜וּעַ לֹא־יֵרְע֣וּ פָנַ֗י אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָעִ֜יר בֵּית־קִבְר֤וֹת אֲבֹתַי֙ חֲרֵבָ֔ה וּשְׁעָרֶ֖יהָ אֻכְּל֥וּ בָאֵֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: v'mr lmlkh hmlkh l'vlm ychyh mdv' l'yr'v pny 'shr h'yr bytqbrvt 'bty chrbh vsh'ryh 'khlv b'sh
verses.translation: And I said unto the king: ‘Let the king live for ever: why should not my countenance be sad, when the city, the place of my fathers’ sepulchres, lieth waste, and the gates thereof are consumed with fire?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לִי֙ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ עַל־מַה־זֶּ֖ה אַתָּ֣ה מְבַקֵּ֑שׁ וָֽאֶתְפַּלֵּ֔ל אֶל־אֱלֹהֵ֖י הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr ly hmlkh 'lmhzh 'th mbqsh v'tpll 'l'lhy hshmym
verses.translation: Then the king said unto me: ‘For what dost thou make request?’ So I prayed to the God of heaven.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֣ר לַמֶּ֔לֶךְ אִם־עַל־הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ ט֔וֹב וְאִם־יִיטַ֥ב עַבְדְּךָ֖ לְפָנֶ֑יךָ אֲשֶׁ֧ר תִּשְׁלָחֵ֣נִי אֶל־יְהוּדָ֗ה אֶל־עִ֛יר קִבְר֥וֹת אֲבֹתַ֖י וְאֶבְנֶֽנָּה׃
verses.translit: v'mr lmlkh 'm'lhmlkh tvb v'myytb 'bdkh lpnykh 'shr tshlchny 'lyhvdh 'l'yr qbrvt 'bty v'bnnh
verses.translation: And I said unto the king: ‘If it please the king, and if thy servant have found favour in thy sight, that thou wouldest send me unto Judah, unto the city of my fathers’sepulchres, that I may build it.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֩אמֶר֩ לִ֨י הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ וְהַשֵּׁגַ֣ל  יוֹשֶׁ֣בֶת אֶצְל֗וֹ עַד־מָתַ֛י יִהְיֶ֥ה מַֽהֲלָכְךָ֖ וּמָתַ֣י תָּשׁ֑וּב וַיִּיטַ֤ב לִפְנֵֽי־הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ וַיִּשְׁלָחֵ֔נִי וָֽאֶתְּנָ֥ה ל֖וֹ זְמָֽן׃
verses.translit: vy'mr ly hmlkh vhshgl  yvshbt 'tslv 'dmty yhyh mhlkhkh vmty tshvb vyytb lpnyhmlkh vyshlchny v'tnh lv zmn
verses.translation: And the king said unto me, the queen also sitting by him: ‘For how long shall thy journey be? and when wilt thou return?’ So it pleased the king to send me; and I set him a time.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאוֹמַר֮ לַמֶּ֒לֶךְ֒ אִם־עַל־הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ ט֔וֹב אִגְּרוֹת֙ יִתְּנוּ־לִ֔י עַֽל־פַּחֲו֖וֹת עֵ֣בֶר הַנָּהָ֑ר אֲשֶׁר֙ יַעֲבִיר֔וּנִי עַ֥ד אֲשֶׁר־אָב֖וֹא אֶל־יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'vmr lmlkh 'm'lhmlkh tvb 'grvt ytnvly 'lpchvvt 'br hnhr 'shr y'byrvny 'd 'shr'bv' 'lyhvdh
verses.translation: Moreover I said unto the king: ‘If it please the king, let letters be given me to the governors beyond the River, that they may let me pass through till I come unto Judah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִגֶּ֡רֶת אֶל־אָסָף֩ שֹׁמֵ֨ר הַפַּרְדֵּ֜ס אֲשֶׁ֣ר לַמֶּ֗לֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִתֶּן־לִ֣י עֵצִ֡ים לְ֠קָר֠וֹת אֶת־שַׁעֲרֵ֨י הַבִּירָ֤ה אֲשֶׁר־לַבַּ֙יִת֙ וּלְחוֹמַ֣ת הָעִ֔יר וְלַבַּ֖יִת אֲשֶׁר־אָב֣וֹא אֵלָ֑יו וַיִּתֶּן־לִ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ כְּיַד־אֱלֹהַ֖י הַטּוֹבָ֥ה עָלָֽי׃
verses.translit: v'grt 'l'sf shmr hprds 'shr lmlkh 'shr ytnly 'tsym lqrvt 'tsh'ry hbyrh 'shrlbyt vlchvmt h'yr vlbyt 'shr'bv' 'lyv vytnly hmlkh khyd'lhy htvbh 'ly
verses.translation: and a letter unto Asaph the keeper of the king’s park, that he may give me timber to make beams for the gates of the castle which appertaineth to the house, and for the wall of the city, and for the house that I shall enter into.’ And the king granted me, according to the good hand of my God upon me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָֽאָב֗וֹא אֶֽל־פַּֽחֲווֹת֙ עֵ֣בֶר הַנָּהָ֔ר וָאֶתְּנָ֣ה לָהֶ֔ם אֵ֖ת אִגְּר֣וֹת הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח עִמִּי֙ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ שָׂ֥רֵי חַ֖יִל וּפָרָשִֽׁים׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'bv' 'lpchvvt 'br hnhr v'tnh lhm 't 'grvt hmlkh vyshlch 'my hmlkh shry chyl vprshym {p}
verses.translation: Then I came to the governors beyond the River, and gave them the king’s letters. Now the king had sent with me captains of the army and horsemen.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֞ע סַנְבַלַּ֣ט הַחֹרֹנִ֗י וְטֽוֹבִיָּה֙ הָעֶ֣בֶד הָֽעַמֹּנִ֔י וַיֵּ֥רַע לָהֶ֖ם רָעָ֣ה גְדֹלָ֑ה אֲשֶׁר־בָּ֣א אָדָ֔ם לְבַקֵּ֥שׁ טוֹבָ֖ה לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vyshm' snblt hchrny vtvbyh h'bd h'mny vyr' lhm r'h gdlh 'shrb' 'dm lbqsh tvbh lbny yshr'l
verses.translation: And when Sanballat the Horonite, and Tobiah the servant, the Ammonite, heard of it, it grieved them exceedingly, for that there was come a man to seek the welfare of the children of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאָב֖וֹא אֶל־יְרוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם וָאֱהִי־שָׁ֖ם יָמִ֥ים שְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃
verses.translit: v'bv' 'lyrvshl͏m v'hyshm ymym shlshh
verses.translation: So I came to Jerusalem, and was there three days.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאָק֣וּם  לַ֗יְלָה אֲנִי֮ וַאֲנָשִׁ֣ים ׀ מְעַט֮ עִמִּי֒ וְלֹא־הִגַּ֣דְתִּי לְאָדָ֔ם מָ֗ה אֱלֹהַי֙ נֹתֵ֣ן אֶל־לִבִּ֔י לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת לִירוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם וּבְהֵמָה֙ אֵ֣ין עִמִּ֔י כִּ֚י אִם־הַבְּהֵמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י רֹכֵ֥ב בָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: v'qvm  lylh 'ny v'nshym  m't 'my vl'hgdty l'dm mh 'lhy ntn 'llby l'shvt lyrvshl͏m vbhmh 'yn 'my khy 'mhbhmh 'shr 'ny rkhb bh
verses.translation: And I arose in the night, I and some few men with me; neither told I any man what my God put into my heart to do for Jerusalem; neither was there any beast with me, save the beast that I rode upon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֵצְאָ֨ה בְשַֽׁעַר־הַגַּ֜יְא לַ֗יְלָה וְאֶל־פְּנֵי֙ עֵ֣ין הַתַּנִּ֔ין וְאֶל־שַׁ֖עַר הָאַשְׁפֹּ֑ת וָאֱהִ֨י שֹׂבֵ֜ר בְּחוֹמֹ֤ת יְרוּשָׁלַ֙͏ִם֙ אֲשֶׁר־[הֵ֣ם ׀ פְּרוּצִ֔ים] (המפרוצים) וּשְׁעָרֶ֖יהָ אֻכְּל֥וּ בָאֵֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: v'ts'h bsh'rhgy' lylh v'lpny 'yn htnyn v'lsh'r h'shpt v'hy shbr bchvmt yrvshl͏m 'shr[hm  prvtsym] (hmprvtsym) vsh'ryh 'khlv b'sh
verses.translation: And I went out by night by the valley gate, even toward the dragon’s well, and to the dung gate, and viewed the walls of Jerusalem, which were broken down, and the gates thereof were consumed with fire.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֶֽעֱבֹר֙ אֶל־שַׁ֣עַר הָעַ֔יִן וְאֶל־בְּרֵכַ֖ת הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וְאֵין־מָק֥וֹם לַבְּהֵמָ֖ה לַעֲבֹ֥ר תַּחְתָּֽי׃
verses.translit: v''br 'lsh'r h'yn v'lbrkht hmlkh v'ynmqvm lbhmh l'br tchty
verses.translation: Then I went on to the fountain gate and to the king’s pool; but there was no place for the beast that was under me to pass.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֱהִ֨י עֹלֶ֤ה בַנַּ֙חַל֙ לַ֔יְלָה וָאֱהִ֥י שֹׂבֵ֖ר בַּחוֹמָ֑ה וָאָשׁ֗וּב וָאָב֛וֹא בְּשַׁ֥עַר הַגַּ֖יְא וָאָשֽׁוּב׃
verses.translit: v'hy 'lh bnchl lylh v'hy shbr bchvmh v'shvb v'bv' bsh'r hgy' v'shvb
verses.translation: Then went I up in the night in the valley, and viewed the wall; and I turned back, and entered by the valley gate, and so returned.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַסְּגָנִ֗ים לֹ֤א יָדְעוּ֙ אָ֣נָה הָלַ֔כְתִּי וּמָ֖ה אֲנִ֣י עֹשֶׂ֑ה וְלַיְּהוּדִ֨ים וְלַכֹּהֲנִ֜ים וְלַחֹרִ֣ים וְלַסְּגָנִ֗ים וּלְיֶ֙תֶר֙ עֹשֵׂ֣ה הַמְּלָאכָ֔ה עַד־כֵּ֖ן לֹ֥א הִגַּֽדְתִּי׃
verses.translit: vhsgnym l' yd'v 'nh hlkhty vmh 'ny 'shh vlyhvdym vlkhhnym vlchrym vlsgnym vlytr 'shh hml'khh 'dkhn l' hgdty
verses.translation: And the rulers knew not whither I went, or what I did; neither had I as yet told it to the Jews, nor to the priests, nor to the nobles, nor to the rulers, nor to the rest that did the work. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאוֹמַ֣ר אֲלֵהֶ֗ם אַתֶּ֤ם רֹאִים֙ הָרָעָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֲנַ֣חְנוּ בָ֔הּ אֲשֶׁ֤ר יְרוּשָׁלַ֙͏ִם֙ חֲרֵבָ֔ה וּשְׁעָרֶ֖יהָ נִצְּת֣וּ בָאֵ֑שׁ לְכ֗וּ וְנִבְנֶה֙ אֶת־חוֹמַ֣ת יְרוּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם וְלֹא־נִהְיֶ֥ה ע֖וֹד חֶרְפָּֽה׃
verses.translit: v'vmr 'lhm 'tm r'ym hr'h 'shr 'nchnv bh 'shr yrvshl͏m chrbh vsh'ryh ntstv b'sh lkhv vnbnh 'tchvmt yrvshl͏m vl'nhyh 'vd chrph
verses.translation: Then said I unto them: ‘Ye see the evil case that we are in, how Jerusalem lieth waste, and the gates thereof are burned with fire; come and let us build up the wall of Jerusalem, that we be no more a reproach.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאַגִּ֨יד לָהֶ֜ם אֶת־יַ֣ד אֱלֹהַ֗י אֲשֶׁר־הִיא֙ טוֹבָ֣ה עָלַ֔י וְאַף־דִּבְרֵ֥י הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָֽמַר־לִ֑י וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ נָק֣וּם וּבָנִ֔ינוּ וַיְחַזְּק֥וּ יְדֵיהֶ֖ם לַטּוֹבָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'gyd lhm 'tyd 'lhy 'shrhy' tvbh 'ly v'fdbry hmlkh 'shr 'mrly vy'mrv nqvm vbnynv vychzqv ydyhm ltvbh {p}
verses.translation: And I told them of the hand of my God which was good upon me; as also of the king’s words that he had spoken unto me. And they said: ‘Let us rise up and build.’ So they strengthened their hands for the good work.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַע֩ סַנְבַלַּ֨ט הַחֹרֹנִ֜י וְטֹבִיָּ֣ה  הָעֶ֣בֶד הָֽעַמּוֹנִ֗י וְגֶ֙שֶׁם֙ הָֽעַרְבִ֔י וַיַּלְעִ֣גוּ לָ֔נוּ וַיִּבְז֖וּ עָלֵ֑ינוּ וַיֹּאמְר֗וּ מָֽה־הַדָּבָ֤ר הַזֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אַתֶּ֣ם עֹשִׂ֔ים הַעַ֥ל הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ אַתֶּ֥ם מֹרְדִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyshm' snblt hchrny vtbyh  h'bd h'mvny vgshm h'rby vyl'gv lnv vybzv 'lynv vy'mrv mhhdbr hzh 'shr 'tm 'shym h'l hmlkh 'tm mrdym
verses.translation: But when Sanballat the Horonite, and Tobiah the servant, the Ammonite, and Geshem the Arabian, heard it, they laughed us to scorn, and despised us, and said: ‘What is this thing that ye do? will ye rebel against the king?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאָשִׁ֨יב אוֹתָ֜ם דָּבָ֗ר וָאוֹמַ֤ר לָהֶם֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י הַשָּׁמַ֗יִם ה֚וּא יַצְלִ֣יחַֽ לָ֔נוּ וַאֲנַ֥חְנוּ עֲבָדָ֖יו נָק֣וּם וּבָנִ֑ינוּ וְלָכֶ֗ם אֵֽין־חֵ֧לֶק וּצְדָקָ֛ה וְזִכָּר֖וֹן בִּירוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'shyb 'vtm dbr v'vmr lhm 'lhy hshmym hv' ytslych lnv v'nchnv 'bdyv nqvm vbnynv vlkhm 'ynchlq vtsdqh vzkhrvn byrvshl͏m {p}
verses.translation: Then answered I them, and said unto them: ‘The God of heaven, He will prosper us; therefore we His servants will arise and build; but ye have no portion, nor right, nor memorial, in Jerusalem.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֡קׇם אֶלְיָשִׁיב֩ הַכֹּהֵ֨ן הַגָּד֜וֹל וְאֶחָ֣יו הַכֹּהֲנִ֗ים וַיִּבְנוּ֙ אֶת־שַׁ֣עַר הַצֹּ֔אן הֵ֣מָּה קִדְּשׁ֔וּהוּ וַֽיַּעֲמִ֖ידוּ דַּלְתֹתָ֑יו וְעַד־מִגְדַּ֤ל הַמֵּאָה֙ קִדְּשׁ֔וּהוּ עַ֖ד מִגְדַּ֥ל חֲנַנְאֵֽל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyqm 'lyshyb hkhhn hgdvl v'chyv hkhhnym vybnv 'tsh'r hts'n hmh qdshvhv vy'mydv dlttyv v'dmgdl hm'h qdshvhv 'd mgdl chnn'l {s}
verses.translation: Then Eliashib the high priest rose up with his brethren the priests, and they builded the sheep gate; they sanctified it, and set up the doors of it; even unto the tower of Hammeah they sanctified it, unto the tower of Hananel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַל־יָד֥וֹ בָנ֖וּ אַנְשֵׁ֣י יְרֵח֑וֹ וְעַל־יָד֣וֹ בָנָ֔ה זַכּ֖וּר בֶּן־אִמְרִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'lydv bnv 'nshy yrchv v'lydv bnh zkhvr bn'mry {s}
verses.translation: And next unto him builded the men of Jericho. And next to them builded Zaccur the son of Imri.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵת֙ שַׁ֣עַר הַדָּגִ֔ים בָּנ֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י הַסְּנָאָ֑ה הֵ֣מָּה קֵר֔וּהוּ וַֽיַּעֲמִ֙ידוּ֙ דַּלְתֹתָ֔יו מַנְעוּלָ֖יו וּבְרִיחָֽיו׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v't sh'r hdgym bnv bny hsn'h hmh qrvhv vy'mydv dlttyv mn'vlyv vbrychyv {s}
verses.translation: And the fish gate did the sons of Hassenaah build; they laid the beams thereof, and set up the doors thereof, the bolts thereof, and the bars thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַל־יָדָ֣ם הֶחֱזִ֗יק מְרֵמ֤וֹת בֶּן־אוּרִיָּה֙ בֶּן־הַקּ֔וֹץ {ס} וְעַל־יָדָ֣ם הֶחֱזִ֔יק מְשֻׁלָּ֥ם בֶּן־בֶּרֶכְיָ֖ה בֶּן־מְשֵׁיזַבְאֵ֑ל {ס} וְעַל־יָדָ֣ם הֶֽחֱזִ֔יק צָד֖וֹק בֶּֽן־בַּעֲנָֽא׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'lydm hchzyq mrmvt bn'vryh bnhqvts {s} v'lydm hchzyq mshlm bnbrkhyh bnmshyzb'l {s} v'lydm hchzyq tsdvq bnb'n' {s}
verses.translation: And next unto them repaired Meremoth the son of Uriah, the son of Hakkoz. And next unto them repaired Meshullam the son of Berechiah, the son of Meshezabel. And next unto them repaired Zadok the son of Baana.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַל־יָדָ֖ם הֶחֱזִ֣יקוּ הַתְּקוֹעִ֑ים וְאַדִּֽירֵיהֶם֙ לֹא־הֵבִ֣יאוּ צַוָּרָ֔ם בַּעֲבֹדַ֖ת אֲדֹנֵיהֶֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'lydm hchzyqv htqv'ym v'dyryhm l'hby'v tsvrm b'bdt 'dnyhm {s}
verses.translation: And next unto them the Tekoites repaired; and their nobles put not their necks to the work of their lord.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵת֩ שַׁ֨עַר הַיְשָׁנָ֜ה הֶחֱזִ֗יקוּ יֽוֹיָדָע֙ בֶּן־פָּסֵ֔חַ וּמְשֻׁלָּ֖ם בֶּן־בְּסֽוֹדְיָ֑ה הֵ֣מָּה קֵר֔וּהוּ וַֽיַּעֲמִ֙ידוּ֙ דַּלְתֹתָ֔יו וּמַנְעֻלָ֖יו וּבְרִיחָֽיו׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v't sh'r hyshnh hchzyqv yvyd' bnpsch vmshlm bnbsvdyh hmh qrvhv vy'mydv dlttyv vmn'lyv vbrychyv {s}
verses.translation: And the gate of the old city repaired Joiada the son of Paseah and Meshullam the son of Besodeiah; they laid the beams thereof, and set up the doors thereof, and the bolts thereof, and the bars thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַל־יָדָ֨ם הֶחֱזִ֜יק מְלַטְיָ֣ה הַגִּבְעֹנִ֗י וְיָדוֹן֙ הַמֵּרֹ֣נֹתִ֔י אַנְשֵׁ֥י גִבְע֖וֹן וְהַמִּצְפָּ֑ה לְכִסֵּ֕א פַּחַ֖ת עֵ֥בֶר הַנָּהָֽר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'lydm hchzyq mltyh hgb'ny vydvn hmrnty 'nshy gb'vn vhmtsph lkhs' pcht 'br hnhr {s}
verses.translation: And next unto them repaired Melatiah the Gibeonite, and Jadon the Meronothite, the men of Gibeon, and of Mizpah, for them that appertained to the throne of the governor beyond the River.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־יָד֣וֹ הֶחֱזִ֗יק עֻזִּיאֵ֤ל בֶּֽן־חַרְהֲיָה֙ צֽוֹרְפִ֔ים {ס} וְעַל־יָד֣וֹ הֶחֱזִ֔יק חֲנַנְיָ֖ה בֶּן־הָרַקָּחִ֑ים וַיַּֽעַזְבוּ֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם עַ֖ד הַחוֹמָ֥ה הָרְחָבָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'lydv hchzyq 'zy'l bnchrhyh tsvrpym {s} v'lydv hchzyq chnnyh bnhrqchym vy'zbv yrvshl͏m 'd hchvmh hrchbh {s}
verses.translation: Next unto him repaired Uzziel the son of Harhaiah, goldsmiths. And next unto him repaired Hananiah one of the perfumers, and they restored Jerusalem even unto the broad wall.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַל־יָדָ֤ם הֶחֱזִיק֙ רְפָיָ֣ה בֶן־ח֔וּר שַׂ֕ר חֲצִ֖י פֶּ֥לֶךְ יְרוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'lydm hchzyq rpyh bnchvr shr chtsy plkh yrvshl͏m {s}
verses.translation: And next unto them repaired Rephaiah the son of Hur, the ruler of half the district of Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַל־יָדָ֧ם הֶחֱזִ֛יק יְדָיָ֥ה בֶן־חֲרוּמַ֖ף וְנֶ֣גֶד בֵּית֑וֹ וְעַל־יָד֣וֹ הֶחֱזִ֔יק חַטּ֖וּשׁ בֶּן־חֲשַׁבְנְיָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'lydm hchzyq ydyh bnchrvmf vngd bytv v'lydv hchzyq chtvsh bnchshbnyh {s}
verses.translation: And next unto them repaired Jedaiah the son of Harumaph, even over against his house. And next unto him repaired Hattush the son of Hashabneiah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִדָּ֣ה שֵׁנִ֗ית הֶחֱזִיק֙ מַלְכִּיָּ֣ה בֶן־חָרִ֔ם וְחַשּׁ֖וּב בֶּן־פַּחַ֣ת מוֹאָ֑ב וְאֵ֖ת מִגְדַּ֥ל הַתַּנּוּרִֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: mdh shnyt hchzyq mlkhyh bnchrm vchshvb bnpcht mv'b v't mgdl htnvrym {s}
verses.translation: Malchijah the son of Harim, and Hasshub the son of Pahath-moab, repaired another portion, and the tower of the furnaces.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַל־יָד֣וֹ הֶחֱזִ֗יק שַׁלּוּם֙ בֶּן־הַלּוֹחֵ֔שׁ שַׂ֕ר חֲצִ֖י פֶּ֣לֶךְ יְרוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם ה֖וּא וּבְנוֹתָֽיו׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'lydv hchzyq shlvm bnhlvchsh shr chtsy plkh yrvshl͏m hv' vbnvtyv {s}
verses.translation: And next unto him repaired Shallum the son of Hallohesh, the ruler of half the district of Jerusalem, he and his daughters.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵת֩ שַׁ֨עַר הַגַּ֜יְא הֶחֱזִ֣יק חָנוּן֮ וְיֹשְׁבֵ֣י זָנ֒וֹחַ֒ הֵ֣מָּה בָנ֔וּהוּ וַֽיַּעֲמִ֙ידוּ֙ דַּלְתֹתָ֔יו מַנְעֻלָ֖יו וּבְרִיחָ֑יו וְאֶ֤לֶף אַמָּה֙ בַּחוֹמָ֔ה עַ֖ד שַׁ֥עַר הָשְׁפֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: 't sh'r hgy' hchzyq chnvn vyshby znvch hmh bnvhv vy'mydv dlttyv mn'lyv vbrychyv v'lf 'mh bchvmh 'd sh'r hshpvt
verses.translation: The valley gate repaired Hanun, and the inhabitants of Zanoah; they built it, and set up the doors thereof, the bolts thereof, and the bars thereof, and a thousand cubits of the wall unto the dung gate.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֣ת  שַׁ֣עַר הָאַשְׁפּ֗וֹת הֶחֱזִיק֙ מַלְכִּיָּ֣ה בֶן־רֵכָ֔ב שַׂ֖ר פֶּ֣לֶךְ בֵּית־הַכָּ֑רֶם ה֣וּא יִבְנֶ֔נּוּ וְיַעֲמִיד֙ דַּלְתֹתָ֔יו מַנְעֻלָ֖יו וּבְרִיחָֽיו׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v't  sh'r h'shpvt hchzyq mlkhyh bnrkhb shr plkh bythkhrm hv' ybnnv vy'myd dlttyv mn'lyv vbrychyv {s}
verses.translation: And the dung gate repaired Malchijah the son of Rechab, the ruler of the district of Beth-cherem; he built it, and set up the doors thereof, the bolts thereof, and the bars thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵת֩ שַׁ֨עַר הָעַ֜יִן הֶ֠חֱזִ֠יק שַׁלּ֣וּן בֶּן־כׇּל־חֹזֶה֮ שַׂ֣ר פֶּ֣לֶךְ הַמִּצְפָּה֒ ה֤וּא יִבְנֶ֙נּוּ֙ וִיטַֽלְלֶ֔נּוּ (ויעמידו) [וְיַעֲמִיד֙] דַּלְתֹתָ֔יו מַנְעֻלָ֖יו וּבְרִיחָ֑יו וְ֠אֵ֠ת חוֹמַ֞ת בְּרֵכַ֤ת הַשֶּׁ֙לַח֙ לְגַן־הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וְעַד־הַֽמַּעֲל֔וֹת הַיּוֹרְד֖וֹת מֵעִ֥יר דָּוִֽיד׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v't sh'r h'yn hchzyq shlvn bnkhlchzh shr plkh hmtsph hv' ybnnv vytllnv (vy'mydv) [vy'myd] dlttyv mn'lyv vbrychyv v't chvmt brkht hshlch lgnhmlkh v'dhm'lvt hyvrdvt m'yr dvyd {s}
verses.translation: And the fountain gate repaired Shallun the son of Colhozeh, the ruler of the district of Mizpah; he built it, and covered it, and set up the doors thereof, the bolts thereof, and the bars thereof, and the wall of the pool of Shelah by the king’s garden, even unto the stairs that go down from the city of David.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַחֲרָ֤יו הֶחֱזִיק֙ נְחֶמְיָ֣ה בֶן־עַזְבּ֔וּק שַׂ֕ר חֲצִ֖י פֶּ֣לֶךְ בֵּֽית־צ֑וּר עַד־נֶ֙גֶד֙ קִבְרֵ֣י דָוִ֔יד וְעַד־הַבְּרֵכָה֙ הָעֲשׂוּיָ֔ה וְעַ֖ד בֵּ֥ית הַגִּבֹּרִֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'chryv hchzyq nchmyh bn'zbvq shr chtsy plkh byttsvr 'dngd qbry dvyd v'dhbrkhh h'shvyh v'd byt hgbrym {s}
verses.translation: After him repaired Nehemiah the son of Azbuk, the ruler of half the district of Beth-zur, unto the place over against the sepulchres of David, and unto the pool that was made, and unto the house of the mighty men.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַחֲרָ֛יו הֶחֱזִ֥יקוּ הַלְוִיִּ֖ם רְח֣וּם בֶּן־בָּנִ֑י {ס} עַל־יָד֣וֹ הֶחֱזִ֗יק חֲשַׁבְיָ֛ה שַׂר־חֲצִי־פֶ֥לֶךְ קְעִילָ֖ה לְפִלְכּֽוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'chryv hchzyqv hlvym rchvm bnbny {s} 'lydv hchzyq chshbyh shrchtsyplkh q'ylh lplkhv {s}
verses.translation: After him repaired the Levites, Rehum the son of Bani. Next unto him repaired Hashabiah, the ruler of half the district of Keilah, for his district.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַחֲרָיו֙ הֶחֱזִ֣יקוּ אֲחֵיהֶ֔ם בַּוַּ֖י בֶּן־חֵנָדָ֑ד שַׂ֕ר חֲצִ֖י פֶּ֥לֶךְ קְעִילָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'chryv hchzyqv 'chyhm bvy bnchndd shr chtsy plkh q'ylh {s}
verses.translation: After him repaired their brethren, Bavvai the son of Henadad, the ruler of half the district of Keilah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְחַזֵּ֨ק עַל־יָד֜וֹ עֵ֧זֶר בֶּן־יֵשׁ֛וּעַ שַׂ֥ר הַמִּצְפָּ֖ה מִדָּ֣ה שֵׁנִ֑ית מִנֶּ֕גֶד עֲלֹ֥ת הַנֶּ֖שֶׁק הַמִּקְצֹֽעַ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vychzq 'lydv 'zr bnyshv' shr hmtsph mdh shnyt mngd 'lt hnshq hmqts' {s}
verses.translation: And next to him repaired Ezer the son of Jeshua, the ruler of Mizpah, another portion, over against the ascent to the armoury at the Turning.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַחֲרָ֨יו הֶחֱרָ֧ה הֶחֱזִ֛יק בָּר֥וּךְ בֶּן־[זַכַּ֖י] (זבי) מִדָּ֣ה שֵׁנִ֑ית מִ֨ן־הַמִּקְצ֔וֹעַ עַד־פֶּ֙תַח֙ בֵּ֣ית אֶלְיָשִׁ֔יב הַכֹּהֵ֖ן הַגָּדֽוֹל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'chryv hchrh hchzyq brvkh bn[zkhy] (zby) mdh shnyt mnhmqtsv' 'dptch byt 'lyshyb hkhhn hgdvl {s}
verses.translation: After him Baruch the son of Zaccai earnestly repaired another portion, from the Turning unto the door of the house of Eliashib the high priest.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַחֲרָ֣יו הֶחֱזִ֗יק מְרֵמ֧וֹת בֶּן־אוּרִיָּ֛ה בֶּן־הַקּ֖וֹץ מִדָּ֣ה שֵׁנִ֑ית מִפֶּ֙תַח֙ בֵּ֣ית אֶלְיָשִׁ֔יב וְעַד־תַּכְלִ֖ית בֵּ֥ית אֶלְיָשִֽׁיב׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'chryv hchzyq mrmvt bn'vryh bnhqvts mdh shnyt mptch byt 'lyshyb v'dtkhlyt byt 'lyshyb {s}
verses.translation: After him repaired Meremoth the son of Uriah the son of Hakkoz another portion, from the door of the house of Eliashib even to the end of the house of Eliashib.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַחֲרָ֛יו הֶחֱזִ֥יקוּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים אַנְשֵׁ֥י הַכִּכָּֽר׃
verses.translit: v'chryv hchzyqv hkhhnym 'nshy hkhkhr
verses.translation: And after him repaired the priests, the men of the Plain.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַחֲרָ֨יו הֶחֱזִ֧יק בִּנְיָמִ֛ן וְחַשּׁ֖וּב נֶ֣גֶד בֵּיתָ֑ם {ס} אַחֲרָ֣יו הֶחֱזִ֗יק עֲזַרְיָ֧ה בֶן־מַעֲשֵׂיָ֛ה בֶּן־עֲנָֽנְיָ֖ה אֵ֥צֶל בֵּיתֽוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'chryv hchzyq bnymn vchshvb ngd bytm {s} 'chryv hchzyq 'zryh bnm'shyh bn'nnyh 'tsl bytv {s}
verses.translation: After them repaired Benjamin and Hasshub over against their house. After them repaired Azariah the son of Maaseiah the son of Ananiah beside his own house.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַחֲרָ֣יו הֶחֱזִ֗יק בִּנּ֛וּי בֶּן־חֵנָדָ֖ד מִדָּ֣ה שֵׁנִ֑ית מִבֵּ֣ית עֲזַרְיָ֔ה עַד־הַמִּקְצ֖וֹעַ וְעַד־הַפִּנָּֽה׃
verses.translit: 'chryv hchzyq bnvy bnchndd mdh shnyt mbyt 'zryh 'dhmqtsv' v'dhpnh
verses.translation: After him repaired Binnui the son of Henadad another portion, from the house of Azariah unto the Turning and unto the corner.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פָּלָ֣ל בֶּן־אוּזַי֮ מִנֶּ֣גֶד הַמִּקְצ֒וֹעַ֒ וְהַמִּגְדָּ֗ל הַיּוֹצֵא֙ מִבֵּ֤ית הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ הָֽעֶלְי֔וֹן אֲשֶׁ֖ר לַחֲצַ֣ר הַמַּטָּרָ֑ה אַחֲרָ֖יו פְּדָיָ֥ה בֶן־פַּרְעֹֽשׁ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: pll bn'vzy mngd hmqtsv' vhmgdl hyvts' mbyt hmlkh h'lyvn 'shr lchtsr hmtrh 'chryv pdyh bnpr'sh {s}
verses.translation: Palal the son of Uzai repaired over against the Turning, and the tower that standeth out from the upper house of the king, which is by the court of the guard. After him Pedaiah the son of Parosh repaired.—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַ֨נְּתִינִ֔ים הָי֥וּ יֹשְׁבִ֖ים בָּעֹ֑פֶל עַ֠ד נֶ֜גֶד שַׁ֤עַר הַמַּ֙יִם֙ לַמִּזְרָ֔ח וְהַמִּגְדָּ֖ל הַיּוֹצֵֽא׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vhntynym hyv yshbym b'pl 'd ngd sh'r hmym lmzrch vhmgdl hyvts' {s}
verses.translation: Now the Nethinim dwelt in Ophel, unto the place over against the water gate toward the east, and the tower that standeth out.—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַחֲרָ֛יו הֶחֱזִ֥יקוּ הַתְּקֹעִ֖ים מִדָּ֣ה שֵׁנִ֑ית מִנֶּ֜גֶד הַמִּגְדָּ֤ל הַגָּדוֹל֙ הַיּוֹצֵ֔א וְעַ֖ד חוֹמַ֥ת הָעֹֽפֶל׃
verses.translit: 'chryv hchzyqv htq'ym mdh shnyt mngd hmgdl hgdvl hyvts' v'd chvmt h'pl
verses.translation: After him the Tekoites repaired another portion, over against the great tower that standeth out, and unto the wall of Ophel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֵעַ֣ל  שַׁ֣עַר הַסּוּסִ֗ים הֶחֱזִ֙יקוּ֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים אִ֖ישׁ לְנֶ֥גֶד בֵּיתֽוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: m'l  sh'r hsvsym hchzyqv hkhhnym 'ysh lngd bytv {s}
verses.translation: Above the horse gate repaired the priests, every one over against his own house.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַחֲרָ֧יו הֶחֱזִ֛יק צָד֥וֹק בֶּן־אִמֵּ֖ר נֶ֣גֶד בֵּית֑וֹ {ס} וְאַחֲרָ֤יו הֶחֱזִיק֙ שְׁמַֽעְיָ֣ה בֶן־שְׁכַנְיָ֔ה שֹׁמֵ֖ר שַׁ֥עַר הַמִּזְרָֽח׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'chryv hchzyq tsdvq bn'mr ngd bytv {s} v'chryv hchzyq shm'yh bnshkhnyh shmr sh'r hmzrch {s}
verses.translation: After them repaired Zadok the son of Immer over against his own house. And after him repaired Shemaiah the son of Shecaniah, the keeper of the east gate.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (אחרי) [אַחֲרָ֨יו] הֶחֱזִ֜יק חֲנַנְיָ֣ה בֶן־שֶׁלֶמְיָ֗ה וְחָנ֧וּן בֶּן־צָלָ֛ף הַשִּׁשִּׁ֖י מִדָּ֣ה שֵׁנִ֑י {ס} אַחֲרָ֣יו הֶחֱזִ֗יק מְשֻׁלָּם֙ בֶּן־בֶּ֣רֶכְיָ֔ה נֶ֖גֶד נִשְׁכָּתֽוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: ('chry) ['chryv] hchzyq chnnyh bnshlmyh vchnvn bntslf hshshy mdh shny {s} 'chryv hchzyq mshlm bnbrkhyh ngd nshkhtv {s}
verses.translation: After him repaired Hananiah the son of Shelemiah, and Hanun the sixth son of Zalaph, another portion. After him repaired Meshullam the son of Berechiah over against his chamber.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (אחרי) [אַחֲרָ֣יו] הֶחֱזִ֗יק מַלְכִּיָּה֙ בֶּן־הַצֹּ֣רְפִ֔י עַד־בֵּ֥ית הַנְּתִינִ֖ים וְהָרֹכְלִ֑ים נֶ֚גֶד שַׁ֣עַר הַמִּפְקָ֔ד וְעַ֖ד עֲלִיַּ֥ת הַפִּנָּֽה׃
verses.translit: ('chry) ['chryv] hchzyq mlkhyh bnhtsrpy 'dbyt hntynym vhrkhlym ngd sh'r hmpqd v'd 'lyt hpnh
verses.translation: After him repaired Malchijah one of the goldsmiths unto the house of the Nethinim, and of the merchants, over against the gate of Hammiphkad, and to the upper chamber of the corner.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבֵ֨ין עֲלִיַּ֤ת הַפִּנָּה֙ לְשַׁ֣עַר הַצֹּ֔אן הֶחֱזִ֥יקוּ הַצֹּרְפִ֖ים וְהָרֹכְלִֽים׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vbyn 'lyt hpnh lsh'r hts'n hchzyqv htsrpym vhrkhlym {p}
verses.translation: And between the upper chamber of the corner and the sheep gate repaired the goldsmiths and the merchants.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֞י כַּאֲשֶׁ֧ר שָׁמַ֣ע סַנְבַלַּ֗ט כִּֽי־אֲנַ֤חְנוּ בוֹנִים֙ אֶת־הַ֣חוֹמָ֔ה וַיִּ֣חַר ל֔וֹ וַיִּכְעַ֖ס הַרְבֵּ֑ה וַיַּלְעֵ֖ג עַל־הַיְּהוּדִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyhy kh'shr shm' snblt khy'nchnv bvnym 'thchvmh vychr lv vykh's hrbh vyl'g 'lhyhvdym
verses.translation: But it came to pass that, when Sanballat heard that we builded the wall, he was wroth, and took great indignation, and mocked the Jews.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר  לִפְנֵ֣י אֶחָ֗יו וְחֵיל֙ שֹֽׁמְר֔וֹן וַיֹּ֕אמֶר מָ֛ה הַיְּהוּדִ֥ים הָאֲמֵלָלִ֖ים עֹשִׂ֑ים הֲיַעַזְב֨וּ לָהֶ֤ם הֲיִזְבָּ֙חוּ֙ הַיְכַלּ֣וּ בַיּ֔וֹם הַיְחַיּ֧וּ אֶת־הָאֲבָנִ֛ים מֵעֲרֵמ֥וֹת הֶעָפָ֖ר וְהֵ֥מָּה שְׂרוּפֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vy'mr  lpny 'chyv vchyl shmrvn vy'mr mh hyhvdym h'mllym 'shym hy'zbv lhm hyzbchv hykhlv byvm hychyv 'th'bnym m'rmvt h'pr vhmh shrvpvt
verses.translation: And he spoke before his brethren and the army of Samaria, and said: ‘What do these feeble Jews? will they restore at will? will they sacrifice? will they make an end this day? will they revive the stones out of the heaps of rubbish, seeing they are burned?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְטוֹבִיָּ֥ה הָעַמֹּנִ֖י אֶצְל֑וֹ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר גַּ֚ם אֲשֶׁר־הֵ֣ם בּוֹנִ֔ים אִם־יַעֲלֶ֣ה שׁוּעָ֔ל וּפָרַ֖ץ חוֹמַ֥ת אַבְנֵיהֶֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vtvbyh h'mny 'tslv vy'mr gm 'shrhm bvnym 'my'lh shv'l vprts chvmt 'bnyhm {p}
verses.translation: Now Tobiah the Ammonite was by him, and he said: ‘Even that which they build, if a fox go up, he shall break down their stone wall.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁמַ֤ע אֱלֹהֵ֙ינוּ֙ כִּֽי־הָיִ֣ינוּ בוּזָ֔ה וְהָשֵׁ֥ב חֶרְפָּתָ֖ם אֶל־רֹאשָׁ֑ם וּתְנֵ֥ם לְבִזָּ֖ה בְּאֶ֥רֶץ שִׁבְיָֽה׃
verses.translit: shm' 'lhynv khyhyynv bvzh vhshb chrptm 'lr'shm vtnm lbzh b'rts shbyh
verses.translation: Hear, O our God; for we are despised; and turn back their reproach upon their own head, and give them up to spoiling in a land of captivity;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַל־תְּכַס֙ עַל־עֲוֺנָ֔ם וְחַטָּאתָ֖ם מִלְּפָנֶ֣יךָ אַל־תִּמָּחֶ֑ה כִּ֥י הִכְעִ֖יסוּ לְנֶ֥גֶד הַבּוֹנִֽים׃
verses.translit: v'ltkhs 'l'vnm vcht'tm mlpnykh 'ltmchh khy hkh'ysv lngd hbvnym
verses.translation: and cover not their iniquity, and let not their sin be blotted out from before Thee; for they have vexed Thee before the builders.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַנִּבְנֶה֙ אֶת־הַ֣חוֹמָ֔ה וַתִּקָּשֵׁ֥ר כׇּל־הַחוֹמָ֖ה עַד־חֶצְיָ֑הּ וַיְהִ֧י לֵ֦ב לָעָ֖ם לַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vnbnh 'thchvmh vtqshr khlhchvmh 'dchtsyh vyhy lb l'm l'shvt {p}
verses.translation: So we built the wall; and all the wall was joined together unto half the height thereof; for the people had a mind to work.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י כַאֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁמַ֣ע סַנְבַלַּ֡ט וְ֠טוֹבִיָּ֠ה וְהָעַרְבִ֨ים וְהָעַמֹּנִ֜ים וְהָאַשְׁדּוֹדִ֗ים כִּֽי־עָלְתָ֤ה אֲרוּכָה֙ לְחֹמ֣וֹת יְרוּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם כִּי־הֵחֵ֥לּוּ הַפְּרֻצִ֖ים לְהִסָּתֵ֑ם וַיִּ֥חַר לָהֶ֖ם מְאֹֽד׃
verses.translit: vyhy kh'shr shm' snblt vtvbyh vh'rbym vh'mnym vh'shdvdym khy'lth 'rvkhh lchmvt yrvshl͏m khyhchlv hprtsym lhstm vychr lhm m'd
verses.translation: But it came to pass that, when Sanballat, and Tobiah, and the Arabians, and the Ammonites, and the Ashdodites, heard that the repairing of the walls of Jerusalem went forward, and that the breaches began to be stopped, then they were very wroth;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְשְׁר֤וּ כֻלָּם֙ יַחְדָּ֔ו לָב֖וֹא לְהִלָּחֵ֣ם בִּירוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם וְלַעֲשׂ֥וֹת ל֖וֹ תּוֹעָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyqshrv khlm ychdv lbv' lhlchm byrvshl͏m vl'shvt lv tv'h
verses.translation: and they conspired all of them together to come and fight against Jerusalem, and to cause confusion therein.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַנִּתְפַּלֵּ֖ל אֶל־אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ וַנַּעֲמִ֨יד מִשְׁמָ֧ר עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם יוֹמָ֥ם וָלַ֖יְלָה מִפְּנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vntpll 'l'lhynv vn'myd mshmr 'lyhm yvmm vlylh mpnyhm
verses.translation: But we made our prayer unto our God, and set a watch against them day and night, because of them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוּדָ֗ה כָּשַׁל֙ כֹּ֣חַ הַסַּבָּ֔ל וְהֶעָפָ֖ר הַרְבֵּ֑ה וַאֲנַ֙חְנוּ֙ לֹ֣א נוּכַ֔ל לִבְנ֖וֹת בַּחוֹמָֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvdh khshl khch hsbl vh'pr hrbh v'nchnv l' nvkhl lbnvt bchvmh
verses.translation: And Judah said: ‘The strength of the bearers of burdens is decayed, and there is much rubbish; so that we are not able to build the wall.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ צָרֵ֗ינוּ לֹ֤א יֵדְעוּ֙ וְלֹ֣א יִרְא֔וּ עַ֛ד אֲשֶׁר־נָב֥וֹא אֶל־תּוֹכָ֖ם וַהֲרַגְנ֑וּם וְהִשְׁבַּ֖תְנוּ אֶת־הַמְּלָאכָֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv tsrynv l' yd'v vl' yr'v 'd 'shrnbv' 'ltvkhm vhrgnvm vhshbtnv 'thml'khh
verses.translation: And our adversaries said: ‘They shall not know, neither see, till we come into the midst of them, and slay them, and cause the work to cease.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ כַּאֲשֶׁר־בָּ֣אוּ הַיְּהוּדִ֔ים הַיֹּשְׁבִ֖ים אֶצְלָ֑ם וַיֹּ֤אמְרוּ לָ֙נוּ֙ עֶ֣שֶׂר פְּעָמִ֔ים מִכׇּל־הַמְּקֹמ֖וֹת אֲשֶׁר־תָּשׁ֥וּבוּ עָלֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: vyhy kh'shrb'v hyhvdym hyshbym 'tslm vy'mrv lnv 'shr p'mym mkhlhmqmvt 'shrtshvbv 'lynv
verses.translation: And it came to pass that, when the Jews that dwelt by them came, they said unto us ten times: ‘Ye must return unto us from all places.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָֽאַעֲמִ֞יד מִֽתַּחְתְּי֧וֹת לַמָּק֛וֹם מֵאַחֲרֵ֥י לַחוֹמָ֖ה (בצחחיים) [בַּצְּחִיחִ֑ים] וָֽאַעֲמִ֤יד אֶת־הָעָם֙ לְמִשְׁפָּח֔וֹת עִם־חַרְבֹתֵיהֶ֛ם רׇמְחֵיהֶ֖ם וְקַשְּׁתֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v''myd mtchtyvt lmqvm m'chry lchvmh (btschchyym) [btschychym] v''myd 'th'm lmshpchvt 'mchrbtyhm rmchyhm vqshttyhm
verses.translation: Therefore set I in the lowest parts of the space behind the wall, in the open places, I even set the people after their families with their swords, their spears, and their bows.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֵ֣רֶא וָאָק֗וּם וָאֹמַ֞ר אֶל־הַחֹרִ֤ים וְאֶל־הַסְּגָנִים֙ וְאֶל־יֶ֣תֶר הָעָ֔ם אַל־תִּֽירְא֖וּ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֑ם אֶת־אֲדֹנָ֞י הַגָּד֤וֹל וְהַנּוֹרָא֙ זְכֹ֔רוּ וְהִֽלָּחֲמ֗וּ עַל־אֲחֵיכֶם֙ בְּנֵיכֶ֣ם וּבְנֹתֵיכֶ֔ם נְשֵׁיכֶ֖ם וּבָתֵּיכֶֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'r' v'qvm v'mr 'lhchrym v'lhsgnym v'lytr h'm 'ltyr'v mpnyhm 't'dny hgdvl vhnvr' zkhrv vhlchmv 'l'chykhm bnykhm vbntykhm nshykhm vbtykhm {p}
verses.translation: And I looked, and rose up, and said unto the nobles, and to the rulers, and to the rest of the people: ‘Be not ye afraid of them; remember the Lord, who is great and awful, and fight for your brethren, your sons and your daughters, your wives and your houses.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֞י כַּֽאֲשֶׁר־שָׁמְע֤וּ אוֹיְבֵ֙ינוּ֙ כִּי־נ֣וֹדַֽע לָ֔נוּ וַיָּ֥פֶר הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶת־עֲצָתָ֑ם (ונשוב) [וַנָּ֤שׇׁב] כֻּלָּ֙נוּ֙ אֶל־הַ֣חוֹמָ֔ה אִ֖ישׁ אֶל־מְלַאכְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyhy kh'shrshm'v 'vybynv khynvd' lnv vypr h'lhym 't'tstm (vnshvb) [vnshb] khlnv 'lhchvmh 'ysh 'lml'khtv
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when our enemies heard that it was known unto us, and God had brought their counsel to nought, that we returned all of us to the wall, every one unto his work.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י  מִן־הַיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא חֲצִ֣י נְעָרַי֮ עֹשִׂ֣ים בַּמְּלָאכָה֒ וְחֶצְיָ֗ם מַחֲזִיקִים֙ וְהָרְמָחִ֣ים הַמָּגִנִּ֔ים וְהַקְּשָׁת֖וֹת וְהַשִּׁרְיֹנִ֑ים וְהַ֨שָּׂרִ֔ים אַחֲרֵ֖י כׇּל־בֵּ֥ית יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyhy  mnhyvm hhv' chtsy n'ry 'shym bml'khh vchtsym mchzyqym vhrmchym hmgnym vhqshtvt vhshrynym vhshrym 'chry khlbyt yhvdh
verses.translation: And it came to pass from that time forth, that half of my servants wrought in the work, and half of them held the spears, the shields, and the bows, and the coats of mail; and the rulers were behind all the house of Judah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַבּוֹנִ֧ים בַּחוֹמָ֛ה וְהַנֹּשְׂאִ֥ים בַּסֶּ֖בֶל עֹמְשִׂ֑ים בְּאַחַ֤ת יָדוֹ֙ עֹשֶׂ֣ה בַמְּלָאכָ֔ה וְאַחַ֖ת מַחֲזֶ֥קֶת הַשָּֽׁלַח׃
verses.translit: hbvnym bchvmh vhnsh'ym bsbl 'mshym b'cht ydv 'shh bml'khh v'cht mchzqt hshlch
verses.translation: They that builded the wall and they that bore burdens laded themselves, every one with one of his hands wrought in the work, and with the other held his weapon;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַ֨בּוֹנִ֔ים אִ֥ישׁ חַרְבּ֛וֹ אֲסוּרִ֥ים עַל־מׇתְנָ֖יו וּבוֹנִ֑ים וְהַתּוֹקֵ֥עַ בַּשּׁוֹפָ֖ר אֶצְלִֽי׃
verses.translit: vhbvnym 'ysh chrbv 'svrym 'lmtnyv vbvnym vhtvq' bshvpr 'tsly
verses.translation: and the builders, every one had his sword girded by his side, and so builded. And he that sounded the horn was by me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֞ר אֶל־הַחֹרִ֤ים וְאֶל־הַסְּגָנִים֙ וְאֶל־יֶ֣תֶר הָעָ֔ם הַמְּלָאכָ֥ה הַרְבֵּ֖ה וּרְחָבָ֑ה וַאֲנַ֗חְנוּ נִפְרָדִים֙ עַל־הַ֣חוֹמָ֔ה רְחוֹקִ֖ים אִ֥ישׁ מֵאָחִֽיו׃
verses.translit: v'mr 'lhchrym v'lhsgnym v'lytr h'm hml'khh hrbh vrchbh v'nchnv nprdym 'lhchvmh rchvqym 'ysh m'chyv
verses.translation: And I said unto the nobles, and to the rulers and to the rest of the people: ‘The work is great and large, and we are separated upon the wall, one far from another;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּמְק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֤ר תִּשְׁמְעוּ֙ אֶת־ק֣וֹל הַשּׁוֹפָ֔ר שָׁ֖מָּה תִּקָּבְצ֣וּ אֵלֵ֑ינוּ אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ יִלָּ֥חֶם לָֽנוּ׃
verses.translit: bmqvm 'shr tshm'v 'tqvl hshvpr shmh tqbtsv 'lynv 'lhynv ylchm lnv
verses.translation: in what place soever ye hear the sound of the horn, resort ye thither unto us; our God will fight for us.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲנַ֖חְנוּ עֹשִׂ֣ים בַּמְּלָאכָ֑ה וְחֶצְיָ֗ם מַחֲזִיקִים֙ בָּֽרְמָחִ֔ים מֵעֲל֣וֹת הַשַּׁ֔חַר עַ֖ד צֵ֥את הַכּוֹכָבִֽים׃
verses.translit: v'nchnv 'shym bml'khh vchtsym mchzyqym brmchym m'lvt hshchr 'd ts't hkhvkhbym
verses.translation: So we wrought in the work; and half of them held the spears from the rising of the morning till the stars appeared.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּ֣ם בָּעֵ֤ת הַהִיא֙ אָמַ֣רְתִּי לָעָ֔ם אִ֣ישׁ וְנַעֲר֔וֹ יָלִ֖ינוּ בְּת֣וֹךְ יְרוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם וְהָֽיוּ־לָ֧נוּ הַלַּ֛יְלָה מִשְׁמָ֖ר וְהַיּ֥וֹם מְלָאכָֽה׃
verses.translit: gm b't hhy' 'mrty l'm 'ysh vn'rv ylynv btvkh yrvshl͏m vhyvlnv hlylh mshmr vhyvm ml'khh
verses.translation: Likewise at the same time said I unto the people: ‘Let every one with his servant lodge within Jerusalem, that in the night they may be a guard to us, and may labour in the day.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֨ין אֲנִ֜י וְאַחַ֣י וּנְעָרַ֗י וְאַנְשֵׁ֤י הַמִּשְׁמָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אַחֲרַ֔י אֵין־אֲנַ֥חְנוּ פֹשְׁטִ֖ים בְּגָדֵ֑ינוּ אִ֖ישׁ שִׁלְח֥וֹ הַמָּֽיִם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'yn 'ny v'chy vn'ry v'nshy hmshmr 'shr 'chry 'yn'nchnv pshtym bgdynv 'ysh shlchv hmym {p}
verses.translation: So neither I, nor my brethren, nor my servants, nor the men of the guard that followed me, none of us put off our clothes, every one that went to the water had his weapon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתְּהִ֨י צַעֲקַ֥ת הָעָ֛ם וּנְשֵׁיהֶ֖ם גְּדוֹלָ֑ה אֶל־אֲחֵיהֶ֖ם הַיְּהוּדִֽים׃
verses.translit: vthy ts'qt h'm vnshyhm gdvlh 'l'chyhm hyhvdym
verses.translation: Then there arose a great cry of the people and of their wives against their brethren the Jews.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיֵשׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֹמְרִ֔ים בָּנֵ֥ינוּ וּבְנֹתֵ֖ינוּ אֲנַ֣חְנוּ רַבִּ֑ים וְנִקְחָ֥ה דָגָ֖ן וְנֹאכְלָ֥ה וְנִחְיֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vysh 'shr 'mrym bnynv vbntynv 'nchnv rbym vnqchh dgn vn'khlh vnchyh
verses.translation: For there were that said: ‘We, our sons and our daughters, are many; let us get for them corn, that we may eat and live.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיֵשׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֹמְרִ֔ים שְׂדֹתֵ֛ינוּ וּכְרָמֵ֥ינוּ וּבָתֵּ֖ינוּ אֲנַ֣חְנוּ עֹרְבִ֑ים וְנִקְחָ֥ה דָגָ֖ן בָּרָעָֽב׃
verses.translit: vysh 'shr 'mrym shdtynv vkhrmynv vbtynv 'nchnv 'rbym vnqchh dgn br'b
verses.translation: Some also there were that said: ‘We are mortgaging our fields, and our vineyards, and our houses; let us get corn, because of the dearth.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיֵשׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֹמְרִ֔ים לָוִ֥ינוּ כֶ֖סֶף לְמִדַּ֣ת הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ שְׂדֹתֵ֖ינוּ וּכְרָמֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: vysh 'shr 'mrym lvynv khsf lmdt hmlkh shdtynv vkhrmynv
verses.translation: There were also that said: ‘We have borrowed money for the king’s tribute upon our fields and our vineyards.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה כִּבְשַׂ֤ר אַחֵ֙ינוּ֙ בְּשָׂרֵ֔נוּ כִּבְנֵיהֶ֖ם בָּנֵ֑ינוּ וְהִנֵּ֣ה אֲנַ֣חְנוּ כֹ֠בְשִׁ֠ים אֶת־בָּנֵ֨ינוּ וְאֶת־בְּנֹתֵ֜ינוּ לַעֲבָדִ֗ים וְיֵ֨שׁ מִבְּנֹתֵ֤ינוּ נִכְבָּשׁוֹת֙ וְאֵ֣ין לְאֵ֣ל יָדֵ֔נוּ וּשְׂדֹתֵ֥ינוּ וּכְרָמֵ֖ינוּ לַאֲחֵרִֽים׃
verses.translit: v'th khbshr 'chynv bshrnv khbnyhm bnynv vhnh 'nchnv khbshym 'tbnynv v'tbntynv l'bdym vysh mbntynv nkhbshvt v'yn l'l ydnv vshdtynv vkhrmynv l'chrym
verses.translation: Yet now our flesh is as the flesh of our brethren, our children as their children; and, lo, we bring into bondage our sons and our daughters to be servants, and some of our daughters are brought into bondage already; neither is it in our power to help it; for other men have our fields and our vineyards.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּ֥חַר לִ֖י מְאֹ֑ד כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר שָׁמַ֙עְתִּי֙ אֶת־זַֽעֲקָתָ֔ם וְאֵ֖ת הַדְּבָרִ֥ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.translit: vychr ly m'd kh'shr shm'ty 'tz'qtm v't hdbrym h'lh
verses.translation: And I was very angry when I heard their cry and these words.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּמָּלֵ֨ךְ לִבִּ֜י עָלַ֗י וָאָרִ֙יבָה֙ אֶת־הַחֹרִ֣ים וְאֶת־הַסְּגָנִ֔ים וָאֹמְרָ֣ה לָהֶ֔ם מַשָּׁ֥א אִישׁ־בְּאָחִ֖יו אַתֶּ֣ם (נשאים) [נֹשִׁ֑ים] וָאֶתֵּ֥ן עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם קְהִלָּ֥ה גְדוֹלָֽה׃
verses.translit: vymlkh lby 'ly v'rybh 'thchrym v'thsgnym v'mrh lhm msh' 'yshb'chyv 'tm (nsh'ym) [nshym] v'tn 'lyhm qhlh gdvlh
verses.translation: Then I consulted with myself, and contended with the nobles and the rulers, and said unto them: ‘Ye lend upon pledge, every one to his brother.’ And I held a great assembly against them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֹמְרָ֣ה לָהֶ֗ם אֲנַ֣חְנוּ קָ֠נִ֠ינוּ אֶת־אַחֵ֨ינוּ הַיְּהוּדִ֜ים הַנִּמְכָּרִ֤ים לַגּוֹיִם֙ כְּדֵ֣י בָ֔נוּ וְגַם־אַתֶּ֛ם תִּמְכְּר֥וּ אֶת־אֲחֵיכֶ֖ם וְנִמְכְּרוּ־לָ֑נוּ וַֽיַּחֲרִ֔ישׁוּ וְלֹ֥א מָצְא֖וּ דָּבָֽר׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'mrh lhm 'nchnv qnynv 't'chynv hyhvdym hnmkhrym lgvym khdy bnv vgm'tm tmkhrv 't'chykhm vnmkhrvlnv vychryshv vl' mts'v dbr {p}
verses.translation: And I said unto them: ‘We after our ability have redeemed our brethren the Jews, that sold themselves unto the heathen; and would ye nevertheless sell your brethren, and should they sell themselves unto us?’ Then held they their peace, and found never a word.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (ויאמר) [וָאוֹמַ֕ר] לֹא־ט֥וֹב הַדָּבָ֖ר אֲשֶׁר־אַתֶּ֣ם עֹשִׂ֑ים הֲל֞וֹא בְּיִרְאַ֤ת אֱלֹהֵ֙ינוּ֙ תֵּלֵ֔כוּ מֵחֶרְפַּ֖ת הַגּוֹיִ֥ם אוֹיְבֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: (vy'mr) [v'vmr] l'tvb hdbr 'shr'tm 'shym hlv' byr't 'lhynv tlkhv mchrpt hgvym 'vybynv
verses.translation: Also I said: ‘The thing that ye do is not good; ought ye not to walk in the fear of our God, because of the reproach of the heathen our enemies?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגַם־אֲנִי֙ אַחַ֣י וּנְעָרַ֔י נֹשִׁ֥ים בָּהֶ֖ם כֶּ֣סֶף וְדָגָ֑ן נַֽעַזְבָה־נָּ֖א אֶת־הַמַּשָּׁ֥א הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: vgm'ny 'chy vn'ry nshym bhm khsf vdgn n'zbhn' 'thmsh' hzh
verses.translation: And I likewise, my brethren and my servants, have lent them money and corn. I pray you, let us leave off this exaction.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָשִׁ֩יבוּ֩ נָ֨א לָהֶ֜ם כְּהַיּ֗וֹם שְׂדֹתֵיהֶ֛ם כַּרְמֵיהֶ֥ם זֵיתֵיהֶ֖ם וּבָתֵּיהֶ֑ם וּמְאַ֨ת הַכֶּ֤סֶף וְהַדָּגָן֙ הַתִּיר֣וֹשׁ וְהַיִּצְהָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֖ם נֹשִׁ֥ים בָּהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: hshybv n' lhm khhyvm shdtyhm khrmyhm zytyhm vbtyhm vm't hkhsf vhdgn htyrvsh vhytshr 'shr 'tm nshym bhm
verses.translation: Restore, I pray you, to them, even this day, their fields, their vineyards, their oliveyards, and their houses, also the hundred pieces of silver, and the corn, the wine, and the oil, that ye exact of them.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ נָשִׁ֗יב וּמֵהֶם֙ לֹ֣א נְבַקֵּ֔שׁ כֵּ֣ן נַעֲשֶׂ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר אַתָּ֣ה אוֹמֵ֑ר וָאֶקְרָא֙ אֶת־הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים וָֽאַשְׁבִּיעֵ֔ם לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת כַּדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv nshyb vmhm l' nbqsh khn n'shh kh'shr 'th 'vmr v'qr' 'thkhhnym v'shby'm l'shvt khdbr hzh
verses.translation: Then said they: ‘We will restore them, and will require nothing of them; so will we do, even as thou sayest.’ Then I called the priests, and took an oath of them, that they should do according to this promise.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּם־חׇצְנִ֣י נָעַ֗רְתִּי וָֽאֹמְרָ֡ה כָּ֣כָה יְנַעֵ֪ר הָֽאֱלֹהִ֟ים אֶת־כׇּל־הָאִישׁ֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא־יָקִ֜ים אֶת־הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֗ה מִבֵּיתוֹ֙ וּמִ֣יגִיע֔וֹ וְכָ֛כָה יִהְיֶ֥ה נָע֖וּר וָרֵ֑ק וַיֹּאמְר֨וּ כׇֽל־הַקָּהָ֜ל אָמֵ֗ן וַֽיְהַלְלוּ֙ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֔ה וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הָעָ֖ם כַּדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: gmchtsny n'rty v'mrh khkhh yn'r h'lhym 'tkhlh'ysh 'shr l'yqym 'thdbr hzh mbytv vmygy'v vkhkhh yhyh n'vr vrq vy'mrv khlhqhl 'mn vyhllv 'tyhvh vy'sh h'm khdbr hzh
verses.translation: Also I shook out my lap, and said: ‘So God shake out every man from his house, and from his labour, that performeth not this promise; even thus be he shaken out, and emptied.’ And all the congregation said: ‘Amen’, and praised the LORD. And the people did according to this promise.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּ֞ם מִיּ֣וֹם  אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֣ה אוֹתִ֗י לִהְי֣וֹת פֶּחָם֮ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ יְהוּדָה֒ מִשְּׁנַ֣ת עֶשְׂרִ֗ים וְ֠עַ֠ד שְׁנַ֨ת שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים וּשְׁתַּ֙יִם֙ לְאַרְתַּחְשַׁ֣סְתְּא הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ שָׁנִ֖ים שְׁתֵּ֣ים עֶשְׂרֵ֑ה אֲנִ֣י וְאַחַ֔י לֶ֥חֶם הַפֶּחָ֖ה לֹ֥א אָכַֽלְתִּי׃
verses.translit: gm myvm  'shrtsvh 'vty lhyvt pchm b'rts yhvdh mshnt 'shrym v'd shnt shlshym vshtym l'rtchshst' hmlkh shnym shtym 'shrh 'ny v'chy lchm hpchh l' 'khlty
verses.translation: Moreover from the time that I was appointed to be their governor in the land of Judah, from the twentieth year even unto the two and thirtieth year of Artaxerxes the king, that is, twelve years, I and my brethren have not eaten the bread of the governor.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַפַּחוֹת֩ הָרִאשֹׁנִ֨ים אֲשֶׁר־לְפָנַ֜י הִכְבִּ֣ידוּ עַל־הָעָ֗ם וַיִּקְח֨וּ מֵהֶ֜ם בְּלֶ֤חֶם וָיַ֙יִן֙ אַחַר֙ כֶּֽסֶף־שְׁקָלִ֣ים אַרְבָּעִ֔ים גַּ֥ם נַעֲרֵיהֶ֖ם שָׁלְט֣וּ עַל־הָעָ֑ם וַאֲנִי֙ לֹא־עָשִׂ֣יתִי כֵ֔ן מִפְּנֵ֖י יִרְאַ֥ת אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: vhpchvt hr'shnym 'shrlpny hkhbydv 'lh'm vyqchv mhm blchm vyyn 'chr khsfshqlym 'rb'ym gm n'ryhm shltv 'lh'm v'ny l''shyty khn mpny yr't 'lhym
verses.translation: But the former governors that were before me laid burdens upon the people, and took of them for bread and wine above forty shekels of silver; yea, even their servants lorded over the people; but so did not I, because of the fear of God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֠גַ֠ם בִּמְלֶ֜אכֶת הַחוֹמָ֤ה הַזֹּאת֙ הֶחֱזַ֔קְתִּי וְשָׂדֶ֖ה לֹ֣א קָנִ֑ינוּ וְכׇ֨ל־נְעָרַ֔י קְבוּצִ֥ים שָׁ֖ם עַל־הַמְּלָאכָֽה׃
verses.translit: vgm bml'kht hchvmh hz't hchzqty vshdh l' qnynv vkhln'ry qbvtsym shm 'lhml'khh
verses.translation: Yea, also I set hand to the work of this wall, neither bought we any land; and all my servants were gathered thither unto the work.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַיְּהוּדִ֨ים וְהַסְּגָנִ֜ים מֵאָ֧ה וַחֲמִשִּׁ֣ים אִ֗ישׁ וְהַבָּאִ֥ים אֵלֵ֛ינוּ מִן־הַגּוֹיִ֥ם אֲשֶׁר־סְבִיבֹתֵ֖ינוּ עַל־שֻׁלְחָנִֽי׃
verses.translit: vhyhvdym vhsgnym m'h vchmshym 'ysh vhb'ym 'lynv mnhgvym 'shrsbybtynv 'lshlchny
verses.translation: Moreover there were at my table of the Jews and the rulers a hundred and fifty men, beside those that came unto us from among the nations that were round about us.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲשֶׁר֩ הָיָ֨ה נַעֲשֶׂ֜ה לְי֣וֹם אֶחָ֗ד שׁ֣וֹר אֶחָ֞ד צֹ֠אן שֵׁשׁ־בְּרֻר֤וֹת וְצִפֳּרִים֙ נַֽעֲשׂוּ־לִ֔י וּבֵ֨ין עֲשֶׂ֧רֶת יָמִ֛ים בְּכׇל־יַ֖יִן לְהַרְבֵּ֑ה וְעִם־זֶ֗ה לֶ֤חֶם הַפֶּחָה֙ לֹ֣א בִקַּ֔שְׁתִּי כִּֽי־כָֽבְדָ֥ה הָעֲבֹדָ֖ה עַל־הָעָ֥ם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: v'shr hyh n'shh lyvm 'chd shvr 'chd ts'n shshbrrvt vtsprym n'shvly vbyn 'shrt ymym bkhlyyn lhrbh v'mzh lchm hpchh l' bqshty khykhbdh h'bdh 'lh'm hzh
verses.translation: Now that which was prepared for one day was one ox and six choice sheep, also fowls were prepared for me; and once in ten days store of all sorts of wine; yet for all this I demanded not the bread of the governor, because the service was heavy upon this people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זׇכְרָה־לִּ֥י אֱלֹהַ֖י לְטוֹבָ֑ה כֹּ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־עָשִׂ֖יתִי עַל־הָעָ֥ם הַזֶּֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: zkhrhly 'lhy ltvbh khl 'shr'shyty 'lh'm hzh {p}
verses.translation: Remember unto me, O my God, for good, all that I have done for this people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י כַאֲשֶׁ֣ר נִשְׁמַ֣ע לְסַנְבַלַּ֣ט וְ֠טוֹבִיָּ֠ה וּלְגֶ֨שֶׁם הָֽעַרְבִ֜י וּלְיֶ֣תֶר אֹֽיְבֵ֗ינוּ כִּ֤י בָנִ֙יתִי֙ אֶת־הַ֣חוֹמָ֔ה וְלֹא־נ֥וֹתַר בָּ֖הּ פָּ֑רֶץ גַּ֚ם עַד־הָעֵ֣ת הַהִ֔יא דְּלָת֖וֹת לֹא־הֶעֱמַ֥דְתִּי בַשְּׁעָרִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyhy kh'shr nshm' lsnblt vtvbyh vlgshm h'rby vlytr 'ybynv khy bnyty 'thchvmh vl'nvtr bh prts gm 'dh't hhy' dltvt l'h'mdty bsh'rym
verses.translation: Now it came to pass, when it was reported to Sanballat and Tobiah, and to Geshem the Arabian, and unto the rest of our enemies, that I had builded the wall, and that there was no breach left therein—though even unto that time I had not set up the doors in the gates—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֨ח סַנְבַלַּ֤ט וְגֶ֙שֶׁם֙ אֵלַ֣י לֵאמֹ֔ר לְכָ֞ה וְנִֽוָּעֲדָ֥ה יַחְדָּ֛ו בַּכְּפִירִ֖ים בְּבִקְעַ֣ת אוֹנ֑וֹ וְהֵ֙מָּה֙ חֹֽשְׁבִ֔ים לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת לִ֖י רָעָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyshlch snblt vgshm 'ly l'mr lkhh vnv'dh ychdv bkhpyrym bbq't 'vnv vhmh chshbym l'shvt ly r'h
verses.translation: that Sanballat and Geshem sent unto me, saying: ‘Come, let us meet together in one of the villages in the plain of Ono.’ But they thought to do me mischief.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֶשְׁלְחָ֨ה עֲלֵיהֶ֤ם מַלְאָכִים֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר מְלָאכָ֤ה גְדוֹלָה֙ אֲנִ֣י עֹשֶׂ֔ה וְלֹ֥א אוּכַ֖ל לָרֶ֑דֶת לָ֣מָּה תִשְׁבַּ֤ת הַמְּלָאכָה֙ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר אַרְפֶּ֔הָ וְיָרַדְתִּ֖י אֲלֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v'shlchh 'lyhm ml'khym l'mr ml'khh gdvlh 'ny 'shh vl' 'vkhl lrdt lmh tshbt hml'khh kh'shr 'rph vyrdty 'lykhm
verses.translation: And I sent messengers unto them, saying: ‘I am doing a great work, so that I cannot come down; why should the work cease, whilst I leave it, and come down to you?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלְח֥וּ אֵלַ֛י כַּדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּ֖ה אַרְבַּ֣ע פְּעָמִ֑ים וָאָשִׁ֥יב אוֹתָ֖ם כַּדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyshlchv 'ly khdbr hzh 'rb' p'mym v'shyb 'vtm khdbr hzh {p}
verses.translation: And they sent unto me four times after this sort; and I answered them after the same manner.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַח֩ אֵלַ֨י סַנְבַלַּ֜ט כַּדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּ֛ה פַּ֥עַם חֲמִישִׁ֖ית אֶֽת־נַעֲר֑וֹ וְאִגֶּ֥רֶת פְּתוּחָ֖ה בְּיָדֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyshlch 'ly snblt khdbr hzh p'm chmyshyt 'tn'rv v'grt ptvchh bydv
verses.translation: Then sent Sanballat his servant unto me in like manner the fifth time with an open letter in his hand;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כָּת֣וּב בָּ֗הּ בַּגּוֹיִ֤ם נִשְׁמָע֙ וְגַשְׁמ֣וּ אֹמֵ֔ר אַתָּ֤ה וְהַיְּהוּדִים֙ חֹשְׁבִ֣ים לִמְר֔וֹד עַל־כֵּ֛ן אַתָּ֥ה בוֹנֶ֖ה הַחוֹמָ֑ה וְאַתָּ֗ה הֹוֶ֤ה לָהֶם֙ לְמֶ֔לֶךְ כַּדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.translit: khtvb bh bgvym nshm' vgshmv 'mr 'th vhyhvdym chshbym lmrvd 'lkhn 'th bvnh hchvmh v'th hvh lhm lmlkh khdbrym h'lh
verses.translation: wherein was written: ‘It is reported among the nations, and Geshem saith it, that thou and the Jews think to rebel; for which cause thou buildest the wall; and thou wouldest be their king, even according to these words.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגַם־נְבִיאִ֡ים הֶעֱמַ֣דְתָּ לִקְרֹא֩ עָלֶ֨יךָ בִֽירוּשָׁלַ֜͏ִם לֵאמֹ֗ר מֶ֚לֶךְ בִּֽיהוּדָ֔ה וְעַתָּה֙ יִשָּׁמַ֣ע לַמֶּ֔לֶךְ כַּדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה וְעַתָּ֣ה לְכָ֔ה וְנִֽוָּעֲצָ֖ה יַחְדָּֽו׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vgmnby'ym h'mdt lqr' 'lykh byrvshl͏m l'mr mlkh byhvdh v'th yshm' lmlkh khdbrym h'lh v'th lkhh vnv'tsh ychdv {p}
verses.translation: And thou hast also appointed prophets to proclaim of thee at Jerusalem, saying: There is a king in Judah; and now shall it be reported to the king according to these words. Come now therefore, and let us take counsel together.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֶשְׁלְחָ֤ה אֵלָיו֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לֹ֤א נִֽהְיָה֙ כַּדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֖ר אַתָּ֣ה אוֹמֵ֑ר כִּ֥י מִֽלִּבְּךָ֖ אַתָּ֥ה בוֹדָֽאם׃
verses.translit: v'shlchh 'lyv l'mr l' nhyh khdbrym h'lh 'shr 'th 'vmr khy mlbkh 'th bvd'm
verses.translation: Then I sent unto him, saying: ‘There are no such things done as thou sayest, but thou feignest them out of thine own heart.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֻלָּ֗ם מְיָֽרְאִ֤ים אוֹתָ֙נוּ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר יִרְפּ֧וּ יְדֵיהֶ֛ם מִן־הַמְּלָאכָ֖ה וְלֹ֣א תֵעָשֶׂ֑ה וְעַתָּ֖ה חַזֵּ֥ק אֶת־יָדָֽי׃
verses.translit: khy khlm myr'ym 'vtnv l'mr yrpv ydyhm mnhml'khh vl' t'shh v'th chzq 'tydy
verses.translation: For they all would have us afraid, saying: ‘Their hands shall be weakened from the work, that it be not done.’ But now, strengthen Thou my hands.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲנִי־בָ֗אתִי בֵּ֣ית שְֽׁמַֽעְיָ֧ה בֶן־דְּלָיָ֛ה בֶּן־מְהֵֽיטַבְאֵ֖ל וְה֣וּא עָצ֑וּר וַיֹּ֡אמֶר נִוָּעֵד֩ אֶל־בֵּ֨ית הָאֱלֹהִ֜ים אֶל־תּ֣וֹךְ הַֽהֵיכָ֗ל וְנִסְגְּרָה֙ דַּלְת֣וֹת הַהֵיכָ֔ל כִּ֚י בָּאִ֣ים לְהׇרְגֶ֔ךָ וְלַ֖יְלָה בָּאִ֥ים לְהׇרְגֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: v'nyb'ty byt shm'yh bndlyh bnmhytb'l vhv' 'tsvr vy'mr nv'd 'lbyt h'lhym 'ltvkh hhykhl vnsgrh dltvt hhykhl khy b'ym lhrgkh vlylh b'ym lhrgkh
verses.translation: And as for me, I went unto the house of Shemaiah the son of Delaiah the son of Mehetabel, who was shut up; and he said: ‘Let us meet together in the house of God, within the temple, and let us shut the doors of the temple; for they will come to slay thee; yea, in the night will they come to slay thee.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֹמְרָ֗ה הַאִ֤ישׁ כָּמ֙וֹנִי֙ יִבְרָ֔ח וּמִ֥י כָמ֛וֹנִי אֲשֶׁר־יָבֹ֥א אֶל־הַהֵיכָ֖ל וָחָ֑י לֹ֖א אָבֽוֹא׃
verses.translit: v'mrh h'ysh khmvny ybrch vmy khmvny 'shryb' 'lhhykhl vchy l' 'bv'
verses.translation: And I said: ‘Should such a man as I flee? and who is there, that, being such as I, could go into the temple and live? I will not go in.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאַכִּ֕ירָה וְהִנֵּ֥ה לֹֽא־אֱלֹהִ֖ים שְׁלָח֑וֹ כִּ֤י הַנְּבוּאָה֙ דִּבֶּ֣ר עָלַ֔י וְטוֹבִיָּ֥ה וְסַנְבַלַּ֖ט שְׂכָרֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'khyrh vhnh l''lhym shlchv khy hnbv'h dbr 'ly vtvbyh vsnblt shkhrv
verses.translation: And I discerned, and, lo, God had not sent him; for he pronounced this prophecy against me, whereas Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְמַ֤עַן שָׂכוּר֙ ה֔וּא לְמַֽעַן־אִירָ֥א וְאֶֽעֱשֶׂה־כֵּ֖ן וְחָטָ֑אתִי וְהָיָ֤ה לָהֶם֙ לְשֵׁ֣ם רָ֔ע לְמַ֖עַן יְחָֽרְפֽוּנִי׃ {פ}
verses.translit: lm'n shkhvr hv' lm'n'yr' v''shhkhn vcht'ty vhyh lhm lshm r' lm'n ychrpvny {p}
verses.translation: For this cause was he hired, that I should be afraid, and do so, and sin, and that they might have matter for an evil report, that they might taunt me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זׇכְרָ֧ה אֱלֹהַ֛י לְטוֹבִיָּ֥ה וּלְסַנְבַלַּ֖ט כְּמַעֲשָׂ֣יו אֵ֑לֶּה וְגַ֨ם לְנוֹעַדְיָ֤ה הַנְּבִיאָה֙ וּלְיֶ֣תֶר הַנְּבִיאִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָי֖וּ מְיָֽרְאִ֥ים אוֹתִֽי׃
verses.translit: zkhrh 'lhy ltvbyh vlsnblt khm'shyv 'lh vgm lnv'dyh hnby'h vlytr hnby'ym 'shr hyv myr'ym 'vty
verses.translation: Remember, O my God, Tobiah and Sanballat according to these their works, and also the prophetess Noadiah, and the rest of the prophets, that would have me put in fear.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּשְׁלַם֙ הַֽחוֹמָ֔ה בְּעֶשְׂרִ֥ים וַחֲמִשָּׁ֖ה לֶאֱל֑וּל לַחֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וּשְׁנַ֖יִם יֽוֹם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vtshlm hchvmh b'shrym vchmshh l'lvl lchmshym vshnym yvm {p}
verses.translation: So the wall was finished in the twenty and fifth day of the month Elul, in fifty and two days.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר שָֽׁמְעוּ֙ כׇּל־א֣וֹיְבֵ֔ינוּ וַיִּֽרְא֗וּ כׇּל־הַגּוֹיִם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר סְבִֽיבֹתֵ֔ינוּ וַיִּפְּל֥וּ מְאֹ֖ד בְּעֵינֵיהֶ֑ם וַיֵּ֣דְע֔וּ כִּ֚י מֵאֵ֣ת אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ נֶעֶשְׂתָ֖ה הַמְּלָאכָ֥ה הַזֹּֽאת׃
verses.translit: vyhy kh'shr shm'v khl'vybynv vyr'v khlhgvym 'shr sbybtynv vyplv m'd b'ynyhm vyd'v khy m't 'lhynv n'shth hml'khh hz't
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when all our enemies heard thereof, that all the nations that were about us feared, and were much cast down in their own eyes; for they perceived that this work was wrought of our God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּ֣ם  בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵ֗ם מַרְבִּ֞ים חֹרֵ֤י יְהוּדָה֙ אִגְּרֹ֣תֵיהֶ֔ם הוֹלְכ֖וֹת עַל־טוֹבִיָּ֑ה וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר לְטוֹבִיָּ֖ה בָּא֥וֹת אֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: gm  bymym hhm mrbym chry yhvdh 'grtyhm hvlkhvt 'ltvbyh v'shr ltvbyh b'vt 'lyhm
verses.translation: Moreover in those days the nobles of Judah sent many letters unto Tobiah, and the letters of Tobiah came unto them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־רַבִּ֣ים בִּֽיהוּדָ֗ה בַּעֲלֵ֤י שְׁבוּעָה֙ ל֔וֹ כִּי־חָתָ֥ן ה֖וּא לִשְׁכַנְיָ֣ה בֶן־אָרַ֑ח וִֽיהוֹחָנָ֣ן בְּנ֔וֹ לָקַ֕ח אֶת־בַּת־מְשֻׁלָּ֖ם בֶּ֥ן בֶּֽרֶכְיָֽה׃
verses.translit: khyrbym byhvdh b'ly shbv'h lv khychtn hv' lshkhnyh bn'rch vyhvchnn bnv lqch 'tbtmshlm bn brkhyh
verses.translation: For there were many in Judah sworn unto him, because he was the son-in-law of Shecaniah the son of Arah; and his son Jehohanan had taken the daughter of Meshullam the son of Berechiah to wife.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּ֣ם טוֹבֹתָ֗יו הָי֤וּ אֹמְרִים֙ לְפָנַ֔י וּדְבָרַ֕י הָי֥וּ מוֹצִיאִ֖ים ל֑וֹ אִגְּר֛וֹת שָׁלַ֥ח טוֹבִיָּ֖ה לְיָֽרְאֵֽנִי׃ {פ}
verses.translit: gm tvbtyv hyv 'mrym lpny vdbry hyv mvtsy'ym lv 'grvt shlch tvbyh lyr'ny {p}
verses.translation: Also they spoke of his good deeds before me, and reported my words to him. And Tobiah sent letters to put me in fear.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר נִבְנְתָה֙ הַחוֹמָ֔ה וָאַעֲמִ֖יד הַדְּלָת֑וֹת וַיִּפָּ֥קְד֛וּ הַשּׁוֹעֲרִ֥ים וְהַמְשֹׁרְרִ֖ים וְהַלְוִיִּֽם׃
verses.translit: vyhy kh'shr nbnth hchvmh v''myd hdltvt vypqdv hshv'rym vhmshrrym vhlvym
verses.translation: Now it came to pass, when the wall was built, and I had set up the doors, and the porters and the singers and the Levites were appointed,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֲצַוֶּ֞ה אֶת־חֲנָ֣נִי אָחִ֗י וְאֶת־חֲנַנְיָ֛ה שַׂ֥ר הַבִּירָ֖ה עַל־יְרוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם כִּי־הוּא֙ כְּאִ֣ישׁ אֱמֶ֔ת וְיָרֵ֥א אֶת־הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים מֵרַבִּֽים׃
verses.translit: v'tsvh 'tchnny 'chy v'tchnnyh shr hbyrh 'lyrvshl͏m khyhv' kh'ysh 'mt vyr' 'th'lhym mrbym
verses.translation: that I gave my brother Hanani, and Hananiah the governor of the castle, charge over Jerusalem; for he was a faithful man, and feared God above many.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (ויאמר) [וָאֹמַ֣ר] לָהֶ֗ם לֹ֣א יִפָּֽתְח֞וּ שַׁעֲרֵ֤י יְרוּשָׁלַ֙͏ִם֙ עַד־חֹ֣ם הַשֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ וְעַ֨ד הֵ֥ם עֹמְדִ֛ים יָגִ֥יפוּ הַדְּלָת֖וֹת וֶאֱחֹ֑זוּ וְהַעֲמֵ֗יד מִשְׁמְרוֹת֙ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם אִ֚ישׁ בְּמִשְׁמָר֔וֹ וְאִ֖ישׁ נֶ֥גֶד בֵּיתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: (vy'mr) [v'mr] lhm l' yptchv sh'ry yrvshl͏m 'dchm hshmsh v'd hm 'mdym ygypv hdltvt v'chzv vh'myd mshmrvt yshby yrvshl͏m 'ysh bmshmrv v'ysh ngd bytv
verses.translation: And I said unto them: ‘Let not the gates of Jerusalem be opened until the sun be hot; and while they stand on guard, let them shut the doors, and bar ye them; and let watches be appointed of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, every one in his watch, and every one to be over against his house.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָעִ֞יר רַחֲבַ֤ת יָדַ֙יִם֙ וּגְדֹלָ֔ה וְהָעָ֥ם מְעַ֖ט בְּתוֹכָ֑הּ וְאֵ֥ין בָּתִּ֖ים בְּנוּיִֽם׃
verses.translit: vh'yr rchbt ydym vgdlh vh'm m't btvkhh v'yn btym bnvym
verses.translation: Now the city was wide and large; but the people were few therein, and the houses were not builded.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֤ן אֱלֹהַי֙ אֶל־לִבִּ֔י וָאֶקְבְּצָ֞ה אֶת־הַחֹרִ֧ים וְאֶת־הַסְּגָנִ֛ים וְאֶת־הָעָ֖ם לְהִתְיַחֵ֑שׂ וָֽאֶמְצָ֗א סֵ֤פֶר הַיַּ֙חַשׂ֙ הָעוֹלִ֣ים בָּרִאשׁוֹנָ֔ה וָאֶמְצָ֖א כָּת֥וּב בּֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vytn 'lhy 'llby v'qbtsh 'thchrym v'thsgnym v'th'm lhtychsh v'mts' spr hychsh h'vlym br'shvnh v'mts' khtvb bv {p}
verses.translation: And my God put into my heart to gather together the nobles, and the rulers, and the people, that they might be reckoned by genealogy. And I found the book of the genealogy of them that came up at the first, and I found written therein:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה  בְּנֵ֣י הַמְּדִינָ֗ה הָעֹלִים֙ מִשְּׁבִ֣י הַגּוֹלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֶגְלָ֔ה נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֖ר מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֑ל וַיָּשׁ֧וּבוּ לִֽירוּשָׁלַ֛͏ִם וְלִיהוּדָ֖ה אִ֥ישׁ לְעִירֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'lh  bny hmdynh h'lym mshby hgvlh 'shr hglh nbvkhdntsr mlkh bbl vyshvbv lyrvshl͏m vlyhvdh 'ysh l'yrv
verses.translation: These are the children of the province, that went up out of the captivity of those that had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away, and that returned unto Jerusalem and to Judah, every one unto his city;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַבָּאִ֣ים עִם־זְרֻבָּבֶ֗ל יֵשׁ֡וּעַ נְחֶמְיָ֡ה עֲ֠זַרְיָ֠ה רַֽעַמְיָ֨ה נַחֲמָ֜נִי מׇרְדֳּכַ֥י בִּלְשָׁ֛ן מִסְפֶּ֥רֶת בִּגְוַ֖י נְח֣וּם בַּעֲנָ֑ה מִסְפַּ֕ר אַנְשֵׁ֖י עַ֥ם יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hb'ym 'mzrbbl yshv' nchmyh 'zryh r'myh nchmny mrdkhy blshn msprt bgvy nchvm b'nh mspr 'nshy 'm yshr'l {s}
verses.translation: who came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, Baanah. The number of the men of the people of Israel:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֔שׁ אַלְפַּ֕יִם מֵאָ֖ה וְשִׁבְעִ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny pr'sh 'lpym m'h vshb'ym vshnym {s}
verses.translation: The children of Parosh, two thousand a hundred and seventy and two.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י שְׁפַטְיָ֔ה שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שִׁבְעִ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny shptyh shlsh m'vt shb'ym vshnym {s}
verses.translation: The children of Shephatiah, three hundred seventy and two.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י אָרַ֔ח שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny 'rch shsh m'vt chmshym vshnym {s}
verses.translation: The children of Arah, six hundred fifty and two.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵֽי־פַחַ֥ת מוֹאָ֛ב לִבְנֵ֥י יֵשׁ֖וּעַ וְיוֹאָ֑ב אַלְפַּ֕יִם וּשְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵא֖וֹת שְׁמֹנָ֥ה עָשָֽׂר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bnypcht mv'b lbny yshv' vyv'b 'lpym vshmnh m'vt shmnh 'shr {s}
verses.translation: The children of Pahath-moab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab, two thousand and eight hundred and eighteen.
