verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י עֵילָ֔ם אֶ֕לֶף מָאתַ֖יִם חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny 'ylm 'lf m'tym chmshym v'rb'h {s}
verses.translation: The children of Elam, a thousand two hundred fifty and four.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י זַתּ֔וּא שְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵא֖וֹת אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וַחֲמִשָּֽׁה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny ztv' shmnh m'vt 'rb'ym vchmshh {s}
verses.translation: The children of Zattu, eight hundred forty and five.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י זַכָּ֔י שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וְשִׁשִּֽׁים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny zkhy shb' m'vt vshshym {s}
verses.translation: The children of Zaccai, seven hundred and threescore.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י בִנּ֔וּי שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny bnvy shsh m'vt 'rb'ym vshmnh {s}
verses.translation: The children of Binnui, six hundred forty and eight.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י בֵבָ֔י שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny bby shsh m'vt 'shrym vshmnh {s}
verses.translation: The children of Bebai, six hundred twenty and eight.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י עַזְגָּ֔ד אַלְפַּ֕יִם שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny 'zgd 'lpym shlsh m'vt 'shrym vshnym {s}
verses.translation: The children of Azgad, two thousand three hundred twenty and two.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵי֙ אֲדֹ֣נִיקָ֔ם שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שִׁשִּׁ֥ים וְשִׁבְעָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny 'dnyqm shsh m'vt shshym vshb'h {s}
verses.translation: The children of Adonikam, six hundred threescore and seven.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י בִגְוָ֔י אַלְפַּ֖יִם שִׁשִּׁ֥ים וְשִׁבְעָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny bgvy 'lpym shshym vshb'h {s}
verses.translation: The children of Bigvai, two thousand threescore and seven.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י עָדִ֔ין שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וַחֲמִשָּֽׁה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny 'dyn shsh m'vt chmshym vchmshh {s}
verses.translation: The children of Adin, six hundred fifty and five.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵֽי־אָטֵ֥ר לְחִזְקִיָּ֖ה תִּשְׁעִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny'tr lchzqyh tsh'ym vshmnh {s}
verses.translation: The children of Ater, of Hezekiah, ninety and eight.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י חָשֻׁ֔ם שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny chshm shlsh m'vt 'shrym vshmnh {s}
verses.translation: The children of Hashum, three hundred twenty and eight.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י בֵצָ֔י שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny btsy shlsh m'vt 'shrym v'rb'h {s}
verses.translation: The children of Bezai, three hundred twenty and four.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י חָרִ֔יף מֵאָ֖ה שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny chryf m'h shnym 'shr {s}
verses.translation: The children of Hariph, a hundred and twelve.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֥י גִבְע֖וֹן תִּשְׁעִ֥ים וַחֲמִשָּֽׁה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny gb'vn tsh'ym vchmshh {s}
verses.translation: The children of Gibeon, ninety and five.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַנְשֵׁ֤י בֵֽית־לֶ֙חֶם֙ וּנְטֹפָ֔ה מֵאָ֖ה שְׁמֹנִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'nshy bytlchm vntph m'h shmnym vshmnh {s}
verses.translation: The men of Beth-lehem and Netophah, a hundred fourscore and eight.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַנְשֵׁ֣י עֲנָת֔וֹת מֵאָ֖ה עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'nshy 'ntvt m'h 'shrym vshmnh {s}
verses.translation: The men of Anathoth, a hundred twenty and eight.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַנְשֵׁ֥י בֵית־עַזְמָ֖וֶת אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'nshy byt'zmvt 'rb'ym vshnym {s}
verses.translation: The men of Beth-azmaveth, forty and two.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַנְשֵׁ֨י קִרְיַ֤ת יְעָרִים֙ כְּפִירָ֣ה וּבְאֵר֔וֹת שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּשְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'nshy qryt y'rym khpyrh vb'rvt shb' m'vt 'rb'ym vshlshh {s}
verses.translation: The men of Kiriath-jearim, Chephirah, and Beeroth, seven hundred forty and three.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַנְשֵׁ֤י הָֽרָמָה֙ וָגָ֔בַע שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאֶחָֽד׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'nshy hrmh vgb' shsh m'vt 'shrym v'chd {s}
verses.translation: The men of Ramah and Geba, six hundred twenty and one.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַנְשֵׁ֣י מִכְמָ֔ס מֵאָ֖ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'nshy mkhms m'h v'shrym vshnym {s}
verses.translation: The men of Michmas, a hundred and twenty and two.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַנְשֵׁ֤י בֵֽית־אֵל֙ וְהָעָ֔י מֵאָ֖ה עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'nshy byt'l vh'y m'h 'shrym vshlshh {s}
verses.translation: The men of Beth-el and Ai, a hundred twenty and three.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַנְשֵׁ֥י נְב֛וֹ אַחֵ֖ר חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'nshy nbv 'chr chmshym vshnym {s}
verses.translation: The men of the other Nebo, fifty and two.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵי֙ עֵילָ֣ם אַחֵ֔ר אֶ֕לֶף מָאתַ֖יִם חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny 'ylm 'chr 'lf m'tym chmshym v'rb'h {s}
verses.translation: The children of the other Elam, a thousand two hundred fifty and four. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י חָרִ֔ם שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת וְעֶשְׂרִֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny chrm shlsh m'vt v'shrym {s}
verses.translation: The children of Harim, three hundred and twenty.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י יְרֵח֔וֹ שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וַחֲמִשָּֽׁה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny yrchv shlsh m'vt 'rb'ym vchmshh {s}
verses.translation: The children of Jericho, three hundred forty and five.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵי־לֹד֙ חָדִ֣יד וְאֹנ֔וֹ שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאֶחָֽד׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bnyld chdyd v'nv shb' m'vt v'shrym v'chd {s}
verses.translation: The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono, seven hundred twenty and one.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י סְנָאָ֔ה שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֔ים תְּשַׁ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וּשְׁלֹשִֽׁים׃ {פ}
verses.translit: bny sn'h shlsht 'lpym tsh' m'vt vshlshym {p}
verses.translation: The children of Senaah, three thousand nine hundred and thirty.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַֽכֹּהֲנִ֑ים בְּנֵ֤י יְדַֽעְיָה֙ לְבֵ֣ית יֵשׁ֔וּעַ תְּשַׁ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שִׁבְעִ֥ים וּשְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hkhhnym bny yd'yh lbyt yshv' tsh' m'vt shb'ym vshlshh {s}
verses.translation: The priests: The children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua, nine hundred seventy and three.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י אִמֵּ֔ר אֶ֖לֶף חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny 'mr 'lf chmshym vshnym {s}
verses.translation: The children of Immer, a thousand fifty and two.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י פַשְׁח֔וּר אֶ֕לֶף מָאתַ֖יִם אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וְשִׁבְעָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny pshchvr 'lf m'tym 'rb'ym vshb'h {s}
verses.translation: The children of Pashhur, a thousand two hundred forty and seven.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י חָרִ֔ם אֶ֖לֶף שִׁבְעָ֥ה עָשָֽׂר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny chrm 'lf shb'h 'shr {s}
verses.translation: The children of Harim, a thousand and seventeen.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַלְוִיִּ֑ם בְּנֵֽי־יֵשׁ֧וּעַ לְקַדְמִיאֵ֛ל לִבְנֵ֥י לְהוֹדְוָ֖ה שִׁבְעִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hlvym bnyyshv' lqdmy'l lbny lhvdvh shb'ym v'rb'h {s}
verses.translation: The Levites: the children of Jeshua, of Kadmiel, of the children of Hodeiah, seventy and four.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַֽמְשֹׁרְרִ֑ים בְּנֵ֣י אָסָ֔ף מֵאָ֖ה אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hmshrrym bny 'sf m'h 'rb'ym vshmnh {s}
verses.translation: The singers: the children of Asaph, a hundred forty and eight.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַשֹּֽׁעֲרִ֗ים בְּנֵֽי־שַׁלֻּ֤ם בְּנֵֽי־אָטֵר֙ בְּנֵֽי־טַלְמֹ֣ן בְּנֵֽי־עַקּ֔וּב בְּנֵ֥י חֲטִיטָ֖א בְּנֵ֣י שֹׁבָ֑י מֵאָ֖ה שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: hsh'rym bnyshlm bny'tr bnytlmn bny'qvb bny chtyt' bny shby m'h shlshym vshmnh {p}
verses.translation: The porters: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai, a hundred thirty and eight.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַנְּתִינִ֑ים בְּנֵי־צִחָ֥א בְנֵי־חֲשֻׂפָ֖א בְּנֵ֥י טַבָּעֽוֹת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hntynym bnytsch' bnychshp' bny tb'vt {s}
verses.translation: The Nethinim: the children of Ziha, the children of Hasupha, the children of Tabbaoth;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵי־קֵירֹ֥ס בְּנֵי־סִיעָ֖א בְּנֵ֥י פָדֽוֹן׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bnyqyrs bnysy'' bny pdvn {s}
verses.translation: the children of Keros, the children of Sia, the children of Padon;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵי־לְבָנָ֥ה בְנֵי־חֲגָבָ֖א בְּנֵ֥י שַׁלְמָֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bnylbnh bnychgb' bny shlmy {s}
verses.translation: the children of Lebanah, the children of Hagaba, the children of Salmai;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵי־חָנָ֥ן בְּנֵי־גִדֵּ֖ל בְּנֵי־גָֽחַר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bnychnn bnygdl bnygchr {s}
verses.translation: the children of Hanan, the children of Giddel, the children of Gahar;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵי־רְאָיָ֥ה בְנֵי־רְצִ֖ין בְּנֵ֥י נְקוֹדָֽא׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bnyr'yh bnyrtsyn bny nqvd' {s}
verses.translation: the children of Reaiah, the children of Rezin, the children of Nekoda;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵי־גַזָּ֥ם בְּנֵי־עֻזָּ֖א בְּנֵ֥י פָסֵֽחַ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bnygzm bny'z' bny psch {s}
verses.translation: the children of Gazzam, the children of Uzza, the children of Paseah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵי־בֵסַ֥י בְּנֵי־מְעוּנִ֖ים בְּנֵ֥י (נפושסים) [נְפִֽישְׁסִֽים]׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bnybsy bnym'vnym bny (npvshsym) [npyshsym] {s}
verses.translation: the children of Besai, the children of Meunim, the children of Nephishesim;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵי־בַקְבּ֥וּק בְּנֵֽי־חֲקוּפָ֖א בְּנֵ֥י חַרְחֽוּר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bnybqbvq bnychqvp' bny chrchvr {s}
verses.translation: the children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵי־בַצְלִ֥ית בְּנֵֽי־מְחִידָ֖א בְּנֵ֥י חַרְשָֽׁא׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bnybtslyt bnymchyd' bny chrsh' {s}
verses.translation: the children of Bazlith, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵי־בַרְק֥וֹס בְּֽנֵי־סִֽיסְרָ֖א בְּנֵי־תָֽמַח׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bnybrqvs bnysysr' bnytmch {s}
verses.translation: the children of Barkos, the children of Sisera, the children of Temah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֥י נְצִ֖יחַ בְּנֵ֥י חֲטִיפָֽא׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny ntsych bny chtyp' {s}
verses.translation: the children of Neziah, the children of Hatipha.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֖י עַבְדֵ֣י שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה בְּנֵי־סוֹטַ֥י בְּנֵי־סֹפֶ֖רֶת בְּנֵ֥י פְרִידָֽא׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny 'bdy shlmh bnysvty bnysprt bny pryd' {s}
verses.translation: The children of Solomon’s servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Sophereth, the children of Perida;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵי־יַעְלָ֥א בְנֵי־דַרְק֖וֹן בְּנֵ֥י גִדֵּֽל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bnyy'l' bnydrqvn bny gdl {s}
verses.translation: the children of Jala, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֧י שְׁפַטְיָ֣ה בְנֵֽי־חַטִּ֗יל {ס} בְּנֵ֛י פֹּכֶ֥רֶת הַצְּבָיִ֖ים בְּנֵ֥י אָמֽוֹן׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny shptyh bnychtyl {s} bny pkhrt htsbyym bny 'mvn {s}
verses.translation: the children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth-hazzebaim, the children of Amon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּ֨ל־הַנְּתִינִ֔ים וּבְנֵ֖י עַבְדֵ֣י שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת תִּשְׁעִ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khlhntynym vbny 'bdy shlmh shlsh m'vt tsh'ym vshnym {p}
verses.translation: All the Nethinim, and the children of Solomon’s servants, were three hundred ninety and two.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֗לֶּה הָֽעוֹלִים֙ מִתֵּ֥ל מֶ֙לַח֙ תֵּ֣ל חַרְשָׁ֔א כְּר֥וּב אַדּ֖וֹן וְאִמֵּ֑ר וְלֹ֣א יָכְל֗וּ לְהַגִּ֤יד בֵּית־אֲבֹתָם֙ וְזַרְעָ֔ם אִ֥ם מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הֵֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'lh h'vlym mtl mlch tl chrsh' khrvb 'dvn v'mr vl' ykhlv lhgyd byt'btm vzr'm 'm myshr'l hm {s}
verses.translation: And these were they that went up from Tel-melah, Tel-harsha, Cherub, Addon, and Immer; but they could not tell their fathers’houses, nor their seed, whether they were of Israel:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵי־דְלָיָ֥ה בְנֵֽי־טוֹבִיָּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י נְקוֹדָ֑א שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת וְאַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: bnydlyh bnytvbyh bny nqvd' shsh m'vt v'rb'ym vshnym {p}
verses.translation: the children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred forty and two.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִן־הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים בְּנֵ֥י חֳבַיָּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י הַקּ֑וֹץ בְּנֵ֣י בַרְזִלַּ֗י אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָ֠קַ֠ח מִבְּנ֞וֹת בַּרְזִלַּ֤י הַגִּלְעָדִי֙ אִשָּׁ֔ה וַיִּקָּרֵ֖א עַל־שְׁמָֽם׃
verses.translit: vmnhkhhnym bny chbyh bny hqvts bny brzly 'shr lqch mbnvt brzly hgl'dy 'shh vyqr' 'lshmm
verses.translation: And of the priests: the children of Habaiah, the children of Hakkoz, the children of Barzillai, who took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and was called after their name.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֗לֶּה בִּקְשׁ֧וּ כְתָבָ֛ם הַמִּתְיַחְשִׂ֖ים וְלֹ֣א נִמְצָ֑א וַיְגֹֽאֲל֖וּ מִן־הַכְּהֻנָּֽה׃
verses.translit: 'lh bqshv khtbm hmtychshym vl' nmts' vyg'lv mnhkhhnh
verses.translation: These sought their register, that is, the genealogy, but it was not found; therefore were they deemed polluted and put from the priesthood.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר הַתִּרְשָׁ֙תָא֙ לָהֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־יֹאכְל֖וּ מִקֹּ֣דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁ֑ים עַ֛ד עֲמֹ֥ד הַכֹּהֵ֖ן לְאוּרִ֥ים וְתֻמִּֽים׃
verses.translit: vy'mr htrsht' lhm 'shr l'y'khlv mqdsh hqdshym 'd 'md hkhhn l'vrym vtmym
verses.translation: And the Tirshatha said unto them, that they should not eat of the most holy things, till there stood up a priest with Urim and Thummim.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־הַקָּהָ֖ל כְּאֶחָ֑ד אַרְבַּ֣ע רִבּ֔וֹא אַלְפַּ֖יִם שְׁלֹשׁ־מֵא֥וֹת וְשִׁשִּֽׁים׃
verses.translit: khlhqhl kh'chd 'rb' rbv' 'lpym shlshm'vt vshshym
verses.translation: The whole congregation together was forty and two thousand three hundred and threescore,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִ֠לְּבַ֠ד עַבְדֵיהֶ֤ם וְאַמְהֹֽתֵיהֶם֙ אֵ֔לֶּה שִׁבְעַ֣ת אֲלָפִ֔ים שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים וְשִׁבְעָ֑ה וְלָהֶ֗ם מְשֹֽׁרְרִים֙ וּמְשֹׁ֣רְר֔וֹת מָאתַ֖יִם וְאַרְבָּעִ֥ים וַחֲמִשָּֽׁה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: mlbd 'bdyhm v'mhtyhm 'lh shb't 'lpym shlsh m'vt shlshym vshb'h vlhm mshrrym vmshrrvt m'tym v'rb'ym vchmshh {s}
verses.translation: beside their men-servants and their maid-servants, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty and seven; and they had two hundred forty and five singing men and singing women.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גְּמַלִּ֕ים אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים וַחֲמִשָּׁ֑ה חֲמֹרִ֕ים שֵׁ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֔ים שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וְעֶשְׂרִֽים׃
verses.translit: gmlym 'rb' m'vt shlshym vchmshh chmrym shsht 'lpym shb' m'vt v'shrym
verses.translation: Their camels, four hundred thirty and five; their asses, six thousand seven hundred and twenty.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִקְצָת֙ רָאשֵׁ֣י הָֽאָב֔וֹת נָתְנ֖וּ לַמְּלָאכָ֑ה הַתִּרְשָׁ֜תָא נָתַ֣ן לָאוֹצָ֗ר זָהָ֞ב דַּרְכְּמֹנִ֥ים אֶ֙לֶף֙ מִזְרָק֣וֹת חֲמִשִּׁ֔ים כׇּתְנוֹת֙ כֹּֽהֲנִ֔ים שְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vmqtst r'shy h'bvt ntnv lml'khh htrsht' ntn l'vtsr zhb drkhmnym 'lf mzrqvt chmshym khtnvt khhnym shlshym vchmsh m'vt
verses.translation: And some from among the heads of fathers’houses gave unto the work. The Tirshatha gave to the treasury a thousand darics of gold, fifty basins, five hundred and thirty priests’tunics.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמֵֽרָאשֵׁ֣י הָֽאָב֗וֹת נָֽתְנוּ֙ לְאוֹצַ֣ר הַמְּלָאכָ֔ה זָהָ֕ב דַּרְכְּמוֹנִ֖ים שְׁתֵּ֣י רִבּ֑וֹת וְכֶ֕סֶף מָנִ֖ים אַלְפַּ֥יִם וּמָאתָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vmr'shy h'bvt ntnv l'vtsr hml'khh zhb drkhmvnym shty rbvt vkhsf mnym 'lpym vm'tym
verses.translation: And some of the heads of fathers’houses gave into the treasury of the work twenty thousand darics of gold, and two thousand and two hundred pounds of silver.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתְנוּ֮ שְׁאֵרִ֣ית הָעָם֒ זָהָ֗ב דַּרְכְּמֹנִים֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י רִבּ֔וֹא וְכֶ֖סֶף מָנִ֣ים אַלְפָּ֑יִם וְכׇתְנֹ֥ת כֹּֽהֲנִ֖ים שִׁשִּׁ֥ים וְשִׁבְעָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'shr ntnv sh'ryt h'm zhb drkhmnym shty rbv' vkhsf mnym 'lpym vkhtnt khhnym shshym vshb'h
verses.translation: And that which the rest of the people gave was twenty thousand darics of gold, and two thousand pounds of silver, and threescore and seven priests’tunics.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּשְׁב֣וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֡ם וְהַשּׁוֹעֲרִים֩ וְהַמְשֹׁרְרִ֨ים וּמִן־הָעָ֧ם וְהַנְּתִינִ֛ים וְכׇל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּעָרֵיהֶ֑ם {ס} וַיִּגַּע֙ הַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י וּבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּעָרֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vyshbv hkhhnym vhlvym vhshv'rym vhmshrrym vmnh'm vhntynym vkhlyshr'l b'ryhm {s} vyg' hchdsh hshby'y vbny yshr'l b'ryhm
verses.translation: So the priests, and the Levites, and the porters, and the singers, and some of the people, and the Nethinim, and all Israel, dwelt in their cities. And when the seventh month was come, and the children of Israel were in their cities,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּאָסְפ֤וּ כׇל־הָעָם֙ כְּאִ֣ישׁ אֶחָ֔ד אֶל־הָ֣רְח֔וֹב אֲשֶׁ֖ר לִפְנֵ֣י שַֽׁעַר־הַמָּ֑יִם וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ לְעֶזְרָ֣א הַסֹּפֵ֔ר לְהָבִ֗יא אֶת־סֵ֙פֶר֙ תּוֹרַ֣ת מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vy'spv khlh'm kh'ysh 'chd 'lhrchvb 'shr lpny sh'rhmym vy'mrv l'zr' hspr lhby' 'tspr tvrt mshh 'shrtsvh yhvh 'tyshr'l
verses.translation: all the people gathered themselves together as one man into the broad place that was before the water gate; and they spoke unto Ezra the scribe to bring the book of the Law of Moses, which the LORD had commanded to Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבִ֣יא עֶזְרָ֣א הַ֠כֹּהֵ֠ן אֶֽת־הַתּוֹרָ֞ה לִפְנֵ֤י הַקָּהָל֙ מֵאִ֣ישׁ וְעַד־אִשָּׁ֔ה וְכֹ֖ל מֵבִ֣ין לִשְׁמֹ֑עַ בְּי֥וֹם אֶחָ֖ד לַחֹ֥דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִֽי׃
verses.translit: vyby' 'zr' hkhhn 'thtvrh lpny hqhl m'ysh v'd'shh vkhl mbyn lshm' byvm 'chd lchdsh hshby'y
verses.translation: And Ezra the priest brought the Law before the congregation, both men and women, and all that could hear with understanding, upon the first day of the seventh month.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָא־בוֹ֩ לִפְנֵ֨י הָרְח֜וֹב אֲשֶׁ֣ר  לִפְנֵ֣י שַֽׁעַר־הַמַּ֗יִם מִן־הָאוֹר֙ עַד־מַחֲצִ֣ית הַיּ֔וֹם נֶ֛גֶד הָאֲנָשִׁ֥ים וְהַנָּשִׁ֖ים וְהַמְּבִינִ֑ים וְאׇזְנֵ֥י כׇל־הָעָ֖ם אֶל־סֵ֥פֶר הַתּוֹרָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyqr'bv lpny hrchvb 'shr  lpny sh'rhmym mnh'vr 'dmchtsyt hyvm ngd h'nshym vhnshym vhmbynym v'zny khlh'm 'lspr htvrh
verses.translation: And he read therein before the broad place that was before the water gate from early morning until midday, in the presence of the men and the women, and of those that could understand; and the ears of all the people were attentive unto the book of the Law.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיַּעֲמֹ֞ד עֶזְרָ֣א הַסֹּפֵ֗ר עַֽל־מִגְדַּל־עֵץ֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשׂ֣וּ לַדָּבָר֒ וַיַּֽעֲמֹ֣ד אֶצְל֡וֹ מַתִּתְיָ֡ה וְשֶׁ֡מַע וַ֠עֲנָיָ֠ה וְאוּרִיָּ֧ה וְחִלְקִיָּ֛ה וּמַעֲשֵׂיָ֖ה עַל־יְמִינ֑וֹ וּמִשְּׂמֹאל֗וֹ פְּ֠דָיָ֠ה וּמִֽישָׁאֵ֧ל וּמַלְכִּיָּ֛ה וְחָשֻׁ֥ם וְחַשְׁבַּדָּ֖נָה זְכַרְיָ֥ה מְשֻׁלָּֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vy'md 'zr' hspr 'lmgdl'ts 'shr 'shv ldbr vy'md 'tslv mttyh vshm' v'nyh v'vryh vchlqyh vm'shyh 'lymynv vmshm'lv pdyh vmysh'l vmlkhyh vchshm vchshbdnh zkhryh mshlm {p}
verses.translation: And Ezra the scribe stood upon a pulpit of wood, which they had made for the purpose; and beside him stood Mattithiah, and Shema, and Anaiah, and Uriah, and Hilkiah, and Maaseiah, on his right hand; and on his left hand, Pedaiah, and Mishael, and Malchijah, and Hashum, and Hashbaddanah, Zechariah, and Meshullam.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּפְתַּ֨ח עֶזְרָ֤א הַסֵּ֙פֶר֙ לְעֵינֵ֣י כׇל־הָעָ֔ם כִּֽי־מֵעַ֥ל כׇּל־הָעָ֖ם הָיָ֑ה וּכְפִתְח֖וֹ עָֽמְד֥וּ כׇל־הָעָֽם׃
verses.translit: vyptch 'zr' hspr l'yny khlh'm khym'l khlh'm hyh vkhptchv 'mdv khlh'm
verses.translation: And Ezra opened the book in the sight of all the people—for he was above all the people—and when he opened it, all the people stood up.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְבָ֣רֶךְ עֶזְרָ֔א אֶת־יְהֹוָ֥ה הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים הַגָּד֑וֹל וַיַּֽעֲנ֨וּ כׇל־הָעָ֜ם אָמֵ֤ן ׀ אָמֵן֙ בְּמֹ֣עַל יְדֵיהֶ֔ם וַיִּקְּד֧וּ וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲו֛וּ לַיהֹוָ֖ה אַפַּ֥יִם אָֽרְצָה׃
verses.translit: vybrkh 'zr' 'tyhvh h'lhym hgdvl vy'nv khlh'm 'mn  'mn bm'l ydyhm vyqdv vyshtchvv lyhvh 'pym 'rtsh
verses.translation: And Ezra blessed the LORD, the great God. And all the people answered: ‘Amen, Amen’, with the lifting up of their hands; and they bowed their heads, and fell down before the LORD with their faces to the ground.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיֵשׁ֡וּעַ וּבָנִ֡י וְשֵׁרֵ֥בְיָ֣ה  יָמִ֡ין עַקּ֡וּב שַׁבְּתַ֣י ׀ הֽוֹדִיָּ֡ה מַעֲשֵׂיָ֡ה קְלִיטָ֣א עֲזַרְיָה֩ יוֹזָבָ֨ד חָנָ֤ן פְּלָאיָה֙ וְהַלְוִיִּ֔ם מְבִינִ֥ים אֶת־הָעָ֖ם לַתּוֹרָ֑ה וְהָעָ֖ם עַל־עׇמְדָֽם׃
verses.translit: vyshv' vbny vshrbyh  ymyn 'qvb shbty  hvdyh m'shyh qlyt' 'zryh yvzbd chnn pl'yh vhlvym mbynym 'th'm ltvrh vh'm 'l'mdm
verses.translation: Also Jeshua, and Bani, and Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodiah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah, even the Levites, caused the people to understand the Law; and the people stood in their place.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיִּקְרְא֥וּ בַסֵּ֛פֶר בְּתוֹרַ֥ת הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים מְפֹרָ֑שׁ וְשׂ֣וֹם שֶׂ֔כֶל וַיָּבִ֖ינוּ בַּמִּקְרָֽא׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyqr'v bspr btvrt h'lhym mprsh vshvm shkhl vybynv bmqr' {p}
verses.translation: And they read in the book, in the Law of God, distinctly; and they gave the sense, and caused them to understand the reading.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר נְחֶמְיָ֣ה ה֣וּא הַתִּרְשָׁ֡תָא וְעֶזְרָ֣א הַכֹּהֵ֣ן ׀ הַסֹּפֵ֡ר וְהַלְוִיִּם֩ הַמְּבִינִ֨ים אֶת־הָעָ֜ם לְכׇל־הָעָ֗ם הַיּ֤וֹם קָדֹֽשׁ־הוּא֙ לַיהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֔ם אַל־תִּֽתְאַבְּל֖וּ וְאַל־תִּבְכּ֑וּ כִּ֤י בוֹכִים֙ כׇּל־הָעָ֔ם כְּשׇׁמְעָ֖ם אֶת־דִּבְרֵ֥י הַתּוֹרָֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr nchmyh hv' htrsht' v'zr' hkhhn  hspr vhlvym hmbynym 'th'm lkhlh'm hyvm qdshhv' lyhvh 'lhykhm 'ltt'blv v'ltbkhv khy bvkhym khlh'm khshm'm 'tdbry htvrh
verses.translation: And Nehemiah, who was the Tirshatha, and Ezra the priest the scribe, and the Levites that taught the people, said unto all the people: ‘This day is holy unto the LORD your God; mourn not, nor weep.’ For all the people wept, when they heard the words of the Law.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לָהֶ֡ם לְכוּ֩ אִכְל֨וּ מַשְׁמַנִּ֜ים וּשְׁת֣וּ מַֽמְתַקִּ֗ים וְשִׁלְח֤וּ מָנוֹת֙ לְאֵ֣ין נָכ֣וֹן ל֔וֹ כִּֽי־קָד֥וֹשׁ הַיּ֖וֹם לַאֲדֹנֵ֑ינוּ וְאַל־תֵּ֣עָצֵ֔בוּ כִּֽי־חֶדְוַ֥ת יְהֹוָ֖ה הִ֥יא מָֽעֻזְּכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr lhm lkhv 'khlv mshmnym vshtv mmtqym vshlchv mnvt l'yn nkhvn lv khyqdvsh hyvm l'dnynv v'lt'tsbv khychdvt yhvh hy' m'zkhm
verses.translation: Then he said unto them: ‘Go your way, eat the fat, and drink the sweet, and send portions unto him for whom nothing is prepared; for this day is holy unto our Lord; neither be ye grieved; for the joy of the LORD is your strength.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַלְוִיִּ֞ם מַחְשִׁ֤ים לְכׇל־הָעָם֙ לֵאמֹ֣ר הַ֔סּוּ כִּ֥י הַיּ֖וֹם קָדֹ֑שׁ וְאַל־תֵּעָצֵֽבוּ׃
verses.translit: vhlvym mchshym lkhlh'm l'mr hsv khy hyvm qdsh v'lt'tsbv
verses.translation: So the Levites stilled all the people, saying: ‘Hold your peace, for the day is holy; neither be ye grieved.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּלְכ֨וּ כׇל־הָעָ֜ם לֶאֱכֹ֤ל וְלִשְׁתּוֹת֙ וּלְשַׁלַּ֣ח מָנ֔וֹת וְלַעֲשׂ֖וֹת שִׂמְחָ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֑ה כִּ֤י הֵבִ֙ינוּ֙ בַּדְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הוֹדִ֖יעוּ לָהֶֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vylkhv khlh'm l'khl vlshtvt vlshlch mnvt vl'shvt shmchh gdvlh khy hbynv bdbrym 'shr hvdy'v lhm {p}
verses.translation: And all the people went their way to eat, and to drink, and to send portions, and to make great mirth, because they had understood the words that were declared unto them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבַיּ֣וֹם הַשֵּׁנִ֡י נֶאֶסְפוּ֩ רָאשֵׁ֨י הָאָב֜וֹת לְכׇל־הָעָ֗ם הַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ וְהַלְוִיִּ֔ם אֶל־עֶזְרָ֖א הַסֹּפֵ֑ר וּלְהַשְׂכִּ֖יל אֶל־דִּבְרֵ֥י הַתּוֹרָֽה׃
verses.translit: vbyvm hshny n'spv r'shy h'bvt lkhlh'm hkhhnym vhlvym 'l'zr' hspr vlhshkhyl 'ldbry htvrh
verses.translation: And on the second day were gathered together the heads of fathers’houses of all the people, the priests, and the Levites, unto Ezra the scribe, even to give attention to the words of the Law.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיִּמְצְא֖וּ כָּת֣וּב בַּתּוֹרָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֤ה יְהֹוָה֙ בְּיַד־מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֲשֶׁר֩ יֵשְׁב֨וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל בַּסֻּכּ֛וֹת בֶּחָ֖ג בַּחֹ֥דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִֽי׃
verses.translit: vymts'v khtvb btvrh 'shr tsvh yhvh bydmshh 'shr yshbv bnyyshr'l bskhvt bchg bchdsh hshby'y
verses.translation: And they found written in the Law, how that the LORD had commanded by Moses, that the children of Israel should dwell in booths in the feast of the seventh month;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר יַשְׁמִ֗יעוּ וְיַעֲבִ֨ירוּ ק֥וֹל בְּכׇל־עָרֵיהֶם֮ וּבִירוּשָׁלַ֣͏ִם לֵאמֹר֒ צְא֣וּ הָהָ֗ר וְהָבִ֙יאוּ֙ עֲלֵי־זַ֙יִת֙ וַעֲלֵי־עֵ֣ץ שֶׁ֔מֶן וַעֲלֵ֤י הֲדַס֙ וַעֲלֵ֣י תְמָרִ֔ים וַעֲלֵ֖י עֵ֣ץ עָבֹ֑ת לַעֲשֹׂ֥ת סֻכֹּ֖ת כַּכָּתֽוּב׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'shr yshmy'v vy'byrv qvl bkhl'ryhm vbyrvshl͏m l'mr ts'v hhr vhby'v 'lyzyt v'ly'ts shmn v'ly hds v'ly tmrym v'ly 'ts 'bt l'sht skht khkhtvb {s}
verses.translation: and that they should publish and proclaim in all their cities, and in Jerusalem, saying: ‘Go forth unto the mount, and fetch olive branches, and branches of wild olive, and myrtle branches, and palm branches, and branches of thick trees, to make booths, as it is written.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּצְא֣וּ הָעָם֮ וַיָּבִ֒יאוּ֒ וַיַּעֲשׂוּ֩ לָהֶ֨ם סֻכּ֜וֹת אִ֤ישׁ עַל־גַּגּוֹ֙ וּבְחַצְרֹ֣תֵיהֶ֔ם וּבְחַצְר֖וֹת בֵּ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וּבִרְחוֹב֙ שַׁ֣עַר הַמַּ֔יִם וּבִרְח֖וֹב שַׁ֥עַר אֶפְרָֽיִם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyts'v h'm vyby'v vy'shv lhm skhvt 'ysh 'lggv vbchtsrtyhm vbchtsrvt byt h'lhym vbrchvb sh'r hmym vbrchvb sh'r 'prym {s}
verses.translation: So the people went forth, and brought them, and made themselves booths, every one upon the roof of his house, and in their courts, and in the courts of the house of God, and in the broad place of the water gate, and in the broad place of the gate of Ephraim.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּֽעֲשׂ֣וּ כׇֽל־הַ֠קָּהָ֠ל הַשָּׁבִ֨ים מִן־הַשְּׁבִ֥י ׀ סֻכּוֹת֮ וַיֵּשְׁב֣וּ בַסֻּכּוֹת֒ כִּ֣י לֹֽא־עָשׂ֡וּ מִימֵי֩ יֵשׁ֨וּעַ בִּן־נ֥וּן כֵּן֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עַ֖ד הַיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא וַתְּהִ֥י שִׂמְחָ֖ה גְּדוֹלָ֥ה מְאֹֽד׃
verses.translit: vy'shv khlhqhl hshbym mnhshby  skhvt vyshbv bskhvt khy l''shv mymy yshv' bnnvn khn bny yshr'l 'd hyvm hhv' vthy shmchh gdvlh m'd
verses.translation: And all the congregation of them that were come back out of the captivity made booths, and dwelt in the booths; for since the days of Joshua the son of Nun unto that day had not the children of Israel done so. And there was very great gladness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֠יִּקְרָ֠א בְּסֵ֨פֶר תּוֹרַ֤ת הָאֱלֹהִים֙ י֣וֹם ׀ בְּי֔וֹם מִן־הַיּוֹם֙ הָֽרִאשׁ֔וֹן עַ֖ד הַיּ֣וֹם הָאַחֲר֑וֹן וַיַּֽעֲשׂוּ־חָג֙ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים וּבַיּ֧וֹם הַשְּׁמִינִ֛י עֲצֶ֖רֶת כַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyqr' bspr tvrt h'lhym yvm  byvm mnhyvm hr'shvn 'd hyvm h'chrvn vy'shvchg shb't ymym vbyvm hshmyny 'tsrt khmshpt {p}
verses.translation: Also day by day, from the first day unto the last day, he read in the book of the Law of God. And they kept the feast seven days;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְיוֹם֩ עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֜ה לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַזֶּ֗ה נֶאֶסְפ֤וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּצ֣וֹם וּבְשַׂקִּ֔ים וַאֲדָמָ֖ה עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vbyvm 'shrym v'rb'h lchdsh hzh n'spv bnyyshr'l btsvm vbshqym v'dmh 'lyhm
verses.translation: Now in the twenty and fourth day of this month the children of Israel were assembled with fasting, and with sackcloth, and earth upon them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּבָּֽדְלוּ֙ זֶ֣רַע יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִכֹּ֖ל בְּנֵ֣י נֵכָ֑ר וַיַּעַמְד֗וּ וַיִּתְוַדּוּ֙ עַל־חַטֹּ֣אתֵיהֶ֔ם וַעֲוֺנ֖וֹת אֲבֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vybdlv zr' yshr'l mkhl bny nkhr vy'mdv vytvdv 'lcht'tyhm v'vnvt 'btyhm
verses.translation: And the seed of Israel separated themselves from all foreigners, and stood and confessed their sins, and the iniquities of their fathers.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּק֙וּמוּ֙ עַל־עׇמְדָ֔ם וַֽיִּקְרְא֗וּ בְּסֵ֨פֶר תּוֹרַ֧ת יְהֹוָ֛ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֖ם רְבִעִ֣ית הַיּ֑וֹם וּרְבִעִית֙ מִתְוַדִּ֣ים וּמִֽשְׁתַּחֲוִ֔ים לַיהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyqvmv 'l'mdm vyqr'v bspr tvrt yhvh 'lhyhm rb'yt hyvm vrb'yt mtvdym vmshtchvym lyhvh 'lhyhm {p}
verses.translation: And they stood up in their place, and read in the book of the Law of the LORD their God a fourth part of the day; and another fourth part they confessed, and prostrated themselves before the LORD their God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֜קׇם עַֽל־מַֽעֲלֵ֣ה הַלְוִיִּ֗ם יֵשׁ֨וּעַ וּבָנִ֜י קַדְמִיאֵ֧ל שְׁבַנְיָ֛ה בֻּנִּ֥י שֵׁרֵבְיָ֖ה בָּנִ֣י כְנָ֑נִי וַֽיִּזְעֲקוּ֙ בְּק֣וֹל גָּד֔וֹל אֶל־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vyqm 'lm'lh hlvym yshv' vbny qdmy'l shbnyh bny shrbyh bny khnny vyz'qv bqvl gdvl 'lyhvh 'lhyhm
verses.translation: Then stood up upon the platform of the Levites, Jeshua, and Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, and Chenani, and cried with a loud voice unto the LORD their God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ הַלְוִיִּ֡ם יֵשׁ֣וּעַ וְ֠קַדְמִיאֵ֠ל בָּנִ֨י חֲשַׁבְנְיָ֜ה שֵׁרֵֽבְיָ֤ה הֽוֹדִיָּה֙ שְׁבַנְיָ֣ה פְתַֽחְיָ֔ה ק֗וּמוּ בָּרְכוּ֙ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם מִן־הָעוֹלָ֖ם עַד־הָעוֹלָ֑ם וִיבָֽרְכוּ֙ שֵׁ֣ם כְּבֹדֶ֔ךָ וּמְרוֹמַ֥ם עַל־כׇּל־בְּרָכָ֖ה וּתְהִלָּֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv hlvym yshv' vqdmy'l bny chshbnyh shrbyh hvdyh shbnyh ptchyh qvmv brkhv 'tyhvh 'lhykhm mnh'vlm 'dh'vlm vybrkhv shm khbdkh vmrvmm 'lkhlbrkhh vthlh
verses.translation: Then the Levites, Jeshua, and Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah, and Pethahiah, said: ‘Stand up and bless the LORD your God from everlasting to everlasting; and let them say: Blessed be Thy glorious Name, that is exalted above all blessing and praise.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַתָּה־ה֣וּא יְהֹוָה֮ לְבַדֶּ֒ךָ֒ (את) [אַתָּ֣ה] עָשִׂ֡יתָ אֶֽת־הַשָּׁמַ֩יִם֩ שְׁמֵ֨י הַשָּׁמַ֜יִם וְכׇל־צְבָאָ֗ם הָאָ֜רֶץ וְכׇל־אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָלֶ֙יהָ֙ הַיַּמִּים֙ וְכׇל־אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּהֶ֔ם וְאַתָּ֖ה מְחַיֶּ֣ה אֶת־כֻּלָּ֑ם וּצְבָ֥א הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם לְךָ֥ מִשְׁתַּחֲוִֽים׃
verses.translit: 'thhv' yhvh lbdkh ('t) ['th] 'shyt 'thshmym shmy hshmym vkhltsb'm h'rts vkhl'shr 'lyh hymym vkhl'shr bhm v'th mchyh 'tkhlm vtsb' hshmym lkh mshtchvym
verses.translation: Thou art the LORD, even Thou alone; Thou hast made heaven, the heaven of heavens, with all their host, the earth and all things that are thereon, the seas and all that is in them, and Thou preservest them all; and the host of heaven worshippeth Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַתָּה־הוּא֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר בָּחַ֙רְתָּ֙ בְּאַבְרָ֔ם וְהוֹצֵאת֖וֹ מֵא֣וּר כַּשְׂדִּ֑ים וְשַׂ֥מְתָּ שְּׁמ֖וֹ אַבְרָהָֽם׃
verses.translit: 'thhv' yhvh h'lhym 'shr bchrt b'brm vhvts'tv m'vr khshdym vshmt shmv 'brhm
verses.translation: Thou art the LORD the God, who didst choose Abram, and broughtest him forth out of Ur of the Chaldees, and gavest him the name of Abraham;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמָצָ֣אתָ אֶת־לְבָבוֹ֮ נֶאֱמָ֣ן לְפָנֶ֒יךָ֒ וְכָר֨וֹת עִמּ֜וֹ הַבְּרִ֗ית לָתֵ֡ת אֶת־אֶ֩רֶץ֩ הַכְּנַעֲנִ֨י הַחִתִּ֜י הָאֱמֹרִ֧י וְהַפְּרִזִּ֛י וְהַיְבוּסִ֥י וְהַגִּרְגָּשִׁ֖י לָתֵ֣ת לְזַרְע֑וֹ וַתָּ֙קֶם֙ אֶת־דְּבָרֶ֔יךָ כִּ֥י צַדִּ֖יק אָֽתָּה׃
verses.translit: vmts't 'tlbbv n'mn lpnykh vkhrvt 'mv hbryt ltt 't'rts hkhn'ny hchty h'mry vhprzy vhybvsy vhgrgshy ltt lzr'v vtqm 'tdbrykh khy tsdyq 'th
verses.translation: and foundest his heart faithful before Thee, and madest a covenant with him to give the land of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Amorite, and the Perizzite, and the Jebusite, and the Girgashite, even to give it unto his seed, and hast performed Thy words; for Thou art righteous;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֵּ֛רֶא אֶת־עֳנִ֥י אֲבֹתֵ֖ינוּ בְּמִצְרָ֑יִם וְאֶת־זַעֲקָתָ֥ם שָׁמַ֖עְתָּ עַל־יַם־סֽוּף׃
verses.translit: vtr' 't'ny 'btynv bmtsrym v'tz'qtm shm't 'lymsvf
verses.translation: And Thou sawest the affliction of our fathers in Egypt, and heardest their cry by the Red Sea;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֠תִּתֵּ֠ן אֹתֹ֨ת וּמֹֽפְתִ֜ים בְּפַרְעֹ֤ה וּבְכׇל־עֲבָדָיו֙ וּבְכׇל־עַ֣ם אַרְצ֔וֹ כִּ֣י יָדַ֔עְתָּ כִּ֥י הֵזִ֖ידוּ עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם וַתַּֽעַשׂ־לְךָ֥ שֵׁ֖ם כְּהַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: vttn 'tt vmptym bpr'h vbkhl'bdyv vbkhl'm 'rtsv khy yd't khy hzydv 'lyhm vt'shlkh shm khhyvm hzh
verses.translation: and didst show signs and wonders upon Pharaoh, and on all his servants, and on all the people of his land; for Thou knewest that they dealt proudly against them; and didst get Thee a name, as it is this day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַיָּם֙ בָּקַ֣עְתָּ לִפְנֵיהֶ֔ם וַיַּֽעַבְר֥וּ בְתוֹךְ־הַיָּ֖ם בַּיַּבָּשָׁ֑ה וְֽאֶת־רֹ֨דְפֵיהֶ֜ם הִשְׁלַ֧כְתָּ בִמְצוֹלֹ֛ת כְּמוֹ־אֶ֖בֶן בְּמַ֥יִם עַזִּֽים׃
verses.translit: vhym bq't lpnyhm vy'brv btvkhhym bybshh v'trdpyhm hshlkht bmtsvlt khmv'bn bmym 'zym
verses.translation: And Thou didst divide the sea before them, so that they went through the midst of the sea on the dry land; and their pursuers Thou didst cast into the depths, as a stone into the mighty waters.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְעַמּ֣וּד עָנָ֔ן הִנְחִיתָ֖ם יוֹמָ֑ם וּבְעַמּ֥וּד אֵשׁ֙ לַ֔יְלָה לְהָאִ֣יר לָהֶ֔ם אֶת־הַדֶּ֖רֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֵֽלְכוּ־בָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vb'mvd 'nn hnchytm yvmm vb'mvd 'sh lylh lh'yr lhm 'thdrkh 'shr ylkhvbh
verses.translation: Moreover in a pillar of cloud Thou didst lead them by day; and in a pillar of fire by night, to give them light in the way wherein they should go.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַ֤ל הַר־סִינַי֙ יָרַ֔דְתָּ וְדַבֵּ֥ר עִמָּהֶ֖ם מִשָּׁמָ֑יִם וַתִּתֵּ֨ן לָהֶ֜ם מִשְׁפָּטִ֤ים יְשָׁרִים֙ וְתוֹר֣וֹת אֱמֶ֔ת חֻקִּ֥ים וּמִצְוֺ֖ת טוֹבִֽים׃
verses.translit: v'l hrsyny yrdt vdbr 'mhm mshmym vttn lhm mshptym yshrym vtvrvt 'mt chqym vmtsvt tvbym
verses.translation: Thou camest down also upon mount Sinai, and spokest with them from heaven, and gavest them right ordinances and laws of truth, good statutes and commandments;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־שַׁבַּ֥ת קׇדְשְׁךָ֖ הוֹדַ֣עְתָּ לָהֶ֑ם וּמִצְו֤וֹת וְחֻקִּים֙ וְתוֹרָ֔ה צִוִּ֣יתָ לָהֶ֔ם בְּיַ֖ד מֹשֶׁ֥ה עַבְדֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translit: v'tshbt qdshkh hvd't lhm vmtsvvt vchqym vtvrh tsvyt lhm byd mshh 'bdkh
verses.translation: and madest known unto them Thy holy sabbath, and didst command them commandments, and statutes, and a law, by the hand of Moses Thy servant;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֠לֶ֠חֶם מִשָּׁמַ֜יִם נָתַ֤תָּה לָהֶם֙ לִרְעָבָ֔ם וּמַ֗יִם מִסֶּ֛לַע הוֹצֵ֥אתָ לָהֶ֖ם לִצְמָאָ֑ם וַתֹּ֣אמֶר לָהֶ֗ם לָבוֹא֙ לָרֶ֣שֶׁת אֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־נָשָׂ֥אתָ אֶת־יָדְךָ֖ לָתֵ֥ת לָהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vlchm mshmym ntth lhm lr'bm vmym msl' hvts't lhm ltsm'm vt'mr lhm lbv' lrsht 'th'rts 'shrnsh't 'tydkh ltt lhm
verses.translation: and gavest them bread from heaven for their hunger, and broughtest forth water for them out of the rock for their thirst, and didst command them that they should go in to possess the land which Thou hadst lifted up Thy hand to give them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֵ֥ם וַאֲבֹתֵ֖ינוּ הֵזִ֑ידוּ וַיַּקְשׁוּ֙ אֶת־עׇרְפָּ֔ם וְלֹ֥א שָׁמְע֖וּ אֶל־מִצְוֺתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: vhm v'btynv hzydv vyqshv 't'rpm vl' shm'v 'lmtsvtykh
verses.translation: But they and our fathers dealt proudly, and hardened their neck, and hearkened not to Thy commandments,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְמָאֲנ֣וּ לִשְׁמֹ֗עַ וְלֹא־זָכְר֤וּ נִפְלְאֹתֶ֙יךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֣יתָ עִמָּהֶ֔ם וַיַּקְשׁוּ֙ אֶת־עׇרְפָּ֔ם וַיִּתְּנוּ־רֹ֛אשׁ לָשׁ֥וּב לְעַבְדֻתָ֖ם בְּמִרְיָ֑ם וְאַתָּה֩ אֱל֨וֹהַּ סְלִיח֜וֹת חַנּ֧וּן וְרַח֛וּם אֶֽרֶךְ־אַפַּ֥יִם וְרַב־[חֶ֖סֶד] (וחסד) וְלֹ֥א עֲזַבְתָּֽם׃
verses.translit: vym'nv lshm' vl'zkhrv npl'tykh 'shr 'shyt 'mhm vyqshv 't'rpm vytnvr'sh lshvb l'bdtm bmrym v'th 'lvh slychvt chnvn vrchvm 'rkh'pym vrb[chsd] (vchsd) vl' 'zbtm
verses.translation: and refused to hearken, neither were mindful of Thy wonders that Thou didst among them; but hardened their neck, and in their rebellion appointed a captain to return to their bondage; but Thou art a God ready to pardon, gracious and full of compassion, slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy, and forsookest them not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֗ף כִּֽי־עָשׂ֤וּ לָהֶם֙ עֵ֣גֶל מַסֵּכָ֔ה וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ זֶ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶעֶלְךָ֖ מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֔וּ נֶאָצ֖וֹת גְּדֹלֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: 'f khy'shv lhm 'gl mskhh vy'mrv zh 'lhykh 'shr h'lkh mmtsrym vy'shv n'tsvt gdlvt
verses.translation: Yea, when they had made them a molten calf, and said: ‘This is thy God that brought thee up out of Egypt, and had wrought great provocations;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּה֙ בְּרַחֲמֶ֣יךָ הָֽרַבִּ֔ים לֹ֥א עֲזַבְתָּ֖ם בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר אֶת־עַמּ֣וּד הֶ֠עָנָ֠ן לֹא־סָ֨ר מֵעֲלֵיהֶ֤ם בְּיוֹמָם֙ לְהַנְחֹתָ֣ם בְּהַדֶּ֔רֶךְ וְאֶת־עַמּ֨וּד הָאֵ֤שׁ בְּלַ֙יְלָה֙ לְהָאִ֣יר לָהֶ֔ם וְאֶת־הַדֶּ֖רֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֵֽלְכוּ־בָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: v'th brchmykh hrbym l' 'zbtm bmdbr 't'mvd h'nn l'sr m'lyhm byvmm lhnchtm bhdrkh v't'mvd h'sh blylh lh'yr lhm v'thdrkh 'shr ylkhvbh
verses.translation: yet Thou in Thy manifold mercies forsookest them not in the wilderness; the pillar of cloud departed not from over them by day, to lead them in the way; neither the pillar of fire by night, to show them light, and the way wherein they should go.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרוּחֲךָ֙ הַטּוֹבָ֔ה נָתַ֖תָּ לְהַשְׂכִּילָ֑ם וּמַנְךָ֙ לֹא־מָנַ֣עְתָּ מִפִּיהֶ֔ם וּמַ֛יִם נָתַ֥תָּה לָהֶ֖ם לִצְמָאָֽם׃
verses.translit: vrvchkh htvbh ntt lhshkhylm vmnkh l'mn't mpyhm vmym ntth lhm ltsm'm
verses.translation: Thou gavest also Thy good spirit to instruct them, and withheldest not Thy manna from their mouth, and gavest them water for their thirst.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַרְבָּעִ֥ים שָׁנָ֛ה כִּלְכַּלְתָּ֥ם בַּמִּדְבָּ֖ר לֹ֣א חָסֵ֑רוּ שַׂלְמֹֽתֵיהֶם֙ לֹ֣א בָל֔וּ וְרַגְלֵיהֶ֖ם לֹ֥א בָצֵֽקוּ׃
verses.translit: v'rb'ym shnh khlkhltm bmdbr l' chsrv shlmtyhm l' blv vrglyhm l' btsqv
verses.translation: Yea, forty years didst Thou sustain them in the wilderness, and they lacked nothing; their clothes waxed not old, and their feet swelled not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּתֵּ֨ן לָהֶ֤ם מַמְלָכוֹת֙ וַעֲמָמִ֔ים וַֽתַּחְלְקֵ֖ם לְפֵאָ֑ה וַיִּֽירְשׁ֞וּ אֶת־אֶ֣רֶץ סִיח֗וֹן וְאֶת־אֶ֙רֶץ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ חֶשְׁבּ֔וֹן וְאֶת־אֶ֖רֶץ ע֥וֹג מֶֽלֶךְ־הַבָּשָֽׁן׃
verses.translit: vttn lhm mmlkhvt v'mmym vtchlqm lp'h vyyrshv 't'rts sychvn v't'rts mlkh chshbvn v't'rts 'vg mlkhhbshn
verses.translation: Moreover Thou gavest them kingdoms and peoples, which Thou didst allot quarter by quarter; so they possessed the land of Sihon, even the land of the king of Heshbon, and the land of Og king of Bashan.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵיהֶ֣ם הִרְבִּ֔יתָ כְּכֹכְבֵ֖י הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וַתְּבִיאֵם֙ אֶל־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־אָמַ֥רְתָּ לַאֲבֹתֵיהֶ֖ם לָב֥וֹא לָרָֽשֶׁת׃
verses.translit: vbnyhm hrbyt khkhkhby hshmym vtby'm 'lh'rts 'shr'mrt l'btyhm lbv' lrsht
verses.translation: Their children also didst Thou multiply as the stars of heaven, and didst bring them into the land, concerning which Thou didst say to their fathers, that they should go in to possess it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֤אוּ הַבָּנִים֙ וַיִּֽירְשׁ֣וּ אֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ וַתַּכְנַ֨ע לִפְנֵיהֶ֜ם אֶת־יֹשְׁבֵ֤י הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ הַכְּנַ֣עֲנִ֔ים וַֽתִּתְּנֵ֖ם בְּיָדָ֑ם וְאֶת־מַלְכֵיהֶם֙ וְאֶת־עַֽמְמֵ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת בָּהֶ֖ם כִּרְצוֹנָֽם׃
verses.translit: vyb'v hbnym vyyrshv 'th'rts vtkhn' lpnyhm 'tyshby h'rts hkhn'nym vttnm bydm v'tmlkhyhm v't'mmy h'rts l'shvt bhm khrtsvnm
verses.translation: So the children went in and possessed the land, and Thou didst subdue before them the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, and gavest them into their hands, with their kings, and the peoples of the land, that they might do with them as they would.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיִּלְכְּד֞וּ עָרִ֣ים בְּצוּרֹת֮ וַאֲדָמָ֣ה שְׁמֵנָה֒ וַיִּֽירְשׁ֡וּ בָּתִּ֣ים מְלֵֽאִים־כׇּל־ט֠וּב בֹּר֨וֹת חֲצוּבִ֜ים כְּרָמִ֧ים וְזֵיתִ֛ים וְעֵ֥ץ מַאֲכָ֖ל לָרֹ֑ב וַיֹּאכְל֤וּ וַֽיִּשְׂבְּעוּ֙ וַיַּשְׁמִ֔ינוּ וַיִּֽתְעַדְּנ֖וּ בְּטוּבְךָ֥ הַגָּדֽוֹל׃
verses.translit: vylkhdv 'rym btsvrt v'dmh shmnh vyyrshv btym ml'ymkhltvb brvt chtsvbym khrmym vzytym v'ts m'khl lrb vy'khlv vyshb'v vyshmynv vyt'dnv btvbkh hgdvl
verses.translation: And they took fortified cities, and a fat land, and possessed houses full of all good things, cisterns hewn out, vineyards, and oliveyards, and fruit-trees in abundance; so they did eat, and were filled, and became fat, and luxuriated in Thy great goodness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּמְר֨וּ וַֽיִּמְרְד֜וּ בָּ֗ךְ וַיַּשְׁלִ֤כוּ אֶת־תּוֹרָֽתְךָ֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י גַוָּ֔ם וְאֶת־נְבִיאֶ֣יךָ הָרָ֔גוּ אֲשֶׁר־הֵעִ֥ידוּ בָ֖ם לַהֲשִׁיבָ֣ם אֵלֶ֑יךָ וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֔וּ נֶאָצ֖וֹת גְּדוֹלֹֽת׃
verses.translit: vymrv vymrdv bkh vyshlkhv 'ttvrtkh 'chry gvm v'tnby'ykh hrgv 'shrh'ydv bm lhshybm 'lykh vy'shv n'tsvt gdvlt
verses.translation: Nevertheless they were disobedient, and rebelled against Thee, and cast Thy law behind their back, and slew Thy prophets that did forewarn them to turn them back unto Thee, and they wrought great provocations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽתִּתְּנֵם֙ בְּיַ֣ד צָֽרֵיהֶ֔ם וַיָּצֵ֖רוּ לָהֶ֑ם וּבְעֵ֤ת צָֽרָתָם֙ יִצְעֲק֣וּ אֵלֶ֔יךָ וְאַתָּה֙ מִשָּׁמַ֣יִם תִּשְׁמָ֔ע וּֽכְרַחֲמֶ֣יךָ הָֽרַבִּ֗ים תִּתֵּ֤ן לָהֶם֙ מֽוֹשִׁיעִ֔ים וְיוֹשִׁיע֖וּם מִיַּ֥ד צָרֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vttnm byd tsryhm vytsrv lhm vb't tsrtm yts'qv 'lykh v'th mshmym tshm' vkhrchmykh hrbym ttn lhm mvshy'ym vyvshy'vm myd tsryhm
verses.translation: Therefore Thou didst deliver them into the hand of their adversaries, who distressed them; and in the time of their trouble, when they cried unto Thee, Thou heardest from heaven; and according to Thy manifold mercies Thou gavest them saviours who might save them out of the hand of their adversaries.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּכְנ֣וֹחַ לָהֶ֔ם יָשׁ֕וּבוּ לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת רַ֖ע לְפָנֶ֑יךָ וַתַּֽעַזְבֵ֞ם בְּיַ֤ד אֹֽיְבֵיהֶם֙ וַיִּרְדּ֣וּ בָהֶ֔ם וַיָּשׁ֙וּבוּ֙ וַיִּזְעָק֔וּךָ וְאַתָּ֞ה מִשָּׁמַ֧יִם תִּשְׁמַ֛ע וְתַצִּילֵ֥ם כְּֽרַחֲמֶ֖יךָ רַבּ֥וֹת עִתִּֽים׃
verses.translit: vkhnvch lhm yshvbv l'shvt r' lpnykh vt'zbm byd 'ybyhm vyrdv bhm vyshvbv vyz'qvkh v'th mshmym tshm' vttsylm khrchmykh rbvt 'tym
verses.translation: But after they had rest, they did evil again before Thee; therefore didst Thou leave them in the hand of their enemies, so that they had the dominion over them; yet when they returned, and cried unto Thee, many times didst Thou hear from heaven, and deliver them according to Thy mercies;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתָּ֨עַד בָּהֶ֜ם לַהֲשִׁיבָ֣ם אֶל־תּוֹרָתֶ֗ךָ וְהֵ֨מָּה הֵזִ֜ידוּ וְלֹא־שָׁמְע֤וּ לְמִצְוֺתֶ֙יךָ֙ וּבְמִשְׁפָּטֶ֣יךָ חָֽטְאוּ־בָ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה אָדָ֖ם וְחָיָ֣ה בָהֶ֑ם וַיִּתְּנ֤וּ כָתֵף֙ סוֹרֶ֔רֶת וְעׇרְפָּ֥ם הִקְשׁ֖וּ וְלֹ֥א שָׁמֵֽעוּ׃
verses.translit: vt'd bhm lhshybm 'ltvrtkh vhmh hzydv vl'shm'v lmtsvtykh vbmshptykh cht'vbm 'shry'shh 'dm vchyh bhm vytnv khtf svrrt v'rpm hqshv vl' shm'v
verses.translation: and didst forewarn them, that Thou mightest bring them back unto Thy law; yet they dealt proudly, and hearkened not unto Thy commandments, but sinned against Thine ordinances, which if a man do, he shall live by them, and presented a stubborn shoulder, and hardened their neck, and would not hear.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּמְשֹׁ֤ךְ עֲלֵיהֶם֙ שָׁנִ֣ים רַבּ֔וֹת וַתָּ֨עַד בָּ֧ם בְּרוּחֲךָ֛ בְּיַד־נְבִיאֶ֖יךָ וְלֹ֣א הֶאֱזִ֑ינוּ וַֽתִּתְּנֵ֔ם בְּיַ֖ד עַמֵּ֥י הָאֲרָצֹֽת׃
verses.translit: vtmshkh 'lyhm shnym rbvt vt'd bm brvchkh bydnby'ykh vl' h'zynv vttnm byd 'my h'rtst
verses.translation: Yet many years didst Thou extend mercy unto them, and didst forewarn them by Thy spirit through Thy prophets; yet would they not give ear; therefore gavest Thou them into the hand of the peoples of the lands.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּֽבְרַחֲמֶ֧יךָ הָרַבִּ֛ים לֹֽא־עֲשִׂיתָ֥ם כָּלָ֖ה וְלֹ֣א עֲזַבְתָּ֑ם כִּ֛י אֵֽל־חַנּ֥וּן וְרַח֖וּם אָֽתָּה׃
verses.translit: vbrchmykh hrbym l''shytm khlh vl' 'zbtm khy 'lchnvn vrchvm 'th
verses.translation: Nevertheless in Thy manifold mercies Thou didst not utterly consume them, nor forsake them; for Thou art a gracious and merciful God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֣ה אֱ֠לֹהֵ֠ינוּ הָאֵ֨ל הַגָּד֜וֹל הַגִּבּ֣וֹר וְהַנּוֹרָא֮ שׁוֹמֵ֣ר הַבְּרִ֣ית וְהַחֶ֒סֶד֒ אַל־יִמְעַ֣ט לְפָנֶ֡יךָ אֵ֣ת כׇּל־הַתְּלָאָ֣ה אֲֽשֶׁר־מְ֠צָאַ֠תְנוּ לִמְלָכֵ֨ינוּ לְשָׂרֵ֧ינוּ וּלְכֹהֲנֵ֛ינוּ וְלִנְבִיאֵ֥ינוּ וְלַאֲבֹתֵ֖ינוּ וּלְכׇל־עַמֶּ֑ךָ מִימֵי֙ מַלְכֵ֣י אַשּׁ֔וּר עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: v'th 'lhynv h'l hgdvl hgbvr vhnvr' shvmr hbryt vhchsd 'lym't lpnykh 't khlhtl'h 'shrmts'tnv lmlkhynv lshrynv vlkhhnynv vlnby'ynv vl'btynv vlkhl'mkh mymy mlkhy 'shvr 'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: Now therefore, our God, the great, the mighty, and the awful God, who keepest covenant and mercy, let not all the travail seem little before Thee, that hath come upon us, on our kings, on our princes, and on our priests, and on our prophets, and on our fathers, and on all Thy people, since the time of the kings of Assyria unto this day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה צַדִּ֔יק עַ֖ל כׇּל־הַבָּ֣א עָלֵ֑ינוּ כִּֽי־אֱמֶ֥ת עָשִׂ֖יתָ וַאֲנַ֥חְנוּ הִרְשָֽׁעְנוּ׃
verses.translit: v'th tsdyq 'l khlhb' 'lynv khy'mt 'shyt v'nchnv hrsh'nv
verses.translation: Howbeit Thou art just in all that is come upon us; for Thou hast dealt truly, but we have done wickedly;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־מְלָכֵ֤ינוּ שָׂרֵ֙ינוּ֙ כֹּהֲנֵ֣ינוּ וַאֲבֹתֵ֔ינוּ לֹ֥א עָשׂ֖וּ תּוֹרָתֶ֑ךָ וְלֹ֤א הִקְשִׁ֙יבוּ֙ אֶל־מִצְוֺתֶ֔יךָ וּלְעֵ֣דְוֺתֶ֔יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הַעִידֹ֖תָ בָּהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v'tmlkhynv shrynv khhnynv v'btynv l' 'shv tvrtkh vl' hqshybv 'lmtsvtykh vl'dvtykh 'shr h'ydt bhm
verses.translation: neither have our kings, our princes, our priests, nor our fathers, kept Thy law, nor hearkened unto Thy commandments and Thy testimonies, wherewith Thou didst testify against them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֵ֣ם בְּמַלְכוּתָם֩ וּבְטוּבְךָ֨ הָרָ֜ב אֲשֶׁר־נָתַ֣תָּ לָהֶ֗ם וּבְאֶ֨רֶץ הָרְחָבָ֧ה וְהַשְּׁמֵנָ֛ה אֲשֶׁר־נָתַ֥תָּ לִפְנֵיהֶ֖ם לֹ֣א עֲבָד֑וּךָ וְֽלֹא־שָׁ֔בוּ מִמַּֽעַלְלֵיהֶ֖ם הָרָעִֽים׃
verses.translit: vhm bmlkhvtm vbtvbkh hrb 'shrntt lhm vb'rts hrchbh vhshmnh 'shrntt lpnyhm l' 'bdvkh vl'shbv mm'llyhm hr'ym
verses.translation: For they have not served Thee in their kingdom, and in Thy great goodness that Thou gavest them, and in the large and fat land which Thou gavest before them, neither turned they from their wicked works.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֛ה אֲנַ֥חְנוּ הַיּ֖וֹם עֲבָדִ֑ים וְהָאָ֜רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־נָתַ֣תָּה לַאֲבֹתֵ֗ינוּ לֶאֱכֹ֤ל אֶת־פִּרְיָהּ֙ וְאֶת־טוּבָ֔הּ הִנֵּ֛ה אֲנַ֥חְנוּ עֲבָדִ֖ים עָלֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: hnh 'nchnv hyvm 'bdym vh'rts 'shrntth l'btynv l'khl 'tpryh v'ttvbh hnh 'nchnv 'bdym 'lyh
verses.translation: Behold, we are servants this day, and as for the land that Thou gavest unto our fathers to eat the fruit thereof and the good thereof, behold, we are servants in it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּתְבוּאָתָ֣הּ מַרְבָּ֗ה לַמְּלָכִ֛ים אֲשֶׁר־נָתַ֥תָּה עָלֵ֖ינוּ בְּחַטֹּאותֵ֑ינוּ וְעַ֣ל גְּ֠וִיֹּתֵ֠ינוּ מֹשְׁלִ֤ים וּבִבְהֶמְתֵּ֙נוּ֙ כִּרְצוֹנָ֔ם וּבְצָרָ֥ה גְדֹלָ֖ה אֲנָֽחְנוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vtbv'th mrbh lmlkhym 'shrntth 'lynv bcht'vtynv v'l gvytynv mshlym vbbhmtnv khrtsvnm vbtsrh gdlh 'nchnv {p}
verses.translation: And it yieldeth much increase unto the kings whom Thou hast set over us because of our sins; also they have power over our bodies, and over our cattle, at their pleasure, and we are in great distress.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְכׇל־זֹ֕את אֲנַ֛חְנוּ כֹּרְתִ֥ים אֲמָנָ֖ה וְכֹתְבִ֑ים וְעַל֙ הֶֽחָת֔וּם שָׂרֵ֥ינוּ לְוִיֵּ֖נוּ כֹּהֲנֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: vbkhlz't 'nchnv khrtym 'mnh vkhtbym v'l hchtvm shrynv lvynv khhnynv
verses.translation: And yet for all this we make a sure covenant, and subscribe it; and our princes, our Levites, and our priests, set their seal unto it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַ֖ל הַחֲתוּמִ֑ים נְחֶמְיָ֧ה הַתִּרְשָׁ֛תָא בֶּן־חֲכַלְיָ֖ה וְצִדְקִיָּֽה׃
verses.translit: v'l hchtvmym nchmyh htrsht' bnchkhlyh vtsdqyh
verses.translation: Now those that set their seal were: Nehemiah the Tirshatha, the son of Hachaliah, and Zedekiah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׂרָיָ֥ה עֲזַרְיָ֖ה יִרְמְיָֽה׃
verses.translit: shryh 'zryh yrmyh
verses.translation: Seraiah, Azariah, Jeremiah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פַּשְׁח֥וּר אֲמַרְיָ֖ה מַלְכִּיָּֽה׃
verses.translit: pshchvr 'mryh mlkhyh
verses.translation: Pashhur, Amariah, Malchijah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חַטּ֥וּשׁ שְׁבַנְיָ֖ה מַלּֽוּךְ׃
verses.translit: chtvsh shbnyh mlvkh
verses.translation: Hattush, Shebaniah, Malluch;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חָרִ֥ם מְרֵמ֖וֹת עֹֽבַדְיָֽה׃
verses.translit: chrm mrmvt 'bdyh
verses.translation: Harim, Meremoth, Obadiah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דָּנִיֵּ֥אל גִּנְּת֖וֹן בָּרֽוּךְ׃
verses.translit: dny'l gntvn brvkh
verses.translation: Daniel, Ginnethon, Baruch;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מְשֻׁלָּ֥ם אֲבִיָּ֖ה מִיָּמִֽן׃
verses.translit: mshlm 'byh mymn
verses.translation: Meshullam, Abijah, Mijamin;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַֽעַזְיָ֥ה בִלְגַּ֖י שְׁמַֽעְיָ֑ה אֵ֖לֶּה הַכֹּהֲנִֽים׃
verses.translit: m'zyh blgy shm'yh 'lh hkhhnym
verses.translation: Maaziah, Bilgai, Shemaiah. These were the priests.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽהַלְוִיִּ֑ם וְיֵשׁ֙וּעַ֙ בֶּן־אֲזַנְיָ֔ה בִּנּ֕וּי מִבְּנֵ֥י חֵנָדָ֖ד קַדְמִיאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vhlvym vyshv' bn'znyh bnvy mbny chndd qdmy'l
verses.translation: And the Levites: Jeshua the son of Azaniah, Binnui of the sons of Henadad, Kadmiel;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲחֵיהֶ֑ם שְׁבַנְיָ֧ה הֽוֹדִיָּ֛ה קְלִיטָ֖א פְּלָאיָ֥ה חָנָֽן׃
verses.translit: v'chyhm shbnyh hvdyh qlyt' pl'yh chnn
verses.translation: and their brethren, Shebaniah, Hodiah, Kelita, Pelaiah, Hanan;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִיכָ֥א רְח֖וֹב חֲשַׁבְיָֽה׃
verses.translit: mykh' rchvb chshbyh
verses.translation: Mica, Rehob, Hashabiah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זַכּ֥וּר שֵׁרֵֽבְיָ֖ה שְׁבַנְיָֽה׃
verses.translit: zkhvr shrbyh shbnyh
verses.translation: Zaccur, Sherebiah, Shebaniah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הוֹדִיָּ֥ה בָנִ֖י בְּנִֽינוּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hvdyh bny bnynv {s}
verses.translation: Hodiah, Bani, Beninu. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רָאשֵׁ֖י הָעָ֑ם פַּרְעֹשׁ֙ פַּחַ֣ת מוֹאָ֔ב עֵילָ֥ם זַתּ֖וּא בָּנִֽי׃
verses.translit: r'shy h'm pr'sh pcht mv'b 'ylm ztv' bny
verses.translation: The chiefs of the people: Parosh, Pahath-moab, Elam, Zattu, Bani;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֻּנִּ֥י עַזְגָּ֖ד בֵּבָֽי׃
verses.translit: bny 'zgd bby
verses.translation: Bunni, Azgad, Bebai;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲדֹנִיָּ֥ה בִגְוַ֖י עָדִֽין׃
verses.translit: 'dnyh bgvy 'dyn
verses.translation: Adonijah, Bigvai, Adin;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָטֵ֥ר חִזְקִיָּ֖ה עַזּֽוּר׃
verses.translit: 'tr chzqyh 'zvr
verses.translation: Ater, Hezekiah, Azzur;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הוֹדִיָּ֥ה חָשֻׁ֖ם בֵּצָֽי׃
verses.translit: hvdyh chshm btsy
verses.translation: Hodiah, Hashum, Bezai;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חָרִ֥יף עֲנָת֖וֹת (נובי) [נֵיבָֽי]׃
verses.translit: chryf 'ntvt (nvby) [nyby]
verses.translation: Hariph, Anathoth, Nebai;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַגְפִּיעָ֥שׁ מְשֻׁלָּ֖ם חֵזִֽיר׃
verses.translit: mgpy'sh mshlm chzyr
verses.translation: Magpiash, Meshullam, Hezir;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מְשֵׁיזַבְאֵ֥ל צָד֖וֹק יַדּֽוּעַ׃
verses.translit: mshyzb'l tsdvq ydv'
verses.translation: Meshezabel, Zadok, Jaddua;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פְּלַטְיָ֥ה חָנָ֖ן עֲנָיָֽה׃
verses.translit: pltyh chnn 'nyh
verses.translation: Pelatiah, Hanan, Anaiah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הוֹשֵׁ֥עַ חֲנַנְיָ֖ה חַשּֽׁוּב׃
verses.translit: hvsh' chnnyh chshvb
verses.translation: Hoshea, Hananiah, Hasshub;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַלּוֹחֵ֥שׁ פִּלְחָ֖א שׁוֹבֵֽק׃
verses.translit: hlvchsh plch' shvbq
verses.translation: Hallohesh, Pilha, Shobek;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רְח֥וּם חֲשַׁבְנָ֖ה מַעֲשֵׂיָֽה׃
verses.translit: rchvm chshbnh m'shyh
verses.translation: Rehum, Hashabnah, Maaseiah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲחִיָּ֥ה חָנָ֖ן עָנָֽן׃
verses.translit: v'chyh chnn 'nn
verses.translation: and Ahiah, Hanan, Anan;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַלּ֥וּךְ חָרִ֖ם בַּעֲנָֽה׃
verses.translit: mlvkh chrm b'nh
verses.translation: Malluch, Harim, Baanah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׁאָ֣ר הָעָ֡ם הַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים הַ֠לְוִיִּ֠ם הַשּׁוֹעֲרִ֨ים הַמְשֹׁרְרִ֜ים הַנְּתִינִ֗ים וְֽכׇל־הַנִּבְדָּ֞ל מֵעַמֵּ֤י הָאֲרָצוֹת֙ אֶל־תּוֹרַ֣ת הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים נְשֵׁיהֶ֖ם בְּנֵיהֶ֣ם וּבְנֹתֵיהֶ֑ם כֹּ֖ל יוֹדֵ֥עַ מֵבִֽין׃
verses.translit: vsh'r h'm hkhhnym hlvym hshv'rym hmshrrym hntynym vkhlhnbdl m'my h'rtsvt 'ltvrt h'lhym nshyhm bnyhm vbntyhm khl yvd' mbyn
verses.translation: And the rest of the people, the priests, the Levites, the porters, the singers, the Nethinim, and all they that had separated themselves from the peoples of the lands unto the law of God, their wives, their sons, and their daughters, every one that had knowledge and understanding;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַחֲזִיקִ֣ים עַל־אֲחֵיהֶם֮ אַדִּירֵיהֶם֒ וּבָאִ֞ים בְּאָלָ֣ה וּבִשְׁבוּעָ֗ה לָלֶ֙כֶת֙ בְּתוֹרַ֣ת הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִתְּנָ֔ה בְּיַ֖ד מֹשֶׁ֣ה עֶֽבֶד־הָֽאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְלִשְׁמ֣וֹר וְלַעֲשׂ֗וֹת אֶת־כׇּל־מִצְוֺת֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֲדֹנֵ֔ינוּ וּמִשְׁפָּטָ֖יו וְחֻקָּֽיו׃
verses.translit: mchzyqym 'l'chyhm 'dyryhm vb'ym b'lh vbshbv'h llkht btvrt h'lhym 'shr ntnh byd mshh 'bdh'lhym vlshmvr vl'shvt 'tkhlmtsvt yhvh 'dnynv vmshptyv vchqyv
verses.translation: they cleaved to their brethren, their nobles, and entered into a curse, and into an oath, to walk in God’s law, which was given by Moses the servant of God, and to observe and do all the commandments of the LORD our Lord, and His ordinances and His statutes;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹא־נִתֵּ֥ן בְּנֹתֵ֖ינוּ לְעַמֵּ֣י הָאָ֑רֶץ וְאֶת־בְּנֹ֣תֵיהֶ֔ם לֹ֥א נִקַּ֖ח לְבָנֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: v'shr l'ntn bntynv l'my h'rts v'tbntyhm l' nqch lbnynv
verses.translation: and that we would not give our daughters unto the peoples of the land, nor take their daughters for our sons;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַמֵּ֣י הָאָ֡רֶץ הַֽמְבִיאִים֩ אֶת־הַמַּקָּח֨וֹת וְכׇל־שֶׁ֜בֶר בְּי֤וֹם הַשַּׁבָּת֙ לִמְכּ֔וֹר לֹא־נִקַּ֥ח מֵהֶ֛ם בַּשַּׁבָּ֖ת וּבְי֣וֹם קֹ֑דֶשׁ וְנִטֹּ֛שׁ אֶת־הַשָּׁנָ֥ה הַשְּׁבִיעִ֖ית וּמַשָּׁ֥א כׇל־יָֽד׃
verses.translit: v'my h'rts hmby'ym 'thmqchvt vkhlshbr byvm hshbt lmkhvr l'nqch mhm bshbt vbyvm qdsh vntsh 'thshnh hshby'yt vmsh' khlyd
verses.translation: and if the peoples of the land bring ware or any victuals on the sabbath day to sell, that we would not buy of them on the sabbath, or on a holy day; and that we would forego the seventh year, and the exaction of every debt.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֶעֱמַ֤דְנוּ עָלֵ֙ינוּ֙ מִצְוֺ֔ת לָתֵ֥ת עָלֵ֛ינוּ שְׁלִישִׁ֥ית הַשֶּׁ֖קֶל בַּשָּׁנָ֑ה לַעֲבֹדַ֖ת בֵּ֥ית אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: vh'mdnv 'lynv mtsvt ltt 'lynv shlyshyt hshql bshnh l'bdt byt 'lhynv
verses.translation: Also we made ordinances for us, to charge ourselves yearly with the third part of a shekel for the service of the house of our God;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְלֶ֣חֶם הַֽמַּעֲרֶ֡כֶת וּמִנְחַ֣ת הַתָּמִ֣יד וּלְעוֹלַ֣ת הַ֠תָּמִ֠יד הַשַּׁבָּת֨וֹת הֶחֳדָשִׁ֜ים לַמּוֹעֲדִ֗ים וְלַקֳּדָשִׁים֙ וְלַ֣חַטָּא֔וֹת לְכַפֵּ֖ר עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְכֹ֖ל מְלֶ֥אכֶת בֵּית־אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: llchm hm'rkht vmncht htmyd vl'vlt htmyd hshbtvt hchdshym lmv'dym vlqdshym vlcht'vt lkhpr 'lyshr'l vkhl ml'kht byt'lhynv {s}
verses.translation: for the showbread, and for the continual meal-offering, and for the continual burnt-offering, of the sabbaths, of the new moons, for the appointed seasons, and for the holy things, and for the sin-offerings to make atonement for Israel, and for all the work of the house of our God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַגּוֹרָל֨וֹת הִפַּ֜לְנוּ עַל־קֻרְבַּ֣ן הָעֵצִ֗ים הַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים הַלְוִיִּם֮ וְהָעָם֒ לְ֠הָבִ֠יא לְבֵ֨ית אֱלֹהֵ֧ינוּ לְבֵית־אֲבֹתֵ֛ינוּ לְעִתִּ֥ים מְזֻמָּנִ֖ים שָׁנָ֣ה בְשָׁנָ֑ה לְבַעֵ֗ר עַל־מִזְבַּח֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ כַּכָּת֖וּב בַּתּוֹרָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhgvrlvt hplnv 'lqrbn h'tsym hkhhnym hlvym vh'm lhby' lbyt 'lhynv lbyt'btynv l'tym mzmnym shnh bshnh lb'r 'lmzbch yhvh 'lhynv khkhtvb btvrh
verses.translation: And we cast lots, the priests, the Levites, and the people, for the wood-offering, to bring it into the house of our God, according to our fathers’houses, at times appointed, year by year, to burn upon the altar of the LORD our God, as it is written in the Law;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְהָבִ֞יא אֶת־בִּכּוּרֵ֣י אַדְמָתֵ֗נוּ וּבִכּוּרֵ֛י כׇּל־פְּרִ֥י כׇל־עֵ֖ץ שָׁנָ֣ה בְשָׁנָ֑ה לְבֵ֖ית יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vlhby' 'tbkhvry 'dmtnv vbkhvry khlpry khl'ts shnh bshnh lbyt yhvh
verses.translation: and to bring the first-fruits of our land, and the first-fruits of all fruit of all manner of trees, year by year, unto the house of the LORD;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־בְּכֹר֤וֹת בָּנֵ֙ינוּ֙ וּבְהֶמְתֵּ֔נוּ כַּכָּת֖וּב בַּתּוֹרָ֑ה וְאֶת־בְּכוֹרֵ֨י בְקָרֵ֜ינוּ וְצֹאנֵ֗ינוּ לְהָבִיא֙ לְבֵ֣ית אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ לַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים הַמְשָׁרְתִ֖ים בְּבֵ֥ית אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: v'tbkhrvt bnynv vbhmtnv khkhtvb btvrh v'tbkhvry bqrynv vts'nynv lhby' lbyt 'lhynv lkhhnym hmshrtym bbyt 'lhynv
verses.translation: also the first-born of our sons, and of our cattle, as it is written in the Law, and the firstlings of our herds and of our flocks, to bring to the house of our God, unto the priests that minister in the house of our God;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־רֵאשִׁ֣ית עֲרִיסֹתֵ֣ינוּ וּ֠תְרוּמֹתֵ֠ינוּ וּפְרִ֨י כׇל־עֵ֜ץ תִּיר֣וֹשׁ וְיִצְהָ֗ר נָבִ֤יא לַכֹּהֲנִים֙ אֶל־לִשְׁכ֣וֹת בֵּית־אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ וּמַעְשַׂ֥ר אַדְמָתֵ֖נוּ לַלְוִיִּ֑ם וְהֵם֙ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם הַֽמְעַשְּׂרִ֔ים בְּכֹ֖ל עָרֵ֥י עֲבֹדָתֵֽנוּ׃
verses.translit: v'tr'shyt 'rystynv vtrvmtynv vpry khl'ts tyrvsh vytshr nby' lkhhnym 'llshkhvt byt'lhynv vm'shr 'dmtnv llvym vhm hlvym hm'shrym bkhl 'ry 'bdtnv
verses.translation: and that we should bring the first of our dough, and our heave-offerings, and the fruit of all manner of trees, the wine and the oil, unto the priests, to the chambers of the house of our God; and the tithes of our land unto the Levites; for they, the Levites, take the tithes in all the cities of our tillage.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֨ה הַכֹּהֵ֧ן בֶּֽן־אַהֲרֹ֛ן עִם־הַלְוִיִּ֖ם בַּעְשֵׂ֣ר הַלְוִיִּ֑ם וְהַלְוִיִּ֞ם יַעֲל֨וּ אֶת־מַעֲשַׂ֤ר הַֽמַּעֲשֵׂר֙ לְבֵ֣ית אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ אֶל־הַלְּשָׁכ֖וֹת לְבֵ֥ית הָאוֹצָֽר׃
verses.translit: vhyh hkhhn bn'hrn 'mhlvym b'shr hlvym vhlvym y'lv 'tm'shr hm'shr lbyt 'lhynv 'lhlshkhvt lbyt h'vtsr
verses.translation: And the priest the son of Aaron shall be with the Levites, when the Levites take tithes; and the Levites shall bring up the tithe of the tithes unto the house of our God, to the chambers, into the treasure-house. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י אֶל־הַ֠לְּשָׁכ֠וֹת יָבִ֨יאוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל וּבְנֵ֣י הַלֵּוִ֗י אֶת־תְּרוּמַ֣ת הַדָּגָן֮ הַתִּיר֣וֹשׁ וְהַיִּצְהָר֒ וְשָׁם֙ כְּלֵ֣י הַמִּקְדָּ֔שׁ וְהַכֹּהֲנִים֙ הַמְשָׁ֣רְתִ֔ים וְהַשּׁוֹעֲרִ֖ים וְהַמְשֹׁרְרִ֑ים וְלֹ֥א נַעֲזֹ֖ב אֶת־בֵּ֥ית אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: khy 'lhlshkhvt yby'v bnyyshr'l vbny hlvy 'ttrvmt hdgn htyrvsh vhytshr vshm khly hmqdsh vhkhhnym hmshrtym vhshv'rym vhmshrrym vl' n'zb 'tbyt 'lhynv
verses.translation: For the children of Israel and the children of Levi shall bring the heave-offering of the corn, of the wine, and of the oil, unto the chambers, where are the vessels of the sanctuary, and the priests that minister, and the porters, and the singers; and we will not forsake the house of our God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּשְׁב֥וּ שָׂרֵֽי־הָעָ֖ם בִּירוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם וּשְׁאָ֣ר הָ֠עָ֠ם הִפִּ֨ילוּ גוֹרָל֜וֹת לְהָבִ֣יא  אֶחָ֣ד מִן־הָעֲשָׂרָ֗ה לָשֶׁ֙בֶת֙ בִּֽירוּשָׁלַ֙͏ִם֙ עִ֣יר הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ וְתֵ֥שַׁע הַיָּד֖וֹת בֶּעָרִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyshbv shryh'm byrvshl͏m vsh'r h'm hpylv gvrlvt lhby'  'chd mnh'shrh lshbt byrvshl͏m 'yr hqdsh vtsh' hydvt b'rym
verses.translation: And the princes of the people dwelt in Jerusalem; the rest of the people also cast lots, to bring one of ten to dwell in Jerusalem the holy city, and nine parts in the other cities.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְבָרְכ֖וּ הָעָ֑ם לְכֹל֙ הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֔ים הַמִּֽתְנַדְּבִ֔ים לָשֶׁ֖בֶת בִּירוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vybrkhv h'm lkhl h'nshym hmtndbym lshbt byrvshl͏m {p}
verses.translation: And the people blessed all the men that willingly offered themselves to dwell in Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ רָאשֵׁ֣י הַמְּדִינָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָשְׁב֖וּ בִּירוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם וּבְעָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה יָֽשְׁב֞וּ אִ֤ישׁ בַּאֲחֻזָּתוֹ֙ בְּעָ֣רֵיהֶ֔ם יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל הַכֹּהֲנִים֙ וְהַלְוִיִּ֣ם וְהַנְּתִינִ֔ים וּבְנֵ֖י עַבְדֵ֥י שְׁלֹמֹֽה׃
verses.translit: v'lh r'shy hmdynh 'shr yshbv byrvshl͏m vb'ry yhvdh yshbv 'ysh b'chztv b'ryhm yshr'l hkhhnym vhlvym vhntynym vbny 'bdy shlmh
verses.translation: Now these are the chiefs of the province that dwelt in Jerusalem; but in the cities of Judah dwelt every one in his possession in their cities, to wit, Israelites, the priests, and the Levites, and the Nethinim, and the children of Solomon’s servants.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבִֽירוּשָׁלַ֙͏ִם֙ יָֽשְׁב֔וּ מִבְּנֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה וּמִבְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֑ן מִבְּנֵ֣י יְ֠הוּדָ֠ה עֲתָיָ֨ה בֶן־עֻזִּיָּ֜ה בֶּן־זְכַרְיָ֧ה בֶן־אֲמַרְיָ֛ה בֶּן־שְׁפַטְיָ֥ה בֶן־מַהֲלַלְאֵ֖ל מִבְּנֵי־פָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vbyrvshl͏m yshbv mbny yhvdh vmbny bnymn mbny yhvdh 'tyh bn'zyh bnzkhryh bn'mryh bnshptyh bnmhll'l mbnyprts
verses.translation: And in Jerusalem dwelt certain of the children of Judah, and of the children of Benjamin. Of the children of Judah: Athaiah the son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalalel, of the children of Perez;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמַעֲשֵׂיָ֣ה בֶן־בָּר֣וּךְ בֶּן־כׇּל־חֹ֠זֶ֠ה בֶּן־חֲזָיָ֨ה בֶן־עֲדָיָ֧ה בֶן־יוֹיָרִ֛יב בֶּן־זְכַרְיָ֖ה בֶּן־הַשִּׁלֹנִֽי׃
verses.translit: vm'shyh bnbrvkh bnkhlchzh bnchzyh bn'dyh bnyvyryb bnzkhryh bnhshlny
verses.translation: and Maaseiah the son of Baruch, the son of Colhozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, the son of the Shilonite.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־בְּנֵי־פֶ֕רֶץ הַיֹּשְׁבִ֖ים בִּירוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֛וֹת שִׁשִּׁ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנָ֖ה אַנְשֵׁי־חָֽיִל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khlbnyprts hyshbym byrvshl͏m 'rb' m'vt shshym vshmnh 'nshychyl {p}
verses.translation: All the sons of Perez that dwelt in Jerusalem were four hundred threescore and eight valiant men.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֑ן סַלֻּ֡א בֶּן־מְשֻׁלָּ֡ם בֶּן־יוֹעֵ֡ד בֶּן־פְּדָיָה֩ בֶן־ק֨וֹלָיָ֧ה בֶן־מַעֲשֵׂיָ֛ה בֶּן־אִֽיתִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־יְשַֽׁעְיָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'lh bny bnymn sl' bnmshlm bnyv'd bnpdyh bnqvlyh bnm'shyh bn'yty'l bnysh'yh
verses.translation: And these are the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jeshaiah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַחֲרָ֖יו גַּבַּ֣י סַלָּ֑י תְּשַׁ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'chryv gby sly tsh' m'vt 'shrym vshmnh
verses.translation: And after him Gabbai, Sallai, nine hundred twenty and eight.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיוֹאֵ֥ל בֶּן־זִכְרִ֖י פָּקִ֣יד עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם וִיהוּדָ֧ה בֶן־הַסְּנוּאָ֛ה עַל־הָעִ֖יר מִשְׁנֶֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyv'l bnzkhry pqyd 'lyhm vyhvdh bnhsnv'h 'lh'yr mshnh {p}
verses.translation: And Joel the son of Zichri was their overseer; and Judah the son of Hassenuah was second over the city.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִן־הַֽכֹּהֲנִ֑ים יְדַֽעְיָ֥ה בֶן־יוֹיָרִ֖יב יָכִֽין׃
verses.translit: mnhkhhnym yd'yh bnyvyryb ykhyn
verses.translation: Of the priests: Jedaiah the son of Joiarib, Jachin,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׂרָיָ֨ה בֶן־חִלְקִיָּ֜ה בֶּן־מְשֻׁלָּ֣ם בֶּן־צָד֗וֹק בֶּן־מְרָיוֹת֙ בֶּן־אֲחִיט֔וּב נְגִ֖ד בֵּ֥ית הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: shryh bnchlqyh bnmshlm bntsdvq bnmryvt bn'chytvb ngd byt h'lhym
verses.translation: Seraiah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of the house of God,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲחֵיהֶ֗ם עֹשֵׂ֤ה הַמְּלָאכָה֙ לַבַּ֔יִת שְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵא֖וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֣ים וּשְׁנָ֑יִם וַ֠עֲדָיָ֠ה בֶּן־יְרֹחָ֤ם בֶּן־פְּלַלְיָה֙ בֶּן־אַמְצִ֣י בֶן־זְכַרְיָ֔ה בֶּן־פַּשְׁח֖וּר בֶּן־מַלְכִּיָּֽה׃
verses.translit: v'chyhm 'shh hml'khh lbyt shmnh m'vt 'shrym vshnym v'dyh bnyrchm bnpllyh bn'mtsy bnzkhryh bnpshchvr bnmlkhyh
verses.translation: and their brethren that did the work of the house, eight hundred twenty and two; and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶחָיו֙ רָאשִׁ֣ים לְאָב֔וֹת מָאתַ֖יִם אַרְבָּעִ֣ים וּשְׁנָ֑יִם וַעֲמַשְׁסַ֧י בֶּן־עֲזַרְאֵ֛ל בֶּן־אַחְזַ֥י בֶּן־מְשִׁלֵּמ֖וֹת בֶּן־אִמֵּֽר׃
verses.translit: v'chyv r'shym l'bvt m'tym 'rb'ym vshnym v'mshsy bn'zr'l bn'chzy bnmshlmvt bn'mr
verses.translation: and his brethren, chiefs of fathers’houses, two hundred forty and two; and Amashsai the son of Azarel, the son of Ahzai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲחֵיהֶם֙ גִּבֹּ֣רֵי חַ֔יִל מֵאָ֖ה עֶשְׂרִ֣ים וּשְׁמֹנָ֑ה וּפָקִ֣יד עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם זַבְדִּיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־הַגְּדוֹלִֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'chyhm gbry chyl m'h 'shrym vshmnh vpqyd 'lyhm zbdy'l bnhgdvlym {s}
verses.translation: and their brethren, mighty men of valour, a hundred twenty and eight; and their overseer was Zabdiel, the son of Haggedolim.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִֽן־הַלְוִיִּ֑ם שְׁמַעְיָ֧ה בֶן־חַשּׁ֛וּב בֶּן־עַזְרִיקָ֥ם בֶּן־חֲשַׁבְיָ֖ה בֶּן־בּוּנִּֽי׃
verses.translit: vmnhlvym shm'yh bnchshvb bn'zryqm bnchshbyh bnbvny
verses.translation: And of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשַׁבְּתַ֨י וְיוֹזָבָ֜ד עַל־הַמְּלָאכָ֤ה הַחִֽיצֹנָה֙ לְבֵ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים מֵרָאשֵׁ֖י הַלְוִיִּֽם׃
verses.translit: vshbty vyvzbd 'lhml'khh hchytsnh lbyt h'lhym mr'shy hlvym
verses.translation: and Shabbethai and Jozabad, of the chiefs of the Levites, who had the oversight of the outward business of the house of God;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמַתַּנְיָ֣ה בֶן־מִ֠יכָ֠א בֶּן־זַבְדִּ֨י בֶן־אָסָ֜ף רֹ֗אשׁ הַתְּחִלָּה֙ יְהוֹדֶ֣ה לַתְּפִלָּ֔ה וּבַקְבֻּקְיָ֖ה מִשְׁנֶ֣ה מֵאֶחָ֑יו וְעַבְדָּא֙ בֶּן־שַׁמּ֔וּעַ בֶּן־גָּלָ֖ל בֶּן־[יְדוּתֽוּן] (ידיתון)׃
verses.translit: vmtnyh bnmykh' bnzbdy bn'sf r'sh htchlh yhvdh ltplh vbqbqyh mshnh m'chyv v'bd' bnshmv' bngll bn[ydvtvn] (ydytvn)
verses.translation: and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, who was the chief to begin the thanksgiving in prayer, and Bakbukiah, the second among his brethren; and Abda the son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־הַלְוִיִּם֙ בְּעִ֣יר הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ מָאתַ֖יִם שְׁמֹנִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khlhlvym b'yr hqdsh m'tym shmnym v'rb'h {p}
verses.translation: All the Levites in the holy city were two hundred fourscore and four.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַשּֽׁוֹעֲרִים֙ עַקּ֣וּב טַלְמ֔וֹן וַאֲחֵיהֶ֖ם הַשֹּׁמְרִ֣ים בַּשְּׁעָרִ֑ים מֵאָ֖ה שִׁבְעִ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vhshv'rym 'qvb tlmvn v'chyhm hshmrym bsh'rym m'h shb'ym vshnym
verses.translation: Moreover the porters, Akkub, Talmon, and their brethren, that kept watch at the gates, were a hundred seventy and two.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׁאָ֨ר יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל הַכֹּהֲנִ֤ים הַלְוִיִּם֙ בְּכׇל־עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה אִ֖ישׁ בְּנַחֲלָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vsh'r yshr'l hkhhnym hlvym bkhl'ry yhvdh 'ysh bnchltv
verses.translation: And the residue of Israel, of the priests, the Levites, were in all the cities of Judah, every one in his inheritance.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַנְּתִינִ֖ים יֹשְׁבִ֣ים בָּעֹ֑פֶל וְצִיחָ֥א וְגִשְׁפָּ֖א עַל־הַנְּתִינִֽים׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhntynym yshbym b'pl vtsych' vgshp' 'lhntynym {p}
verses.translation: But the Nethinim dwelt in Ophel; and Ziha and Gishpa were over the Nethinim.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּפְקִ֤יד הַלְוִיִּם֙ בִּיר֣וּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם עֻזִּ֤י בֶן־בָּנִי֙ בֶּן־חֲשַׁבְיָ֔ה בֶּן־מַתַּנְיָ֖ה בֶּן־מִיכָ֑א מִבְּנֵ֤י אָסָף֙ הַמְשֹׁ֣רְרִ֔ים לְנֶ֖גֶד מְלֶ֥אכֶת בֵּית־הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: vpqyd hlvym byrvshl͏m 'zy bnbny bnchshbyh bnmtnyh bnmykh' mbny 'sf hmshrrym lngd ml'kht byth'lhym
verses.translation: The overseer also of the Levites at Jerusalem was Uzzi the son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Mica, of the sons of Asaph, the singers, over the business of the house of God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־מִצְוַ֥ת הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם וַאֲמָנָ֥ה עַל־הַמְשֹׁרְרִ֖ים דְּבַר־י֥וֹם בְּיוֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: khymtsvt hmlkh 'lyhm v'mnh 'lhmshrrym dbryvm byvmv
verses.translation: For there was a commandment from the king concerning them, and a sure ordinance concerning the singers, as every day required.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)
