verses.original: וּפְתַֽחְיָ֨ה בֶן־מְשֵֽׁיזַבְאֵ֜ל מִבְּנֵי־זֶ֤רַח בֶּן־יְהוּדָה֙ לְיַ֣ד הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ לְכׇל־דָּבָ֖ר לָעָֽם׃
verses.translit: vptchyh bnmshyzb'l mbnyzrch bnyhvdh lyd hmlkh lkhldbr l'm
verses.translation: And Pethahiah the son of Meshezabel, of the children of Zerah the son of Judah, was at the king’s hand in all matters concerning the people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶל־הַחֲצֵרִ֖ים בִּשְׂדֹתָ֑ם מִבְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה יָֽשְׁב֞וּ בְּקִרְיַ֤ת הָֽאַרְבַּע֙ וּבְנֹתֶ֔יהָ וּבְדִיבֹן֙ וּבְנֹתֶ֔יהָ וּבִֽיקַּבְצְאֵ֖ל וַחֲצֵרֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: v'lhchtsrym bshdtm mbny yhvdh yshbv bqryt h'rb' vbntyh vbdybn vbntyh vbyqbts'l vchtsryh
verses.translation: And for the villages, with their fields, some of the children of Judah dwelt in Kiriath-arba and the towns thereof, and in Dibon and the towns thereof, and in Jekabzeel and the villages thereof;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְיֵשׁ֥וּעַ וּבְמֹלָדָ֖ה וּבְבֵ֥ית פָּֽלֶט׃
verses.translit: vbyshv' vbmldh vbbyt plt
verses.translation: and in Jeshua, and in Moladah, and Beth-pelet;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבַחֲצַ֥ר שׁוּעָ֛ל וּבִבְאֵ֥ר שֶׁ֖בַע וּבְנֹתֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: vbchtsr shv'l vbb'r shb' vbntyh
verses.translation: and in Hazar-shual, and in Beer-sheba and the towns thereof;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְצִֽקְלַ֥ג וּבִמְכֹנָ֖ה וּבִבְנֹתֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: vbtsqlg vbmkhnh vbbntyh
verses.translation: and in Ziklag, and in Meconah and in the towns thereof;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְעֵ֥ין רִמּ֛וֹן וּבְצׇרְעָ֖ה וּבְיַרְמֽוּת׃
verses.translit: vb'yn rmvn vbtsr'h vbyrmvt
verses.translation: and in En-rimmon, and in Zorah, and in Jarmuth;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זָנֹ֤חַ עֲדֻלָּם֙ וְחַצְרֵיהֶ֔ם לָכִישׁ֙ וּשְׂדֹתֶ֔יהָ עֲזֵקָ֖ה וּבְנֹתֶ֑יהָ וַיַּחֲנ֥וּ מִבְּאֵֽר־שֶׁ֖בַע עַד־גֵּ֥יא הִנֹּֽם׃
verses.translit: znch 'dlm vchtsryhm lkhysh vshdtyh 'zqh vbntyh vychnv mb'rshb' 'dgy' hnm
verses.translation: Zanoah, Adullam, and their villages, Lachish and the fields thereof, Azekah and the towns thereof. So they encamped from Beer-sheba unto the valley of Hinnom.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֥י בִנְיָמִ֖ן מִגָּ֑בַע מִכְמָ֣שׂ וְעַיָּ֔ה וּבֵֽית־אֵ֖ל וּבְנֹתֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: vbny bnymn mgb' mkhmsh v'yh vbyt'l vbntyh
verses.translation: And the children of Benjamin from Geba onward, at Michmas and Aijah, and at Beth-el and the towns thereof;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֲנָת֥וֹת נֹ֖ב עֲנָֽנְיָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'ntvt nb 'nnyh
verses.translation: at Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חָצ֥וֹר ׀ רָמָ֖ה גִּתָּֽיִם׃
verses.translit: chtsvr  rmh gtym
verses.translation: Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חָדִ֥יד צְבֹעִ֖ים נְבַלָּֽט׃
verses.translit: chdyd tsb'ym nblt
verses.translation: Hadid, Zeboim, Neballat;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֥ד וְאוֹנ֖וֹ גֵּ֥י הַחֲרָשִֽׁים׃
verses.translit: ld v'vnv gy hchrshym
verses.translation: Lod, and Ono, Ge-harashim.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִ֨ן־הַלְוִיִּ֔ם מַחְלְק֥וֹת יְהוּדָ֖ה לְבִנְיָמִֽין׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vmnhlvym mchlqvt yhvdh lbnymyn {p}
verses.translation: And of the Levites, certain courses in Judah were joined to Benjamin.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ הַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָל֛וּ עִם־זְרֻבָּבֶ֥ל בֶּן־שְׁאַלְתִּיאֵ֖ל וְיֵשׁ֑וּעַ שְׂרָיָ֥ה יִרְמְיָ֖ה עֶזְרָֽא׃
verses.translit: v'lh hkhhnym vhlvym 'shr 'lv 'mzrbbl bnsh'lty'l vyshv' shryh yrmyh 'zr'
verses.translation: Now these are the priests and the Levites that went up with Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua: Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲמַרְיָ֥ה מַלּ֖וּךְ חַטּֽוּשׁ׃
verses.translit: 'mryh mlvkh chtvsh
verses.translation: Amariah, Malluch, Hattush;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁכַנְיָ֥ה רְחֻ֖ם מְרֵמֹֽת׃
verses.translit: shkhnyh rchm mrmt
verses.translation: Shecaniah, Rehum, Meremoth;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עִדּ֥וֹא גִנְּת֖וֹי אֲבִיָּֽה׃
verses.translit: 'dv' gntvy 'byh
verses.translation: Iddo, Ginnethoi, Abijah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִיָּמִ֥ין מַֽעַדְיָ֖ה בִּלְגָּֽה׃
verses.translit: mymyn m'dyh blgh
verses.translation: Mijamin, Maadiah, Bilgah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁמַֽעְיָ֥ה וְיוֹיָרִ֖יב יְדַֽעְיָֽה׃
verses.translit: shm'yh vyvyryb yd'yh
verses.translation: Shemaiah, and Joiarib, Jedaiah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: סַלּ֣וּ עָמ֔וֹק חִלְקִיָּ֖ה יְדַֽעְיָ֑ה אֵ֣לֶּה רָאשֵׁ֧י הַכֹּהֲנִ֛ים וַאֲחֵיהֶ֖ם בִּימֵ֥י יֵשֽׁוּעַ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: slv 'mvq chlqyh yd'yh 'lh r'shy hkhhnym v'chyhm bymy yshv' {p}
verses.translation: Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah, Jedaiah. These were the chiefs of the priests and their brethren in the days of Jeshua.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַלְוִיִּ֗ם יֵשׁ֧וּעַ בִּנּ֛וּי קַדְמִיאֵ֥ל שֵׁרֵבְיָ֖ה יְהוּדָ֣ה מַתַּנְיָ֑ה עַֽל־הֻיְּד֖וֹת ה֥וּא וְאֶחָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vhlvym yshv' bnvy qdmy'l shrbyh yhvdh mtnyh 'lhydvt hv' v'chyv
verses.translation: Moreover the Levites: Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, and Mattaniah, who was over the thanksgiving, he and his brethren.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבַקְבֻּֽקְיָ֨ה (וענו) [וְעֻנִּ֧י] אֲחֵיהֶ֛ם לְנֶגְדָּ֖ם לְמִשְׁמָרֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vbqbqyh (v'nv) [v'ny] 'chyhm lngdm lmshmrvt
verses.translation: Also Bakbukiah and Unni, their brethren, were over against them in wards.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיֵשׁ֖וּעַ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־יֽוֹיָקִ֑ים וְיֽוֹיָקִים֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־אֶלְיָשִׁ֔יב וְאֶלְיָשִׁ֖יב אֶת־יוֹיָדָֽע׃
verses.translit: vyshv' hvlyd 'tyvyqym vyvyqym hvlyd 't'lyshyb v'lyshyb 'tyvyd'
verses.translation: And Jeshua begot Joiakim, and Joiakim begot Eliashib, and Eliashib begot Joiada,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיוֹיָדָע֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־יוֹנָתָ֔ן וְיוֹנָתָ֖ן הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־יַדּֽוּעַ׃
verses.translit: vyvyd' hvlyd 'tyvntn vyvntn hvlyd 'tydv'
verses.translation: and Joiada begot Jonathan and Jonathan begot Jaddua.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבִימֵי֙ יֽוֹיָקִ֔ים הָי֥וּ כֹהֲנִ֖ים רָאשֵׁ֣י הָאָב֑וֹת לִשְׂרָיָ֣ה מְרָיָ֔ה לְיִרְמְיָ֖ה חֲנַנְיָֽה׃
verses.translit: vbymy yvyqym hyv khhnym r'shy h'bvt lshryh mryh lyrmyh chnnyh
verses.translation: And in the days of Joiakim were priests, heads of fathers’houses: of Seraiah, Meraiah; of Jeremiah, Hananiah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְעֶזְרָ֣א מְשֻׁלָּ֔ם לַאֲמַרְיָ֖ה יְהוֹחָנָֽן׃
verses.translit: l'zr' mshlm l'mryh yhvchnn
verses.translation: of Ezra, Meshullam; of Amariah, Jehohanan;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (למלוכי) [לִמְלִ֙יכוּ֙] יֽוֹנָתָ֔ן לִשְׁבַנְיָ֖ה יוֹסֵֽף׃
verses.translit: (lmlvkhy) [lmlykhv] yvntn lshbnyh yvsf
verses.translation: of Melicu, Jonathan; of Shebaniah, Joseph;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְחָרִ֣ם עַדְנָ֔א לִמְרָי֖וֹת חֶלְקָֽי׃
verses.translit: lchrm 'dn' lmryvt chlqy
verses.translation: of Harim, Adna; of Meraioth, Helkai;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (לעדיא) [לְעִדּ֥וֹא] זְכַרְיָ֖ה לְגִנְּת֥וֹן מְשֻׁלָּֽם׃
verses.translit: (l'dy') [l'dv'] zkhryh lgntvn mshlm
verses.translation: of Iddo, Zechariah; of Ginnethon, Meshullam;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַאֲבִיָּ֖ה זִכְרִ֑י לְמִ֨נְיָמִ֔ין לְמוֹעַדְיָ֖ה פִּלְטָֽי׃
verses.translit: l'byh zkhry lmnymyn lmv'dyh plty
verses.translation: of Abijah, Zichri; of Miniamin; of Moadiah, Piltai;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְבִלְגָּ֣ה שַׁמּ֔וּעַ לִֽשְׁמַעְיָ֖ה יְהוֹנָתָֽן׃
verses.translit: lblgh shmv' lshm'yh yhvntn
verses.translation: of Bilgah, Shammua; of Shemaiah, Jehonathan;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְיוֹיָרִ֣יב מַתְּנַ֔י לִֽידַֽעְיָ֖ה עֻזִּֽי׃
verses.translit: vlyvyryb mtny lyd'yh 'zy
verses.translation: and of Joiarib, Mattenai; of Jedaiah, Uzzi;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְסַלַּ֥י קַלָּ֖י לְעָמ֥וֹק עֵֽבֶר׃
verses.translit: lsly qly l'mvq 'br
verses.translation: of Sallai, Kallai; of Amok, Eber;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְחִלְקִיָּ֣ה חֲשַׁבְיָ֔ה לִֽידַֽעְיָ֖ה נְתַנְאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: lchlqyh chshbyh lyd'yh ntn'l
verses.translation: of Hilkiah, Hashabiah; of Jedaiah, Nethanel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַלְוִיִּם֩ בִּימֵ֨י אֶלְיָשִׁ֜יב יוֹיָדָ֤ע וְיוֹחָנָן֙ וְיַדּ֔וּעַ כְּתוּבִ֖ים רָאשֵׁ֣י אָב֑וֹת וְהַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים עַל־מַלְכ֖וּת דָּרְיָ֥וֶשׁ הַפָּֽרְסִֽי׃ {פ}
verses.translit: hlvym bymy 'lyshyb yvyd' vyvchnn vydv' khtvbym r'shy 'bvt vhkhhnym 'lmlkhvt dryvsh hprsy {p}
verses.translation: The Levites in the days of Eliashib, Joiada, and Johanan, and Jaddua, were recorded heads of fathers’houses; also the priests, in the reign of Darius the Persian.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֤י לֵוִי֙ רָאשֵׁ֣י הָֽאָב֔וֹת כְּתוּבִ֕ים עַל־סֵ֖פֶר דִּבְרֵ֣י הַיָּמִ֑ים וְעַד־יְמֵ֖י יֽוֹחָנָ֥ן בֶּן־אֶלְיָשִֽׁיב׃
verses.translit: bny lvy r'shy h'bvt khtvbym 'lspr dbry hymym v'dymy yvchnn bn'lyshyb
verses.translation: The sons of Levi, heads of fathers’houses, were written in the book of the chronicles, even until the days of Johanan the son of Eliashib.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרָאשֵׁ֣י הַ֠לְוִיִּ֠ם חֲשַׁבְיָ֨ה שֵֽׁרֵבְיָ֜ה וְיֵשׁ֤וּעַ בֶּן־קַדְמִיאֵל֙ וַאֲחֵיהֶ֣ם לְנֶגְדָּ֔ם לְהַלֵּ֣ל לְהוֹד֔וֹת בְּמִצְוַ֖ת דָּוִ֣יד אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים מִשְׁמָ֖ר לְעֻמַּ֥ת מִשְׁמָֽר׃
verses.translit: vr'shy hlvym chshbyh shrbyh vyshv' bnqdmy'l v'chyhm lngdm lhll lhvdvt bmtsvt dvyd 'yshh'lhym mshmr l'mt mshmr
verses.translation: And the chiefs of the Levites: Hashabiah, Sherebiah, and Jeshua the son of Kadmiel, with their brethren over against them, to praise and give thanks, according to the commandment of David the man of God, ward against ward.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַתַּנְיָ֧ה וּבַקְבֻּֽקְיָ֛ה עֹבַדְיָ֥ה מְשֻׁלָּ֖ם טַלְמ֣וֹן עַקּ֑וּב שֹׁמְרִ֤ים שֽׁוֹעֲרִים֙ מִשְׁמָ֔ר בַּאֲסֻפֵּ֖י הַשְּׁעָרִֽים׃
verses.translit: mtnyh vbqbqyh 'bdyh mshlm tlmvn 'qvb shmrym shv'rym mshmr b'spy hsh'rym
verses.translation: Mattaniah, and Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, Akkub, were porters keeping the ward at the store-houses of the gates.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֕לֶּה בִּימֵ֛י יוֹיָקִ֥ים בֶּן־יֵשׁ֖וּעַ בֶּן־יוֹצָדָ֑ק וּבִימֵי֙ נְחֶמְיָ֣ה הַפֶּחָ֔ה וְעֶזְרָ֥א הַכֹּהֵ֖ן הַסּוֹפֵֽר׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'lh bymy yvyqym bnyshv' bnyvtsdq vbymy nchmyh hpchh v'zr' hkhhn hsvpr {p}
verses.translation: These were in the days of Joiakim the son of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor, and of Ezra the priest the scribe.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבַחֲנֻכַּ֞ת חוֹמַ֣ת יְרוּשָׁלַ֗͏ִם בִּקְשׁ֤וּ אֶת־הַלְוִיִּם֙ מִכׇּל־מְק֣וֹמֹתָ֔ם לַהֲבִיאָ֖ם לִֽירוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם לַעֲשֹׂ֨ת חֲנֻכָּ֤ה וְשִׂמְחָה֙ וּבְתוֹד֣וֹת וּבְשִׁ֔יר מְצִלְתַּ֖יִם נְבָלִ֥ים וּבְכִנֹּרֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vbchnkht chvmt yrvshl͏m bqshv 'thlvym mkhlmqvmtm lhby'm lyrvshl͏m l'sht chnkhh vshmchh vbtvdvt vbshyr mtsltym nblym vbkhnrvt
verses.translation: And at the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem they sought the Levites out of all their places, to bring them to Jerusalem, to keep the dedication with gladness, both with thanksgivings, and with singing, with cymbals, psalteries, and with harps.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּאָ֣סְפ֔וּ בְּנֵ֖י הַמְשֹׁרְרִ֑ים וּמִן־הַכִּכָּר֙ סְבִיב֣וֹת יְרוּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם וּמִן־חַצְרֵ֖י נְטֹפָתִֽי׃
verses.translit: vy'spv bny hmshrrym vmnhkhkhr sbybvt yrvshl͏m vmnchtsry ntpty
verses.translation: And the sons of the singers gathered themselves together, both out of the Plain round about Jerusalem, and from the villages of the Netophathites;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִבֵּית֙ הַגִּלְגָּ֔ל וּמִשְּׂד֥וֹת גֶּ֖בַע וְעַזְמָ֑וֶת כִּ֣י חֲצֵרִ֗ים בָּנ֤וּ לָהֶם֙ הַמְשֹׁ֣רְרִ֔ים סְבִיב֖וֹת יְרוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: vmbyt hglgl vmshdvt gb' v'zmvt khy chtsrym bnv lhm hmshrrym sbybvt yrvshl͏m
verses.translation: also from Beth-gilgal, and out of the fields of Geba and Azmaveth; for the singers had builded them villages round about Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּֽטַּהֲר֔וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֑ם וַֽיְטַהֲרוּ֙ אֶת־הָעָ֔ם וְאֶת־הַשְּׁעָרִ֖ים וְאֶת־הַחוֹמָֽה׃
verses.translit: vythrv hkhhnym vhlvym vythrv 'th'm v'thsh'rym v'thchvmh
verses.translation: And the priests and the Levites purified themselves; and they purified the people, and the gates, and the wall.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאַעֲלֶה֙ אֶת־שָׂרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה מֵעַ֖ל לַחוֹמָ֑ה וָאַעֲמִ֡ידָה שְׁתֵּ֣י תוֹדֹת֩ גְּדוֹלֹ֨ת וְתַהֲלֻכֹ֤ת לַיָּמִין֙ מֵעַ֣ל לַחוֹמָ֔ה לְשַׁ֖עַר הָאַשְׁפֹּֽת׃
verses.translit: v''lh 'tshry yhvdh m'l lchvmh v''mydh shty tvdt gdvlt vthlkht lymyn m'l lchvmh lsh'r h'shpt
verses.translation: Then I brought up the princes of Judah upon the wall, and appointed two great companies that gave thanks and went in procession: on the right hand upon the wall toward the dung gate;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֤לֶךְ אַחֲרֵיהֶם֙ הוֹשַׁ֣עְיָ֔ה וַחֲצִ֖י שָׂרֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.translit: vylkh 'chryhm hvsh'yh vchtsy shry yhvdh
verses.translation: and after them went Hoshaiah, and half of the princes of Judah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַעֲזַרְיָ֥ה עֶזְרָ֖א וּמְשֻׁלָּֽם׃
verses.translit: v'zryh 'zr' vmshlm
verses.translation: and Azariah, Ezra, and Meshullam,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהוּדָה֙ וּבִנְיָמִ֔ן וּֽשְׁמַֽעְיָ֖ה וְיִרְמְיָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: yhvdh vbnymn vshm'yh vyrmyh {p}
verses.translation: Judah, and Benjamin, and Shemaiah, and Jeremiah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִבְּנֵ֥י הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים בַּחֲצֹצְר֑וֹת זְכַרְיָ֨ה בֶן־יֽוֹנָתָ֜ן בֶּן־שְׁמַֽעְיָ֗ה בֶּן־מַתַּנְיָה֙ בֶּן־מִ֣יכָיָ֔ה בֶּן־זַכּ֖וּר בֶּן־אָסָֽף׃
verses.translit: vmbny hkhhnym bchtstsrvt zkhryh bnyvntn bnshm'yh bnmtnyh bnmykhyh bnzkhvr bn'sf
verses.translation: and certain of the priests’sons with trumpets: Zechariah the son of Jonathan, the son of Shemaiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Micaiah, the son of Zaccur, the son of Asaph;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽאֶחָ֡יו שְֽׁמַעְיָ֡ה וַעֲזַרְאֵ֡ל מִֽלְלַ֡י גִּֽלְלַ֡י מָעַ֞י נְתַנְאֵ֤ל וִֽיהוּדָה֙ חֲנָ֔נִי בִּכְלֵי־שִׁ֥יר דָּוִ֖יד אִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְעֶזְרָ֥א הַסּוֹפֵ֖ר לִפְנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v'chyv shm'yh v'zr'l mlly glly m'y ntn'l vyhvdh chnny bkhlyshyr dvyd 'ysh h'lhym v'zr' hsvpr lpnyhm
verses.translation: and his brethren, Shemaiah, and Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethanel, and Judah, Hanani, with the musical instruments of David the man of God; and Ezra the scribe was before them;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַל֩ שַׁ֨עַר הָעַ֜יִן וְנֶגְדָּ֗ם עָלוּ֙ עַֽל־מַעֲלוֹת֙ עִ֣יר דָּוִ֔יד בַּֽמַּעֲלֶ֖ה לַחוֹמָ֑ה מֵעַל֙ לְבֵ֣ית דָּוִ֔יד וְעַ֛ד שַׁ֥עַר הַמַּ֖יִם מִזְרָֽח׃
verses.translit: v'l sh'r h'yn vngdm 'lv 'lm'lvt 'yr dvyd bm'lh lchvmh m'l lbyt dvyd v'd sh'r hmym mzrch
verses.translation: and by the fountain gate, and straight before them, they went up by the stairs of the city of David, at the going up of the wall, above the house of David, even unto the water gate eastward.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַתּוֹדָ֧ה הַשֵּׁנִ֛ית הַהוֹלֶ֥כֶת לְמ֖וֹאל וַאֲנִ֣י אַחֲרֶ֑יהָ וַחֲצִ֨י הָעָ֜ם מֵעַ֣ל לְהַחוֹמָ֗ה מֵעַל֙ לְמִגְדַּ֣ל הַתַּנּוּרִ֔ים וְעַ֖ד הַחוֹמָ֥ה הָרְחָבָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhtvdh hshnyt hhvlkht lmv'l v'ny 'chryh vchtsy h'm m'l lhchvmh m'l lmgdl htnvrym v'd hchvmh hrchbh
verses.translation: And the other company of them that gave thanks went to meet them, and I after them, with the half of the people, upon the wall, above the tower of the furnaces, even unto the broad wall;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמֵעַ֣ל לְשַֽׁעַר־אֶ֠פְרַ֠יִם וְעַל־שַׁ֨עַר הַיְשָׁנָ֜ה וְעַל־שַׁ֣עַר הַדָּגִ֗ים וּמִגְדַּ֤ל חֲנַנְאֵל֙ וּמִגְדַּ֣ל הַמֵּאָ֔ה וְעַ֖ד שַׁ֣עַר הַצֹּ֑אן וְעָ֣מְד֔וּ בְּשַׁ֖עַר הַמַּטָּרָֽה׃
verses.translit: vm'l lsh'r'prym v'lsh'r hyshnh v'lsh'r hdgym vmgdl chnn'l vmgdl hm'h v'd sh'r hts'n v'mdv bsh'r hmtrh
verses.translation: and above the gate of Ephraim, and by the gate of the old city and by the fish gate, and the tower of Hananel, and the tower of Hammeah, even unto the sheep gate; and they stood still in the gate of the guard.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽתַּעֲמֹ֛דְנָה שְׁתֵּ֥י הַתּוֹדֹ֖ת בְּבֵ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וַאֲנִ֕י וַחֲצִ֥י הַסְּגָנִ֖ים עִמִּֽי׃
verses.translit: vt'mdnh shty htvdt bbyt h'lhym v'ny vchtsy hsgnym 'my
verses.translation: So stood the two companies of them that gave thanks in the house of God, and I, and the half of the rulers with me;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַכֹּהֲנִ֡ים אֶלְיָקִ֡ים מַעֲשֵׂיָ֡ה מִ֠נְיָמִ֠ין מִיכָיָ֧ה אֶלְיוֹעֵינַ֛י זְכַרְיָ֥ה חֲנַנְיָ֖ה בַּחֲצֹצְרֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vhkhhnym 'lyqym m'shyh mnymyn mykhyh 'lyv'yny zkhryh chnnyh bchtstsrvt
verses.translation: and the priests, Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Micaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, and Hananiah, with trumpets;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמַעֲשֵׂיָ֨ה וּֽשְׁמַֽעְיָ֜ה וְאֶלְעָזָ֧ר וְעֻזִּ֛י וִֽיהוֹחָנָ֥ן וּמַלְכִּיָּ֖ה וְעֵילָ֣ם וָעָ֑זֶר וַיַּשְׁמִ֙יעוּ֙ הַמְשֹׁ֣רְרִ֔ים וְיִֽזְרַחְיָ֖ה הַפָּקִֽיד׃
verses.translit: vm'shyh vshm'yh v'l'zr v'zy vyhvchnn vmlkhyh v'ylm v'zr vyshmy'v hmshrrym vyzrchyh hpqyd
verses.translation: and Maaseiah, and Shemaiah, and Eleazar, and Uzzi, and Jehohanan, and Malchijah, and Elam, and Ezer. And the singers sang loud, with Jezrahiah their overseer.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּזְבְּח֣וּ בַיּוֹם־הַ֠ה֠וּא זְבָחִ֨ים גְּדוֹלִ֜ים וַיִּשְׂמָ֗חוּ כִּ֤י הָאֱלֹהִים֙ שִׂמְּחָם֙ שִׂמְחָ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֔ה וְגַ֧ם הַנָּשִׁ֛ים וְהַיְלָדִ֖ים שָׂמֵ֑חוּ וַתִּשָּׁמַ֛ע שִׂמְחַ֥ת יְרוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם מֵרָחֽוֹק׃
verses.translit: vyzbchv byvmhhv' zbchym gdvlym vyshmchv khy h'lhym shmchm shmchh gdvlh vgm hnshym vhyldym shmchv vtshm' shmcht yrvshl͏m mrchvq
verses.translation: And they offered great sacrifices that day, and rejoiced; for God had made them rejoice with great joy; and the women also and the children rejoiced; so that the joy of Jerusalem was heard even afar off.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּפָּקְד֣וּ בַיּוֹם֩ הַה֨וּא אֲנָשִׁ֜ים עַל־הַנְּשָׁכ֗וֹת לָא֨וֹצָר֥וֹת לַתְּרוּמוֹת֮ לָרֵאשִׁ֣ית וְלַמַּֽעַשְׂרוֹת֒ לִכְנ֨וֹס בָּהֶ֜ם לִשְׂדֵ֤י הֶעָרִים֙ מְנָא֣וֹת הַתּוֹרָ֔ה לַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְלַלְוִיִּ֑ם כִּ֚י שִׂמְחַ֣ת יְהוּדָ֔ה עַל־הַכֹּהֲנִ֥ים וְעַל־הַלְוִיִּ֖ם הָעֹמְדִֽים׃
verses.translit: vypqdv byvm hhv' 'nshym 'lhnshkhvt l'vtsrvt ltrvmvt lr'shyt vlm'shrvt lkhnvs bhm lshdy h'rym mn'vt htvrh lkhhnym vllvym khy shmcht yhvdh 'lhkhhnym v'lhlvym h'mdym
verses.translation: And on that day were men appointed over the chambers for the treasures, for the heave-offerings, for the first-fruits, and for the tithes, to gather into them, according to the fields of the cities, the portions appointed by the law for the priests and Levites; for Judah rejoiced for the priests and for the Levites that took their stations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיִּשְׁמְר֞וּ מִשְׁמֶ֤רֶת אֱלֹֽהֵיהֶם֙ וּמִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת הַֽטׇּהֳרָ֔ה וְהַמְשֹׁרְרִ֖ים וְהַשֹּׁעֲרִ֑ים כְּמִצְוַ֥ת דָּוִ֖יד שְׁלֹמֹ֥ה בְנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyshmrv mshmrt 'lhyhm vmshmrt hthrh vhmshrrym vhsh'rym khmtsvt dvyd shlmh bnv
verses.translation: And they kept the ward of their God, and the ward of the purification, and so did the singers and the porters, according to the commandment of David, and of Solomon his son.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־בִימֵ֥י דָוִ֛יד וְאָסָ֖ף מִקֶּ֑דֶם (ראש) [רָאשֵׁי֙] הַמְשֹׁ֣רְרִ֔ים וְשִׁיר־תְּהִלָּ֥ה וְהֹד֖וֹת לֵֽאלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: khybymy dvyd v'sf mqdm (r'sh) [r'shy] hmshrrym vshyrthlh vhdvt l'lhym
verses.translation: For in the days of David and Asaph of old there were chief of the singers, and songs of praise and thanksgiving unto God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכׇל־יִשְׂרָאֵל֩ בִּימֵ֨י זְרֻבָּבֶ֜ל וּבִימֵ֣י נְחֶמְיָ֗ה נֹ֥תְנִ֛ים מְנָי֛וֹת הַמְשֹׁרְרִ֥ים וְהַשֹּׁעֲרִ֖ים דְּבַר־י֣וֹם בְּיוֹמ֑וֹ וּמַקְדִּשִׁים֙ לַלְוִיִּ֔ם וְהַ֨לְוִיִּ֔ם מַקְדִּשִׁ֖ים לִבְנֵ֥י אַהֲרֹֽן׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vkhlyshr'l bymy zrbbl vbymy nchmyh ntnym mnyvt hmshrrym vhsh'rym dbryvm byvmv vmqdshym llvym vhlvym mqdshym lbny 'hrn {p}
verses.translation: And all Israel in the days of Zerubbabel, and in the days of Nehemiah, gave the portions of the singers and the porters, as every day required; and they hallowed for the Levites; and the Levites hallowed for the sons of Aaron.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא נִקְרָ֛א בְּסֵ֥פֶר מֹשֶׁ֖ה בְּאׇזְנֵ֣י הָעָ֑ם וְנִמְצָא֙ כָּת֣וּב בּ֔וֹ אֲ֠שֶׁ֠ר לֹא־יָב֨וֹא עַמֹּנִ֧י וּמוֹאָבִ֛י בִּקְהַ֥ל הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים עַד־עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: byvm hhv' nqr' bspr mshh b'zny h'm vnmts' khtvb bv 'shr l'ybv' 'mny vmv'by bqhl h'lhym 'd'vlm
verses.translation: On that day they read in the book of Moses in the hearing of the people; and therein was found written, that an Ammonite and a Moabite should not enter into the assembly of God for ever;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י לֹ֧א קִדְּמ֛וּ אֶת־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בַּלֶּ֣חֶם וּבַמָּ֑יִם וַיִּשְׂכֹּ֨ר עָלָ֤יו אֶת־בִּלְעָם֙ לְקַֽלְל֔וֹ וַיַּהֲפֹ֧ךְ אֱלֹהֵ֛ינוּ הַקְּלָלָ֖ה לִבְרָכָֽה׃
verses.translit: khy l' qdmv 'tbny yshr'l blchm vbmym vyshkhr 'lyv 'tbl'm lqllv vyhpkh 'lhynv hqllh lbrkhh
verses.translation: because they met not the children of Israel with bread and with water, but hired Balaam against them, to curse them; howbeit our God turned the curse into a blessing.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֖י כְּשׇׁמְעָ֣ם אֶת־הַתּוֹרָ֑ה וַיַּבְדִּ֥ילוּ כׇל־עֵ֖רֶב מִיִּשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vyhy khshm'm 'thtvrh vybdylv khl'rb myshr'l
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when they had heard the law, that they separated from Israel all the alien mixture.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלִפְנֵ֣י מִזֶּ֔ה אֶלְיָשִׁיב֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן נָת֖וּן בְּלִשְׁכַּ֣ת בֵּית־אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ קָר֖וֹב לְטוֹבִיָּֽה׃
verses.translit: vlpny mzh 'lyshyb hkhhn ntvn blshkht byt'lhynv qrvb ltvbyh
verses.translation: Now before this, Eliashib the priest, who was appointed over the chambers of the house of our God, being allied unto Tobiah,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֨עַשׂ ל֜וֹ לִשְׁכָּ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֗ה וְשָׁ֣ם הָי֪וּ לְפָנִ֟ים נֹ֠תְנִ֠ים אֶת־הַמִּנְחָ֨ה הַלְּבוֹנָ֜ה וְהַכֵּלִ֗ים וּמַעְשַׂ֤ר הַדָּגָן֙ הַתִּיר֣וֹשׁ וְהַיִּצְהָ֔ר מִצְוַת֙ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם וְהַמְשֹׁרְרִ֖ים וְהַשּׁוֹעֲרִ֑ים וּתְרוּמַ֖ת הַכֹּהֲנִֽים׃
verses.translit: vy'sh lv lshkhh gdvlh vshm hyv lpnym ntnym 'thmnchh hlbvnh vhkhlym vm'shr hdgn htyrvsh vhytshr mtsvt hlvym vhmshrrym vhshv'rym vtrvmt hkhhnym
verses.translation: had prepared for him a great chamber, where aforetime they laid the meal-offerings, the frankincense, and the vessels, and the tithes of the corn, the wine, and the oil, which were given by commandment to the Levites, and the singers, and the porters; and the heave-offerings for the priests.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְכׇל־זֶ֕ה לֹ֥א הָיִ֖יתִי בִּֽירוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם כִּ֡י בִּשְׁנַת֩ שְׁלֹשִׁ֨ים וּשְׁתַּ֜יִם לְאַרְתַּחְשַׁ֤סְתְּא מֶֽלֶךְ־בָּבֶל֙ בָּ֣אתִי אֶל־הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וּלְקֵ֥ץ יָמִ֖ים נִשְׁאַ֥לְתִּי מִן־הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.translit: vbkhlzh l' hyyty byrvshl͏m khy bshnt shlshym vshtym l'rtchshst' mlkhbbl b'ty 'lhmlkh vlqts ymym nsh'lty mnhmlkh
verses.translation: But in all this time I was not at Jerusalem; for in the two and thirtieth year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon I went unto the king, and after certain days asked I leave of the king;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאָב֖וֹא לִֽירוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם וָאָבִ֣ינָה בָרָעָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֤ה אֶלְיָשִׁיב֙ לְט֣וֹבִיָּ֔ה לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת לוֹ֙ נִשְׁכָּ֔ה בְּחַצְרֵ֖י בֵּ֥ית הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: v'bv' lyrvshl͏m v'bynh br'h 'shr 'shh 'lyshyb ltvbyh l'shvt lv nshkhh bchtsry byt h'lhym
verses.translation: and I came to Jerusalem, and understood the evil that Eliashib had done for Tobiah, in preparing him a chamber in the courts of the house of God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֥רַֽע לִ֖י מְאֹ֑ד וָֽאַשְׁלִ֜יכָה אֶֽת־כׇּל־כְּלֵ֧י בֵית־טוֹבִיָּ֛ה הַח֖וּץ מִן־הַלִּשְׁכָּֽה׃
verses.translit: vyr' ly m'd v'shlykhh 'tkhlkhly byttvbyh hchvts mnhlshkhh
verses.translation: And it grieved me sore; therefore I cast forth all the household stuff of Tobiah out of the chamber.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֹ֣מְרָ֔ה וַֽיְטַהֲר֖וּ הַלְּשָׁכ֑וֹת וָאָשִׁ֣יבָה שָּׁ֗ם כְּלֵי֙ בֵּ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים אֶת־הַמִּנְחָ֖ה וְהַלְּבוֹנָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'mrh vythrv hlshkhvt v'shybh shm khly byt h'lhym 'thmnchh vhlbvnh {p}
verses.translation: Then I commanded, and they cleansed the chambers; and thither brought I again the vessels of the house of God, with the meal-offerings and the frankincense.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֵ֣דְעָ֔ה כִּֽי־מְנָי֥וֹת הַלְוִיִּ֖ם לֹ֣א נִתָּ֑נָה וַיִּבְרְח֧וּ אִישׁ־לְשָׂדֵ֛הוּ הַלְוִיִּ֥ם וְהַמְשֹׁרְרִ֖ים עֹשֵׂ֥י הַמְּלָאכָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'd'h khymnyvt hlvym l' ntnh vybrchv 'yshlshdhv hlvym vhmshrrym 'shy hml'khh
verses.translation: And I perceived that the portions of the Levites had not been given them; so that the Levites and the singers, that did the work, were fled every one to his field.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאָרִ֙יבָה֙ אֶת־הַסְּגָנִ֔ים וָאֹ֣מְרָ֔ה מַדּ֖וּעַ נֶעֱזַ֣ב בֵּית־הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וָֽאֶקְבְּצֵ֔ם וָֽאַעֲמִדֵ֖ם עַל־עׇמְדָֽם׃
verses.translit: v'rybh 'thsgnym v'mrh mdv' n'zb byth'lhym v'qbtsm v''mdm 'l'mdm
verses.translation: Then contended I with the rulers, and said: ‘Why is the house of God forsaken?’ And I gathered them together, and set them in their place.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכׇל־יְהוּדָ֗ה הֵבִ֜יאוּ מַעְשַׂ֧ר הַדָּגָ֛ן וְהַתִּיר֥וֹשׁ וְהַיִּצְהָ֖ר לָאוֹצָרֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vkhlyhvdh hby'v m'shr hdgn vhtyrvsh vhytshr l'vtsrvt
verses.translation: Then brought all Judah the tithe of the corn and the wine and the oil unto the treasuries.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאוֹצְרָ֣ה עַל־א֠וֹצָר֠וֹת שֶׁלֶמְיָ֨ה הַכֹּהֵ֜ן וְצָד֣וֹק הַסּוֹפֵ֗ר וּפְדָיָה֙ מִן־הַלְוִיִּ֔ם וְעַ֨ל־יָדָ֔ם חָנָ֥ן בֶּן־זַכּ֖וּר בֶּן־מַתַּנְיָ֑ה כִּ֤י נֶאֱמָנִים֙ נֶחְשָׁ֔בוּ וַעֲלֵיהֶ֖ם לַחֲלֹ֥ק לַאֲחֵיהֶֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'vtsrh 'l'vtsrvt shlmyh hkhhn vtsdvq hsvpr vpdyh mnhlvym v'lydm chnn bnzkhvr bnmtnyh khy n'mnym nchshbv v'lyhm lchlq l'chyhm {p}
verses.translation: And I made treasurers over the treasuries, Shelemiah the priest, and Zadok the scribe, and of the Levites, Pedaiah; and next to them was Hanan the son of Zaccur, the son of Mattaniah; for they were counted faithful, and their office was to distribute unto their brethren.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זׇכְרָה־לִּ֥י אֱלֹהַ֖י עַל־זֹ֑את וְאַל־תֶּ֣מַח חֲסָדַ֗י אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂ֛יתִי בְּבֵ֥ית אֱלֹהַ֖י וּבְמִשְׁמָרָֽיו׃
verses.translit: zkhrhly 'lhy 'lz't v'ltmch chsdy 'shr 'shyty bbyt 'lhy vbmshmryv
verses.translation: Remember me, O my God, concerning this, and wipe not out my good deeds that I have done for the house of my God, and for the wards thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵ֡מָּה רָאִ֣יתִי בִֽיהוּדָ֣ה ׀ דֹּֽרְכִֽים־גִּתּ֣וֹת ׀ בַּשַּׁבָּ֡ת וּמְבִיאִ֣ים הָעֲרֵמ֣וֹת וְֽעֹמְסִ֪ים עַל־הַחֲמֹרִ֟ים וְאַף־יַ֜יִן עֲנָבִ֤ים וּתְאֵנִים֙ וְכׇל־מַשָּׂ֔א וּמְבִיאִ֥ים יְרוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם בְּי֣וֹם הַשַּׁבָּ֑ת וָאָעִ֕יד בְּי֖וֹם מִכְרָ֥ם צָֽיִד׃
verses.translit: bymym hhmh r'yty byhvdh  drkhymgtvt  bshbt vmby'ym h'rmvt v'msym 'lhchmrym v'fyyn 'nbym vt'nym vkhlmsh' vmby'ym yrvshl͏m byvm hshbt v''yd byvm mkhrm tsyd
verses.translation: In those days saw I in Judah some treading winepresses on the sabbath, and bringing in heaps of corn, and lading asses therewith; as also wine, grapes, and figs, and all manner of burdens, which they brought into Jerusalem on the sabbath day; and I forewarned them in the day wherein they sold victuals.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַצֹּרִים֙ יָ֣שְׁבוּ בָ֔הּ מְבִיאִ֥ים דָּ֖אג וְכׇל־מֶ֑כֶר וּמוֹכְרִ֧ים בַּשַּׁבָּ֛ת לִבְנֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה וּבִירוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: vhtsrym yshbv bh mby'ym d'g vkhlmkhr vmvkhrym bshbt lbny yhvdh vbyrvshl͏m
verses.translation: There dwelt men of Tyre also therein, who brought in fish, and all manner of ware, and sold on the sabbath unto the children of Judah, and in Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאָרִ֕יבָה אֵ֖ת חֹרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה וָאֹמְרָ֣ה לָהֶ֗ם מָֽה־הַדָּבָ֨ר הָרָ֤ע הַזֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אַתֶּ֣ם עֹשִׂ֔ים וּֽמְחַלְּלִ֖ים אֶת־י֥וֹם הַשַּׁבָּֽת׃
verses.translit: v'rybh 't chry yhvdh v'mrh lhm mhhdbr hr' hzh 'shr 'tm 'shym vmchllym 'tyvm hshbt
verses.translation: Then I contended with the nobles of Judah, and said unto them: ‘What evil thing is this that ye do, and profane the sabbath day?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲל֨וֹא כֹ֤ה עָשׂוּ֙ אֲבֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וַיָּבֵ֨א אֱלֹהֵ֜ינוּ עָלֵ֗ינוּ אֵ֚ת כׇּל־הָרָעָ֣ה הַזֹּ֔את וְעַ֖ל הָעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֑את וְאַתֶּ֞ם מוֹסִיפִ֤ים חָרוֹן֙ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְחַלֵּ֖ל אֶת־הַשַּׁבָּֽת׃ {פ}
verses.translit: hlv' khh 'shv 'btykhm vyb' 'lhynv 'lynv 't khlhr'h hz't v'l h'yr hz't v'tm mvsypym chrvn 'lyshr'l lchll 'thshbt {p}
verses.translation: Did not your fathers thus, and did not our God bring all this evil upon us, and upon this city? yet ye bring more wrath upon Israel by profaning the sabbath.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֡י כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר צָֽלְלוּ֩ שַׁעֲרֵ֨י יְרוּשָׁלַ֜͏ִם לִפְנֵ֣י הַשַּׁבָּ֗ת וָאֹֽמְרָה֙ וַיִּסָּגְר֣וּ הַדְּלָת֔וֹת וָאֹ֣מְרָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹ֣א יִפְתָּח֔וּם עַ֖ד אַחַ֣ר הַשַּׁבָּ֑ת וּמִנְּעָרַ֗י הֶֽעֱמַ֙דְתִּי֙ עַל־הַשְּׁעָרִ֔ים לֹא־יָב֥וֹא מַשָּׂ֖א בְּי֥וֹם הַשַּׁבָּֽת׃
verses.translit: vyhy kh'shr tsllv sh'ry yrvshl͏m lpny hshbt v'mrh vysgrv hdltvt v'mrh 'shr l' yptchvm 'd 'chr hshbt vmn'ry h'mdty 'lhsh'rym l'ybv' msh' byvm hshbt
verses.translation: And it came to pass that, when the gates of Jerusalem began to be dark before the sabbath, I commanded that the doors should be shut, and commanded that they should not be opened till after the sabbath; and some of my servants set I over the gates, that there should no burden be brought in on the sabbath day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּלִ֨ינוּ הָרֹכְלִ֜ים וּמֹכְרֵ֧י כׇל־מִמְכָּ֛ר מִח֥וּץ לִירוּשָׁלָ֖͏ִם פַּ֥עַם וּשְׁתָּֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vylynv hrkhlym vmkhry khlmmkhr mchvts lyrvshl͏m p'm vshtym
verses.translation: So the merchants and sellers of all kind of ware lodged without Jerusalem once or twice.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאָעִ֣ידָה בָהֶ֗ם וָאֹמְרָ֤ה אֲלֵיהֶם֙ מַדּ֜וּעַ אַתֶּ֤ם לֵנִים֙ נֶ֣גֶד הַחוֹמָ֔ה אִם־תִּשְׁנ֕וּ יָ֖ד אֶשְׁלַ֣ח בָּכֶ֑ם מִן־הָעֵ֣ת הַהִ֔יא לֹא־בָ֖אוּ בַּשַּׁבָּֽת׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v''ydh bhm v'mrh 'lyhm mdv' 'tm lnym ngd hchvmh 'mtshnv yd 'shlch bkhm mnh't hhy' l'b'v bshbt {p}
verses.translation: Then I forewarned them, and said unto them: ‘Why lodge ye about the wall? if ye do so again, I will lay hands on you.’ From that time forth came they no more on the sabbath.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֹמְרָ֣ה לַלְוִיִּ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִֽהְי֤וּ מִֽטַּהֲרִים֙ וּבָאִים֙ שֹׁמְרִ֣ים הַשְּׁעָרִ֔ים לְקַדֵּ֖שׁ אֶת־י֣וֹם הַשַּׁבָּ֑ת גַּם־זֹאת֙ זׇכְרָה־לִּ֣י אֱלֹהַ֔י וְח֥וּסָה עָלַ֖י כְּרֹ֥ב חַסְדֶּֽךָ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'mrh llvym 'shr yhyv mthrym vb'ym shmrym hsh'rym lqdsh 'tyvm hshbt gmz't zkhrhly 'lhy vchvsh 'ly khrb chsdkh {p}
verses.translation: And I commanded the Levites that they should purify themselves, and that they should come and keep the gates, to sanctify the sabbath day. Remember unto me, O my God, this also, and spare me according to the greatness of Thy mercy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּ֣ם  בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵ֗ם רָאִ֤יתִי אֶת־הַיְּהוּדִים֙ הֹשִׁ֗יבוּ נָשִׁים֙ (אשדודיות) [אַשְׁדֳּדִיּ֔וֹת] (עמוניות) [עַמֳּנִיּ֖וֹת] מוֹאֲבִיּֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: gm  bymym hhm r'yty 'thyhvdym hshybv nshym ('shdvdyvt) ['shddyvt] ('mvnyvt) ['mnyvt] mv'byvt
verses.translation: In those days also saw I the Jews that had married women of Ashdod, of Ammon, and of Moab;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵיהֶ֗ם חֲצִי֙ מְדַבֵּ֣ר אַשְׁדּוֹדִ֔ית וְאֵינָ֥ם מַכִּירִ֖ים לְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוּדִ֑ית וְכִלְשׁ֖וֹן עַ֥ם וָעָֽם׃
verses.translit: vbnyhm chtsy mdbr 'shdvdyt v'ynm mkhyrym ldbr yhvdyt vkhlshvn 'm v'm
verses.translation: and their children spoke half in the speech of Ashdod, and could not speak in the Jews’language, but according to the language of each people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאָרִ֤יב עִמָּם֙ וָאֲקַֽלְלֵ֔ם וָאַכֶּ֥ה מֵהֶ֛ם אֲנָשִׁ֖ים וָֽאֶמְרְטֵ֑ם וָאַשְׁבִּיעֵ֣ם בֵּֽאלֹהִ֗ים אִם־תִּתְּנ֤וּ בְנֹֽתֵיכֶם֙ לִבְנֵיהֶ֔ם וְאִם־תִּשְׂאוּ֙ מִבְּנֹ֣תֵיהֶ֔ם לִבְנֵיכֶ֖ם וְלָכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v'ryb 'mm v'qllm v'khh mhm 'nshym v'mrtm v'shby'm b'lhym 'mttnv bntykhm lbnyhm v'mtsh'v mbntyhm lbnykhm vlkhm
verses.translation: And I contended with them, and cursed them, and smote certain of them, and plucked off their hair, and made them swear by God: ‘Ye shall not give your daughters unto their sons, nor take their daughters for your sons, or for yourselves.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲל֣וֹא עַל־אֵ֣לֶּה חָטָֽא־שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֡ל וּבַגּוֹיִ֣ם הָרַבִּים֩ לֹֽא־הָיָ֨ה מֶ֜לֶךְ כָּמֹ֗הוּ וְאָה֤וּב לֵֽאלֹהָיו֙ הָיָ֔ה וַיִּתְּנֵ֣הוּ אֱלֹהִ֔ים מֶ֖לֶךְ עַל־כׇּל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל גַּם־אוֹת֣וֹ הֶחֱטִ֔יאוּ הַנָּשִׁ֖ים הַנׇּכְרִיּֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: hlv' 'l'lh cht'shlmh mlkh yshr'l vbgvym hrbym l'hyh mlkh khmhv v'hvb l'lhyv hyh vytnhv 'lhym mlkh 'lkhlyshr'l gm'vtv hchty'v hnshym hnkhryvt
verses.translation: Did not Solomon king of Israel sin by these things? yet among many nations was there no king like him, and he was beloved of his God, and God made him king over all Israel; nevertheless even him did the foreign women cause to sin.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלָכֶ֣ם הֲנִשְׁמַ֗ע לַעֲשֹׂת֙ אֵ֣ת כׇּל־הָרָעָ֤ה הַגְּדוֹלָה֙ הַזֹּ֔את לִמְעֹ֖ל בֵּֽאלֹהֵ֑ינוּ לְהֹשִׁ֖יב נָשִׁ֥ים נׇכְרִיּֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vlkhm hnshm' l'sht 't khlhr'h hgdvlh hz't lm'l b'lhynv lhshyb nshym nkhryvt
verses.translation: Shall we then hearken unto you to do all this great evil, to break faith with our God in marrying foreign women?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִבְּנֵ֨י יוֹיָדָ֤ע בֶּן־אֶלְיָשִׁיב֙ הַכֹּהֵ֣ן הַגָּד֔וֹל חָתָ֖ן לְסַנְבַלַּ֣ט הַחֹרֹנִ֑י וָאַבְרִיחֵ֖הוּ מֵעָלָֽי׃
verses.translit: vmbny yvyd' bn'lyshyb hkhhn hgdvl chtn lsnblt hchrny v'brychhv m'ly
verses.translation: And one of the sons of Joiada, the son of Eliashib the high priest, was son-in-law to Sanballat the Horonite; therefore I chased him from me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זׇכְרָ֥ה לָהֶ֖ם אֱלֹהָ֑י עַ֚ל גׇּאֳלֵ֣י הַכְּהֻנָּ֔ה וּבְרִ֥ית הַכְּהֻנָּ֖ה וְהַלְוִיִּֽם׃
verses.translit: zkhrh lhm 'lhy 'l g'ly hkhhnh vbryt hkhhnh vhlvym
verses.translation: Remember them, O my God, because they have defiled the priesthood, and the covenant of the priesthood, and of the Levites.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְטִֽהַרְתִּ֖ים מִכׇּל־נֵכָ֑ר {פ} וָאַעֲמִ֧ידָה מִשְׁמָר֛וֹת לַכֹּהֲנִ֥ים וְלַלְוִיִּ֖ם אִ֥ישׁ בִּמְלַאכְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vthrtym mkhlnkhr {p} v''mydh mshmrvt lkhhnym vllvym 'ysh bml'khtv
verses.translation: Thus cleansed I them from everything foreign, and appointed wards for the priests and for the Levites, every one in his work;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְקֻרְבַּ֧ן הָעֵצִ֛ים בְּעִתִּ֥ים מְזֻמָּנ֖וֹת וְלַבִּכּוּרִ֑ים זׇכְרָה־לִּ֥י אֱלֹהַ֖י לְטוֹבָֽה׃
verses.translit: vlqrbn h'tsym b'tym mzmnvt vlbkhvrym zkhrhly 'lhy ltvbh
verses.translation: and for the wood-offering, at times appointed, and for the first-fruits. Remember me, O my God, for good.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָדָ֥ם שֵׁ֖ת אֱנֽוֹשׁ׃
verses.translit: 'dm sht 'nvsh
verses.translation: ADAM, SETH, Enosh;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קֵינָ֥ן מַהֲלַלְאֵ֖ל יָֽרֶד׃
verses.translit: qynn mhll'l yrd
verses.translation: Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֲנ֥וֹךְ מְתוּשֶׁ֖לַח לָֽמֶךְ׃
verses.translit: chnvkh mtvshlch lmkh
verses.translation: Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נֹ֥חַ שֵׁ֖ם חָ֥ם וָיָֽפֶת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: nch shm chm vypt {s}
verses.translation: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י יֶ֔פֶת גֹּ֣מֶר וּמָג֔וֹג וּמָדַ֖י וְיָוָ֣ן וְתֻבָ֑ל וּמֶ֖שֶׁךְ וְתִירָֽס׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny ypt gmr vmgvg vmdy vyvn vtbl vmshkh vtyrs {s}
verses.translation: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֖י גֹּ֑מֶר אַשְׁכְּנַ֥ז וְדִיפַ֖ת וְתוֹגַרְמָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vbny gmr 'shkhnz vdypt vtvgrmh {s}
verses.translation: And the sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, and Diphath, and Togarmah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֥י יָוָ֖ן אֱלִישָׁ֣ה וְתַרְשִׁ֑ישָׁה כִּתִּ֖ים וְרוֹדָנִֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vbny yvn 'lyshh vtrshyshh khtym vrvdnym {s}
verses.translation: And the sons of Javan: Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Rodanim.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֖י חָ֑ם כּ֥וּשׁ וּמִצְרַ֖יִם פּ֥וּט וּכְנָֽעַן׃
verses.translit: bny chm khvsh vmtsrym pvt vkhn'n
verses.translation: The sons of Ham: Cush, and Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֣י כ֔וּשׁ סְבָא֙ וַֽחֲוִילָ֔ה וְסַבְתָּ֥א וְרַעְמָ֖א וְסַבְתְּכָ֑א וּבְנֵ֥י רַעְמָ֖א שְׁבָ֥א וּדְדָֽן׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vbny khvsh sb' vchvylh vsbt' vr'm' vsbtkh' vbny r'm' shb' vddn {s}
verses.translation: And the sons of Cush: Seba, and Havilah, and Sabta, and Raama, and Sabteca. And the sons of Raama: Sheba, and Dedan.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכ֖וּשׁ יָלַ֣ד אֶת־נִמְר֑וֹד ה֣וּא הֵחֵ֔ל לִֽהְי֥וֹת גִּבּ֖וֹר בָּאָֽרֶץ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vkhvsh yld 'tnmrvd hv' hchl lhyvt gbvr b'rts {s}
verses.translation: And Cush begot Nimrod; he began to be a mighty one in the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִצְרַ֡יִם יָלַ֞ד אֶת־[לוּדִ֧ים] (לודיים) וְאֶת־עֲנָמִ֛ים וְאֶת־לְהָבִ֖ים וְאֶת־נַפְתֻּחִֽים׃
verses.translit: vmtsrym yld 't[lvdym] (lvdyym) v't'nmym v'tlhbym v'tnptchym
verses.translation: And Mizraim begot Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽאֶת־פַּתְרֻסִ֞ים וְאֶת־כַּסְלֻחִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָצְא֥וּ מִשָּׁ֛ם פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים וְאֶת־כַּפְתֹּרִֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'tptrsym v'tkhslchym 'shr yts'v mshm plshtym v'tkhptrym {s}
verses.translation: and Pathrusim, and Casluhim—from whence came the Philistines—and Caphtorim.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּכְנַ֗עַן יָלַ֛ד אֶת־צִיד֥וֹן בְּכֹר֖וֹ וְאֶת־חֵֽת׃
verses.translit: vkhn'n yld 'ttsydvn bkhrv v'tcht
verses.translation: And Canaan begot Zidon his first-born, and Heth;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־הַיְבוּסִי֙ וְאֶת־הָ֣אֱמֹרִ֔י וְאֵ֖ת הַגִּרְגָּשִֽׁי׃
verses.translit: v'thybvsy v'th'mry v't hgrgshy
verses.translation: and the Jebusite, and the Amorite, and the Girgashite;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־הַחִוִּ֥י וְאֶת־הַעַרְקִ֖י וְאֶת־הַסִּינִֽי׃
verses.translit: v'thchvy v'th'rqy v'thsyny
verses.translation: and the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־הָאַרְוָדִ֥י וְאֶת־הַצְּמָרִ֖י וְאֶת־הַחֲמָתִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'th'rvdy v'thtsmry v'thchmty {s}
verses.translation: and the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י שֵׁ֔ם עֵילָ֣ם וְאַשּׁ֔וּר וְאַרְפַּכְשַׁ֖ד וְל֣וּד וַאֲרָ֑ם וְע֥וּץ וְח֖וּל וְגֶ֥תֶר וָמֶֽשֶׁךְ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny shm 'ylm v'shvr v'rpkhshd vlvd v'rm v'vts vchvl vgtr vmshkh {s}
verses.translation: The Sons of Shem: Elam, and Asshur, and Arpachshad, and Lud, and Aram, and Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Meshech.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַרְפַּכְשַׁ֖ד יָלַ֣ד אֶת־שָׁ֑לַח וְשֶׁ֖לַח יָלַ֥ד אֶת־עֵֽבֶר׃
verses.translit: v'rpkhshd yld 'tshlch vshlch yld 't'br
verses.translation: And Arpachshad begot Shelah, and Shelah begot Eber.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְעֵ֥בֶר יֻלַּ֖ד שְׁנֵ֣י בָנִ֑ים שֵׁ֣ם הָאֶחָ֞ד פֶּ֗לֶג כִּ֤י בְיָמָיו֙ נִפְלְגָ֣ה הָאָ֔רֶץ וְשֵׁ֥ם אָחִ֖יו יׇקְטָֽן׃
verses.translit: vl'br yld shny bnym shm h'chd plg khy bymyv nplgh h'rts vshm 'chyv yqtn
verses.translation: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg; for in his days the earth was divided; and his brother’s name was Joktan.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיׇקְטָ֣ן יָלַ֔ד אֶת־אַלְמוֹדָ֖ד וְאֶת־שָׁ֑לֶף וְאֶת־חֲצַרְמָ֖וֶת וְאֶת־יָֽרַח׃
verses.translit: vyqtn yld 't'lmvdd v'tshlf v'tchtsrmvt v'tyrch
verses.translation: And Joktan begot Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־הֲדוֹרָ֥ם וְאֶת־אוּזָ֖ל וְאֶת־דִּקְלָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'thdvrm v't'vzl v'tdqlh
verses.translation: and Hadoram, and Uzal, and Diklah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־עֵיבָ֥ל וְאֶת־אֲבִֽימָאֵ֖ל וְאֶת־שְׁבָֽא׃
verses.translit: v't'ybl v't'bym'l v'tshb'
verses.translation: and Ebal, and Abimael, and Sheba;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־אוֹפִ֥יר וְאֶת־חֲוִילָ֖ה וְאֶת־יוֹבָ֑ב כׇּל־אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י יׇקְטָֽן׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v't'vpyr v'tchvylh v'tyvbb khl'lh bny yqtn {s}
verses.translation: and Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שֵׁ֥ם ׀ אַרְפַּכְשַׁ֖ד שָֽׁלַח׃
verses.translit: shm  'rpkhshd shlch
verses.translation: Shem, Arpachshad, Shelah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֵ֥בֶר פֶּ֖לֶג רְעֽוּ׃
verses.translit: 'br plg r'v
verses.translation: Eber, Peleg, Reu;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׂר֥וּג נָח֖וֹר תָּֽרַח׃
verses.translit: shrvg nchvr trch
verses.translation: Serug, Nahor, Terah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַבְרָ֖ם ה֥וּא אַבְרָהָֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'brm hv' 'brhm {s}
verses.translation: Abram—the same is Abraham.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵי֙ אַבְרָהָ֔ם יִצְחָ֖ק וְיִשְׁמָעֵֽאל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny 'brhm ytschq vyshm''l {s}
verses.translation: The sons of Abraham: Isaac, and Ishmael.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֖לֶּה תֹּלְדוֹתָ֑ם בְּכ֤וֹר יִשְׁמָעֵאל֙ נְבָי֔וֹת וְקֵדָ֥ר וְאַדְבְּאֵ֖ל וּמִבְשָֽׂם׃
verses.translit: 'lh tldvtm bkhvr yshm''l nbyvt vqdr v'db'l vmbshm
verses.translation: These are their generations: the first-born of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִשְׁמָ֣ע וְדוּמָ֔ה מַשָּׂ֖א חֲדַ֥ד וְתֵימָֽא׃
verses.translit: mshm' vdvmh msh' chdd vtym'
verses.translation: Mishma, and Dumah, Massa, Hadad, and Tema,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְט֥וּר נָפִ֖ישׁ וָקֵ֑דְמָה אֵ֥לֶּה הֵ֖ם בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׁמָעֵֽאל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: ytvr npysh vqdmh 'lh hm bny yshm''l {s}
verses.translation: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedem. These are the sons of Ishmael.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֨י קְטוּרָ֜ה פִּילֶ֣גֶשׁ אַבְרָהָ֗ם יָלְדָ֞ה אֶת־זִמְרָ֧ן וְיׇקְשָׁ֛ן וּמְדָ֥ן וּמִדְיָ֖ן וְיִשְׁבָּ֣ק וְשׁ֑וּחַ וּבְנֵ֥י יׇקְשָׁ֖ן שְׁבָ֥א וּדְדָֽן׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vbny qtvrh pylgsh 'brhm yldh 'tzmrn vyqshn vmdn vmdyn vyshbq vshvch vbny yqshn shb' vddn {s}
verses.translation: And the sons of Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: she bore Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah. And the sons of Jokshan: Sheba, and Dedan.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֣י מִדְיָ֗ן עֵיפָ֤ה וָעֵ֙פֶר֙ וַחֲנ֔וֹךְ וַאֲבִידָ֖ע וְאֶלְדָּעָ֑ה כׇּל־אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י קְטוּרָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vbny mdyn 'yph v'pr vchnvkh v'byd' v'ld'h khl'lh bny qtvrh {s}
verses.translation: And the sons of Midian: Ephah, and Epher, and Hanoch, and Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the sons of Keturah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיּ֥וֹלֶד אַבְרָהָ֖ם אֶת־יִצְחָ֑ק בְּנֵ֣י יִצְחָ֔ק עֵשָׂ֖ו וְיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyvld 'brhm 'tytschq bny ytschq 'shv vyshr'l {s}
verses.translation: And Abraham begot Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau, and Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֖י עֵשָׂ֑ו אֱלִיפַ֛ז רְעוּאֵ֥ל וִיע֖וּשׁ וְיַעְלָ֥ם וְקֹֽרַח׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny 'shv 'lypz r'v'l vy'vsh vy'lm vqrch {s}
verses.translation: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, and Jeush, and Jalam and Korah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֖י אֱלִיפָ֑ז תֵּימָ֤ן וְאוֹמָר֙ צְפִ֣י וְגַעְתָּ֔ם קְנַ֖ז וְתִמְנָ֥ע וַעֲמָלֵֽק׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny 'lypz tymn v'vmr tspy vg'tm qnz vtmn' v'mlq {s}
verses.translation: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, and Omar, Zephi, and Gatam, Kenaz, and Timna, and Amalek.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֖י רְעוּאֵ֑ל נַ֥חַת זֶ֖רַח שַׁמָּ֥ה וּמִזָּֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny r'v'l ncht zrch shmh vmzh {s}
verses.translation: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֣י שֵׂעִ֔יר לוֹטָ֥ן וְשׁוֹבָ֖ל וְצִבְע֣וֹן וַעֲנָ֑ה וְדִישֹׁ֥ן וְאֵ֖צֶר וְדִישָֽׁן׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vbny sh'yr lvtn vshvbl vtsb'vn v'nh vdyshn v'tsr vdyshn {s}
verses.translation: And the sons of Seir: Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah, and Dishon, and Ezer, and Dishan.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֥י לוֹטָ֖ן חֹרִ֣י וְהוֹמָ֑ם וַאֲח֥וֹת לוֹטָ֖ן תִּמְנָֽע׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vbny lvtn chry vhvmm v'chvt lvtn tmn' {s}
verses.translation: And the sons of Lotan: Hori, and Homam; and Timna was Lotan’s sister.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י שׁוֹבָ֔ל עַלְיָ֧ן וּמָנַ֛חַת וְעֵיבָ֖ל שְׁפִ֣י וְאוֹנָ֑ם וּבְנֵ֥י צִבְע֖וֹן אַיָּ֥ה וַעֲנָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny shvbl 'lyn vmncht v'ybl shpy v'vnm vbny tsb'vn 'yh v'nh {s}
verses.translation: The sons of Shobal: Alian, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. And the sons of Zibeon: Aiah, and Anah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֥י עֲנָ֖ה דִּישׁ֑וֹן וּבְנֵ֣י דִישׁ֔וֹן חַמְרָ֥ן וְאֶשְׁבָּ֖ן וְיִתְרָ֥ן וּכְרָֽן׃
verses.translit: bny 'nh dyshvn vbny dyshvn chmrn v'shbn vytrn vkhrn
verses.translation: The sons of Anah: Dishon. And the sons of Dishon: Hamran, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּֽנֵי־אֵ֔צֶר בִּלְהָ֥ן וְזַעֲוָ֖ן יַעֲקָ֑ן בְּנֵ֥י דִישׁ֖וֹן ע֥וּץ וַאֲרָֽן׃ {פ}
verses.translit: bny'tsr blhn vz'vn y'qn bny dyshvn 'vts v'rn {p}
verses.translation: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, and Zaavan, Jaakan. The sons of Dishan: Uz, and Aran.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֣לֶּה הַמְּלָכִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר מָֽלְכוּ֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ אֱד֔וֹם לִפְנֵ֥י מְלׇךְ־מֶ֖לֶךְ לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בֶּ֚לַע בֶּן־בְּע֔וֹר וְשֵׁ֥ם עִיר֖וֹ דִּנְהָֽבָה׃
verses.translit: v'lh hmlkhym 'shr mlkhv b'rts 'dvm lpny mlkhmlkh lbny yshr'l bl' bnb'vr vshm 'yrv dnhbh
verses.translation: Now these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom, before their reigned any king over the children of Israel: Bela the son of Beor; and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֖מׇת בָּ֑לַע וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔יו יוֹבָ֥ב בֶּן־זֶ֖רַח מִבׇּצְרָֽה׃
verses.translit: vymt bl' vymlkh tchtyv yvbb bnzrch mbtsrh
verses.translation: And Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֖מׇת יוֹבָ֑ב וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔יו חוּשָׁ֖ם מֵאֶ֥רֶץ הַתֵּימָנִֽי׃
verses.translit: vymt yvbb vymlkh tchtyv chvshm m'rts htymny
verses.translation: And Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his stead.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֖מׇת חוּשָׁ֑ם וַיִּמְלֹ֨ךְ תַּחְתָּ֜יו הֲדַ֣ד בֶּן־בְּדַ֗ד הַמַּכֶּ֤ה אֶת־מִדְיָן֙ בִּשְׂדֵ֣ה מוֹאָ֔ב וְשֵׁ֥ם עִיר֖וֹ (עיות) [עֲוִֽית]׃
verses.translit: vymt chvshm vymlkh tchtyv hdd bnbdd hmkhh 'tmdyn bshdh mv'b vshm 'yrv ('yvt) ['vyt]
verses.translation: And Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead; and the name of his city was Avith.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֖מׇת הֲדָ֑ד וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔יו שַׂמְלָ֖ה מִמַּשְׂרֵקָֽה׃
verses.translit: vymt hdd vymlkh tchtyv shmlh mmshrqh
verses.translation: And Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֖מׇת שַׂמְלָ֑ה וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔יו שָׁא֖וּל מֵרְחֹב֥וֹת הַנָּהָֽר׃
verses.translit: vymt shmlh vymlkh tchtyv sh'vl mrchbvt hnhr
verses.translation: And Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth by the River reigned in his stead.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֖מׇת שָׁא֑וּל וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔יו בַּ֥עַל חָנָ֖ן בֶּן־עַכְבּֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: vymt sh'vl vymlkh tchtyv b'l chnn bn'khbvr
verses.translation: And Shaul died, and Baal-hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֙מׇת֙ בַּ֣עַל חָנָ֔ן וַיִּמְלֹ֤ךְ תַּחְתָּיו֙ הֲדַ֔ד וְשֵׁ֥ם עִיר֖וֹ פָּ֑עִי וְשֵׁ֨ם אִשְׁתּ֤וֹ מְהֵֽיטַבְאֵל֙ בַּת־מַטְרֵ֔ד בַּ֖ת מֵ֥י זָהָֽב׃
verses.translit: vymt b'l chnn vymlkh tchtyv hdd vshm 'yrv p'y vshm 'shtv mhytb'l btmtrd bt my zhb
verses.translation: And Baal-hanan died, and Hadad reigned in his stead; and the name of his city was Pai; and his wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֖מׇת הֲדָ֑ד {פ} וַיִּֽהְיוּ֙ אַלּוּפֵ֣י אֱד֔וֹם אַלּ֥וּף תִּמְנָ֛ע אַלּ֥וּף (עליה) [עַֽלְוָ֖ה] אַלּ֥וּף יְתֵֽת׃
verses.translit: vymt hdd {p} vyhyv 'lvpy 'dvm 'lvf tmn' 'lvf ('lyh) ['lvh] 'lvf ytt
verses.translation: And Hadad died. And the chiefs of Edom were: the chief of Timna, the chief of Alvah, the chief of Jetheth;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַלּ֧וּף אׇהֳלִיבָמָ֛ה אַלּ֥וּף אֵלָ֖ה אַלּ֥וּף פִּינֹֽן׃
verses.translit: 'lvf 'hlybmh 'lvf 'lh 'lvf pynn
verses.translation: the chief of Oholibamah, the chief of Elah, the chief of Pinon;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַלּ֥וּף קְנַ֛ז אַלּ֥וּף תֵּימָ֖ן אַלּ֥וּף מִבְצָֽר׃
verses.translit: 'lvf qnz 'lvf tymn 'lvf mbtsr
verses.translation: the chief of Kenaz, the chief of Teman, the chief of Mibzar;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַלּ֥וּף מַגְדִּיאֵ֖ל אַלּ֣וּף עִירָ֑ם אֵ֖לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֥י אֱדֽוֹם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'lvf mgdy'l 'lvf 'yrm 'lh 'lvpy 'dvm {p}
verses.translation: the chief of Magdiel, the chief of Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל רְאוּבֵ֤ן שִׁמְעוֹן֙ לֵוִ֣י וִיהוּדָ֔ה יִשָּׂשכָ֖ר וּזְבֻלֽוּן׃
verses.translit: 'lh bny yshr'l r'vbn shm'vn lvy vyhvdh yshshkhr vzblvn
verses.translation: These are the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דָּ֚ן יוֹסֵ֣ף וּבִנְיָמִ֔ן נַפְתָּלִ֖י גָּ֥ד וְאָשֵֽׁר׃ {פ}
verses.translit: dn yvsf vbnymn nptly gd v'shr {p}
verses.translation: Dan, Joseph, and Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה עֵ֤ר וְאוֹנָן֙ וְשֵׁלָ֔ה שְׁלוֹשָׁה֙ נ֣וֹלַד ל֔וֹ מִבַּת־שׁ֖וּעַ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֑ית וַיְהִ֞י עֵ֣ר  בְּכ֣וֹר יְהוּדָ֗ה רַ֛ע בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה וַיְמִיתֵֽהוּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny yhvdh 'r v'vnn vshlh shlvshh nvld lv mbtshv' hkhn'nyt vyhy 'r  bkhvr yhvdh r' b'yny yhvh vymythv {s}
verses.translation: The sons of Judah: Er, and Onan, and Shelah; which three were born unto him of Bath-shua the Canaanitess. And Er, Judah’s first-born, was wicked in the sight of the LORD; and He slew him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְתָמָר֙ כַּלָּת֔וֹ יָ֥לְדָה לּ֖וֹ אֶת־פֶּ֣רֶץ וְאֶת־זָ֑רַח כׇּל־בְּנֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה חֲמִשָּֽׁה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vtmr khltv yldh lv 'tprts v'tzrch khlbny yhvdh chmshh {s}
verses.translation: And Tamar his daughter-in-law bore him Perez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵי־פֶ֖רֶץ חֶצְר֥וֹן וְחָמֽוּל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bnyprts chtsrvn vchmvl {s}
verses.translation: The sons of Perez: Hezron, and Hamul.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֣י זֶ֗רַח זִ֠מְרִ֠י וְאֵיתָ֧ן וְהֵימָ֛ן וְכַלְכֹּ֥ל וָדָ֖רַע כֻּלָּ֥ם חֲמִשָּֽׁה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vbny zrch zmry v'ytn vhymn vkhlkhl vdr' khlm chmshh {s}
verses.translation: And the sons of Zerah: Zimri, and Ethan, and Heman, and Calcol, and Dara: five of them in all.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֖י כַּרְמִ֑י עָכָר֙ עוֹכֵ֣ר יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר מָעַ֖ל בַּחֵֽרֶם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vbny khrmy 'khr 'vkhr yshr'l 'shr m'l bchrm {s}
verses.translation: And the sons of Carmi: Achar, the troubler of Israel, who committed a trespass concerning the devoted thing.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֥י אֵיתָ֖ן עֲזַרְיָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vbny 'ytn 'zryh {s}
verses.translation: And the sons of Ethan: Azariah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֥י חֶצְר֖וֹן אֲשֶׁ֣ר נֽוֹלַד־ל֑וֹ אֶת־יְרַחְמְאֵ֥ל וְאֶת־רָ֖ם וְאֶת־כְּלוּבָֽי׃
verses.translit: vbny chtsrvn 'shr nvldlv 'tyrchm'l v'trm v'tkhlvby
verses.translation: The sons also of Hezron, that were born unto him: Jerahmeel, and Ram, and Chelubai.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרָ֖ם הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־עַמִּֽינָדָ֑ב וְעַמִּֽינָדָב֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־נַחְשׁ֔וֹן נְשִׂ֖יא בְּנֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.translit: vrm hvlyd 't'myndb v'myndb hvlyd 'tnchshvn nshy' bny yhvdh
verses.translation: And Ram begot Amminadab; and Amminadab begot Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנַחְשׁוֹן֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־שַׂלְמָ֔א וְשַׂלְמָ֖א הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־בֹּֽעַז׃
verses.translit: vnchshvn hvlyd 'tshlm' vshlm' hvlyd 'tb'z
verses.translation: and Nahshon begot Salma, and Salma begot Boaz;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבֹ֙עַז֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־עוֹבֵ֔ד וְעוֹבֵ֖ד הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־יִשָֽׁי׃
verses.translit: vb'z hvlyd 't'vbd v'vbd hvlyd 'tyshy
verses.translation: and Boaz begot Obed, and Obed begot Jesse;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִישַׁ֛י הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־בְּכֹר֖וֹ אֶת־אֱלִיאָ֑ב וַאֲבִֽינָדָב֙ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י וְשִׁמְעָ֖א הַשְּׁלִשִֽׁי׃
verses.translit: v'yshy hvlyd 'tbkhrv 't'ly'b v'byndb hshny vshm'' hshlshy
verses.translation: and Jesse begot his first-born Eliab, and Abinadab the second, and Shimea the third;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נְתַנְאֵל֙ הָרְבִיעִ֔י רַדַּ֖י הַחֲמִישִֽׁי׃
verses.translit: ntn'l hrby'y rdy hchmyshy
verses.translation: Nethanel the fourth, Raddai the fifth;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֹ֚צֶם הַשִּׁשִּׁ֔י דָּוִ֖יד הַשְּׁבִעִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'tsm hshshy dvyd hshb'y
verses.translation: Ozem the sixth, David the seventh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַחְיֹתֵיהֶ֖ם צְרוּיָ֣ה וַאֲבִיגָ֑יִל וּבְנֵ֣י צְרוּיָ֗ה אַבְשַׁ֛י וְיוֹאָ֥ב וַעֲשָׂהאֵ֖ל שְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃
verses.translit: v'chytyhm tsrvyh v'bygyl vbny tsrvyh 'bshy vyv'b v'shh'l shlshh
verses.translation: And their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. And the sons of Zeruiah: Abishai, and Joab, and Asahel, three.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲבִיגַ֕יִל יָלְדָ֖ה אֶת־עֲמָשָׂ֑א וַאֲבִ֣י עֲמָשָׂ֔א יֶ֖תֶר הַיִּשְׁמְעֵאלִֽי׃
verses.translit: v'bygyl yldh 't'msh' v'by 'msh' ytr hyshm''ly
verses.translation: And Abigail bore Amasa; and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmaelite.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכָלֵ֣ב בֶּן־חֶצְר֗וֹן הוֹלִ֛יד אֶת־עֲזוּבָ֥ה אִשָּׁ֖ה וְאֶת־יְרִיע֑וֹת וְאֵ֣לֶּה בָנֶ֔יהָ יֵ֥שֶׁר וְשׁוֹבָ֖ב וְאַרְדּֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: vkhlb bnchtsrvn hvlyd 't'zvbh 'shh v'tyry'vt v'lh bnyh yshr vshvbb v'rdvn
verses.translation: And Caleb the son of Hezron begot children of Azubah his wife—and of Jerioth—and these were her sons: Jesher, and Shobab, and Ardon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתָּ֖מׇת עֲזוּבָ֑ה וַיִּֽקַּֽח־ל֤וֹ כָלֵב֙ אֶת־אֶפְרָ֔ת וַתֵּ֥לֶד ל֖וֹ אֶת־חֽוּר׃
verses.translit: vtmt 'zvbh vyqchlv khlb 't'prt vtld lv 'tchvr
verses.translation: And Azubah died, and Caleb took unto him Ephrath, who bore him Hur.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְחוּר֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־אוּרִ֔י וְאוּרִ֖י הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־בְּצַלְאֵֽל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vchvr hvlyd 't'vry v'vry hvlyd 'tbtsl'l {s}
verses.translation: And Hur begot Uri, and Uri begot Bezalel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַחַ֗ר בָּ֤א חֶצְרוֹן֙ אֶל־בַּת־מָכִיר֙ אֲבִ֣י גִלְעָ֔ד וְה֣וּא לְקָחָ֔הּ וְה֖וּא בֶּן־שִׁשִּׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַתֵּ֥לֶד ל֖וֹ אֶת־שְׂגֽוּב׃
verses.translit: v'chr b' chtsrvn 'lbtmkhyr 'by gl'd vhv' lqchh vhv' bnshshym shnh vtld lv 'tshgvb
verses.translation: And afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead; whom he took to wife when he was threescore years old; and she bore him Segub.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׂג֖וּב הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־יָאִ֑יר וַֽיְהִי־ל֗וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֤ים וְשָׁלוֹשׁ֙ עָרִ֔ים בְּאֶ֖רֶץ הַגִּלְעָֽד׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vshgvb hvlyd 'ty'yr vyhylv 'shrym vshlvsh 'rym b'rts hgl'd {s}
verses.translation: And Segub begot Jair, who had three and twenty cities in the land of Gilead.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֣ח גְּשֽׁוּר־וַ֠אֲרָ֠ם אֶת־חַוֺּ֨ת יָאִ֧יר מֵאִתָּ֛ם אֶת־קְנָ֥ת וְאֶת־בְּנֹתֶ֖יהָ שִׁשִּׁ֣ים עִ֑יר כׇּל־אֵ֕לֶּה בְּנֵ֖י מָכִ֥יר אֲבִֽי־גִלְעָֽד׃
verses.translit: vyqch gshvrv'rm 'tchvt y'yr m'tm 'tqnt v'tbntyh shshym 'yr khl'lh bny mkhyr 'bygl'd
verses.translation: And Geshur and Aram took Havvoth-jair from them, with Kenath, and the villages thereof, even threescore cities. All these were the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַחַ֥ר מוֹת־חֶצְר֖וֹן בְּכָלֵ֣ב אֶפְרָ֑תָה וְאֵ֤שֶׁת חֶצְרוֹן֙ אֲבִיָּ֔ה וַתֵּ֣לֶד ל֔וֹ אֶת־אַשְׁח֖וּר אֲבִ֥י תְקֽוֹעַ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'chr mvtchtsrvn bkhlb 'prth v'sht chtsrvn 'byh vtld lv 't'shchvr 'by tqv' {s}
verses.translation: And after that Hezron was dead in Caleb-ephrath, then Abiah Hezron’s wife bore him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּהְי֧וּ בְנֵי־יְרַחְמְאֵ֛ל בְּכ֥וֹר חֶצְר֖וֹן הַבְּכ֣וֹר ׀ רָ֑ם וּבוּנָ֥ה וָאֹ֛רֶן וָאֹ֖צֶם אֲחִיָּֽה׃
verses.translit: vyhyv bnyyrchm'l bkhvr chtsrvn hbkhvr  rm vbvnh v'rn v'tsm 'chyh
verses.translation: And the sons of Jerahmeel the first-born of Hezron were Ram the first-born, and Bunah, and Oren, and Ozem, Ahijah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתְּהִ֨י אִשָּׁ֥ה אַחֶ֛רֶת לִֽירַחְמְאֵ֖ל וּשְׁמָ֣הּ עֲטָרָ֑ה הִ֖יא אֵ֥ם אוֹנָֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vthy 'shh 'chrt lyrchm'l vshmh 'trh hy' 'm 'vnm {s}
verses.translation: And Jerahmeel had another wife, whose name was Atarah; she was the mother of Onam.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּהְי֥וּ בְנֵי־רָ֖ם בְּכ֣וֹר יְרַחְמְאֵ֑ל מַ֥עַץ וְיָמִ֖ין וָעֵֽקֶר׃
verses.translit: vyhyv bnyrm bkhvr yrchm'l m'ts vymyn v'qr
verses.translation: And the sons of Ram the first-born of Jerahmeel were Maaz, and Jamin, and Eker.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּהְי֥וּ בְנֵי־אוֹנָ֖ם שַׁמַּ֣י וְיָדָ֑ע וּבְנֵ֣י שַׁמַּ֔י נָדָ֖ב וַאֲבִישֽׁוּר׃
verses.translit: vyhyv bny'vnm shmy vyd' vbny shmy ndb v'byshvr
verses.translation: And the sons of Onam were Shammai, and Jada; and the sons of Shammai: Nadab, and Abishur.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשֵׁ֛ם אֵ֥שֶׁת אֲבִישׁ֖וּר אֲבִיהָ֑יִל וַתֵּ֣לֶד ל֔וֹ אֶת־אַחְבָּ֖ן וְאֶת־מוֹלִֽיד׃
verses.translit: vshm 'sht 'byshvr 'byhyl vtld lv 't'chbn v'tmvlyd
verses.translation: And the name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail; and she bore him Ahban, and Molid.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֥י נָדָ֖ב סֶ֣לֶד וְאַפָּ֑יִם וַיָּ֥מׇת סֶ֖לֶד לֹ֥א בָנִֽים׃
verses.translit: vbny ndb sld v'pym vymt sld l' bnym
verses.translation: And the sons of Nadab: Seled, and Appaim; but Seled died without children.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֥י אַפַּ֖יִם יִשְׁעִ֑י וּבְנֵ֤י יִשְׁעִי֙ שֵׁשָׁ֔ן וּבְנֵ֥י שֵׁשָׁ֖ן אַחְלָֽי׃
verses.translit: vbny 'pym ysh'y vbny ysh'y shshn vbny shshn 'chly
verses.translation: And the sons of Appaim: Ishi. And the sons of Ishi: Sheshan. And the sons of Sheshan: Ahlai.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֤י יָדָע֙ אֲחִ֣י שַׁמַּ֔י יֶ֖תֶר וְיוֹנָתָ֑ן וַיָּ֥מׇת יֶ֖תֶר לֹ֥א בָנִֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vbny yd' 'chy shmy ytr vyvntn vymt ytr l' bnym {s}
verses.translation: And the sons of Jada the brother of Shammai: Jether, and Jonathan: and Jether died without children.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֥י יוֹנָתָ֖ן פֶּ֣לֶת וְזָזָ֑א אֵ֥לֶּה הָי֖וּ בְּנֵ֥י יְרַחְמְאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vbny yvntn plt vzz' 'lh hyv bny yrchm'l
verses.translation: And the sons of Jonathan: Peleth, and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹא־הָיָ֧ה לְשֵׁשָׁ֛ן בָּנִ֖ים כִּ֣י אִם־בָּנ֑וֹת וּלְשֵׁשָׁ֛ן עֶ֥בֶד מִצְרִ֖י וּשְׁמ֥וֹ יַרְחָֽע׃
verses.translit: vl'hyh lshshn bnym khy 'mbnvt vlshshn 'bd mtsry vshmv yrch'
verses.translation: Now Sheshan had no sons, but daughters. And Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Jarha.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֨ן שֵׁשָׁ֧ן אֶת־בִּתּ֛וֹ לְיַרְחָ֥ע עַבְדּ֖וֹ לְאִשָּׁ֑ה וַתֵּ֥לֶד ל֖וֹ אֶת־עַתָּֽי׃
verses.translit: vytn shshn 'tbtv lyrch' 'bdv l'shh vtld lv 't'ty
verses.translation: So Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant to wife; and she bore him Attai.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתַּי֙ הֹלִ֣יד אֶת־נָתָ֔ן וְנָתָ֖ן הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־זָבָֽד׃
verses.translit: v'ty hlyd 'tntn vntn hvlyd 'tzbd
verses.translation: And Attai begot Nathan, and Nathan begot Zabad;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְזָבָד֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־אֶפְלָ֔ל וְאֶפְלָ֖ל הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־עוֹבֵֽד׃
verses.translit: vzbd hvlyd 't'pll v'pll hvlyd 't'vbd
verses.translation: and Zabad begot Ephlal, and Ephlal begot Obed;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעוֹבֵד֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־יֵה֔וּא וְיֵה֖וּא הֹלִ֥יד אֶת־עֲזַרְיָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'vbd hvlyd 'tyhv' vyhv' hlyd 't'zryh
verses.translation: and Obed begot Jehu, and Jehu begot Azariah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽעֲזַרְיָה֙ הֹלִ֣יד אֶת־חָ֔לֶץ וְחֶ֖לֶץ הֹלִ֥יד אֶת־אֶלְעָשָֽׂה׃
verses.translit: v'zryh hlyd 'tchlts vchlts hlyd 't'l'shh
verses.translation: and Azariah begot Helez, and Helez begot Eleasah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶלְעָשָׂה֙ הֹלִ֣יד אֶת־סִֽסְמָ֔י וְסִסְמַ֖י הֹלִ֥יד אֶת־שַׁלּֽוּם׃
verses.translit: v'l'shh hlyd 'tssmy vssmy hlyd 'tshlvm
verses.translation: and Eleasah begot Sisamai, and Sisamai begot Shallum;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשַׁלּוּם֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־יְקַמְיָ֔ה וִיקַמְיָ֖ה הֹלִ֥יד אֶת־אֱלִישָׁמָֽע׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vshlvm hvlyd 'tyqmyh vyqmyh hlyd 't'lyshm' {s}
verses.translation: and Shallum begot Jekamiah, and Jekamiah begot Elishama.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֤י כָלֵב֙ אֲחִ֣י יְרַחְמְאֵ֔ל מֵישָׁ֥ע בְּכֹר֖וֹ ה֣וּא אֲבִי־זִ֑יף וּבְנֵ֥י מָרֵשָׁ֖ה אֲבִ֥י חֶבְרֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: vbny khlb 'chy yrchm'l mysh' bkhrv hv' 'byzyf vbny mrshh 'by chbrvn
verses.translation: And the sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were Mesha his first-born, who was the father of Ziph, and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֖י חֶבְר֑וֹן קֹ֥רַח וְתַפֻּ֖חַ וְרֶ֥קֶם וָשָֽׁמַע׃
verses.translit: vbny chbrvn qrch vtpch vrqm vshm'
verses.translation: And the sons of Hebron: Korah, and Tappuah, and Rekem, and Shema.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשֶׁ֣מַע הוֹלִ֔יד אֶת־רַ֖חַם אֲבִ֣י יׇרְקְעָ֑ם וְרֶ֖קֶם הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־שַׁמָּֽי׃
verses.translit: vshm' hvlyd 'trchm 'by yrq'm vrqm hvlyd 'tshmy
verses.translation: And Shema begot Raham, the father of Jorkeam; and Rekem begot Shammai.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבֶן־שַׁמַּ֖י מָע֑וֹן וּמָע֖וֹן אֲבִ֥י בֵֽית־צֽוּר׃
verses.translit: vbnshmy m'vn vm'vn 'by byttsvr
verses.translation: And the son of Shammai was Maon; and Maon was the father of Beth-zur.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעֵיפָה֙ פִּילֶ֣גֶשׁ כָּלֵ֔ב יָ֥לְדָ֛ה אֶת־חָרָ֥ן וְאֶת־מוֹצָ֖א וְאֶת־גָּזֵ֑ז וְחָרָ֖ן הֹלִ֥יד אֶת־גָּזֵֽז׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'yph pylgsh khlb yldh 'tchrn v'tmvts' v'tgzz vchrn hlyd 'tgzz {s}
verses.translation: And Ephah, Caleb’s concubine, bore Haran, and Moza, and Gazez; and Haran begot Gazez.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֖י יׇהְדָּ֑י רֶ֧גֶם וְיוֹתָ֛ם וְגֵישָׁ֥ן וָפֶ֖לֶט וְעֵיפָ֥ה וָשָֽׁעַף׃
verses.translit: vbny yhdy rgm vyvtm vgyshn vplt v'yph vsh'f
verses.translation: And the sons of Jahdai: Regem, and Jotham, and Geshan, and Pelet, and Ephah, and Shaaph.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פִּילֶ֤גֶשׁ כָּלֵב֙ מַֽעֲכָ֔ה יָ֥לַד שֶׁ֖בֶר וְאֶֽת־תִּרְחֲנָֽה׃
verses.translit: pylgsh khlb m'khh yld shbr v'ttrchnh
verses.translation: Maacah, Caleb’s concubine, bore Sheber and Tirhanah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֵּ֗לֶד שַׁ֚עַף אֲבִ֣י מַדְמַנָּ֔ה אֶת־שְׁוָ֛א אֲבִ֥י מַכְבֵּנָ֖ה וַאֲבִ֣י גִבְעָ֑א וּבַת־כָּלֵ֖ב עַכְסָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vtld sh'f 'by mdmnh 'tshv' 'by mkhbnh v'by gb'' vbtkhlb 'khsh {s}
verses.translation: And [the wife of] Shaaph the father of Madmannah bore Sheva the father of Machbenah and the father of Gibea. And the daughter of Caleb was Achsah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֤לֶּה הָיוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י כָלֵ֔ב בֶּן־ח֖וּר בְּכ֣וֹר אֶפְרָ֑תָה שׁוֹבָ֕ל אֲבִ֖י קִרְיַ֥ת יְעָרִֽים׃
verses.translit: 'lh hyv bny khlb bnchvr bkhvr 'prth shvbl 'by qryt y'rym
verses.translation: These were the sons of Caleb. The sons of Hur the first-born of Ephrath: Shobal the father of Kiriath-jearim;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שַׂלְמָא֙ אֲבִ֣י בֵֽית־לָ֔חֶם חָרֵ֖ף אֲבִ֥י בֵית־גָּדֵֽר׃
verses.translit: shlm' 'by bytlchm chrf 'by bytgdr
verses.translation: Salma the father of Beth-lehem, Hareph the father of Beth-gader.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּהְי֤וּ בָנִים֙ לְשׁוֹבָ֔ל אֲבִ֖י קִרְיַ֣ת יְעָרִ֑ים הָרֹאֶ֖ה חֲצִ֥י הַמְּנֻחֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vyhyv bnym lshvbl 'by qryt y'rym hr'h chtsy hmnchvt
verses.translation: And Shobal the father of Kiriath-jearim had sons: Haroeh, and half of the Menuhoth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִשְׁפְּחוֹת֙ קִרְיַ֣ת יְעָרִ֔ים הַיִּתְרִי֙ וְהַפּוּתִ֔י וְהַשֻּׁמָתִ֖י וְהַמִּשְׁרָעִ֑י מֵאֵ֗לֶּה יָֽצְאוּ֙ הַצָּ֣רְעָתִ֔י וְהָאֶשְׁתָּ֖אֻֽלִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vmshpchvt qryt y'rym hytry vhpvty vhshmty vhmshr'y m'lh yts'v htsr'ty vh'sht'ly {s}
verses.translation: And the families of Kiriath-jearim: the Ithrites, and the Puthites, and the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; of them came the Zorathites, and the Eshtaolites.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י שַׂלְמָ֗א בֵּ֥ית לֶ֙חֶם֙ וּנְט֣וֹפָתִ֔י עַטְר֖וֹת בֵּ֣ית יוֹאָ֑ב וַחֲצִ֥י הַמָּנַחְתִּ֖י הַצׇּרְעִֽי׃
verses.translit: bny shlm' byt lchm vntvpty 'trvt byt yv'b vchtsy hmnchty htsr'y
verses.translation: The sons of Salma: Beth-lehem, and the Netophathites, Atroth-beth-joab, and half of the Manahathites, the Zorites.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִשְׁפְּח֤וֹת סֹֽפְרִים֙ (ישבו) [יֹשְׁבֵ֣י] יַעְבֵּ֔ץ תִּרְעָתִ֥ים שִׁמְעָתִ֖ים שׂוּכָתִ֑ים הֵ֚מָּה הַקִּינִ֣ים הַבָּאִ֔ים מֵחַמַּ֖ת אֲבִ֥י בֵית־רֵכָֽב׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vmshpchvt sprym (yshbv) [yshby] y'bts tr'tym shm'tym shvkhtym hmh hqynym hb'ym mchmt 'by bytrkhb {s}
verses.translation: And the families of scribes that dwelt at Jabez: the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, the Sucathites. These are the Kenites that came of Hammath, the father of the house of Rechab.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֤לֶּה הָיוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י דָוִ֔יד אֲשֶׁ֥ר נוֹלַד־ל֖וֹ בְּחֶבְר֑וֹן הַבְּכ֣וֹר  אַמְנֹ֗ן לַאֲחִינֹ֙עַם֙ הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִ֔ית שֵׁנִי֙ דָּנִיֵּ֔אל לַאֲבִיגַ֖יִל הַֽכַּרְמְלִֽית׃
verses.translit: v'lh hyv bny dvyd 'shr nvldlv bchbrvn hbkhvr  'mnn l'chyn'm hyzr''lyt shny dny'l l'bygyl hkhrmlyt
verses.translation: Now these were the sons of David, that were born unto him in Hebron: the first-born, Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second, Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelitess;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַשְּׁלִשִׁי֙ לְאַבְשָׁל֣וֹם בֶּֽן־מַעֲכָ֔ה בַּת־תַּלְמַ֖י מֶ֣לֶךְ גְּשׁ֑וּר הָרְבִיעִ֖י אֲדֹנִיָּ֥ה בֶן־חַגִּֽית׃
verses.translit: hshlshy l'bshlvm bnm'khh bttlmy mlkh gshvr hrby'y 'dnyh bnchgyt
verses.translation: the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur; the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַחֲמִישִׁ֥י שְׁפַטְיָ֖ה לַאֲבִיטָ֑ל הַשִּׁשִּׁ֥י יִתְרְעָ֖ם לְעֶגְלָ֥ה אִשְׁתּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: hchmyshy shptyh l'bytl hshshy ytr'm l'glh 'shtv
verses.translation: the fifth, Shephatiah of Abital; the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁשָּׁה֙ נוֹלַד־ל֣וֹ בְחֶבְר֔וֹן וַיִּ֨מְלׇךְ־שָׁ֔ם שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִ֖ים וְשִׁשָּׁ֣ה חֳדָשִׁ֑ים וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים וְשָׁלוֹשׁ֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: shshh nvldlv bchbrvn vymlkhshm shb' shnym vshshh chdshym vshlshym vshlvsh shnh mlkh byrvshl͏m {s}
verses.translation: Six were born unto him in Hebron; and there he reigned seven years and six months; and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֥לֶּה נוּלְּדוּ־ל֖וֹ בִּירוּשָׁלָ֑יִם שִׁ֠מְעָ֠א וְשׁוֹבָ֞ב וְנָתָ֤ן וּשְׁלֹמֹה֙ אַרְבָּעָ֔ה לְבַת־שׁ֖וּעַ בַּת־עַמִּיאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: v'lh nvldvlv byrvshlym shm'' vshvbb vntn vshlmh 'rb'h lbtshv' bt'my'l
verses.translation: And these were born unto him in Jerusalem: Shimea, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon, four, of Bath-shua the daughter of Ammiel;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיִבְחָ֥ר וֶאֱלִישָׁמָ֖ע וֶאֱלִיפָֽלֶט׃
verses.translit: vybchr v'lyshm' v'lyplt
verses.translation: and Ibhar, and Elishama, and Eliphelet;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנֹ֥גַהּ וְנֶ֖פֶג וְיָפִֽיעַ׃
verses.translit: vngh vnpg vypy'
verses.translation: and Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וֶאֱלִישָׁמָ֧ע וְאֶלְיָדָ֛ע וֶאֱלִיפֶ֖לֶט תִּשְׁעָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'lyshm' v'lyd' v'lyplt tsh'h
verses.translation: and Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֖ל בְּנֵ֣י דָוִ֑יד מִלְּבַ֥ד בְּֽנֵי־פִֽילַגְשִׁ֖ים וְתָמָ֥ר אֲחוֹתָֽם׃ {פ}
