verses.translit: khl bny dvyd mlbd bnypylgshym vtmr 'chvtm {p}
verses.translation: All these were the sons of David, beside the sons of the concubines; and Tamar was their sister.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבֶן־שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה רְחַבְעָ֑ם אֲבִיָּ֥ה בְנ֛וֹ אָסָ֥א בְנ֖וֹ יְהוֹשָׁפָ֥ט בְּנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vbnshlmh rchb'm 'byh bnv 's' bnv yhvshpt bnv
verses.translation: And Solomon’s son was Rehoboam; Abijah his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יוֹרָ֥ם בְּנ֛וֹ אֲחַזְיָ֥הוּ בְנ֖וֹ יוֹאָ֥שׁ בְּנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: yvrm bnv 'chzyhv bnv yv'sh bnv
verses.translation: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲמַצְיָ֧הוּ בְנ֛וֹ עֲזַרְיָ֥ה בְנ֖וֹ יוֹתָ֥ם בְּנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'mtsyhv bnv 'zryh bnv yvtm bnv
verses.translation: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָחָ֥ז בְּנ֛וֹ חִזְקִיָּ֥הוּ בְנ֖וֹ מְנַשֶּׁ֥ה בְנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'chz bnv chzqyhv bnv mnshh bnv
verses.translation: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָמ֥וֹן בְּנ֖וֹ יֹאשִׁיָּ֥הוּ בְנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'mvn bnv y'shyhv bnv
verses.translation: Amon his son, Josiah his son.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵי֙ יֹֽאשִׁיָּ֔הוּ הַבְּכוֹר֙ יֽוֹחָנָ֔ן הַשֵּׁנִ֖י יְהוֹיָקִ֑ים הַשְּׁלִשִׁי֙ צִדְקִיָּ֔הוּ הָרְבִיעִ֖י שַׁלּֽוּם׃
verses.translit: vbny y'shyhv hbkhvr yvchnn hshny yhvyqym hshlshy tsdqyhv hrby'y shlvm
verses.translation: And the sons of Josiah: the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֖י יְהוֹיָקִ֑ים יְכׇנְיָ֥ה בְנ֖וֹ צִדְקִיָּ֥ה בְנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vbny yhvyqym ykhnyh bnv tsdqyh bnv
verses.translation: And the sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵי֙ יְכׇנְיָ֣ה אַסִּ֔ר שְׁאַלְתִּיאֵ֖ל בְּנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vbny ykhnyh 'sr sh'lty'l bnv
verses.translation: And the sons of Jeconiah—the same is Assir—Shealtiel his son;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמַלְכִירָ֥ם וּפְדָיָ֖ה וְשֶׁנְאַצַּ֑ר יְקַמְיָ֥ה הוֹשָׁמָ֖ע וּנְדַבְיָֽה׃
verses.translit: vmlkhyrm vpdyh vshn'tsr yqmyh hvshm' vndbyh
verses.translation: and Malchiram, and Pedaiah, and Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֣י פְדָיָ֔ה זְרֻבָּבֶ֖ל וְשִׁמְעִ֑י וּבֶן־זְרֻבָּבֶל֙ מְשֻׁלָּ֣ם וַחֲנַנְיָ֔ה וּשְׁלֹמִ֖ית אֲחוֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: vbny pdyh zrbbl vshm'y vbnzrbbl mshlm vchnnyh vshlmyt 'chvtm
verses.translation: And the sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel, and Shimei. And the sons of Zerubbabel: Meshullam, and Hananiah; and Shelomith was their sister;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַחֲשֻׁבָ֡ה וָ֠אֹ֠הֶל וּבֶרֶכְיָ֧ה וַחֲסַדְיָ֛ה י֥וּשַׁב חֶ֖סֶד חָמֵֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: vchshbh v'hl vbrkhyh vchsdyh yvshb chsd chmsh
verses.translation: and Hashubah and Ohel, and Berechiah, and Hasadiah, Jushabhesed, five.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבֶן־חֲנַנְיָ֖ה פְּלַטְיָ֣ה וִישַֽׁעְיָ֑ה בְּנֵ֤י רְפָיָה֙ בְּנֵ֣י אַרְנָ֔ן בְּנֵ֥י עֹבַדְיָ֖ה בְּנֵ֥י שְׁכַנְיָֽה׃
verses.translit: vbnchnnyh pltyh vysh'yh bny rpyh bny 'rnn bny 'bdyh bny shkhnyh
verses.translation: And the sons of Hananiah: Pelatiah, and Jeshaiah; the sons of [Jeshaiah]: Rephaiah; the sons of [Rephaiah]: Arnan; the sons of [Arnan]: Obadiah; the sons of [Obadiah]: Shecaniah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֥י שְׁכַנְיָ֖ה שְׁמַֽעְיָ֑ה וּבְנֵ֣י שְׁמַֽעְיָ֗ה חַטּ֡וּשׁ וְ֠יִגְאָ֠ל וּבָרִ֧יחַ וּנְעַרְיָ֛ה וְשָׁפָ֖ט שִׁשָּֽׁה׃
verses.translit: vbny shkhnyh shm'yh vbny shm'yh chtvsh vyg'l vbrych vn'ryh vshpt shshh
verses.translation: And the sons of Shecaniah: Shemaiah; and the sons of Shemaiah: Hattush, and Igal, and Bariah, and Neariah, and Shaphat, six.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבֶן־נְעַרְיָ֗ה אֶלְיוֹעֵינַ֧י וְחִזְקִיָּ֛ה וְעַזְרִיקָ֖ם שְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vbnn'ryh 'lyv'yny vchzqyh v'zryqm shlshh {s}
verses.translation: And the sons of Neariah: Elioenai, and Hizkiah, and Azrikam, three.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֣י אֶלְיוֹעֵינַ֗י (הודיוהו) [הוֹדַוְיָ֡הוּ] וְאֶלְיָשִׁ֡יב וּפְלָיָ֡ה וְ֠עַקּ֠וּב וְיוֹחָנָ֧ן וּדְלָיָ֛ה וַעֲנָ֖נִי שִׁבְעָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vbny 'lyv'yny (hvdyvhv) [hvdvyhv] v'lyshyb vplyh v'qvb vyvchnn vdlyh v'nny shb'h {s}
verses.translation: And the sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah, and Eliashib, and Pelaiah, and Akkub, and Johanan, and Delaiah, and Anani, seven.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֖י יְהוּדָ֑ה פֶּ֧רֶץ חֶצְר֛וֹן וְכַרְמִ֖י וְח֥וּר וְשׁוֹבָֽל׃
verses.translit: bny yhvdh prts chtsrvn vkhrmy vchvr vshvbl
verses.translation: The sons of Judah: Perez, Hezron, and Carmi, and Hur, and Shobal.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּרְאָיָ֤ה בֶן־שׁוֹבָל֙ הֹלִ֣יד אֶת־יַ֔חַת וְיַ֣חַת הֹלִ֔יד אֶת־אֲחוּמַ֖י וְאֶת־לָ֑הַד אֵ֖לֶּה מִשְׁפְּח֥וֹת הַצָּֽרְעָתִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vr'yh bnshvbl hlyd 'tycht vycht hlyd 't'chvmy v'tlhd 'lh mshpchvt htsr'ty {s}
verses.translation: And Reaiah the son of Shobal begot Jahath; and Jahath begot Ahumai, and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ אֲבִ֣י עֵיטָ֔ם יִזְרְעֶ֥אל וְיִשְׁמָ֖א וְיִדְבָּ֑שׁ וְשֵׁ֥ם אֲחוֹתָ֖ם הַצְלֶלְפּֽוֹנִי׃
verses.translit: v'lh 'by 'ytm yzr''l vyshm' vydbsh vshm 'chvtm htsllpvny
verses.translation: And these were [the sons of] the father of Etam: Jezreel, and Ishma, and Idbash; and the name of their sister was Hazlelponi;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּפְנוּאֵל֙ אֲבִ֣י גְדֹ֔ר וְעֵ֖זֶר אֲבִ֣י חוּשָׁ֑ה אֵ֤לֶּה בְנֵי־חוּר֙ בְּכ֣וֹר אֶפְרָ֔תָה אֲבִ֖י בֵּ֥ית לָֽחֶם׃
verses.translit: vpnv'l 'by gdr v'zr 'by chvshh 'lh bnychvr bkhvr 'prth 'by byt lchm
verses.translation: and Penuel the father of Gedor, and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur the first-born of Ephrath, the father of Beth-lehem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְאַשְׁחוּר֙ אֲבִ֣י תְק֔וֹעַ הָי֖וּ שְׁתֵּ֣י נָשִׁ֑ים חֶלְאָ֖ה וְנַעֲרָֽה׃
verses.translit: vl'shchvr 'by tqv' hyv shty nshym chl'h vn'rh
verses.translation: And Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֵּ֨לֶד ל֤וֹ נַֽעֲרָה֙ אֶת־אֲחֻזָּ֣ם וְאֶת־חֵ֔פֶר וְאֶת־תֵּֽימְנִ֖י וְאֶת־הָאֲחַשְׁתָּרִ֑י אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י נַעֲרָֽה׃
verses.translit: vtld lv n'rh 't'chzm v'tchpr v'ttymny v'th'chshtry 'lh bny n'rh
verses.translation: And Naarah bore him Ahuzam, and Hepher, and Timeni, and Ahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֖י חֶלְאָ֑ה צֶ֥רֶת (יצחר) [וְצֹ֖חַר] וְאֶתְנָֽן׃
verses.translit: vbny chl'h tsrt (ytschr) [vtschr] v'tnn
verses.translation: And the sons of Helah were Zereth, and Zohar, and Ethnan.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְק֣וֹץ הוֹלִ֔יד אֶת־עָנ֖וּב וְאֶת־הַצֹּבֵבָ֑ה וּמִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת אֲחַרְחֵ֖ל בֶּן־הָרֽוּם׃
verses.translit: vqvts hvlyd 't'nvb v'thtsbbh vmshpcht 'chrchl bnhrvm
verses.translation: And Koz begot Anub, and Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י יַעְבֵּ֔ץ נִכְבָּ֖ד מֵאֶחָ֑יו וְאִמּ֗וֹ קָרְאָ֨ה שְׁמ֤וֹ יַעְבֵּץ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר כִּ֥י יָלַ֖דְתִּי בְּעֹֽצֶב׃
verses.translit: vyhy y'bts nkhbd m'chyv v'mv qr'h shmv y'bts l'mr khy yldty b'tsb
verses.translation: And Jabez was more honourable than his brethren; and his mother called his name Jabez, saying: ‘Because I bore him with pain.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֣א יַ֠עְבֵּ֠ץ לֵאלֹהֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל לֵאמֹ֗ר אִם־בָּרֵ֨ךְ תְּבָרְכֵ֜נִי וְהִרְבִּ֤יתָ אֶת־גְּבוּלִי֙ וְהָיְתָ֤ה יָדְךָ֙ עִמִּ֔י וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ מֵּרָעָ֖ה לְבִלְתִּ֣י עׇצְבִּ֑י וַיָּבֵ֥א אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־שָׁאָֽל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyqr' y'bts l'lhy yshr'l l'mr 'mbrkh tbrkhny vhrbyt 'tgbvly vhyth ydkh 'my v'shyt mr'h lblty 'tsby vyb' 'lhym 't 'shrsh'l {s}
verses.translation: And Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying: ‘Oh that Thou wouldest bless me indeed, and enlarge my border, and that Thy hand might be with me, and that Thou wouldest work deliverance from evil, that it may not pain me! ’ And God granted him that which he requested.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּכְל֥וּב אֲחִי־שׁוּחָ֖ה הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־מְחִ֑יר ה֖וּא אֲבִ֥י אֶשְׁתּֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: vkhlvb 'chyshvchh hvlyd 'tmchyr hv' 'by 'shtvn
verses.translation: And Chelub the brother of Shuhah begot Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶשְׁתּ֗וֹן הוֹלִ֞יד אֶת־בֵּ֤ית רָפָא֙ וְאֶת־פָּסֵ֔חַ וְאֶת־תְּחִנָּ֖ה אֲבִ֣י עִ֣יר נָחָ֑שׁ אֵ֖לֶּה אַנְשֵׁ֥י רֵכָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'shtvn hvlyd 'tbyt rp' v'tpsch v'ttchnh 'by 'yr nchsh 'lh 'nshy rkhh {s}
verses.translation: And Eshton begot Beth-rapha, and Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Ir-nahash. These are the men of Recah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֣י קְנַ֔ז עׇתְנִיאֵ֖ל וּשְׂרָיָ֑ה וּבְנֵ֥י עׇתְנִיאֵ֖ל חֲתַֽת׃
verses.translit: vbny qnz 'tny'l vshryh vbny 'tny'l chtt
verses.translation: And the sons of Kenaz: Othniel, and Seraiah; and the sons of Othniel: Hathath.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמְעוֹנֹתַ֖י הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־עׇפְרָ֑ה וּשְׂרָיָ֗ה הוֹלִ֤יד אֶת־יוֹאָב֙ אֲבִי֙ גֵּ֣יא חֲרָשִׁ֔ים כִּ֥י חֲרָשִׁ֖ים הָיֽוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vm'vnty hvlyd 't'prh vshryh hvlyd 'tyv'b 'by gy' chrshym khy chrshym hyv {p}
verses.translation: And Meonothai begot Ophrah; and Seraiah begot Joab the father of Ge-harashim; for they were craftsmen.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵי֙ כָּלֵ֣ב בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּ֔ה עִ֥ירוּ אֵלָ֖ה וָנָ֑עַם וּבְנֵ֥י אֵלָ֖ה וּקְנַֽז׃
verses.translit: vbny khlb bnypnh 'yrv 'lh vn'm vbny 'lh vqnz
verses.translation: And the sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam; and the sons of Elah: Kenaz.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֖י יְהַלֶּלְאֵ֑ל זִ֣יף וְזִיפָ֔ה תִּירְיָ֖א וַאֲשַׂרְאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vbny yhll'l zyf vzyph tyry' v'shr'l
verses.translation: And the sons of Jehallelel: Ziph, and Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבֶ֨ן־עֶזְרָ֔ה יֶ֥תֶר וּמֶ֖רֶד וְעֵ֣פֶר וְיָל֑וֹן וַתַּ֙הַר֙ אֶת־מִרְיָ֣ם וְאֶת־שַׁמַּ֔י וְאֶת־יִשְׁבָּ֖ח אֲבִ֥י אֶשְׁתְּמֹֽעַ׃
verses.translit: vbn'zrh ytr vmrd v'pr vylvn vthr 'tmrym v'tshmy v'tyshbch 'by 'shtm'
verses.translation: And the sons of Ezrah: Jether, and Mered, and Epher, and Jalon. And she bore Miriam, and Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִשְׁתּ֣וֹ הַיְהֻֽדִיָּ֗ה יָלְדָ֞ה אֶת־יֶ֨רֶד אֲבִ֤י גְדוֹר֙ וְאֶת־חֶ֙בֶר֙ אֲבִ֣י שׂוֹכ֔וֹ וְאֶת־יְקוּתִיאֵ֖ל אֲבִ֣י זָנ֑וֹחַ וְאֵ֗לֶּה בְּנֵי֙ בִּתְיָ֣ה בַת־פַּרְעֹ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לָקַ֖ח מָֽרֶד׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'shtv hyhdyh yldh 'tyrd 'by gdvr v'tchbr 'by shvkhv v'tyqvty'l 'by znvch v'lh bny btyh btpr'h 'shr lqch mrd {s}
verses.translation: and his wife Hajehudijah bore Jered the father of Gedor, and Heber the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah—and these are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh whom Mered took.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵי֙ אֵ֣שֶׁת הֽוֹדִיָּ֔ה אֲח֣וֹת נַ֔חַם אֲבִ֥י קְעִילָ֖ה הַגַּרְמִ֑י וְאֶשְׁתְּמֹ֖עַ הַמַּעֲכָתִֽי׃
verses.translit: vbny 'sht hvdyh 'chvt nchm 'by q'ylh hgrmy v'shtm' hm'khty
verses.translation: And the sons of the wife of Hodiah, the sister of Naham, were the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maacathite.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֣י שִׁימ֔וֹן אַמְנ֣וֹן וְרִנָּ֔ה בֶּן־חָנָ֖ן (ותולון) [וְתִיל֑וֹן] וּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׁעִ֔י זוֹחֵ֖ת וּבֶן־זוֹחֵֽת׃
verses.translit: vbny shymvn 'mnvn vrnh bnchnn (vtvlvn) [vtylvn] vbny ysh'y zvcht vbnzvcht
verses.translation: And the sons of Shimon: Amnon, and Rinnah, Ben-hanan, and Tilon. And the sons of Ishi: Zoheth, and Ben-zoheth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵי֙ שֵׁלָ֣ה בֶן־יְהוּדָ֔ה עֵ֚ר אֲבִ֣י לֵכָ֔ה וְלַעְדָּ֖ה אֲבִ֣י מָרֵשָׁ֑ה וּמִשְׁפְּח֛וֹת בֵּית־עֲבֹדַ֥ת הַבֻּ֖ץ לְבֵ֥ית אַשְׁבֵּֽעַ׃
verses.translit: bny shlh bnyhvdh 'r 'by lkhh vl'dh 'by mrshh vmshpchvt byt'bdt hbts lbyt 'shb'
verses.translation: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah: Er the father of Lecah, and Ladah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of them that wrought fine linen, of the house of Ashbea;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיוֹקִ֞ים וְאַנְשֵׁ֣י כֹזֵבָ֗א וְיוֹאָ֧שׁ וְשָׂרָ֛ף אֲשֶׁר־בָּעֲל֥וּ לְמוֹאָ֖ב וְיָשֻׁ֣בִי לָ֑חֶם וְהַדְּבָרִ֖ים עַתִּיקִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyvqym v'nshy khzb' vyv'sh vshrf 'shrb'lv lmv'b vyshby lchm vhdbrym 'tyqym
verses.translation: and Jokim, and the men of Cozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had dominion in Moab, and Jashubi-lehem. And the records are ancient.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵ֚מָּה הַיּ֣וֹצְרִ֔ים וְיֹשְׁבֵ֥י נְטָעִ֖ים וּגְדֵרָ֑ה עִם־הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ בִּמְלַאכְתּ֖וֹ יָ֥שְׁבוּ שָֽׁם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hmh hyvtsrym vyshby nt'ym vgdrh 'mhmlkh bml'khtv yshbv shm {s}
verses.translation: These were the potters, and those that dwelt among plantations and hedges; there they dwelt occupied in the king’s work.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֖י שִׁמְע֑וֹן נְמוּאֵ֣ל וְיָמִ֔ין יָרִ֖יב זֶ֥רַח שָׁאֽוּל׃
verses.translit: bny shm'vn nmv'l vymyn yryb zrch sh'vl
verses.translation: The sons of Simeon: Nemuel, and Jamim, Jarib, Zerah, Shaul;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שַׁלֻּ֥ם בְּנ֛וֹ מִבְשָׂ֥ם בְּנ֖וֹ מִשְׁמָ֥ע בְּנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: shlm bnv mbshm bnv mshm' bnv
verses.translation: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, Mishma his son.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֖י מִשְׁמָ֑ע חַמּוּאֵ֥ל בְּנ֛וֹ זַכּ֥וּר בְּנ֖וֹ שִׁמְעִ֥י בְנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vbny mshm' chmv'l bnv zkhvr bnv shm'y bnv
verses.translation: And the sons of Mishma: Hammuel his son, Zaccur his son, Shimei his son.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְשִׁמְעִ֞י בָּנִ֨ים שִׁשָּׁ֤ה עָשָׂר֙ וּבָנ֣וֹת שֵׁ֔שׁ וּלְאֶחָ֕יו אֵ֖ין בָּנִ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים וְכֹל֙ מִשְׁפַּחְתָּ֔ם לֹ֥א הִרְבּ֖וּ עַד־בְּנֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vlshm'y bnym shshh 'shr vbnvt shsh vl'chyv 'yn bnym rbym vkhl mshpchtm l' hrbv 'dbny yhvdh {s}
verses.translation: And Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brethren had not many children, neither did all their family multiply, like to the children of Judah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֥שְׁב֛וּ בִּבְאֵֽר־שֶׁ֥בַע וּמוֹלָדָ֖ה וַחֲצַ֥ר שׁוּעָֽל׃
verses.translit: vyshbv bb'rshb' vmvldh vchtsr shv'l
verses.translation: And they dwelt at Beer-sheba, and Moladah, and Hazar-shual;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְבִלְהָ֥ה וּבְעֶ֖צֶם וּבְתוֹלָֽד׃
verses.translit: vbblhh vb'tsm vbtvld
verses.translation: and at Bilhah, and at Ezem, and at Tolad;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבִבְתוּאֵ֥ל וּבְחׇרְמָ֖ה וּבְצִֽיקְלָֽג׃
verses.translit: vbbtv'l vbchrmh vbtsyqlg
verses.translation: and at Bethuel, and at Hormah, and at Ziklag;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְבֵ֤ית מַרְכָּבוֹת֙ וּבַחֲצַ֣ר סוּסִ֔ים וּבְבֵ֥ית בִּרְאִ֖י וּֽבְשַׁעֲרָ֑יִם אֵ֥לֶּה עָרֵיהֶ֖ם עַד־מְלֹ֥ךְ דָּוִֽיד׃
verses.translit: vbbyt mrkhbvt vbchtsr svsym vbbyt br'y vbsh'rym 'lh 'ryhm 'dmlkh dvyd
verses.translation: and at Beth-marcaboth, and Hazar-susim, and at Beth-biri, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities unto the reign of David.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְחַצְרֵיהֶם֙ עֵיטָ֣ם וָעַ֔יִן רִמּ֥וֹן וְתֹ֖כֶן וְעָשָׁ֑ן עָרִ֖ים חָמֵֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: vchtsryhm 'ytm v'yn rmvn vtkhn v'shn 'rym chmsh
verses.translation: And their villages were Etam, and Ain, Rimmon, and Tochen, and Ashan, five cities;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכׇל־חַצְרֵיהֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֧ר סְבִיב֛וֹת הֶעָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה עַד־בָּ֑עַל {ס} זֹ֚את מֽוֹשְׁבֹתָ֔ם וְהִתְיַחְשָׂ֖ם לָהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vkhlchtsryhm 'shr sbybvt h'rym h'lh 'db'l {s} z't mvshbtm vhtychshm lhm
verses.translation: and all their villages that were round about the same cities, unto Baal. These were their habitations, and they have their genealogy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמְשׁוֹבָ֣ב וְיַמְלֵ֔ךְ וְיוֹשָׁ֖ה בֶּן־אֲמַצְיָֽה׃
verses.translit: vmshvbb vymlkh vyvshh bn'mtsyh
verses.translation: And Meshobab, and Jamlech, and Joshah the son of Amaziah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיוֹאֵ֑ל וְיֵהוּא֙ בֶּן־י֣וֹשִׁבְיָ֔ה בֶּן־שְׂרָיָ֖ה בֶּן־עֲשִׂיאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vyv'l vyhv' bnyvshbyh bnshryh bn'shy'l
verses.translation: and Joel, and Jehu the son of Joshibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶלְיוֹעֵינַ֡י וְֽיַעֲקֹ֡בָה וִ֠ישׁוֹחָיָ֠ה וַעֲשָׂיָ֧ה וַעֲדִיאֵ֛ל וִישִׂימִאֵ֖ל וּבְנָיָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'lyv'yny vy'qbh vyshvchyh v'shyh v'dy'l vyshym'l vbnyh
verses.translation: and Elioenai, and Jaakobah, and Jeshoaiah, and Asaiah, and Adiel, and Jesimiel, and Benaiah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְזִיזָ֨א בֶן־שִׁפְעִ֧י בֶן־אַלּ֛וֹן בֶּן־יְדָיָ֥ה בֶן־שִׁמְרִ֖י בֶּן־שְׁמַֽעְיָֽה׃
verses.translit: vzyz' bnshp'y bn'lvn bnydyh bnshmry bnshm'yh
verses.translation: and Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֚לֶּה הַבָּאִ֣ים בְּשֵׁמ֔וֹת נְשִׂיאִ֖ים בְּמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָ֑ם וּבֵית֙ אֲב֣וֹתֵיהֶ֔ם פָּרְצ֖וּ לָרֽוֹב׃
verses.translit: 'lh hb'ym bshmvt nshy'ym bmshpchvtm vbyt 'bvtyhm prtsv lrvb
verses.translation: these mentioned by name were princes in their families; and their fathers’houses increased greatly.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּֽלְכוּ֙ לִמְב֣וֹא גְדֹ֔ר עַ֖ד לְמִזְרַ֣ח הַגָּ֑יְא לְבַקֵּ֥שׁ מִרְעֶ֖ה לְצֹאנָֽם׃
verses.translit: vylkhv lmbv' gdr 'd lmzrch hgy' lbqsh mr'h lts'nm
verses.translation: And they went to the entrance of Gedor, even unto the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיִּמְצְא֤וּ מִרְעֶה֙ שָׁמֵ֣ן וָט֔וֹב וְהָאָ֙רֶץ֙ רַחֲבַ֣ת יָדַ֔יִם וְשֹׁקֶ֖טֶת וּשְׁלֵוָ֑ה כִּ֣י מִן־חָ֔ם הַיֹּשְׁבִ֥ים שָׁ֖ם לְפָנִֽים׃
verses.translit: vymts'v mr'h shmn vtvb vh'rts rchbt ydym vshqtt vshlvh khy mnchm hyshbym shm lpnym
verses.translation: And they found fat pasture and good, and the land was wide, and quiet, and peaceable; for they that dwelt there aforetime were of Ham.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֡אוּ אֵ֩לֶּה֩ הַכְּתוּבִ֨ים בְּשֵׁמ֜וֹת בִּימֵ֣י  יְחִזְקִיָּ֣הוּ מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָ֗ה וַיַּכּ֨וּ אֶת־אׇהֳלֵיהֶ֜ם וְאֶת־[הַמְּעוּנִ֨ים] (המעינים) אֲשֶׁ֤ר נִמְצְאֽוּ־שָׁ֙מָּה֙ וַיַּֽחֲרִימֻם֙ עַד־הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה וַיֵּשְׁב֖וּ תַּחְתֵּיהֶ֑ם כִּי־מִרְעֶ֥ה לְצֹאנָ֖ם שָֽׁם׃
verses.translit: vyb'v 'lh hkhtvbym bshmvt bymy  ychzqyhv mlkhyhvdh vykhv 't'hlyhm v't[hm'vnym] (hm'ynym) 'shr nmts'vshmh vychrymm 'dhyvm hzh vyshbv tchtyhm khymr'h lts'nm shm
verses.translation: And these written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and smote their tents, and the Meunim that were found there, and destroyed them utterly, unto this day, and dwelt in their stead; because there was pasture there for their flocks.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמֵהֶ֣ם  מִן־בְּנֵ֣י שִׁמְע֗וֹן הָֽלְכוּ֙ לְהַ֣ר שֵׂעִ֔יר אֲנָשִׁ֖ים חֲמֵ֣שׁ מֵא֑וֹת וּפְלַטְיָ֡ה וּ֠נְעַרְיָ֠ה וּרְפָיָ֧ה וְעֻזִּיאֵ֛ל בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׁעִ֖י בְּרֹאשָֽׁם׃
verses.translit: vmhm  mnbny shm'vn hlkhv lhr sh'yr 'nshym chmsh m'vt vpltyh vn'ryh vrpyh v'zy'l bny ysh'y br'shm
verses.translation: And some of them, even of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, and Neariah, and Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּכּ֕וּ אֶת־שְׁאֵרִ֥ית הַפְּלֵטָ֖ה לַעֲמָלֵ֑ק וַיֵּ֣שְׁבוּ שָׁ֔ם עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vykhv 'tsh'ryt hplth l'mlq vyshbv shm 'd hyvm hzh {p}
verses.translation: And they smote the remnant of the Amalekites that escaped, and dwelt there unto this day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֨י רְאוּבֵ֥ן בְּכֽוֹר־יִשְׂרָאֵל֮ כִּ֣י ה֣וּא הַבְּכוֹר֒ וּֽבְחַלְּלוֹ֙ יְצוּעֵ֣י אָבִ֔יו נִתְּנָה֙ בְּכֹ֣רָת֔וֹ לִבְנֵ֥י יוֹסֵ֖ף בֶּן־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְלֹ֥א לְהִתְיַחֵ֖שׂ לַבְּכֹרָֽה׃
verses.translit: vbny r'vbn bkhvryshr'l khy hv' hbkhvr vbchllv ytsv'y 'byv ntnh bkhrtv lbny yvsf bnyshr'l vl' lhtychsh lbkhrh
verses.translation: And the sons of Reuben the first-born of Israel—for he was the first-born; but, forasmuch as he defiled his father’s couch, his birthright was given unto the sons of Joseph the son of Israel, yet not so that he was to be reckoned in the genealogy as first-born.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י יְהוּדָה֙ גָּבַ֣ר בְּאֶחָ֔יו וּלְנָגִ֖יד מִמֶּ֑נּוּ וְהַבְּכֹרָ֖ה לְיוֹסֵֽף׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khy yhvdh gbr b'chyv vlngyd mmnv vhbkhrh lyvsf {s}
verses.translation: For Judah prevailed above his brethren, and of him came he that is the prince; but the birthright was Joseph’s—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֥י רְאוּבֵ֖ן בְּכ֣וֹר יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל חֲנ֥וֹךְ וּפַלּ֖וּא חֶצְר֥וֹן וְכַרְמִֽי׃
verses.translit: bny r'vbn bkhvr yshr'l chnvkh vplv' chtsrvn vkhrmy
verses.translation: the sons of Reuben the first-born of Israel: Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֖י יוֹאֵ֑ל שְׁמַֽעְיָ֥ה בְנ֛וֹ גּ֥וֹג בְּנ֖וֹ שִׁמְעִ֥י בְנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: bny yv'l shm'yh bnv gvg bnv shm'y bnv
verses.translation: The sons of Joel: Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִיכָ֥ה בְנ֛וֹ רְאָיָ֥ה בְנ֖וֹ בַּ֥עַל בְּנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: mykhh bnv r'yh bnv b'l bnv
verses.translation: Micah his son, Reaiah his son, Baal his son;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּאֵרָ֣ה בְנ֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֶגְלָ֔ה תִּלְּגַ֥ת פִּלְנְאֶ֖סֶר מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשֻּׁ֑ר ה֥וּא נָשִׂ֖יא לָרֽאוּבֵנִֽי׃
verses.translit: b'rh bnv 'shr hglh tlgt pln'sr mlkh 'shr hv' nshy' lr'vbny
verses.translation: Beerah his son, whom Tillegath-pilneser king of Assyria carried away captive; he was prince of the Reubenites.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶחָיו֙ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֔יו בְּהִתְיַחֵ֖שׂ לְתֹלְדוֹתָ֑ם הָרֹ֥אשׁ יְעִיאֵ֖ל וּזְכַרְיָֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: v'chyv lmshpchtyv bhtychsh ltldvtm hr'sh y'y'l vzkhryhv
verses.translation: And his brethren by their families, when the genealogy of their generations was reckoned: the chief Jeiel, and Zechariah,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבֶ֙לַע֙ בֶּן־עָזָ֔ז בֶּן־שֶׁ֖מַע בֶּן־יוֹאֵ֑ל ה֚וּא יוֹשֵׁ֣ב בַּעֲרֹעֵ֔ר וְעַד־נְב֖וֹ וּבַ֥עַל מְעֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: vbl' bn'zz bnshm' bnyv'l hv' yvshb b'r'r v'dnbv vb'l m'vn
verses.translation: and Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who dwelt in Aroer, even unto Nebo and Baal-meon;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלַמִּזְרָ֗ח יָשַׁב֙ עַד־לְב֣וֹא מִדְבָּ֔רָה לְמִן־הַנָּהָ֖ר פְּרָ֑ת כִּ֧י מִקְנֵיהֶ֛ם רָב֖וּ בְּאֶ֥רֶץ גִּלְעָֽד׃
verses.translit: vlmzrch yshb 'dlbv' mdbrh lmnhnhr prt khy mqnyhm rbv b'rts gl'd
verses.translation: and eastward he dwelt even unto the entrance of the wilderness from the river Euphrates; because their cattle were multiplied in the land of Gilead.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבִימֵ֣י שָׁא֗וּל עָשׂ֤וּ מִלְחָמָה֙ עִם־הַֽהַגְרִאִ֔ים וַֽיִּפְּל֖וּ בְּיָדָ֑ם וַיֵּֽשְׁבוּ֙ בְּאׇ֣הֳלֵיהֶ֔ם עַֽל־כׇּל־פְּנֵ֖י מִזְרָ֥ח לַגִּלְעָֽד׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vbymy sh'vl 'shv mlchmh 'mhhgr'ym vyplv bydm vyshbv b'hlyhm 'lkhlpny mzrch lgl'd {s}
verses.translation: And in the days of Saul they made war with the Hagrites, who fell by their hand; and they dwelt in their tents throughout all the land east of Gilead.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵי־גָ֣ד לְנֶגְדָּ֗ם יָ֥שְׁב֛וּ בְּאֶ֥רֶץ הַבָּשָׁ֖ן עַד־סַלְכָֽה׃
verses.translit: vbnygd lngdm yshbv b'rts hbshn 'dslkhh
verses.translation: And the sons of Gad dwelt over against them, in the land of Bashan unto Salcah:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יוֹאֵ֣ל הָרֹ֔אשׁ וְשָׁפָ֖ם הַמִּשְׁנֶ֑ה וְיַעְנַ֥י וְשָׁפָ֖ט בַּבָּשָֽׁן׃
verses.translit: yv'l hr'sh vshpm hmshnh vy'ny vshpt bbshn
verses.translation: Joel the chief, and Shapham the second, and Janai, and Shaphat in Bashan;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲחֵיהֶ֞ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבוֹתֵיהֶ֗ם מִיכָאֵ֡ל וּמְשֻׁלָּ֡ם וְ֠שֶׁ֠בַע וְיוֹרַ֧י וְיַעְכָּ֛ן וְזִ֥יעַ וָעֵ֖בֶר שִׁבְעָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'chyhm lbyt 'bvtyhm mykh'l vmshlm vshb' vyvry vy'khn vzy' v'br shb'h {s}
verses.translation: and their brethren of their fathers’houses: Michael, and Meshullam, and Sheba, and Jorai, and Jacan, and Zia, and Eber, seven.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה  בְּנֵ֣י אֲבִיחַ֗יִל בֶּן־חוּרִ֡י בֶּן־יָ֠ר֠וֹחַ בֶּן־גִּלְעָ֧ד בֶּן־מִיכָאֵ֛ל בֶּן־יְשִׁישַׁ֥י בֶּן־יַחְדּ֖וֹ בֶּן־בּֽוּז׃
verses.translit: 'lh  bny 'bychyl bnchvry bnyrvch bngl'd bnmykh'l bnyshyshy bnychdv bnbvz
verses.translation: These were the sons of Abihail the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jehishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲחִי֙ בֶּן־עַבְדִּיאֵ֣ל בֶּן־גּוּנִ֔י רֹ֖אשׁ לְבֵ֥ית אֲבוֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: 'chy bn'bdy'l bngvny r'sh lbyt 'bvtm
verses.translation: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of their fathers’houses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֥שְׁב֛וּ בַּגִּלְעָ֥ד בַּבָּשָׁ֖ן וּבִבְנֹתֶ֑יהָ וּבְכׇֽל־מִגְרְשֵׁ֥י שָׁר֖וֹן עַל־תּוֹצְאוֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: vyshbv bgl'd bbshn vbbntyh vbkhlmgrshy shrvn 'ltvts'vtm
verses.translation: And they dwelt in Gilead in Bashan, and in the towns thereof, and in all the open lands of the plain, upon their borders.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֻּלָּם֙ הִתְיַחְשׂ֔וּ בִּימֵ֖י יוֹתָ֣ם מֶֽלֶךְ־יְהוּדָ֑ה וּבִימֵ֖י יָרׇבְעָ֥ם מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khlm htychshv bymy yvtm mlkhyhvdh vbymy yrb'm mlkhyshr'l {p}
verses.translation: All these were reckoned by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵ֨ן וְגָדִ֜י וַחֲצִ֥י שֵֽׁבֶט־מְנַשֶּׁה֮ מִן־בְּנֵי־חַ֒יִל֒ אֲ֠נָשִׁ֠ים נֹשְׂאֵ֨י מָגֵ֤ן וְחֶ֙רֶב֙ וְדֹ֣רְכֵי קֶ֔שֶׁת וּלְמוּדֵ֖י מִלְחָמָ֑ה אַרְבָּעִ֨ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֥ה אֶ֛לֶף וּשְׁבַע־מֵא֥וֹת וְשִׁשִּׁ֖ים יֹצְאֵ֥י צָבָֽא׃
verses.translit: bnyr'vbn vgdy vchtsy shbtmnshh mnbnychyl 'nshym nsh'y mgn vchrb vdrkhy qsht vlmvdy mlchmh 'rb'ym v'rb'h 'lf vshb'm'vt vshshym yts'y tsb'
verses.translation: The sons of Reuben, and the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, as many as were valiant men, men able to bear buckler and sword, and to shoot with bow, and skilful in war, were forty and four thousand seven hundred and threescore, that were able to go forth to war.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּעֲשׂ֥וּ מִלְחָמָ֖ה עִם־הַהַגְרִיאִ֑ים וִיט֥וּר וְנָפִ֖ישׁ וְנוֹדָֽב׃
verses.translit: vy'shv mlchmh 'mhhgry'ym vytvr vnpysh vnvdb
verses.translation: And they made war with the Hagrites, with Jetur, and Naphish, and Nodab.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּעָזְר֣וּ עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם וַיִּנָּתְנ֤וּ בְיָדָם֙ הַֽהַגְרִיאִ֔ים וְכֹ֖ל שֶׁ֣עִמָּהֶ֑ם כִּ֠י לֵאלֹהִ֤ים זָעֲקוּ֙ בַּמִּלְחָמָ֔ה וְנַעְתּ֥וֹר לָהֶ֖ם כִּי־בָ֥טְחוּ בֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vy'zrv 'lyhm vyntnv bydm hhgry'ym vkhl sh'mhm khy l'lhym z'qv bmlchmh vn'tvr lhm khybtchv bv
verses.translation: And they were helped against them, and the Hagrites were delivered into their hand, and all that were with them; for they cried to God in the battle, and He was entreated of them, because they put their trust in Him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁבּ֣וּ מִקְנֵיהֶ֗ם גְּֽמַלֵּיהֶ֞ם חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים אֶ֙לֶף֙ וְצֹ֗אן מָאתַ֤יִם וַחֲמִשִּׁים֙ אֶ֔לֶף וַחֲמוֹרִ֖ים אַלְפָּ֑יִם וְנֶ֥פֶשׁ אָדָ֖ם מֵ֥אָה אָֽלֶף׃
verses.translit: vyshbv mqnyhm gmlyhm chmshym 'lf vts'n m'tym vchmshym 'lf vchmvrym 'lpym vnpsh 'dm m'h 'lf
verses.translation: And they took away their cattle: of their camels fifty thousand, and of sheep two hundred and fifty thousand, and of asses two thousand; and of souls of men a hundred thousand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־חֲלָלִ֤ים רַבִּים֙ נָפָ֔לוּ כִּ֥י מֵהָאֱלֹהִ֖ים הַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה וַיֵּשְׁב֥וּ תַחְתֵּיהֶ֖ם עַד־הַגֹּלָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khychllym rbym nplv khy mh'lhym hmlchmh vyshbv tchtyhm 'dhglh {p}
verses.translation: For there fell many slain, because the war was of God. And they dwelt in their stead until the captivity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֗י חֲצִי֙ שֵׁ֣בֶט מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה יָשְׁב֖וּ בָּאָ֑רֶץ מִבָּשָׁ֞ן עַד־בַּ֧עַל חֶרְמ֛וֹן וּשְׂנִ֥יר וְהַר־חֶרְמ֖וֹן הֵ֥מָּה רָבֽוּ׃
verses.translit: vbny chtsy shbt mnshh yshbv b'rts mbshn 'db'l chrmvn vshnyr vhrchrmvn hmh rbv
verses.translation: And the children of the half-tribe of Manasseh dwelt in the land, from Bashan unto Baal-hermon and Senir and mount Hermon, where they increased.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֖לֶּה רָאשֵׁ֣י בֵית־אֲבוֹתָ֑ם וְעֵ֡פֶר וְיִשְׁעִ֡י וֶאֱלִיאֵ֡ל וְ֠עַזְרִיאֵ֠ל וְיִרְמְיָ֨ה וְהוֹדַוְיָ֜ה וְיַחְדִּיאֵ֗ל אֲנָשִׁים֙ גִּבּ֣וֹרֵי חַ֔יִל אַנְשֵׁ֣י שֵׁמ֔וֹת רָאשִׁ֖ים לְבֵ֥ית אֲבוֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: v'lh r'shy byt'bvtm v'pr vysh'y v'ly'l v'zry'l vyrmyh vhvdvyh vychdy'l 'nshym gbvry chyl 'nshy shmvt r'shym lbyt 'bvtm
verses.translation: And these were the heads of their fathers’houses: Epher, and Ishi, and Eliel, and Azriel, and Jeremiah, and Hodaviah, and Jahdiel, mighty men of valour, famous men, heads of their fathers’houses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּֽמְעֲל֔וּ בֵּאלֹהֵ֖י אֲבֹתֵיהֶ֑ם וַיִּזְנ֗וּ אַֽחֲרֵי֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י עַמֵּֽי־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־הִשְׁמִ֥יד אֱלֹהִ֖ים מִפְּנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vym'lv b'lhy 'btyhm vyznv 'chry 'lhy 'myh'rts 'shrhshmyd 'lhym mpnyhm
verses.translation: And they broke faith with the God of their fathers, and went astray after the gods of the peoples of the land, whom God destroyed before them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֩עַר֩ אֱלֹהֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אֶת־ר֣וּחַ  פּ֣וּל מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁ֗וּר וְאֶת־ר֙וּחַ֙ תִּלְּגַ֤ת פִּלְנֶ֙סֶר֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר וַיַּגְלֵם֙ לָראוּבֵנִ֣י וְלַגָּדִ֔י וְלַחֲצִ֖י שֵׁ֣בֶט מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה וַ֠יְבִיאֵ֠ם לַחְלַ֨ח וְחָב֤וֹר וְהָרָא֙ וּנְהַ֣ר גּוֹזָ֔ן עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vy'r 'lhy yshr'l 'trvch  pvl mlkh'shvr v'trvch tlgt plnsr mlkh 'shvr vyglm lr'vbny vlgdy vlchtsy shbt mnshh vyby'm lchlch vchbvr vhr' vnhr gvzn 'd hyvm hzh {p}
verses.translation: And the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tillegath-pilneser king of Assyria, and he carried them away, even the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, and brought them unto Halah, and Habor, and Hara, and to the river of Gozan, unto this day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֖י לֵוִ֑י גֵּרְשׁ֕וֹן קְהָ֖ת וּמְרָרִֽי׃
verses.translit: bny lvy grshvn qht vmrry
verses.translation: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֖י קְהָ֑ת עַמְרָ֣ם יִצְהָ֔ר וְחֶבְר֖וֹן וְעֻזִּיאֵֽל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vbny qht 'mrm ytshr vchbrvn v'zy'l {s}
verses.translation: And the sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֣י עַמְרָ֔ם אַהֲרֹ֥ן וּמֹשֶׁ֖ה וּמִרְיָ֑ם {ס} וּבְנֵ֣י אַֽהֲרֹ֔ן נָדָב֙ וַאֲבִיה֔וּא אֶלְעָזָ֖ר וְאִיתָמָֽר׃
verses.translit: vbny 'mrm 'hrn vmshh vmrym {s} vbny 'hrn ndb v'byhv' 'l'zr v'ytmr
verses.translation: And the children of Amram: Aaron, and Moses, and Miriam. And the sons of Aaron: Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶלְעָזָר֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־פִּֽינְחָ֔ס פִּֽינְחָ֖ס הֹלִ֥יד אֶת־אֲבִישֽׁוּעַ׃
verses.translit: 'l'zr hvlyd 'tpynchs pynchs hlyd 't'byshv'
verses.translation: Eleazar begot Phinehas, Phinehas begot Abishua;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲבִישׁ֙וּעַ֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־בֻּקִּ֔י וּבֻקִּ֖י הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־עֻזִּֽי׃
verses.translit: v'byshv' hvlyd 'tbqy vbqy hvlyd 't'zy
verses.translation: and Abishua begot Bukki, and Bukki begot Uzzi;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעֻזִּי֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־זְרַֽחְיָ֔ה וּֽזְרַֽחְיָ֖ה הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־מְרָיֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: v'zy hvlyd 'tzrchyh vzrchyh hvlyd 'tmryvt
verses.translation: and Uzzi begot Zerahiah, and Zerahiah begot Meraioth;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מְרָיוֹת֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־אֲמַרְיָ֔ה וַאֲמַרְיָ֖ה הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־אֲחִיטֽוּב׃
verses.translit: mryvt hvlyd 't'mryh v'mryh hvlyd 't'chytvb
verses.translation: Meraioth begot Amariah, and Amariah begot Ahitub;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽאֲחִיטוּב֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־צָד֔וֹק וְצָד֖וֹק הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־אֲחִימָֽעַץ׃
verses.translit: v'chytvb hvlyd 'ttsdvq vtsdvq hvlyd 't'chym'ts
verses.translation: and Ahitub begot Zadok, and Zadok begot Ahimaaz;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲחִימַ֙עַץ֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־עֲזַרְיָ֔ה וַעֲזַרְיָ֖ה הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־יוֹחָנָֽן׃
verses.translit: v'chym'ts hvlyd 't'zryh v'zryh hvlyd 'tyvchnn
verses.translation: and Ahimaaz begot Azariah, and Azariah begot Johanan;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיוֹחָנָ֖ן הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־עֲזַרְיָ֑ה ה֚וּא אֲשֶׁ֣ר כִּהֵ֔ן בַּבַּ֕יִת אֲשֶׁר־בָּנָ֥ה שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה בִּירוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: vyvchnn hvlyd 't'zryh hv' 'shr khhn bbyt 'shrbnh shlmh byrvshl͏m
verses.translation: and Johanan begot Azariah—he it is that executed the priest’s office in the house that Solomon built in Jerusalem—:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיּ֥וֹלֶד עֲזַרְיָ֖ה אֶת־אֲמַרְיָ֑ה וַאֲמַרְיָ֖ה הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־אֲחִיטֽוּב׃
verses.translit: vyvld 'zryh 't'mryh v'mryh hvlyd 't'chytvb
verses.translation: and Azariah begot Amariah, and Amariah begot Ahitub;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽאֲחִיטוּב֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־צָד֔וֹק וְצָד֖וֹק הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־שַׁלּֽוּם׃
verses.translit: v'chytvb hvlyd 'ttsdvq vtsdvq hvlyd 'tshlvm
verses.translation: and Ahitub begot Zadok, and Zadok begot Shallum;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשַׁלּוּם֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־חִלְקִיָּ֔ה וְחִלְקִיָּ֖ה הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־עֲזַרְיָֽה׃
verses.translit: vshlvm hvlyd 'tchlqyh vchlqyh hvlyd 't'zryh
verses.translation: and Shallum begot Hilkiah, and Hilkiah begot Azariah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַעֲזַרְיָה֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־שְׂרָיָ֔ה וּשְׂרָיָ֖ה הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־יְהוֹצָדָֽק׃
verses.translit: v'zryh hvlyd 'tshryh vshryh hvlyd 'tyhvtsdq
verses.translation: and Azariah begot Seraiah, and Seraiah begot Jehozadak;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וִיהוֹצָדָ֣ק הָלַ֔ךְ בְּהַגְל֣וֹת יְהֹוָ֔ה אֶת־יְהוּדָ֖ה וִירֽוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם בְּיַ֖ד נְבֻכַדְנֶאצַּֽר׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyhvtsdq hlkh bhglvt yhvh 'tyhvdh vyrvshl͏m byd nbkhdn'tsr {p}
verses.translation: and Jehozadak went into captivity, when the LORD carried away Judah and Jerusalem by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֖י לֵוִ֑י גֵּרְשֹׁ֕ם קְהָ֖ת וּמְרָרִֽי׃
verses.translit: bny lvy grshm qht vmrry
verses.translation: The sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath and Merari.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֛לֶּה שְׁמ֥וֹת בְּֽנֵי־גֵרְשׁ֖וֹם לִבְנִ֥י וְשִׁמְעִֽי׃
verses.translit: v'lh shmvt bnygrshvm lbny vshm'y
verses.translation: And these are the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni, and Shimei.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֖י קְהָ֑ת עַמְרָ֣ם וְיִצְהָ֔ר וְחֶבְר֖וֹן וְעֻזִּיאֵֽל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vbny qht 'mrm vytshr vchbrvn v'zy'l {s}
verses.translation: And the sons of Kohath were Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֥י מְרָרִ֖י מַחְלִ֣י וּמֻשִׁ֑י וְאֵ֛לֶּה מִשְׁפְּח֥וֹת הַלֵּוִ֖י לַאֲבֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: bny mrry mchly vmshy v'lh mshpchvt hlvy l'btyhm
verses.translation: The sons of Merari: Mahli, and Mushi. And these are the families of the Levites according to their fathers’houses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְֽגֵרְשׁ֑וֹם לִבְנִ֥י בְנ֛וֹ יַ֥חַת בְּנ֖וֹ זִמָּ֥ה בְנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: lgrshvm lbny bnv ycht bnv zmh bnv
verses.translation: Of Gershom: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יוֹאָ֤ח בְּנוֹ֙ עִדּ֣וֹ בְנ֔וֹ זֶ֥רַח בְּנ֖וֹ יְאׇתְרַ֥י בְּנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: yv'ch bnv 'dv bnv zrch bnv y'try bnv
verses.translation: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, Jeatherai his son. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֖י קְהָ֑ת עַמִּינָדָ֣ב בְּנ֔וֹ קֹ֥רַח בְּנ֖וֹ אַסִּ֥יר בְּנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: bny qht 'myndb bnv qrch bnv 'syr bnv
verses.translation: The sons of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶלְקָנָ֥ה בְנ֛וֹ וְאֶבְיָסָ֥ף בְּנ֖וֹ וְאַסִּ֥יר בְּנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'lqnh bnv v'bysf bnv v'syr bnv
verses.translation: Elkanah his son, and Ebiasaph his son, and Assir his son;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תַּ֤חַת בְּנוֹ֙ אוּרִיאֵ֣ל בְּנ֔וֹ עֻזִּיָּ֥ה בְנ֖וֹ וְשָׁא֥וּל בְּנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: tcht bnv 'vry'l bnv 'zyh bnv vsh'vl bnv
verses.translation: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵי֙ אֶלְקָנָ֔ה עֲמָשַׂ֖י וַאֲחִימֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vbny 'lqnh 'mshy v'chymvt
verses.translation: And the sons of Elkanah: Amasai, and Ahimoth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶלְקָנָ֑ה (בנו) [בְּנֵי֙] אֶלְקָנָ֔ה צוֹפַ֥י בְּנ֖וֹ וְנַ֥חַת בְּנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'lqnh (bnv) [bny] 'lqnh tsvpy bnv vncht bnv
verses.translation: As for Elkanah: the sons of Elkanah: Zophai his son, and Nahath his son;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱלִיאָ֥ב בְּנ֛וֹ יְרֹחָ֥ם בְּנ֖וֹ אֶלְקָנָ֥ה בְנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'ly'b bnv yrchm bnv 'lqnh bnv
verses.translation: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֧י שְׁמוּאֵ֛ל הַבְּכֹ֥ר וַשְׁנִ֖י וַאֲבִיָּֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vbny shmv'l hbkhr vshny v'byh {s}
verses.translation: And the sons of Samuel: the first-born Vashni; then Abiah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֥י מְרָרִ֖י מַחְלִ֑י לִבְנִ֥י בְנ֛וֹ שִׁמְעִ֥י בְנ֖וֹ עֻזָּ֥ה בְנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: bny mrry mchly lbny bnv shm'y bnv 'zh bnv
verses.translation: The sons of Merari: Mahli; Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁמְעָ֥א בְנ֛וֹ חַגִּיָּ֥ה בְנ֖וֹ עֲשָׂיָ֥ה בְנֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: shm'' bnv chgyh bnv 'shyh bnv {p}
verses.translation: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֗לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֶעֱמִ֥יד דָּוִ֛יד עַל־יְדֵי־שִׁ֖יר בֵּ֣ית יְהֹוָ֑ה מִמְּנ֖וֹחַ הָאָרֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: v'lh 'shr h'myd dvyd 'lydyshyr byt yhvh mmnvch h'rvn
verses.translation: And these are they whom David set over the service of song in the house of the LORD, after that the ark had rest.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּֽהְי֨וּ מְשָֽׁרְתִ֜ים לִפְנֵ֨י מִשְׁכַּ֤ן אֹֽהֶל־מוֹעֵד֙ בַּשִּׁ֔יר עַד־בְּנ֧וֹת שְׁלֹמֹ֛ה אֶת־בֵּ֥ית יְהֹוָ֖ה בִּירוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם וַיַּעַמְד֥וּ כְמִשְׁפָּטָ֖ם עַל־עֲבוֹדָתָֽם׃
verses.translit: vyhyv mshrtym lpny mshkhn 'hlmv'd bshyr 'dbnvt shlmh 'tbyt yhvh byrvshl͏m vy'mdv khmshptm 'l'bvdtm
verses.translation: And they ministered with song before the tabernacle of the tent of meeting, until Solomon had built the house of the LORD in Jerusalem; and they took their station at their service according to their order.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֥לֶּה הָעֹמְדִ֖ים וּבְנֵיהֶ֑ם מִבְּנֵי֙ הַקְּהָתִ֔י הֵימָן֙ הַמְשׁוֹרֵ֔ר בֶּן־יוֹאֵ֖ל בֶּן־שְׁמוּאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: v'lh h'mdym vbnyhm mbny hqhty hymn hmshvrr bnyv'l bnshmv'l
verses.translation: And these are they that took their station, and their sons. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman the singer, the son of Joel, the son of Samuel;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֶּן־אֶלְקָנָה֙ בֶּן־יְרֹחָ֔ם בֶּן־אֱלִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־תּֽוֹחַ׃
verses.translit: bn'lqnh bnyrchm bn'ly'l bntvch
verses.translation: the son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֶּן־[צוּף֙] (ציף) בֶּן־אֶלְקָנָ֔ה בֶּן־מַ֖חַת בֶּן־עֲמָשָֽׂי׃
verses.translit: bn[tsvf] (tsyf) bn'lqnh bnmcht bn'mshy
verses.translation: the son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֶּן־אֶלְקָנָה֙ בֶּן־יוֹאֵ֔ל בֶּן־עֲזַרְיָ֖ה בֶּן־צְפַנְיָֽה׃
verses.translit: bn'lqnh bnyv'l bn'zryh bntspnyh
verses.translation: the son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֶּן־תַּ֙חַת֙ בֶּן־אַסִּ֔יר בֶּן־אֶבְיָסָ֖ף בֶּן־קֹֽרַח׃
verses.translit: bntcht bn'syr bn'bysf bnqrch
verses.translation: the son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֶּן־יִצְהָ֣ר בֶּן־קְהָ֔ת בֶּן־לֵוִ֖י בֶּן־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bnytshr bnqht bnlvy bnyshr'l {s}
verses.translation: the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָחִ֣יו אָסָ֔ף הָעֹמֵ֖ד עַל־יְמִינ֑וֹ אָסָ֥ף בֶּן־בֶּרֶכְיָ֖הוּ בֶּן־שִׁמְעָֽא׃
verses.translit: v'chyv 'sf h'md 'lymynv 'sf bnbrkhyhv bnshm''
verses.translation: And his brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand; even Asaph the son of Berechiah, the son of Shimea;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֶּן־מִיכָאֵ֥ל בֶּן־בַּעֲשֵׂיָ֖ה בֶּן־מַלְכִּיָּֽה׃
verses.translit: bnmykh'l bnb'shyh bnmlkhyh
verses.translation: the son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchijah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֶּן־אֶתְנִ֥י בֶן־זֶ֖רַח בֶּן־עֲדָיָֽה׃
verses.translit: bn'tny bnzrch bn'dyh
verses.translation: the son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֶּן־אֵיתָ֥ן בֶּן־זִמָּ֖ה בֶּן־שִׁמְעִֽי׃
verses.translit: bn'ytn bnzmh bnshm'y
verses.translation: the son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֶּן־יַ֥חַת בֶּן־גֵּרְשֹׁ֖ם בֶּן־לֵוִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bnycht bngrshm bnlvy {s}
verses.translation: the son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֧י מְרָרִ֛י אֲחֵיהֶ֖ם עַֽל־הַשְּׂמֹ֑אול אֵיתָן֙ בֶּן־קִישִׁ֔י בֶּן־עַבְדִּ֖י בֶּן־מַלּֽוּךְ׃
verses.translit: vbny mrry 'chyhm 'lhshm'vl 'ytn bnqyshy bn'bdy bnmlvkh
verses.translation: And on the left hand their brethren the sons of Merari: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֶּן־חֲשַׁבְיָ֥ה בֶן־אֲמַצְיָ֖ה בֶּן־חִלְקִיָּֽה׃
verses.translit: bnchshbyh bn'mtsyh bnchlqyh
verses.translation: the son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֶּן־אַמְצִ֥י בֶן־בָּנִ֖י בֶּן־שָֽׁמֶר׃
verses.translit: bn'mtsy bnbny bnshmr
verses.translation: the son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shemer;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֶּן־מַחְלִי֙ בֶּן־מוּשִׁ֔י בֶּן־מְרָרִ֖י בֶּן־לֵוִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bnmchly bnmvshy bnmrry bnlvy {s}
verses.translation: the son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲחֵיהֶ֖ם הַלְוִיִּ֑ם נְתוּנִ֕ים לְכׇ֨ל־עֲבוֹדַ֔ת מִשְׁכַּ֖ן בֵּ֥ית הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: v'chyhm hlvym ntvnym lkhl'bvdt mshkhn byt h'lhym
verses.translation: And their brethren the Levites were appointed for all the service of the tabernacle of the house of God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽאַהֲרֹ֨ן וּבָנָ֜יו מַקְטִירִ֨ים עַל־מִזְבַּ֤ח הָעוֹלָה֙ וְעַל־מִזְבַּ֣ח הַקְּטֹ֔רֶת לְכֹ֕ל מְלֶ֖אכֶת קֹ֣דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁ֑ים וּלְכַפֵּר֙ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כְּכֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֔ה מֹשֶׁ֖ה עֶ֥בֶד הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'hrn vbnyv mqtyrym 'lmzbch h'vlh v'lmzbch hqtrt lkhl ml'kht qdsh hqdshym vlkhpr 'lyshr'l khkhl 'shr tsvh mshh 'bd h'lhym {p}
verses.translation: But Aaron and his sons offered upon the altar of burnt-offering, and upon the altar of incense, for all the work of the most holy place, and to make atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֑ן אֶלְעָזָ֥ר בְּנ֛וֹ פִּֽינְחָ֥ס בְּנ֖וֹ אֲבִישׁ֥וּעַ בְּנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'lh bny 'hrn 'l'zr bnv pynchs bnv 'byshv' bnv
verses.translation: And these are the sons of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֻּקִּ֥י בְנ֛וֹ עֻזִּ֥י בְנ֖וֹ זְרַֽחְיָ֥ה בְנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: bqy bnv 'zy bnv zrchyh bnv
verses.translation: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מְרָי֥וֹת בְּנ֛וֹ אֲמַרְיָ֥ה בְנ֖וֹ אֲחִיט֥וּב בְּנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: mryvt bnv 'mryh bnv 'chytvb bnv
verses.translation: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צָד֥וֹק בְּנ֖וֹ אֲחִימַ֥עַץ בְּנֽוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: tsdvq bnv 'chym'ts bnv {s}
verses.translation: Zadok his son, Ahimaaz his son.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ מֽוֹשְׁבוֹתָ֔ם לְטִירוֹתָ֖ם בִּגְבוּלָ֑ם לִבְנֵ֤י אַֽהֲרֹן֙ לְמִשְׁפַּ֣חַת הַקְּהָתִ֔י כִּ֥י לָהֶ֖ם הָיָ֥ה הַגּוֹרָֽל׃
verses.translit: v'lh mvshbvtm ltyrvtm bgbvlm lbny 'hrn lmshpcht hqhty khy lhm hyh hgvrl
verses.translation: Now these are their dwelling-places according to their encampments in their borders: to the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites, for theirs was the [first] lot,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיִּתְּנ֥וּ לָהֶ֛ם אֶת־חֶבְר֖וֹן בְּאֶ֣רֶץ יְהוּדָ֑ה וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֖יהָ סְבִיבֹתֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: vytnv lhm 'tchbrvn b'rts yhvdh v'tmgrshyh sbybtyh
verses.translation: to them they gave Hebron in the land of Judah, and the open land round about it;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־שְׂדֵ֥ה הָעִ֖יר וְאֶת־חֲצֵרֶ֑יהָ נָתְנ֖וּ לְכָלֵ֥ב בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'tshdh h'yr v'tchtsryh ntnv lkhlb bnypnh {s}
verses.translation: but the fields of the city, and the villages thereof, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלִבְנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֗ן נָֽתְנוּ֙ אֶת־עָרֵ֣י הַמִּקְלָ֔ט אֶת־חֶבְר֥וֹן וְאֶת־לִבְנָ֖ה וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑יהָ וְאֶת־יַתִּ֥ר וְאֶֽת־אֶשְׁתְּמֹ֖עַ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃
verses.translit: vlbny 'hrn ntnv 't'ry hmqlt 'tchbrvn v'tlbnh v'tmgrshyh v'tytr v't'shtm' v'tmgrshyh
verses.translation: And to the sons of Aaron they gave the acity of refuge, Hebron; Libnah also with the open land about it, and Jattir, and Eshtemoa with the open land about it;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־חִילֵז֙ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֔יהָ אֶת־דְּבִ֖יר וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃
verses.translit: v'tchylz v'tmgrshyh 'tdbyr v'tmgrshyh
verses.translation: and Hilen with the open land about it, Debir with the open land about it;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־עָשָׁן֙ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֔יהָ וְאֶת־בֵּ֥ית שֶׁ֖מֶשׁ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v't'shn v'tmgrshyh v'tbyt shmsh v'tmgrshyh {s}
verses.translation: and Ashan with the open land about it, and Beth-shemesh with the open land about it;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִמַּטֵּ֣ה בִנְיָמִ֗ן אֶת־גֶּ֤בַע וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֙יהָ֙ וְאֶת־עָלֶ֣מֶת וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֔יהָ וְאֶת־עֲנָת֖וֹת וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑יהָ כׇּל־עָרֵיהֶ֛ם שְׁלֹשׁ־עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה עִ֖יר בְּמִשְׁפְּחוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vmmth bnymn 'tgb' v'tmgrshyh v't'lmt v'tmgrshyh v't'ntvt v'tmgrshyh khl'ryhm shlsh'shrh 'yr bmshpchvtyhm {s}
verses.translation: and out of the tribe of Benjamin: Geba with the open land about it, and Alemeth with the open land about it, and Anathoth with the open land about it. All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלִבְנֵ֨י קְהָ֜ת הַנּֽוֹתָרִ֗ים מִמִּשְׁפַּ֣חַת הַמַּטֶּ֡ה מִֽ֠מַּחֲצִ֠ית מַטֵּ֨ה חֲצִ֧י מְנַשֶּׁ֛ה בַּגּוֹרָ֖ל עָרִ֥ים עָֽשֶׂר׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vlbny qht hnvtrym mmshpcht hmth mmchtsyt mth chtsy mnshh bgvrl 'rym 'shr {p}
verses.translation: And unto the rest of the sons of Kohath were given by lot, out of the family of the tribe, out of the half-tribe, the half of Manasseh, ten cities.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלִבְנֵ֨י גֵרְשׁ֜וֹם לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָ֗ם מִמַּטֵּ֣ה יִ֠שָּׂשכָ֠ר וּמִמַּטֵּ֨ה אָשֵׁ֜ר וּמִמַּטֵּ֣ה נַפְתָּלִ֗י וּמִמַּטֵּ֤ה מְנַשֶּׁה֙ בַּבָּשָׁ֔ן עָרִ֖ים שְׁלֹ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vlbny grshvm lmshpchvtm mmth yshshkhr vmmth 'shr vmmth nptly vmmth mnshh bbshn 'rym shlsh 'shrh {s}
verses.translation: And to the sons of Gershom, according to their families, out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִבְנֵ֨י מְרָרִ֜י לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָ֗ם מִמַּטֵּ֣ה רְ֠אוּבֵ֠ן וּֽמִמַּטֵּה־גָ֞ד וּמִמַּטֵּ֤ה זְבֻלוּן֙ בַּגּוֹרָ֔ל עָרִ֖ים שְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: lbny mrry lmshpchvtm mmth r'vbn vmmthgd vmmth zblvn bgvrl 'rym shtym 'shrh {s}
verses.translation: Unto the sons of Merari were given by lot, according to their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתְּנ֥וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לַלְוִיִּ֑ם אֶת־הֶעָרִ֖ים וְאֶת־מִגְרְשֵׁיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vytnv bnyyshr'l llvym 'th'rym v'tmgrshyhm
verses.translation: So the children of Israel gave to the Levites the cities with the open land about them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתְּנ֣וּ בַגּוֹרָ֗ל מִמַּטֵּ֤ה בְנֵֽי־יְהוּדָה֙ וּמִמַּטֵּ֣ה בְנֵֽי־שִׁמְע֔וֹן וּמִמַּטֵּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֑ן אֵ֚ת הֶעָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁר־יִקְרְא֥וּ אֶתְהֶ֖ם בְּשֵׁמֽוֹת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vytnv bgvrl mmth bnyyhvdh vmmth bnyshm'vn vmmth bny bnymn 't h'rym h'lh 'shryqr'v 'thm bshmvt {s}
verses.translation: And they gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities which are mentioned by name.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִֽמִּשְׁפְּח֖וֹת בְּנֵ֣י קְהָ֑ת וַֽיְהִי֙ עָרֵ֣י גְבוּלָ֔ם מִמַּטֵּ֖ה אֶפְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vmmshpchvt bny qht vyhy 'ry gbvlm mmth 'prym
verses.translation: And some of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their borders out of the tribe of Ephraim.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתְּנ֨וּ לָהֶ֜ם אֶת־עָרֵ֧י הַמִּקְלָ֛ט אֶת־שְׁכֶ֥ם וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֖יהָ בְּהַ֣ר אֶפְרָ֑יִם וְאֶת־גֶּ֖זֶר וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃
verses.translit: vytnv lhm 't'ry hmqlt 'tshkhm v'tmgrshyh bhr 'prym v'tgzr v'tmgrshyh
verses.translation: And they gave unto them the bcity of refuge, Shechem in the hill-country of Ephraim with the open land about it; Gezer also with the open land about it;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶֽת־יׇקְמְעָם֙ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֔יהָ וְאֶת־בֵּ֥ית חוֹר֖וֹן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃
verses.translit: v'tyqm'm v'tmgrshyh v'tbyt chvrvn v'tmgrshyh
verses.translation: and Jokmeam with the open land about it, and Bethhoron with the open land about it;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־אַיָּלוֹן֙ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֔יהָ וְאֶת־גַּת־רִמּ֖וֹן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃
verses.translit: v't'ylvn v'tmgrshyh v'tgtrmvn v'tmgrshyh
verses.translation: and Aijalon with the open land about it, and Gath-rimmon with the open land about it;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִֽמַּחֲצִית֙ מַטֵּ֣ה מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה אֶת־עָנֵר֙ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֔יהָ וְאֶת־בִּלְעָ֖ם וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑יהָ לְמִשְׁפַּ֥חַת לִבְנֵֽי־קְהָ֖ת הַנּוֹתָרִֽים׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vmmchtsyt mth mnshh 't'nr v'tmgrshyh v'tbl'm v'tmgrshyh lmshpcht lbnyqht hnvtrym {p}
verses.translation: and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh: Aner with the open land about it, and Bileam with the open land about it, for the rest of the family of the sons of Kohath.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִבְנֵי֮ גֵּרְשׁוֹם֒ מִמִּשְׁפַּ֗חַת חֲצִי֙ מַטֵּ֣ה מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה אֶת־גּוֹלָ֥ן בַּבָּשָׁ֖ן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑יהָ וְאֶת־עַשְׁתָּר֖וֹת וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃
verses.translit: lbny grshvm mmshpcht chtsy mth mnshh 'tgvln bbshn v'tmgrshyh v't'shtrvt v'tmgrshyh
verses.translation: Unto the sons of Gershom were given, out of the family of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with the open land about it, and Ashtaroth with the open land about it;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִמַּטֵּ֣ה יִשָּׂשכָ֔ר אֶת־קֶ֖דֶשׁ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑יהָ אֶת־דָּבְרַ֖ת וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃
verses.translit: vmmth yshshkhr 'tqdsh v'tmgrshyh 'tdbrt v'tmgrshyh
verses.translation: and out of the tribe of Issachar: Kedesh with the open land about it, Dobrath with the open land about it;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־רָאמוֹת֙ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֔יהָ וְאֶת־עָנֵ֖ם וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'tr'mvt v'tmgrshyh v't'nm v'tmgrshyh {s}
verses.translation: and Ramoth with the open land about it, and Anem with the open land about it;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִמַּטֵּ֣ה אָשֵׁ֔ר אֶת־מָשָׁ֖ל וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑יהָ וְאֶת־עַבְדּ֖וֹן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃
verses.translit: vmmth 'shr 'tmshl v'tmgrshyh v't'bdvn v'tmgrshyh
verses.translation: and out of the tribe of Asher: Mashal with the open land about it, and Abdon with the open land about it;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־חוּקֹק֙ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֔יהָ וְאֶת־רְחֹ֖ב וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'tchvqq v'tmgrshyh v'trchb v'tmgrshyh {s}
verses.translation: and Hukok with the open land about it; and Rehob with the open land about it;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִמַּטֵּ֣ה נַפְתָּלִ֗י אֶת־קֶ֤דֶשׁ בַּגָּלִיל֙ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֔יהָ וְאֶת־חַמּ֖וֹן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑יהָ וְאֶת־קִרְיָתַ֖יִם וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vmmth nptly 'tqdsh bglyl v'tmgrshyh v'tchmvn v'tmgrshyh v'tqrytym v'tmgrshyh {s}
verses.translation: and out of the tribe of Naphtali: Kedesh in Galilee with the open land about it, and Hammon with the open land about it, and Kiriathaim with the open land about it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִבְנֵ֣י מְרָרִי֮ הַנּוֹתָרִים֒ מִמַּטֵּ֣ה זְבֻל֔וּן אֶת־רִמּוֹנ֖וֹ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑יהָ אֶת־תָּב֖וֹר וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃
verses.translit: lbny mrry hnvtrym mmth zblvn 'trmvnv v'tmgrshyh 'ttbvr v'tmgrshyh
verses.translation: Unto the rest [of the Levites], the sons of Merari, were given, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Rimmono with the open land about it, Tabor with the open land about it;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמֵעֵ֜בֶר לְיַרְדֵּ֣ן יְרֵחוֹ֮ לְמִזְרַ֣ח הַיַּרְדֵּן֒ מִמַּטֵּ֣ה רְאוּבֵ֔ן אֶת־בֶּ֥צֶר בַּמִּדְבָּ֖ר וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑יהָ וְאֶת־יַ֖הְצָה וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃
verses.translit: vm'br lyrdn yrchv lmzrch hyrdn mmth r'vbn 'tbtsr bmdbr v'tmgrshyh v'tyhtsh v'tmgrshyh
verses.translation: and beyond the Jordan at Jericho, on the east side of the Jordan, were given them, out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer in the wilderness with the open land about it, and Jahaz with the open land about it,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־קְדֵמוֹת֙ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֔יהָ וְאֶת־מֵיפַ֖עַת וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃
verses.translit: v'tqdmvt v'tmgrshyh v'tmyp't v'tmgrshyh
verses.translation: and Kedemoth with the open land about it, and Mephaath with the open land about it;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִ֨מַּטֵּה־גָ֔ד אֶת־רָאמ֥וֹת בַּגִּלְעָ֖ד וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑יהָ וְאֶֽת־מַחֲנַ֖יִם וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃
verses.translit: vmmthgd 'tr'mvt bgl'd v'tmgrshyh v'tmchnym v'tmgrshyh
verses.translation: and out of the tribe of Gad: Ramoth in Gilead with the open land about it, and Mahanaim with the open land about it,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־חֶשְׁבּוֹן֙ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֔יהָ וְאֶת־יַעְזֵ֖יר וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'tchshbvn v'tmgrshyh v'ty'zyr v'tmgrshyh {s}
verses.translation: and Heshbon with the open land about it, and Jazer with the open land about it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלִבְנֵ֣י יִשָּׂשכָ֗ר תּוֹלָ֧ע וּפוּאָ֛ה (ישיב) [יָשׁ֥וּב] וְשִׁמְר֖וֹן אַרְבָּעָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vlbny yshshkhr tvl' vpv'h (yshyb) [yshvb] vshmrvn 'rb'h {s}
verses.translation: And of the sons of Issachar: Tola, and Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֣י תוֹלָ֗ע עֻזִּ֡י וּרְפָיָ֡ה וִ֠ירִיאֵ֠ל וְיַחְמַ֨י וְיִבְשָׂ֜ם וּשְׁמוּאֵ֗ל רָאשִׁ֤ים לְבֵית־אֲבוֹתָם֙ לְתוֹלָ֔ע גִּבּ֥וֹרֵי חַ֖יִל לְתֹלְדוֹתָ֑ם מִסְפָּרָם֙ בִּימֵ֣י דָוִ֔יד עֶשְׂרִֽים־וּשְׁנַ֥יִם אֶ֖לֶף וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vbny tvl' 'zy vrpyh vyry'l vychmy vybshm vshmv'l r'shym lbyt'bvtm ltvl' gbvry chyl ltldvtm msprm bymy dvyd 'shrymvshnym 'lf vshsh m'vt {s}
verses.translation: And the sons of Tola: Uzzi and Rephaiah, and Jeriel, and Jahmai, and Ibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their fathers’houses, mighty men of valour according to their generations, even of Tola; their number in the days of David was two and twenty thousand and six hundred.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֥י עֻזִּ֖י יִֽזְרַֽחְיָ֑ה וּבְנֵ֣י יִֽזְרַֽחְיָ֗ה מִיכָאֵ֡ל וְ֠עֹבַדְיָ֠ה וְיוֹאֵ֧ל יִשִּׁיָּ֛ה חֲמִשָּׁ֖ה רָאשִׁ֥ים כֻּלָּֽם׃
verses.translit: vbny 'zy yzrchyh vbny yzrchyh mykh'l v'bdyh vyv'l yshyh chmshh r'shym khlm
verses.translation: And the sons of Uzzi: Izrahiah; and the sons of Izrahiah: Michael, and Obadiah, and Joel, Isshiah, five; all of them chief men.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַעֲלֵיהֶ֨ם לְתֹלְדוֹתָ֜ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבוֹתָ֗ם גְּדוּדֵי֙ צְבָ֣א מִלְחָמָ֔ה שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וְשִׁשָּׁ֖ה אָ֑לֶף כִּי־הִרְבּ֥וּ נָשִׁ֖ים וּבָנִֽים׃
verses.translit: v'lyhm ltldvtm lbyt 'bvtm gdvdy tsb' mlchmh shlshym vshshh 'lf khyhrbv nshym vbnym
verses.translation: And with them, by their generations, after their fathers’houses, were bands of the host for war, six and thirty thousand; for they had many wives and sons.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲחֵיהֶ֗ם לְכֹל֙ מִשְׁפְּח֣וֹת יִשָּׂשכָ֔ר גִּבּוֹרֵ֖י חֲיָלִ֑ים שְׁמוֹנִ֤ים וְשִׁבְעָה֙ אֶ֔לֶף הִתְיַחְשָׂ֖ם לַכֹּֽל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'chyhm lkhl mshpchvt yshshkhr gbvry chylym shmvnym vshb'h 'lf htychshm lkhl {s}
verses.translation: And their brethren among all the families of Issachar, mighty men of valour, reckoned in all by genealogy, were fourscore and seven thousand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּנְיָמִ֗ן בֶּ֧לַע וָבֶ֛כֶר וִידִֽיעֲאֵ֖ל שְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃
verses.translit: bnymn bl' vbkhr vydy''l shlshh
verses.translation: [The sons of] Benjamin: Bela, and Becher, and Jediael, three.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֣י בֶ֗לַע אֶצְבּ֡וֹן וְעֻזִּ֡י וְ֠עֻזִּיאֵ֠ל וִירִימ֨וֹת וְעִירִ֜י חֲמִשָּׁ֗ה רָאשֵׁי֙ בֵּ֣ית אָב֔וֹת גִּבּוֹרֵ֖י חֲיָלִ֑ים וְהִתְיַחְשָׂ֗ם עֶשְׂרִ֤ים וּשְׁנַ֙יִם֙ אֶ֔לֶף וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים וְאַרְבָּעָֽה׃
verses.translit: vbny bl' 'tsbvn v'zy v'zy'l vyrymvt v'yry chmshh r'shy byt 'bvt gbvry chylym vhtychshm 'shrym vshnym 'lf vshlshym v'rb'h
verses.translation: And the sons of Bela: Ezbon, and Uzzi, and Uzziel, and Jerimoth, and Iri, five; heads of fathers’houses, mighty men of valour; and they were reckoned by genealogy twenty and two thousand and thirty and four.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֣י בֶ֗כֶר זְמִירָ֡ה וְיוֹעָ֡שׁ וֶֽ֠אֱלִיעֶ֠זֶר וְאֶלְיוֹעֵינַ֤י וְעׇמְרִי֙ וִירֵמ֣וֹת וַאֲבִיָּ֔ה וַעֲנָת֖וֹת וְעָלָ֑מֶת כׇּל־אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵי־בָֽכֶר׃
verses.translit: vbny bkhr zmyrh vyv'sh v'ly'zr v'lyv'yny v'mry vyrmvt v'byh v'ntvt v'lmt khl'lh bnybkhr
verses.translation: And the sons of Becher: Zemirah, and Joash, and Eliezer, and Elioenai, and Omri, and Jeremoth, and Abijah, and Anathoth, and Alemeth. All these were the sons of Becher.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִתְיַחְשָׂ֣ם לְתֹלְדוֹתָ֗ם רָאשֵׁי֙ בֵּ֣ית אֲבוֹתָ֔ם גִּבּוֹרֵ֖י חָ֑יִל עֶשְׂרִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף וּמָאתָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vhtychshm ltldvtm r'shy byt 'bvtm gbvry chyl 'shrym 'lf vm'tym
verses.translation: And they were reckoned by genealogy, after their generations, heads of their fathers’houses, mighty men of valour, twenty thousand and two hundred.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֥י יְדִיעֲאֵ֖ל בִּלְהָ֑ן וּבְנֵ֣י בִלְהָ֗ן (יעיש) [יְע֡וּשׁ] וּ֠בִנְיָמִ֠ן וְאֵה֤וּד וּֽכְנַעֲנָה֙ וְזֵיתָ֔ן וְתַרְשִׁ֖ישׁ וַאֲחִישָֽׁחַר׃
verses.translit: vbny ydy''l blhn vbny blhn (y'ysh) [y'vsh] vbnymn v'hvd vkhn'nh vzytn vtrshysh v'chyshchr
verses.translation: And the sons of Jediael: Bilhan; and the sons of Bilhan: Jeush, and Benjamin, and Ehud, and Chenaanah, and Zethan, and Tarshish, and Ahishahar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־אֵ֜לֶּה בְּנֵ֤י יְדִֽיעֲאֵל֙ לְרָאשֵׁ֣י הָאָב֔וֹת גִּבּוֹרֵ֖י חֲיָלִ֑ים שִׁבְעָֽה־עָשָׂ֥ר אֶ֙לֶף֙ וּמָאתַ֔יִם יֹצְאֵ֥י צָבָ֖א לַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.translit: khl'lh bny ydy''l lr'shy h'bvt gbvry chylym shb'h'shr 'lf vm'tym yts'y tsb' lmlchmh
verses.translation: All these were sons of Jediael, even heads of their fathers’houses, mighty men of valour, seventeen thousand and two hundred, that were able to go forth in the host for war.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשֻׁפִּ֤ם וְחֻפִּם֙ בְּנֵ֣י עִ֔יר חֻשִׁ֖ם בְּנֵ֥י אַחֵֽר׃
verses.translit: vshpm vchpm bny 'yr chshm bny 'chr
verses.translation: Shuppim also, and Huppim, the sons of Ir, Hushim, the son of aanother.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י נַפְתָּלִ֗י יַחֲצִיאֵ֧ל וְגוּנִ֛י וְיֵ֥צֶר וְשַׁלּ֖וּם בְּנֵ֥י בִלְהָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: bny nptly ychtsy'l vgvny vytsr vshlvm bny blhh {p}
verses.translation: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shallum, the sons of Bilhah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה אַשְׂרִיאֵ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָלָ֑דָה פִּֽילַגְשׁוֹ֙ הָֽאֲרַמִּיָּ֔ה יָלְדָ֕ה אֶת־מָכִ֖יר אֲבִ֥י גִלְעָֽד׃
verses.translit: bny mnshh 'shry'l 'shr yldh pylgshv h'rmyh yldh 'tmkhyr 'by gl'd
verses.translation: The sons of Manasseh: Asriel, whom his wife bore—his concubine the Aramitess bore Machir the father of Gilead;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמָכִ֞יר לָקַ֤ח אִשָּׁה֙ לְחֻפִּ֣ים וּלְשֻׁפִּ֔ים וְשֵׁ֤ם אֲחֹתוֹ֙ מַֽעֲכָ֔ה וְשֵׁ֥ם הַשֵּׁנִ֖י צְלׇפְחָ֑ד וַתִּהְיֶ֥נָה לִצְלׇפְחָ֖ד בָּנֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vmkhyr lqch 'shh lchpym vlshpym vshm 'chtv m'khh vshm hshny tslpchd vthynh ltslpchd bnvt
verses.translation: and Machir took a wife of Huppim and Shuppim, whose sister’s name was Maacah—and the name of the second was Zelophehad; and Zelophehad had daughters.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֵּ֨לֶד מַעֲכָ֤ה אֵֽשֶׁת־מָכִיר֙ בֵּ֔ן וַתִּקְרָ֤א שְׁמוֹ֙ פֶּ֔רֶשׁ וְשֵׁ֥ם אָחִ֖יו שָׁ֑רֶשׁ וּבָנָ֖יו אוּלָ֥ם וָרָֽקֶם׃
verses.translit: vtld m'khh 'shtmkhyr bn vtqr' shmv prsh vshm 'chyv shrsh vbnyv 'vlm vrqm
verses.translation: And Maacah the wife of Machir bore a son, and she called his name Peresh; and the name of his brother was Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rekem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֥י אוּלָ֖ם בְּדָ֑ן אֵ֚לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י גִלְעָ֔ד בֶּן־מָכִ֖יר בֶּן־מְנַשֶּֽׁה׃
verses.translit: vbny 'vlm bdn 'lh bny gl'd bnmkhyr bnmnshh
verses.translation: And the sons of Ulam: Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲחֹת֖וֹ הַמֹּלֶ֑כֶת יָֽלְדָה֙ אֶת־אִ֣ישְׁה֔וֹד וְאֶת־אֲבִיעֶ֖זֶר וְאֶת־מַחְלָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'chtv hmlkht yldh 't'yshhvd v't'by'zr v'tmchlh
verses.translation: And his sister Hammolecheth bore Ish-hod, and Abiezer, and Mahlah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּהְי֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י שְׁמִידָ֑ע אַחְיָ֣ן וָשֶׁ֔כֶם וְלִקְחִ֖י וַאֲנִיעָֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyhyv bny shmyd' 'chyn vshkhm vlqchy v'ny'm {p}
verses.translation: And the sons of Shemida were Ahian, and Shechem, and Likhi, and Aniam.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֥י אֶפְרַ֖יִם שׁוּתָ֑לַח וּבֶ֤רֶד בְּנוֹ֙ וְתַ֣חַת בְּנ֔וֹ וְאֶלְעָדָ֥ה בְנ֖וֹ וְתַ֥חַת בְּנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vbny 'prym shvtlch vbrd bnv vtcht bnv v'l'dh bnv vtcht bnv
verses.translation: And the sons of Ephraim: Shuthelah—and Bered was his son, and Tahath his son, and Eleadah his son, and Tahath his son,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְזָבָ֥ד בְּנ֛וֹ וְשׁוּתֶ֥לַח בְּנ֖וֹ וְעֵ֣זֶר וְאֶלְעָ֑ד וַהֲרָג֗וּם אַנְשֵׁי־גַת֙ הַנּוֹלָדִ֣ים בָּאָ֔רֶץ כִּ֣י יָֽרְד֔וּ לָקַ֖חַת אֶת־מִקְנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vzbd bnv vshvtlch bnv v'zr v'l'd vhrgvm 'nshygt hnvldym b'rts khy yrdv lqcht 'tmqnyhm
verses.translation: and Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son—and Ezer, and Elead, whom the men of Gath that were born in the land slew, because they came down to take away their cattle.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתְאַבֵּ֛ל אֶפְרַ֥יִם אֲבִיהֶ֖ם יָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים וַיָּבֹ֥אוּ אֶחָ֖יו לְנַחֲמֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyt'bl 'prym 'byhm ymym rbym vyb'v 'chyv lnchmv
verses.translation: And Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brethren came to comfort him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹא֙ אֶל־אִשְׁתּ֔וֹ וַתַּ֖הַר וַתֵּ֣לֶד בֵּ֑ן וַיִּקְרָ֤א אֶת־שְׁמוֹ֙ בְּרִיעָ֔ה כִּ֥י בְרָעָ֖ה הָיְתָ֥ה בְּבֵיתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyb' 'l'shtv vthr vtld bn vyqr' 'tshmv bry'h khy br'h hyth bbytv
verses.translation: And he went in to his wife, and she conceived, and bore a son, and he called his name Beriah, because ait went evil with his house.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבִתּ֣וֹ שֶֽׁאֱרָ֔ה וַתִּ֧בֶן אֶת־בֵּית־חוֹר֛וֹן הַתַּחְתּ֖וֹן וְאֶת־הָעֶלְי֑וֹן וְאֵ֖ת אֻזֵּ֥ן שֶׁאֱרָֽה׃
verses.translit: vbtv sh'rh vtbn 'tbytchvrvn htchtvn v'th'lyvn v't 'zn sh'rh
verses.translation: And his daughter was Sheerah, who built Beth-horon the nether and the upper, and Uzzen-sheerah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרֶ֣פַח בְּנ֗וֹ וְרֶ֧שֶׁף וְתֶ֛לַח בְּנ֖וֹ וְתַ֥חַן בְּנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vrpch bnv vrshf vtlch bnv vtchn bnv
verses.translation: And Rephah was his son, and Resheph, and Telah his son, and Tahan his son;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַעְדָּ֥ן בְּנ֛וֹ עַמִּיה֥וּד בְּנ֖וֹ אֱלִישָׁמָ֥ע בְּנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: l'dn bnv 'myhvd bnv 'lyshm' bnv
verses.translation: Ladan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נ֥וֹן בְּנ֖וֹ יְהוֹשֻׁ֥עַ בְּנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: nvn bnv yhvsh' bnv
verses.translation: Nun his son, Joshua his son.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽאֲחֻזָּתָם֙ וּמֹ֣שְׁבוֹתָ֔ם בֵּֽית־אֵ֖ל וּבְנֹתֶ֑יהָ וְלַמִּזְרָ֣ח נַעֲרָ֔ן וְלַֽמַּעֲרָ֗ב גֶּ֤זֶר וּבְנֹתֶ֙יהָ֙ וּשְׁכֶ֣ם וּבְנֹתֶ֔יהָ עַד־עַיָּ֖ה וּבְנֹתֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: v'chztm vmshbvtm byt'l vbntyh vlmzrch n'rn vlm'rb gzr vbntyh vshkhm vbntyh 'd'yh vbntyh
verses.translation: And their possessions and habitations were Beth-el and the towns thereof, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer, with the towns thereof; Shechem also and the towns thereof, unto Aiah and the towns thereof;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַל־יְדֵ֣י בְנֵֽי־מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה בֵּית־שְׁאָ֤ן וּבְנֹתֶ֙יהָ֙ תַּעְנַ֣ךְ וּבְנֹתֶ֔יהָ מְגִדּ֥וֹ וּבְנוֹתֶ֖יהָ דּ֣וֹר וּבְנוֹתֶ֑יהָ בְּאֵ֙לֶּה֙ יָֽשְׁב֔וּ בְּנֵ֥י יוֹסֵ֖ף בֶּן־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'lydy bnymnshh bytsh'n vbntyh t'nkh vbntyh mgdv vbnvtyh dvr vbnvtyh b'lh yshbv bny yvsf bnyshr'l {p}
verses.translation: and by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Beth-shean and the towns thereof, Taanach and the towns thereof, Megiddo and the towns thereof, Dor and the towns thereof. In these dwelt the children of Joseph the son of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י אָשֵׁ֗ר יִמְנָ֧ה וְיִשְׁוָ֛ה וְיִשְׁוִ֥י וּבְרִיעָ֖ה וְשֶׂ֥רַח אֲחוֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: bny 'shr ymnh vyshvh vyshvy vbry'h vshrch 'chvtm
verses.translation: The sons of Asher: Imnah, and Ishvah, and Ishvi, and Beriah, and Serah their sister.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֣י בְרִיעָ֔ה חֶ֖בֶר וּמַלְכִּיאֵ֑ל ה֖וּא אֲבִ֥י (ברזות) [בִרְזָֽיִת]׃
verses.translit: vbny bry'h chbr vmlkhy'l hv' 'by (brzvt) [brzyt]
verses.translation: And the sons of Beriah: Heber, and Malchiel, who was the father of Birzaith.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְחֶ֙בֶר֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־יַפְלֵ֔ט וְאֶת־שׁוֹמֵ֖ר וְאֶת־חוֹתָ֑ם וְאֵ֖ת שׁוּעָ֥א אֲחוֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: vchbr hvlyd 'typlt v'tshvmr v'tchvtm v't shv'' 'chvtm
verses.translation: And Heber begot Japhlet, and Shomer, and Hotham, and Shua their sister.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֣י יַפְלֵ֔ט פָּסַ֥ךְ וּבִמְהָ֖ל וְעַשְׁוָ֑ת אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י יַפְלֵֽט׃
verses.translit: vbny yplt pskh vbmhl v'shvt 'lh bny yplt
verses.translation: And the sons of Japhlet: Pasach, and Bimhal, and Asvath. These are the children of Japhlet.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֖י שָׁ֑מֶר אֲחִ֥י (ורוהגה) [וְרׇהְגָּ֖ה] (יחבה) [וְחֻבָּ֥ה] וַאֲרָֽם׃
verses.translit: vbny shmr 'chy (vrvhgh) [vrhgh] (ychbh) [vchbh] v'rm
verses.translation: And the sons of Shemer: Ahi, and Rohgah, and Hubbah, and Aram.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבֶן־הֵ֖לֶם אָחִ֑יו צוֹפַ֥ח וְיִמְנָ֖ע וְשֵׁ֥לֶשׁ וְעָמָֽל׃
verses.translit: vbnhlm 'chyv tsvpch vymn' vshlsh v'ml
verses.translation: And the sons of Helem his brother: Zophah, and Imna, and Shelesh, and Amal.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֖י צוֹפָ֑ח ס֧וּחַ וְחַרְנֶ֛פֶר וְשׁוּעָ֖ל וּבֵרִ֥י וְיִמְרָֽה׃
verses.translit: bny tsvpch svch vchrnpr vshv'l vbry vymrh
verses.translation: The sons of Zophah: Suah, and Harnepher, and Shaul, and Beri, and Imrah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֶּ֣צֶר וָה֗וֹד וְשַׁמָּ֧א וְשִׁלְשָׁ֛ה וְיִתְרָ֖ן וּבְאֵרָֽא׃
verses.translit: btsr vhvd vshm' vshlshh vytrn vb'r'
verses.translation: Bezer, and Hod, and Shamma, and Shilsha, and Ithran, and Beera.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֖י יֶ֑תֶר יְפֻנֶּ֥ה וּפִסְפָּ֖ה וַאְרָֽא׃
verses.translit: vbny ytr ypnh vpsph v'r'
verses.translation: And the sons of Jether: Jephunneh, and Pispa, and Ara.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֖י עֻלָּ֑א אָרַ֥ח וְחַנִּיאֵ֖ל וְרִצְיָֽא׃
verses.translit: vbny 'l' 'rch vchny'l vrtsy'
verses.translation: And the sons of Ulla: Arah, and Hanniel, and Rizia.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־אֵ֣לֶּה בְנֵֽי־אָ֠שֵׁ֠ר רָאשֵׁ֨י בֵית־הָאָב֤וֹת בְּרוּרִים֙ גִּבּוֹרֵ֣י חֲיָלִ֔ים רָאשֵׁ֖י הַנְּשִׂיאִ֑ים וְהִתְיַחְשָׂ֤ם בַּצָּבָא֙ בַּמִּלְחָמָ֔ה מִסְפָּרָ֣ם אֲנָשִׁ֔ים עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְשִׁשָּׁ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃ {ס}
