verses.translit: khl'lh bny'shr r'shy byth'bvt brvrym gbvry chylym r'shy hnshy'ym vhtychshm btsb' bmlchmh msprm 'nshym 'shrym vshshh 'lf {s}
verses.translation: All these were the children of Asher, heads of the fathers’houses, choice and mighty men of valour, chief of the princes. And the number of them reckoned by genealogy for service in war was twenty and six thousand men.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבִ֨נְיָמִ֔ן הוֹלִ֖יד אֶת־בֶּ֣לַע בְּכֹר֑וֹ אַשְׁבֵּל֙ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י וְאַחְרַ֖ח הַשְּׁלִישִֽׁי׃
verses.translit: vbnymn hvlyd 'tbl' bkhrv 'shbl hshny v'chrch hshlyshy
verses.translation: And Benjamin begot Bela his first-born, Ashbel the second, and Aharah the third;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נוֹחָה֙ הָרְבִיעִ֔י וְרָפָ֖א הַחֲמִישִֽׁי׃
verses.translit: nvchh hrby'y vrp' hchmyshy
verses.translation: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּהְי֥וּ בָנִ֖ים לְבָ֑לַע אַדָּ֥ר וְגֵרָ֖א וַאֲבִיהֽוּד׃
verses.translit: vyhyv bnym lbl' 'dr vgr' v'byhvd
verses.translation: And Bela had sons, Addar, and Gera, and Abihud;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲבִישׁ֥וּעַ וְנַעֲמָ֖ן וַאֲחֽוֹחַ׃
verses.translit: v'byshv' vn'mn v'chvch
verses.translation: and Abishua, and Naaman, and Ahoah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגֵרָ֥א וּשְׁפוּפָ֖ן וְחוּרָֽם׃
verses.translit: vgr' vshpvpn vchvrm
verses.translation: and Gera, and Shephuphan, and Huram.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י אֵח֑וּד אֵ֣לֶּה הֵ֞ם רָאשֵׁ֤י אָבוֹת֙ לְי֣וֹשְׁבֵי גֶ֔בַע וַיַּגְל֖וּם אֶל־מָנָֽחַת׃
verses.translit: v'lh bny 'chvd 'lh hm r'shy 'bvt lyvshby gb' vyglvm 'lmncht
verses.translation: And these are the sons of Ehud—these are the heads of fathers’houses of the inhabitants of Geba, and they were carried captive to Manahath;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנַעֲמָ֧ן וַאֲחִיָּ֛ה וְגֵרָ֖א ה֣וּא הֶגְלָ֑ם וְהוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־עֻזָּ֖א וְאֶת־אֲחִיחֻֽד׃
verses.translit: vn'mn v'chyh vgr' hv' hglm vhvlyd 't'z' v't'chychd
verses.translation: and Naaman, and Ahijah, and Gera, were they that carried them captive—and he begot Uzza, and Ahihud.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשַׁחֲרַ֗יִם הוֹלִיד֙ בִּשְׂדֵ֣ה מוֹאָ֔ב מִן־שִׁלְח֖וֹ אֹתָ֑ם חוּשִׁ֥ים וְאֶֽת־בַּעֲרָ֖א נָשָֽׁיו׃
verses.translit: vshchrym hvlyd bshdh mv'b mnshlchv 'tm chvshym v'tb'r' nshyv
verses.translation: And Shaharaim begot children in the field of Moab, after he had sent them away, to wit, Hushim and Baara his wives;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיּ֖וֹלֶד מִן־חֹ֣דֶשׁ אִשְׁתּ֑וֹ אֶת־יוֹבָב֙ וְאֶת־צִבְיָ֔א וְאֶת־מֵישָׁ֖א וְאֶת־מַלְכָּֽם׃
verses.translit: vyvld mnchdsh 'shtv 'tyvbb v'ttsby' v'tmysh' v'tmlkhm
verses.translation: he begot of Hodesh his wife, Jobab, and Zibia, and Mesha, and Malcam;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־יְע֥וּץ וְאֶת־שָֽׂכְיָ֖ה וְאֶת־מִרְמָ֑ה אֵ֥לֶּה בָנָ֖יו רָאשֵׁ֥י אָבֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: v'ty'vts v'tshkhyh v'tmrmh 'lh bnyv r'shy 'bvt
verses.translation: and Jeuz, and Sachiah, and Mirmah. These were his sons, heads of fathers’houses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמֵחֻשִׁ֛ים הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־אֲבִיט֖וּב וְאֶת־אֶלְפָּֽעַל׃
verses.translit: vmchshym hvlyd 't'bytvb v't'lp'l
verses.translation: and of Hushim he begot Abitub, and Elpaal.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֣י אֶלְפַּ֔עַל עֵ֥בֶר וּמִשְׁעָ֖ם וָשָׁ֑מֶד ה֚וּא בָּנָ֣ה אֶת־אוֹנ֔וֹ וְאֶת־לֹ֖ד וּבְנֹתֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: vbny 'lp'l 'br vmsh'm vshmd hv' bnh 't'vnv v'tld vbntyh
verses.translation: And the sons of Elpaal: Eber, and Misham, and Shemed, who built Ono, and Lod, with the towns thereof;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְרִעָ֣ה וָשֶׁ֔מַע הֵ֚מָּה רָאשֵׁ֣י הָאָב֔וֹת לְיוֹשְׁבֵ֖י אַיָּל֑וֹן הֵ֥מָּה הִבְרִ֖יחוּ אֶת־י֥וֹשְׁבֵי גַֽת׃
verses.translit: vbr'h vshm' hmh r'shy h'bvt lyvshby 'ylvn hmh hbrychv 'tyvshby gt
verses.translation: and Beriah, and Shema, who were heads of fathers’houses of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who put to flight the inhabitants of Gath.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַחְי֥וֹ שָׁשָׁ֖ק וִירֵמֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: v'chyv shshq vyrmvt
verses.translation: And Ahio, Shashak, and Jeremoth;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּזְבַדְיָ֥ה וַעֲרָ֖ד וָעָֽדֶר׃
verses.translit: vzbdyh v'rd v'dr
verses.translation: and Zebadiah, and Arad, and Eder;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִיכָאֵ֧ל וְיִשְׁפָּ֛ה וְיוֹחָ֖א בְּנֵ֥י בְרִיעָֽה׃
verses.translit: vmykh'l vyshph vyvch' bny bry'h
verses.translation: and Michael, and Ishpah, and Joha, were the sons of Beriah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּזְבַדְיָ֥ה וּמְשֻׁלָּ֖ם וְחִזְקִ֥י וָחָֽבֶר׃
verses.translit: vzbdyh vmshlm vchzqy vchbr
verses.translation: And Zebadiah, and Meshullam, and Hizki, and Heber;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיִשְׁמְרַ֧י וְיִזְלִיאָ֛ה וְיוֹבָ֖ב בְּנֵ֥י אֶלְפָּֽעַל׃
verses.translit: vyshmry vyzly'h vyvbb bny 'lp'l
verses.translation: and Ishmerai, and Izliah, and Jobab, were the sons of Elpaal.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָקִ֥ים וְזִכְרִ֖י וְזַבְדִּֽי׃
verses.translit: vyqym vzkhry vzbdy
verses.translation: And Jakim, and Zichri, and Zabdi;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וֶאֱלִיעֵינַ֥י וְצִלְּתַ֖י וֶאֱלִיאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: v'ly'yny vtslty v'ly'l
verses.translation: and Elienai, and Zillethai, and Eliel;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַעֲדָיָ֧ה וּבְרָאיָ֛ה וְשִׁמְרָ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י שִׁמְעִֽי׃
verses.translit: v'dyh vbr'yh vshmrt bny shm'y
verses.translation: and Adaiah, and Beraiah, and Shimrath, were the sons of Shimei.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיִשְׁפָּ֥ן וָעֵ֖בֶר וֶאֱלִיאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vyshpn v'br v'ly'l
verses.translation: And Ishpan, and Ebed, and Eliel;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַבְדּ֥וֹן וְזִכְרִ֖י וְחָנָֽן׃
verses.translit: v'bdvn vzkhry vchnn
verses.translation: and Abdon, and Zichri, and Hanan;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַחֲנַנְיָ֥ה וְעֵילָ֖ם וְעַנְתֹתִיָּֽה׃
verses.translit: vchnnyh v'ylm v'nttyh
verses.translation: and Hananiah, and Elam, and Anthothiah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיִפְדְיָ֥ה (ופניאל) [וּפְנוּאֵ֖ל] בְּנֵ֥י שָׁשָֽׁק׃
verses.translit: vypdyh (vpny'l) [vpnv'l] bny shshq
verses.translation: and Iphdeiah, and Penuel, were the sons of Shashak.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשַׁמְשְׁרַ֥י וּשְׁחַרְיָ֖ה וַעֲתַלְיָֽה׃
verses.translit: vshmshry vshchryh v'tlyh
verses.translation: And Shamsherai, and Shehariah, and Athaliah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיַעֲרֶשְׁיָ֧ה וְאֵלִיָּ֛ה וְזִכְרִ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יְרֹחָֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'rshyh v'lyh vzkhry bny yrchm
verses.translation: and Jaareshiah, and Elijah, and Zichri, were the sons of Jeroham.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה רָאשֵׁ֥י אָב֛וֹת לְתֹלְדוֹתָ֖ם רָאשִׁ֑ים אֵ֖לֶּה יָשְׁב֥וּ בִירוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: 'lh r'shy 'bvt ltldvtm r'shym 'lh yshbv byrvshl͏m
verses.translation: These were heads of fathers’houses throughout their generations, chief men; these dwelt in Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְגִבְע֥וֹן יָשְׁב֖וּ אֲבִ֣י גִבְע֑וֹן וְשֵׁ֥ם אִשְׁתּ֖וֹ מַעֲכָֽה׃
verses.translit: vbgb'vn yshbv 'by gb'vn vshm 'shtv m'khh
verses.translation: And in Gibeon there dwelt the father of Gibeon [, Jeiel], whose wife’s name was Maacah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנ֥וֹ הַבְּכ֖וֹר עַבְדּ֑וֹן וְצ֥וּר וְקִ֖ישׁ וּבַ֥עַל וְנָדָֽב׃
verses.translit: vbnv hbkhvr 'bdvn vtsvr vqysh vb'l vndb
verses.translation: and his first-born son Abdon, and Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Nadab;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּגְד֥וֹר וְאַחְי֖וֹ וָזָֽכֶר׃
verses.translit: vgdvr v'chyv vzkhr
verses.translation: and Gedor, and Ahio, and Zecher.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִקְל֖וֹת הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־שִׁמְאָ֑ה וְאַף־הֵ֗מָּה נֶ֧גֶד אֲחֵיהֶ֛ם יָשְׁב֥וּ בִירוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם עִם־אֲחֵיהֶֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vmqlvt hvlyd 'tshm'h v'fhmh ngd 'chyhm yshbv byrvshl͏m 'm'chyhm {s}
verses.translation: And Mikloth begot Shimeah. And they also dwelt with their brethren in Jerusalem, over against their brethren.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנֵר֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־קִ֔ישׁ וְקִ֖ישׁ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־שָׁא֑וּל וְשָׁא֗וּל הוֹלִ֤יד אֶת־יְהֽוֹנָתָן֙ וְאֶת־מַלְכִּישׁ֔וּעַ וְאֶת־אֲבִינָדָ֖ב וְאֶת־אֶשְׁבָּֽעַל׃
verses.translit: vnr hvlyd 'tqysh vqysh hvlyd 'tsh'vl vsh'vl hvlyd 'tyhvntn v'tmlkhyshv' v't'byndb v't'shb'l
verses.translation: And Ner begot Kish; and Kish begot Saul; and Saul begot Jonathan, and Malchi-shua, and Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבֶן־יְהוֹנָתָ֖ן מְרִ֣יב בָּ֑עַל וּמְרִ֥יב בַּ֖עַל הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־מִיכָֽה׃
verses.translit: vbnyhvntn mryb b'l vmryb b'l hvlyd 'tmykhh
verses.translation: And the son of Jonathan was Merib-baal; and Merib-baal begot Micah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֖י מִיכָ֑ה פִּית֥וֹן וָמֶ֖לֶךְ וְתַאְרֵ֥עַ וְאָחָֽז׃
verses.translit: vbny mykhh pytvn vmlkh vt'r' v'chz
verses.translation: And the sons of Micah; Pithon, and Melech, and Taarea, and Ahaz.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָחָז֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־יְהוֹעַדָּ֔ה וִיהוֹעַדָּ֗ה הוֹלִ֛יד אֶת־עָלֶ֥מֶת וְאֶת־עַזְמָ֖וֶת וְאֶת־זִמְרִ֑י וְזִמְרִ֖י הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־מוֹצָֽא׃
verses.translit: v'chz hvlyd 'tyhv'dh vyhv'dh hvlyd 't'lmt v't'zmvt v'tzmry vzmry hvlyd 'tmvts'
verses.translation: And Ahaz begot Jehoaddah; and Jehoaddah begot Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begot Moza;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמוֹצָ֖א הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־בִּנְעָ֑א רָפָ֥ה בְנ֛וֹ אֶלְעָשָׂ֥ה בְנ֖וֹ אָצֵ֥ל בְּנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vmvts' hvlyd 'tbn'' rph bnv 'l'shh bnv 'tsl bnv
verses.translation: and Moza begot Binea; Raphah was his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְאָצֵל֮ שִׁשָּׁ֣ה בָנִים֒ וְאֵ֣לֶּה שְׁמוֹתָ֗ם עַזְרִיקָ֥ם ׀ בֹּ֙כְרוּ֙ וְיִשְׁמָעֵ֣אל וּשְׁעַרְיָ֔ה וְעֹבַדְיָ֖ה וְחָנָ֑ן כׇּל־אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י אָצַֽל׃
verses.translit: vl'tsl shshh bnym v'lh shmvtm 'zryqm  bkhrv vyshm''l vsh'ryh v'bdyh vchnn khl'lh bny 'tsl
verses.translation: And Azel had six sons, whose names are these: Azrikam, Bocru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֖י עֵ֣שֶׁק אָחִ֑יו אוּלָ֣ם בְּכֹר֔וֹ יְעוּשׁ֙ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י וֶאֱלִיפֶ֖לֶט הַשְּׁלִשִֽׁי׃
verses.translit: vbny 'shq 'chyv 'vlm bkhrv y'vsh hshny v'lyplt hshlshy
verses.translation: And the sons of Eshek his brother: Ulam his firstborn, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּהְי֣וּ בְנֵֽי־א֠וּלָ֠ם אֲנָשִׁ֨ים גִּבּוֹרֵי־חַ֜יִל דֹּ֣רְכֵי קֶ֗שֶׁת וּמַרְבִּ֤ים בָּנִים֙ וּבְנֵ֣י בָנִ֔ים מֵאָ֖ה וַחֲמִשִּׁ֑ים כׇּל־אֵ֖לֶּה מִבְּנֵ֥י בִנְיָמִֽן׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyhyv bny'vlm 'nshym gbvrychyl drkhy qsht vmrbym bnym vbny bnym m'h vchmshym khl'lh mbny bnymn {p}
verses.translation: And the sons of Ulam were mighty men of valour, archers; and had many sons, and sons’sons, a hundred and fifty. All these were of the sons of Benjamin.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכׇל־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ הִתְיַחְשׂ֔וּ וְהִנָּ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֔ים עַל־סֵ֖פֶר מַלְכֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וִיהוּדָ֛ה הׇגְל֥וּ לְבָבֶ֖ל בְּמַעֲלָֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vkhlyshr'l htychshv vhnm khtvbym 'lspr mlkhy yshr'l vyhvdh hglv lbbl bm'lm {s}
verses.translation: So all Israel were reckoned by genealogies; and, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel; and Judah was carried away captive to Babylon because of their transgression.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַיּֽוֹשְׁבִים֙ הָרִ֣אשֹׁנִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּאֲחֻזָּתָ֖ם בְּעָרֵיהֶ֑ם יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים הַלְוִיִּ֖ם וְהַנְּתִינִֽים׃
verses.translit: vhyvshbym hr'shnym 'shr b'chztm b'ryhm yshr'l hkhhnym hlvym vhntynym
verses.translation: Now the first inhabitants that dwelt in their possessions in their cities were, Israelites, the priests, the Levites, and the Nethinim.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבִירוּשָׁלַ֙͏ִם֙ יָֽשְׁב֔וּ מִן־בְּנֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה וּמִן־בְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֑ן וּמִן־בְּנֵ֥י אֶפְרַ֖יִם וּמְנַשֶּֽׁה׃
verses.translit: vbyrvshl͏m yshbv mnbny yhvdh vmnbny bnymn vmnbny 'prym vmnshh
verses.translation: And in Jerusalem dwelt of the children of Judah, and of the children of Benjamin, and of the children of Ephraim and Manasseh:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עוּתַ֨י בֶּן־עַמִּיה֤וּד בֶּן־עׇמְרִי֙ בֶּן־אִמְרִ֣י בֶן־(בנימן)־[בָּנִ֔י מִן־]בְּנֵי־פֶ֖רֶץ בֶּן־יְהוּדָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'vty bn'myhvd bn'mry bn'mry bn(bnymn)[bny mn]bnyprts bnyhvdh {s}
verses.translation: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Perez the son of Judah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִן־הַשִּׁ֣ילוֹנִ֔י עֲשָׂיָ֥ה הַבְּכ֖וֹר וּבָנָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vmnhshylvny 'shyh hbkhvr vbnyv
verses.translation: And of the Shilonites: Asaiah the first-born and his sons.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִן־בְּנֵי־זֶ֖רַח יְעוּאֵ֑ל וַאֲחֵיהֶ֖ם שֵׁשׁ־מֵא֥וֹת וְתִשְׁעִֽים׃
verses.translit: vmnbnyzrch y'v'l v'chyhm shshm'vt vtsh'ym
verses.translation: And of the sons of Zerah: Jeuel, and their brethren, six hundred and ninety.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִן־בְּנֵ֖י בִּנְיָמִ֑ן סַלּוּא֙ בֶּן־מְשֻׁלָּ֔ם בֶּן־הוֹדַוְיָ֖ה בֶּן־הַסְּנֻאָֽה׃
verses.translit: vmnbny bnymn slv' bnmshlm bnhvdvyh bnhsn'h
verses.translation: And of the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hassenuah,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיִבְנְיָה֙ בֶּן־יְרֹחָ֔ם וְאֵלָ֥ה בֶן־עֻזִּ֖י בֶּן־מִכְרִ֑י וּמְשֻׁלָּם֙ בֶּן־שְׁפַטְיָ֔ה בֶּן־רְעוּאֵ֖ל בֶּן־יִבְנִיָּֽה׃
verses.translit: vybnyh bnyrchm v'lh bn'zy bnmkhry vmshlm bnshptyh bnr'v'l bnybnyh
verses.translation: and Ibneiah the son of Jeroham, and Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri, and Meshullam the son of Shephatiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibneiah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽאֲחֵיהֶם֙ לְתֹ֣לְדוֹתָ֔ם תְּשַׁ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁ֣ים וְשִׁשָּׁ֑ה כׇּל־אֵ֣לֶּה אֲנָשִׁ֔ים רָאשֵׁ֥י אָב֖וֹת לְבֵ֥ית אֲבֹתֵיהֶֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'chyhm ltldvtm tsh' m'vt vchmshym vshshh khl'lh 'nshym r'shy 'bvt lbyt 'btyhm {s}
verses.translation: and their brethren, according to their generations, nine hundred and fifty and six. All these men were heads of fathers’houses by their fathers’houses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִן־הַֽכֹּהֲנִ֑ים יְדַעְיָ֥ה וִיהוֹיָרִ֖יב וְיָכִֽין׃
verses.translit: vmnhkhhnym yd'yh vyhvyryb vykhyn
verses.translation: And of the priests: Jedaiah, and Jehoiarib, and Jachin;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַעֲזַרְיָ֨ה בֶן־חִלְקִיָּ֜ה בֶּן־מְשֻׁלָּ֣ם בֶּן־צָד֗וֹק בֶּן־מְרָיוֹת֙ בֶּן־אֲחִיט֔וּב נְגִ֖יד בֵּ֥ית הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'zryh bnchlqyh bnmshlm bntsdvq bnmryvt bn'chytvb ngyd byt h'lhym {s}
verses.translation: and Azariah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of the house of God;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַעֲדָיָה֙ בֶּן־יְרֹחָ֔ם בֶּן־פַּשְׁח֖וּר בֶּן־מַלְכִּיָּ֑ה וּמַעְשַׂ֨י בֶּן־עֲדִיאֵ֧ל בֶּן־יַחְזֵ֛רָה בֶּן־מְשֻׁלָּ֥ם בֶּן־מְשִׁלֵּמִ֖ית בֶּן־אִמֵּֽר׃
verses.translit: v'dyh bnyrchm bnpshchvr bnmlkhyh vm'shy bn'dy'l bnychzrh bnmshlm bnmshlmyt bn'mr
verses.translation: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah, and Maasai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲחֵיהֶ֗ם רָאשִׁים֙ לְבֵ֣ית אֲבוֹתָ֔ם אֶ֕לֶף וּשְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וְשִׁשִּׁ֑ים גִּבּ֣וֹרֵי חֵ֔יל מְלֶ֖אכֶת עֲבוֹדַ֥ת בֵּית־הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: v'chyhm r'shym lbyt 'bvtm 'lf vshb' m'vt vshshym gbvry chyl ml'kht 'bvdt byth'lhym
verses.translation: and their brethren, heads of their fathers’houses, a thousand and seven hundred and threescore; very able men for the work of the service of the house of God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִֽן־הַלְוִיִּ֑ם שְׁמַֽעְיָ֧ה בֶן־חַשּׁ֛וּב בֶּן־עַזְרִיקָ֥ם בֶּן־חֲשַׁבְיָ֖ה מִן־בְּנֵ֥י מְרָרִֽי׃
verses.translit: vmnhlvym shm'yh bnchshvb bn'zryqm bnchshbyh mnbny mrry
verses.translation: And of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבַקְבַּקַּ֥ר חֶ֖רֶשׁ וְגָלָ֑ל וּמַתַּנְיָה֙ בֶּן־מִיכָ֔א בֶּן־זִכְרִ֖י בֶּן־אָסָֽף׃
verses.translit: vbqbqr chrsh vgll vmtnyh bnmykh' bnzkhry bn'sf
verses.translation: and Bakbakkar, Heresh, and Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעֹֽבַדְיָה֙ בֶּֽן־שְׁמַעְיָ֔ה בֶּן־גָּלָ֖ל בֶּן־יְדוּת֑וּן וּבֶרֶכְיָ֤ה בֶן־אָסָא֙ בֶּן־אֶלְקָנָ֔ה הַיּוֹשֵׁ֖ב בְּחַצְרֵ֥י נְטוֹפָתִֽי׃
verses.translit: v'bdyh bnshm'yh bngll bnydvtvn vbrkhyh bn's' bn'lqnh hyvshb bchtsry ntvpty
verses.translation: and Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun, and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, that dwelt in the villages of the Netophathites. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַשֹּֽׁעֲרִים֙ שַׁלּ֣וּם וְעַקּ֔וּב וְטַלְמֹ֖ן וַאֲחִימָ֑ן וַאֲחִיהֶ֥ם שַׁלּ֖וּם הָרֹֽאשׁ׃
verses.translit: vhsh'rym shlvm v'qvb vtlmn v'chymn v'chyhm shlvm hr'sh
verses.translation: And the porters: Shallum, and Akkub, and Talmon, and Ahiman, and their brother Shallum the chief;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽעַד־הֵ֔נָּה בְּשַׁ֥עַר הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ מִזְרָ֑חָה הֵ֚מָּה הַשֹּׁ֣עֲרִ֔ים לְמַחֲנ֖וֹת בְּנֵ֥י לֵוִֽי׃
verses.translit: v'dhnh bsh'r hmlkh mzrchh hmh hsh'rym lmchnvt bny lvy
verses.translation: who hitherto waited in the king’s gate eastward; they were the porters for the camp of the children of Levi.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשַׁלּ֣וּם בֶּן־ק֠וֹרֵ֠א בֶּן־אֶבְיָסָ֨ף בֶּן־קֹ֜רַח וְֽאֶחָ֧יו לְבֵית־אָבִ֣יו הַקׇּרְחִ֗ים עַ֚ל מְלֶ֣אכֶת הָעֲבוֹדָ֔ה שֹׁמְרֵ֥י הַסִּפִּ֖ים לָאֹ֑הֶל וַאֲבֹֽתֵיהֶם֙ עַל־מַחֲנֵ֣ה יְהֹוָ֔ה שֹׁמְרֵ֖י הַמָּבֽוֹא׃
verses.translit: vshlvm bnqvr' bn'bysf bnqrch v'chyv lbyt'byv hqrchym 'l ml'kht h'bvdh shmry hspym l'hl v'btyhm 'lmchnh yhvh shmry hmbv'
verses.translation: And Shallum the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brethren, of his father’s house, the Korahites, were over the work of the service, keepers of the gates of the Tent; and their fathers had been over the camp of the LORD, keepers of the entry;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּפִֽינְחָ֣ס בֶּן־אֶלְעָזָ֗ר נָגִ֨יד הָיָ֧ה עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם לְפָנִ֖ים יְהֹוָ֥ה ׀ עִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vpynchs bn'l'zr ngyd hyh 'lyhm lpnym yhvh  'mv
verses.translation: and Phinehas the son of Eleazar was ruler over them in time past, the LORD being with him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זְכַרְיָה֙ בֶּ֣ן מְשֶֽׁלֶמְיָ֔ה שֹׁעֵ֥ר פֶּ֖תַח לְאֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.translit: zkhryh bn mshlmyh sh'r ptch l'hl mv'd
verses.translation: Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was porter of the door of the tent of meeting.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֻּלָּ֤ם הַבְּרוּרִים֙ לְשֹׁעֲרִ֣ים בַּסִּפִּ֔ים מָאתַ֖יִם וּשְׁנֵ֣ים עָשָׂ֑ר הֵ֤מָּה בְחַצְרֵיהֶם֙ הִתְיַחְשָׂ֔ם הֵ֣מָּה יִסַּ֥ד דָּוִ֛יד וּשְׁמוּאֵ֥ל הָרֹאֶ֖ה בֶּאֱמוּנָתָֽם׃
verses.translit: khlm hbrvrym lsh'rym bspym m'tym vshnym 'shr hmh bchtsryhm htychshm hmh ysd dvyd vshmv'l hr'h b'mvntm
verses.translation: All these that were chosen to be porters in the gates were two hundred and twelve. These were reckoned by genealogy in their villages, whom David and Samuel the seer did ordain in their set office.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֵ֨ם וּבְנֵיהֶ֜ם עַל־הַשְּׁעָרִ֧ים לְבֵית־יְהֹוָ֛ה לְבֵ֥ית הָאֹ֖הֶל לְמִשְׁמָרֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vhm vbnyhm 'lhsh'rym lbytyhvh lbyt h'hl lmshmrvt
verses.translation: So they and their children had the oversight of the gates of the house of the LORD, even the house of the Tent, by wards.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְאַרְבַּ֣ע רוּח֔וֹת יִהְי֖וּ הַשֹּׁעֲרִ֑ים מִזְרָ֥ח יָ֖מָּה צָפ֥וֹנָה וָנֶֽגְבָּה׃
verses.translit: l'rb' rvchvt yhyv hsh'rym mzrch ymh tspvnh vngbh
verses.translation: On the four sides were the porters, toward the east, west, north, and south.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲחֵיהֶ֨ם בְּחַצְרֵיהֶ֜ם לָב֨וֹא לְשִׁבְעַ֧ת הַיָּמִ֛ים מֵעֵ֥ת אֶל־עֵ֖ת עִם־אֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.translit: v'chyhm bchtsryhm lbv' lshb't hymym m't 'l't 'm'lh
verses.translation: And their brethren, in their villages, were to come in every seven days from time to time to be with them;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י בֶאֱמוּנָ֞ה הֵ֗מָּה אַרְבַּ֙עַת֙ גִּבֹּרֵ֣י הַשֹּׁעֲרִ֔ים הֵ֖ם הַלְוִיִּ֑ם וְהָיוּ֙ עַל־הַלְּשָׁכ֔וֹת וְעַ֥ל הָאֹצְר֖וֹת בֵּ֥ית הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: khy b'mvnh hmh 'rb't gbry hsh'rym hm hlvym vhyv 'lhlshkhvt v'l h'tsrvt byt h'lhym
verses.translation: for the four chief porters were in a set office. These were the Levites. They were also over the chambers and over the treasuries in the house of God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּסְבִיב֥וֹת בֵּית־הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים יָלִ֑ינוּ כִּֽי־עֲלֵיהֶ֣ם מִשְׁמֶ֔רֶת וְהֵ֥ם עַל־הַמַּפְתֵּ֖חַ וְלַבֹּ֥קֶר לַבֹּֽקֶר׃
verses.translit: vsbybvt byth'lhym ylynv khy'lyhm mshmrt vhm 'lhmptch vlbqr lbqr
verses.translation: And they lodged round about the house of God, because the charge thereof was upon them, and to them pertained the opening thereof morning by morning.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמֵהֶ֖ם עַל־כְּלֵ֣י הָעֲבוֹדָ֑ה כִּֽי־בְמִסְפָּ֣ר יְבִיא֔וּם וּבְמִסְפָּ֖ר יוֹצִיאֽוּם׃
verses.translit: vmhm 'lkhly h'bvdh khybmspr yby'vm vbmspr yvtsy'vm
verses.translation: And certain of them had charge of the vessels of service; for by tale were they brought in and by tale were they taken out.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמֵהֶ֗ם מְמֻנִּים֙ עַל־הַכֵּלִ֔ים וְעַ֖ל כׇּל־כְּלֵ֣י הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ וְעַל־הַסֹּ֙לֶת֙ וְהַיַּ֣יִן וְהַשֶּׁ֔מֶן וְהַלְּבוֹנָ֖ה וְהַבְּשָׂמִֽים׃
verses.translit: vmhm mmnym 'lhkhlym v'l khlkhly hqdsh v'lhslt vhyyn vhshmn vhlbvnh vhbshmym
verses.translation: Some of them also were appointed over the furniture, and over all the holy vessels, and over the fine flour, and the wine, and the oil, and the frankincense, and the spices.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִן־בְּנֵי֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים רֹקְחֵ֥י הַמִּרְקַ֖חַת לַבְּשָׂמִֽים׃
verses.translit: vmnbny hkhhnym rqchy hmrqcht lbshmym
verses.translation: And some of the sons of the priests prepared the confection of the spices.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמַתִּתְיָה֙ מִן־הַלְוִיִּ֔ם ה֥וּא הַבְּכ֖וֹר לְשַׁלֻּ֣ם הַקׇּרְחִ֑י בֶּאֱמוּנָ֕ה עַ֖ל מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה הַחֲבִתִּֽים׃
verses.translit: vmttyh mnhlvym hv' hbkhvr lshlm hqrchy b'mvnh 'l m'shh hchbtym
verses.translation: And Mattithiah, one of the Levites, who was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, had the set office over the things that were baked on griddles.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִן־בְּנֵ֧י הַקְּהָתִ֛י מִן־אֲחֵיהֶ֖ם עַל־לֶ֣חֶם הַֽמַּעֲרָ֑כֶת לְהָכִ֖ין שַׁבַּ֥ת שַׁבָּֽת׃
verses.translit: vmnbny hqhty mn'chyhm 'llchm hm'rkht lhkhyn shbt shbt
verses.translation: And some of their brethren, of the sons of the Kohathites, were over the showbread, to prepare it every sabbath.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֣לֶּה הַ֠מְשֹׁרְרִ֠ים רָאשֵׁ֨י אָב֧וֹת לַלְוִיִּ֛ם בַּלְּשָׁכֹ֖ת (פטירים) [פְּטוּרִ֑ים] כִּֽי־יוֹמָ֥ם וָלַ֛יְלָה עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם בַּמְּלָאכָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'lh hmshrrym r'shy 'bvt llvym blshkht (ptyrym) [ptvrym] khyyvmm vlylh 'lyhm bml'khh
verses.translation: And these are the singers, heads of fathers’houses of the Levites, who dwelt in the chambers and were free from other service; for they were employed in their work day and night.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֩לֶּה֩ רָאשֵׁ֨י הָאָב֧וֹת לַלְוִיִּ֛ם לְתֹלְדוֹתָ֖ם רָאשִׁ֑ים אֵ֖לֶּה יָשְׁב֥וּ בִירוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'lh r'shy h'bvt llvym ltldvtm r'shym 'lh yshbv byrvshl͏m {s}
verses.translation: These were heads of fathers’houses of the Levites, by their generations, chief men; these dwelt at Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְגִבְע֛וֹן יָשְׁב֥וּ אֲבִי־גִבְע֖וֹן (יעואל) [יְעִיאֵ֑ל] וְשֵׁ֥ם אִשְׁתּ֖וֹ מַעֲכָֽה׃
verses.translit: vbgb'vn yshbv 'bygb'vn (y'v'l) [y'y'l] vshm 'shtv m'khh
verses.translation: And in Gibeon there dwelt the father of Gibeon, Jeiel, whose wife’s name was Maacah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנ֥וֹ הַבְּכ֖וֹר עַבְדּ֑וֹן וְצ֣וּר וְקִ֔ישׁ וּבַ֥עַל וְנֵ֖ר וְנָדָֽב׃
verses.translit: vbnv hbkhvr 'bdvn vtsvr vqysh vb'l vnr vndb
verses.translation: and his first-born son Abdon, and Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Ner, and Nadab;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּגְד֣וֹר וְאַחְי֔וֹ וּזְכַרְיָ֖ה וּמִקְלֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vgdvr v'chyv vzkhryh vmqlvt
verses.translation: and Gedor, and Ahio, and Zechariah, and Mikloth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִקְל֖וֹת הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־שִׁמְאָ֑ם וְאַף־הֵ֗ם נֶ֧גֶד אֲחֵיהֶ֛ם יָשְׁב֥וּ בִירוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם עִם־אֲחֵיהֶֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vmqlvt hvlyd 'tshm'm v'fhm ngd 'chyhm yshbv byrvshl͏m 'm'chyhm {s}
verses.translation: And Mikloth begot Shimeam. And they also dwelt with their brethren in Jerusalem, over against their brethren. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנֵר֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־קִ֔ישׁ וְקִ֖ישׁ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־שָׁא֑וּל וְשָׁא֗וּל הוֹלִ֤יד אֶת־יְהֽוֹנָתָן֙ וְאֶת־מַלְכִּישׁ֔וּעַ וְאֶת־אֲבִינָדָ֖ב וְאֶת־אֶשְׁבָּֽעַל׃
verses.translit: vnr hvlyd 'tqysh vqysh hvlyd 'tsh'vl vsh'vl hvlyd 'tyhvntn v'tmlkhyshv' v't'byndb v't'shb'l
verses.translation: And Ner begot Kish; and Kish begot Saul; and Saul begot Jonathan, and Malchi-shua, and Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבֶן־יְהוֹנָתָ֖ן מְרִ֣יב בָּ֑עַל וּמְרִי־בַ֖עַל הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־מִיכָֽה׃
verses.translit: vbnyhvntn mryb b'l vmryb'l hvlyd 'tmykhh
verses.translation: And the son of Jonathan was Merib-baal; and Merib-baal begot Micah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֖י מִיכָ֑ה פִּיתֹ֥ן וָמֶ֖לֶךְ וְתַחְרֵֽעַ׃
verses.translit: vbny mykhh pytn vmlkh vtchr'
verses.translation: And the sons of Micah: Pithon, and Melech, and Taharea[,band Ahaz].
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָחָז֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־יַעְרָ֔ה וְיַעְרָ֗ה הוֹלִ֛יד אֶת־עָלֶ֥מֶת וְאֶת־עַזְמָ֖וֶת וְאֶת־זִמְרִ֑י וְזִמְרִ֖י הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־מוֹצָֽא׃
verses.translit: v'chz hvlyd 'ty'rh vy'rh hvlyd 't'lmt v't'zmvt v'tzmry vzmry hvlyd 'tmvts'
verses.translation: And Ahaz begot Jarah; and Jarah begot Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begot Moza.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמוֹצָ֖א הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־בִּנְעָ֑א וּרְפָיָ֥ה בְנ֛וֹ אֶלְעָשָׂ֥ה בְנ֖וֹ אָצֵ֥ל בְּנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vmvts' hvlyd 'tbn'' vrpyh bnv 'l'shh bnv 'tsl bnv
verses.translation: And Moza begot Binea; and Rephaiah his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְאָצֵל֮ שִׁשָּׁ֣ה בָנִים֒ וְאֵ֣לֶּה שְׁמוֹתָ֗ם עַזְרִיקָ֥ם ׀ בֹּ֙כְרוּ֙ וְיִשְׁמָעֵ֣אל וּשְׁעַרְיָ֔ה וְעֹבַדְיָ֖ה וְחָנָ֑ן אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י אָצַֽל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vl'tsl shshh bnym v'lh shmvtm 'zryqm  bkhrv vyshm''l vsh'ryh v'bdyh vchnn 'lh bny 'tsl {p}
verses.translation: And Azel had six sons, whose names are these: Azrikam, Bocru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan; these were the sons of Azel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּפְלִשְׁתִּ֖ים נִלְחֲמ֣וּ בְיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיָּ֤נׇס אִֽישׁ־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מִפְּנֵ֣י פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וַיִּפְּל֥וּ חֲלָלִ֖ים בְּהַ֥ר גִּלְבֹּֽעַ׃
verses.translit: vplshtym nlchmv byshr'l vyns 'yshyshr'l mpny plshtym vyplv chllym bhr glb'
verses.translation: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain in mount Gilboa.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּדְבְּק֣וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים אַחֲרֵ֥י שָׁא֖וּל וְאַחֲרֵ֣י בָנָ֑יו וַיַּכּ֣וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֗ים אֶת־יוֹנָתָ֧ן וְאֶת־אֲבִינָדָ֛ב וְאֶת־מַלְכִּישׁ֖וּעַ בְּנֵ֥י שָׁאֽוּל׃
verses.translit: vydbqv plshtym 'chry sh'vl v'chry bnyv vykhv plshtym 'tyvntn v't'byndb v'tmlkhyshv' bny sh'vl
verses.translation: And the Philistines followed hard after Saul and after his sons; and the Philistines slew Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Malchi-shua, the sons of Saul.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּכְבַּ֤ד הַמִּלְחָמָה֙ עַל־שָׁא֔וּל וַיִּמְצָאֻ֖הוּ הַמּוֹרִ֣ים בַּקָּ֑שֶׁת וַיָּ֖חֶל מִן־הַיּוֹרִֽים׃
verses.translit: vtkhbd hmlchmh 'lsh'vl vymts'hv hmvrym bqsht vychl mnhyvrym
verses.translation: And the battle went sore against Saul, and the archers overtook him; and he was in anguish by reason of the archers.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שָׁאוּל֩ אֶל־נֹשֵׂ֨א כֵלָ֜יו שְׁלֹ֥ף חַרְבְּךָ֣  וְדׇקְרֵ֣נִי בָ֗הּ פֶּן־יָבֹ֜אוּ הָעֲרֵלִ֤ים הָאֵ֙לֶּה֙ וְהִתְעַלְּלוּ־בִ֔י וְלֹ֤א אָבָה֙ נֹשֵׂ֣א כֵלָ֔יו כִּ֥י יָרֵ֖א מְאֹ֑ד {ס} וַיִּקַּ֤ח שָׁאוּל֙ אֶת־הַחֶ֔רֶב וַיִּפֹּ֖ל עָלֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr sh'vl 'lnsh' khlyv shlf chrbkh  vdqrny bh pnyb'v h'rlym h'lh vht'llvby vl' 'bh nsh' khlyv khy yr' m'd {s} vyqch sh'vl 'thchrb vypl 'lyh
verses.translation: Then said Saul unto his armour-bearer: ‘Draw thy sword, and thrust me through therewith; lest these uncircumcised come and make a mock of me.’ But his armour-bearer would not; for he was sore afraid. Therefore Saul took his sword, and fell upon it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֥רְא נֹשֵֽׂא־כֵלָ֖יו כִּ֣י מֵ֣ת שָׁא֑וּל וַיִּפֹּ֥ל גַּם־ה֛וּא עַל־הַחֶ֖רֶב וַיָּמֹֽת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyr' nsh'khlyv khy mt sh'vl vypl gmhv' 'lhchrb vymt {s}
verses.translation: And when his armour-bearer saw that Saul was dead, he likewise fell upon his sword, and died.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֤מׇת שָׁאוּל֙ וּשְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת בָּנָ֔יו וְכׇל־בֵּית֖וֹ יַחְדָּ֥ו מֵֽתוּ׃
verses.translit: vymt sh'vl vshlsht bnyv vkhlbytv ychdv mtv
verses.translation: So Saul died, and his three sons; and all his house died together.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֠יִּרְא֠וּ כׇּל־אִ֨ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל אֲשֶׁר־בָּעֵ֙מֶק֙ כִּ֣י נָ֔סוּ וְכִי־מֵ֖תוּ שָׁא֣וּל וּבָנָ֑יו וַיַּעַזְב֤וּ עָֽרֵיהֶם֙ וַיָּנֻ֔סוּ וַיָּבֹ֣אוּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וַיֵּשְׁב֖וּ בָּהֶֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyr'v khl'ysh yshr'l 'shrb'mq khy nsv vkhymtv sh'vl vbnyv vy'zbv 'ryhm vynsv vyb'v plshtym vyshbv bhm {s}
verses.translation: And when all the men of Israel that were in the valley saw that [Israel] fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, they forsook their cities, and fled; and the Philistines came and dwelt in them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ מִֽמׇּחֳרָ֔ת וַיָּבֹ֣אוּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים לְפַשֵּׁ֖ט אֶת־הַחֲלָלִ֑ים וַֽיִּמְצְא֤וּ אֶת־שָׁאוּל֙ וְאֶת־בָּנָ֔יו נֹפְלִ֖ים בְּהַ֥ר גִּלְבֹּֽעַ׃
verses.translit: vyhy mmchrt vyb'v plshtym lpsht 'thchllym vymts'v 'tsh'vl v'tbnyv nplym bhr glb'
verses.translation: And it came to pass on the morrow, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, that they found Saul and his sons fallen in mount Gilboa.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֨פְשִׁיטֻ֔הוּ וַיִּשְׂא֥וּ אֶת־רֹאשׁ֖וֹ וְאֶת־כֵּלָ֑יו וַיְשַׁלְּח֨וּ בְאֶרֶץ־פְּלִשְׁתִּ֜ים סָבִ֗יב לְבַשֵּׂ֛ר אֶת־עֲצַבֵּיהֶ֖ם וְאֶת־הָעָֽם׃
verses.translit: vypshythv vysh'v 'tr'shv v'tkhlyv vyshlchv b'rtsplshtym sbyb lbshr 't'tsbyhm v'th'm
verses.translation: And they stripped him, and took his head, and his armour, and sent into the land of the Philistines round about, to carry the tidings unto their idols, and to the people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּשִׂ֙ימוּ֙ אֶת־כֵּלָ֔יו בֵּ֖ית אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֑ם וְאֶת־גֻּלְגׇּלְתּ֥וֹ תָקְע֖וּ בֵּ֥ית דָּגֽוֹן׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyshymv 'tkhlyv byt 'lhyhm v'tglgltv tq'v byt dgvn {s}
verses.translation: And they put his armour in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the house of Dagon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיִּשְׁמְע֔וּ כֹּ֖ל יָבֵ֣ישׁ גִּלְעָ֑ד אֵ֛ת כׇּל־אֲשֶׁר־עָשׂ֥וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֖ים לְשָׁאֽוּל׃
verses.translit: vyshm'v khl ybysh gl'd 't khl'shr'shv plshtym lsh'vl
verses.translation: And when all Jabesh-gilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּק֘וּמוּ֮ כׇּל־אִ֣ישׁ חַ֒יִל֒ וַיִּשְׂא֞וּ אֶת־גּוּפַ֣ת שָׁא֗וּל וְאֵת֙ גּוּפֹ֣ת בָּנָ֔יו וַיְבִיא֖וּם יָבֵ֑ישָׁה וַיִּקְבְּר֨וּ אֶת־עַצְמוֹתֵיהֶ֜ם תַּ֤חַת הָֽאֵלָה֙ בְּיָבֵ֔שׁ וַיָּצ֖וּמוּ שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyqvmv khl'ysh chyl vysh'v 'tgvpt sh'vl v't gvpt bnyv vyby'vm ybyshh vyqbrv 't'tsmvtyhm tcht h'lh bybsh vytsvmv shb't ymym
verses.translation: all the valiant men arose, and took away the body of Saul, and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the terebinth in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֣מׇת שָׁא֗וּל בְּמַֽעֲלוֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר מָעַ֣ל בַּיהֹוָ֔ה עַל־דְּבַ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־שָׁמָ֑ר וְגַם־לִשְׁא֥וֹל בָּא֖וֹב לִדְרֽוֹשׁ׃
verses.translit: vymt sh'vl bm'lv 'shr m'l byhvh 'ldbr yhvh 'shr l'shmr vgmlsh'vl b'vb ldrvsh
verses.translation: So Saul died for his transgression which he committed against the LORD, because of the word of the LORD, which he kept not; and also for that he asked counsel of a ghost, to inquire thereby,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹא־דָרַ֥שׁ בַּיהֹוָ֖ה וַיְמִיתֵ֑הוּ וַיַּסֵּב֙ אֶת־הַמְּלוּכָ֔ה לְדָוִ֖יד בֶּן־יִשָֽׁי׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vl'drsh byhvh vymythv vysb 'thmlvkhh ldvyd bnyshy {p}
verses.translation: and inquired not of the LORD; therefore He slew him, and turned the kingdom unto David the son of Jesse.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקָּבְצ֧וּ כׇֽל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶל־דָּוִ֖יד חֶבְר֣וֹנָה לֵאמֹ֑ר הִנֵּ֛ה עַצְמְךָ֥ וּֽבְשָׂרְךָ֖ אֲנָֽחְנוּ׃
verses.translit: vyqbtsv khlyshr'l 'ldvyd chbrvnh l'mr hnh 'tsmkh vbshrkh 'nchnv
verses.translation: Then all Israel gathered themselves to David unto Hebron, saying: ‘Behold, we are thy bone and thy flesh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּם־תְּמ֣וֹל גַּם־שִׁלְשׁ֗וֹם גַּ֚ם בִּֽהְי֣וֹת שָׁא֣וּל מֶ֔לֶךְ אַתָּ֛ה הַמּוֹצִ֥יא וְהַמֵּבִ֖יא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיֹּ֩אמֶר֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ לְךָ֗ אַתָּ֨ה תִרְעֶ֤ה אֶת־עַמִּי֙ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאַתָּה֙ תִּֽהְיֶ֣ה נָגִ֔יד עַ֖ל עַמִּ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: gmtmvl gmshlshvm gm bhyvt sh'vl mlkh 'th hmvtsy' vhmby' 'tyshr'l vy'mr yhvh 'lhykh lkh 'th tr'h 't'my 'tyshr'l v'th thyh ngyd 'l 'my yshr'l
verses.translation: In times past, even when Saul was king, it was thou that didst lead out and bring in Israel; and the LORD thy God said unto thee: Thou shalt feed My people Israel, and thou shalt be prince over My people Israel.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֠יָּבֹ֠אוּ כׇּל־זִקְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל אֶל־הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ חֶבְר֔וֹנָה וַיִּכְרֹת֩ לָהֶ֨ם דָּוִ֥יד בְּרִ֛ית בְּחֶבְר֖וֹן לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה וַיִּמְשְׁח֨וּ אֶת־דָּוִ֤יד לְמֶ֙לֶךְ֙ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּדְבַ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה בְּיַד־שְׁמוּאֵֽל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyb'v khlzqny yshr'l 'lhmlkh chbrvnh vykhrt lhm dvyd bryt bchbrvn lpny yhvh vymshchv 'tdvyd lmlkh 'lyshr'l khdbr yhvh bydshmv'l {s}
verses.translation: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the LORD; and they anointed David king over Israel, according to the word of the LORD by the hand of Samuel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֨לֶךְ דָּוִ֧יד וְכׇל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל יְרוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם הִ֣יא יְב֑וּס וְשָׁם֙ הַיְבוּסִ֔י יֹשְׁבֵ֖י הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vylkh dvyd vkhlyshr'l yrvshl͏m hy' ybvs vshm hybvsy yshby h'rts
verses.translation: And David and all Israel went to Jerusalem—the same is Jebus—and the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land, were there.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמְר֜וּ יֹשְׁבֵ֤י יְבוּס֙ לְדָוִ֔יד לֹ֥א תָב֖וֹא הֵ֑נָּה וַיִּלְכֹּ֤ד דָּוִיד֙ אֶת־מְצֻדַ֣ת צִיּ֔וֹן הִ֖יא עִ֥יר דָּוִֽיד׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv yshby ybvs ldvyd l' tbv' hnh vylkhd dvyd 'tmtsdt tsyvn hy' 'yr dvyd
verses.translation: And the inhabitants of Jebus said to David: ‘Thou shalt not come in hither.’ Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion; the same is the city of David.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֔יד כׇּל־מַכֵּ֤ה יְבוּסִי֙ בָּרִ֣אשׁוֹנָ֔ה יִהְיֶ֥ה לְרֹ֖אשׁ וּלְשָׂ֑ר וַיַּ֧עַל בָּרִאשׁוֹנָ֛ה יוֹאָ֥ב בֶּן־צְרוּיָ֖ה וַיְהִ֥י לְרֹֽאשׁ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr dvyd khlmkhh ybvsy br'shvnh yhyh lr'sh vlshr vy'l br'shvnh yv'b bntsrvyh vyhy lr'sh
verses.translation: And David said: ‘Whosoever smiteth the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain.’ And Joab the son of Zeruiah went up first, and was made chief.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב דָּוִ֖יד בַּמְצָ֑ד עַל־כֵּ֥ן קָרְאוּ־ל֖וֹ עִ֥יר דָּוִֽיד׃
verses.translit: vyshb dvyd bmtsd 'lkhn qr'vlv 'yr dvyd
verses.translation: And David dwelt in the stronghold; therefore they called it the city of David.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּ֤בֶן הָעִיר֙ מִסָּבִ֔יב מִן־הַמִּלּ֖וֹא וְעַד־הַסָּבִ֑יב וְיוֹאָ֕ב יְחַיֶּ֖ה אֶת־שְׁאָ֥ר הָעִֽיר׃
verses.translit: vybn h'yr msbyb mnhmlv' v'dhsbyb vyv'b ychyh 'tsh'r h'yr
verses.translation: And he built the city round about, from Millo even round about; and Joab repaired the rest of the city.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ דָּוִ֖יד הָל֣וֹךְ וְגָד֑וֹל וַיהֹוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת עִמּֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vylkh dvyd hlvkh vgdvl vyhvh tsb'vt 'mv {p}
verses.translation: And David waxed greater and greater; for the LORD of hosts was with him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֨לֶּה רָאשֵׁ֤י הַגִּבֹּרִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְדָוִ֔יד הַמִּתְחַזְּקִ֨ים עִמּ֧וֹ בְמַלְכוּת֛וֹ עִם־כׇּל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְהַמְלִיכ֑וֹ כִּדְבַ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'lh r'shy hgbrym 'shr ldvyd hmtchzqym 'mv bmlkhvtv 'mkhlyshr'l lhmlykhv khdbr yhvh 'lyshr'l {s}
verses.translation: Now these are the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who held strongly with him in his kingdom, together with all Israel, to make him king, according to the word of the LORD concerning Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֛לֶּה מִסְפַּ֥ר הַגִּבֹּרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְדָוִ֑יד יָֽשׇׁבְעָ֣ם בֶּן־חַכְמוֹנִ֗י רֹ֚אשׁ (השלושים) [הַשָּׁ֣לִישִׁ֔ים] הֽוּא־עוֹרֵ֧ר אֶת־חֲנִית֛וֹ עַל־שְׁלֹשׁ־מֵא֥וֹת חָלָ֖ל בְּפַ֥עַם אֶחָֽת׃
verses.translit: v'lh mspr hgbrym 'shr ldvyd yshb'm bnchkhmvny r'sh (hshlvshym) [hshlyshym] hv''vrr 'tchnytv 'lshlshm'vt chll bp'm 'cht
verses.translation: And this is the number of the mighty men whom David had: Jashobeam, the son of a Hachmonite, the chief of the captains; he lifted up his spear against three hundred and slew them at one time.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַחֲרָ֛יו אֶלְעָזָ֥ר בֶּן־דּוֹד֖וֹ הָאֲחוֹחִ֑י ה֖וּא בִּשְׁלוֹשָׁ֥ה הַגִּבֹּרִֽים׃
verses.translit: v'chryv 'l'zr bndvdv h'chvchy hv' bshlvshh hgbrym
verses.translation: And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who was one of the three mighty men.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֽוּא־הָיָ֨ה עִם־דָּוִ֜יד בַּפַּ֣ס דַּמִּ֗ים וְהַפְּלִשְׁתִּים֙ נֶאֶסְפוּ־שָׁ֣ם לַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה וַתְּהִ֛י חֶלְקַ֥ת הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה מְלֵאָ֣ה שְׂעוֹרִ֑ים וְהָעָ֥ם נָ֖סוּ מִפְּנֵ֥י פְלִשְׁתִּֽים׃
verses.translit: hv'hyh 'mdvyd bps dmym vhplshtym n'spvshm lmlchmh vthy chlqt hshdh ml'h sh'vrym vh'm nsv mpny plshtym
verses.translation: He was with David at Pas-dammim, and there the Philistines were gathered together to battle, where was a plot of ground full of barley; and the people fled from before the Philistines.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּֽתְיַצְּב֤וּ בְתוֹךְ־הַֽחֶלְקָה֙ וַיַּצִּיל֔וּהָ וַיַּכּ֖וּ אֶת־פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וַיּ֥וֹשַׁע יְהֹוָ֖ה תְּשׁוּעָ֥ה גְדוֹלָֽה׃
verses.translit: vytytsbv btvkhhchlqh vytsylvh vykhv 'tplshtym vyvsh' yhvh tshv'h gdvlh
verses.translation: But they stood in the midst of the plot, and defended it, and slew the Philistines; and the LORD saved them by a great victory.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּרְד֡וּ שְֽׁלוֹשָׁה֩ מִן־הַשְּׁלוֹשִׁ֨ים רֹ֤אשׁ עַל־הַצֻּר֙ אֶל־דָּוִ֔יד אֶל־מְעָרַ֖ת עֲדֻלָּ֑ם וּמַחֲנֵ֣ה פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים חֹנָ֖ה בְּעֵ֥מֶק רְפָאִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyrdv shlvshh mnhshlvshym r'sh 'lhtsr 'ldvyd 'lm'rt 'dlm vmchnh plshtym chnh b'mq rp'ym
verses.translation: And three of the thirty chiefs went down to the rock to David, unto the cave of Adullam; and the host of the Philistines were encamped in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְדָוִ֖יד אָ֣ז בַּמְּצוּדָ֑ה וּנְצִ֣יב פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים אָ֖ז בְּבֵ֥ית לָֽחֶם׃
verses.translit: vdvyd 'z bmtsvdh vntsyb plshtym 'z bbyt lchm
verses.translation: And David was then in the stronghold, and the garrison of the Philistines was then in Beth-lehem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתְאָ֥ו דָּוִ֖יד וַיֹּאמַ֑ר מִ֚י יַשְׁקֵ֣נִי מַ֔יִם מִבּ֥וֹר בֵּֽית־לֶ֖חֶם אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּשָּֽׁעַר׃
verses.translit: vyt'v dvyd vy'mr my yshqny mym mbvr bytlchm 'shr bsh'r
verses.translation: And David longed, and said: ‘Oh that one would give me water to drink of the well of Beth-lehem, which is by the gate! ’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּבְקְע֨וּ הַשְּׁלֹשָׁ֜ה בְּמַחֲנֵ֣ה פְלִשְׁתִּ֗ים וַיִּֽשְׁאֲבוּ־מַ֙יִם֙ מִבּ֤וֹר בֵּֽית־לֶ֙חֶם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּשַּׁ֔עַר וַיִּשְׂא֖וּ וַיָּבִ֣אוּ אֶל־דָּוִ֑יד וְלֹא־אָבָ֤ה דָוִיד֙ לִשְׁתּוֹתָ֔ם וַיְנַסֵּ֥ךְ אֹתָ֖ם לַיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vybq'v hshlshh bmchnh plshtym vysh'bvmym mbvr bytlchm 'shr bsh'r vysh'v vyb'v 'ldvyd vl''bh dvyd lshtvtm vynskh 'tm lyhvh
verses.translation: And the three broke through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Beth-lehem, that was by the gate, and took it, and brought it to David; but David would not drink thereof, but poured it out unto the LORD,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֡אמֶר חָלִ֩ילָה֩ לִּ֨י מֵאֱלֹהַ֜י מֵעֲשׂ֣וֹת זֹ֗את הֲדַ֣ם הָאֲנָשִׁים֩ הָאֵ֨לֶּה אֶשְׁתֶּ֤ה בְנַפְשׁוֹתָם֙ כִּ֣י בְנַפְשׁוֹתָ֣ם הֱבִיא֔וּם וְלֹ֥א אָבָ֖ה לִשְׁתּוֹתָ֑ם אֵ֣לֶּה עָשׂ֔וּ שְׁלֹ֖שֶׁת הַגִּבּוֹרִֽים׃
verses.translit: vy'mr chlylh ly m'lhy m'shvt z't hdm h'nshym h'lh 'shth bnpshvtm khy bnpshvtm hby'vm vl' 'bh lshtvtm 'lh 'shv shlsht hgbvrym
verses.translation: and said: ‘My God forbid it me, that I should do this; shall I drink the blood of these men that have put their lives in jeopardy? for with the jeopardy of their lives they brought it.’ Therefore he would not drink it. These things did the three mighty men.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַבְשַׁ֣י אֲחִֽי־יוֹאָ֗ב ה֤וּא הָיָה֙ רֹ֣אשׁ הַשְּׁלוֹשָׁ֔ה וְהוּא֙ עוֹרֵ֣ר אֶת־חֲנִית֔וֹ עַל־שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת חָלָ֑ל (ולא) [וְלוֹ־]שֵׁ֖ם בַּשְּׁלוֹשָֽׁה׃
verses.translit: v'bshy 'chyyv'b hv' hyh r'sh hshlvshh vhv' 'vrr 'tchnytv 'lshlsh m'vt chll (vl') [vlv]shm bshlvshh
verses.translation: And Abishai, the brother of Joab, he was chief of the three; for he lifted up his spear against three hundred and slew them, and had a name among the three.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִן־הַשְּׁלוֹשָׁ֤ה בַשְּׁנַ֙יִם֙ נִכְבָּ֔ד וַיְהִ֥י לָהֶ֖ם לְשָׂ֑ר וְעַד־הַשְּׁלוֹשָׁ֖ה לֹא־בָֽא׃ {ס}
verses.translit: mnhshlvshh bshnym nkhbd vyhy lhm lshr v'dhshlvshh l'b' {s}
verses.translation: Of the three in the second rank he was the most honourable, and was made their captain; howbeit he attained not to the first three.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנָיָ֨ה בֶן־יְהוֹיָדָ֧ע בֶּן־אִֽישׁ־חַ֛יִל רַב־פְּעָלִ֖ים מִֽן־קַבְצְאֵ֑ל ה֣וּא הִכָּ֗ה אֵ֣ת שְׁנֵ֤י אֲרִיאֵל֙ מוֹאָ֔ב וְ֠ה֠וּא יָרַ֞ד וְהִכָּ֧ה אֶֽת־הָאֲרִ֛י בְּת֥וֹךְ הַבּ֖וֹר בְּי֥וֹם הַשָּֽׁלֶג׃
verses.translit: bnyh bnyhvyd' bn'yshchyl rbp'lym mnqbts'l hv' hkhh 't shny 'ry'l mv'b vhv' yrd vhkhh 'th'ry btvkh hbvr byvm hshlg
verses.translation: Beniah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done mighty deeds, he smote the two altar-hearths of Moab; he went down also and slew a lion in the midst of a pit in time of snow.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֽוּא־הִכָּה֩ אֶת־הָאִ֨ישׁ הַמִּצְרִ֜י אִ֥ישׁ מִדָּ֣ה  חָמֵ֣שׁ בָּאַמָּ֗ה וּבְיַ֨ד הַמִּצְרִ֤י חֲנִית֙ כִּמְנ֣וֹר אֹֽרְגִ֔ים וַיֵּ֥רֶד אֵלָ֖יו בַּשָּׁ֑בֶט וַיִּגְזֹ֤ל אֶֽת־הַחֲנִית֙ מִיַּ֣ד הַמִּצְרִ֔י וַיַּהַרְגֵ֖הוּ בַּחֲנִיתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vhv'hkhh 'th'ysh hmtsry 'ysh mdh  chmsh b'mh vbyd hmtsry chnyt khmnvr 'rgym vyrd 'lyv bshbt vygzl 'thchnyt myd hmtsry vyhrghv bchnytv
verses.translation: And he slew an Egyptian, a man of great stature, five cubits high; and in the Egyptian’s hand was a spear like a weaver’s beam; and he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and slew him with his own spear.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה עָשָׂ֔ה בְּנָיָ֖הוּ בֶּן־יְהוֹיָדָ֑ע וְלוֹ־שֵׁ֖ם בִּשְׁלוֹשָׁ֥ה הַגִּבֹּרִֽים׃
verses.translit: 'lh 'shh bnyhv bnyhvyd' vlvshm bshlvshh hgbrym
verses.translation: These things did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and had a name among the three mighty men.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִן־הַשְּׁלוֹשִׁ֗ים הִנּ֤וֹ נִכְבָּד֙ ה֔וּא וְאֶל־הַשְּׁלֹשָׁ֖ה לֹא־בָ֑א וַיְשִׂימֵ֥הוּ דָוִ֖יד עַל־מִשְׁמַעְתּֽוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: mnhshlvshym hnv nkhbd hv' v'lhshlshh l'b' vyshymhv dvyd 'lmshm'tv {s}
verses.translation: Behold, he was more honourable than the thirty, but he attained not to the first three; and David set him over his guard.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגִבּוֹרֵ֖י הַחֲיָלִ֑ים עֲשָׂהאֵל֙ אֲחִ֣י יוֹאָ֔ב {ס} אֶלְחָנָ֥ן בֶּן־דּוֹד֖וֹ מִבֵּ֥ית לָֽחֶם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vgbvry hchylym 'shh'l 'chy yv'b {s} 'lchnn bndvdv mbyt lchm {s}
verses.translation: Also the mighty men of valour: Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Beth-lehem;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שַׁמּוֹת֙ הַהֲרוֹרִ֔י {ס} חֶ֖לֶץ הַפְּלוֹנִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: shmvt hhrvry {s} chlts hplvny {s}
verses.translation: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עִירָ֤א בֶן־עִקֵּשׁ֙ הַתְּקוֹעִ֔י {ס} אֲבִיעֶ֖זֶר הָעַנְּתוֹתִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'yr' bn'qsh htqv'y {s} 'by'zr h'ntvty {s}
verses.translation: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Anathothite;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: סִבְּכַי֙ הַחֻ֣שָׁתִ֔י {ס} עִילַ֖י הָאֲחוֹחִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: sbkhy hchshty {s} 'yly h'chvchy {s}
verses.translation: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַהְרַי֙ הַנְּטֹ֣פָתִ֔י {ס} חֵ֥לֶד בֶּֽן־בַּעֲנָ֖ה הַנְּטוֹפָתִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: mhry hntpty {s} chld bnb'nh hntvpty {s}
verses.translation: Mahrai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִיתַ֣י בֶּן־רִיבַ֗י מִגִּבְעַת֙ בְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֔ן {ס} בְּנָיָ֖ה הַפִּרְעָתֹנִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'yty bnryby mgb't bny bnymn {s} bnyh hpr'tny {s}
verses.translation: Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חוּרַי֙ מִנַּ֣חֲלֵי גָ֔עַשׁ {ס} אֲבִיאֵ֖ל הָעַרְבָתִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: chvry mnchly g'sh {s} 'by'l h'rbty {s}
verses.translation: Hurai of Nahale-gaash, Abiel the Arbathite;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַזְמָ֙וֶת֙ הַבַּ֣חֲרוּמִ֔י {ס} אֶלְיַחְבָּ֖א הַשַּׁעַלְבֹנִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'zmvt hbchrvmy {s} 'lychb' hsh'lbny {s}
verses.translation: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֗י הָשֵׁם֙ הַגִּ֣זוֹנִ֔י {ס} יוֹנָתָ֥ן בֶּן־שָׁגֵ֖ה הַהֲרָרִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny hshm hgzvny {s} yvntn bnshgh hhrry {s}
verses.translation: the sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shageh the Hararite;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲחִיאָ֧ם בֶּן־שָׂכָ֛ר הַהֲרָרִ֖י {ס} אֱלִיפַ֥ל בֶּן־אֽוּר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'chy'm bnshkhr hhrry {s} 'lypl bn'vr {s}
verses.translation: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֵ֚פֶר הַמְּכֵ֣רָתִ֔י אֲחִיָּ֖ה הַפְּלֹנִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: chpr hmkhrty 'chyh hplny {s}
verses.translation: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֶצְרוֹ֙ הַֽכַּרְמְלִ֔י {ס} נַעֲרַ֖י בֶּן־אֶזְבָּֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: chtsrv hkhrmly {s} n'ry bn'zby {s}
verses.translation: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai the son of Ezbai;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יוֹאֵל֙ אֲחִ֣י נָתָ֔ן {ס} מִבְחָ֖ר בֶּן־הַגְרִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: yv'l 'chy ntn {s} mbchr bnhgry {s}
verses.translation: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Hagri;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צֶ֖לֶק הָעַמּוֹנִ֑י נַחְרַי֙ הַבֵּ֣רֹתִ֔י נֹשֵׂ֕א כְּלֵ֖י יוֹאָ֥ב בֶּן־צְרוּיָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: tslq h'mvny nchry hbrty nsh' khly yv'b bntsrvyh {s}
verses.translation: Zelek the Ammonite, Nahrai the Berothite, the armour-bearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עִירָא֙ הַיִּתְרִ֔י {ס} גָּרֵ֖ב הַיִּתְרִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'yr' hytry {s} grb hytry {s}
verses.translation: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֽוּרִיָּה֙ הַחִתִּ֔י {ס} זָבָ֖ד בֶּן־אַחְלָֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'vryh hchty {s} zbd bn'chly {s}
verses.translation: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֲדִינָ֨א בֶן־שִׁיזָ֜א הָראוּבֵנִ֗י רֹ֛אשׁ לָראוּבֵנִ֖י וְעָלָ֥יו שְׁלֹשִֽׁים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'dyn' bnshyz' hr'vbny r'sh lr'vbny v'lyv shlshym {s}
verses.translation: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite, a chief of the Reubenites, and thirty with him;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חָנָן֙ בֶּֽן־מַעֲכָ֔ה וְיוֹשָׁפָ֖ט הַמִּתְנִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: chnn bnm'khh vyvshpt hmtny {s}
verses.translation: Hanan the son of Maacah, and Joshaphat the Mithnite;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֻזִּיָּ֖א הָעַשְׁתְּרָתִ֑י {ס} שָׁמָע֙ (ויעואל) [וִיעִיאֵ֔ל] בְּנֵ֖י חוֹתָ֥ם הָעֲרֹעֵרִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'zy' h'shtrty {s} shm' (vy'v'l) [vy'y'l] bny chvtm h'r'ry {s}
verses.translation: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jeiel the sons of Hotham the Aroerite;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְדִֽיעֲאֵל֙ בֶּן־שִׁמְרִ֔י וְיֹחָ֥א אָחִ֖יו הַתִּיצִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: ydy''l bnshmry vych' 'chyv htytsy {s}
verses.translation: Jediael the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱלִיאֵל֙ הַֽמַּחֲוִ֔ים וִירִיבַ֥י וְיוֹשַׁוְיָ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י אֶלְנָ֑עַם {ס} וְיִתְמָ֖ה הַמּוֹאָבִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'ly'l hmchvym vyryby vyvshvyh bny 'ln'm {s} vytmh hmv'by
verses.translation: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱלִיאֵ֣ל וְעוֹבֵ֔ד {ס} וְיַעֲשִׂיאֵ֖ל הַמְּצֹבָיָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'ly'l v'vbd {s} vy'shy'l hmtsbyh {p}
verses.translation: Eliel, and Obed, and Jaasiel the Mezobaite.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֗לֶּה הַבָּאִ֤ים אֶל־דָּוִיד֙ לְצִ֣יקְלַ֔ג ע֣וֹד עָצ֔וּר מִפְּנֵ֖י שָׁא֣וּל בֶּן־קִ֑ישׁ וְהֵ֙מָּה֙ בַּגִּבּוֹרִ֔ים עֹזְרֵ֖י הַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'lh hb'ym 'ldvyd ltsyqlg 'vd 'tsvr mpny sh'vl bnqysh vhmh bgbvrym 'zry hmlchmh
verses.translation: Now these are they that came to David to Ziklag, while he was yet shut up because of Saul the son of Kish; and they were among the mighty men, his helpers in war.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נֹ֣שְׁקֵי קֶ֗שֶׁת מַיְמִינִ֤ים וּמַשְׂמִאלִים֙ בָּאֲבָנִ֔ים וּבַחִצִּ֖ים בַּקָּ֑שֶׁת מֵאֲחֵ֥י שָׁא֖וּל מִבִּנְיָמִֽן׃
verses.translit: nshqy qsht mymynym vmshm'lym b'bnym vbchtsym bqsht m'chy sh'vl mbnymn
verses.translation: They were armed with bows, and could use both the right hand and the left in slinging stones and in shooting arrows from the bow; they were of Saul’s brethren of Benjamin.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָרֹ֨אשׁ אֲחִיעֶ֜זֶר וְיוֹאָ֗שׁ בְּנֵי֙ הַשְּׁמָעָ֣ה הַגִּבְעָתִ֔י (ויזואל) [וִיזִיאֵ֥ל] וָפֶ֖לֶט בְּנֵ֣י עַזְמָ֑וֶת וּבְרָכָ֕ה וְיֵה֖וּא הָעַנְּתֹתִֽי׃
verses.translit: hr'sh 'chy'zr vyv'sh bny hshm'h hgb'ty (vyzv'l) [vyzy'l] vplt bny 'zmvt vbrkhh vyhv' h'ntty
verses.translation: The chief was Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; and Jeziel, and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; and Beracah, and Jehu the Anathothite;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיִֽשְׁמַעְיָ֧ה הַגִּבְעוֹנִ֛י גִּבּ֥וֹר בַּשְּׁלֹשִׁ֖ים וְעַל־הַשְּׁלֹשִֽׁים׃
verses.translit: vyshm'yh hgb'vny gbvr bshlshym v'lhshlshym
verses.translation: and Ishmaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty, and over the thirty;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיִרְמְיָ֤ה וְיַחֲזִיאֵל֙ וְי֣וֹחָנָ֔ן וְיוֹזָבָ֖ד הַגְּדֵרָתִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyrmyh vychzy'l vyvchnn vyvzbd hgdrty {s}
verses.translation: and Jeremiah, and Jahaziel, and Johanan, and Jozabad the Gederathite;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶלְעוּזַ֤י וִֽירִימוֹת֙ וּבְעַלְיָ֣ה וּשְׁמַרְיָ֔הוּ וּשְׁפַטְיָ֖הוּ (החריפי) [הַחֲרוּפִֽי]׃
verses.translit: 'l'vzy vyrymvt vb'lyh vshmryhv vshptyhv (hchrypy) [hchrvpy]
verses.translation: Eluzai, and Jerimoth, and Bealiah, and Shemariah, and Shephatiah the Hariphite;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶלְקָנָ֡ה וְ֠יִשִּׁיָּ֠הוּ וַעֲזַרְאֵ֧ל וְיוֹעֶ֛זֶר וְיָשׇׁבְעָ֖ם הַקׇּרְחִֽים׃
verses.translit: 'lqnh vyshyhv v'zr'l vyv'zr vyshb'm hqrchym
verses.translation: Elkanah, and Isshiah, and Azarel, and Joezer, and Jashobeam, the Korahites;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיוֹעֵאלָ֧ה וּזְבַדְיָ֛ה בְּנֵ֥י יְרֹחָ֖ם מִֽן־הַגְּדֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: vyv''lh vzbdyh bny yrchm mnhgdvr
verses.translation: and Joelah, and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of the troop.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִן־הַגָּדִ֡י נִבְדְּל֣וּ אֶל־דָּוִיד֩ לַמְצַ֨ד מִדְבָּ֜רָה גִּבֹּרֵ֣י הַחַ֗יִל אַנְשֵׁ֤י צָבָא֙ לַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה עֹרְכֵ֥י צִנָּ֖ה וָרֹ֑מַח וּפְנֵ֤י אַרְיֵה֙ פְּנֵיהֶ֔ם וְכִצְבָאיִ֥ם עַל־הֶהָרִ֖ים לְמַהֵֽר׃
verses.translit: vmnhgdy nbdlv 'ldvyd lmtsd mdbrh gbry hchyl 'nshy tsb' lmlchmh 'rkhy tsnh vrmch vpny 'ryh pnyhm vkhtsb'ym 'lhhrym lmhr
verses.translation: And of the Gadites there separated themselves unto David to the stronghold in the wilderness, mighty men of valour, men trained for war, that could handle shield and spear; whose faces were like the faces of lions, and they were as swift as the roes upon the mountains;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֵ֖זֶר הָרֹ֑אשׁ עֹֽבַדְיָה֙ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י אֱלִיאָ֖ב הַשְּׁלִשִֽׁי׃
verses.translit: 'zr hr'sh 'bdyh hshny 'ly'b hshlshy
verses.translation: Ezer the chief, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִשְׁמַנָּה֙ הָרְבִיעִ֔י יִרְמְיָ֖ה הַחֲמִשִֽׁי׃
verses.translit: mshmnh hrby'y yrmyh hchmshy
verses.translation: Mashmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַתַּי֙ הַשִּׁשִּׁ֔י אֱלִיאֵ֖ל הַשְּׁבִעִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'ty hshshy 'ly'l hshb'y
verses.translation: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֽוֹחָנָן֙ הַשְּׁמִינִ֔י אֶלְזָבָ֖ד הַתְּשִׁיעִֽי׃
verses.translit: yvchnn hshmyny 'lzbd htshy'y
verses.translation: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִרְמְיָ֙הוּ֙ הָעֲשִׂירִ֔י מַכְבַּנַּ֖י עַשְׁתֵּ֥י עָשָֽׂר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: yrmyhv h'shyry mkhbny 'shty 'shr {s}
verses.translation: Jeremiah the tenth, Machbannai the eleventh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֥לֶּה מִבְּנֵי־גָ֖ד רָאשֵׁ֣י הַצָּבָ֑א אֶחָ֤ד לְמֵאָה֙ הַקָּטָ֔ן וְהַגָּד֖וֹל לְאָֽלֶף׃
verses.translit: 'lh mbnygd r'shy htsb' 'chd lm'h hqtn vhgdvl l'lf
verses.translation: These of the sons of Gad were captains of the host; he that was least was equal to a hundred, and the greatest to a thousand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה הֵ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָבְר֤וּ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן֙ בַּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֔וֹן וְה֥וּא מְמַלֵּ֖א עַל־כׇּל־[גְּדוֹתָ֑יו] (גדיתיו) וַיַּבְרִ֙יחוּ֙ אֶת־כׇּל־הָ֣עֲמָקִ֔ים לַמִּזְרָ֖ח וְלַֽמַּעֲרָֽב׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'lh hm 'shr 'brv 'thyrdn bchdsh hr'shvn vhv' mml' 'lkhl[gdvtyv] (gdytyv) vybrychv 'tkhlh'mqym lmzrch vlm'rb {p}
verses.translation: These are they that went over the Jordan in the first month, when it had overflown all its banks; and they put to flight all them of the valleys, both toward the east, and toward the west.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֗אוּ מִן־בְּנֵ֤י בִנְיָמִן֙ וִֽיהוּדָ֔ה עַד־לַמְצָ֖ד לְדָוִֽיד׃
verses.translit: vyb'v mnbny bnymn vyhvdh 'dlmtsd ldvyd
verses.translation: And there came of the children of Benjamin and Judah to the stronghold unto David.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֣א דָוִיד֮ לִפְנֵיהֶם֒ וַיַּ֙עַן֙ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לָהֶ֔ם אִם־לְשָׁל֞וֹם בָּאתֶ֤ם אֵלַי֙ לְעׇזְרֵ֔נִי יִֽהְיֶה־לִּ֧י עֲלֵיכֶ֛ם לֵבָ֖ב לְיָ֑חַד וְאִֽם־לְרַמּוֹתַ֣נִי לְצָרַ֗י בְּלֹ֤א חָמָס֙ בְּכַפַּ֔י יֵ֛רֶא אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבוֹתֵ֖ינוּ וְיוֹכַֽח׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyts' dvyd lpnyhm vy'n vy'mr lhm 'mlshlvm b'tm 'ly l'zrny yhyhly 'lykhm lbb lychd v'mlrmvtny ltsry bl' chms bkhpy yr' 'lhy 'bvtynv vyvkhch {s}
verses.translation: And David went out to meet them, and answered and said unto them: ‘If ye be come peaceably unto me to help me, my heart shall be knit unto you; but if ye be come to betray me to mine adversaries, seeing there is no wrong in my hands, the God of our fathers look thereon, and give judgment.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְר֣וּחַ לָֽבְשָׁ֗ה אֶת־עֲמָשַׂי֮ רֹ֣אשׁ (השלושים) [הַשָּׁלִישִׁים֒] לְךָ֤ דָוִיד֙ וְעִמְּךָ֣ בֶן־יִשַׁ֔י שָׁל֨וֹם ׀ שָׁל֜וֹם לְךָ֗ וְשָׁלוֹם֙ לְעֹ֣זְרֶ֔ךָ כִּ֥י עֲזָֽרְךָ֖ אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ וַיְקַבְּלֵ֣ם דָּוִ֔יד וַֽיִּתְּנֵ֖ם בְּרָאשֵׁ֥י הַגְּדֽוּד׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vrvch lbshh 't'mshy r'sh (hshlvshym) [hshlyshym] lkh dvyd v'mkh bnyshy shlvm  shlvm lkh vshlvm l'zrkh khy 'zrkh 'lhykh vyqblm dvyd vytnm br'shy hgdvd {p}
verses.translation: Then the spirit clothed Amasai, who was chief of the captains: Thine are we, David, And on thy side, thou son of Jesse; Peace, peace be unto thee, And peace be to thy helpers; For thy God helpeth thee. Then David received them, and made them captains of the band.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִֽמְּנַשֶּׁ֞ה נָפְל֣וּ עַל־דָּוִ֗יד בְּבֹא֨וֹ עִם־פְּלִשְׁתִּ֧ים עַל־שָׁא֛וּל לַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה וְלֹ֣א עֲזָרֻ֑ם כִּ֣י בְעֵצָ֗ה שִׁלְּחֻ֜הוּ סַרְנֵ֤י פְלִשְׁתִּים֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר בְּרָאשֵׁ֕ינוּ יִפּ֖וֹל אֶל־אֲדֹנָ֥יו שָׁאֽוּל׃
verses.translit: vmmnshh nplv 'ldvyd bb'v 'mplshtym 'lsh'vl lmlchmh vl' 'zrm khy b'tsh shlchhv srny plshtym l'mr br'shynv ypvl 'l'dnyv sh'vl
verses.translation: Of Manasseh also there fell away some to David, when he came with the Philistines against Saul to battle, but athey helped them not; for the lords of the Philistines upon advisement sent him away, saying: ‘He will fall away to his master Saul to the jeopardy of our heads.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּלֶכְתּ֣וֹ אֶל־צִֽיקְלַ֗ג נָפְל֣וּ עָלָ֣יו ׀ מִֽמְּנַשֶּׁ֡ה עַ֠דְנַ֠ח וְיוֹזָבָ֤ד וִידִֽיעֲאֵל֙ וּמִיכָאֵ֣ל וְיוֹזָבָ֔ד וֶאֱלִיה֖וּא וְצִלְּתָ֑י רָאשֵׁ֥י הָאֲלָפִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לִמְנַשֶּֽׁה׃
verses.translit: blkhtv 'ltsyqlg nplv 'lyv  mmnshh 'dnch vyvzbd vydy''l vmykh'l vyvzbd v'lyhv' vtslty r'shy h'lpym 'shr lmnshh
verses.translation: As he went to Ziklag, there fell to him of Manasseh, Adnah, and Jozabad, and Jediael, and Michael, and Jozabad, and Elihu, and Zillethai, captains of thousands that were of Manasseh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֵ֗מָּה עָזְר֤וּ עִם־דָּוִיד֙ עַֽל־הַגְּד֔וּד כִּֽי־גִבּ֥וֹרֵי חַ֖יִל כֻּלָּ֑ם וַיִּהְי֥וּ שָׂרִ֖ים בַּצָּבָֽא׃
verses.translit: vhmh 'zrv 'mdvyd 'lhgdvd khygbvry chyl khlm vyhyv shrym btsb'
verses.translation: And they helped David against the troop, for they were all mighty men of valour, and were
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֚י לְעֶת־י֣וֹם בְּי֔וֹם יָבֹ֥אוּ עַל־דָּוִ֖יד לְעׇזְר֑וֹ עַד־לְמַחֲנֶ֥ה גָד֖וֹל כְּמַחֲנֵ֥ה אֱלֹהִֽים׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khy l'tyvm byvm yb'v 'ldvyd l'zrv 'dlmchnh gdvl khmchnh 'lhym {p}
verses.translation: For from day to day men came to David to help him, until there was a great host, like the host of God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֠אֵ֠לֶּה מִסְפְּרֵ֞י רָאשֵׁ֤י הֶחָלוּץ֙ לַצָּבָ֔א בָּ֥אוּ עַל־דָּוִ֖יד חֶבְר֑וֹנָה לְהָסֵ֞ב מַלְכ֥וּת שָׁא֛וּל אֵלָ֖יו כְּפִ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'lh mspry r'shy hchlvts ltsb' b'v 'ldvyd chbrvnh lhsb mlkhvt sh'vl 'lyv khpy yhvh {s}
verses.translation: And these are the numbers of the heads of them that were armed for war, who came to David to Hebron, to turn the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the word of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה נֹשְׂאֵ֥י צִנָּ֖ה וָרֹ֑מַח שֵׁ֧שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֛ים וּשְׁמוֹנֶ֥ה מֵא֖וֹת חֲלוּצֵ֥י צָבָֽא׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny yhvdh nsh'y tsnh vrmch shsht 'lpym vshmvnh m'vt chlvtsy tsb' {s}
verses.translation: The children of Judah that bore shield and spear were six thousand and eight hundred, armed for war.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִן־בְּנֵ֣י שִׁמְע֗וֹן גִּבּ֤וֹרֵֽי חַ֙יִל֙ לַצָּבָ֔א שִׁבְעַ֥ת אֲלָפִ֖ים וּמֵאָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: mnbny shm'vn gbvry chyl ltsb' shb't 'lpym vm'h {s}
verses.translation: Of the children of Simeon, mighty men of valour for the war, seven thousand and one hundred.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִן־בְּנֵי֙ הַלֵּוִ֔י אַרְבַּ֥עַת אֲלָפִ֖ים וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: mnbny hlvy 'rb't 'lpym vshsh m'vt {s}
verses.translation: Of the children of Levi four thousand and six hundred.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וִיהוֹיָדָ֖ע הַנָּגִ֣יד לְאַהֲרֹ֑ן וְעִמּ֕וֹ שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֖ים וּשְׁבַ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyhvyd' hngyd l'hrn v'mv shlsht 'lpym vshb' m'vt {s}
verses.translation: And Jehoiada was the leader of the house of Aaron, and with him were three thousand and seven hundred;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְצָד֥וֹק נַ֖עַר גִּבּ֣וֹר חָ֑יִל וּבֵית־אָבִ֥יו שָׂרִ֖ים עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vtsdvq n'r gbvr chyl vbyt'byv shrym 'shrym vshnym {s}
verses.translation: and Zadok, a young man mighty of valour, and of his father’s house twenty and two captains.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִן־בְּנֵ֧י בִנְיָמִ֛ן אֲחֵ֥י שָׁא֖וּל שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֑ים וְעַד־הֵ֙נָּה֙ מַרְבִּיתָ֔ם שֹׁמְרִ֕ים מִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת בֵּ֥ית שָׁאֽוּל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vmnbny bnymn 'chy sh'vl shlsht 'lpym v'dhnh mrbytm shmrym mshmrt byt sh'vl {s}
verses.translation: And of the children of Benjamin, the brethren of Saul, three thousand; for hitherto the greatest part of them had kept their allegiance to the house of Saul.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִן־בְּנֵ֣י אֶפְרַ֔יִם עֶשְׂרִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף וּשְׁמוֹנֶ֣ה מֵא֑וֹת גִּבּ֣וֹרֵי חַ֔יִל אַנְשֵׁ֥י שֵׁמ֖וֹת לְבֵ֥ית אֲבוֹתָֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vmnbny 'prym 'shrym 'lf vshmvnh m'vt gbvry chyl 'nshy shmvt lbyt 'bvtm {s}
verses.translation: And of the children of Ephraim twenty thousand and eight hundred, mighty men of valour, famous men in their fathers’houses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמֵֽחֲצִי֙ מַטֵּ֣ה מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה שְׁמוֹנָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר אָ֑לֶף אֲשֶׁ֤ר נִקְּבוּ֙ בְּשֵׁמ֔וֹת לָב֖וֹא לְהַמְלִ֥יךְ אֶת־דָּוִֽיד׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vmchtsy mth mnshh shmvnh 'shr 'lf 'shr nqbv bshmvt lbv' lhmlykh 'tdvyd {s}
verses.translation: And of the half-tribe of Manasseh eighteen thousand, who were mentioned by name, to come and make David king.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִבְּנֵ֣י יִשָּׂשכָ֗ר יוֹדְעֵ֤י בִינָה֙ לַֽעִתִּ֔ים לָדַ֖עַת מַה־יַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל רָאשֵׁיהֶ֣ם מָאתַ֔יִם וְכׇל־אֲחֵיהֶ֖ם עַל־פִּיהֶֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vmbny yshshkhr yvd'y bynh l'tym ld't mhy'shh yshr'l r'shyhm m'tym vkhl'chyhm 'lpyhm {s}
verses.translation: And of the children of Issachar, men that had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do; the heads of them were two hundred; and all their brethren were at their commandment.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִזְּבֻל֞וּן יוֹצְאֵ֣י צָבָ֗א עֹרְכֵ֧י מִלְחָמָ֛ה בְּכׇל־כְּלֵ֥י מִלְחָמָ֖ה חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים אָ֑לֶף וְלַעֲדֹ֖ר בְּלֹא־לֵ֥ב וָלֵֽב׃ {ס}
verses.translit: mzblvn yvts'y tsb' 'rkhy mlchmh bkhlkhly mlchmh chmshym 'lf vl'dr bl'lb vlb {s}
verses.translation: Of Zebulun, such as were able to go out in the host, that could set the battle in array, with all manner of instruments of war, fifty thousand; and that could order the battle array, and were not of double heart.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִנַּפְתָּלִ֖י שָׂרִ֣ים אָ֑לֶף וְעִמָּהֶם֙ בְּצִנָּ֣ה וַחֲנִ֔ית שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וְשִׁבְעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vmnptly shrym 'lf v'mhm btsnh vchnyt shlshym vshb'h 'lf {s}
verses.translation: And of Naphtali a thousand captains, and with them with shield and spear thirty and seven thousand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִן־הַדָּנִי֙ עֹרְכֵ֣י מִלְחָמָ֔ה עֶשְׂרִֽים־וּשְׁמוֹנָ֥ה אֶ֖לֶף וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vmnhdny 'rkhy mlchmh 'shrymvshmvnh 'lf vshsh m'vt {s}
verses.translation: And of the Danites that could set the battle in array, twenty and eight thousand and six hundred.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמֵאָשֵׁ֗ר יוֹצְאֵ֥י צָבָ֛א לַעֲרֹ֥ךְ מִלְחָמָ֖ה אַרְבָּעִ֥ים אָֽלֶף׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vm'shr yvts'y tsb' l'rkh mlchmh 'rb'ym 'lf {s}
verses.translation: And of Asher, such as were able to go out in the host, that could set the battle in array, forty thousand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמֵעֵ֣בֶר לַ֠יַּרְדֵּ֠ן מִן־הָראוּבֵנִ֨י וְהַגָּדִ֜י וַחֲצִ֣י  שֵׁ֣בֶט מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה בְּכֹל֙ כְּלֵי֙ צְבָ֣א מִלְחָמָ֔ה מֵאָ֥ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֖ים אָֽלֶף׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vm'br lyrdn mnhr'vbny vhgdy vchtsy  shbt mnshh bkhl khly tsb' mlchmh m'h v'shrym 'lf {s}
verses.translation: And on the other side of the Jordan, of the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and of the half-tribe of Manasseh, with all manner of instruments of war for the battle, a hundred and twenty thousand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־אֵ֜לֶּה אַנְשֵׁ֣י מִלְחָמָה֮ עֹדְרֵ֣י מַעֲרָכָה֒ בְּלֵבָ֤ב שָׁלֵם֙ בָּ֣אוּ חֶבְר֔וֹנָה לְהַמְלִ֥יךְ אֶת־דָּוִ֖יד עַל־כׇּל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ֠גַ֠ם כׇּל־שֵׁרִ֧ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל לֵ֥ב אֶחָ֖ד לְהַמְלִ֥יךְ אֶת־דָּוִֽיד׃
verses.translit: khl'lh 'nshy mlchmh 'dry m'rkhh blbb shlm b'v chbrvnh lhmlykh 'tdvyd 'lkhlyshr'l vgm khlshryt yshr'l lb 'chd lhmlykh 'tdvyd
verses.translation: All these, being men of war, that could order the battle array, came with a whole heart to Hebron, to make David king over all Israel; and all the rest also of Israel were of one heart to make David king.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּֽהְיוּ־שָׁ֤ם עִם־דָּוִיד֙ יָמִ֣ים שְׁלוֹשָׁ֔ה אֹכְלִ֖ים וְשׁוֹתִ֑ים כִּי־הֵכִ֥ינוּ לָהֶ֖ם אֲחֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vyhyvshm 'mdvyd ymym shlvshh 'khlym vshvtym khyhkhynv lhm 'chyhm
verses.translation: And they were there with David three days, eating and drinking; for their brethren had made preparation for them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגַ֣ם הַקְּרֽוֹבִים־אֲ֠לֵיהֶ֠ם עַד־יִשָּׂשכָ֨ר וּזְבֻל֜וּן וְנַפְתָּלִ֗י מְבִיאִ֣ים לֶ֡חֶם בַּחֲמוֹרִ֣ים וּבַגְּמַלִּ֣ים וּבַפְּרָדִ֣ים ׀ וּֽבַבָּקָ֡ר מַאֲכָ֡ל קֶ֠מַח דְּבֵלִ֨ים וְצִמּוּקִ֧ים וְיַיִן־וְשֶׁ֛מֶן וּבָקָ֥ר וְצֹ֖אן לָרֹ֑ב כִּ֥י שִׂמְחָ֖ה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vgm hqrvbym'lyhm 'dyshshkhr vzblvn vnptly mby'ym lchm bchmvrym vbgmlym vbprdym  vbbqr m'khl qmch dblym vtsmvqym vyynvshmn vbqr vts'n lrb khy shmchh byshr'l {p}
verses.translation: Moreover they that were nigh unto them, even as far as Issachar and Zebulun and Naphtali, brought bread on asses, and on camels, and on mules, and on oxen, victual of meal, cakes of figs, and clusters of raisins, and wine, and oil, and oxen, and sheep in abundance; for there was joy in Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּוָּעַ֣ץ דָּוִ֗יד עִם־שָׂרֵ֧י הָאֲלָפִ֛ים וְהַמֵּא֖וֹת לְכׇל־נָגִֽיד׃
verses.translit: vyv'ts dvyd 'mshry h'lpym vhm'vt lkhlngyd
verses.translation: And David consulted with the captains of thousands and of hundreds, even with every leader.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֜יד לְכֹ֣ל  קְהַ֣ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אִם־עֲלֵיכֶ֨ם ט֜וֹב וּמִן־יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ נִפְרְצָה֙ נִשְׁלְחָ֞ה עַל־אַחֵ֣ינוּ הַנִּשְׁאָרִ֗ים בְּכֹל֙ אַרְצ֣וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְעִמָּהֶ֛ם הַכֹּהֲנִ֥ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֖ם בְּעָרֵ֣י מִגְרְשֵׁיהֶ֑ם וְיִקָּבְצ֖וּ אֵלֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr dvyd lkhl  qhl yshr'l 'm'lykhm tvb vmnyhvh 'lhynv nprtsh nshlchh 'l'chynv hnsh'rym bkhl 'rtsvt yshr'l v'mhm hkhhnym vhlvym b'ry mgrshyhm vyqbtsv 'lynv
verses.translation: And David said unto all the assembly of Israel: ‘If it seem good unto you, and if it be of the LORD our God, let us send abroad everywhere unto our brethren that are left in all the land of Israel, and with them to the priests and Levites that are in their cities that have open land about them, that they may gather themselves unto us;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָסֵ֛בָּה אֶת־אֲר֥וֹן אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ אֵלֵ֑ינוּ כִּֽי־לֹ֥א דְרַשְׁנֻ֖הוּ בִּימֵ֥י שָׁאֽוּל׃
verses.translit: vnsbh 't'rvn 'lhynv 'lynv khyl' drshnhv bymy sh'vl
verses.translation: and let us bring back the ark of our God to us; for we sought not unto it in the days of Saul.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֥וּ כׇֽל־הַקָּהָ֖ל לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת כֵּ֑ן כִּֽי־יָשַׁ֥ר הַדָּבָ֖ר בְּעֵינֵ֥י כׇל־הָעָֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv khlhqhl l'shvt khn khyyshr hdbr b'yny khlh'm
verses.translation: And all the assembly said that they would do so; for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּקְהֵ֤ל דָּוִיד֙ אֶת־כׇּל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִן־שִׁיח֥וֹר מִצְרַ֖יִם וְעַד־לְב֣וֹא חֲמָ֑ת לְהָבִיא֙ אֶת־אֲר֣וֹן הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים מִקִּרְיַ֖ת יְעָרִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyqhl dvyd 'tkhlyshr'l mnshychvr mtsrym v'dlbv' chmt lhby' 't'rvn h'lhym mqryt y'rym
verses.translation: So David assembled all Israel together, from Shihor the brook of Egypt even unto the entrance of Hamath, to bring the ark of God from Kiriath-jearim.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֨עַל דָּוִ֤יד וְכׇל־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בַּעֲלָ֔תָה אֶל־קִרְיַ֥ת יְעָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר לִֽיהוּדָ֑ה לְהַעֲל֣וֹת מִשָּׁ֗ם אֵת֩ אֲר֨וֹן הָאֱלֹהִ֧ים ׀ יְהֹוָ֛ה יוֹשֵׁ֥ב הַכְּרוּבִ֖ים אֲשֶׁר־נִקְרָ֥א שֵֽׁם׃
verses.translit: vy'l dvyd vkhlyshr'l b'lth 'lqryt y'rym 'shr lyhvdh lh'lvt mshm 't 'rvn h'lhym  yhvh yvshb hkhrvbym 'shrnqr' shm
verses.translation: And David went up, and all Israel, to Baalah, that is, to Kiriath-jearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up from thence the ark of God, the LORD that sitteth upon the cherubim, whereon is called the Name.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּרְכִּ֜יבוּ אֶת־אֲר֤וֹן הָאֱלֹהִים֙ עַל־עֲגָלָ֣ה חֲדָשָׁ֔ה מִבֵּ֖ית אֲבִינָדָ֑ב וְעֻזָּ֣א וְאַחְי֔וֹ נֹהֲגִ֖ים בָּעֲגָלָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyrkhybv 't'rvn h'lhym 'l'glh chdshh mbyt 'byndb v'z' v'chyv nhgym b'glh
verses.translation: And they set the ark of God upon a new cart, [and brought it] out of the house of Abinadab; and Uzza and Ahio drove the cart.
