verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְדָוִ֣יד וְכׇל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל מְשַׂחֲקִ֛ים לִפְנֵ֥י הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים בְּכׇל־עֹ֑ז וּבְשִׁירִ֤ים וּבְכִנֹּרוֹת֙ וּבִנְבָלִ֣ים וּבְתֻפִּ֔ים וּבִמְצִלְתַּ֖יִם וּבַחֲצֹצְרֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vdvyd vkhlyshr'l mshchqym lpny h'lhym bkhl'z vbshyrym vbkhnrvt vbnblym vbtpym vbmtsltym vbchtstsrvt
verses.translation: And David and all Israel played before God with all their might; even with songs, and with harps, and with psalteries, and with timbrels, and with cymbals, and with trumpets.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ עַד־גֹּ֣רֶן כִּידֹ֑ן וַיִּשְׁלַ֨ח עֻזָּ֜א אֶת־יָד֗וֹ לֶֽאֱחֹז֙ אֶת־הָ֣אָר֔וֹן כִּ֥י שָֽׁמְט֖וּ הַבָּקָֽר׃
verses.translit: vyb'v 'dgrn khydn vyshlch 'z' 'tydv l'chz 'th'rvn khy shmtv hbqr
verses.translation: And when they came unto the threshing-floor of Chidon, Uzza put forth his hand to hold the ark; for the oxen stumbled.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּֽחַר־אַ֤ף יְהֹוָה֙ בְּעֻזָּ֔א וַיַּכֵּ֕הוּ עַ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־שָׁלַ֥ח יָד֖וֹ עַל־הָאָר֑וֹן וַיָּ֥מׇת שָׁ֖ם לִפְנֵ֥י אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: vychr'f yhvh b'z' vykhhv 'l 'shrshlch ydv 'lh'rvn vymt shm lpny 'lhym
verses.translation: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Uzza, and He smote him, because he put forth his hand to the ark; and there he died before God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּ֣חַר לְדָוִ֔יד כִּֽי־פָרַ֧ץ יְהֹוָ֛ה פֶּ֖רֶץ בְּעֻזָּ֑א וַיִּקְרָ֞א לַמָּק֤וֹם הַהוּא֙ פֶּ֣רֶץ עֻזָּ֔א עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: vychr ldvyd khyprts yhvh prts b'z' vyqr' lmqvm hhv' prts 'z' 'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: And David was displeased, because the LORD had broken forth upon Uzza; and that place was called Perez-uzza unto this day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּירָ֤א דָוִיד֙ אֶת־הָ֣אֱלֹהִ֔ים בַּיּ֥וֹם הַה֖וּא לֵאמֹ֑ר הֵ֚יךְ אָבִ֣יא אֵלַ֔י אֵ֖ת אֲר֥וֹן הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyyr' dvyd 'th'lhym byvm hhv' l'mr hykh 'by' 'ly 't 'rvn h'lhym
verses.translation: And David was afraid of God that day, saying: ‘How shall I bring the ark of God home to me?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹא־הֵסִ֨יר דָּוִ֧יד אֶת־הָאָר֛וֹן אֵלָ֖יו אֶל־עִ֣יר דָּוִ֑יד וַיַּטֵּ֕הוּ אֶל־בֵּ֥ית עֹבֵֽד־אֱדֹ֖ם הַגִּתִּֽי׃
verses.translit: vl'hsyr dvyd 'th'rvn 'lyv 'l'yr dvyd vythv 'lbyt 'bd'dm hgty
verses.translation: So David removed not the ark unto him into the city of David, but carried it aside into the house of Obed-edom the Gittite.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֩שֶׁב֩ אֲר֨וֹן הָאֱלֹהִ֜ים עִם־בֵּ֨ית עֹבֵ֥ד אֱדֹ֛ם בְּבֵית֖וֹ שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה חֳדָשִׁ֑ים וַיְבָ֧רֶךְ יְהֹוָ֛ה אֶת־בֵּ֥ית עֹבֵֽד־אֱדֹ֖ם וְאֶת־כׇּל־אֲשֶׁר־לֽוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyshb 'rvn h'lhym 'mbyt 'bd 'dm bbytv shlshh chdshym vybrkh yhvh 'tbyt 'bd'dm v'tkhl'shrlv {s}
verses.translation: And the ark of God remained with the family of Obed-edom in his house three months; and the LORD blessed the house of Obed-edom, and all that he had.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֠יִּשְׁלַ֠ח (חירם) [חוּרָ֨ם] מֶלֶךְ־צֹ֥ר מַלְאָכִים֮ אֶל־דָּוִיד֒ וַעֲצֵ֣י אֲרָזִ֔ים וְחָרָשֵׁ֣י קִ֔יר וְחָרָשֵׁ֖י עֵצִ֑ים לִבְנ֥וֹת ל֖וֹ בָּֽיִת׃
verses.translit: vyshlch (chyrm) [chvrm] mlkhtsr ml'khym 'ldvyd v'tsy 'rzym vchrshy qyr vchrshy 'tsym lbnvt lv byt
verses.translation: And Huram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and cedar-trees, and masons, and carpenters, to build him a house.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֣דַע דָּוִ֔יד כִּֽי־הֱכִינ֧וֹ יְהֹוָ֛ה לְמֶ֖לֶךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּֽי־נִשֵּׂ֤את לְמַ֙עְלָה֙ מַלְכוּת֔וֹ בַּעֲב֖וּר עַמּ֥וֹ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyd' dvyd khyhkhynv yhvh lmlkh 'lyshr'l khynsh't lm'lh mlkhvtv b'bvr 'mv yshr'l {s}
verses.translation: And David perceived that the LORD had established him king over Israel, for his kingdom was exalted exceedingly, for His people Israel’s sake.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח דָּוִ֥יד ע֛וֹד נָשִׁ֖ים בִּירוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם וַיּ֧וֹלֶד דָּוִ֛יד ע֖וֹד בָּנִ֥ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vyqch dvyd 'vd nshym byrvshl͏m vyvld dvyd 'vd bnym vbnvt
verses.translation: And David took more wives at Jerusalem; and David begot more sons and daughters.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ שְׁמ֣וֹת הַיְלוּדִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיוּ־ל֖וֹ בִּירוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם שַׁמּ֣וּעַ וְשׁוֹבָ֔ב נָתָ֖ן וּשְׁלֹמֹֽה׃
verses.translit: v'lh shmvt hylvdym 'shr hyvlv byrvshl͏m shmv' vshvbb ntn vshlmh
verses.translation: And these are the names of the children whom he had in Jerusalem: Shammua, and Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיִבְחָ֥ר וֶאֱלִישׁ֖וּעַ וְאֶלְפָּֽלֶט׃
verses.translit: vybchr v'lyshv' v'lplt
verses.translation: and Ibhar, and Elishua, and Elpelet;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנֹ֥גַהּ וְנֶ֖פֶג וְיָפִֽיעַ׃
verses.translit: vngh vnpg vypy'
verses.translation: and Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וֶאֱלִישָׁמָ֥ע וּבְעֶלְיָדָ֖ע וֶאֱלִיפָֽלֶט׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'lyshm' vb'lyd' v'lyplt {p}
verses.translation: and Elishama, and Beeliada, and Eliphelet.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמְע֣וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֗ים כִּי־נִמְשַׁ֨ח דָּוִ֤יד לְמֶ֙לֶךְ֙ עַל־כׇּל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיַּעֲל֥וּ כׇל־פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים לְבַקֵּ֣שׁ אֶת־דָּוִ֑יד וַיִּשְׁמַ֣ע דָּוִ֔יד וַיֵּצֵ֖א לִפְנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vyshm'v plshtym khynmshch dvyd lmlkh 'lkhlyshr'l vy'lv khlplshtym lbqsh 'tdvyd vyshm' dvyd vyts' lpnyhm
verses.translation: And when the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David; and David heard of it, and went out to meet them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּפְלִשְׁתִּ֖ים בָּ֑אוּ וַֽיִּפְשְׁט֖וּ בְּעֵ֥מֶק רְפָאִֽים׃
verses.translit: vplshtym b'v vypshtv b'mq rp'ym
verses.translation: Now the Philistines had come and made a raid in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁאַ֨ל דָּוִ֤יד בֵּאלֹהִים֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הַאֶֽעֱלֶה֙ עַל־[פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים] (פלשתיים) וּנְתַתָּ֖ם בְּיָדִ֑י וַיֹּ֨אמֶר ל֤וֹ יְהֹוָה֙ עֲלֵ֔ה וּנְתַתִּ֖ים בְּיָדֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: vysh'l dvyd b'lhym l'mr h''lh 'l[plshtym] (plshtyym) vnttm bydy vy'mr lv yhvh 'lh vnttym bydkh
verses.translation: And David inquired of God, saying: ‘Shall I go up against the Philistines? and wilt Thou deliver them into my hand?’ And the LORD said unto him: ‘Go up; for I will deliver them into thy hand.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּעֲל֥וּ בְּבַֽעַל־פְּרָצִים֮ וַיַּכֵּ֣ם שָׁ֣ם דָּוִיד֒ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֔יד פָּרַ֨ץ הָאֱלֹהִ֧ים אֶת־אוֹיְבַ֛י בְּיָדִ֖י כְּפֶ֣רֶץ מָ֑יִם עַל־כֵּ֗ן קָ֥רְא֛וּ שֵֽׁם־הַמָּק֥וֹם הַה֖וּא בַּ֥עַל פְּרָצִֽים׃
verses.translit: vy'lv bb'lprtsym vykhm shm dvyd vy'mr dvyd prts h'lhym 't'vyby bydy khprts mym 'lkhn qr'v shmhmqvm hhv' b'l prtsym
verses.translation: So they came up to Baal-perazim, and David smote them there; and David said: ‘God hath broken mine enemies by my hand, like the breach of waters.’ Therefore they called the name of that place Baal-perazim.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַזְבוּ שָׁ֖ם אֶת־אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֑ם וַיֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֔יד וַיִּשָּׂרְפ֖וּ בָּאֵֽשׁ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vy'zbv shm 't'lhyhm vy'mr dvyd vyshrpv b'sh {p}
verses.translation: And they left their gods there; and David gave commandment, and they were burned with fire.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּסִ֤יפוּ עוֹד֙ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וַֽיִּפְשְׁט֖וּ בָּעֵֽמֶק׃
verses.translit: vysypv 'vd plshtym vypshtv b'mq
verses.translation: And the Philistines yet again made a raid in the valley.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁאַ֨ל ע֤וֹד דָּוִיד֙ בֵּאלֹהִ֔ים וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לוֹ֙ הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים לֹ֥א תַעֲלֶ֖ה אַחֲרֵיהֶ֑ם הָסֵב֙ מֵֽעֲלֵיהֶ֔ם וּבָ֥אתָ לָהֶ֖ם מִמּ֥וּל הַבְּכָאִֽים׃
verses.translit: vysh'l 'vd dvyd b'lhym vy'mr lv h'lhym l' t'lh 'chryhm hsb m'lyhm vb't lhm mmvl hbkh'ym
verses.translation: And David inquired again of God; and God said unto him: ‘Thou shalt not go up after them; turn away from them, and come upon them over against the mulberry-trees.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וִ֠יהִ֠י כְּֽשׇׁמְעֲךָ֞ אֶת־ק֤וֹל הַצְּעָדָה֙ בְּרָאשֵׁ֣י הַבְּכָאִ֔ים אָ֖ז תֵּצֵ֣א בַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה כִּֽי־יָצָ֤א הָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ לְפָנֶ֔יךָ לְהַכּ֖וֹת אֶת־מַחֲנֵ֥ה פְלִשְׁתִּֽים׃
verses.translit: vyhy khshm'kh 'tqvl hts'dh br'shy hbkh'ym 'z tts' bmlchmh khyyts' h'lhym lpnykh lhkhvt 'tmchnh plshtym
verses.translation: And it shall be, when thou hearest the sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry-trees, that then thou shalt go out to battle; for God is gone out before thee to smite the host of the Philistines.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ דָּוִ֔יד כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֖הוּ הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וַיַּכּוּ֙ אֶת־מַחֲנֵ֣ה פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים מִגִּבְע֖וֹן וְעַד־גָּֽזְרָה׃
verses.translit: vy'sh dvyd kh'shr tsvhv h'lhym vykhv 'tmchnh plshtym mgb'vn v'dgzrh
verses.translation: And David did as God commanded him; and they smote the host of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gezer.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֥א שֵׁם־דָּוִ֖יד בְּכׇל־הָאֲרָצ֑וֹת וַיהֹוָ֛ה נָתַ֥ן אֶת־פַּחְדּ֖וֹ עַל־כׇּל־הַגּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.translit: vyts' shmdvyd bkhlh'rtsvt vyhvh ntn 'tpchdv 'lkhlhgvym
verses.translation: And the fame of David went out into all lands; and the LORD brought the fear of him upon all nations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּעַשׂ־ל֥וֹ בָתִּ֖ים בְּעִ֣יר דָּוִ֑יד וַיָּ֤כֶן מָקוֹם֙ לַאֲר֣וֹן הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים וַיֶּט־ל֖וֹ אֹֽהֶל׃
verses.translit: vy'shlv btym b'yr dvyd vykhn mqvm l'rvn h'lhym vytlv 'hl
verses.translation: And [David] made him houses in the city of David; and he prepared a place for the ark of God, and pitched for it a tent.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָ֚ז אָמַ֣ר דָּוִ֔יד לֹ֤א לָשֵׂאת֙ אֶת־אֲר֣וֹן הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים כִּ֖י אִם־הַלְוִיִּ֑ם כִּֽי־בָ֣ם  בָּחַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֗ה לָשֵׂ֞את אֶת־אֲר֧וֹן יְהֹוָ֛ה וּֽלְשָׁרְת֖וֹ עַד־עוֹלָֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'z 'mr dvyd l' lsh't 't'rvn h'lhym khy 'mhlvym khybm  bchr yhvh lsh't 't'rvn yhvh vlshrtv 'd'vlm {p}
verses.translation: Then David said: ‘None ought to carry the ark of God but the Levites; for them hath the LORD chosen to carry the ark of the LORD, and to minister unto Him for ever.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּקְהֵ֥ל דָּוִ֛יד אֶת־כׇּל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶל־יְרוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם לְהַֽעֲלוֹת֙ אֶת־אֲר֣וֹן יְהֹוָ֔ה אֶל־מְקוֹמ֖וֹ אֲשֶׁר־הֵכִ֥ין לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyqhl dvyd 'tkhlyshr'l 'lyrvshl͏m lh'lvt 't'rvn yhvh 'lmqvmv 'shrhkhyn lv
verses.translation: And David assembled all Israel at Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the LORD unto its place, which he had prepared for it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֶּאֱסֹ֥ף דָּוִ֛יד אֶת־בְּנֵ֥י אַהֲרֹ֖ן וְאֶת־הַלְוִיִּֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vy'sf dvyd 'tbny 'hrn v'thlvym {s}
verses.translation: And David gathered together the sons of Aaron, and the Levites;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִבְנֵ֖י קְהָ֑ת אוּרִיאֵ֣ל הַשָּׂ֔ר וְאֶחָ֖יו מֵאָ֥ה וְעֶשְׂרִֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: lbny qht 'vry'l hshr v'chyv m'h v'shrym {s}
verses.translation: of the sons of Kohath: Uriel the chief, and his brethren a hundred and twenty;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִבְנֵ֖י מְרָרִ֑י עֲשָׂיָ֣ה הַשָּׂ֔ר וְאֶחָ֖יו מָאתַ֥יִם וְעֶשְׂרִֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: lbny mrry 'shyh hshr v'chyv m'tym v'shrym {s}
verses.translation: of the sons of Merari: Asaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred and twenty;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִבְנֵ֖י גֵּרְשׁ֑וֹם יוֹאֵ֣ל הַשָּׂ֔ר וְאֶחָ֖יו מֵאָ֥ה וּשְׁלֹשִֽׁים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: lbny grshvm yv'l hshr v'chyv m'h vshlshym {s}
verses.translation: of the sons of Gershom: Joel the chief, and his brethren a hundred and thirty;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִבְנֵ֖י אֱלִיצָפָ֑ן שְׁמַֽעְיָ֥ה הַשָּׂ֖ר וְאֶחָ֥יו מָאתָֽיִם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: lbny 'lytspn shm'yh hshr v'chyv m'tym {s}
verses.translation: of the sons of Elizaphan: Shemaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִבְנֵ֖י חֶבְר֑וֹן אֱלִיאֵ֥ל הַשָּׂ֖ר וְאֶחָ֥יו שְׁמוֹנִֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: lbny chbrvn 'ly'l hshr v'chyv shmvnym {s}
verses.translation: of the sons of Hebron: Eliel the chief, and his brethren fourscore;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִבְנֵ֖י עֻזִּיאֵ֑ל עַמִּינָדָ֣ב הַשָּׂ֔ר וְאֶחָ֕יו מֵאָ֖ה וּשְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃ {פ}
verses.translit: lbny 'zy'l 'myndb hshr v'chyv m'h vshnym 'shr {p}
verses.translation: of the sons of Uzziel: Amminadab the chief, and his brethren a hundred and twelve.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֣א דָוִ֔יד לְצָד֥וֹק וּלְאֶבְיָתָ֖ר הַכֹּהֲנִ֑ים וְלַלְוִיִּ֗ם לְאוּרִיאֵ֤ל עֲשָׂיָה֙ וְיוֹאֵ֣ל שְׁמַֽעְיָ֔ה וֶאֱלִיאֵ֖ל וְעַמִּינָדָֽב׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyqr' dvyd ltsdvq vl'bytr hkhhnym vllvym l'vry'l 'shyh vyv'l shm'yh v'ly'l v'myndb {s}
verses.translation: And David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites, for Uriel, Asaiah, and Joel, Shemaiah, and Eliel, and Amminadab,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לָהֶ֔ם אַתֶּ֛ם רָאשֵׁ֥י הָאָב֖וֹת לַלְוִיִּ֑ם הִֽתְקַדְּשׁוּ֙ אַתֶּ֣ם וַאֲחֵיכֶ֔ם וְהַעֲלִיתֶ֗ם אֵ֣ת אֲר֤וֹן יְהֹוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶל־הֲכִינ֖וֹתִי לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr lhm 'tm r'shy h'bvt llvym htqdshv 'tm v'chykhm vh'lytm 't 'rvn yhvh 'lhy yshr'l 'lhkhynvty lv
verses.translation: and said unto them: ‘Ye are the heads of the fathers’houses of the Levites; sanctify yourselves, both ye and your brethren, that ye may bring up the ark of the LORD, the God of Israel, unto the place that I have prepared for it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֛י לְמַבָּרִ֥אשׁוֹנָ֖ה לֹ֣א אַתֶּ֑ם פָּרַ֨ץ יְהֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֙ינוּ֙ בָּ֔נוּ כִּֽי־לֹ֥א דְרַשְׁנֻ֖הוּ כַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.translit: khy lmbr'shvnh l' 'tm prts yhvh 'lhynv bnv khyl' drshnhv khmshpt
verses.translation: For because ye [bore it] not at the first, the LORD our God made a breach upon us, for that we sought Him not according to the ordinance.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּֽתְקַדְּשׁ֔וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֑ם לְהַעֲל֕וֹת אֶת־אֲר֥וֹן יְהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vytqdshv hkhhnym vhlvym lh'lvt 't'rvn yhvh 'lhy yshr'l
verses.translation: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of the LORD, the God of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׂא֣וּ בְנֵֽי־הַלְוִיִּ֗ם אֵ֚ת אֲר֣וֹן הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה מֹשֶׁ֖ה כִּדְבַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֑ה בִּכְתֵפָ֥ם בַּמֹּט֖וֹת עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vysh'v bnyhlvym 't 'rvn h'lhym kh'shr tsvh mshh khdbr yhvh bkhtpm bmtvt 'lyhm {p}
verses.translation: And the children of the Levites bore the ark of God upon their shoulders with the bars thereon, as Moses commanded according to the word of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִיד֮ לְשָׂרֵ֣י הַלְוִיִּם֒ לְהַעֲמִ֗יד אֶת־אֲחֵיהֶם֙ הַמְשֹׁ֣רְרִ֔ים בִּכְלֵי־שִׁ֛יר נְבָלִ֥ים וְכִנֹּר֖וֹת וּמְצִלְתָּ֑יִם מַשְׁמִיעִ֥ים לְהָרִֽים־בְּק֖וֹל לְשִׂמְחָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vy'mr dvyd lshry hlvym lh'myd 't'chyhm hmshrrym bkhlyshyr nblym vkhnrvt vmtsltym mshmy'ym lhrymbqvl lshmchh {p}
verses.translation: And David spoke to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brethren the singers, with instruments of music, psalteries and harps and cymbals, sounding aloud and lifting up the voice with joy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּעֲמִ֣ידוּ הַלְוִיִּ֗ם אֵ֚ת הֵימָ֣ן בֶּן־יוֹאֵ֔ל וּמִ֨ן־אֶחָ֔יו אָסָ֖ף בֶּן־בֶּרֶכְיָ֑הוּ {ס} וּמִן־בְּנֵ֤י מְרָרִי֙ אֲחֵיהֶ֔ם אֵיתָ֖ן בֶּן־קוּשָׁיָֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: vy'mydv hlvym 't hymn bnyv'l vmn'chyv 'sf bnbrkhyhv {s} vmnbny mrry 'chyhm 'ytn bnqvshyhv
verses.translation: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brethren, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari their brethren, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעִמָּהֶ֖ם אֲחֵיהֶ֣ם הַמִּשְׁנִ֑ים זְכַרְיָ֡הוּ בֵּ֡ן וְיַעֲזִיאֵ֡ל וּשְׁמִירָמ֡וֹת וִיחִיאֵ֣ל ׀ וְעֻנִּ֡י אֱלִיאָ֡ב וּבְנָיָ֡הוּ וּמַעֲשֵׂיָ֡הוּ וּמַתִּתְיָ֩הוּ֩ וֶאֱלִ֨יפְלֵ֜הוּ וּמִקְנֵיָ֨הוּ וְעֹבֵ֥ד אֱדֹ֛ם וִיעִיאֵ֖ל הַשֹּׁעֲרִֽים׃
verses.translit: v'mhm 'chyhm hmshnym zkhryhv bn vy'zy'l vshmyrmvt vychy'l  v'ny 'ly'b vbnyhv vm'shyhv vmttyhv v'lyplhv vmqnyhv v'bd 'dm vy'y'l hsh'rym
verses.translation: and with them their brethren of the second degree, Zechariah, Ben, and Jaaziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, Eliab, and Benaiah, and Maaseiah, and Mattithiah, and Eliphalehu, and Mikneiah, and Obed-edom, and Jeiel, the doorkeepers.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַמְשֹׁ֣רְרִ֔ים הֵימָ֥ן אָסָ֖ף וְאֵיתָ֑ן בִּמְצִלְתַּ֥יִם נְחֹ֖שֶׁת לְהַשְׁמִֽיעַ׃
verses.translit: vhmshrrym hymn 'sf v'ytn bmtsltym nchsht lhshmy'
verses.translation: So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan [, were appointed], with cymbals of brass to sound aloud;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּזְכַרְיָ֨ה וַעֲזִיאֵ֜ל וּשְׁמִירָמ֤וֹת וִֽיחִיאֵל֙ וְעֻנִּ֣י וֶאֱלִיאָ֔ב וּמַעֲשֵׂיָ֖הוּ וּבְנָיָ֑הוּ בִּנְבָלִ֖ים עַל־עֲלָמֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vzkhryh v'zy'l vshmyrmvt vychy'l v'ny v'ly'b vm'shyhv vbnyhv bnblym 'l'lmvt
verses.translation: and Zechariah, and Aziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, and Eliab, and Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with psalteries set to Alamoth;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמַתִּתְיָ֣הוּ וֶאֱלִֽיפְלֵ֗הוּ וּמִקְנֵיָ֙הוּ֙ וְעֹבֵ֣ד אֱדֹ֔ם וִיעִיאֵ֖ל וַעֲזַזְיָ֑הוּ בְּכִנֹּר֥וֹת עַל־הַשְּׁמִינִ֖ית לְנַצֵּֽחַ׃
verses.translit: vmttyhv v'lyplhv vmqnyhv v'bd 'dm vy'y'l v'zzyhv bkhnrvt 'lhshmynyt lntsch
verses.translation: and Mattithiah, and Eliphalehu, and Mikneiahu, and Obed-edom, and Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps on the Sheminith, to lead.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּכְנַנְיָ֥הוּ שַֽׂר־הַלְוִיִּ֖ם בְּמַשָּׂ֑א יָסֹר֙ בַּמַּשָּׂ֔א כִּ֥י מֵבִ֖ין הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: vkhnnyhv shrhlvym bmsh' ysr bmsh' khy mbyn hv'
verses.translation: And Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, was over the song; he was master in the song, because he was skilful.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבֶֽרֶכְיָה֙ וְאֶלְקָנָ֔ה שֹׁעֲרִ֖ים לָאָרֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: vbrkhyh v'lqnh sh'rym l'rvn
verses.translation: And Berechiah and Elkanah were door-keepers for the ark.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׁבַנְיָ֡הוּ וְיוֹשָׁפָ֡ט וּנְתַנְאֵ֡ל וַעֲמָשַׂ֡י וּ֠זְכַרְיָ֠הוּ וּבְנָיָ֤הוּ וֶאֱלִיעֶ֙זֶר֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים (מחצצרים) [מַחְצְרִים֙] בַּחֲצֹ֣צְר֔וֹת לִפְנֵ֖י אֲר֣וֹן הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְעֹבֵ֤ד אֱדֹם֙ וִֽיחִיָּ֔ה שֹׁעֲרִ֖ים לָאָרֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: vshbnyhv vyvshpt vntn'l v'mshy vzkhryhv vbnyhv v'ly'zr hkhhnym (mchtstsrym) [mchtsrym] bchtstsrvt lpny 'rvn h'lhym v'bd 'dm vychyh sh'rym l'rvn
verses.translation: And Shebaniah, and Joshaphat, and Nethanel, and Amasai, and Zechariah, and Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, did blow with the trumpets before the ark of God; and Obed-edom and Jehiah were doorkeepers for the ark.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דָוִ֛יד וְזִקְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְשָׂרֵ֣י הָאֲלָפִ֑ים הַהֹלְכִ֗ים לְֽהַעֲל֞וֹת אֶת־אֲר֧וֹן בְּרִית־יְהֹוָ֛ה מִן־בֵּ֥ית עֹבֵֽד־אֱדֹ֖ם בְּשִׂמְחָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyhy dvyd vzqny yshr'l vshry h'lpym hhlkhym lh'lvt 't'rvn brytyhvh mnbyt 'bd'dm bshmchh {p}
verses.translation: So David, and the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands, went to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of the house of Obed-edom with joy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ בֶּעְזֹ֣ר הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים אֶ֨ת־הַלְוִיִּ֔ם נֹשְׂאֵ֖י אֲר֣וֹן בְּרִית־יְהֹוָ֑ה וַיִּזְבְּח֥וּ שִׁבְעָֽה־פָרִ֖ים וְשִׁבְעָ֥ה אֵילִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyhy b'zr h'lhym 'thlvym nsh'y 'rvn brytyhvh vyzbchv shb'hprym vshb'h 'ylym
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when God helped the Levites that bore the ark of the covenant of the LORD, that they sacrificed seven bullocks and seven rams.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְדָוִ֞יד מְכֻרְבָּ֣ל  בִּמְעִ֣יל בּ֗וּץ וְכׇל־הַלְוִיִּם֙ הַנֹּשְׂאִ֣ים אֶת־הָאָר֔וֹן וְהַמְשֹׁ֣רְרִ֔ים וּכְנַנְיָ֛ה הַשַּׂ֥ר הַמַּשָּׂ֖א הַמְשֹׁרְרִ֑ים וְעַל־דָּוִ֖יד אֵפ֥וֹד בָּֽד׃
verses.translit: vdvyd mkhrbl  bm'yl bvts vkhlhlvym hnsh'ym 'th'rvn vhmshrrym vkhnnyh hshr hmsh' hmshrrym v'ldvyd 'pvd bd
verses.translation: And David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, and all the Levites that bore the ark, and the singers, and Chenaniah the master of the singers in the song; and David had upon him an ephod of linen.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכׇל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל מַֽעֲלִים֙ אֶת־אֲר֣וֹן בְּרִית־יְהֹוָ֔ה בִּתְרוּעָה֙ וּבְק֣וֹל שׁוֹפָ֔ר וּבַחֲצֹצְר֖וֹת וּבִמְצִלְתָּ֑יִם מַשְׁמִעִ֕ים בִּנְבָלִ֖ים וְכִנֹּרֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vkhlyshr'l m'lym 't'rvn brytyhvh btrv'h vbqvl shvpr vbchtstsrvt vbmtsltym mshm'ym bnblym vkhnrvt
verses.translation: Thus all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the LORD with shouting, and with sound of the horn, and with trumpets, and with cymbals, sounding aloud with psalteries and harps.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י אֲרוֹן֙ בְּרִ֣ית יְהֹוָ֔ה בָּ֖א עַד־עִ֣יר דָּוִ֑יד וּמִיכַ֨ל בַּת־שָׁא֜וּל נִשְׁקְפָ֣ה  בְּעַ֣ד הַחַלּ֗וֹן וַתֵּ֨רֶא אֶת־הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ דָּוִיד֙ מְרַקֵּ֣ד וּמְשַׂחֵ֔ק וַתִּ֥בֶז ל֖וֹ בְּלִבָּֽהּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyhy 'rvn bryt yhvh b' 'd'yr dvyd vmykhl btsh'vl nshqph  b'd hchlvn vtr' 'thmlkh dvyd mrqd vmshchq vtbz lv blbh {p}
verses.translation: And it came to pass, as the ark of the covenant of the LORD came to the city of David, that Michal the daughter of Saul looked out at the window, and saw king David dancing and making merry; and she despised him in her heart.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבִ֙יאוּ֙ אֶת־אֲר֣וֹן הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים וַיַּצִּ֣יגוּ אֹת֔וֹ בְּת֣וֹךְ הָאֹ֔הֶל אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָטָה־ל֖וֹ דָּוִ֑יד וַיַּקְרִ֛יבוּ עֹל֥וֹת וּשְׁלָמִ֖ים לִפְנֵ֥י הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyby'v 't'rvn h'lhym vytsygv 'tv btvkh h'hl 'shr nthlv dvyd vyqrybv 'lvt vshlmym lpny h'lhym
verses.translation: And they brought in the ark of God, and set it in the midst of the tent that David had pitched for it, and they offered burnt-offerings and peace-offerings before God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְכַ֣ל דָּוִ֔יד מֵהַעֲל֥וֹת הָעֹלָ֖ה וְהַשְּׁלָמִ֑ים וַיְבָ֥רֶךְ אֶת־הָעָ֖ם בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vykhl dvyd mh'lvt h'lh vhshlmym vybrkh 'th'm bshm yhvh
verses.translation: And when David had made an end of offering the burnt-offering and the peace-offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְחַלֵּק֙ לְכׇל־אִ֣ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מֵאִ֖ישׁ וְעַד־אִשָּׁ֑ה לְאִישׁ֙ כִּכַּר־לֶ֔חֶם וְאֶשְׁפָּ֖ר וַאֲשִׁישָֽׁה׃
verses.translit: vychlq lkhl'ysh yshr'l m'ysh v'd'shh l'ysh khkhrlchm v'shpr v'shyshh
verses.translation: And he dealt to every one of Israel, both man and woman, to every one a loaf of bread, and a cake made in a pan, and a sweet cake.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֞ן לִפְנֵ֨י אֲר֧וֹן יְהֹוָ֛ה מִן־הַלְוִיִּ֖ם מְשָֽׁרְתִ֑ים וּלְהַזְכִּיר֙ וּלְהוֹד֣וֹת וּלְהַלֵּ֔ל לַיהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vytn lpny 'rvn yhvh mnhlvym mshrtym vlhzkhyr vlhvdvt vlhll lyhvh 'lhy yshr'l {s}
verses.translation: And he appointed certain of the Levites to minister before the ark of the LORD, and to celebrate and to thank and praise the LORD, the God of Israel:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָסָ֥ף הָרֹ֖אשׁ וּמִשְׁנֵ֣הוּ זְכַרְיָ֑ה יְעִיאֵ֡ל וּשְׁמִירָמ֡וֹת וִיחִיאֵ֡ל וּמַתִּתְיָ֡ה וֶאֱלִיאָ֡ב וּבְנָיָ֩הוּ֩ וְעֹבֵ֨ד אֱדֹ֜ם וִיעִיאֵ֗ל בִּכְלֵ֤י נְבָלִים֙ וּבְכִנֹּר֔וֹת וְאָסָ֖ף בַּֽמְצִלְתַּ֥יִם מַשְׁמִֽיעַ׃
verses.translit: 'sf hr'sh vmshnhv zkhryh y'y'l vshmyrmvt vychy'l vmttyh v'ly'b vbnyhv v'bd 'dm vy'y'l bkhly nblym vbkhnrvt v'sf bmtsltym mshmy'
verses.translation: Asaph the chief, and second to him Zechariah, Jeiel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Mattithiah, and Eliab, and Benaiah, and Obed-edom, and Jeiel, with psalteries and with harps; and Asaph with cymbals, sounding aloud;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנָיָ֥הוּ וְיַחֲזִיאֵ֖ל הַכֹּהֲנִ֑ים בַּחֲצֹצְר֣וֹת תָּמִ֔יד לִפְנֵ֖י אֲר֥וֹן בְּרִית־הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: vbnyhv vychzy'l hkhhnym bchtstsrvt tmyd lpny 'rvn bryth'lhym
verses.translation: and Benaiah and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually, before the ark of the covenant of God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא אָ֣ז נָתַ֤ן דָּוִיד֙ בָּרֹ֔אשׁ לְהֹד֖וֹת לַיהֹוָ֑ה בְּיַד־אָסָ֖ף וְאֶחָֽיו׃ {פ}
verses.translit: byvm hhv' 'z ntn dvyd br'sh lhdvt lyhvh byd'sf v'chyv {p}
verses.translation: Then on that day did David first ordain to give thanks unto the LORD, by the hand of Asaph and his brethren.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הוֹד֤וּ לַֽיהֹוָה֙ קִרְא֣וּ בִשְׁמ֔וֹ הוֹדִ֥יעוּ בָעַמִּ֖ים עֲלִילֹתָֽיו׃
verses.translit: hvdv lyhvh qr'v bshmv hvdy'v b'mym 'lyltyv
verses.translation: O give thanks unto the LORD, call upon His name; Make known His doings among the peoples.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁ֤ירוּ לוֹ֙ זַמְּרוּ־ל֔וֹ שִׂ֖יחוּ בְּכׇל־נִפְלְאֹתָֽיו׃
verses.translit: shyrv lv zmrvlv shychv bkhlnpl'tyv
verses.translation: Sing unto Him, sing praises unto Him; Speak ye of all His marvellous works.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִֽתְהַלְלוּ֙ בְּשֵׁ֣ם קׇדְשׁ֔וֹ יִשְׂמַ֕ח לֵ֖ב מְבַקְשֵׁ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: hthllv bshm qdshv yshmch lb mbqshy yhvh
verses.translation: Glory ye in His holy name; Let the heart of them rejoice that seek the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דִּרְשׁ֤וּ יְהֹוָה֙ וְעֻזּ֔וֹ בַּקְּשׁ֥וּ פָנָ֖יו תָּמִֽיד׃
verses.translit: drshv yhvh v'zv bqshv pnyv tmyd
verses.translation: Seek ye the LORD and His strength; Seek His face continually.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זִכְר֗וּ נִפְלְאֹתָיו֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה מֹפְתָ֖יו וּמִשְׁפְּטֵי־פִֽיהוּ׃
verses.translit: zkhrv npl'tyv 'shr 'shh mptyv vmshptypyhv
verses.translation: Remember His marvellous works that He hath done, His wonders, and the judgments of His mouth;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֶ֚רַע יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל עַבְדּ֔וֹ בְּנֵ֥י יַעֲקֹ֖ב בְּחִירָֽיו׃
verses.translit: zr' yshr'l 'bdv bny y'qb bchyryv
verses.translation: O ye seed of Israel His servant, Ye children of Jacob, His chosen ones.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֚וּא יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ בְּכׇל־הָאָ֖רֶץ מִשְׁפָּטָֽיו׃
verses.translit: hv' yhvh 'lhynv bkhlh'rts mshptyv
verses.translation: He is the LORD our God; His judgments are in all the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זִכְר֤וּ לְעוֹלָם֙ בְּרִית֔וֹ דָּבָ֥ר צִוָּ֖ה לְאֶ֥לֶף דּֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: zkhrv l'vlm brytv dbr tsvh l'lf dvr
verses.translation: Remember His covenant for ever, The word which He commanded to a thousand generations;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֤ר כָּרַת֙ אֶת־אַבְרָהָ֔ם וּשְׁבוּעָת֖וֹ לְיִצְחָֽק׃
verses.translit: 'shr khrt 't'brhm vshbv'tv lytschq
verses.translation: [The covenant] which He made with Abraham, And His oath unto Isaac;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּעֲמִידֶ֤הָ לְיַֽעֲקֹב֙ לְחֹ֔ק לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּרִ֥ית עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'mydh ly'qb lchq lyshr'l bryt 'vlm
verses.translation: And He established it unto Jacob for a statute, To Israel for an everlasting covenant;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֵאמֹ֗ר לְךָ֙ אֶתֵּ֣ן אֶֽרֶץ־כְּנָ֔עַן חֶ֖בֶל נַחֲלַתְכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: l'mr lkh 'tn 'rtskhn'n chbl nchltkhm
verses.translation: Saying: ‘Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, The lot of your inheritance.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּהְיֽוֹתְכֶם֙ מְתֵ֣י מִסְפָּ֔ר כִּמְעַ֖ט וְגָרִ֥ים בָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: bhyvtkhm mty mspr khm't vgrym bh
verses.translation: When ye were but a few men in number, Yea, very few, and sojourners in it,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּֽתְהַלְּכוּ֙ מִגּ֣וֹי אֶל־גּ֔וֹי וּמִמַּמְלָכָ֖ה אֶל־עַ֥ם אַחֵֽר׃
verses.translit: vythlkhv mgvy 'lgvy vmmmlkhh 'l'm 'chr
verses.translation: And when they went about from nation to nation, And from one kingdom to another people,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹֽא־הִנִּ֤יחַ לְאִישׁ֙ לְעׇשְׁקָ֔ם וַיּ֥וֹכַח עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם מְלָכִֽים׃
verses.translit: l'hnych l'ysh l'shqm vyvkhch 'lyhm mlkhym
verses.translation: He suffered no man to do them wrong, Yea, for their sake He reproved kings:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַֽל־תִּגְּעוּ֙ בִּמְשִׁיחָ֔י וּבִנְבִיאַ֖י אַל־תָּרֵֽעוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'ltg'v bmshychy vbnby'y 'ltr'v {p}
verses.translation: ’Touch not Mine anointed ones, And do My prophets no harm.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁ֤ירוּ לַֽיהֹוָה֙ כׇּל־הָאָ֔רֶץ בַּשְּׂר֥וּ מִיּֽוֹם־אֶל־י֖וֹם יְשׁוּעָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: shyrv lyhvh khlh'rts bshrv myvm'lyvm yshv'tv
verses.translation: Sing unto the LORD, all the earth; Proclaim His salvation from day to day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: סַפְּר֤וּ בַגּוֹיִם֙ אֶת־כְּבוֹד֔וֹ בְּכׇל־הָעַמִּ֖ים נִפְלְאֹתָֽיו׃
verses.translit: sprv bgvym 'tkhbvdv bkhlh'mym npl'tyv
verses.translation: Declare His glory among the nations, His marvellous works among all the peoples.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי֩ גָד֨וֹל יְהֹוָ֤ה וּמְהֻלָּל֙ מְאֹ֔ד וְנוֹרָ֥א ה֖וּא עַל־כׇּל־אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: khy gdvl yhvh vmhll m'd vnvr' hv' 'lkhl'lhym
verses.translation: For great is the LORD, and highly to be praised; He also is to be feared above all gods.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֠י כׇּל־אֱלֹהֵ֤י הָֽעַמִּים֙ אֱלִילִ֔ים וַיהֹוָ֖ה שָׁמַ֥יִם עָשָֽׂה׃
verses.translit: khy khl'lhy h'mym 'lylym vyhvh shmym 'shh
verses.translation: For all the gods of the peoples are things of nought; But the LORD made the heavens.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֤וֹד וְהָדָר֙ לְפָנָ֔יו עֹ֥ז וְחֶדְוָ֖ה בִּמְקֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: hvd vhdr lpnyv 'z vchdvh bmqmv
verses.translation: Honour and majesty are before Him; Strength and gladness are in His place.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָב֤וּ לַֽיהֹוָה֙ מִשְׁפְּח֣וֹת עַמִּ֔ים הָב֥וּ לַיהֹוָ֖ה כָּב֥וֹד וָעֹֽז׃
verses.translit: hbv lyhvh mshpchvt 'mym hbv lyhvh khbvd v'z
verses.translation: Ascribe unto the LORD, ye kindreds of the peoples, Ascribe unto the LORD glory and strength.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָב֥וּ לַֽיהֹוָ֖ה כְּב֣וֹד שְׁמ֑וֹ שְׂא֤וּ מִנְחָה֙ וּבֹ֣אוּ לְפָנָ֔יו הִשְׁתַּחֲו֥וּ לַֽיהֹוָ֖ה בְּהַדְרַת־קֹֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: hbv lyhvh khbvd shmv sh'v mnchh vb'v lpnyv hshtchvv lyhvh bhdrtqdsh
verses.translation: Ascribe unto the LORD the glory due unto His name; Bring an offering, and come before Him; Worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חִ֤ילוּ מִלְּפָנָיו֙ כׇּל־הָאָ֔רֶץ אַף־תִּכּ֥וֹן תֵּבֵ֖ל בַּל־תִּמּֽוֹט׃
verses.translit: chylv mlpnyv khlh'rts 'ftkhvn tbl bltmvt
verses.translation: Tremble before Him, all the earth; The world also is established that it cannot be moved.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִשְׂמְח֤וּ הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ וְתָגֵ֣ל הָאָ֔רֶץ וְיֹאמְר֥וּ בַגּוֹיִ֖ם יְהֹוָ֥ה מָלָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: yshmchv hshmym vtgl h'rts vy'mrv bgvym yhvh mlkh
verses.translation: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice; And let them say among the nations: ‘The LORD reigneth.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִרְעַ֤ם הַיָּם֙ וּמְלוֹא֔וֹ יַעֲלֹ֥ץ הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה וְכׇל־אֲשֶׁר־בּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: yr'm hym vmlv'v y'lts hshdh vkhl'shrbv
verses.translation: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; Let the field exult, and all that is therein;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָ֥ז יְרַנְּנ֖וּ עֲצֵ֣י הַיָּ֑עַר מִלִּפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה כִּי־בָ֖א לִשְׁפּ֥וֹט אֶת־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: 'z yrnnv 'tsy hy'r mlpny yhvh khyb' lshpvt 'th'rts
verses.translation: Then shall the trees of the wood sing for joy, Before the LORD, for He is come to judge the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הוֹד֤וּ לַֽיהֹוָה֙ כִּ֣י ט֔וֹב כִּ֥י לְעוֹלָ֖ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: hvdv lyhvh khy tvb khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: O give thanks unto the LORD; for He is good; For His mercy endureth for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִמְר֕וּ הוֹשִׁיעֵ֙נוּ֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׁעֵ֔נוּ וְקַבְּצֵ֥נוּ וְהַצִּילֵ֖נוּ מִן־הַגּוֹיִ֑ם לְהֹדוֹת֙ לְשֵׁ֣ם קׇדְשֶׁ֔ךָ לְהִשְׁתַּבֵּ֖חַ בִּתְהִלָּתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: v'mrv hvshy'nv 'lhy ysh'nv vqbtsnv vhtsylnv mnhgvym lhdvt lshm qdshkh lhshtbch bthltkh
verses.translation: And say ye: ‘Save us, O God of our salvation, And gather us together and deliver us from the nations, That we may give thanks unto Thy holy name, That we may triumph in Thy praise.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּר֤וּךְ יְהֹוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִן־הָעוֹלָ֖ם וְעַ֣ד הָעֹלָ֑ם וַיֹּאמְר֤וּ כׇל־הָעָם֙ אָמֵ֔ן וְהַלֵּ֖ל לַיהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: brvkh yhvh 'lhy yshr'l mnh'vlm v'd h'lm vy'mrv khlh'm 'mn vhll lyhvh {p}
verses.translation: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, From everlasting even to everlasting. And all the people said: ‘Amen, ‘and praised the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּעֲזׇב־שָׁ֗ם לִפְנֵי֙ אֲר֣וֹן בְּרִית־יְהֹוָ֔ה לְאָסָ֖ף וּלְאֶחָ֑יו לְשָׁרֵ֞ת לִפְנֵ֧י הָאָר֛וֹן תָּמִ֖יד לִדְבַר־י֥וֹם בְּיוֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vy'zbshm lpny 'rvn brytyhvh l'sf vl'chyv lshrt lpny h'rvn tmyd ldbryvm byvmv
verses.translation: So he left there, before the ark of the covenant of the LORD, Asaph and his brethren, to minister before the ark continually, as every day’s work required;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעֹבֵ֥ד אֱדֹ֛ם וַאֲחֵיהֶ֖ם שִׁשִּׁ֣ים וּשְׁמוֹנָ֑ה {ס} וְעֹבֵ֨ד אֱדֹ֧ם בֶּן־יְדִית֛וּן וְחֹסָ֖ה לְשֹׁעֲרִֽים׃
verses.translit: v'bd 'dm v'chyhm shshym vshmvnh {s} v'bd 'dm bnydytvn vchsh lsh'rym
verses.translation: and Obed-edom with their brethren, threescore and eight; Obed-edom also the son of Jedithun and Hosah to be door-keepers;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֣ת  צָד֣וֹק הַכֹּהֵ֗ן וְאֶחָיו֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים לִפְנֵ֖י מִשְׁכַּ֣ן יְהֹוָ֑ה בַּבָּמָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּגִבְעֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: v't  tsdvq hkhhn v'chyv hkhhnym lpny mshkhn yhvh bbmh 'shr bgb'vn
verses.translation: and Zadok the priest, and his brethren the priests, before the tabernacle of the LORD in the high place that was at Gibeon,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְֽהַעֲלוֹת֩ עֹל֨וֹת לַיהֹוָ֜ה עַל־מִזְבַּ֧ח הָעֹלָ֛ה תָּמִ֖יד לַבֹּ֣קֶר וְלָעָ֑רֶב וּלְכׇל־הַכָּתוּב֙ בְּתוֹרַ֣ת יְהֹוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֖ה עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: lh'lvt 'lvt lyhvh 'lmzbch h'lh tmyd lbqr vl'rb vlkhlhkhtvb btvrt yhvh 'shr tsvh 'lyshr'l
verses.translation: to offer burnt-offerings unto the LORD upon the altar of burnt-offering continually morning and evening, even according to all that is written in the Law of the LORD, which He commanded unto Israel;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעִמָּהֶם֙ הֵימָ֣ן וִידוּת֔וּן וּשְׁאָר֙ הַבְּרוּרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִקְּב֖וּ בְּשֵׁמ֑וֹת לְהֹדוֹת֙ לַֽיהֹוָ֔ה כִּ֥י לְעוֹלָ֖ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'mhm hymn vydvtvn vsh'r hbrvrym 'shr nqbv bshmvt lhdvt lyhvh khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: and with them Heman and Jeduthun, and the rest that were chosen, who were mentioned by name, to give thanks to the LORD, because His mercy endureth for ever;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעִמָּהֶם֩ הֵימָ֨ן וִידוּת֜וּן חֲצֹצְר֤וֹת וּמְצִלְתַּ֙יִם֙ לְמַשְׁמִיעִ֔ים וּכְלֵ֖י שִׁ֣יר הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וּבְנֵ֥י יְדוּת֖וּן לַשָּֽׁעַר׃
verses.translit: v'mhm hymn vydvtvn chtstsrvt vmtsltym lmshmy'ym vkhly shyr h'lhym vbny ydvtvn lsh'r
verses.translation: and with them Heman and Jeduthun, to sound aloud with trumpets and cymbals, and with instruments for the songs of God; and the sons of Jeduthun to be at the gate.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּלְכ֥וּ כׇל־הָעָ֖ם אִ֣ישׁ לְבֵית֑וֹ וַיִּסֹּ֥ב דָּוִ֖יד לְבָרֵ֥ךְ אֶת־בֵּיתֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vylkhv khlh'm 'ysh lbytv vysb dvyd lbrkh 'tbytv {p}
verses.translation: And all the people departed every man to his house; and David returned to bless his house.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֕י כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר יָשַׁ֥ב דָּוִ֖יד בְּבֵית֑וֹ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֜יד אֶל־נָתָ֣ן הַנָּבִ֗יא הִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֤י יוֹשֵׁב֙ בְּבֵ֣ית הָאֲרָזִ֔ים וַאֲר֥וֹן בְּרִית־יְהֹוָ֖ה תַּ֥חַת יְרִיעֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vyhy kh'shr yshb dvyd bbytv vy'mr dvyd 'lntn hnby' hnh 'nkhy yvshb bbyt h'rzym v'rvn brytyhvh tcht yry'vt
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when David dwelt in his house, that David said to Nathan the prophet: ‘Lo, I dwell in a house of cedar, but the ark of the covenant of the LORD dwelleth under curtains.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר נָתָן֙ אֶל־דָּוִ֔יד כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּֽלְבָבְךָ֖ עֲשֵׂ֑ה כִּ֥י הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים עִמָּֽךְ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vy'mr ntn 'ldvyd khl 'shr blbbkh 'shh khy h'lhym 'mkh {s}
verses.translation: And Nathan said unto David: ‘Do all that is in thy heart; for God is with thee.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֖י בַּלַּ֣יְלָה הַה֑וּא וַֽיְהִי֙ דְּבַר־אֱלֹהִ֔ים אֶל־נָתָ֖ן לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyhy blylh hhv' vyhy dbr'lhym 'lntn l'mr
verses.translation: And it came to pass the same night, that the word of God came to Nathan, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֵ֤ךְ וְאָֽמַרְתָּ֙ אֶל־דָּוִ֣יד עַבְדִּ֔י כֹּ֖ה אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֑ה לֹ֥א אַתָּ֛ה תִּבְנֶה־לִּ֥י הַבַּ֖יִת לָשָֽׁבֶת׃
verses.translit: lkh v'mrt 'ldvyd 'bdy khh 'mr yhvh l' 'th tbnhly hbyt lshbt
verses.translation: ’Go and tell David My servant: Thus saith the LORD: Thou shalt not build Me a house to dwell in;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י לֹ֤א יָשַׁ֙בְתִּי֙ בְּבַ֔יִת מִן־הַיּ֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֤ר הֶעֱלֵ֙יתִי֙ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עַ֖ד הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה וָאֶהְיֶ֛ה מֵאֹ֥הֶל אֶל־אֹ֖הֶל וּמִמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃
verses.translit: khy l' yshbty bbyt mnhyvm 'shr h'lyty 'tyshr'l 'd hyvm hzh v'hyh m'hl 'l'hl vmmshkhn
verses.translation: for I have not dwelt in a house since the day that I brought up Israel, unto this day; but have [gone] from tent to tent, and from one tabernacle [to another[.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶֽׁר־הִתְהַלַּ֘כְתִּי֮ בְּכׇל־יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ הֲדָבָ֣ר דִּבַּ֗רְתִּי אֶת־אַחַד֙ שֹׁפְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּ֛יתִי לִרְע֥וֹת אֶת־עַמִּ֖י לֵאמֹ֑ר לָ֛מָּה לֹא־בְנִיתֶ֥ם לִ֖י בֵּ֥ית אֲרָזִֽים׃
verses.translit: bkhl 'shrhthlkhty bkhlyshr'l hdbr dbrty 't'chd shpty yshr'l 'shr tsvyty lr'vt 't'my l'mr lmh l'bnytm ly byt 'rzym
verses.translation: In all places wherein I have walked among all Israel, spoke I a word with any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to feed My people, saying: Why have ye not built Me a house of cedar?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֠עַתָּ֠ה כֹּֽה־תֹאמַ֞ר לְעַבְדִּ֣י לְדָוִ֗יד {ס} כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת אֲנִ֤י לְקַחְתִּ֙יךָ֙ מִן־הַנָּוֶ֔ה מִֽן־אַחֲרֵ֖י הַצֹּ֑אן לִֽהְי֣וֹת נָגִ֔יד עַ֖ל עַמִּ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: v'th khht'mr l'bdy ldvyd {s} khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'ny lqchtykh mnhnvh mn'chry hts'n lhyvt ngyd 'l 'my yshr'l
verses.translation: Now therefore thus shalt thou say unto My servant David: Thus saith the LORD of hosts: I took thee from the sheepcote, from following the sheep, that thou shouldest be prince over My people Israel;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֶהְיֶ֣ה עִמְּךָ֗ בְּכֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָלַ֔כְתָּ וָאַכְרִ֥ית אֶת־כׇּל־אוֹיְבֶ֖יךָ מִפָּנֶ֑יךָ וְעָשִׂ֤יתִֽי לְךָ֙ שֵׁ֔ם כְּשֵׁ֥ם הַגְּדוֹלִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: v'hyh 'mkh bkhl 'shr hlkht v'khryt 'tkhl'vybykh mpnykh v'shyty lkh shm khshm hgdvlym 'shr b'rts
verses.translation: and I have been with thee whithersoever thou wentest, and have cut off all thine enemies from before thee; and I will make thee a name, like unto the name of the great ones that are in the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשַׂמְתִּ֣י מָ֠ק֠וֹם לְעַמִּ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל וּנְטַעְתִּ֙יהוּ֙ וְשָׁכַ֣ן תַּחְתָּ֔יו וְלֹ֥א יִרְגַּ֖ז ע֑וֹד וְלֹֽא־יוֹסִ֤יפוּ בְנֵֽי־עַוְלָה֙ לְבַלֹּת֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר בָּרִאשׁוֹנָֽה׃
verses.translit: vshmty mqvm l'my yshr'l vnt'tyhv vshkhn tchtyv vl' yrgz 'vd vl'yvsypv bny'vlh lbltv kh'shr br'shvnh
verses.translation: And I will appoint a place for My people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in their own place, and be disquieted no more; neither shall the children of wickedness waste them any more, as at the first,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְמִיָּמִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוִּ֤יתִי שֹֽׁפְטִים֙ עַל־עַמִּ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְהִכְנַ֖עְתִּי אֶת־כׇּל־אוֹיְבֶ֑יךָ וָאַגִּ֣ד לָ֔ךְ וּבַ֖יִת יִֽבְנֶה־לְּךָ֥ יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vlmymym 'shr tsvyty shptym 'l'my yshr'l vhkhn'ty 'tkhl'vybykh v'gd lkh vbyt ybnhlkh yhvh
verses.translation: even from the day that I commanded judges to be over My people Israel; and I will subdue all thine enemies. Moreover I tell thee that the LORD will build thee a house.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה כִּֽי־מָלְא֤וּ יָמֶ֙יךָ֙ לָלֶ֣כֶת עִם־אֲבֹתֶ֔יךָ וַהֲקִימוֹתִ֤י אֶֽת־זַרְעֲךָ֙ אַחֲרֶ֔יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִהְיֶ֖ה מִבָּנֶ֑יךָ וַהֲכִינוֹתִ֖י אֶת־מַלְכוּתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vhyh khyml'v ymykh llkht 'm'btykh vhqymvty 'tzr'kh 'chrykh 'shr yhyh mbnykh vhkhynvty 'tmlkhvtv
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, when thy days are fulfilled that thou must go to be with thy fathers, that I will set up thy seed after thee, who shall be of thy sons; and I will establish his kingdom.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֥וּא יִבְנֶה־לִּ֖י בָּ֑יִת וְכֹנַנְתִּ֥י אֶת־כִּסְא֖וֹ עַד־עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: hv' ybnhly byt vkhnnty 'tkhs'v 'd'vlm
verses.translation: He shall build Me a house, and I will establish his throne for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲנִי֙ אֶֽהְיֶה־לּ֣וֹ לְאָ֔ב וְה֖וּא יִֽהְיֶה־לִּ֣י לְבֵ֑ן וְחַסְדִּי֙ לֹא־אָסִ֣יר מֵעִמּ֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר הֲסִיר֔וֹתִי מֵאֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיָ֖ה לְפָנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: 'ny 'hyhlv l'b vhv' yhyhly lbn vchsdy l''syr m'mv kh'shr hsyrvty m'shr hyh lpnykh
verses.translation: I will be to him for a father, and he shall be to Me for a son; and I will not take My mercy away from him, as I took it from him that was before thee;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַעֲמַדְתִּ֛יהוּ בְּבֵיתִ֥י וּבְמַלְכוּתִ֖י עַד־הָעוֹלָ֑ם וְכִסְא֕וֹ יִהְיֶ֥ה נָכ֖וֹן עַד־עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: vh'mdtyhv bbyty vbmlkhvty 'dh'vlm vkhs'v yhyh nkhvn 'd'vlm
verses.translation: but I will settle him in My house and in My kingdom for ever; and his throne shall be established for ever.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּכֹל֙ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה וּכְכֹ֖ל הֶחָז֣וֹן הַזֶּ֑ה כֵּ֛ן דִּבֶּ֥ר נָתָ֖ן אֶל־דָּוִֽיד׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khkhl hdbrym h'lh vkhkhl hchzvn hzh khn dbr ntn 'ldvyd {p}
verses.translation: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so did Nathan speak unto David.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹא֙ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֔יד וַיֵּ֖שֶׁב לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה וַיֹּ֗אמֶר מִֽי־אֲנִ֞י יְהֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹהִים֙ וּמִ֣י בֵיתִ֔י כִּ֥י הֲבִיאֹתַ֖נִי עַד־הֲלֹֽם׃
verses.translit: vyb' hmlkh dvyd vyshb lpny yhvh vy'mr my'ny yhvh 'lhym vmy byty khy hby'tny 'dhlm
verses.translation: Then David the king went in, and sat before the LORD; and he said: ‘Who am I, O LORD God, and what is my house, that Thou hast brought me thus far?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּקְטַ֨ן זֹ֤את בְּעֵינֶ֙יךָ֙ אֱלֹהִ֔ים וַתְּדַבֵּ֥ר עַל־בֵּֽית־עַבְדְּךָ֖ לְמֵרָח֑וֹק וּרְאִיתַ֗נִי כְּת֧וֹר הָאָדָ֛ם הַֽמַּעֲלָ֖ה יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: vtqtn z't b'ynykh 'lhym vtdbr 'lbyt'bdkh lmrchvq vr'ytny khtvr h'dm hm'lh yhvh 'lhym
verses.translation: And this was a small thing in Thine eyes, O God; but Thou hast spoken of Thy servant’s house for a great while to come, and hast regarded me after the manner of a man of high degree, O LORD God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַה־יּוֹסִ֨יף ע֥וֹד דָּוִ֛יד אֵלֶ֖יךָ לְכָב֣וֹד אֶת־עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ וְאַתָּ֖ה אֶֽת־עַבְדְּךָ֥ יָדָֽעְתָּ׃
verses.translit: mhyvsyf 'vd dvyd 'lykh lkhbvd 't'bdkh v'th 't'bdkh yd't
verses.translation: What can David say yet more unto Thee concerning the honour which is done to Thy servant? for Thou knowest Thy servant.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֕ה בַּעֲב֤וּר עַבְדְּךָ֙ וּֽכְלִבְּךָ֔ עָשִׂ֕יתָ אֵ֥ת כׇּל־הַגְּדוּלָּ֖ה הַזֹּ֑את לְהֹדִ֖יעַ אֶת־כׇּל־הַגְּדֻלּֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: yhvh b'bvr 'bdkh vkhlbkh 'shyt 't khlhgdvlh hz't lhdy' 'tkhlhgdlvt
verses.translation: O LORD, for Thy servant’s sake, and according to Thine own heart, hast Thou wrought all this greatness, to make known all these great things.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָה֙ אֵ֣ין כָּמ֔וֹךָ וְאֵ֥ין אֱלֹהִ֖ים זוּלָתֶ֑ךָ בְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־שָׁמַ֖עְנוּ בְּאׇזְנֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: yhvh 'yn khmvkh v'yn 'lhym zvltkh bkhl 'shrshm'nv b'znynv
verses.translation: O LORD, there is none like Thee, neither is there any God beside Thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִי֙ כְּעַמְּךָ֣ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל גּ֥וֹי אֶחָ֖ד בָּאָ֑רֶץ אֲשֶׁר֩ הָלַ֨ךְ הָאֱלֹהִ֜ים לִפְדּ֧וֹת ל֣וֹ עָ֗ם לָשׂ֤וּם לְךָ֙ שֵׁ֚ם גְּדֻלּ֣וֹת וְנֹרָא֔וֹת לְגָרֵ֗שׁ מִפְּנֵ֧י עַמְּךָ֛ אֲשֶׁר־פָּדִ֥יתָ מִמִּצְרַ֖יִם גּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.translit: vmy kh'mkh yshr'l gvy 'chd b'rts 'shr hlkh h'lhym lpdvt lv 'm lshvm lkh shm gdlvt vnr'vt lgrsh mpny 'mkh 'shrpdyt mmtsrym gvym
verses.translation: And who is like Thy people Israel, a nation one in the earth, whom God went to redeem unto Himself for a people, to make Thee a name by great and tremendous things, in driving out nations from before Thy people, whom Thou didst redeem out of Egypt.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֠תִּתֵּ֠ן אֶת־עַמְּךָ֨ יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל ׀ לְךָ֛ לְעָ֖ם עַד־עוֹלָ֑ם וְאַתָּ֣ה יְהֹוָ֔ה הָיִ֥יתָ לָהֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: vttn 't'mkh yshr'l  lkh l'm 'd'vlm v'th yhvh hyyt lhm l'lhym
verses.translation: For Thy people Israel didst Thou make Thine own people for ever; and Thou, LORD, becamest their God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֣ה יְהֹוָ֔ה הַדָּבָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבַּ֤רְתָּ עַֽל־עַבְדְּךָ֙ וְעַל־בֵּית֔וֹ יֵאָמֵ֖ן עַד־עוֹלָ֑ם וַעֲשֵׂ֖ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּֽרְתָּ׃
verses.translit: v'th yhvh hdbr 'shr dbrt 'l'bdkh v'lbytv y'mn 'd'vlm v'shh kh'shr dbrt
verses.translation: And now, O LORD, let the word that Thou hast spoken concerning Thy servant, and concerning his house, be established for ever, and do as Thou hast spoken.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֠יֵאָמֵ֠ן וְיִגְדַּ֨ל שִׁמְךָ֤ עַד־עוֹלָם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר יְהֹוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֱלֹהִ֖ים לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּבֵית־דָּוִ֥יד עַבְדְּךָ֖ נָכ֥וֹן לְפָנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: vy'mn vygdl shmkh 'd'vlm l'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l 'lhym lyshr'l vbytdvyd 'bdkh nkhvn lpnykh
verses.translation: Yea, let it be established, and let Thy name be magnified for ever, that it may be said: The LORD of hosts is the God of Israel, even a God to Israel; and the house of David Thy servant shall be established before Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י  אַתָּ֣ה אֱלֹהַ֗י גָּלִ֙יתָ֙ אֶת־אֹ֣זֶן עַבְדְּךָ֔ לִבְנ֥וֹת ל֖וֹ בָּ֑יִת עַל־כֵּן֙ מָצָ֣א עַבְדְּךָ֔ לְהִתְפַּלֵּ֖ל לְפָנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: khy  'th 'lhy glyt 't'zn 'bdkh lbnvt lv byt 'lkhn mts' 'bdkh lhtpll lpnykh
verses.translation: For Thou, O my God, hast revealed to Thy servant that Thou wilt build him a house; therefore hath Thy servant taken heart to pray before Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֣ה יְהֹוָ֔ה אַתָּה־ה֖וּא הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וַתְּדַבֵּר֙ עַֽל־עַבְדְּךָ֔ הַטּוֹבָ֖ה הַזֹּֽאת׃
verses.translit: v'th yhvh 'thhv' h'lhym vtdbr 'l'bdkh htvbh hz't
verses.translation: And now, O LORD, Thou alone art God, and hast promised this good thing unto Thy servant;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה הוֹאַ֙לְתָּ֙ לְבָרֵךְ֙ אֶת־בֵּ֣ית עַבְדְּךָ֔ לִֽהְי֥וֹת לְעוֹלָ֖ם לְפָנֶ֑יךָ כִּֽי־אַתָּ֤ה יְהֹוָה֙ בֵּרַ֔כְתָּ וּמְבֹרָ֖ךְ לְעוֹלָֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'th hv'lt lbrkh 'tbyt 'bdkh lhyvt l'vlm lpnykh khy'th yhvh brkht vmbrkh l'vlm {p}
verses.translation: and now it hath pleased Thee to bless the house of Thy servant, that it may continue for ever before Thee; for Thou, O LORD, hast blessed, and so let [Thy servant] be blessed for ever.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ אַֽחֲרֵי־כֵ֔ן וַיַּ֥ךְ דָּוִ֛יד אֶת־פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים וַיַּכְנִיעֵ֑ם וַיִּקַּ֛ח אֶת־גַּ֥ת וּבְנֹתֶ֖יהָ מִיַּ֥ד פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים׃
verses.translit: vyhy 'chrykhn vykh dvyd 'tplshtym vykhny'm vyqch 'tgt vbntyh myd plshtym
verses.translation: And after this it came to pass, that David smote the Philistines, and subdued them, and took Gath and its towns out of the hand of the Philistines.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֖ךְ אֶת־מוֹאָ֑ב וַיִּהְי֤וּ מוֹאָב֙ עֲבָדִ֣ים לְדָוִ֔יד נֹשְׂאֵ֖י מִנְחָֽה׃
verses.translit: vykh 'tmv'b vyhyv mv'b 'bdym ldvyd nsh'y mnchh
verses.translation: And he smote Moab; and the Moabites became servants to David, and brought presents.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֥ךְ דָּוִ֛יד אֶת־הֲדַדְעֶ֥זֶר מֶלֶךְ־צוֹבָ֖ה חֲמָ֑תָה בְּלֶכְתּ֕וֹ לְהַצִּ֥יב יָד֖וֹ בִּֽנְהַר־פְּרָֽת׃
verses.translit: vykh dvyd 'thdd'zr mlkhtsvbh chmth blkhtv lhtsyb ydv bnhrprt
verses.translation: And David smote Hadarezer king of Zobah by Hamath, as he went to establish his dominion at the river Euphrates.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּלְכֹּד֩ דָּוִ֨יד מִמֶּ֜נּוּ אֶ֣לֶף רֶ֗כֶב וְשִׁבְעַ֤ת אֲלָפִים֙ פָּרָשִׁ֔ים וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף אִ֣ישׁ רַגְלִ֑י וַיְעַקֵּ֤ר דָּוִיד֙ אֶת־כׇּל־הָרֶ֔כֶב וַיּוֹתֵ֥ר מִמֶּ֖נּוּ מֵ֥אָה רָֽכֶב׃
verses.translit: vylkhd dvyd mmnv 'lf rkhb vshb't 'lpym prshym v'shrym 'lf 'ysh rgly vy'qr dvyd 'tkhlhrkhb vyvtr mmnv m'h rkhb
verses.translation: And David took from him a thousand chariots, and seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen; and David houghed all the chariot horses, but reserved of them for a hundred chariots.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹא֙ אֲרַ֣ם דַּרְמֶ֔שֶׂק לַעְז֕וֹר לַהֲדַדְעֶ֖זֶר מֶ֣לֶךְ צוֹבָ֑ה וַיַּ֤ךְ דָּוִיד֙ בַּאֲרָ֔ם עֶשְׂרִֽים־וּשְׁנַ֥יִם אֶ֖לֶף אִֽישׁ׃
verses.translit: vyb' 'rm drmshq l'zvr lhdd'zr mlkh tsvbh vykh dvyd b'rm 'shrymvshnym 'lf 'ysh
verses.translation: And when the Arameans of Damascus came to succour Hadarezer king of Zobah, David smote of the Arameans two and twenty thousand men.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֤שֶׂם דָּוִיד֙ בַּאֲרַ֣ם דַּרְמֶ֔שֶׂק וַיְהִ֤י אֲרָם֙ לְדָוִ֔יד עֲבָדִ֖ים נֹשְׂאֵ֣י מִנְחָ֑ה וַיּ֤וֹשַׁע יְהֹוָה֙ לְדָוִ֔יד בְּכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָלָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vyshm dvyd b'rm drmshq vyhy 'rm ldvyd 'bdym nsh'y mnchh vyvsh' yhvh ldvyd bkhl 'shr hlkh
verses.translation: Then David put [garrisons] in Aram Damascus; and the Arameans became servants to David, and brought presents. And the LORD gave victory to David whithersoever he went.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֣ח דָּוִ֗יד אֵ֚ת שִׁלְטֵ֣י הַזָּהָ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָי֔וּ עַ֖ל עַבְדֵ֣י הֲדַדְעָ֑זֶר וַיְבִיאֵ֖ם יְרוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: vyqch dvyd 't shlty hzhb 'shr hyv 'l 'bdy hdd'zr vyby'm yrvshl͏m
verses.translation: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadarezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִטִּבְחַ֤ת וּמִכּוּן֙ עָרֵ֣י הֲדַדְעֶ֔זֶר לָקַ֥ח דָּוִ֛יד נְחֹ֖שֶׁת רַבָּ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד בָּ֣הּ  עָשָׂ֣ה שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה אֶת־יָ֤ם הַנְּחֹ֙שֶׁת֙ וְאֶת־הָֽעַמּוּדִ֔ים וְאֵ֖ת כְּלֵ֥י הַנְּחֹֽשֶׁת׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vmtbcht vmkhvn 'ry hdd'zr lqch dvyd nchsht rbh m'd bh  'shh shlmh 'tym hnchsht v'th'mvdym v't khly hnchsht {p}
verses.translation: And from Tibhath and from Cun, cities of Hadarezer, David took very much brass, wherewith Solomon made the brazen sea, and the pillars, and the vessels of brass.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֕ע תֹּ֖עוּ מֶ֣לֶךְ חֲמָ֑ת כִּ֚י הִכָּ֣ה דָוִ֔יד אֶת־כׇּל־חֵ֖יל הֲדַדְעֶ֥זֶר מֶלֶךְ־צוֹבָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyshm' t'v mlkh chmt khy hkhh dvyd 'tkhlchyl hdd'zr mlkhtsvbh
verses.translation: And when Tou king of Hamath heard that David had smitten all the host of Hadarezer king of Zobah,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח אֶת־הֲדֽוֹרָם־בְּנ֣וֹ אֶל־הַמֶּֽלֶךְ־דָּ֠וִ֠יד (לשאול) [לִשְׁאׇל־]ל֨וֹ לְשָׁל֜וֹם וּֽלְבָרְכ֗וֹ עַל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִלְחַ֤ם בַּהֲדַדְעֶ֙זֶר֙ וַיַּכֵּ֔הוּ כִּי־אִ֛ישׁ מִלְחֲמ֥וֹת תֹּ֖עוּ הָיָ֣ה הֲדַדְעָ֑זֶר וְכֹ֗ל כְּלֵ֛י זָהָ֥ב וָכֶ֖סֶף וּנְחֹֽשֶׁת׃
verses.translit: vyshlch 'thdvrmbnv 'lhmlkhdvyd (lsh'vl) [lsh'l]lv lshlvm vlbrkhv 'l 'shr nlchm bhdd'zr vykhhv khy'ysh mlchmvt t'v hyh hdd'zr vkhl khly zhb vkhsf vnchsht
verses.translation: he sent Hadoram his son to king David, to salute him, and to bless him—because he had fought against Hadarezer and smitten him; for Hadarezer had wars with Tou—and [he had with him] all manner of vessels of gold and silver and brass.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּם־אֹתָ֗ם הִקְדִּ֞ישׁ הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ דָּוִיד֙ לַֽיהֹוָ֔ה עִם־הַכֶּ֙סֶף֙ וְהַזָּהָ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָשָׂ֖א מִכׇּל־הַגּוֹיִ֑ם מֵאֱד֤וֹם וּמִמּוֹאָב֙ וּמִבְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן וּמִפְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים וּמֵעֲמָלֵֽק׃
verses.translit: gm'tm hqdysh hmlkh dvyd lyhvh 'mhkhsf vhzhb 'shr nsh' mkhlhgvym m'dvm vmmv'b vmbny 'mvn vmplshtym vm'mlq
verses.translation: These also did king David dedicate unto the LORD, with the silver and the gold that he carried away from all the nations; from Edom, and from Moab, and from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines, and from Amalek.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַבְשַׁ֣י בֶּן־צְרוּיָ֗ה הִכָּ֤ה אֶת־אֱדוֹם֙ בְּגֵ֣יא הַמֶּ֔לַח שְׁמוֹנָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר אָֽלֶף׃
verses.translit: v'bshy bntsrvyh hkhh 't'dvm bgy' hmlch shmvnh 'shr 'lf
verses.translation: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah smote of the Edomites in the Valley of Salt eighteen thousand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֤שֶׂם בֶּאֱדוֹם֙ נְצִיבִ֔ים וַיִּהְי֥וּ כׇל־אֱד֖וֹם עֲבָדִ֣ים לְדָוִ֑יד וַיּ֤וֹשַׁע יְהֹוָה֙ אֶת־דָּוִ֔יד בְּכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָלָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vyshm b'dvm ntsybym vyhyv khl'dvm 'bdym ldvyd vyvsh' yhvh 'tdvyd bkhl 'shr hlkh
verses.translation: And he put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became servants to David. And the LORD gave victory to David whithersoever he went.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּמְלֹ֥ךְ דָּוִ֖יד עַל־כׇּל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיְהִ֗י עֹשֶׂ֛ה מִשְׁפָּ֥ט וּצְדָקָ֖ה לְכׇל־עַמּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vymlkh dvyd 'lkhlyshr'l vyhy 'shh mshpt vtsdqh lkhl'mv
verses.translation: And David reigned over all Israel; and he executed justice and righteousness unto all his people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיוֹאָ֥ב בֶּן־צְרוּיָ֖ה עַל־הַצָּבָ֑א וִיהוֹשָׁפָ֥ט בֶּן־אֲחִיל֖וּד מַזְכִּֽיר׃
verses.translit: vyv'b bntsrvyh 'lhtsb' vyhvshpt bn'chylvd mzkhyr
verses.translation: And Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the host; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְצָד֧וֹק בֶּן־אֲחִיט֛וּב וַאֲבִימֶ֥לֶךְ בֶּן־אֶבְיָתָ֖ר כֹּהֲנִ֑ים וְשַׁוְשָׁ֖א סוֹפֵֽר׃
verses.translit: vtsdvq bn'chytvb v'bymlkh bn'bytr khhnym vshvsh' svpr
verses.translation: And Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Abimelech the son of Abiathar, were priests; and Shavsha was scribe;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנָיָ֙הוּ֙ בֶּן־יְה֣וֹיָדָ֔ע עַל־הַכְּרֵתִ֖י וְהַפְּלֵתִ֑י וּבְנֵי־דָוִ֥יד הָרִֽאשֹׁנִ֖ים לְיַ֥ד הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vbnyhv bnyhvyd' 'lhkhrty vhplty vbnydvyd hr'shnym lyd hmlkh {p}
verses.translation: and Beniah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David were chief about the king.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ אַחֲרֵי־כֵ֔ן וַיָּ֕מׇת נָחָ֖שׁ מֶ֣לֶךְ בְּנֵֽי־עַמּ֑וֹן וַיִּמְלֹ֥ךְ בְּנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃
verses.translit: vyhy 'chrykhn vymt nchsh mlkh bny'mvn vymlkh bnv tchtyv
verses.translation: And it came to pass after this, that Nahash the king of the children of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his stead.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֜יד אֶעֱשֶׂה־חֶ֣סֶד  עִם־חָנ֣וּן בֶּן־נָחָ֗שׁ כִּֽי־עָשָׂ֨ה אָבִ֤יו עִמִּי֙ חֶ֔סֶד וַיִּשְׁלַ֥ח דָּוִ֛יד מַלְאָכִ֖ים לְנַחֲמ֣וֹ עַל־אָבִ֑יו וַיָּבֹ֩אוּ֩ עַבְדֵ֨י דָוִ֜יד אֶל־אֶ֧רֶץ בְּנֵֽי־עַמּ֛וֹן אֶל־חָנ֖וּן לְנַחֲמֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr dvyd ''shhchsd  'mchnvn bnnchsh khy'shh 'byv 'my chsd vyshlch dvyd ml'khym lnchmv 'l'byv vyb'v 'bdy dvyd 'l'rts bny'mvn 'lchnvn lnchmv
verses.translation: And David said: ‘l will show kindness unto Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father showed kindness to me.’ So David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. And David’s servants came into the land of the children of Ammon to Hanun, to comfort him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְרוּ֩ שָׂרֵ֨י בְנֵי־עַמּ֜וֹן לְחָנ֗וּן הַֽמְכַבֵּ֨ד דָּוִ֤יד אֶת־אָבִ֙יךָ֙ בְּעֵינֶ֔יךָ כִּֽי־שָׁלַ֥ח לְךָ֖ מְנַחֲמִ֑ים הֲלֹ֡א בַּ֠עֲב֠וּר לַחְקֹ֨ר וְלַהֲפֹ֤ךְ וּלְרַגֵּל֙ הָאָ֔רֶץ בָּ֥אוּ עֲבָדָ֖יו אֵלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv shry bny'mvn lchnvn hmkhbd dvyd 't'bykh b'ynykh khyshlch lkh mnchmym hl' b'bvr lchqr vlhpkh vlrgl h'rts b'v 'bdyv 'lykh
verses.translation: But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun: ‘Thinkest thou that David doth honour thy father, that he hath sent comforters unto thee? are not his servants come unto thee to search, and to overthrow, and to spy out the land?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח חָנ֜וּן אֶת־עַבְדֵ֤י דָוִיד֙ וַֽיְגַלְּחֵ֔ם וַיִּכְרֹ֧ת אֶת־מַדְוֵיהֶ֛ם בַּחֵ֖צִי עַד־הַמִּפְשָׂעָ֑ה וַֽיְשַׁלְּחֵֽם׃
verses.translit: vyqch chnvn 't'bdy dvyd vyglchm vykhrt 'tmdvyhm bchtsy 'dhmpsh'h vyshlchm
verses.translation: So Hanun took David’s servants, and shaved them, and cut off their garments in the middle, even to their hips, and sent them away.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּלְכוּ֩ וַיַּגִּ֨ידוּ לְדָוִ֤יד עַל־הָֽאֲנָשִׁים֙ וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח לִקְרָאתָ֔ם כִּֽי־הָי֥וּ הָאֲנָשִׁ֖ים נִכְלָמִ֣ים מְאֹ֑ד וַיֹּ֤אמֶר הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ שְׁב֣וּ בִֽירֵח֔וֹ עַ֛ד אֲשֶׁר־יְצַמַּ֥ח זְקַנְכֶ֖ם וְשַׁבְתֶּֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vylkhv vygydv ldvyd 'lh'nshym vyshlch lqr'tm khyhyv h'nshym nkhlmym m'd vy'mr hmlkh shbv byrchv 'd 'shrytsmch zqnkhm vshbtm {s}
verses.translation: Then there went certain persons, and told David how the men were served. And he sent to meet them; for the men were greatly ashamed. And the king said: ‘Tarry at Jericho until your beards be grown, and then return.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּרְאוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן כִּ֥י הִֽתְבָּאֲשׁ֖וּ עִם־דָּוִ֑יד וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח חָ֠נ֠וּן וּבְנֵ֨י עַמּ֜וֹן אֶ֣לֶף כִּכַּר־כֶּ֗סֶף לִשְׂכֹּ֣ר לָ֠הֶ֠ם מִן־אֲרַ֨ם נַהֲרַ֜יִם וּמִן־אֲרַ֤ם מַֽעֲכָה֙ וּמִצּוֹבָ֔ה רֶ֖כֶב וּפָרָשִֽׁים׃
verses.translit: vyr'v bny 'mvn khy htb'shv 'mdvyd vyshlch chnvn vbny 'mvn 'lf khkhrkhsf lshkhr lhm mn'rm nhrym vmn'rm m'khh vmtsvbh rkhb vprshym
verses.translation: And when the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David, Hanun and the children of Ammon sent a thousand talents of silver to hire them chariots and horsemen out of Aram-naharaim, and out of Aram-maacah, and out of Zobah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׂכְּר֣וּ לָהֶ֡ם שְׁנַ֩יִם֩ וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֨ים אֶ֜לֶף רֶ֗כֶב וְאֶת־מֶ֤לֶךְ מַֽעֲכָה֙ וְאֶת־עַמּ֔וֹ וַיָּבֹ֕אוּ וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ לִפְנֵ֣י מֵֽידְבָ֑א {ס} וּבְנֵ֣י עַמּ֗וֹן נֶֽאֶסְפוּ֙ מֵעָ֣רֵיהֶ֔ם וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ לַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyshkhrv lhm shnym vshlshym 'lf rkhb v'tmlkh m'khh v't'mv vyb'v vychnv lpny mydb' {s} vbny 'mvn n'spv m'ryhm vyb'v lmlchmh {s}
verses.translation: So they hired them thirty and two thousand chariots, and the king of Maacah and his people; who came and encamped before Medeba. And the children of Ammon gathered themselves together from their cities, and came to battle.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֖ע דָּוִ֑יד וַיִּשְׁלַח֙ אֶת־יוֹאָ֔ב וְאֵ֥ת כׇּל־צָבָ֖א הַגִּבּוֹרִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyshm' dvyd vyshlch 'tyv'b v't khltsb' hgbvrym
verses.translation: And when David heard of it, he sent Joab, and all the host of the mighty men.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּֽצְאוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן וַיַּעַרְכ֥וּ מִלְחָמָ֖ה פֶּ֣תַח הָעִ֑יר וְהַמְּלָכִ֣ים אֲשֶׁר־בָּ֔אוּ לְבַדָּ֖ם בַּשָּׂדֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vyts'v bny 'mvn vy'rkhv mlchmh ptch h'yr vhmlkhym 'shrb'v lbdm bshdh
verses.translation: And the children of Ammon came out and put the battle in array at the gate of the city; and the kings that were come were by themselves in the field.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֣רְא יוֹאָ֗ב כִּֽי־הָיְתָ֧ה פְנֵֽי־הַמִּלְחָמָ֛ה אֵלָ֖יו פָּנִ֣ים וְאָח֑וֹר וַיִּבְחַ֗ר מִכׇּל־בָּחוּר֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַֽיַּעֲרֹ֖ךְ לִקְרַ֥את אֲרָֽם׃
verses.translit: vyr' yv'b khyhyth pnyhmlchmh 'lyv pnym v'chvr vybchr mkhlbchvr byshr'l vy'rkh lqr't 'rm
verses.translation: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose of all the choice men of Israel, and put them in array against the Arameans.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵת֙ יֶ֣תֶר הָעָ֔ם נָתַ֕ן בְּיַ֖ד אַבְשַׁ֣י אָחִ֑יו וַיַּ֣עַרְכ֔וּ לִקְרַ֖את בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: v't ytr h'm ntn byd 'bshy 'chyv vy'rkhv lqr't bny 'mvn
verses.translation: And the rest of the people he committed into the hand of Abishai his brother, and they put themselves in array against the children of Ammon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר אִם־תֶּחֱזַ֤ק מִמֶּ֙נִּי֙ אֲרָ֔ם וְהָיִ֥יתָ לִּ֖י לִתְשׁוּעָ֑ה {ס} וְאִם־בְּנֵ֥י עַמּ֛וֹן יֶחֶזְק֥וּ מִמְּךָ֖ וְהוֹשַׁעְתִּֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'mtchzq mmny 'rm vhyyt ly ltshv'h {s} v'mbny 'mvn ychzqv mmkh vhvsh'tykh
verses.translation: And he said: ‘If the Arameans be too strong for me, then thou shalt help me; but if the children of Ammon be too strong for thee, then I will help thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֲזַ֤ק וְנִֽתְחַזְּקָה֙ בְּעַד־עַמֵּ֔נוּ וּבְעַ֖ד עָרֵ֣י אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ וַֽיהֹוָ֔ה הַטּ֥וֹב בְּעֵינָ֖יו יַעֲשֶֽׂה׃
verses.translit: chzq vntchzqh b'd'mnv vb'd 'ry 'lhynv vyhvh htvb b'ynyv y'shh
verses.translation: Be of good courage, and let us prove strong for our people, and for the cities of our God; and the LORD do that which seemeth Him good.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּגַּ֨שׁ יוֹאָ֜ב וְהָעָ֧ם אֲשֶׁר־עִמּ֛וֹ לִפְנֵ֥י אֲרָ֖ם לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה וַיָּנ֖וּסוּ מִפָּנָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vygsh yv'b vh'm 'shr'mv lpny 'rm lmlchmh vynvsv mpnyv
verses.translation: So Joab and the people that were with him drew nigh unto the battle to meet the Arameans; and they fled before him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֨י עַמּ֤וֹן רָאוּ֙ כִּֽי־נָ֣ס אֲרָ֔ם וַיָּנ֣וּסוּ גַם־הֵ֗ם מִפְּנֵי֙ אַבְשַׁ֣י אָחִ֔יו וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ הָעִ֑ירָה וַיָּבֹ֥א יוֹאָ֖ב יְרוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vbny 'mvn r'v khyns 'rm vynvsv gmhm mpny 'bshy 'chyv vyb'v h'yrh vyb' yv'b yrvshl͏m {s}
verses.translation: And when the children of Ammon saw that the Arameans were fled, they likewise fled before Abishai his brother, and entered into the city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֣רְא אֲרָ֗ם כִּ֣י נִגְּפוּ֮ לִפְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וַֽיִּשְׁלְחוּ֙ מַלְאָכִ֔ים וַיּוֹצִ֣יאוּ אֶת־אֲרָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר מֵעֵ֣בֶר הַנָּהָ֑ר וְשׁוֹפַ֛ךְ שַׂר־צְבָ֥א הֲדַדְעֶ֖זֶר לִפְנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vyr' 'rm khy ngpv lpny yshr'l vyshlchv ml'khym vyvtsy'v 't'rm 'shr m'br hnhr vshvpkh shrtsb' hdd'zr lpnyhm
verses.translation: And when the Arameans saw that they were put to the worse before Israel, they sent messengers, and brought out the Arameans that were beyond the River, with Shophach the captain of the host of Hadarezer at their head.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֻּגַּ֣ד לְדָוִ֗יד וַיֶּאֱסֹ֤ף אֶת־כׇּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וַיַּעֲבֹ֣ר הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן וַיָּבֹ֣א אֲלֵהֶ֔ם וַֽיַּעֲרֹ֖ךְ אֲלֵהֶ֑ם וַיַּעֲרֹ֨ךְ דָּוִ֜יד לִקְרַ֤את אֲרָם֙ מִלְחָמָ֔ה וַיִּֽלָּחֲמ֖וּ עִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vygd ldvyd vy'sf 'tkhlyshr'l vy'br hyrdn vyb' 'lhm vy'rkh 'lhm vy'rkh dvyd lqr't 'rm mlchmh vylchmv 'mv
verses.translation: And it was told David; and he gathered all Israel together, and passed over the Jordan, and came upon them, and set the battle in array against them. So when David had put the battle in array against the Arameans, they fought with him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֣נׇס אֲרָם֮ מִלִּפְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וַיַּהֲרֹ֨ג דָּוִ֜יד מֵאֲרָ֗ם שִׁבְעַ֤ת אֲלָפִים֙ רֶ֔כֶב וְאַרְבָּעִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף אִ֣ישׁ רַגְלִ֑י וְאֵ֛ת שׁוֹפַ֥ךְ שַֽׂר־הַצָּבָ֖א הֵמִֽית׃
verses.translit: vyns 'rm mlpny yshr'l vyhrg dvyd m'rm shb't 'lpym rkhb v'rb'ym 'lf 'ysh rgly v't shvpkh shrhtsb' hmyt
verses.translation: And the Arameans fled before Israel; and David slew of the Arameans the men of seven thousand chariots, and forty thousand footmen, and killed Shophach the captain of the host.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּרְא֞וּ עַבְדֵ֣י הֲדַדְעֶ֗זֶר כִּ֤י נִגְּפוּ֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיַּשְׁלִ֥ימוּ עִם־דָּוִ֖יד וַיַּעַבְדֻ֑הוּ וְלֹֽא־אָבָ֣ה אֲרָ֔ם לְהוֹשִׁ֥יעַ אֶת־בְּנֵֽי־עַמּ֖וֹן עֽוֹד׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyr'v 'bdy hdd'zr khy ngpv lpny yshr'l vyshlymv 'mdvyd vy'bdhv vl''bh 'rm lhvshy' 'tbny'mvn 'vd {s}
verses.translation: And when the servants of Hadarezer saw that they were put to the worse before Israel, they made peace with David, and served him; neither would the Arameans help the children of Ammon any more.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֡י לְעֵת֩ תְּשׁוּבַ֨ת הַשָּׁנָ֜ה לְעֵ֣ת  צֵ֣את הַמְּלָכִ֗ים וַיִּנְהַ֣ג יוֹאָב֩ אֶת־חֵ֨יל הַצָּבָ֜א וַיַּשְׁחֵ֣ת  אֶת־אֶ֣רֶץ בְּנֵי־עַמּ֗וֹן וַיָּבֹא֙ וַיָּ֣צַר אֶת־רַבָּ֔ה וְדָוִ֖יד יֹשֵׁ֣ב בִּירוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם וַיַּ֥ךְ יוֹאָ֛ב אֶת־רַבָּ֖ה וַיֶּהֶרְסֶֽהָ׃
verses.translit: vyhy l't tshvbt hshnh l't  ts't hmlkhym vynhg yv'b 'tchyl htsb' vyshcht  't'rts bny'mvn vyb' vytsr 'trbh vdvyd yshb byrvshl͏m vykh yv'b 'trbh vyhrsh
verses.translation: And it came to pass, at the time of the return of the year, at the time when kings go out to battle, that Joab led forth the power of the army, and wasted the country of the children of Ammon, and came and besieged Rabbah. But David tarried at Jerusalem. And Joab smote Rabbah, and overthrew it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֣ח דָּוִ֣יד אֶת־עֲטֶֽרֶת־מַלְכָּם֩ מֵעַ֨ל רֹאשׁ֜וֹ וַֽיִּמְצָאָ֣הּ  מִשְׁקַ֣ל כִּכַּר־זָהָ֗ב וּבָהּ֙ אֶ֣בֶן יְקָרָ֔ה וַתְּהִ֖י עַל־רֹ֣אשׁ דָּוִ֑יד וּשְׁלַ֥ל הָעִ֛יר הוֹצִ֖יא הַרְבֵּ֥ה מְאֹֽד׃
verses.translit: vyqch dvyd 't'trtmlkhm m'l r'shv vymts'h  mshql khkhrzhb vbh 'bn yqrh vthy 'lr'sh dvyd vshll h'yr hvtsy' hrbh m'd
verses.translation: And David took the crown of Malcam from off his head, and found it to weigh a talent of gold, and there were precious stones in it; and it was set upon David’s head; and he brought forth the spoil of the city, exceeding much.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־הָעָ֨ם אֲשֶׁר־בָּ֜הּ הוֹצִ֗יא וַיָּ֨שַׂר בַּמְּגֵרָ֜ה וּבַחֲרִיצֵ֤י הַבַּרְזֶל֙ וּבַמְּגֵר֔וֹת וְכֵן֙ יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה דָוִ֔יד לְכֹ֖ל עָרֵ֣י בְנֵי־עַמּ֑וֹן וַיָּ֧שׇׁב דָּוִ֛יד וְכׇל־הָעָ֖ם יְרוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'th'm 'shrbh hvtsy' vyshr bmgrh vbchrytsy hbrzl vbmgrvt vkhn y'shh dvyd lkhl 'ry bny'mvn vyshb dvyd vkhlh'm yrvshl͏m {s}
verses.translation: And he brought forth the people that were therein, and cut them with saws, and with harrows of iron, and with axes. And thus did David unto all the cities of the children of Ammon. And David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ אַחֲרֵי־כֵ֔ן וַתַּעֲמֹ֧ד מִלְחָמָ֛ה בְּגֶ֖זֶר עִם־פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים אָ֣ז הִכָּ֞ה סִבְּכַ֣י הַחֻשָׁתִ֗י אֶת־סִפַּ֛י מִילִידֵ֥י הָרְפָאִ֖ים וַיִּכָּנֵֽעוּ׃
verses.translit: vyhy 'chrykhn vt'md mlchmh bgzr 'mplshtym 'z hkhh sbkhy hchshty 'tspy mylydy hrp'ym vykhn'v
verses.translation: And it came to pass after this, that there arose war at Gezer with the Philistines; then Sibbecai the Hushathite slew Sippai, of the sons of the giants; and they were subdued.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתְּהִי־ע֥וֹד מִלְחָמָ֖ה אֶת־פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וַיַּ֞ךְ אֶלְחָנָ֣ן בֶּן־[יָעִ֗יר] (יעור) אֶת־לַחְמִי֙ אֲחִי֙ גׇּלְיָ֣ת הַגִּתִּ֔י וְעֵ֣ץ חֲנִית֔וֹ כִּמְנ֖וֹר אֹרְגִֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vthy'vd mlchmh 'tplshtym vykh 'lchnn bn[y'yr] (y'vr) 'tlchmy 'chy glyt hgty v'ts chnytv khmnvr 'rgym {s}
verses.translation: And there was again war with the Philistines; and Elhanan the son of Jair slew Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתְּהִי־ע֥וֹד מִלְחָמָ֖ה בְּגַ֑ת וַיְהִ֣י  אִ֣ישׁ מִדָּ֗ה וְאֶצְבְּעֹתָ֤יו שֵׁשׁ־וָשֵׁשׁ֙ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים וְאַרְבַּ֔ע וְגַם־ה֖וּא נוֹלַ֥ד לְהָרָפָֽא׃
verses.translit: vthy'vd mlchmh bgt vyhy  'ysh mdh v'tsb'tyv shshvshsh 'shrym v'rb' vgmhv' nvld lhrp'
verses.translation: And there was again war at Gath, where was a man of great stature, whose fingers and toes were four and twenty, six [on each hand], and six [on each foot]; and he also was born unto the giant.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְחָרֵ֖ף אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיַּכֵּ֙הוּ֙ יְה֣וֹנָתָ֔ן בֶּן־שִׁמְעָ֖א אֲחִ֥י דָוִֽיד׃
verses.translit: vychrf 'tyshr'l vykhhv yhvntn bnshm'' 'chy dvyd
verses.translation: And when he taunted Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea David’s brother slew him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֛ל נוּלְּד֥וּ לְהָרָפָ֖א בְּגַ֑ת וַיִּפְּל֥וּ בְיַד־דָּוִ֖יד וּבְיַד־עֲבָדָֽיו׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'l nvldv lhrp' bgt vyplv byddvyd vbyd'bdyv {p}
verses.translation: These were born unto the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּעֲמֹ֥ד שָׂטָ֖ן עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיָּ֙סֶת֙ אֶת־דָּוִ֔יד לִמְנ֖וֹת אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vy'md shtn 'lyshr'l vyst 'tdvyd lmnvt 'tyshr'l
verses.translation: And Satan stood up against Israel, and moved David to number Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֤יד אֶל־יוֹאָב֙ וְאֶל־שָׂרֵ֣י הָעָ֔ם לְכ֗וּ סִפְרוּ֙ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִבְּאֵ֥ר שֶׁ֖בַע וְעַד־דָּ֑ן וְהָבִ֣יאוּ אֵלַ֔י וְאֵדְעָ֖ה אֶת־מִסְפָּרָֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr dvyd 'lyv'b v'lshry h'm lkhv sprv 'tyshr'l mb'r shb' v'ddn vhby'v 'ly v'd'h 'tmsprm
verses.translation: And David said to Joab and to the princes of the people: ‘Go, number Israel from Beersheba even to Dan; and bring me word, that I may know the sum of them.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יוֹאָ֗ב יוֹסֵף֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה עַל־עַמּ֤וֹ ׀ כָּהֵם֙ מֵאָ֣ה פְעָמִ֔ים הֲלֹא֙ אֲדֹנִ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ כֻּלָּ֥ם לַאדֹנִ֖י לַעֲבָדִ֑ים לָ֣מָּה יְבַקֵּ֥שׁ זֹאת֙ אֲדֹנִ֔י לָ֛מָּה יִֽהְיֶ֥ה לְאַשְׁמָ֖ה לְיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yv'b yvsf yhvh 'l'mv  khhm m'h p'mym hl' 'dny hmlkh khlm l'dny l'bdym lmh ybqsh z't 'dny lmh yhyh l'shmh lyshr'l
verses.translation: And Joab said: ‘The LORD make His people a hundred times so many more as they are; but, my lord the king, are they not all my lord’s servants? why doth my lord require this thing? why will he be a cause of guilt unto Israel?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּדְבַר־הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ חָזַ֣ק עַל־יוֹאָ֑ב וַיֵּצֵ֣א יוֹאָ֗ב וַיִּתְהַלֵּךְ֙ בְּכׇל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיָּבֹ֖א יְרוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: vdbrhmlkh chzq 'lyv'b vyts' yv'b vythlkh bkhlyshr'l vyb' yrvshl͏m
verses.translation: Nevertheless the king’s word prevailed against Joab. Wherefore Joab departed and went throughout all Israel, and came to Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֥ן יוֹאָ֛ב אֶת־מִסְפַּ֥ר מִפְקַד־הָעָ֖ם אֶל־דָּוִ֑יד וַיְהִ֣י כׇֽל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֡ל אֶ֣לֶף אֲלָפִים֩ וּמֵאָ֨ה אֶ֤לֶף אִישׁ֙ שֹׁ֣לֵֽף חֶ֔רֶב וִיהוּדָ֕ה אַרְבַּע֩ מֵא֨וֹת וְשִׁבְעִ֥ים אֶ֛לֶף אִ֖ישׁ שֹׁ֥לֵֽף־חָֽרֶב׃
verses.translit: vytn yv'b 'tmspr mpqdh'm 'ldvyd vyhy khlyshr'l 'lf 'lpym vm'h 'lf 'ysh shlf chrb vyhvdh 'rb' m'vt vshb'ym 'lf 'ysh shlfchrb
verses.translation: And Joab gave up the sum of the numbering of the people unto David. And all they of Israel were a thousand thousand and a hundred thousand men that drew sword; and Judah was four hundred three-score and ten thousand men that drew sword.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)
