verses.original: וְלֵוִי֙ וּבִנְיָמִ֔ן לֹ֥א פָקַ֖ד בְּתוֹכָ֑ם כִּֽי־נִתְעַ֥ב דְּבַר־הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ אֶת־יוֹאָֽב׃
verses.translit: vlvy vbnymn l' pqd btvkhm khynt'b dbrhmlkh 'tyv'b
verses.translation: But Levi and Benjamin he did not number among them; for the king’s word was abominable to Joab.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֙רַע֙ בְּעֵינֵ֣י הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים עַל־הַדָּבָ֖ר הַזֶּ֑ה וַיַּ֖ךְ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyr' b'yny h'lhym 'lhdbr hzh vykh 'tyshr'l {s}
verses.translation: And God was displeased with this thing; therefore He smote Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר דָּוִיד֙ אֶל־הָ֣אֱלֹהִ֔ים חָטָ֣אתִֽי מְאֹ֔ד אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂ֖יתִי אֶת־הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֑ה וְעַתָּ֗ה הַֽעֲבֶר־נָא֙ אֶת־עֲו֣וֹן עַבְדְּךָ֔ כִּ֥י נִסְכַּ֖לְתִּי מְאֹֽד׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vy'mr dvyd 'lh'lhym cht'ty m'd 'shr 'shyty 'thdbr hzh v'th h'brn' 't'vvn 'bdkh khy nskhlty m'd {p}
verses.translation: And David said unto God: ‘I have sinned greatly, in that I have done this thing; but now, put away, I beseech Thee, the iniquity of Thy servant; for I have done very foolishly.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֤ר יְהֹוָה֙ אֶל־גָּ֔ד חֹזֵ֥ה דָוִ֖יד לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lgd chzh dvyd l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Gad, David’s seer, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֵךְ֩ וְדִבַּרְתָּ֨ אֶל־דָּוִ֜יד לֵאמֹ֗ר כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה שָׁל֕וֹשׁ אֲנִ֖י נֹטֶ֣ה עָלֶ֑יךָ בְּחַר־לְךָ֛ אַחַ֥ת מֵהֵ֖נָּה וְאֶעֱשֶׂה־לָּֽךְ׃
verses.translit: lkh vdbrt 'ldvyd l'mr khh 'mr yhvh shlvsh 'ny nth 'lykh bchrlkh 'cht mhnh v''shhlkh
verses.translation: ’Go and speak unto David, saying: Thus saith the LORD: I offer thee three things; choose thee one of them, that I may do it unto thee.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֥בֹא גָ֖ד אֶל־דָּוִ֑יד וַיֹּ֥אמֶר ל֛וֹ כֹּה־אָמַ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה קַבֶּל־לָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vyb' gd 'ldvyd vy'mr lv khh'mr yhvh qbllkh
verses.translation: So Gad came to David, and said unto him: ‘Thus saith the LORD: Take which thou wilt:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־שָׁל֨וֹשׁ שָׁנִ֜ים רָעָ֗ב וְאִם־שְׁלֹשָׁ֨ה חֳדָשִׁ֜ים נִסְפֶּ֥ה מִפְּנֵֽי־צָרֶ֘יךָ֮ וְחֶ֣רֶב אוֹיְבֶ֣יךָ ׀ לְמַשֶּׂ֒גֶת֒ וְאִם־שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָ֠מִ֠ים חֶ֣רֶב יְהֹוָ֤ה וְדֶ֙בֶר֙ בָּאָ֔רֶץ וּמַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהֹוָ֔ה מַשְׁחִ֖ית בְּכׇל־גְּב֣וּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְעַתָּ֣ה רְאֵ֔ה מָה־אָשִׁ֥יב אֶת־שֹׁלְחִ֖י דָּבָֽר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'mshlvsh shnym r'b v'mshlshh chdshym nsph mpnytsrykh vchrb 'vybykh  lmshgt v'mshlsht ymym chrb yhvh vdbr b'rts vml'kh yhvh mshchyt bkhlgbvl yshr'l v'th r'h mh'shyb 'tshlchy dbr {s}
verses.translation: either three years of famine; or three months to be swept away before thy foes, while the sword of thine enemies overtaketh thee; or else three days the sword of the LORD, even pestilence in the land, and the angel of the LORD destroying throughout all the borders of Israel. Now therefore consider what answer I shall return to Him that sent me.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֧אמֶר דָּוִ֛יד אֶל־גָּ֖ד צַר־לִ֣י מְאֹ֑ד אֶפְּלָה־נָּ֣א בְיַד־יְהֹוָ֗ה כִּֽי־רַבִּ֤ים רַחֲמָיו֙ מְאֹ֔ד וּבְיַד־אָדָ֖ם אַל־אֶפֹּֽל׃
verses.translit: vy'mr dvyd 'lgd tsrly m'd 'plhn' bydyhvh khyrbym rchmyv m'd vbyd'dm 'l'pl
verses.translation: And David said unto Gad: ‘I am in a great strait; let me fall now into the hand of the LORD, for very great are His mercies; and let me not fall into the hand of man.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֧ן יְהֹוָ֛ה דֶּ֖בֶר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּפֹּל֙ מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שִׁבְעִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף אִֽישׁ׃
verses.translit: vytn yhvh dbr byshr'l vypl myshr'l shb'ym 'lf 'ysh
verses.translation: So the LORD sent a pestilence upon Israel; and there fell of Israel seventy thousand men.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַח֩ הָאֱלֹהִ֨ים ׀ מַלְאָ֥ךְ ׀ לִֽירוּשָׁלַ֘͏ִם֮ לְהַשְׁחִיתָהּ֒ וּכְהַשְׁחִ֗ית רָאָ֤ה יְהֹוָה֙ וַיִּנָּ֣חֶם עַל־הָרָעָ֔ה וַיֹּ֨אמֶר לַמַּלְאָ֤ךְ הַמַּשְׁחִית֙ רַ֔ב עַתָּ֖ה הֶ֣רֶף יָדֶ֑ךָ וּמַלְאַ֤ךְ יְהֹוָה֙ עֹמֵ֔ד עִם־גֹּ֖רֶן אׇרְנָ֥ן הַיְבוּסִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyshlch h'lhym  ml'kh  lyrvshl͏m lhshchyth vkhhshchyt r'h yhvh vynchm 'lhr'h vy'mr lml'kh hmshchyt rb 'th hrf ydkh vml'kh yhvh 'md 'mgrn 'rnn hybvsy {s}
verses.translation: And God sent an angel unto Jerusalem to destroy it; and as he was about to destroy, the LORD beheld, and He repented Him of the evil, and said to the destroying angel: ‘It is enough; now stay thy hand.’ And the angel of the LORD was standing by the threshing-floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשָּׂ֨א דָוִ֜יד אֶת־עֵינָ֗יו וַיַּ֞רְא אֶת־מַלְאַ֤ךְ יְהֹוָה֙ עֹמֵ֗ד בֵּ֤ין הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ וּבֵ֣ין הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וְחַרְבּ֤וֹ שְׁלוּפָה֙ בְּיָד֔וֹ נְטוּיָ֖ה עַל־יְרוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם וַיִּפֹּ֨ל דָּוִ֧יד וְהַזְּקֵנִ֛ים מְכֻסִּ֥ים בַּשַּׂקִּ֖ים עַל־פְּנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vysh' dvyd 't'ynyv vyr' 'tml'kh yhvh 'md byn h'rts vbyn hshmym vchrbv shlvph bydv ntvyh 'lyrvshl͏m vypl dvyd vhzqnym mkhsym bshqym 'lpnyhm
verses.translation: And David lifted up his eyes, and saw the angel of the LORD standing between the earth and the heaven, having a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders, clothed in sackcloth, fell upon their faces.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֣יד אֶֽל־הָאֱלֹהִ֡ים הֲלֹא֩ אֲנִ֨י אָמַ֜רְתִּי לִמְנ֣וֹת בָּעָ֗ם וַאֲנִי־ה֤וּא אֲשֶׁר־חָטָ֙אתִי֙ וְהָרֵ֣עַ הֲרֵע֔וֹתִי וְאֵ֥לֶּה הַצֹּ֖אן מֶ֣ה עָשׂ֑וּ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהַ֗י תְּהִ֨י נָ֤א יָֽדְךָ֙ בִּ֚י וּבְבֵ֣ית אָבִ֔י וּֽבְעַמְּךָ֖ לֹ֥א לְמַגֵּפָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vy'mr dvyd 'lh'lhym hl' 'ny 'mrty lmnvt b'm v'nyhv' 'shrcht'ty vhr' hr'vty v'lh hts'n mh 'shv yhvh 'lhy thy n' ydkh by vbbyt 'by vb'mkh l' lmgph {s}
verses.translation: And David said unto God: ‘Is it not I that commanded the people to be numbered? even I it is that have sinned and done very wickedly; but these sheep, what have they done? let Thy hand, I pray Thee, O LORD my God, be against me, and against my father’s house; but not against Thy people, that they should be plagued.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמַלְאַ֧ךְ יְהֹוָ֛ה אָמַ֥ר אֶל־גָּ֖ד לֵאמֹ֣ר לְדָוִ֑יד כִּ֣י  יַעֲלֶ֣ה דָוִ֗יד לְהָקִ֤ים מִזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ לַֽיהֹוָ֔ה בְּגֹ֖רֶן אׇרְנָ֥ן הַיְבֻסִֽי׃
verses.translit: vml'kh yhvh 'mr 'lgd l'mr ldvyd khy  y'lh dvyd lhqym mzbch lyhvh bgrn 'rnn hybsy
verses.translation: Then the angel of the LORD commanded Gad to say to David, that David should go up, and rear an altar unto the LORD in the threshing-floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֤עַל דָּוִיד֙ בִּדְבַר־גָּ֔ד אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֶּ֖ר בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'l dvyd bdbrgd 'shr dbr bshm yhvh
verses.translation: And David went up at the saying of Gad, which he spoke in the name of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֣שׇׁב אׇרְנָ֗ן וַיַּרְא֙ אֶת־הַמַּלְאָ֔ךְ וְאַרְבַּ֧עַת בָּנָ֛יו עִמּ֖וֹ מִֽתְחַבְּאִ֑ים וְאׇרְנָ֖ן דָּ֥שׁ חִטִּֽים׃
verses.translit: vyshb 'rnn vyr' 'thml'kh v'rb't bnyv 'mv mtchb'ym v'rnn dsh chtym
verses.translation: And Ornan turned back, and saw the angel; and his four sons that were with him hid themselves. Now Ornan was threshing wheat.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֥א דָוִ֖יד עַד־אׇרְנָ֑ן וַיַּבֵּ֤ט אׇרְנָן֙ וַיַּ֣רְא אֶת־דָּוִ֔יד וַיֵּצֵא֙ מִן־הַגֹּ֔רֶן וַיִּשְׁתַּ֧חוּ לְדָוִ֛יד אַפַּ֖יִם אָֽרְצָה׃
verses.translit: vyb' dvyd 'd'rnn vybt 'rnn vyr' 'tdvyd vyts' mnhgrn vyshtchv ldvyd 'pym 'rtsh
verses.translation: And as David came to Ornan, Ornan looked and saw David, and went out of the threshing-floor, and bowed down to David with his face to the ground.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֜יד אֶל־אׇרְנָ֗ן תְּנָה־לִּי֙ מְק֣וֹם הַגֹּ֔רֶן וְאֶבְנֶה־בּ֥וֹ מִזְבֵּ֖חַ לַֽיהֹוָ֑ה בְּכֶ֤סֶף מָלֵא֙ תְּנֵ֣הוּ לִ֔י וְתֵעָצַ֥ר הַמַּגֵּפָ֖ה מֵעַ֥ל הָעָֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr dvyd 'l'rnn tnhly mqvm hgrn v'bnhbv mzbch lyhvh bkhsf ml' tnhv ly vt'tsr hmgph m'l h'm
verses.translation: Then David said to Ornan: ‘Give me the place of this threshing-floor, that I may build thereon an altar unto the LORD; for the full price shalt thou give it me; that the plague may be stayed from the people.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אׇרְנָ֤ן אֶל־דָּוִיד֙ קַֽח־לָ֔ךְ וְיַ֛עַשׂ אֲדֹנִ֥י הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ הַטּ֣וֹב בְּעֵינָ֑יו רְאֵה֩ נָתַ֨תִּי הַבָּקָ֜ר לָעֹל֗וֹת וְהַמּוֹרִגִּ֧ים לָעֵצִ֛ים וְהַחִטִּ֥ים לַמִּנְחָ֖ה הַכֹּ֥ל נָתָֽתִּי׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'rnn 'ldvyd qchlkh vy'sh 'dny hmlkh htvb b'ynyv r'h ntty hbqr l'lvt vhmvrgym l'tsym vhchtym lmnchh hkhl ntty
verses.translation: And Ornan said unto David: ‘Take it to thee, and let my lord the king do that which is good in his eyes; lo, I give thee the oxen for burnt-offerings, and the threshing-instruments for wood, and the wheat for the meal-offering; I give it all’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ דָּוִיד֙ לְאׇרְנָ֔ן לֹ֕א כִּֽי־קָנֹ֥ה אֶקְנֶ֖ה בְּכֶ֣סֶף מָלֵ֑א כִּ֠י לֹא־אֶשָּׂ֤א אֲשֶׁר־לְךָ֙ לַיהֹוָ֔ה וְהַעֲל֥וֹת עוֹלָ֖ה חִנָּֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh dvyd l'rnn l' khyqnh 'qnh bkhsf ml' khy l''sh' 'shrlkh lyhvh vh'lvt 'vlh chnm
verses.translation: And king David said to Ornan: ‘Nay, but I will verily buy it for the full price; for I will not take that which is thine for the LORD, nor offer a burnt-offering without cost.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֥ן דָּוִ֛יד לְאׇרְנָ֖ן בַּמָּק֑וֹם שִׁקְלֵ֣י זָהָ֔ב מִשְׁקָ֖ל שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vytn dvyd l'rnn bmqvm shqly zhb mshql shsh m'vt
verses.translation: So David gave to Ornan for the place six hundred shekels of gold by weight.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּ֩בֶן֩ שָׁ֨ם דָּוִ֤יד מִזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ לַֽיהֹוָ֔ה וַיַּ֥עַל עֹל֖וֹת וּשְׁלָמִ֑ים וַיִּקְרָא֙ אֶל־יְהֹוָ֔ה וַֽיַּעֲנֵ֤הוּ בָאֵשׁ֙ מִן־הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם עַ֖ל מִזְבַּ֥ח הָעֹלָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vybn shm dvyd mzbch lyhvh vy'l 'lvt vshlmym vyqr' 'lyhvh vy'nhv b'sh mnhshmym 'l mzbch h'lh {s}
verses.translation: And David built there an altar unto the LORD, and offered burnt-offerings and peace-offerings, and called upon the LORD; and He answered him from heaven by fire upon the altar of burnt-offering.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהֹוָה֙ לַמַּלְאָ֔ךְ וַיָּ֥שֶׁב חַרְבּ֖וֹ אֶל־נְדָנָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh lml'kh vyshb chrbv 'lndnh
verses.translation: And the LORD commanded the angel; and he put up his sword back into the sheath thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֔יא בִּרְא֤וֹת דָּוִיד֙ כִּֽי־עָנָ֣הוּ יְהֹוָ֔ה בְּגֹ֖רֶן אׇרְנָ֣ן הַיְבוּסִ֑י וַיִּזְבַּ֖ח שָֽׁם׃
verses.translit: b't hhy' br'vt dvyd khy'nhv yhvh bgrn 'rnn hybvsy vyzbch shm
verses.translation: At that time, when David saw that the LORD had answered him in the threshing-floor of Ornan the Jebusite, then he sacrificed there.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִשְׁכַּ֣ן יְ֠הֹוָ֠ה אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂ֨ה מֹשֶׁ֧ה בַמִּדְבָּ֛ר וּמִזְבַּ֥ח הָעוֹלָ֖ה בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֑יא בַּבָּמָ֖ה בְּגִבְעֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: vmshkhn yhvh 'shr'shh mshh bmdbr vmzbch h'vlh b't hhy' bbmh bgb'vn
verses.translation: For the tabernacle of the LORD, which Moses made in the wilderness, and the altar of burnt-offering, were at that time in the high place at Gibeon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹא־יָכֹ֥ל דָּוִ֛יד לָלֶ֥כֶת לְפָנָ֖יו לִדְרֹ֣שׁ אֱלֹהִ֑ים כִּ֣י נִבְעַ֔ת מִפְּנֵ֕י חֶ֖רֶב מַלְאַ֥ךְ יְהֹוָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vl'ykhl dvyd llkht lpnyv ldrsh 'lhym khy nb't mpny chrb ml'kh yhvh {s}
verses.translation: But David could not go before it to inquire of God; for he was terrified because of the sword of the angel of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֔יד זֶ֣ה ה֔וּא בֵּ֖ית יְהֹוָ֣ה הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְזֶה־מִּזְבֵּ֥חַ לְעֹלָ֖ה לְיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vy'mr dvyd zh hv' byt yhvh h'lhym vzhmzbch l'lh lyshr'l {p}
verses.translation: Then David said: ‘This is the house of the LORD God, and this is the altar of burnt-offering for Israel.’ .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֔יד לִכְנוֹס֙ אֶת־הַגֵּרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּאֶ֣רֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיַּעֲמֵ֣ד חֹצְבִ֗ים לַחְצוֹב֙ אַבְנֵ֣י גָזִ֔ית לִבְנ֖וֹת בֵּ֥ית הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: vy'mr dvyd lkhnvs 'thgrym 'shr b'rts yshr'l vy'md chtsbym lchtsvb 'bny gzyt lbnvt byt h'lhym
verses.translation: And David commanded to gather together the strangers that were in the land of Israel; and he set masons to hew wrought stones to build the house of God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבַרְזֶ֣ל ׀ לָ֠רֹ֠ב לַֽמִּסְמְרִ֞ים לְדַלְת֧וֹת הַשְּׁעָרִ֛ים וְלַֽמְחַבְּר֖וֹת הֵכִ֣ין דָּוִ֑יד וּנְחֹ֥שֶׁת לָרֹ֖ב אֵ֥ין מִשְׁקָֽל׃
verses.translit: vbrzl  lrb lmsmrym ldltvt hsh'rym vlmchbrvt hkhyn dvyd vnchsht lrb 'yn mshql
verses.translation: And David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates, and for the couplings; and brass in abundance without weight;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַעֲצֵ֥י אֲרָזִ֖ים לְאֵ֣ין מִסְפָּ֑ר כִּֽי־הֵ֠בִ֠יאוּ הַצִּידֹנִ֨ים וְהַצֹּרִ֜ים עֲצֵ֧י אֲרָזִ֛ים לָרֹ֖ב לְדָוִֽיד׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'tsy 'rzym l'yn mspr khyhby'v htsydnym vhtsrym 'tsy 'rzym lrb ldvyd {p}
verses.translation: and cedar-trees without number; for the Zidonians and they of Tyre brought cedar-trees in abundance to David.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֗יד שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בְנִי֮ נַ֣עַר וָרָךְ֒ וְהַבַּ֜יִת לִבְנ֣וֹת לַֽיהֹוָ֗ה לְהַגְדִּ֨יל ׀ לְמַ֜עְלָה לְשֵׁ֤ם וּלְתִפְאֶ֙רֶת֙ לְכׇל־הָ֣אֲרָצ֔וֹת אָכִ֥ינָה נָּ֖א ל֑וֹ וַיָּ֧כֶן דָּוִ֛יד לָרֹ֖ב לִפְנֵ֥י מוֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr dvyd shlmh bny n'r vrkh vhbyt lbnvt lyhvh lhgdyl  lm'lh lshm vltp'rt lkhlh'rtsvt 'khynh n' lv vykhn dvyd lrb lpny mvtv
verses.translation: And David said: ‘Solomon my son is young and tender, and the house that is to be builded for the LORD must be exceeding magnificent, of fame and of glory throughout all countries; I will therefore make preparation for him.’ So David prepared abundantly before his death.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֖א לִשְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בְנ֑וֹ וַיְצַוֵּ֙הוּ֙ לִבְנ֣וֹת בַּ֔יִת לַיהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyqr' lshlmh bnv vytsvhv lbnvt byt lyhvh 'lhy yshr'l {s}
verses.translation: Then He called for Solomon his son, and charged him to build a house for the LORD, the God of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר דָּוִ֖יד לִשְׁלֹמֹ֑ה (בנו) [בְּנִ֕י] אֲנִי֙ הָיָ֣ה עִם־לְבָבִ֔י לִבְנ֣וֹת בַּ֔יִת לְשֵׁ֖ם יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽי׃
verses.translit: vy'mr dvyd lshlmh (bnv) [bny] 'ny hyh 'mlbby lbnvt byt lshm yhvh 'lhy
verses.translation: And David said to Solomon: ‘My son, as for me, it was in my heart to build a house unto the name of the LORD my God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֨י עָלַ֤י דְּבַר־יְהֹוָה֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר דָּ֤ם לָרֹב֙ שָׁפַ֔כְתָּ וּמִלְחָמ֥וֹת גְּדֹל֖וֹת עָשִׂ֑יתָ לֹא־תִבְנֶ֥ה בַ֙יִת֙ לִשְׁמִ֔י כִּ֚י דָּמִ֣ים רַבִּ֔ים שָׁפַ֥כְתָּ אַ֖רְצָה לְפָנָֽי׃
verses.translit: vyhy 'ly dbryhvh l'mr dm lrb shpkht vmlchmvt gdlvt 'shyt l'tbnh byt lshmy khy dmym rbym shpkht 'rtsh lpny
verses.translation: But the word of the LORD came to me, saying: Thou hast shed blood abundantly, and hast made great wars; thou shalt not build a house unto My name, because thou hast shed much blood upon the earth in My sight.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּה־בֵ֞ן נוֹלָ֣ד לָ֗ךְ ה֤וּא יִֽהְיֶה֙ אִ֣ישׁ מְנוּחָ֔ה וַהֲנִיח֥וֹתִי ל֛וֹ מִכׇּל־אוֹיְבָ֖יו מִסָּבִ֑יב כִּ֤י שְׁלֹמֹה֙ יִֽהְיֶ֣ה שְׁמ֔וֹ וְשָׁל֥וֹם וָשֶׁ֛קֶט אֶתֵּ֥ן עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּיָמָֽיו׃
verses.translit: hnhbn nvld lkh hv' yhyh 'ysh mnvchh vhnychvty lv mkhl'vybyv msbyb khy shlmh yhyh shmv vshlvm vshqt 'tn 'lyshr'l bymyv
verses.translation: Behold, a son shall be born to thee, who shall be a man of rest; and I will give him rest from all his enemies round about; for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness unto Israel in his days.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֽוּא־יִבְנֶ֥ה בַ֙יִת֙ לִשְׁמִ֔י וְהוּא֙ יִֽהְיֶה־לִּ֣י לְבֵ֔ן וַאֲנִי־ל֖וֹ לְאָ֑ב וַהֲכִ֨ינוֹתִ֜י כִּסֵּ֧א מַלְכוּת֛וֹ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עַד־עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: hv'ybnh byt lshmy vhv' yhyhly lbn v'nylv l'b vhkhynvty khs' mlkhvtv 'lyshr'l 'd'vlm
verses.translation: He shall build a house for My name; and he shall be to Me for a son, and I will be to him for a father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַתָּ֣ה בְנִ֔י יְהִ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה עִמָּ֑ךְ וְהִצְלַחְתָּ֗ וּבָנִ֙יתָ֙ בֵּ֚ית יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר עָלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: 'th bny yhy yhvh 'mkh vhtslcht vbnyt byt yhvh 'lhykh kh'shr dbr 'lykh
verses.translation: Now, my son, the LORD be with thee; and prosper thou, and build the house of the LORD thy God, as He hath spoken concerning thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ יִֽתֶּן־לְךָ֤ יְהֹוָה֙ שֵׂ֣כֶל וּבִינָ֔ה וִֽיצַוְּךָ֖ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְלִשְׁמ֕וֹר אֶת־תּוֹרַ֖ת יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: 'kh ytnlkh yhvh shkhl vbynh vytsvkh 'lyshr'l vlshmvr 'ttvrt yhvh 'lhykh
verses.translation: Only the LORD give thee discretion and understanding, and give thee charge concerning Israel; that so thou mayest keep the law of the LORD thy God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָ֣ז תַּצְלִ֔יחַ אִם־תִּשְׁמ֗וֹר לַֽעֲשׂוֹת֙ אֶת־הַחֻקִּ֣ים וְאֶת־הַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהֹוָ֛ה אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֖ה עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל חֲזַ֣ק וֶאֱמָ֔ץ אַל־תִּירָ֖א וְאַל־תֵּחָֽת׃
verses.translit: 'z ttslych 'mtshmvr l'shvt 'thchqym v'thmshptym 'shr tsvh yhvh 'tmshh 'lyshr'l chzq v'mts 'ltyr' v'ltcht
verses.translation: Then shalt thou prosper, if thou observe to do the statutes and the ordinances which the LORD charged Moses with concerning Israel; be strong, and of good courage; fear not, neither be dismayed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֨ה בְעׇנְיִ֜י הֲכִינ֣וֹתִי לְבֵית־יְהֹוָ֗ה זָהָ֞ב כִּכָּרִ֤ים מֵֽאָה־אֶ֙לֶף֙ וְכֶ֗סֶף אֶ֤לֶף אֲלָפִים֙ כִּכָּרִ֔ים וְלַנְּחֹ֤שֶׁת וְלַבַּרְזֶל֙ אֵ֣ין מִשְׁקָ֔ל כִּ֥י לָרֹ֖ב הָיָ֑ה וְעֵצִ֤ים וַֽאֲבָנִים֙ הֲכִינ֔וֹתִי וַעֲלֵיהֶ֖ם תּוֹסִֽיף׃
verses.translit: vhnh b'nyy hkhynvty lbytyhvh zhb khkhrym m'h'lf vkhsf 'lf 'lpym khkhrym vlnchsht vlbrzl 'yn mshql khy lrb hyh v'tsym v'bnym hkhynvty v'lyhm tvsyf
verses.translation: Now, behold, in my straits I have prepared for the house of the LORD a hundred thousand talents of gold, and a thousand thousand talents of silver; and of brass and iron without weight, for it is in abundance; timber also and stone have I prepared; and thou mayest add thereto.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעִמְּךָ֤ לָרֹב֙ עֹשֵׂ֣י מְלָאכָ֔ה חֹצְבִ֕ים וְחָרָשֵׁ֥י אֶ֖בֶן וָעֵ֑ץ וְכׇל־חָכָ֖ם בְּכׇל־מְלָאכָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'mkh lrb 'shy ml'khh chtsbym vchrshy 'bn v'ts vkhlchkhm bkhlml'khh
verses.translation: Moreover there are workmen with thee in abundance, hewers and workers of stone and timber, and all men that are skilful in any manner of work;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַזָּהָ֥ב לַכֶּ֛סֶף וְלַנְּחֹ֥שֶׁת וְלַבַּרְזֶ֖ל אֵ֣ין מִסְפָּ֑ר ק֣וּם וַעֲשֵׂ֔ה וִיהִ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.translit: lzhb lkhsf vlnchsht vlbrzl 'yn mspr qvm v'shh vyhy yhvh 'mkh
verses.translation: of the gold, the silver, and the brass, and the iron, there is no number. Arise and be doing, and the LORD be with thee.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְצַ֤ו דָּוִיד֙ לְכׇל־שָׂרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לַעְזֹ֖ר לִשְׁלֹמֹ֥ה בְנֽוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vytsv dvyd lkhlshry yshr'l l'zr lshlmh bnv {s}
verses.translation: David also commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon his son:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲלֹ֨א יְהֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶם֙ עִמָּכֶ֔ם וְהֵנִ֥יחַ לָכֶ֖ם מִסָּבִ֑יב כִּ֣י  נָתַ֣ן בְּיָדִ֗י אֵ֚ת יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ וְנִכְבְּשָׁ֥ה הָאָ֛רֶץ לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה וְלִפְנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: hl' yhvh 'lhykhm 'mkhm vhnych lkhm msbyb khy  ntn bydy 't yshby h'rts vnkhbshh h'rts lpny yhvh vlpny 'mv
verses.translation: ’Is not the LORD your God with you? and hath He not given you rest on every side? for He hath delivered the inhabitants of the land into my hand; and the land is subdued before the LORD, and before His people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַתָּ֗ה תְּנ֤וּ לְבַבְכֶם֙ וְנַפְשְׁכֶ֔ם לִדְר֖וֹשׁ לַיהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם וְק֗וּמוּ וּבְנוּ֙ אֶת־מִקְדַּשׁ֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים לְהָבִ֞יא אֶת־אֲר֣וֹן בְּרִית־יְהֹוָ֗ה וּכְלֵי֙ קֹ֣דֶשׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים לַבַּ֖יִת הַנִּבְנֶ֥ה לְשֵׁם־יְהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'th tnv lbbkhm vnpshkhm ldrvsh lyhvh 'lhykhm vqvmv vbnv 'tmqdsh yhvh h'lhym lhby' 't'rvn brytyhvh vkhly qdsh h'lhym lbyt hnbnh lshmyhvh {p}
verses.translation: Now set your heart and your soul to seek after the LORD your God; arise therefore, and build ye the sanctuary of the LORD God, to bring the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and the holy vessels of God, into the house that is to be built to the name of the LORD.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְדָוִ֥יד זָקֵ֖ן וְשָׂבַ֣ע יָמִ֑ים וַיַּמְלֵ֛ךְ אֶת־שְׁלֹמֹ֥ה בְנ֖וֹ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vdvyd zqn vshb' ymym vymlkh 'tshlmh bnv 'lyshr'l
verses.translation: Now David was old and full of days; and he made Solomon his son king over Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֶּֽאֱסֹף֙ אֶת־כׇּל־שָׂרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְהַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְהַלְוִיִּֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'sf 'tkhlshry yshr'l vhkhhnym vhlvym
verses.translation: And he gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסָּֽפְרוּ֙ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם מִבֶּ֛ן שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וָמָ֑עְלָה וַיְהִ֨י מִסְפָּרָ֤ם לְגֻלְגְּלֹתָם֙ לִגְבָרִ֔ים שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וּשְׁמוֹנָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃
verses.translit: vysprv hlvym mbn shlshym shnh vm'lh vyhy msprm lglgltm lgbrym shlshym vshmvnh 'lf
verses.translation: And the Levites were numbered from thirty years old and upward; and their number by their polls, man by man, was thirty and eight thousand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֵאֵ֗לֶּה לְנַצֵּ֙חַ֙ עַל־מְלֶ֣אכֶת בֵּית־יְהֹוָ֔ה עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָ֑לֶף וְשֹׁטְרִ֥ים וְשֹׁפְטִ֖ים שֵׁ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִֽים׃
verses.translit: m'lh lntsch 'lml'kht bytyhvh 'shrym v'rb'h 'lf vshtrym vshptym shsht 'lpym
verses.translation: Of these, twenty and four thousand were to oversee the work of the house of the LORD; and six thousand were officers and judges;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַרְבַּ֥עַת אֲלָפִ֖ים שֹׁעֲרִ֑ים וְאַרְבַּ֤עַת אֲלָפִים֙ מְהַֽלְלִ֣ים לַיהֹוָ֔ה בַּכֵּלִ֕ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂ֖יתִי לְהַלֵּֽל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'rb't 'lpym sh'rym v'rb't 'lpym mhllym lyhvh bkhlym 'shr 'shyty lhll {s}
verses.translation: and four thousand were doorkeepers; and four thousand praised the LORD ‘with the instruments which I made to praise therewith.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֶּחָלְקֵ֥ם דָּוִ֖יד מַחְלְק֑וֹת {ס} לִבְנֵ֣י לֵוִ֔י לְגֵרְשׁ֖וֹן קְהָ֥ת וּמְרָרִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vychlqm dvyd mchlqvt {s} lbny lvy lgrshvn qht vmrry {s}
verses.translation: And David divided them into courses according to the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּ֖י לַעְדָּ֥ן וְשִׁמְעִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: lgrshny l'dn vshm'y {s}
verses.translation: Of the Gershonites: Ladan, and Shimei.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י לַעְדָּ֗ן הָרֹ֧אשׁ יְחִיאֵ֛ל וְזֵתָ֥ם וְיוֹאֵ֖ל שְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny l'dn hr'sh ychy'l vztm vyv'l shlshh {s}
verses.translation: The sons of Ladan: Jehiel the chief, and Zetham, and Joel, three.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י שִׁמְעִ֗י (שלמות) [שְׁלֹמִ֧ית] וַחֲזִיאֵ֛ל וְהָרָ֖ן שְׁלֹשָׁ֑ה אֵ֛לֶּה רָאשֵׁ֥י הָאָב֖וֹת לְלַעְדָּֽן׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny shm'y (shlmvt) [shlmyt] vchzy'l vhrn shlshh 'lh r'shy h'bvt ll'dn {s}
verses.translation: The sons of Shimei: Shelomith, and Haziel, and Haran, three. These were the heads of the fathers’houses of Ladan.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֣י שִׁמְעִ֔י יַ֣חַת זִינָ֔א וִיע֖וּשׁ וּבְרִיעָ֑ה אֵ֥לֶּה בְנֵֽי־שִׁמְעִ֖י אַרְבָּעָֽה׃
verses.translit: vbny shm'y ycht zyn' vy'vsh vbry'h 'lh bnyshm'y 'rb'h
verses.translation: And the sons of Shimei: Jahath, Zina, and Jeush, and Beriah. These four were the sons of Shimei.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִי־יַ֣חַת הָרֹ֔אשׁ וְזִיזָ֖ה הַשֵּׁנִ֑י וִיע֤וּשׁ וּבְרִיעָה֙ לֹא־הִרְבּ֣וּ בָנִ֔ים וַיִּֽהְיוּ֙ לְבֵ֣ית אָ֔ב לִפְקֻדָּ֖ה אֶחָֽת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyhyycht hr'sh vzyzh hshny vy'vsh vbry'h l'hrbv bnym vyhyv lbyt 'b lpqdh 'cht {s}
verses.translation: And Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second; but Jeush and Beriah had not many sons; therefore they became a fathers’house in one reckoning.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י קְהָ֗ת עַמְרָ֥ם יִצְהָ֛ר חֶבְר֥וֹן וְעֻזִּיאֵ֖ל אַרְבָּעָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny qht 'mrm ytshr chbrvn v'zy'l 'rb'h {s}
verses.translation: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֥י עַמְרָ֖ם אַהֲרֹ֣ן וּמֹשֶׁ֑ה וַיִּבָּדֵ֣ל אַהֲרֹ֡ן לְֽהַקְדִּישׁוֹ֩ קֹ֨דֶשׁ קׇדָשִׁ֤ים הֽוּא־וּבָנָיו֙ עַד־עוֹלָ֔ם לְהַקְטִיר֩ לִפְנֵ֨י יְהֹוָ֧ה לְשָׁרְת֛וֹ וּלְבָרֵ֥ךְ בִּשְׁמ֖וֹ עַד־עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: bny 'mrm 'hrn vmshh vybdl 'hrn lhqdyshv qdsh qdshym hv'vbnyv 'd'vlm lhqtyr lpny yhvh lshrtv vlbrkh bshmv 'd'vlm
verses.translation: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses; and Aaron was separated, that he should be sanctified as most holy, he and his sons for ever, to offer before the LORD, to minister unto Him, and to bless in His name for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמֹשֶׁ֖ה אִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים בָּנָ֕יו יִקָּרְא֖וּ עַל־שֵׁ֥בֶט הַלֵּוִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vmshh 'ysh h'lhym bnyv yqr'v 'lshbt hlvy {s}
verses.translation: But as for Moses the man of God, his sons are named among the tribe of Levi.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֔ה גֵּרְשׁ֖וֹם וֶאֱלִיעֶֽזֶר׃
verses.translit: bny mshh grshvm v'ly'zr
verses.translation: The sons of Moses: Gershom, and Eliezer.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֥י גֵרְשׁ֖וֹם שְׁבוּאֵ֥ל הָרֹֽאשׁ׃
verses.translit: bny grshvm shbv'l hr'sh
verses.translation: The sons of Gershom: Shebuel the chief.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּהְי֥וּ בְנֵֽי־אֱלִיעֶ֖זֶר רְחַבְיָ֣ה הָרֹ֑אשׁ וְלֹא־הָיָ֤ה לֶאֱלִיעֶ֙זֶר֙ בָּנִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וּבְנֵ֥י רְחַבְיָ֖ה רָב֥וּ לְמָֽעְלָה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyhyv bny'ly'zr rchbyh hr'sh vl'hyh l'ly'zr bnym 'chrym vbny rchbyh rbv lm'lh {s}
verses.translation: And the sons of Eliezer were: Rehabiah the chief. And Eliezer had no other sons; but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֥י יִצְהָ֖ר שְׁלֹמִ֥ית הָרֹֽאשׁ׃
verses.translit: bny ytshr shlmyt hr'sh
verses.translation: The sons of Izhar: Shelomith the chief.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֖י חֶבְר֑וֹן יְרִיָּ֤הוּ הָרֹאשׁ֙ אֲמַרְיָ֣ה הַשֵּׁנִ֔י יַֽחֲזִיאֵל֙ הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֔י וִֽיקַמְעָ֖ם הָרְבִיעִֽי׃
verses.translit: bny chbrvn yryhv hr'sh 'mryh hshny ychzy'l hshlyshy vyqm'm hrby'y
verses.translation: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the chief, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֖י עֻזִּיאֵ֑ל מִיכָ֣ה הָרֹ֔אשׁ וְיִשִּׁיָּ֖ה הַשֵּׁנִֽי׃
verses.translit: bny 'zy'l mykhh hr'sh vyshyh hshny
verses.translation: The sons of Uzziel: Micah the chief, and Isshiah the second.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֤י מְרָרִי֙ מַחְלִ֣י וּמוּשִׁ֔י בְּנֵ֥י מַחְלִ֖י אֶלְעָזָ֥ר וְקִֽישׁ׃
verses.translit: bny mrry mchly vmvshy bny mchly 'l'zr vqysh
verses.translation: The sons of Merari: Mahli, and Mushi. The sons of Mahli: Eleazar, and Kish.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֙מׇת֙ אֶלְעָזָ֔ר וְלֹא־הָ֥יוּ ל֛וֹ בָּנִ֖ים כִּ֣י אִם־בָּנ֑וֹת וַיִּשָּׂא֥וּם בְּנֵי־קִ֖ישׁ אֲחֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vymt 'l'zr vl'hyv lv bnym khy 'mbnvt vysh'vm bnyqysh 'chyhm
verses.translation: And Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters only; and their brethren the sons of Kish took them to wife.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י מוּשִׁ֗י מַחְלִ֥י וְעֵ֛דֶר וִירֵמ֖וֹת שְׁלוֹשָֽׁה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny mvshy mchly v'dr vyrmvt shlvshh {s}
verses.translation: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, and Eder, and Jeremoth, three.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה בְנֵֽי־לֵוִי֩ לְבֵ֨ית אֲבוֹתֵיהֶ֜ם רָאשֵׁ֧י הָאָב֣וֹת לִפְקוּדֵיהֶ֗ם בְּמִסְפַּ֤ר שֵׁמוֹת֙ לְגֻלְגְּלֹתָ֔ם עֹשֵׂה֙ הַמְּלָאכָ֔ה לַעֲבֹדַ֖ת בֵּ֣ית יְהֹוָ֑ה מִבֶּ֛ן עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וָמָֽעְלָה׃
verses.translit: 'lh bnylvy lbyt 'bvtyhm r'shy h'bvt lpqvdyhm bmspr shmvt lglgltm 'shh hml'khh l'bdt byt yhvh mbn 'shrym shnh vm'lh
verses.translation: These were the sons of Levi after their fathers’houses, even the heads of the fathers’houses, according to their muster, in the number of names by their polls, who did the work for the service of the house of the LORD, from twenty years old and upward.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֚י אָמַ֣ר דָּוִ֔יד הֵנִ֛יחַ יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְעַמּ֑וֹ וַיִּשְׁכֹּ֥ן בִּירוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם עַד־לְעוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: khy 'mr dvyd hnych yhvh 'lhyyshr'l l'mv vyshkhn byrvshl͏m 'dl'vlm
verses.translation: For David said: ‘The LORD, the God of Israel, hath given rest unto His people, and He dwelleth in Jerusalem for ever;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגַ֖ם לַלְוִיִּ֑ם אֵין־לָשֵׂ֧את אֶת־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֛ן וְאֶת־כׇּל־כֵּלָ֖יו לַעֲבֹדָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vgm llvym 'ynlsh't 'thmshkhn v'tkhlkhlyv l'bdtv
verses.translation: and also the Levites shall no more have need to carry the tabernacle and all the vessels of it for the service thereof.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י בְדִבְרֵ֤י דָוִיד֙ הָאַ֣חֲרוֹנִ֔ים הֵ֖מָּה מִסְפַּ֣ר בְּנֵֽי־לֵוִ֑י מִבֶּ֛ן עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וּלְמָֽעְלָה׃
verses.translit: khy bdbry dvyd h'chrvnym hmh mspr bnylvy mbn 'shrym shnh vlm'lh
verses.translation: For by the last ordinances of David the sons of Levi were numbered from twenty years old and upward.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י מַעֲמָדָ֞ם לְיַד־בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֗ן לַֽעֲבֹדַת֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהֹוָ֔ה עַל־הַֽחֲצֵרוֹת֙ וְעַל־הַלְּשָׁכ֔וֹת וְעַֽל־טׇהֳרַ֖ת לְכׇל־קֹ֑דֶשׁ וּמַֽעֲשֵׂ֔ה עֲבֹדַ֖ת בֵּ֥ית הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: khy m'mdm lydbny 'hrn l'bdt byt yhvh 'lhchtsrvt v'lhlshkhvt v'lthrt lkhlqdsh vm'shh 'bdt byt h'lhym
verses.translation: For their station was at the side of the sons of Aaron for the service of the house of the LORD, in the courts, and in the chambers, and in the purifying of all holy things, even the work of the service of the house of God;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְלֶ֨חֶם הַֽמַּעֲרֶ֜כֶת וּלְסֹ֤לֶת לְמִנְחָה֙ וְלִרְקִיקֵ֣י הַמַּצּ֔וֹת וְלַֽמַּחֲבַ֖ת וְלַמֻּרְבָּ֑כֶת וּלְכׇל־מְשׂוּרָ֖ה וּמִדָּֽה׃
verses.translit: vllchm hm'rkht vlslt lmnchh vlrqyqy hmtsvt vlmchbt vlmrbkht vlkhlmshvrh vmdh
verses.translation: for the showbread also, and for the fine flour for a meal-offering, whether of unleavened wafers, or of that which is baked on the griddle, or of that which is soaked, and for all manner of measure and size;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלַֽעֲמֹד֙ בַּבֹּ֣קֶר בַּבֹּ֔קֶר לְהֹד֥וֹת וּלְהַלֵּ֖ל לַֽיהֹוָ֑ה וְכֵ֖ן לָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.translit: vl'md bbqr bbqr lhdvt vlhll lyhvh vkhn l'rb
verses.translation: and to stand every morning to thank and praise the LORD, and likewise at even;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְכֹ֨ל הַעֲל֤וֹת עֹלוֹת֙ לַֽיהֹוָ֔ה לַשַּׁ֨בָּת֔וֹת לֶחֳדָשִׁ֖ים וְלַמֹּעֲדִ֑ים בְּמִסְפָּ֨ר כְּמִשְׁפָּ֧ט עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם תָּמִ֖יד לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vlkhl h'lvt 'lvt lyhvh lshbtvt lchdshym vlm'dym bmspr khmshpt 'lyhm tmyd lpny yhvh
verses.translation: and to offer all burnt-offerings unto the LORD, on the sabbaths, on the new moons, and in the appointed seasons, in number according to the ordinance concerning them, continually, before the LORD;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׁמְר֞וּ אֶת־מִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת אֹֽהֶל־מוֹעֵ֗ד וְאֵת֙ מִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ וּמִשְׁמֶ֕רֶת בְּנֵ֥י אַהֲרֹ֖ן אֲחֵיהֶ֑ם לַעֲבֹדַ֖ת בֵּ֥ית יְהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vshmrv 'tmshmrt 'hlmv'd v't mshmrt hqdsh vmshmrt bny 'hrn 'chyhm l'bdt byt yhvh {p}
verses.translation: and that they should keep the charge of the tent of meeting, and the charge of the holy place, and the charge of the sons of Aaron their brethren, for the service of the house of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלִבְנֵ֥י אַהֲרֹ֖ן מַחְלְקוֹתָ֑ם בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֔ן נָדָב֙ וַאֲבִיה֔וּא אֶלְעָזָ֖ר וְאִיתָמָֽר׃
verses.translit: vlbny 'hrn mchlqvtm bny 'hrn ndb v'byhv' 'l'zr v'ytmr
verses.translation: And the courses of the sons of Aaron were these. The sons of Aaron: Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֨מׇת נָדָ֤ב וַֽאֲבִיהוּא֙ לִפְנֵ֣י אֲבִיהֶ֔ם וּבָנִ֖ים לֹא־הָי֣וּ לָהֶ֑ם וַֽיְכַהֲנ֔וּ אֶלְעָזָ֖ר וְאִיתָמָֽר׃
verses.translit: vymt ndb v'byhv' lpny 'byhm vbnym l'hyv lhm vykhhnv 'l'zr v'ytmr
verses.translation: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children; therefore Eleazar and Ithamar executed the priest’s office.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֶּחָלְקֵ֣ם דָּוִ֔יד וְצָדוֹק֙ מִן־בְּנֵ֣י אֶלְעָזָ֔ר וַאֲחִימֶ֖לֶךְ מִן־בְּנֵ֣י אִיתָמָ֑ר לִפְקֻדָּתָ֖ם בַּעֲבֹדָתָֽם׃
verses.translit: vychlqm dvyd vtsdvq mnbny 'l'zr v'chymlkh mnbny 'ytmr lpqdtm b'bdtm
verses.translation: And David with Zadok of the sons of Eleazar, and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, divided them according to their ordering in their service.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּמָּצְא֣וּ בְֽנֵי־אֶלְעָזָ֡ר רַבִּ֞ים לְרָאשֵׁ֧י הַגְּבָרִ֛ים מִן־בְּנֵ֥י אִיתָמָ֖ר וַֽיַּחְלְק֑וּם לִבְנֵ֨י אֶלְעָזָ֜ר רָאשִׁ֤ים לְבֵית־אָבוֹת֙ שִׁשָּׁ֣ה עָשָׂ֔ר וְלִבְנֵ֧י אִיתָמָ֛ר לְבֵ֥ית אֲבוֹתָ֖ם שְׁמוֹנָֽה׃
verses.translit: vymts'v bny'l'zr rbym lr'shy hgbrym mnbny 'ytmr vychlqvm lbny 'l'zr r'shym lbyt'bvt shshh 'shr vlbny 'ytmr lbyt 'bvtm shmvnh
verses.translation: And there were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar; and thus were they divided: of the sons of Eleazar there were sixteen, heads of fathers’houses; and of the sons of Ithamar, according to their fathers’houses, eight.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּחְלְק֥וּם בְּגוֹרָל֖וֹת אֵ֣לֶּה עִם־אֵ֑לֶּה כִּֽי־הָי֤וּ שָׂרֵי־קֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ וְשָׂרֵ֣י הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים מִבְּנֵ֥י אֶלְעָזָ֖ר וּבִבְנֵ֥י אִיתָמָֽר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vychlqvm bgvrlvt 'lh 'm'lh khyhyv shryqdsh vshry h'lhym mbny 'l'zr vbbny 'ytmr {s}
verses.translation: Thus were they divided by lot, one sort with another; for they were princes of the sanctuary and princes of God, both of the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיִּכְתְּבֵ֡ם שְֽׁמַעְיָה֩ בֶן־נְתַנְאֵ֨ל הַסּוֹפֵ֜ר מִן־הַלֵּוִ֗י לִפְנֵ֨י הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ וְהַשָּׂרִים֙ וְצָד֣וֹק הַכֹּהֵ֗ן וַאֲחִימֶ֙לֶךְ֙ בֶּן־אֶבְיָתָ֔ר וְרָאשֵׁי֙ הָאָב֔וֹת לַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְלַלְוִיִּ֑ם בֵּֽית־אָ֣ב אֶחָ֗ד אָחֻז֙ לְאֶלְעָזָ֔ר וְאָחֻ֥ז ׀ אָחֻ֖ז לְאִיתָמָֽר׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vykhtbm shm'yh bnntn'l hsvpr mnhlvy lpny hmlkh vhshrym vtsdvq hkhhn v'chymlkh bn'bytr vr'shy h'bvt lkhhnym vllvym byt'b 'chd 'chz l'l'zr v'chz  'chz l'ytmr {p}
verses.translation: And Shemaiah the son of Nethanel the scribe, who was of the Levites, wrote them in the presence of the king, and the princes, and Zadok the priest, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and the heads of the fathers’houses of the priests and of the Levites: one father’s house being taken for Eleazar, and proportionately for Ithamar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֞א הַגּוֹרָ֤ל הָֽרִאשׁוֹן֙ לִיה֣וֹיָרִ֔יב {ס} לִידַֽעְיָ֖ה הַשֵּׁנִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyts' hgvrl hr'shvn lyhvyryb {s} lyd'yh hshny {s}
verses.translation: Now the first lot came forth to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְחָרִם֙ הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֔י {ס} לִשְׂעֹרִ֖ים הָרְבִעִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: lchrm hshlyshy {s} lsh'rym hrb'y {s}
verses.translation: the third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְמַלְכִּיָּה֙ הַחֲמִישִׁ֔י {ס} לְמִיָּמִ֖ן הַשִּׁשִּֽׁי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: lmlkhyh hchmyshy {s} lmymn hshshy {s}
verses.translation: the fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְהַקּוֹץ֙ הַשְּׁבִעִ֔י {ס} לַאֲבִיָּ֖ה הַשְּׁמִינִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: lhqvts hshb'y {s} l'byh hshmyny {s}
verses.translation: the seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְיֵשׁ֙וּעַ֙ הַתְּשִׁעִ֔י {ס} לִשְׁכַנְיָ֖הוּ הָעֲשִׂרִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: lyshv' htsh'y {s} lshkhnyhv h'shry {s}
verses.translation: the ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְאֶלְיָשִׁיב֙ עַשְׁתֵּ֣י עָשָׂ֔ר {ס} לְיָקִ֖ים שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: l'lyshyb 'shty 'shr {s} lyqym shnym 'shr {s}
verses.translation: the eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְחֻפָּה֙ שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה עָשָׂ֔ר {ס} לְיֶשֶׁבְאָ֖ב אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָֽׂר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: lchph shlshh 'shr {s} lyshb'b 'rb'h 'shr {s}
verses.translation: the thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְבִלְגָּה֙ חֲמִשָּׁ֣ה עָשָׂ֔ר {ס} לְאִמֵּ֖ר שִׁשָּׁ֥ה עָשָֽׂר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: lblgh chmshh 'shr {s} l'mr shshh 'shr {s}
verses.translation: the fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְחֵזִיר֙ שִׁבְעָ֣ה עָשָׂ֔ר {ס} לְהַפִּצֵּ֖ץ שְׁמוֹנָ֥ה עָשָֽׂר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: lchzyr shb'h 'shr {s} lhptsts shmvnh 'shr {s}
verses.translation: the seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Happizzez;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִֽפְתַחְיָה֙ תִּשְׁעָ֣ה עָשָׂ֔ר {ס} לִֽיחֶזְקֵ֖אל הָעֶשְׂרִֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: lptchyh tsh'h 'shr {s} lychzq'l h'shrym {s}
verses.translation: the nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezkel;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְיָכִין֙ אֶחָ֣ד וְעֶשְׂרִ֔ים {ס} לְגָמ֖וּל שְׁנַ֥יִם וְעֶשְׂרִֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: lykhyn 'chd v'shrym {s} lgmvl shnym v'shrym {s}
verses.translation: the one and twentieth to Jachin, the two and twentieth to Gamul;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִדְלָיָ֙הוּ֙ שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֔ים {ס} לְמַעַזְיָ֖הוּ אַרְבָּעָ֥ה וְעֶשְׂרִֽים׃ {פ}
verses.translit: ldlyhv shlshh v'shrym {s} lm'zyhv 'rb'h v'shrym {p}
verses.translation: the three and twentieth to Delaiah, the four and twentieth to Maaziah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה פְקֻדָּתָ֞ם לַעֲבֹדָתָ֗ם לָב֤וֹא לְבֵית־יְהֹוָה֙ כְּמִשְׁפָּטָ֔ם בְּיַ֖ד אַהֲרֹ֣ן אֲבִיהֶ֑ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֔הוּ יְהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'lh pqdtm l'bdtm lbv' lbytyhvh khmshptm byd 'hrn 'byhm kh'shr tsvhv yhvh 'lhy yshr'l {p}
verses.translation: These were the orderings of them in their service, to come into the house of the LORD according to the ordinance given unto them by the hand of Aaron their father, as the LORD, the God of Israel, had commanded him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלִבְנֵ֥י לֵוִ֖י הַנּוֹתָרִ֑ים לִבְנֵ֤י עַמְרָם֙ שֽׁוּבָאֵ֔ל לִבְנֵ֥י שׁוּבָאֵ֖ל יֶחְדְּיָֽהוּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vlbny lvy hnvtrym lbny 'mrm shvb'l lbny shvb'l ychdyhv {s}
verses.translation: And of the rest of the sons of Levi: of the sons of Amram, Shubael; of the sons of Shubael, Jehdeiah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִרְחַבְיָ֑הוּ לִבְנֵ֣י רְחַבְיָ֔הוּ הָרֹ֖אשׁ יִשִּׁיָּֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: lrchbyhv lbny rchbyhv hr'sh yshyh {s}
verses.translation: Of Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, Isshiah the chief.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַיִּצְהָרִ֣י שְׁלֹמ֔וֹת לִבְנֵ֥י שְׁלֹמ֖וֹת יָֽחַת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: lytshry shlmvt lbny shlmvt ycht {s}
verses.translation: Of the Izharites, Shelomoth; of the sons of Shelomoth, Jahath.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנָ֖י יְרִיָּ֑הוּ אֲמַרְיָ֙הוּ֙ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י יַחֲזִיאֵל֙ הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֔י יְקַמְעָ֖ם הָרְבִיעִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vbny yryhv 'mryhv hshny ychzy'l hshlyshy yqm'm hrby'y {s}
verses.translation: And Benai, Jeriah, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, Jekameam the fourth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֤י עֻזִּיאֵל֙ מִיכָ֔ה לִבְנֵ֥י מִיכָ֖ה (שמור) [שָׁמִֽיר]׃
verses.translit: bny 'zy'l mykhh lbny mykhh (shmvr) [shmyr]
verses.translation: The sons of Uzziel, Micah; of the sons of Micah, Shamir.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲחִ֤י מִיכָה֙ יִשִּׁיָּ֔ה {ס} לִבְנֵ֥י יִשִּׁיָּ֖ה זְכַרְיָֽהוּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'chy mykhh yshyh {s} lbny yshyh zkhryhv {s}
verses.translation: The brother of Micah, Isshiah; of the sons of Isshiah, Zechariah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֤י מְרָרִי֙ מַחְלִ֣י וּמוּשִׁ֔י {ס} בְּנֵ֖י יַעֲזִיָּ֥הוּ בְנֽוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny mrry mchly vmvshy {s} bny y'zyhv bnv {s}
verses.translation: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi; the sons of Jaaziah, his son,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֖י מְרָרִ֑י לְיַעֲזִיָּ֣הוּ בְנ֔וֹ וְשֹׁ֥הַם וְזַכּ֖וּר וְעִבְרִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny mrry ly'zyhv bnv vshhm vzkhvr v'bry {s}
verses.translation: even the sons of Merari through Jaaziah his son: Shoham, and Zaccur, and Ibri.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְמַחְלִי֙ אֶלְעָזָ֔ר וְלֹא־הָ֥יָה ל֖וֹ בָּנִֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: lmchly 'l'zr vl'hyh lv bnym {s}
verses.translation: Of Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְקִ֖ישׁ בְּנֵי־קִ֥ישׁ יְרַחְמְאֵֽל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: lqysh bnyqysh yrchm'l {s}
verses.translation: Of Kish: the sons of Kish, Jerahmeel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֣י מוּשִׁ֔י מַחְלִ֥י וְעֵ֖דֶר וִירִימ֑וֹת אֵ֛לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י הַלְוִיִּ֖ם לְבֵ֥ית אֲבֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vbny mvshy mchly v'dr vyrymvt 'lh bny hlvym lbyt 'btyhm
verses.translation: And the sons of Mushi: Mahli, and Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites after their fathers’houses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּפִּ֩ילוּ֩ גַם־הֵ֨ם גּוֹרָל֜וֹת לְעֻמַּ֣ת  אֲחֵיהֶ֣ם בְּנֵי־אַהֲרֹ֗ן לִפְנֵ֨י דָוִ֤יד הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ וְצָד֣וֹק וַאֲחִימֶ֔לֶךְ וְרָאשֵׁי֙ הָאָב֔וֹת לַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְלַלְוִיִּ֑ם אָב֣וֹת הָרֹ֔אשׁ לְעֻמַּ֖ת אָחִ֥יו הַקָּטָֽן׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vypylv gmhm gvrlvt l'mt  'chyhm bny'hrn lpny dvyd hmlkh vtsdvq v'chymlkh vr'shy h'bvt lkhhnym vllvym 'bvt hr'sh l'mt 'chyv hqtn {s}
verses.translation: These likewise cast lots even as their brethren the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, and Zadok, and Ahimelech, and the heads of the fathers’houses of the priests and of the Levites; the fathers’houses of the chief even as those of his younger brother.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּבְדֵּ֣ל דָּוִיד֩ וְשָׂרֵ֨י הַצָּבָ֜א לַעֲבֹדָ֗ה לִבְנֵ֤י אָסָף֙ וְהֵימָ֣ן וִידוּת֔וּן (הנביאים) [הַֽנִּבְּאִ֛ים] בְּכִנֹּר֥וֹת בִּנְבָלִ֖ים וּבִמְצִלְתָּ֑יִם וַֽיְהִי֙ מִסְפָּרָ֔ם אַנְשֵׁ֥י מְלָאכָ֖ה לַעֲבֹדָתָֽם׃
verses.translit: vybdl dvyd vshry htsb' l'bdh lbny 'sf vhymn vydvtvn (hnby'ym) [hnb'ym] bkhnrvt bnblym vbmtsltym vyhy msprm 'nshy ml'khh l'bdtm
verses.translation: Moreover David and the captains of the host separated for the service certain of the sons of Asaph, and of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who should prophesy with harps, with psalteries, and with cymbals; and the number of them that did the work according to their service was:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִבְנֵ֣י אָסָ֗ף זַכּ֧וּר וְיוֹסֵ֛ף וּנְתַנְיָ֥ה וַאֲשַׂרְאֵ֖לָה בְּנֵ֣י אָסָ֑ף עַ֚ל יַד־אָסָ֔ף הַנִּבָּ֖א עַל־יְדֵ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.translit: lbny 'sf zkhvr vyvsf vntnyh v'shr'lh bny 'sf 'l yd'sf hnb' 'lydy hmlkh
verses.translation: of the sons of Asaph: Zaccur, and Joseph, and Nethaniah, and Asarelah, the sons of Asaph; under the hand of Asaph, who prophesied according to the direction of the king.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִידוּת֑וּן בְּנֵ֣י יְדוּת֡וּן גְּדַלְיָ֡הוּ וּצְרִ֡י וִ֠ישַׁעְיָ֠הוּ חֲשַׁבְיָ֨הוּ וּמַתִּתְיָ֜הוּ שִׁשָּׁ֗ה עַל֩ יְדֵ֨י אֲבִיהֶ֤ם יְדוּתוּן֙ בַּכִּנּ֔וֹר הַנִּבָּ֕א עַל־הֹד֥וֹת וְהַלֵּ֖ל לַיהֹוָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: lydvtvn bny ydvtvn gdlyhv vtsry vysh'yhv chshbyhv vmttyhv shshh 'l ydy 'byhm ydvtvn bkhnvr hnb' 'lhdvt vhll lyhvh {s}
verses.translation: Of Jeduthun: the sons of Jeduthun: Gedaliah, and Zeri, and Jeshaiah, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six; under the hands of their father Jeduthun with the harp, who prophesied in giving thanks and praising the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְהֵימָ֑ן בְּנֵ֣י הֵימָ֡ן בֻּקִּיָּ֡הוּ מַתַּנְיָ֡הוּ עֻ֠זִּיאֵ֠ל שְׁבוּאֵ֨ל וִירִימ֜וֹת חֲנַנְיָ֣ה חֲנָ֗נִי אֱלִיאָ֤תָה גִדַּ֙לְתִּי֙ וְרֹמַ֣מְתִּי עֶ֔זֶר יׇשְׁבְּקָ֣שָׁה מַלּ֔וֹתִי הוֹתִ֖יר מַחֲזִיאֹֽת׃
verses.translit: lhymn bny hymn bqyhv mtnyhv 'zy'l shbv'l vyrymvt chnnyh chnny 'ly'th gdlty vrmmty 'zr yshbqshh mlvty hvtyr mchzy't
verses.translation: Of Heman: the sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, and Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, and Romamti-ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, Mahazioth;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־אֵ֨לֶּה בָנִ֜ים לְהֵימָ֗ן חֹזֵ֥ה הַמֶּ֛לֶךְ בְּדִבְרֵ֥י הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים לְהָרִ֣ים קָ֑רֶן וַיִּתֵּ֨ן הָאֱלֹהִ֜ים לְהֵימָ֗ן בָּנִ֛ים אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר וּבָנ֥וֹת שָׁלֽוֹשׁ׃
verses.translit: khl'lh bnym lhymn chzh hmlkh bdbry h'lhym lhrym qrn vytn h'lhym lhymn bnym 'rb'h 'shr vbnvt shlvsh
verses.translation: all these were the sons of Heman the king’s seer in the things pertaining to God, to lift up the horn. And God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־אֵ֣לֶּה עַל־יְדֵי֩ אֲבִיהֶ֨ם בַּשִּׁ֜יר בֵּ֣ית יְהֹוָ֗ה בִּמְצִלְתַּ֙יִם֙ נְבָלִ֣ים וְכִנֹּר֔וֹת לַעֲבֹדַ֖ת בֵּ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים עַ֚ל יְדֵ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ אָסָ֥ף וִידוּת֖וּן וְהֵימָֽן׃
verses.translit: khl'lh 'lydy 'byhm bshyr byt yhvh bmtsltym nblym vkhnrvt l'bdt byt h'lhym 'l ydy hmlkh 'sf vydvtvn vhymn
verses.translation: All these were under the hands of their fathers for song in the house of the LORD, with cymbals, psalteries, and harps, for the service of the house of God, according to the direction of the king—Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֤י מִסְפָּרָם֙ עִם־אֲחֵיהֶ֔ם מְלֻמְּדֵי־שִׁ֖יר לַיהֹוָ֑ה כׇּ֨ל־הַמֵּבִ֔ין מָאתַ֖יִם שְׁמוֹנִ֥ים וּשְׁמוֹנָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyhy msprm 'm'chyhm mlmdyshyr lyhvh khlhmbyn m'tym shmvnym vshmvnh
verses.translation: And the number of them, with their brethren that were instructed in singing unto the LORD, even all that were skilful, was two hundred fourscore and eight.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּפִּ֜ילוּ גּוֹרָל֣וֹת מִשְׁמֶ֗רֶת לְעֻמַּת֙ כַּקָּטֹ֣ן כַּגָּד֔וֹל מֵבִ֖ין עִם־תַּלְמִֽיד׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vypylv gvrlvt mshmrt l'mt khqtn khgdvl mbyn 'mtlmyd {p}
verses.translation: And they cast lots ward against [ward], as well the small as the great, the teacher as the scholar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֞א הַגּוֹרָ֧ל הָרִאשׁ֛וֹן לְאָסָ֖ף לְיוֹסֵ֑ף {ס} גְּדַלְיָ֙הוּ֙ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י הֽוּא־וְאֶחָ֥יו וּבָנָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyts' hgvrl hr'shvn l'sf lyvsf {s} gdlyhv hshny hv'v'chyv vbnyv shnym 'shr {s}
verses.translation: Now the first lot came forth for Asaph to Joseph; The second to Gedaliah; he and his brethren and sons were twelve;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַשְּׁלִשִׁ֣י זַכּ֔וּר בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hshlshy zkhvr bnyv v'chyv shnym 'shr {s}
verses.translation: The third to Zaccur, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָֽרְבִיעִי֙ לַיִּצְרִ֔י בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hrby'y lytsry bnyv v'chyv shnym 'shr {s}
verses.translation: The fourth to Izri, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַחֲמִישִׁ֣י נְתַנְיָ֔הוּ בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hchmyshy ntnyhv bnyv v'chyv shnym 'shr {s}
verses.translation: The fifth to Nethaniah, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַשִּׁשִּׁ֣י בֻקִּיָּ֔הוּ בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hshshy bqyhv bnyv v'chyv shnym 'shr {s}
verses.translation: The sixth to Bukkiah, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַשְּׁבִעִ֣י יְשַׂרְאֵ֔לָה בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hshb'y yshr'lh bnyv v'chyv shnym 'shr {s}
verses.translation: The seventh to Jesarelah, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַשְּׁמִינִ֣י יְשַֽׁעְיָ֔הוּ בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hshmyny ysh'yhv bnyv v'chyv shnym 'shr {s}
verses.translation: The eighth to Jeshaiah, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַתְּשִׁיעִ֣י מַתַּנְיָ֔הוּ בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: htshy'y mtnyhv bnyv v'chyv shnym 'shr {s}
verses.translation: The ninth to Mattaniah, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָעֲשִׂירִ֣י שִׁמְעִ֔י בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: h'shyry shm'y bnyv v'chyv shnym 'shr {s}
verses.translation: The tenth to Shimei, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַשְׁתֵּי־עָשָׂ֣ר עֲזַרְאֵ֔ל בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'shty'shr 'zr'l bnyv v'chyv shnym 'shr {s}
verses.translation: The eleventh to Azarel, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַשְּׁנֵ֤ים עָשָׂר֙ לַֽחֲשַׁבְיָ֔ה בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hshnym 'shr lchshbyh bnyv v'chyv shnym 'shr {s}
verses.translation: The twelfth to Hashabiah, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִשְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה עָשָׂר֙ שֽׁוּבָאֵ֔ל בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: lshlshh 'shr shvb'l bnyv v'chyv shnym 'shr {s}
verses.translation: For the thirteenth, Shubael, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְאַרְבָּעָ֤ה עָשָׂר֙ מַתִּתְיָ֔הוּ בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: l'rb'h 'shr mttyhv bnyv v'chyv shnym 'shr {s}
verses.translation: For the fourteenth, Mattithiah, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַחֲמִשָּׁ֤ה עָשָׂר֙ לִירֵמ֔וֹת בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: lchmshh 'shr lyrmvt bnyv v'chyv shnym 'shr {s}
verses.translation: For the fifteenth to Jeremoth, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְשִׁשָּׁ֤ה עָשָׂר֙ לַחֲנַנְיָ֔הוּ בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: lshshh 'shr lchnnyhv bnyv v'chyv shnym 'shr {s}
verses.translation: For the sixteenth to Hananiah, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְשִׁבְעָ֤ה עָשָׂר֙ לְיׇשְׁבְּקָ֔שָׁה בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: lshb'h 'shr lyshbqshh bnyv v'chyv shnym 'shr {s}
verses.translation: For the seventeenth to Joshbekashah, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִשְׁמוֹנָ֤ה עָשָׂר֙ לַחֲנָ֔נִי בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: lshmvnh 'shr lchnny bnyv v'chyv shnym 'shr {s}
verses.translation: For the eighteenth to Hanani, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְתִשְׁעָ֤ה עָשָׂר֙ לְמַלּ֔וֹתִי בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: ltsh'h 'shr lmlvty bnyv v'chyv shnym 'shr {s}
verses.translation: For the nineteenth to Mallothi, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְעֶשְׂרִים֙ לֶאֱלִיָּ֔תָה בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: l'shrym l'lyth bnyv v'chyv shnym 'shr {s}
verses.translation: For the twentieth to Eliathah, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְאֶחָ֤ד וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ לְהוֹתִ֔יר בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: l'chd v'shrym lhvtyr bnyv v'chyv shnym 'shr {s}
verses.translation: For the one and twentieth to Hothir, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִשְׁנַ֤יִם וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ לְגִדַּ֔לְתִּי בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: lshnym v'shrym lgdlty bnyv v'chyv shnym 'shr {s}
verses.translation: For the two and twentieth to Giddalti, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִשְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ לְמַ֣חֲזִיא֔וֹת בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: lshlshh v'shrym lmchzy'vt bnyv v'chyv shnym 'shr {s}
verses.translation: For the three and twentieth to Mahazioth, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְאַרְבָּעָ֤ה וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ לְרוֹמַ֣מְתִּי עָ֔זֶר בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃ {פ}
verses.translit: l'rb'h v'shrym lrvmmty 'zr bnyv v'chyv shnym 'shr {p}
verses.translation: For the four and twentieth to Romamti-ezer, his sons and his brethren, twelve.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְמַחְלְק֖וֹת לְשֹׁעֲרִ֑ים לַקׇּרְחִ֕ים מְשֶׁלֶמְיָ֥הוּ בֶן־קֹרֵ֖א מִן־בְּנֵ֥י אָסָֽף׃
verses.translit: lmchlqvt lsh'rym lqrchym mshlmyhv bnqr' mnbny 'sf
verses.translation: For the courses of the doorkeepers: of the Korahites: Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלִמְשֶׁלֶמְיָ֖הוּ בָּנִ֑ים זְכַרְיָ֤הוּ הַבְּכוֹר֙ יְדִיעֲאֵ֣ל הַשֵּׁנִ֔י זְבַדְיָ֙הוּ֙ הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֔י יַתְנִיאֵ֖ל הָרְבִיעִֽי׃
verses.translit: vlmshlmyhv bnym zkhryhv hbkhvr ydy''l hshny zbdyhv hshlyshy ytny'l hrby'y
verses.translation: And Meshelemiah had sons: Zechariah the first-born, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֵילָ֤ם הַחֲמִישִׁי֙ יְהוֹחָנָ֣ן הַשִּׁשִּׁ֔י אֶלְיְהוֹעֵינַ֖י הַשְּׁבִיעִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'ylm hchmyshy yhvchnn hshshy 'lyhv'yny hshby'y
verses.translation: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, Eliehoenai the seventh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְעֹבֵ֥ד אֱדֹ֖ם בָּנִ֑ים שְׁמַעְיָ֤ה הַבְּכוֹר֙ יְהוֹזָבָ֣ד הַשֵּׁנִ֔י יוֹאָ֤ח הַשְּׁלִשִׁי֙ וְשָׂכָ֣ר הָרְבִיעִ֔י וּנְתַנְאֵ֖ל הַחֲמִישִֽׁי׃
verses.translit: vl'bd 'dm bnym shm'yh hbkhvr yhvzbd hshny yv'ch hshlshy vshkhr hrby'y vntn'l hchmyshy
verses.translation: And Obed-edom had sons: Shemaiah the first-born, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, and Sacar the fourth, and Nethanel the fifth;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַמִּיאֵ֤ל הַשִּׁשִּׁי֙ יִשָּׂשכָ֣ר הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י פְּעֻלְּתַ֖י הַשְּׁמִינִ֑י כִּ֥י בֵרְכ֖וֹ אֱלֹהִֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'my'l hshshy yshshkhr hshby'y p'lty hshmyny khy brkhv 'lhym {s}
verses.translation: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, Peullethai the eighth; for God blessed him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלִֽשְׁמַעְיָ֤ה בְנוֹ֙ נוֹלַ֣ד בָּנִ֔ים הַמִּמְשָׁלִ֖ים לְבֵ֣ית אֲבִיהֶ֑ם כִּֽי־גִבּ֥וֹרֵי חַ֖יִל הֵֽמָּה׃
verses.translit: vlshm'yh bnv nvld bnym hmmshlym lbyt 'byhm khygbvry chyl hmh
verses.translation: Also unto Shemaiah his son were sons born, that ruled over the house of their father; for they were mighty men of valour.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י שְׁמַֽעְיָ֗ה עׇ֠תְנִ֠י וּרְפָאֵ֨ל וְעוֹבֵ֧ד אֶלְזָבָ֛ד אֶחָ֖יו בְּנֵי־חָ֑יִל אֱלִיה֖וּ וּסְמַכְיָֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: bny shm'yh 'tny vrp'l v'vbd 'lzbd 'chyv bnychyl 'lyhv vsmkhyhv
verses.translation: The sons of Shemaiah: Othni, and Rephael and Obed and Elzabad his brethren, valiant men; Elihu also, and Semachiah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־אֵ֜לֶּה מִבְּנֵ֣י  עֹבֵ֣ד אֱדֹ֗ם הֵ֤מָּה וּבְנֵיהֶם֙ וַאֲחֵיהֶ֔ם אִֽישׁ־חַ֥יִל בַּכֹּ֖חַ לַעֲבֹדָ֑ה שִׁשִּׁ֥ים וּשְׁנַ֖יִם לְעֹבֵ֥ד אֱדֹֽם׃
verses.translit: khl'lh mbny  'bd 'dm hmh vbnyhm v'chyhm 'yshchyl bkhch l'bdh shshym vshnym l'bd 'dm
verses.translation: All these were of the sons of Obed-edom: they and their sons and their brethren, able men in strength for the service; threescore and two of Obed-edom.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלִמְשֶׁלֶמְיָ֗הוּ בָּנִ֧ים וְאַחִ֛ים בְּנֵי־חָ֖יִל שְׁמוֹנָ֥ה עָשָֽׂר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vlmshlmyhv bnym v'chym bnychyl shmvnh 'shr {s}
verses.translation: And Meshelemiah had sons and brethren, valiant men, eighteen.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְחֹסָ֥ה מִן־בְּנֵי־מְרָרִ֖י בָּנִ֑ים שִׁמְרִ֤י הָרֹאשׁ֙ כִּ֣י לֹֽא־הָיָ֣ה בְכ֔וֹר וַיְשִׂימֵ֥הוּ אָבִ֖יהוּ לְרֹֽאשׁ׃
verses.translit: vlchsh mnbnymrry bnym shmry hr'sh khy l'hyh bkhvr vyshymhv 'byhv lr'sh
verses.translation: Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons: Shimri the chief—for though he was not the firstborn, yet his father made him chief—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חִלְקִיָּ֤הוּ הַשֵּׁנִי֙ טְבַלְיָ֣הוּ הַשְּׁלִשִׁ֔י זְכַרְיָ֖הוּ הָרְבִעִ֑י כׇּל־בָּנִ֧ים וְאַחִ֛ים לְחֹסָ֖ה שְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה עָשָֽׂר׃
verses.translit: chlqyhv hshny tblyhv hshlshy zkhryhv hrb'y khlbnym v'chym lchsh shlshh 'shr
verses.translation: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, Zechariah the fourth; all the sons and brethren of Hosah were thirteen.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְ֠אֵ֠לֶּה מַחְלְק֨וֹת הַשֹּׁעֲרִ֜ים לְרָאשֵׁ֧י הַגְּבָרִ֛ים מִשְׁמָר֖וֹת לְעֻמַּ֣ת אֲחֵיהֶ֑ם לְשָׁרֵ֖ת בְּבֵ֥ית יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: l'lh mchlqvt hsh'rym lr'shy hgbrym mshmrvt l'mt 'chyhm lshrt bbyt yhvh
verses.translation: These courses of the doorkeepers, even the chief men, had wards over against their brethren, to minister in the house of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּפִּ֨ילוּ גוֹרָל֜וֹת כַּקָּטֹ֧ן כַּגָּד֛וֹל לְבֵ֥ית אֲבוֹתָ֖ם לְשַׁ֥עַר וָשָֽׁעַר׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vypylv gvrlvt khqtn khgdvl lbyt 'bvtm lsh'r vsh'r {p}
verses.translation: And they cast lots, as well the small as the great, according to their fathers’houses, for every gate.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּפֹּ֧ל הַגּוֹרָ֛ל מִזְרָ֖חָה לְשֶׁלֶמְיָ֑הוּ וּזְכַרְיָ֨הוּ בְנ֜וֹ יוֹעֵ֣ץ  בְּשֶׂ֗כֶל הִפִּ֙ילוּ֙ גּֽוֹרָל֔וֹת וַיֵּצֵ֥א גוֹרָל֖וֹ צָפֽוֹנָה׃
verses.translit: vypl hgvrl mzrchh lshlmyhv vzkhryhv bnv yv'ts  bshkhl hpylv gvrlvt vyts' gvrlv tspvnh
verses.translation: And the lot eastward fell to Shelemiah. Then for Zechariah his son, a discreet counsellor, they cast lots; and his lot came out northward.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְעֹבֵ֥ד אֱדֹ֖ם נֶ֑גְבָּה וּלְבָנָ֖יו בֵּ֥ית הָאֲסֻפִּֽים׃
verses.translit: l'bd 'dm ngbh vlbnyv byt h'spym
verses.translation: To Obed-edom southward; and to his sons the Storehouse.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְשֻׁפִּ֤ים וּלְחֹסָה֙ לַֽמַּעֲרָ֔ב עִ֚ם שַׁ֣עַר שַׁלֶּ֔כֶת בַּֽמְסִלָּ֖ה הָעוֹלָ֑ה מִשְׁמָ֖ר לְעֻמַּ֥ת מִשְׁמָֽר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: lshpym vlchsh lm'rb 'm sh'r shlkht bmslh h'vlh mshmr l'mt mshmr {s}
verses.translation: To Shuppim and Hosah westward, by the gate of Shallecheth, at the causeway that goeth up, ward against ward.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַמִּזְרָח֮ הַלְוִיִּ֣ם שִׁשָּׁה֒ לַצָּפ֤וֹנָה לַיּוֹם֙ אַרְבָּעָ֔ה לַנֶּ֥גְבָּה לַיּ֖וֹם אַרְבָּעָ֑ה {ס} וְלָאֲסֻפִּ֖ים שְׁנַ֥יִם שְׁנָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: lmzrch hlvym shshh ltspvnh lyvm 'rb'h lngbh lyvm 'rb'h {s} vl'spym shnym shnym
verses.translation: Eastward were six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and for the Storehouse two and two.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַפַּרְבָּ֖ר לַֽמַּעֲרָ֑ב אַרְבָּעָה֙ לַֽמְסִלָּ֔ה שְׁנַ֖יִם לַפַּרְבָּֽר׃
verses.translit: lprbr lm'rb 'rb'h lmslh shnym lprbr
verses.translation: For the Precinct westward, four at the causeway, and two at the Precinct.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֗לֶּה מַחְלְקוֹת֙ הַשֹּׁ֣עֲרִ֔ים לִבְנֵ֥י הַקׇּרְחִ֖י וְלִבְנֵ֥י מְרָרִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'lh mchlqvt hsh'rym lbny hqrchy vlbny mrry
verses.translation: These were the courses of the doorkeepers; of the sons of the Korahites, and of the sons of Merari.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽהַלְוִיִּ֑ם אֲחִיָּ֗ה עַל־אֽוֹצְרוֹת֙ בֵּ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים וּלְאֹצְר֖וֹת הַקֳּדָשִֽׁים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vhlvym 'chyh 'l'vtsrvt byt h'lhym vl'tsrvt hqdshym {s}
verses.translation: And of the Levites, Ahijah was over the treasuries of the house of God, and over the treasuries of the hallowed things.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י לַ֠עְדָּ֠ן בְּנֵ֨י הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּ֜י לְלַעְדָּ֗ן רָאשֵׁ֧י הָאָב֛וֹת לְלַעְדָּ֥ן הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּ֖י יְחִיאֵלִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny l'dn bny hgrshny ll'dn r'shy h'bvt ll'dn hgrshny ychy'ly {s}
verses.translation: The sons of Ladan, the sons of the Gershonites belonging to Ladan, the heads of the fathers’houses belonging to Ladan the Gershonite: Jehieli.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֖י יְחִיאֵלִ֑י זֵתָם֙ וְיוֹאֵ֣ל אָחִ֔יו עַל־אֹצְר֖וֹת בֵּ֥ית יְהֹוָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bny ychy'ly ztm vyv'l 'chyv 'l'tsrvt byt yhvh {s}
verses.translation: The sons of Jehieli: Zetham, and Joel his brother, over the treasuries of the house of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַֽעַמְרָמִי֙ לַיִּצְהָרִ֔י לַחֶבְרוֹנִ֖י לָעׇזִּיאֵלִֽי׃
verses.translit: l'mrmy lytshry lchbrvny l'zy'ly
verses.translation: Of the Amramites, of the Izharites, of the Hebronites, of the Uzzielites;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׁבֻאֵל֙ בֶּן־גֵּרְשׁ֣וֹם בֶּן־מֹשֶׁ֔ה נָגִ֖יד עַל־הָאֹצָרֽוֹת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vshb'l bngrshvm bnmshh ngyd 'lh'tsrvt {s}
verses.translation: Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was ruler over the treasuries.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶחָ֖יו לֶאֱלִיעֶ֑זֶר רְחַבְיָ֨הוּ בְנ֜וֹ וִישַׁעְיָ֤הֽוּ בְנוֹ֙ וְיֹרָ֣ם בְּנ֔וֹ וְזִכְרִ֥י בְנ֖וֹ (ושלמות) [וּשְׁלֹמִ֥ית] בְּנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'chyv l'ly'zr rchbyhv bnv vysh'yhv bnv vyrm bnv vzkhry bnv (vshlmvt) [vshlmyt] bnv
verses.translation: And his brethren by Eliezer: Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomith his son.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֧וּא שְׁלֹמ֣וֹת וְאֶחָ֗יו עַ֣ל כׇּל־אֹצְר֤וֹת הַקֳּדָשִׁים֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִקְדִּ֜ישׁ דָּוִ֣יד הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ וְרָאשֵׁ֧י הָאָב֛וֹת לְשָׂרֵֽי־הָאֲלָפִ֥ים וְהַמֵּא֖וֹת וְשָׂרֵ֥י הַצָּבָֽא׃
verses.translit: hv' shlmvt v'chyv 'l khl'tsrvt hqdshym 'shr hqdysh dvyd hmlkh vr'shy h'bvt lshryh'lpym vhm'vt vshry htsb'
verses.translation: This Shelomith and his brethren were over all the treasuries of the dedicated things, which David the king, and the heads of the fathers’houses, the captains over thousands and hundreds, and the captains of the host, had dedicated.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִן־הַמִּלְחָמ֥וֹת וּמִן־הַשָּׁלָ֖ל הִקְדִּ֑ישׁוּ לְחַזֵּ֖ק לְבֵ֥ית יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: mnhmlchmvt vmnhshll hqdyshv lchzq lbyt yhvh
verses.translation: Out of the spoil won in battles did they dedicate to repair the house of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכֹ֨ל הַהִקְדִּ֜ישׁ שְׁמוּאֵ֤ל הָרֹאֶה֙ וְשָׁא֣וּל בֶּן־קִ֔ישׁ וְאַבְנֵ֣ר בֶּן־נֵ֔ר וְיוֹאָ֖ב בֶּן־צְרוּיָ֑ה כֹּ֚ל הַמַּקְדִּ֔ישׁ עַ֥ל יַד־שְׁלֹמִ֖ית וְאֶחָֽיו׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vkhl hhqdysh shmv'l hr'h vsh'vl bnqysh v'bnr bnnr vyv'b bntsrvyh khl hmqdysh 'l ydshlmyt v'chyv {p}
verses.translation: And all that Samuel the seer, and Saul the son of Kish, and Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah, had dedicated; whosoever had dedicated any thing, it was under the hand of Shelomith, and of his brethren.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַיִּצְהָרִ֞י כְּנַנְיָ֣הוּ וּבָנָ֗יו לַמְּלָאכָ֤ה הַחִֽיצוֹנָה֙ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְשֹׁטְרִ֖ים וּלְשֹׁפְטִֽים׃
verses.translit: lytshry khnnyhv vbnyv lml'khh hchytsvnh 'lyshr'l lshtrym vlshptym
verses.translation: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sorts were for the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַחֶבְרוֹנִ֡י חֲשַׁבְיָ֩הוּ֩ וְאֶחָ֨יו בְּנֵי־חַ֜יִל אֶ֣לֶף וּשְׁבַע־מֵא֗וֹת עַ֚ל פְּקֻדַּ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מֵעֵ֥בֶר לַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן מַעְרָ֑בָה לְכֹל֙ מְלֶ֣אכֶת יְהֹוָ֔ה וְלַעֲבֹדַ֖ת הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.translit: lchbrvny chshbyhv v'chyv bnychyl 'lf vshb'm'vt 'l pqdt yshr'l m'br lyrdn m'rbh lkhl ml'kht yhvh vl'bdt hmlkh
verses.translation: Of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brethren, men of valour, a thousand and seven hundred, had the oversight of Israel beyond the Jordan westward; for all the business of the LORD, and for the service of the king.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַֽחֶבְרוֹנִי֙ יְרִיָּ֣ה הָרֹ֔אשׁ לַֽחֶבְרוֹנִ֥י לְתֹלְדֹתָ֖יו לְאָב֑וֹת בִּשְׁנַ֨ת הָאַרְבָּעִ֜ים לְמַלְכ֤וּת דָּוִיד֙ נִדְרָ֔שׁוּ וַיִּמָּצֵ֥א בָהֶ֛ם גִּבּ֥וֹרֵי חַ֖יִל בְּיַעְזֵ֥יר גִּלְעָֽד׃
verses.translit: lchbrvny yryh hr'sh lchbrvny ltldtyv l'bvt bshnt h'rb'ym lmlkhvt dvyd ndrshv vymts' bhm gbvry chyl by'zyr gl'd
verses.translation: Of the Hebronites was Jerijah the chief, even of the Hebronites, according to their generations by fathers’houses. In the fortieth year of the reign of David they were sought for, and there were found among them mighty men of valour at Jazer of Gilead.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶחָ֣יו בְּנֵי־חַ֗יִל אַלְפַּ֛יִם וּשְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת רָאשֵׁ֣י הָאָב֑וֹת וַֽיַּפְקִידֵ֞ם דָּוִ֣יד הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ עַל־הָראוּבֵנִ֤י וְהַגָּדִי֙ וַחֲצִי֙ שֵׁ֣בֶט הַֽמְנַשִּׁ֔י לְכׇל־דְּבַ֥ר הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים וּדְבַ֥ר הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'chyv bnychyl 'lpym vshb' m'vt r'shy h'bvt vypqydm dvyd hmlkh 'lhr'vbny vhgdy vchtsy shbt hmnshy lkhldbr h'lhym vdbr hmlkh {p}
verses.translation: And his brethren, men of valour, were two thousand and seven hundred, heads of fathers’houses, whom king David made overseers over the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half-tribe of the Manassites, for every matter pertaining to God, and for the affairs of the king.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל ׀ לְֽמִסְפָּרָ֡ם רָאשֵׁ֣י הָאָב֣וֹת וְשָׂרֵ֣י הָאֲלָפִ֣ים ׀ וְהַמֵּא֡וֹת וְשֹׁטְרֵיהֶם֩ הַמְשָׁרְתִ֨ים אֶת־הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ לְכֹ֣ל  דְּבַ֣ר הַֽמַּחְלְק֗וֹת הַבָּאָ֤ה וְהַיֹּצֵאת֙ חֹ֣דֶשׁ בְּחֹ֔דֶשׁ לְכֹ֖ל חׇדְשֵׁ֣י הַשָּׁנָ֑ה הַֽמַּחֲלֹ֙קֶת֙ הָאַחַ֔ת עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vbny yshr'l  lmsprm r'shy h'bvt vshry h'lpym  vhm'vt vshtryhm hmshrtym 'thmlkh lkhl  dbr hmchlqvt hb'h vhyts't chdsh bchdsh lkhl chdshy hshnh hmchlqt h'cht 'shrym v'rb'h 'lf {p}
verses.translation: Now the children of Israel after their number, to wit, the heads of fathers’houses and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and their officers that served the king, in any matter of the courses which came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year, of every course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַ֞ל הַמַּחֲלֹ֤קֶת הָרִֽאשׁוֹנָה֙ לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֔וֹן יָשׇׁבְעָ֖ם בֶּן־זַבְדִּיאֵ֑ל וְעַל֙ מַחֲלֻקְתּ֔וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'l hmchlqt hr'shvnh lchdsh hr'shvn yshb'm bnzbdy'l v'l mchlqtv 'shrym v'rb'h 'lf {s}
verses.translation: Over the first course for the first month was Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel; and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִן־בְּנֵי־פֶ֗רֶץ הָרֹ֛אשׁ לְכׇל־שָׂרֵ֥י הַצְּבָא֖וֹת לַחֹ֥דֶשׁ הָרִאשֽׁוֹן׃ {ס}
verses.translit: mnbnyprts hr'sh lkhlshry htsb'vt lchdsh hr'shvn {s}
verses.translation: Of the children of Perez was he, and the chief of all the captains of the host for the first month.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַ֞ל מַחֲלֹ֣קֶת  הַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִ֗י דּוֹדַ֤י הָֽאֲחוֹחִי֙ וּמַ֣חֲלֻקְתּ֔וֹ וּמִקְל֖וֹת הַנָּגִ֑יד וְעַל֙ מַחֲלֻקְתּ֔וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'l mchlqt  hchdsh hshny dvdy h'chvchy vmchlqtv vmqlvt hngyd v'l mchlqtv 'shrym v'rb'h 'lf {s}
verses.translation: And over the course of the second month was Dodai the Ahohite, and his course, and Mikloth the ruler; and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שַׂ֣ר הַצָּבָ֤א הַשְּׁלִישִׁי֙ לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֔י בְּנָיָ֧הוּ בֶן־יְהוֹיָדָ֛ע הַכֹּהֵ֖ן רֹ֑אשׁ וְעַל֙ מַחֲלֻקְתּ֔וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃
verses.translit: shr htsb' hshlyshy lchdsh hshlyshy bnyhv bnyhvyd' hkhhn r'sh v'l mchlqtv 'shrym v'rb'h 'lf
verses.translation: The third captain of the host for the third month was Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the priest, chief; and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֧וּא בְנָיָ֛הוּ גִּבּ֥וֹר הַשְּׁלֹשִׁ֖ים וְעַל־הַשְּׁלֹשִׁ֑ים וּמַ֣חֲלֻקְתּ֔וֹ עַמִּיזָבָ֖ד בְּנֽוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hv' bnyhv gbvr hshlshym v'lhshlshym vmchlqtv 'myzbd bnv {s}
verses.translation: This is that Benaiah, who was the mighty man of the thirty, and over the thirty; and of his course was Ammizabad his son.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָרְבִיעִ֞י לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָרְבִיעִ֗י עֲשָׂהאֵל֙ אֲחִ֣י יוֹאָ֔ב וּזְבַדְיָ֥ה בְנ֖וֹ אַחֲרָ֑יו וְעַל֙ מַחֲלֻקְתּ֔וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hrby'y lchdsh hrby'y 'shh'l 'chy yv'b vzbdyh bnv 'chryv v'l mchlqtv 'shrym v'rb'h 'lf {s}
verses.translation: The fourth captain for the fourth month was Asahel the brother of Joab, and Zebadiah his son after him; and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַחֲמִישִׁי֙ לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַחֲמִישִׁ֔י הַשַּׂ֖ר שַׁמְה֣וּת הַיִּזְרָ֑ח וְעַל֙ מַחֲלֻקְתּ֔וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hchmyshy lchdsh hchmyshy hshr shmhvt hyzrch v'l mchlqtv 'shrym v'rb'h 'lf {s}
verses.translation: The fifth captain for the fifth month was Shamhuth the Izrahite; and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַשִּׁשִּׁי֙ לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשִּׁשִּׁ֔י עִירָ֥א בֶן־עִקֵּ֖שׁ הַתְּקוֹעִ֑י וְעַל֙ מַחֲלֻקְתּ֔וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hshshy lchdsh hshshy 'yr' bn'qsh htqv'y v'l mchlqtv 'shrym v'rb'h 'lf {s}
verses.translation: The sixth captain for the sixth month was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite; and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַשְּׁבִיעִי֙ לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י חֶ֥לֶץ הַפְּלוֹנִ֖י מִן־בְּנֵ֣י אֶפְרָ֑יִם וְעַל֙ מַחֲלֻקְתּ֔וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hshby'y lchdsh hshby'y chlts hplvny mnbny 'prym v'l mchlqtv 'shrym v'rb'h 'lf {s}
verses.translation: The seventh captain for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite, of the children of Ephraim; and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַשְּׁמִינִי֙ לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשְּׁמִינִ֔י סִבְּכַ֥י הַחֻשָׁתִ֖י לַזַּרְחִ֑י וְעַל֙ מַחֲלֻקְתּ֔וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hshmyny lchdsh hshmyny sbkhy hchshty lzrchy v'l mchlqtv 'shrym v'rb'h 'lf {s}
verses.translation: The eighth captain for the eighth month was Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zerahites; and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַתְּשִׁיעִי֙ לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַתְּשִׁיעִ֔י אֲבִיעֶ֥זֶר הָעַנְּתוֹתִ֖י (לבנימיני) [לַבֵּ֣ן ׀ יְמִינִ֑י] וְעַל֙ מַחֲלֻקְתּ֔וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃ {ס}
verses.translit: htshy'y lchdsh htshy'y 'by'zr h'ntvty (lbnymyny) [lbn  ymyny] v'l mchlqtv 'shrym v'rb'h 'lf {s}
verses.translation: The ninth captain for the ninth month was Abiezer the Anathothite, of the Benjamites; and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
