verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָעֲשִׂירִי֙ לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָעֲשִׂירִ֔י מַהְרַ֥י הַנְּטוֹפָתִ֖י לַזַּרְחִ֑י וְעַל֙ מַחֲלֻקְתּ֔וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃ {ס}
verses.translit: h'shyry lchdsh h'shyry mhry hntvpty lzrchy v'l mchlqtv 'shrym v'rb'h 'lf {s}
verses.translation: The tenth captain for the tenth month was Mahrai, the Netophathite, of the Zerahites; and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַשְׁתֵּֽי־עָשָׂר֙ לְעַשְׁתֵּ֣י עָשָׂ֣ר הַחֹ֔דֶשׁ בְּנָיָ֥ה הַפִּרְעָתוֹנִ֖י מִן־בְּנֵ֣י אֶפְרָ֑יִם וְעַל֙ מַחֲלֻקְתּ֔וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'shty'shr l'shty 'shr hchdsh bnyh hpr'tvny mnbny 'prym v'l mchlqtv 'shrym v'rb'h 'lf {s}
verses.translation: The eleventh captain for the eleventh month was Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the children of Ephraim; and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַשְּׁנֵ֤ים עָשָׂר֙ לִשְׁנֵ֣ים עָשָׂ֣ר הַחֹ֔דֶשׁ חֶלְדַּ֥י הַנְּטוֹפָתִ֖י לְעׇתְנִיאֵ֑ל וְעַל֙ מַחֲלֻקְתּ֔וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃ {פ}
verses.translit: hshnym 'shr lshnym 'shr hchdsh chldy hntvpty l'tny'l v'l mchlqtv 'shrym v'rb'h 'lf {p}
verses.translation: The twelfth captain for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel; and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַל֙ שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לָראוּבֵנִ֣י נָגִ֔יד אֱלִיעֶ֖זֶר בֶּן־זִכְרִ֑י {ס} לַשִּׁ֨מְעוֹנִ֔י שְׁפַטְיָ֖הוּ בֶּֽן־מַעֲכָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'l shbty yshr'l lr'vbny ngyd 'ly'zr bnzkhry {s} lshm'vny shptyhv bnm'khh {s}
verses.translation: Furthermore over the tribes of Israel: of the Reubenites was Eliezer the son of Zichri the ruler; of the Simeonites, Shephatiah the son of Maacah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְלֵוִ֛י חֲשַׁבְיָ֥ה בֶן־קְמוּאֵ֖ל לְאַהֲרֹ֥ן צָדֽוֹק׃ {ס}
verses.translit: llvy chshbyh bnqmv'l l'hrn tsdvq {s}
verses.translation: of Levi, Hashabiah the son of Kemuel; of Aaron, Zadok;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִיהוּדָ֕ה אֱלִיה֖וּ מֵאֲחֵ֣י דָוִ֑יד {ס} לְיִ֨שָּׂשכָ֔ר עׇמְרִ֖י בֶּן־מִיכָאֵֽל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: lyhvdh 'lyhv m'chy dvyd {s} lyshshkhr 'mry bnmykh'l {s}
verses.translation: of Judah, Elihu, one of the brethren of David; of Issachar, Omri the son of Michael;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִזְבוּלֻ֕ן יִֽשְׁמַעְיָ֖הוּ בֶּן־עֹבַדְיָ֑הוּ {ס} לְנַ֨פְתָּלִ֔י יְרִימ֖וֹת בֶּן־עַזְרִיאֵֽל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: lzbvln yshm'yhv bn'bdyhv {s} lnptly yrymvt bn'zry'l {s}
verses.translation: of Zebulun, Ishmaiah the son of Obadiah; of Naphtali, Jerimoth the son of Azriel;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִבְנֵ֣י אֶפְרַ֔יִם הוֹשֵׁ֖עַ בֶּן־עֲזַזְיָ֑הוּ לַֽחֲצִי֙ שֵׁ֣בֶט מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה יוֹאֵ֖ל בֶּן־פְּדָיָֽהוּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: lbny 'prym hvsh' bn'zzyhv lchtsy shbt mnshh yv'l bnpdyhv {s}
verses.translation: of the children of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Azaziah; of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Joel the son of Pedaiah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַֽחֲצִ֤י הַֽמְנַשֶּׁה֙ גִּלְעָ֔דָה יִדּ֖וֹ בֶּן־זְכַרְיָ֑הוּ {ס} לְבִ֨נְיָמִ֔ן יַעֲשִׂיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־אַבְנֵֽר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: lchtsy hmnshh gl'dh ydv bnzkhryhv {s} lbnymn y'shy'l bn'bnr {s}
verses.translation: of the half-tribe of Manasseh in Gilead, Iddo the son of Zechariah; of Benjamin, Jaasiel the son of Abner;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְדָ֕ן עֲזַרְאֵ֖ל בֶּן־יְרֹחָ֑ם אֵ֕לֶּה שָׂרֵ֖י שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: ldn 'zr'l bnyrchm 'lh shry shbty yshr'l
verses.translation: of Dan, Azarel the son of Jeroham. These were the captains of the tribes of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־נָשָׂ֤א דָוִיד֙ מִסְפָּרָ֔ם לְמִבֶּ֛ן עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וּלְמָ֑טָּה כִּ֚י אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה לְהַרְבּ֥וֹת אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כְּכוֹכְבֵ֥י הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vl'nsh' dvyd msprm lmbn 'shrym shnh vlmth khy 'mr yhvh lhrbvt 'tyshr'l khkhvkhby hshmym
verses.translation: But David took not the number of them from twenty years old and under; because the LORD had said He would increase Israel like to the stars of heaven.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יוֹאָ֨ב בֶּן־צְרוּיָ֜ה הֵחֵ֤ל לִמְנוֹת֙ וְלֹ֣א כִלָּ֔ה וַיְהִ֥י בָזֹ֛את קֶ֖צֶף עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְלֹ֤א עָלָה֙ הַמִּסְפָּ֔ר בְּמִסְפַּ֥ר דִּבְרֵֽי־הַיָּמִ֖ים לַמֶּ֥לֶךְ דָּוִֽיד׃ {ס}
verses.translit: yv'b bntsrvyh hchl lmnvt vl' khlh vyhy bz't qtsf 'lyshr'l vl' 'lh hmspr bmspr dbryhymym lmlkh dvyd {s}
verses.translation: Joab the son of Zeruiah began to number, but finished not; and there came wrath for this upon Israel; neither was the number put into the account in the chronicles of king David.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַל֙ אֹצְר֣וֹת הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ עַזְמָ֖וֶת בֶּן־עֲדִיאֵ֑ל {ס} וְעַ֣ל הָאֹצָר֡וֹת בַּשָּׂדֶ֞ה בֶּֽעָרִ֤ים וּבַכְּפָרִים֙ וּבַמִּגְדָּל֔וֹת יְהוֹנָתָ֖ן בֶּן־עֻזִּיָּֽהוּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'l 'tsrvt hmlkh 'zmvt bn'dy'l {s} v'l h'tsrvt bshdh b'rym vbkhprym vbmgdlvt yhvntn bn'zyhv {s}
verses.translation: And over the king’s treasuries was Azmaveth the son of Adiel; and over the treasuries in the fields, in the cities, and in the villages, and in the towers, was Jonathan the son of Uzziah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַ֗ל עֹשֵׂי֙ מְלֶ֣אכֶת הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה לַעֲבֹדַ֖ת הָאֲדָמָ֑ה עֶזְרִ֖י בֶּן־כְּלֽוּב׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'l 'shy ml'kht hshdh l'bdt h'dmh 'zry bnkhlvb {s}
verses.translation: and over them that did the work of the field for tillage of the ground was Ezri the son of Chelub;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַ֨ל־הַכְּרָמִ֔ים שִׁמְעִ֖י הָרָמָתִ֑י {ס} וְעַ֤ל שֶׁבַּכְּרָמִים֙ לְאֹצְר֣וֹת הַיַּ֔יִן זַבְדִּ֖י הַשִּׁפְמִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'lhkhrmym shm'y hrmty {s} v'l shbkhrmym l'tsrvt hyyn zbdy hshpmy {s}
verses.translation: and over the vineyards was Shimei the Ramathite; and over the increase of the vineyards for the wine-cellars was Zabdi the Shiphmite;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַל־הַזֵּיתִ֤ים וְהַשִּׁקְמִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּשְּׁפֵלָ֔ה בַּ֥עַל חָנָ֖ן הַגְּדֵרִ֑י {ס} וְעַל־אֹצְר֥וֹת הַשֶּׁ֖מֶן יוֹעָֽשׁ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'lhzytym vhshqmym 'shr bshplh b'l chnn hgdry {s} v'l'tsrvt hshmn yv'sh {s}
verses.translation: and over the olive-trees and the sycomore-trees that were in the Lowland was Baal-hanan the Gederite; and over the cellars of oil was Joash;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַל־הַבָּקָר֙ הָרֹעִ֣ים בַּשָּׁר֔וֹן (שטרי) [שִׁרְטַ֖י] הַשָּׁרוֹנִ֑י {ס} וְעַל־הַבָּקָר֙ בָּעֲמָקִ֔ים שָׁפָ֖ט בֶּן־עַדְלָֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'lhbqr hr'ym bshrvn (shtry) [shrty] hshrvny {s} v'lhbqr b'mqym shpt bn'dly {s}
verses.translation: and over the herds that fed in Sharon was Shirtai the Sharonite; and over the herds that were in the valleys was Shaphat the son of Adlai;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַ֨ל־הַגְּמַלִּ֔ים אוֹבִ֖יל הַיִּשְׁמְעֵלִ֑י {ס} וְעַל־הָ֣אֲתֹנ֔וֹת יֶחְדְּיָ֖הוּ הַמֵּרֹנֹתִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'lhgmlym 'vbyl hyshm'ly {s} v'lh'tnvt ychdyhv hmrnty {s}
verses.translation: and over the camels was Obil the Ishmaelite; and over the asses was Jehdeiah the Meronothite;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַל־הַצֹּ֖אן יָזִ֣יז הַהַגְרִ֑י כׇּל־אֵ֙לֶּה֙ שָׂרֵ֣י הָרְכ֔וּשׁ אֲשֶׁ֖ר לַמֶּ֥לֶךְ דָּוִֽיד׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'lhts'n yzyz hhgry khl'lh shry hrkhvsh 'shr lmlkh dvyd {s}
verses.translation: and over the flocks was Jaziz the Hagrite. All these were the rulers of the substance which was king David’s.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וִיהוֹנָתָ֤ן דּוֹד־דָּוִיד֙ יוֹעֵ֔ץ אִישׁ־מֵבִ֥ין וְסוֹפֵ֖ר ה֑וּא וִיחִיאֵ֥ל בֶּן־חַכְמוֹנִ֖י עִם־בְּנֵ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyhvntn dvddvyd yv'ts 'yshmbyn vsvpr hv' vychy'l bnchkhmvny 'mbny hmlkh {s}
verses.translation: Also Jonathan David’s uncle was a counsellor, a man of understanding, and a scribe; and Jehiel the son of Hachmoni was with the king’s sons;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲחִיתֹ֖פֶל יוֹעֵ֣ץ לַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וְחוּשַׁ֥י הָאַרְכִּ֖י רֵ֥עַ הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'chytpl yv'ts lmlkh vchvshy h'rkhy r' hmlkh {s}
verses.translation: and Ahithophel was the king’s counsellor; and Hushai the Archite was the king’s friend;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַחֲרֵ֣י אֲחִיתֹ֗פֶל יְהוֹיָדָ֤ע בֶּן־בְּנָיָ֙הוּ֙ וְאֶבְיָתָ֔ר וְשַׂר־צָבָ֥א לַמֶּ֖לֶךְ יוֹאָֽב׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'chry 'chytpl yhvyd' bnbnyhv v'bytr vshrtsb' lmlkh yv'b {p}
verses.translation: and after Ahithophel was Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar; and the captain of the king’s host was Joab.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּקְהֵ֣ל דָּוִ֣יד אֶת־כׇּל־שָׂרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֡ל שָׂרֵ֣י הַשְּׁבָטִ֣ים וְשָׂרֵ֣י הַמַּחְלְק֣וֹת הַמְשָׁרְתִ֪ים אֶת־הַמֶּ֟לֶךְ וְשָׂרֵ֣י הָאֲלָפִ֣ים וְשָׂרֵ֣י הַמֵּא֡וֹת וְשָׂרֵ֣י כׇל־רְכוּשׁ־וּמִקְנֶה֩ ׀ לַמֶּ֨לֶךְ וּלְבָנָ֜יו עִם־הַסָּרִיסִ֧ים וְהַגִּבּוֹרִ֛ים וּֽלְכׇל־גִּבּ֥וֹר חָ֖יִל אֶל־יְרוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: vyqhl dvyd 'tkhlshry yshr'l shry hshbtym vshry hmchlqvt hmshrtym 'thmlkh vshry h'lpym vshry hm'vt vshry khlrkhvshvmqnh  lmlkh vlbnyv 'mhsrysym vhgbvrym vlkhlgbvr chyl 'lyrvshl͏m
verses.translation: And David assembled all the princes of Israel, the princes of the tribes, and the captains of the companies that served the king by course, and the captains of thousands, and the captains of hundreds, and the rulers over all the substance and cattle of the king and of his sons, with the officers, and the mighty men, even all the mighty men of valour, unto Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֨קׇם דָּוִ֤יד הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ עַל־רַגְלָ֔יו וַיֹּ֕אמֶר שְׁמָע֖וּנִי אַחַ֣י וְעַמִּ֑י אֲנִ֣י עִם־לְבָבִ֡י לִבְנוֹת֩ בֵּ֨ית מְנוּחָ֜ה לַאֲר֣וֹן בְּרִית־יְהֹוָ֗ה וְלַֽהֲדֹם֙ רַגְלֵ֣י אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ וַהֲכִינ֖וֹתִי לִבְנֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vyqm dvyd hmlkh 'lrglyv vy'mr shm'vny 'chy v'my 'ny 'mlbby lbnvt byt mnvchh l'rvn brytyhvh vlhdm rgly 'lhynv vhkhynvty lbnvt
verses.translation: Then David the king stood up upon his feet, and said: ‘Hear me, my brethren, and my people; as for me, it was in my heart to build a house of rest for the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and for the footstool of our God; and I had made ready for the building.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ אָ֣מַר לִ֔י לֹא־תִבְנֶ֥ה בַ֖יִת לִשְׁמִ֑י כִּ֣י אִ֧ישׁ מִלְחָמ֛וֹת אַ֖תָּה וְדָמִ֥ים שָׁפָֽכְתָּ׃
verses.translit: vh'lhym 'mr ly l'tbnh byt lshmy khy 'ysh mlchmvt 'th vdmym shpkht
verses.translation: But God said unto me: Thou shalt not build a house for My name, because thou art a man of war, and hast shed blood.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּבְחַ֡ר יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵי֩ יִשְׂרָאֵ֨ל בִּ֜י מִכֹּ֣ל בֵּית־אָבִ֗י לִהְי֨וֹת לְמֶ֤לֶךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לְעוֹלָ֔ם כִּ֤י בִֽיהוּדָה֙ בָּחַ֣ר לְנָגִ֔יד וּבְבֵ֥ית יְהוּדָ֖ה בֵּ֣ית אָבִ֑י וּבִבְנֵ֣י אָבִ֔י בִּ֣י רָצָ֔ה לְהַמְלִ֖יךְ עַל־כׇּל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vybchr yhvh 'lhy yshr'l by mkhl byt'by lhyvt lmlkh 'lyshr'l l'vlm khy byhvdh bchr lngyd vbbyt yhvdh byt 'by vbbny 'by by rtsh lhmlykh 'lkhlyshr'l
verses.translation: Howbeit the LORD, the God of Israel, chose me out of all the house of my father to be king over Israel for ever; for He hath chosen Judah to be prince, and in the house of Judah, the house of my father, and among the sons of my father He took pleasure in me to make me king over all Israel;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִ֨כׇּל־בָּנַ֔י כִּ֚י רַבִּ֣ים בָּנִ֔ים נָ֥תַן לִ֖י יְהֹוָ֑ה וַיִּבְחַר֙ בִּשְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בְנִ֔י לָשֶׁ֗בֶת עַל־כִּסֵּ֛א מַלְכ֥וּת יְהֹוָ֖ה עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vmkhlbny khy rbym bnym ntn ly yhvh vybchr bshlmh bny lshbt 'lkhs' mlkhvt yhvh 'lyshr'l
verses.translation: and of all my sons—for the LORD hath given me many sons—He hath chosen Solomon my son to sit upon the throne of the kingdom of the LORD over Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לִ֔י שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בִנְךָ֔ הוּא־יִבְנֶ֥ה בֵיתִ֖י וַחֲצֵרוֹתָ֑י כִּֽי־בָחַ֨רְתִּי ב֥וֹ לִי֙ לְבֵ֔ן וַאֲנִ֖י אֶהְיֶה־לּ֥וֹ לְאָֽב׃
verses.translit: vy'mr ly shlmh bnkh hv'ybnh byty vchtsrvty khybchrty bv ly lbn v'ny 'hyhlv l'b
verses.translation: And He said unto me: Solomon thy son, he shall build My house and My courts; for I have chosen him to be to Me for a son, and I will be to him for a father.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַהֲכִינוֹתִ֥י אֶת־מַלְכוּת֖וֹ עַד־לְעוֹלָ֑ם אִם־יֶחֱזַ֗ק לַעֲשׂ֛וֹת מִצְוֺתַ֥י וּמִשְׁפָּטַ֖י כַּיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: vhkhynvty 'tmlkhvtv 'dl'vlm 'mychzq l'shvt mtsvty vmshpty khyvm hzh
verses.translation: And I will establish his kingdom for ever, if he be constant to do My commandments and Mine ordinances, as at this day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֠עַתָּ֠ה לְעֵינֵ֨י כׇל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל קְהַל־יְהֹוָה֙ וּבְאׇזְנֵ֣י אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ שִׁמְר֣וּ וְדִרְשׁ֔וּ כׇּל־מִצְוֺ֖ת יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם לְמַ֤עַן תִּֽירְשׁוּ֙ אֶת־הָאָ֣רֶץ הַטּוֹבָ֔ה וְהִנְחַלְתֶּ֛ם לִבְנֵיכֶ֥ם אַחֲרֵיכֶ֖ם עַד־עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: v'th l'yny khlyshr'l qhlyhvh vb'zny 'lhynv shmrv vdrshv khlmtsvt yhvh 'lhykhm lm'n tyrshv 'th'rts htvbh vhnchltm lbnykhm 'chrykhm 'd'vlm
verses.translation: Now therefore, in the sight of all Israel, the congregation of the LORD, and in the hearing of our God, observe and seek out all the commandments of the LORD your God; that ye may possess this good land, and leave it for an inheritance to your children after you for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה שְׁלֹמֹֽה־בְנִ֡י דַּע֩ אֶת־אֱלֹהֵ֨י אָבִ֜יךָ וְעׇבְדֵ֗הוּ בְּלֵ֤ב שָׁלֵם֙ וּבְנֶ֣פֶשׁ חֲפֵצָ֔ה כִּ֤י כׇל־לְבָבוֹת֙ דּוֹרֵ֣שׁ יְהֹוָ֔ה וְכׇל־יֵ֥צֶר מַחֲשָׁב֖וֹת מֵבִ֑ין אִֽם־תִּדְרְשֶׁ֙נּוּ֙ יִמָּ֣צֵא לָ֔ךְ וְאִם־תַּעַזְבֶ֖נּוּ יַזְנִיחֲךָ֥ לָעַֽד׃
verses.translit: v'th shlmhbny d' 't'lhy 'bykh v'bdhv blb shlm vbnpsh chptsh khy khllbbvt dvrsh yhvh vkhlytsr mchshbvt mbyn 'mtdrshnv ymts' lkh v'mt'zbnv yznychkh l'd
verses.translation: And thou, Solomon my son, know thou the God of thy father, and serve Him with a whole heart and with a willing mind; for the LORD searcheth all hearts, and understandeth all the imaginations of the thoughts; if thou seek Him, He will be found of thee; but if thou forsake Him, He will cast thee off for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רְאֵ֣ה  עַתָּ֗ה כִּֽי־יְהֹוָ֛ה בָּ֧חַר בְּךָ֛ לִבְנֽוֹת־בַּ֥יִת לַמִּקְדָּ֖שׁ חֲזַ֥ק וַעֲשֵֽׂה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: r'h  'th khyyhvh bchr bkh lbnvtbyt lmqdsh chzq v'shh {p}
verses.translation: Take heed now; for the LORD hath chosen thee to build a house for the sanctuary; be strong, and do it.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן דָּוִ֣יד לִשְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בְנ֡וֹ אֶת־תַּבְנִ֣ית הָאוּלָם֩ וְֽאֶת־בָּ֨תָּ֜יו וְגַנְזַכָּ֧יו וַעֲלִיֹּתָ֛יו וַחֲדָרָ֥יו הַפְּנִימִ֖ים וּבֵ֥ית הַכַּפֹּֽרֶת׃
verses.translit: vytn dvyd lshlmh bnv 'ttbnyt h'vlm v'tbtyv vgnzkhyv v'lytyv vchdryv hpnymym vbyt hkhprt
verses.translation: Then David gave to Solomon his son the pattern of the porch [of the temple], and of the houses thereof, and of the treasuries thereof, and of the upper rooms thereof, and of the inner chambers thereof, and of the place of the ark-cover;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְתַבְנִ֗ית כֹּל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָיָ֤ה בָר֙וּחַ֙ עִמּ֔וֹ לְחַצְר֧וֹת בֵּית־יְהֹוָ֛ה וּלְכׇל־הַלְּשָׁכ֖וֹת סָבִ֑יב לְאֹֽצְרוֹת֙ בֵּ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים וּלְאֹצְר֖וֹת הַקֳּדָשִֽׁים׃
verses.translit: vtbnyt khl 'shr hyh brvch 'mv lchtsrvt bytyhvh vlkhlhlshkhvt sbyb l'tsrvt byt h'lhym vl'tsrvt hqdshym
verses.translation: and the pattern of all that he had by the spirit, for the courts of the house of the LORD, and for all the chambers round about, for the treasuries of the house of God, and for the treasuries of the hallowed things;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּֽלְמַחְלְקוֹת֙ הַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֔ם וּֽלְכׇל־מְלֶ֖אכֶת עֲבוֹדַ֣ת בֵּית־יְהֹוָ֑ה וּֽלְכׇל־כְּלֵ֖י עֲבוֹדַ֥ת בֵּית־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vlmchlqvt hkhhnym vhlvym vlkhlml'kht 'bvdt bytyhvh vlkhlkhly 'bvdt bytyhvh
verses.translation: also for the courses of the priests and the Levites, and for all the work of the service of the house of the LORD, and for all the vessels of service in the house of the LORD:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַזָּהָ֤ב בַּמִּשְׁקָל֙ לַזָּהָ֔ב לְכׇל־כְּלֵ֖י עֲבוֹדָ֣ה וַעֲבוֹדָ֑ה לְכֹ֨ל כְּלֵ֤י הַכֶּ֙סֶף֙ בְּמִשְׁקָ֔ל לְכׇל־כְּלֵ֖י עֲבוֹדָ֥ה וַעֲבוֹדָֽה׃
verses.translit: lzhb bmshql lzhb lkhlkhly 'bvdh v'bvdh lkhl khly hkhsf bmshql lkhlkhly 'bvdh v'bvdh
verses.translation: of gold by weight for the vessels of gold, for all vessels of every kind of service; of silver for all the vessels of silver by weight, for all vessels of every kind of service;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִשְׁקָ֞ל לִמְנֹר֣וֹת הַזָּהָ֗ב וְנֵרֹֽתֵיהֶם֙ זָהָ֔ב בְּמִשְׁקַל־מְנוֹרָ֥ה וּמְנוֹרָ֖ה וְנֵרֹתֶ֑יהָ וְלִמְנֹר֨וֹת הַכֶּ֤סֶף בְּמִשְׁקָל֙ לִמְנוֹרָ֣ה וְנֵרֹתֶ֔יהָ כַּעֲבוֹדַ֖ת מְנוֹרָ֥ה וּמְנוֹרָֽה׃
verses.translit: vmshql lmnrvt hzhb vnrtyhm zhb bmshqlmnvrh vmnvrh vnrtyh vlmnrvt hkhsf bmshql lmnvrh vnrtyh kh'bvdt mnvrh vmnvrh
verses.translation: by weight also for the candlesticks of gold, and for the lamps thereof, of gold, by weight for every candlestick and for the lamps thereof; and for the candlesticks of silver, silver by weight for every candlestick and for the lamps thereof, according to the use of every candlestick;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־הַזָּהָ֥ב מִשְׁקָ֛ל לְשֻׁלְחֲנ֥וֹת הַֽמַּעֲרֶ֖כֶת לְשֻׁלְחַ֣ן וְשֻׁלְחָ֑ן וְכֶ֖סֶף לְשֻׁלְחֲנ֥וֹת הַכָּֽסֶף׃
verses.translit: v'thzhb mshql lshlchnvt hm'rkht lshlchn vshlchn vkhsf lshlchnvt hkhsf
verses.translation: and the gold by weight for the tables of showbread, for every table; and silver for the tables of silver;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַמִּזְלָג֧וֹת וְהַמִּזְרָק֛וֹת וְהַקְּשָׂוֺ֖ת זָהָ֣ב טָה֑וֹר וְלִכְפוֹרֵ֨י הַזָּהָ֤ב בְּמִשְׁקָל֙ לִכְפ֣וֹר וּכְפ֔וֹר וְלִכְפוֹרֵ֥י הַכֶּ֛סֶף בְּמִשְׁקָ֖ל לִכְפ֥וֹר וּכְפֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: vhmzlgvt vhmzrqvt vhqshvt zhb thvr vlkhpvry hzhb bmshql lkhpvr vkhpvr vlkhpvry hkhsf bmshql lkhpvr vkhpvr
verses.translation: and the flesh-hooks, and the basins, and the jars, of pure gold; and for the golden bowls by weight for every bowl; and for the silver bowls by weight for every bowl;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְמִזְבַּ֧ח הַקְּטֹ֛רֶת זָהָ֥ב מְזֻקָּ֖ק בַּמִּשְׁקָ֑ל וּלְתַבְנִ֣ית הַמֶּרְכָּבָ֗ה הַכְּרוּבִ֤ים זָהָב֙ לְפֹ֣רְשִׂ֔ים וְסֹכְכִ֖ים עַל־אֲר֥וֹן בְּרִית־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vlmzbch hqtrt zhb mzqq bmshql vltbnyt hmrkhbh hkhrvbym zhb lprshym vskhkhym 'l'rvn brytyhvh
verses.translation: and for the altar of incense refined gold by weight; and gold for the pattern of the chariot, even the cherubim, that spread out their wings, and covered the ark of the covenant of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַכֹּ֥ל בִּכְתָ֛ב מִיַּ֥ד יְהֹוָ֖ה עָלַ֣י הִשְׂכִּ֑יל כֹּ֖ל מַלְאֲכ֥וֹת הַתַּבְנִֽית׃ {פ}
verses.translit: hkhl bkhtb myd yhvh 'ly hshkhyl khl ml'khvt htbnyt {p}
verses.translation: ’All this [do I give thee] in writing, as the LORD hath made me wise by His hand upon me, even all the works of this pattern.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֜יד לִשְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בְנ֗וֹ חֲזַ֤ק וֶֽאֱמַץ֙ וַעֲשֵׂ֔ה אַל־תִּירָ֖א וְאַל־תֵּחָ֑ת כִּי֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה אֱלֹהִ֤ים אֱלֹהַי֙ עִמָּ֔ךְ לֹ֤א יַרְפְּךָ֙ וְלֹ֣א יַעַזְבֶ֔ךָּ עַד־לִכְל֕וֹת כׇּל־מְלֶ֖אכֶת עֲבוֹדַ֥ת בֵּית־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr dvyd lshlmh bnv chzq v'mts v'shh 'ltyr' v'ltcht khy yhvh 'lhym 'lhy 'mkh l' yrpkh vl' y'zbkh 'dlkhlvt khlml'kht 'bvdt bytyhvh
verses.translation: And David said to Solomon his son: ‘Be strong and of good courage, and do it; fear not, nor be dismayed; for the LORD God, even my God, is with thee; He will not fail thee, nor forsake thee, until all the work for the service of the house of the LORD be finished.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֗ה מַחְלְקוֹת֙ הַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֔ם לְכׇל־עֲבוֹדַ֖ת בֵּ֣ית הָֽאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְעִמְּךָ֨ בְכׇל־מְלָאכָ֜ה לְכׇל־נָדִ֤יב בַּֽחׇכְמָה֙ לְכׇל־עֲבוֹדָ֔ה וְהַשָּׂרִ֥ים וְכׇל־הָעָ֖ם לְכׇל־דְּבָרֶֽיךָ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vhnh mchlqvt hkhhnym vhlvym lkhl'bvdt byt h'lhym v'mkh bkhlml'khh lkhlndyb bchkhmh lkhl'bvdh vhshrym vkhlh'm lkhldbrykh {s}
verses.translation: And, behold, there are the courses of the priests and the Levites, for all the service of the house of God; and there shall be with thee in all manner of work every willing man that hath skill, for any manner of service; also the captains and all the people will be wholly at thy commandment.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֤יד הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ לְכׇל־הַקָּהָ֔ל שְׁלֹמֹ֨ה בְנִ֥י אֶחָ֛ד בָּחַר־בּ֥וֹ אֱלֹהִ֖ים נַ֣עַר וָרָ֑ךְ וְהַמְּלָאכָ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֔ה כִּ֣י לֹ֤א לְאָדָם֙ הַבִּירָ֔ה כִּ֖י לַיהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: vy'mr dvyd hmlkh lkhlhqhl shlmh bny 'chd bchrbv 'lhym n'r vrkh vhml'khh gdvlh khy l' l'dm hbyrh khy lyhvh 'lhym
verses.translation: And David the king said unto all the congregation: ‘Solomon my son, whom alone God hath chosen, is yet young and tender, and the work is great; for the palace is not for man, but for the LORD God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּֽכְכׇל־כֹּחִ֞י הֲכִינ֣וֹתִי לְבֵית־אֱלֹהַ֗י הַזָּהָ֣ב ׀ לַ֠זָּהָ֠ב וְהַכֶּ֨סֶף לַכֶּ֜סֶף וְהַנְּחֹ֣שֶׁת לַנְּחֹ֗שֶׁת הַבַּרְזֶל֙ לַבַּרְזֶ֔ל וְהָעֵצִ֖ים לָעֵצִ֑ים אַבְנֵי־שֹׁ֨הַם וּמִלּוּאִ֜ים אַבְנֵי־פ֣וּךְ וְרִקְמָ֗ה וְכֹ֨ל אֶ֧בֶן יְקָרָ֛ה וְאַבְנֵי־שַׁ֖יִשׁ לָרֹֽב׃
verses.translit: vkhkhlkhchy hkhynvty lbyt'lhy hzhb  lzhb vhkhsf lkhsf vhnchsht lnchsht hbrzl lbrzl vh'tsym l'tsym 'bnyshhm vmlv'ym 'bnypvkh vrqmh vkhl 'bn yqrh v'bnyshysh lrb
verses.translation: Now I have prepared with all my might for the house of my God the gold for the things of gold, and the silver for the things of silver, and the brass for the things of brass, the iron for the things of iron, and wood for the things of wood; onyx stones, and stones to be set, glistering stones, and of divers colours, and all manner of precious stones, and marble stones in abundance.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְע֗וֹד בִּרְצוֹתִי֙ בְּבֵ֣ית אֱלֹהַ֔י יֶשׁ־לִ֥י סְגֻלָּ֖ה זָהָ֣ב וָכָ֑סֶף נָתַ֤תִּי לְבֵית־אֱלֹהַי֙ לְמַ֔עְלָה מִכׇּל־הֲכִינ֖וֹתִי לְבֵ֥ית הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: v'vd brtsvty bbyt 'lhy yshly sglh zhb vkhsf ntty lbyt'lhy lm'lh mkhlhkhynvty lbyt hqdsh
verses.translation: Moreover also, because I have set my affection on the house of my God, seeing that I have a treasure of mine own of gold and silver, I give it unto the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁלֹ֧שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֛ים כִּכְּרֵ֥י זָהָ֖ב מִזְּהַ֣ב אוֹפִ֑יר וְשִׁבְעַ֨ת אֲלָפִ֤ים כִּכַּר־כֶּ֙סֶף֙ מְזֻקָּ֔ק לָט֖וּחַ קִיר֥וֹת הַבָּתִּֽים׃
verses.translit: shlsht 'lpym khkhry zhb mzhb 'vpyr vshb't 'lpym khkhrkhsf mzqq ltvch qyrvt hbtym
verses.translation: even three thousand talents of gold, of the gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver, wherewith to overlay the walls of the houses;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַזָּהָ֤ב לַזָּהָב֙ וְלַכֶּ֣סֶף לַכֶּ֔סֶף וּלְכׇל־מְלָאכָ֖ה בְּיַ֣ד חָרָשִׁ֑ים וּמִ֣י מִתְנַדֵּ֔ב לְמַלֹּ֥אות יָד֛וֹ הַיּ֖וֹם לַיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: lzhb lzhb vlkhsf lkhsf vlkhlml'khh byd chrshym vmy mtndb lml'vt ydv hyvm lyhvh
verses.translation: of gold for the things of gold, and of silver for the things of silver, and for all manner of work to be made by the hands of artificers. Who then offereth willingly to consecrate himself this day unto the LORD?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּֽתְנַדְּבוּ֩ שָׂרֵ֨י הָאָב֜וֹת וְשָׂרֵ֣י  שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְשָׂרֵ֤י הָאֲלָפִים֙ וְהַמֵּא֔וֹת וּלְשָׂרֵ֖י מְלֶ֥אכֶת הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.translit: vytndbv shry h'bvt vshry  shbty yshr'l vshry h'lpym vhm'vt vlshry ml'kht hmlkh
verses.translation: Then the princes of the fathers’houses, and the princes of the tribes of Israel, and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, with the rulers over the king’s work, offered willingly;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיִּתְּנ֞וּ לַעֲבוֹדַ֣ת בֵּית־הָאֱלֹהִ֗ים זָהָ֞ב כִּכָּרִ֣ים חֲמֵשֶׁת־אֲלָפִים֮ וַאֲדַרְכֹנִ֣ים רִבּוֹ֒ וְכֶ֗סֶף כִּכָּרִים֙ עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת אֲלָפִ֔ים וּנְחֹ֕שֶׁת רִבּ֛וֹ וּשְׁמוֹנַ֥ת אֲלָפִ֖ים כִּכָּרִ֑ים וּבַרְזֶ֖ל מֵאָה־אֶ֥לֶף כִּכָּרִֽים׃
verses.translit: vytnv l'bvdt byth'lhym zhb khkhrym chmsht'lpym v'drkhnym rbv vkhsf khkhrym 'shrt 'lpym vnchsht rbv vshmvnt 'lpym khkhrym vbrzl m'h'lf khkhrym
verses.translation: and they gave for the service of the house of God of gold five thousand talents and ten thousand darics, and of silver ten thousand talents, and of brass eighteen thousand talents, and of iron a hundred thousand talents.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַנִּמְצָ֤א אִתּוֹ֙ אֲבָנִ֔ים נָתְנ֖וּ לְאוֹצַ֣ר בֵּית־יְהֹוָ֑ה עַ֥ל יַד־יְחִיאֵ֖ל הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּֽי׃
verses.translit: vhnmts' 'tv 'bnym ntnv l'vtsr bytyhvh 'l ydychy'l hgrshny
verses.translation: And they with whom precious stones were found gave them to the treasure of the house of the LORD, under the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׂמְח֤וּ הָעָם֙ עַל־הִֽתְנַדְּבָ֔ם כִּ֚י בְּלֵ֣ב שָׁלֵ֔ם הִֽתְנַדְּב֖וּ לַֽיהֹוָ֑ה וְגַם֙ דָּוִ֣יד הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ שָׂמַ֖ח שִׂמְחָ֥ה גְדוֹלָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyshmchv h'm 'lhtndbm khy blb shlm htndbv lyhvh vgm dvyd hmlkh shmch shmchh gdvlh {p}
verses.translation: Then the people rejoiced, for that they offered willingly, because with a whole heart they offered willingly to the LORD; and David the king also rejoiced with great joy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְבָ֤רֶךְ דָּוִיד֙ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֔ה לְעֵינֵ֖י כׇּל־הַקָּהָ֑ל וַיֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֗יד בָּר֨וּךְ אַתָּ֤ה יְהֹוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵי֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל אָבִ֔ינוּ מֵעוֹלָ֖ם וְעַד־עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: vybrkh dvyd 'tyhvh l'yny khlhqhl vy'mr dvyd brvkh 'th yhvh 'lhy yshr'l 'bynv m'vlm v'd'vlm
verses.translation: Wherefore David blessed the LORD before all the congregation; and David said: ‘Blessed be Thou, O LORD, the God of Israel our father, for ever and ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְךָ֣ יְ֠הֹוָ֠ה הַגְּדֻלָּ֨ה וְהַגְּבוּרָ֤ה וְהַתִּפְאֶ֙רֶת֙ וְהַנֵּ֣צַח וְהַה֔וֹד כִּי־כֹ֖ל בַּשָּׁמַ֣יִם וּבָאָ֑רֶץ לְךָ֤ יְהֹוָה֙ הַמַּמְלָכָ֔ה וְהַמִּתְנַשֵּׂ֖א לְכֹ֥ל ׀ לְרֹֽאשׁ׃
verses.translit: lkh yhvh hgdlh vhgbvrh vhtp'rt vhntsch vhhvd khykhl bshmym vb'rts lkh yhvh hmmlkhh vhmtnsh' lkhl  lr'sh
verses.translation: Thine, O LORD, is the greatness, and the power, and the glory, and the victory, and the majesty; for all that is in the heaven and in the earth is Thine; Thine is the kingdom, O LORD, and Thou art exalted as head above all.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָעֹ֤שֶׁר וְהַכָּבוֹד֙ מִלְּפָנֶ֔יךָ וְאַתָּה֙ מוֹשֵׁ֣ל בַּכֹּ֔ל וּבְיָדְךָ֖ כֹּ֣חַ וּגְבוּרָ֑ה וּבְיָ֣דְךָ֔ לְגַדֵּ֥ל וּלְחַזֵּ֖ק לַכֹּֽל׃
verses.translit: vh'shr vhkhbvd mlpnykh v'th mvshl bkhl vbydkh khch vgbvrh vbydkh lgdl vlchzq lkhl
verses.translation: Both riches and honour come of Thee, and Thou rulest over all; and in Thy hand is power and might; and in Thy hand it is to make great, and to give strength unto all.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ מוֹדִ֥ים אֲנַ֖חְנוּ לָ֑ךְ וּֽמְהַלְלִ֖ים לְשֵׁ֥ם תִּפְאַרְתֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translit: v'th 'lhynv mvdym 'nchnv lkh vmhllym lshm tp'rtkh
verses.translation: Now therefore, our God, we thank Thee, and praise Thy glorious name.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכִ֨י מִ֤י אֲנִי֙ וּמִ֣י עַמִּ֔י כִּי־נַעְצֹ֣ר כֹּ֔חַ לְהִתְנַדֵּ֖ב כָּזֹ֑את כִּי־מִמְּךָ֣ הַכֹּ֔ל וּמִיָּדְךָ֖ נָתַ֥נּוּ לָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vkhy my 'ny vmy 'my khyn'tsr khch lhtndb khz't khymmkh hkhl vmydkh ntnv lkh
verses.translation: But who am I, and what is my people, that we should be able to offer so willingly after this sort? for all things come of Thee, and of Thine own have we given Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־גֵרִ֨ים אֲנַ֧חְנוּ לְפָנֶ֛יךָ וְתוֹשָׁבִ֖ים כְּכׇל־אֲבֹתֵ֑ינוּ כַּצֵּ֧ל ׀ יָמֵ֛ינוּ עַל־הָאָ֖רֶץ וְאֵ֥ין מִקְוֶֽה׃
verses.translit: khygrym 'nchnv lpnykh vtvshbym khkhl'btynv khtsl  ymynv 'lh'rts v'yn mqvh
verses.translation: For we are strangers before Thee, and sojourners, as all our fathers were: our days on the earth are as a shadow, and there is no abiding.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ כֹּ֣ל הֶהָמ֤וֹן הַזֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֲכִינֹ֔נוּ לִבְנֽוֹת־לְךָ֥ בַ֖יִת לְשֵׁ֣ם קׇדְשֶׁ֑ךָ מִיָּדְךָ֥ (היא) [ה֖וּא] וּלְךָ֥ הַכֹּֽל׃
verses.translit: yhvh 'lhynv khl hhmvn hzh 'shr hkhynnv lbnvtlkh byt lshm qdshkh mydkh (hy') [hv'] vlkh hkhl
verses.translation: O LORD our God, all this store that we have prepared to build Thee a house for Thy holy name cometh of Thy hand, and is all Thine own.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָדַ֣עְתִּי אֱלֹהַ֔י כִּ֤י אַתָּה֙ בֹּחֵ֣ן לֵבָ֔ב וּמֵישָׁרִ֖ים תִּרְצֶ֑ה אֲנִ֗י בְּיֹ֤שֶׁר לְבָבִי֙ הִתְנַדַּ֣בְתִּי כׇל־אֵ֔לֶּה וְעַתָּ֗ה עַמְּךָ֙ הַנִּמְצְאוּ־פֹ֔ה רָאִ֥יתִי בְשִׂמְחָ֖ה לְהִֽתְנַדֶּב־לָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vyd'ty 'lhy khy 'th bchn lbb vmyshrym trtsh 'ny byshr lbby htndbty khl'lh v'th 'mkh hnmts'vph r'yty bshmchh lhtndblkh
verses.translation: I know also, my God, that Thou triest the heart, and hast pleasure in uprightness. As for me, in the uprightness of my heart I have willingly offered all these things; and now have I seen with joy Thy people, that are present here, offer willingly unto Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֗ה אֱ֠לֹהֵ֠י אַבְרָהָ֞ם יִצְחָ֤ק וְיִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֲבֹתֵ֔ינוּ שׇׁמְרָה־זֹּ֣את לְעוֹלָ֔ם לְיֵ֥צֶר מַחְשְׁב֖וֹת לְבַ֣ב עַמֶּ֑ךָ וְהָכֵ֥ן לְבָבָ֖ם אֵלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: yhvh 'lhy 'brhm ytschq vyshr'l 'btynv shmrhz't l'vlm lytsr mchshbvt lbb 'mkh vhkhn lbbm 'lykh
verses.translation: O LORD, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Israel, our fathers, keep this for ever, even the imagination of the thoughts of the heart of Thy people, and direct their heart unto Thee;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלִשְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בְנִ֗י תֵּ֚ן לֵבָ֣ב שָׁלֵ֔ם לִשְׁמוֹר֙ מִצְוֺתֶ֔יךָ עֵדְוֺתֶ֖יךָ וְחֻקֶּ֑יךָ וְלַעֲשׂ֣וֹת הַכֹּ֔ל וְלִבְנ֖וֹת הַבִּירָ֥ה אֲשֶׁר־הֲכִינֽוֹתִי׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vlshlmh bny tn lbb shlm lshmvr mtsvtykh 'dvtykh vchqykh vl'shvt hkhl vlbnvt hbyrh 'shrhkhynvty {p}
verses.translation: and give unto Solomon my son a whole heart, to keep Thy commandments, Thy testimonies, and Thy statutes, and to do all these things, and to build the palace, for which I have made, provision.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר דָּוִיד֙ לְכׇל־הַקָּהָ֔ל בָּ֥רְכוּ נָ֖א אֶת־יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֑ם וַיְבָרְכ֣וּ כׇֽל־הַקָּהָ֗ל לַֽיהֹוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבֹתֵיהֶ֔ם וַיִּקְּד֧וּ וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲו֛וּ לַיהֹוָ֖ה וְלַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr dvyd lkhlhqhl brkhv n' 'tyhvh 'lhykhm vybrkhv khlhqhl lyhvh 'lhy 'btyhm vyqdv vyshtchvv lyhvh vlmlkh
verses.translation: And David said to all the congregation: ‘Now bless the LORD your God.’ And all the congregation blessed the LORD, the God of their fathers, and bowed down their heads, and prostrated themselves before the LORD, and before the king.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּזְבְּח֣וּ לַיהֹוָ֣ה ׀ זְ֠בָחִ֠ים וַיַּעֲל֨וּ עֹל֜וֹת לַיהֹוָ֗ה לְֽמׇחֳרַת֮ הַיּ֣וֹם הַהוּא֒ פָּרִ֨ים אֶ֜לֶף אֵלִ֥ים אֶ֛לֶף כְּבָשִׂ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף וְנִסְכֵּיהֶ֑ם וּזְבָחִ֥ים לָרֹ֖ב לְכׇל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vyzbchv lyhvh  zbchym vy'lv 'lvt lyhvh lmchrt hyvm hhv' prym 'lf 'lym 'lf khbshym 'lf vnskhyhm vzbchym lrb lkhlyshr'l
verses.translation: And they sacrificed sacrifices unto the LORD, and offered burnt-offerings unto the LORD, on the morrow after that day, even a thousand bullocks, a thousand rams, and a thousand lambs, with their drink-offerings, and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאכְל֨וּ וַיִּשְׁתּ֜וּ לִפְנֵ֧י יְהֹוָ֛ה בַּיּ֥וֹם הַה֖וּא בְּשִׂמְחָ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֑ה וַיַּמְלִ֤יכוּ שֵׁנִית֙ לִשְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בֶן־דָּוִ֔יד וַיִּמְשְׁח֧וּ לַיהֹוָ֛ה לְנָגִ֖יד וּלְצָד֥וֹק לְכֹהֵֽן׃
verses.translit: vy'khlv vyshtv lpny yhvh byvm hhv' bshmchh gdvlh vymlykhv shnyt lshlmh bndvyd vymshchv lyhvh lngyd vltsdvq lkhhn
verses.translation: and did eat and drink before the LORD on that day with great gladness. And they made Solomon the son of David king the second time, and anointed him unto the LORD to be prince, and Zadok to be priest.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֣שֶׁב שְׁ֠לֹמֹ֠ה עַל־כִּסֵּ֨א יְהֹוָ֧ה ׀ לְמֶ֛לֶךְ תַּחַת־דָּוִ֥יד אָבִ֖יו וַיַּצְלַ֑ח וַיִּשְׁמְע֥וּ אֵלָ֖יו כׇּל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vyshb shlmh 'lkhs' yhvh  lmlkh tchtdvyd 'byv vytslch vyshm'v 'lyv khlyshr'l
verses.translation: Then Solomon sat on the throne of the LORD as king instead of David his father, and prospered; and all Israel hearkened to him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכׇל־הַשָּׂרִים֙ וְהַגִּבֹּרִ֔ים וְגַ֕ם כׇּל־בְּנֵ֖י הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֑יד נָ֣תְנוּ יָ֔ד תַּ֖חַת שְׁלֹמֹ֥ה הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.translit: vkhlhshrym vhgbrym vgm khlbny hmlkh dvyd ntnv yd tcht shlmh hmlkh
verses.translation: And all the princes, and the mighty men, and all the sons likewise of king David, submitted themselves unto Solomon the king.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְגַדֵּ֨ל יְהֹוָ֤ה אֶת־שְׁלֹמֹה֙ לְמַ֔עְלָה לְעֵינֵ֖י כׇּל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּתֵּ֤ן עָלָיו֙ ה֣וֹד מַלְכ֔וּת אֲ֠שֶׁ֠ר לֹא־הָיָ֧ה עַל־כׇּל־מֶ֛לֶךְ לְפָנָ֖יו עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vygdl yhvh 'tshlmh lm'lh l'yny khlyshr'l vytn 'lyv hvd mlkhvt 'shr l'hyh 'lkhlmlkh lpnyv 'lyshr'l {p}
verses.translation: And the LORD magnified Solomon exceedingly in the sight of all Israel, and bestowed upon him such royal majesty as had not been on any king before him in Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְדָוִיד֙ בֶּן־יִשָׁ֔י מָלַ֖ךְ עַל־כׇּל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vdvyd bnyshy mlkh 'lkhlyshr'l
verses.translation: Now David the son of Jesse reigned over all Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַיָּמִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר מָלַךְ֙ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אַרְבָּעִ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה בְּחֶבְר֤וֹן מָלַךְ֙ שֶׁ֣בַע שָׁנִ֔ים וּבִירוּשָׁלַ֥͏ִם מָלַ֖ךְ שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וְשָׁלֽוֹשׁ׃
verses.translit: vhymym 'shr mlkh 'lyshr'l 'rb'ym shnh bchbrvn mlkh shb' shnym vbyrvshl͏m mlkh shlshym vshlvsh
verses.translation: And the time that he reigned over Israel was forty years: seven years reigned he in Hebron, and thirty and three years reigned he in Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֙מׇת֙ בְּשֵׂיבָ֣ה טוֹבָ֔ה שְׂבַ֥ע יָמִ֖ים עֹ֣שֶׁר וְכָב֑וֹד וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֥ה בְנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃
verses.translit: vymt bshybh tvbh shb' ymym 'shr vkhbvd vymlkh shlmh bnv tchtyv
verses.translation: And he died in a good old age, full of days, riches, and honour; and Solomon his son reigned in his stead.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְדִבְרֵי֙ דָּוִ֣יד הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ הָרִאשֹׁנִ֖ים וְהָאַחֲרֹנִ֑ים הִנָּ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־דִּבְרֵי֙ שְׁמוּאֵ֣ל הָרֹאֶ֔ה וְעַל־דִּבְרֵי֙ נָתָ֣ן הַנָּבִ֔יא וְעַל־דִּבְרֵ֖י גָּ֥ד הַחֹזֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vdbry dvyd hmlkh hr'shnym vh'chrnym hnm khtvbym 'ldbry shmv'l hr'h v'ldbry ntn hnby' v'ldbry gd hchzh
verses.translation: Now the acts of David the king, first and last, behold, they are written in the words of Samuel the seer, and in the words of Nathan the prophet, and in the words of Gad the seer;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עִ֥ם כׇּל־מַלְכוּת֖וֹ וּגְבוּרָת֑וֹ וְהָעִתִּ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָבְר֤וּ עָלָיו֙ וְעַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְעַ֖ל כׇּל־מַמְלְכ֥וֹת הָאֲרָצֽוֹת׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'm khlmlkhvtv vgbvrtv vh'tym 'shr 'brv 'lyv v'lyshr'l v'l khlmmlkhvt h'rtsvt {p}
verses.translation: with all his reign and his might, and the times that went over him, and over Israel, and over all the kingdoms of the countries.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתְחַזֵּ֛ק שְׁלֹמֹ֥ה בֶן־דָּוִ֖יד עַל־מַלְכוּת֑וֹ וַיהֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹהָיו֙ עִמּ֔וֹ וַֽיְגַדְּלֵ֖הוּ לְמָֽעְלָה׃
verses.translit: vytchzq shlmh bndvyd 'lmlkhvtv vyhvh 'lhyv 'mv vygdlhv lm'lh
verses.translation: AND SOLOMON the son of David was strengthened in his kingdom, and the LORD his God was with him, and magnified him exceedingly.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה לְכׇל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֡ל לְשָׂרֵי֩ הָאֲלָפִ֨ים וְהַמֵּא֜וֹת וְלַשֹּׁפְטִ֗ים וּלְכֹ֛ל נָשִׂ֥יא לְכׇל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל רָאשֵׁ֥י הָאָבֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vy'mr shlmh lkhlyshr'l lshry h'lpym vhm'vt vlshptym vlkhl nshy' lkhlyshr'l r'shy h'bvt
verses.translation: And Solomon spoke unto all Israel, to the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and to the judges, and to every prince in all Israel, the heads of the fathers’houses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּלְכ֗וּ שְׁלֹמֹה֙ וְכׇל־הַקָּהָ֣ל עִמּ֔וֹ לַבָּמָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּגִבְע֑וֹן כִּֽי־שָׁ֣ם הָיָ֗ה אֹ֤הֶל מוֹעֵד֙ הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֛ה מֹשֶׁ֥ה עֶבֶד־יְהֹוָ֖ה בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.translit: vylkhv shlmh vkhlhqhl 'mv lbmh 'shr bgb'vn khyshm hyh 'hl mv'd h'lhym 'shr 'shh mshh 'bdyhvh bmdbr
verses.translation: So Solomon, and all the congregation with him, went to the high place that was at Gibeon; for there was the tent of meeting of God, which Moses the servant of the LORD had made in the wilderness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲבָ֗ל אֲר֤וֹן הָאֱלֹהִים֙ הֶעֱלָ֤ה דָוִיד֙ מִקִּרְיַ֣ת יְעָרִ֔ים בַּהֵכִ֥ין ל֖וֹ דָּוִ֑יד כִּ֧י נָֽטָה־ל֛וֹ אֹ֖הֶל בִּירוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: 'bl 'rvn h'lhym h'lh dvyd mqryt y'rym bhkhyn lv dvyd khy nthlv 'hl byrvshl͏m
verses.translation: But the ark of God had David brought up from Kiriath-jearim to the place that David had prepared for it; for he had pitched a tent for it at Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִזְבַּ֣ח הַנְּחֹ֗שֶׁת אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשָׂה֙ בְּצַלְאֵל֙ בֶּן־אוּרִ֣י בֶן־ח֔וּר שָׁ֕ם לִפְנֵ֖י מִשְׁכַּ֣ן יְהֹוָ֑ה וַיִּדְרְשֵׁ֥הוּ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה וְהַקָּהָֽל׃
verses.translit: vmzbch hnchsht 'shr 'shh btsl'l bn'vry bnchvr shm lpny mshkhn yhvh vydrshhv shlmh vhqhl
verses.translation: Moreover the brazen altar, that Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, had made, had been put before the tabernacle of the LORD; and Solomon and the congregation sought unto it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֩עַל֩ שְׁלֹמֹ֨ה שָׁ֜ם עַל־מִזְבַּ֤ח הַנְּחֹ֙שֶׁת֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר לְאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וַיַּ֧עַל עָלָ֛יו עֹל֖וֹת אָֽלֶף׃
verses.translit: vy'l shlmh shm 'lmzbch hnchsht lpny yhvh 'shr l'hl mv'd vy'l 'lyv 'lvt 'lf
verses.translation: And Solomon offered there, upon the brazen altar before the LORD, which was at the tent of meeting, he offered a thousand burnt-offerings upon it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּלַּ֣יְלָה הַה֔וּא נִרְאָ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֖ים לִשְׁלֹמֹ֑ה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֔וֹ שְׁאַ֖ל מָ֥ה אֶתֶּן־לָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: blylh hhv' nr'h 'lhym lshlmh vy'mr lv sh'l mh 'tnlkh
verses.translation: In that night did God, appear unto Solomon, and said unto him: ‘Ask what I shall give thee.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר שְׁלֹמֹה֙ לֵאלֹהִ֔ים אַתָּ֗ה עָשִׂ֛יתָ עִם־דָּוִ֥יד אָבִ֖י חֶ֣סֶד גָּד֑וֹל וְהִמְלַכְתַּ֖נִי תַּחְתָּֽיו׃
verses.translit: vy'mr shlmh l'lhym 'th 'shyt 'mdvyd 'by chsd gdvl vhmlkhtny tchtyv
verses.translation: And Solomon said unto God: ‘Thou hast shown great kindness unto David my father, and hast made me king in his stead.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַתָּה֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֔ים יֵֽאָמֵן֙ דְּבָ֣רְךָ֔ עִ֖ם דָּוִ֣יד אָבִ֑י כִּ֤י אַתָּה֙ הִמְלַכְתַּ֔נִי עַל־עַ֕ם רַ֖ב כַּעֲפַ֥ר הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: 'th yhvh 'lhym y'mn dbrkh 'm dvyd 'by khy 'th hmlkhtny 'l'm rb kh'pr h'rts
verses.translation: Now, O LORD God, let Thy promise unto David my father be established; for Thou hast made me king over a people like the dust of the earth in multitude.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַתָּ֗ה חׇכְמָ֤ה וּמַדָּע֙ תֶּן־לִ֔י וְאֵ֥צְאָ֛ה לִפְנֵ֥י הָעָם־הַזֶּ֖ה וְאָב֑וֹאָה כִּֽי־מִ֣י יִשְׁפֹּ֔ט אֶת־עַמְּךָ֥ הַזֶּ֖ה הַגָּדֽוֹל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'th chkhmh vmd' tnly v'ts'h lpny h'mhzh v'bv'h khymy yshpt 't'mkh hzh hgdvl {s}
verses.translation: Give me now wisdom and knowledge, that I may go out and come in before this people; for who can judge this Thy people, that is so great?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֣ים ׀ לִשְׁלֹמֹ֡ה יַ֣עַן אֲשֶׁר֩ הָיְתָ֨ה זֹ֜את עִם־לְבָבֶ֗ךָ וְלֹֽא־שָׁ֠אַ֠לְתָּ עֹ֣שֶׁר נְכָסִ֤ים וְכָבוֹד֙ וְאֵת֙ נֶ֣פֶשׁ שֹׂנְאֶ֔יךָ וְגַם־יָמִ֥ים רַבִּ֖ים לֹ֣א שָׁאָ֑לְתָּ וַתִּֽשְׁאַל־לְךָ֙ חׇכְמָ֣ה וּמַדָּ֔ע אֲשֶׁ֤ר תִּשְׁפּוֹט֙ אֶת־עַמִּ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִמְלַכְתִּ֖יךָ עָלָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhym  lshlmh y'n 'shr hyth z't 'mlbbkh vl'sh'lt 'shr nkhsym vkhbvd v't npsh shn'ykh vgmymym rbym l' sh'lt vtsh'llkh chkhmh vmd' 'shr tshpvt 't'my 'shr hmlkhtykh 'lyv
verses.translation: And God said to Solomon: ‘Because this was in thy heart, and thou hast not asked riches, wealth, or honour, nor the life of them that hate thee, neither yet hast asked long life, but hast asked wisdom and knowledge for thyself, that thou mayest judge My people, over whom I have made thee king;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַחׇכְמָ֥ה וְהַמַּדָּ֖ע נָת֣וּן לָ֑ךְ וְעֹ֨שֶׁר וּנְכָסִ֤ים וְכָבוֹד֙ אֶתֶּן־לָ֔ךְ אֲשֶׁ֣ר  לֹא־הָ֣יָה כֵ֗ן לַמְּלָכִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְפָנֶ֔יךָ וְאַחֲרֶ֖יךָ לֹ֥א יִֽהְיֶה־כֵּֽן׃
verses.translit: hchkhmh vhmd' ntvn lkh v'shr vnkhsym vkhbvd 'tnlkh 'shr  l'hyh khn lmlkhym 'shr lpnykh v'chrykh l' yhyhkhn
verses.translation: wisdom and knowledge is granted unto thee, and I will give thee riches, and wealth, and honour, such as none of the kings have had that have been before thee, neither shall there any after thee have the like.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֨א שְׁלֹמֹ֜ה לַבָּמָ֤ה אֲשֶׁר־בְּגִבְעוֹן֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם מִלִּפְנֵ֖י אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וַיִּמְלֹ֖ךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyb' shlmh lbmh 'shrbgb'vn yrvshl͏m mlpny 'hl mv'd vymlkh 'lyshr'l {p}
verses.translation: So Solomon came [from his journey] to the high place that was at Gibeon, from before the tent of meeting, unto Jerusalem; and he reigned over Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֶּאֱסֹ֣ף שְׁלֹמֹה֮ רֶ֣כֶב וּפָרָשִׁים֒ וַֽיְהִי־ל֗וֹ אֶ֤לֶף וְאַרְבַּע־מֵאוֹת֙ רֶ֔כֶב וּשְׁנֵים־עָשָׂ֥ר אֶ֖לֶף פָּרָשִׁ֑ים וַיַּנִּיחֵם֙ בְּעָרֵ֣י הָרֶ֔כֶב וְעִם־הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: vy'sf shlmh rkhb vprshym vyhylv 'lf v'rb'm'vt rkhb vshnym'shr 'lf prshym vynychm b'ry hrkhb v'mhmlkh byrvshl͏m
verses.translation: And Solomon gathered chariots and horsemen; and he had a thousand and four hundred chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, that he placed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֨ן הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ אֶת־הַכֶּ֧סֶף וְאֶת־הַזָּהָ֛ב בִּירוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם כָּאֲבָנִ֑ים וְאֵ֣ת הָאֲרָזִ֗ים נָתַ֛ן כַּשִּׁקְמִ֥ים אֲשֶׁר־בַּשְּׁפֵלָ֖ה לָרֹֽב׃
verses.translit: vytn hmlkh 'thkhsf v'thzhb byrvshl͏m kh'bnym v't h'rzym ntn khshqmym 'shrbshplh lrb
verses.translation: And the king made silver and gold to be in Jerusalem as stones, and cedars made he to be as the sycamore-trees that are in the Lowland, for abundance.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמוֹצָ֧א הַסּוּסִ֛ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לִשְׁלֹמֹ֖ה מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם וּמִקְוֵ֕א סֹחֲרֵ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ מִקְוֵ֥א יִקְח֖וּ בִּמְחִֽיר׃
verses.translit: vmvts' hsvsym 'shr lshlmh mmtsrym vmqv' schry hmlkh mqv' yqchv bmchyr
verses.translation: And the horses which Solomon had were brought out of Egypt; also out of Keve, the king’s merchants buying them of the men of Keve at a price.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽ֠יַּעֲל֠וּ וַיּוֹצִ֨יאוּ מִמִּצְרַ֤יִם מֶרְכָּבָה֙ בְּשֵׁ֣שׁ מֵא֣וֹת כֶּ֔סֶף וְס֖וּס בַּחֲמִשִּׁ֣ים וּמֵאָ֑ה וְ֠כֵ֠ן לְכׇל־מַלְכֵ֧י הַחִתִּ֛ים וּמַלְכֵ֥י אֲרָ֖ם בְּיָדָ֥ם יוֹצִֽיאוּ׃
verses.translit: vy'lv vyvtsy'v mmtsrym mrkhbh bshsh m'vt khsf vsvs bchmshym vm'h vkhn lkhlmlkhy hchtym vmlkhy 'rm bydm yvtsy'v
verses.translation: And they fetched up, and brought out of Egypt a chariot for six hundred shekels of silver, and a horse for a hundred and fifty; and so for all the kings of the Hittites, and the kings of Aram, did they bring them out by their means.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה לִבְנ֥וֹת בַּ֙יִת֙ לְשֵׁ֣ם יְהֹוָ֔ה וּבַ֖יִת לְמַלְכוּתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr shlmh lbnvt byt lshm yhvh vbyt lmlkhvtv
verses.translation: Now Solomon purposed to build a house for the name of the LORD, and a house for his kingdom.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסְפֹּ֨ר שְׁלֹמֹ֜ה שִׁבְעִ֥ים אֶ֙לֶף֙ אִ֣ישׁ סַבָּ֔ל וּשְׁמוֹנִ֥ים אֶ֛לֶף אִ֖ישׁ חֹצֵ֣ב בָּהָ֑ר וּמְנַצְּחִ֣ים עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֖ים וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyspr shlmh shb'ym 'lf 'ysh sbl vshmvnym 'lf 'ysh chtsb bhr vmntschym 'lyhm shlsht 'lpym vshsh m'vt {p}
verses.translation: And Solomon counted out threescore and ten thousand men to bear burdens, and fourscore thousand men that were hewers in the mountains, and three thousand and six hundred to oversee them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה אֶל־חוּרָ֥ם מֶלֶךְ־צֹ֖ר לֵאמֹ֑ר כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשִׂ֙יתָ֙ עִם־דָּוִ֣יד אָבִ֔י וַתִּֽשְׁלַֽח־ל֣וֹ אֲרָזִ֔ים לִבְנֽוֹת־ל֥וֹ בַ֖יִת לָשֶׁ֥בֶת בּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyshlch shlmh 'lchvrm mlkhtsr l'mr kh'shr 'shyt 'mdvyd 'by vtshlchlv 'rzym lbnvtlv byt lshbt bv
verses.translation: And Solomon sent to Huram the king of Tyre, saying: ‘As thou didst deal with David my father, and didst send him cedars to build him a house to dwell therein [, even so deal with me].
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּה֩ אֲנִ֨י בוֹנֶה־בַּ֜יִת לְשֵׁ֣ם  יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֗י לְהַקְדִּ֣ישׁ ל֡וֹ לְהַקְטִ֣יר לְפָנָ֣יו קְטֹֽרֶת־סַמִּים֩ וּמַעֲרֶ֨כֶת תָּמִ֤יד וְעֹלוֹת֙ לַבֹּ֣קֶר וְלָעֶ֔רֶב לַשַּׁבָּתוֹת֙ וְלֶ֣חֳדָשִׁ֔ים וּֽלְמוֹעֲדֵ֖י יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ לְעוֹלָ֖ם זֹ֥את עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: hnh 'ny bvnhbyt lshm  yhvh 'lhy lhqdysh lv lhqtyr lpnyv qtrtsmym vm'rkht tmyd v'lvt lbqr vl'rb lshbtvt vlchdshym vlmv'dy yhvh 'lhynv l'vlm z't 'lyshr'l
verses.translation: Behold, I am about to build a house for the name of the LORD my God, to dedicate it to Him, and to burn before Him incense of sweet spices, and for the continual showbread, and for the burnt-offerings morning and evening, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the appointed seasons of the LORD our God. This is an ordinance for ever to Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַבַּ֛יִת אֲשֶׁר־אֲנִ֥י בוֹנֶ֖ה גָּד֑וֹל כִּֽי־גָד֥וֹל אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ מִכׇּל־הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: vhbyt 'shr'ny bvnh gdvl khygdvl 'lhynv mkhlh'lhym
verses.translation: And the house which I build is great; for great is our God above all gods.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִ֤י יַֽעֲצׇר־כֹּ֙חַ֙ לִבְנֽוֹת־ל֣וֹ בַ֔יִת כִּ֧י הַשָּׁמַ֛יִם וּשְׁמֵ֥י הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם לֹ֣א יְכַלְכְּלֻ֑הוּ וּמִ֤י אֲנִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֶבְנֶה־לּ֣וֹ בַ֔יִת כִּ֖י אִם־לְהַקְטִ֥יר לְפָנָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vmy y'tsrkhch lbnvtlv byt khy hshmym vshmy hshmym l' ykhlkhlhv vmy 'ny 'shr 'bnhlv byt khy 'mlhqtyr lpnyv
verses.translation: But who is able to build Him a house, seeing the heaven and the heaven of heavens cannot contain Him? who am I then, that I should build Him a house, save only to offer before Him?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֡ה שְֽׁלַֽח־לִ֣י אִישׁ־חָכָ֡ם לַעֲשׂוֹת֩ בַּזָּהָ֨ב וּבַכֶּ֜סֶף וּבַנְּחֹ֣שֶׁת וּבַבַּרְזֶ֗ל וּבָֽאַרְגְּוָן֙ וְכַרְמִ֣יל וּתְכֵ֔לֶת וְיֹדֵ֖עַ לְפַתֵּ֣חַ פִּתּוּחִ֑ים עִם־הַחֲכָמִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר עִמִּי֙ בִּיהוּדָ֣ה וּבִירוּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֵכִ֖ין דָּוִ֥יד אָבִֽי׃
verses.translit: v'th shlchly 'yshchkhm l'shvt bzhb vbkhsf vbnchsht vbbrzl vb'rgvn vkhrmyl vtkhlt vyd' lptch ptvchym 'mhchkhmym 'shr 'my byhvdh vbyrvshl͏m 'shr hkhyn dvyd 'by
verses.translation: Now therefore send me a man skilful to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass, and in iron, and in purple, and crimson, and blue, and that hath skill to grave all manner of gravings, to be with the skilful men that are with me in Judah and in Jerusalem, whom David my father did provide.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּֽשְׁלַֽח־לִי֩ עֲצֵ֨י אֲרָזִ֜ים בְּרוֹשִׁ֣ים וְאַלְגּוּמִּים֮ מֵֽהַלְּבָנוֹן֒ כִּ֚י אֲנִ֣י יָדַ֔עְתִּי אֲשֶׁ֤ר עֲבָדֶ֙יךָ֙ יֽוֹדְעִ֔ים לִכְר֖וֹת עֲצֵ֣י לְבָנ֑וֹן וְהִנֵּ֥ה עֲבָדַ֖י עִם־עֲבָדֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: vshlchly 'tsy 'rzym brvshym v'lgvmym mhlbnvn khy 'ny yd'ty 'shr 'bdykh yvd'ym lkhrvt 'tsy lbnvn vhnh 'bdy 'm'bdykh
verses.translation: Send me also cedar-trees, cypress-trees, and sandal-wood, out of Lebanon; for I know that thy servants have skill to cut timber in Lebanon; and, behold, my servants shall be with thy servants,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְהָכִ֥ין לִ֛י עֵצִ֖ים לָרֹ֑ב כִּ֥י הַבַּ֛יִת אֲשֶׁר־אֲנִ֥י בוֹנֶ֖ה גָּד֥וֹל וְהַפְלֵֽא׃
verses.translit: vlhkhyn ly 'tsym lrb khy hbyt 'shr'ny bvnh gdvl vhpl'
verses.translation: even to prepare me timber in abundance; for the house which I am about to build shall be great and wonderful.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֣ה לַֽחֹטְבִ֣ים לְֽכֹרְתֵ֣י הָעֵצִ֡ים נָתַ֩תִּי֩ חִטִּ֨ים ׀ מַכּ֜וֹת לַעֲבָדֶ֗יךָ כֹּרִים֙ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים אֶ֔לֶף וּשְׂעֹרִ֕ים כֹּרִ֖ים עֶשְׂרִ֣ים אָ֑לֶף וְיַ֗יִן בַּתִּים֙ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים אֶ֔לֶף וְשֶׁ֕מֶן בַּתִּ֖ים עֶשְׂרִ֥ים אָֽלֶף׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vhnh lchtbym lkhrty h'tsym ntty chtym  mkhvt l'bdykh khrym 'shrym 'lf vsh'rym khrym 'shrym 'lf vyyn btym 'shrym 'lf vshmn btym 'shrym 'lf {s}
verses.translation: And, behold, I will give to thy servants, the hewers that cut timber, twenty thousand measures of beaten wheat, and twenty thousand measures of barley, and twenty thousand baths of wine, and twenty thousand baths of oil.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר חוּרָ֤ם מֶלֶךְ־צֹר֙ בִּכְתָ֔ב וַיִּשְׁלַ֖ח אֶל־שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה בְּאַהֲבַ֤ת יְהֹוָה֙ אֶת־עַמּ֔וֹ נְתָנְךָ֥ עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם מֶֽלֶךְ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr chvrm mlkhtsr bkhtb vyshlch 'lshlmh b'hbt yhvh 't'mv ntnkh 'lyhm mlkh
verses.translation: Then Huram the king of Tyre answered in writing, which he sent to Solomon: ‘Because the LORD loveth His people, He hath made thee king over them.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֘אמֶר֮ חוּרָם֒ בָּר֤וּךְ יְהֹוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה אֶת־הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וְאֶת־הָאָ֑רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתַן֩ לְדָוִ֨יד הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ בֵּ֣ן חָכָ֗ם יוֹדֵ֙עַ֙ שֵׂ֣כֶל וּבִינָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִבְנֶה־בַּ֙יִת֙ לַיהֹוָ֔ה וּבַ֖יִת לְמַלְכוּתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr chvrm brvkh yhvh 'lhy yshr'l 'shr 'shh 'thshmym v'th'rts 'shr ntn ldvyd hmlkh bn chkhm yvd' shkhl vbynh 'shr ybnhbyt lyhvh vbyt lmlkhvtv
verses.translation: Huram said moreover: ‘Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, that made heaven and earth, who hath given to David the king a wise son, endued with discretion and understanding, that should build a house for the LORD, and a house for his kingdom.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה שָׁלַ֧חְתִּי אִישׁ־חָכָ֛ם יוֹדֵ֥עַ בִּינָ֖ה לְחוּרָ֥ם אָבִֽי׃
verses.translit: v'th shlchty 'yshchkhm yvd' bynh lchvrm 'by
verses.translation: And now I have sent a skilful man, endued with understanding, even Huram my master craftsman,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֶּן־אִשָּׁ֞ה מִן־בְּנ֣וֹת דָּ֗ן וְאָבִ֣יו אִישׁ־צֹרִ֡י יוֹדֵ֡עַ לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת בַּזָּֽהָב־וּ֠בַכֶּ֠סֶף בַּנְּחֹ֨שֶׁת בַּבַּרְזֶ֜ל בָּאֲבָנִ֣ים וּבָעֵצִ֗ים בָּאַרְגָּמָ֤ן בַּתְּכֵ֙לֶת֙ וּבַבּ֣וּץ וּבַכַּרְמִ֔יל וּלְפַתֵּ֙חַ֙ כׇּל־פִּתּ֔וּחַ וְלַחְשֹׁ֖ב כׇּל־מַחֲשָׁ֑בֶת אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִנָּֽתֶן־לוֹ֙ עִם־חֲכָמֶ֔יךָ וְֽחַכְמֵ֔י אֲדֹנִ֖י דָּוִ֥יד אָבִֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: bn'shh mnbnvt dn v'byv 'yshtsry yvd' l'shvt bzhbvbkhsf bnchsht bbrzl b'bnym vb'tsym b'rgmn btkhlt vbbvts vbkhrmyl vlptch khlptvch vlchshb khlmchshbt 'shr yntnlv 'mchkhmykh vchkhmy 'dny dvyd 'bykh
verses.translation: the son of a woman of the daughters of Dan, and his father was a man of Tyre, skilful to work in gold, and in silver, in brass, in iron, in stone, and in timber, in purple, in blue, and in fine linen, and in crimson; also to grave any manner of graving, and to devise any device; to do whatever may be set before him, with thy skilful men, and with the skilful men of my lord David thy father.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֠עַתָּ֠ה הַחִטִּ֨ים וְהַשְּׂעֹרִ֜ים הַשֶּׁ֤מֶן וְהַיַּ֙יִן֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמַ֣ר אֲדֹנִ֔י יִשְׁלַ֖ח לַעֲבָדָֽיו׃
verses.translit: v'th hchtym vhsh'rym hshmn vhyyn 'shr 'mr 'dny yshlch l'bdyv
verses.translation: Now therefore the wheat and the barley, the oil and the wine, which my lord hath spoken of, let him send unto his servants;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֠אֲנַ֠חְנוּ נִכְרֹ֨ת עֵצִ֤ים מִן־הַלְּבָנוֹן֙ כְּכׇל־צׇרְכֶּ֔ךָ וּנְבִיאֵ֥ם לְךָ֛ רַפְסֹד֖וֹת עַל־יָ֣ם יָפ֑וֹ וְאַתָּ֛ה תַּעֲלֶ֥ה אֹתָ֖ם יְרוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'nchnv nkhrt 'tsym mnhlbnvn khkhltsrkhkh vnby'm lkh rpsdvt 'lym ypv v'th t'lh 'tm yrvshl͏m {p}
verses.translation: and we will cut wood out of Lebanon, as much as thou shalt need; and we will bring it to thee in floats by sea to Joppa; and thou shalt carry it up to Jerusalem.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסְפֹּ֣ר שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה כׇּל־הָאֲנָשִׁ֤ים הַגֵּירִים֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אַחֲרֵ֣י הַסְּפָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר סְפָרָ֖ם דָּוִ֣יד אָבִ֑יו וַיִּמָּֽצְא֗וּ מֵאָ֤ה וַחֲמִשִּׁים֙ אֶ֔לֶף וּשְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֖ים וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vyspr shlmh khlh'nshym hgyrym 'shr b'rts yshr'l 'chry hspr 'shr sprm dvyd 'byv vymts'v m'h vchmshym 'lf vshlsht 'lpym vshsh m'vt
verses.translation: And Solomon numbered all the strangers that were in the land of Israel, after the numbering wherewith David his father had numbered them; and they were found a hundred and fifty thousand and three thousand and six hundred.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֨עַשׂ מֵהֶ֜ם שִׁבְעִ֥ים אֶ֙לֶף֙ סַבָּ֔ל וּשְׁמֹנִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף חֹצֵ֣ב בָּהָ֑ר וּשְׁלֹ֤שֶׁת אֲלָפִים֙ וְשֵׁ֣שׁ מֵא֔וֹת מְנַצְּחִ֖ים לְהַעֲבִ֥יד אֶת־הָעָֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'sh mhm shb'ym 'lf sbl vshmnym 'lf chtsb bhr vshlsht 'lpym vshsh m'vt mntschym lh'byd 'th'm
verses.translation: And he set threescore and ten thousand of them to bear burdens, and fourscore thousand to be hewers in the mountains, and three thousand and six hundred overseers to set the people at work.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֣חֶל שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה לִבְנ֤וֹת אֶת־בֵּית־יְהֹוָה֙ בִּיר֣וּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם בְּהַר֙ הַמּ֣וֹרִיָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִרְאָ֖ה לְדָוִ֣יד אָבִ֑יהוּ אֲשֶׁ֤ר הֵכִין֙ בִּמְק֣וֹם דָּוִ֔יד בְּגֹ֖רֶן אׇרְנָ֥ן הַיְבוּסִֽי׃
verses.translit: vychl shlmh lbnvt 'tbytyhvh byrvshl͏m bhr hmvryh 'shr nr'h ldvyd 'byhv 'shr hkhyn bmqvm dvyd bgrn 'rnn hybvsy
verses.translation: Then Solomon began to build the house of the LORD at Jerusalem in mount Moriah, where [the LORD] appeared unto David his father; for which provision had been made in the Place of David, in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֠יָּ֠חֶל לִבְנ֞וֹת בַּחֹ֤דֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִי֙ בַּשֵּׁנִ֔י בִּשְׁנַ֥ת אַרְבַּ֖ע לְמַלְכוּתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vychl lbnvt bchdsh hshny bshny bshnt 'rb' lmlkhvtv
verses.translation: And he began to build in the second day of the second month, in the fourth year of his reign.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ הוּסַ֣ד שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה לִבְנ֖וֹת אֶת־בֵּ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים הָאֹ֡רֶךְ אַמּ֞וֹת בַּמִּדָּ֤ה הָרִֽאשׁוֹנָה֙ אַמּ֣וֹת שִׁשִּׁ֔ים וְרֹ֖חַב אַמּ֥וֹת עֶשְׂרִֽים׃
verses.translit: v'lh hvsd shlmh lbnvt 'tbyt h'lhym h'rkh 'mvt bmdh hr'shvnh 'mvt shshym vrchb 'mvt 'shrym
verses.translation: Now these are the foundations which Solomon laid for the building of the house of God. The length by cubits after the ancient measure was threescore cubits, and the breadth twenty cubits.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָאוּלָ֡ם אֲשֶׁר֩ עַל־פְּנֵ֨י הָאֹ֜רֶךְ עַל־פְּנֵ֤י רֹֽחַב־הַבַּ֙יִת֙ אַמּ֣וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֔ים וְהַגֹּ֖בַהּ מֵאָ֣ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֑ים וַיְצַפֵּ֥הוּ מִפְּנִ֖ימָה זָהָ֥ב טָהֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: vh'vlm 'shr 'lpny h'rkh 'lpny rchbhbyt 'mvt 'shrym vhgbh m'h v'shrym vytsphv mpnymh zhb thvr
verses.translation: And the porch that was before [the house], the length of it, according to the breadth of the house, was twenty cubits, and the height a hundred and twenty; and he overlaid it within with pure gold.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֣ת  הַבַּ֣יִת הַגָּד֗וֹל חִפָּה֙ עֵ֣ץ בְּרוֹשִׁ֔ים וַיְחַפֵּ֖הוּ זָהָ֣ב ט֑וֹב וַיַּ֧עַל עָלָ֛יו תִּמֹרִ֖ים וְשַׁרְשְׁרֹֽת׃
verses.translit: v't  hbyt hgdvl chph 'ts brvshym vychphv zhb tvb vy'l 'lyv tmrym vshrshrt
verses.translation: And the greater house he covered with cypress-wood, which he overlaid with fine gold, and wrought thereon palm-trees and chains.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְצַ֧ף אֶת־הַבַּ֛יִת אֶ֥בֶן יְקָרָ֖ה לְתִפְאָ֑רֶת וְהַזָּהָ֖ב זְהַ֥ב פַּרְוָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vytsf 'thbyt 'bn yqrh ltp'rt vhzhb zhb prvym
verses.translation: And he garnished the house with precious stones for beauty; and the gold was gold of Parvaim.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְחַ֨ף אֶת־הַבַּ֜יִת הַקֹּר֧וֹת הַסִּפִּ֛ים וְקִירוֹתָ֥יו וְדַלְתוֹתָ֖יו זָהָ֑ב וּפִתַּ֥ח כְּרוּבִ֖ים עַל־הַקִּירֽוֹת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vychf 'thbyt hqrvt hspym vqyrvtyv vdltvtyv zhb vptch khrvbym 'lhqyrvt {s}
verses.translation: He overlaid also the house, the beams, the thresholds, and the walls thereof, and the doors thereof, with gold; and graved cherubim on the walls.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֙עַשׂ֙ אֶת־בֵּֽית־קֹ֣דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁ֔ים אׇרְכּ֞וֹ עַל־פְּנֵ֤י רֹֽחַב־הַבַּ֙יִת֙ אַמּ֣וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֔ים וְרׇחְבּ֖וֹ אַמּ֣וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֑ים וַיְחַפֵּ֙הוּ֙ זָהָ֣ב ט֔וֹב לְכִכָּרִ֖ים שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vy'sh 'tbytqdsh hqdshym 'rkhv 'lpny rchbhbyt 'mvt 'shrym vrchbv 'mvt 'shrym vychphv zhb tvb lkhkhrym shsh m'vt
verses.translation: And he made the most holy place; the length thereof, according to the breadth of the house, was twenty cubits, and the breadth thereof twenty cubits; and he overlaid it with fine gold, amounting to six hundred talents.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִשְׁקָ֛ל לְמִסְמְר֥וֹת לִשְׁקָלִ֖ים חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים זָהָ֑ב וְהָעֲלִיּ֖וֹת חִפָּ֥ה זָהָֽב׃
verses.translit: vmshql lmsmrvt lshqlym chmshym zhb vh'lyvt chph zhb
verses.translation: And the weight of the nails was fifty shekels of gold. And he overlaid the upper chambers with gold.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֜עַשׂ בְּבֵֽית־קֹ֤דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁים֙ כְּרוּבִ֣ים שְׁנַ֔יִם מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה צַעֲצֻעִ֑ים וַיְצַפּ֥וּ אֹתָ֖ם זָהָֽב׃
verses.translit: vy'sh bbytqdsh hqdshym khrvbym shnym m'shh ts'ts'ym vytspv 'tm zhb
verses.translation: And in the most holy place he made two cherubim of image work; and they overlaid them with gold.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכַנְפֵי֙ הַכְּרוּבִ֔ים אׇרְכָּ֖ם אַמּ֣וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֑ים כְּנַ֨ף הָאֶחָ֜ד לְאַמּ֣וֹת חָמֵ֗שׁ מַגַּ֙עַת֙ לְקִ֣יר הַבַּ֔יִת וְהַכָּנָ֤ף הָאַחֶ֙רֶת֙ אַמּ֣וֹת חָמֵ֔שׁ מַגִּ֕יעַ לִכְנַ֖ף הַכְּר֥וּב הָאַחֵֽר׃
verses.translit: vkhnpy hkhrvbym 'rkhm 'mvt 'shrym khnf h'chd l'mvt chmsh mg't lqyr hbyt vhkhnf h'chrt 'mvt chmsh mgy' lkhnf hkhrvb h'chr
verses.translation: And the wings of the cherubim were twenty cubits long: the wing of the one cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house; and the other wing was likewise five cubits, reaching to the wing of the other cherub.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּכְנַ֨ף הַכְּר֤וּב הָאֶחָד֙ אַמּ֣וֹת חָמֵ֔שׁ מַגִּ֖יעַ לְקִ֣יר הַבָּ֑יִת וְהַכָּנָ֤ף הָאַחֶ֙רֶת֙ אַמּ֣וֹת חָמֵ֔שׁ דְּבֵקָ֕ה לִכְנַ֖ף הַכְּר֥וּב הָאַחֵֽר׃
verses.translit: vkhnf hkhrvb h'chd 'mvt chmsh mgy' lqyr hbyt vhkhnf h'chrt 'mvt chmsh dbqh lkhnf hkhrvb h'chr
verses.translation: And the wing of the other cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house; and the other wing was five cubits also, joining to the wing of the other cherub.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּנְפֵי֙ הַכְּרוּבִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה פֹּרְשִׂ֖ים אַמּ֣וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֑ים וְהֵ֛ם עֹמְדִ֥ים עַל־רַגְלֵיהֶ֖ם וּפְנֵיהֶ֥ם לַבָּֽיִת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khnpy hkhrvbym h'lh prshym 'mvt 'shrym vhm 'mdym 'lrglyhm vpnyhm lbyt {s}
verses.translation: The wings of these cherubim spread themselves forth twenty cubits; and they stood on their feet, and their faces were inward.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֙עַשׂ֙ אֶת־הַפָּרֹ֔כֶת תְּכֵ֥לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֖ן וְכַרְמִ֣יל וּב֑וּץ וַיַּ֥עַל עָלָ֖יו כְּרוּבִֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vy'sh 'thprkht tkhlt v'rgmn vkhrmyl vbvts vy'l 'lyv khrvbym {s}
verses.translation: And he made the veil of blue, and purple, and crimson, and fine linen, and wrought cherubim thereon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֜עַשׂ לִפְנֵ֤י הַבַּ֙יִת֙ עַמּוּדִ֣ים שְׁנַ֔יִם אַמּ֕וֹת שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וְחָמֵ֖שׁ אֹ֑רֶךְ וְהַצֶּ֥פֶת אֲשֶׁר־עַל־רֹאשׁ֖וֹ אַמּ֥וֹת חָמֵֽשׁ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vy'sh lpny hbyt 'mvdym shnym 'mvt shlshym vchmsh 'rkh vhtspt 'shr'lr'shv 'mvt chmsh {s}
verses.translation: Also he made before the house two pillars of thirty and five cubits high, and the capital that was on the top of each of them was five cubits.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֤עַשׂ שַׁרְשְׁרוֹת֙ בַּדְּבִ֔יר וַיִּתֵּ֖ן עַל־רֹ֣אשׁ הָעַמֻּדִ֑ים וַיַּ֤עַשׂ רִמּוֹנִים֙ מֵאָ֔ה וַיִּתֵּ֖ן בַּֽשַּׁרְשְׁרֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vy'sh shrshrvt bdbyr vytn 'lr'sh h'mdym vy'sh rmvnym m'h vytn bshrshrvt
verses.translation: And he made chains in the Sanctuary, and put them on the tops of the pillars; and he made a hundred pomegranates, and put them on the chains.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֤קֶם אֶת־הָֽעַמּוּדִים֙ עַל־פְּנֵ֣י הַהֵיכָ֔ל אֶחָ֥ד מִיָּמִ֖ין וְאֶחָ֣ד מֵֽהַשְּׂמֹ֑אול וַיִּקְרָ֤א שֵׁם־[הַיְמָנִי֙] (הימיני) יָכִ֔ין וְשֵׁ֥ם הַשְּׂמָאלִ֖י בֹּֽעַז׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyqm 'th'mvdym 'lpny hhykhl 'chd mymyn v'chd mhshm'vl vyqr' shm[hymny] (hymyny) ykhyn vshm hshm'ly b'z {s}
verses.translation: And he set up the pillars before the temple, one on the right hand, and the other on the left; and called the name of that on the right hand Jachin, and the name of that on the left Boaz.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֙עַשׂ֙ מִזְבַּ֣ח נְחֹ֔שֶׁת עֶשְׂרִ֤ים אַמָּה֙ אׇרְכּ֔וֹ וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים אַמָּ֖ה רׇחְבּ֑וֹ וְעֶ֥שֶׂר אַמּ֖וֹת קוֹמָתֽוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vy'sh mzbch nchsht 'shrym 'mh 'rkhv v'shrym 'mh rchbv v'shr 'mvt qvmtv {s}
verses.translation: Moreover he made an altar of brass, twenty cubits the length thereof, and twenty cubits the breadth thereof, and ten cubits the height thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ אֶת־הַיָּ֖ם מוּצָ֑ק עֶ֣שֶׂר בָּ֠אַמָּ֠ה מִשְּׂפָת֨וֹ אֶל־שְׂפָת֜וֹ עָג֣וֹל  סָבִ֗יב וְחָמֵ֤שׁ בָּֽאַמָּה֙ קוֹמָת֔וֹ וְקָו֙ שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים בָּאַמָּ֔ה יָסֹ֥ב אֹת֖וֹ סָבִֽיב׃
verses.translit: vy'sh 'thym mvtsq 'shr b'mh mshptv 'lshptv 'gvl  sbyb vchmsh b'mh qvmtv vqv shlshym b'mh ysb 'tv sbyb
verses.translation: Also he made the molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim, round in compass, and the height thereof was five cubits; and a line of thirty cubits did compass it round about.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּדְמ֣וּת בְּקָרִים֩ תַּ֨חַת ל֜וֹ סָבִ֤יב ׀ סָבִיב֙ סוֹבְבִ֣ים אֹת֔וֹ עֶ֚שֶׂר בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה מַקִּיפִ֥ים אֶת־הַיָּ֖ם סָבִ֑יב שְׁנַ֤יִם טוּרִים֙ הַבָּקָ֔ר יְצוּקִ֖ים בְּמֻצַקְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vdmvt bqrym tcht lv sbyb  sbyb svbbym 'tv 'shr b'mh mqypym 'thym sbyb shnym tvrym hbqr ytsvqym bmtsqtv
verses.translation: And under it was the similitude of oxen, which did compass it round about, for ten cubits, compassing the sea round about. The oxen were in two rows, cast when it was cast.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עוֹמֵ֞ד עַל־שְׁנֵ֧ים עָשָׂ֣ר בָּקָ֗ר שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה פֹנִ֣ים ׀ צָפ֡וֹנָה וּשְׁלוֹשָׁה֩ פֹנִ֨ים ׀ יָ֜מָּה וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה  פֹּנִ֣ים נֶ֗גְבָּה וּשְׁלֹשָׁה֙ פֹּנִ֣ים מִזְרָ֔חָה וְהַיָּ֥ם עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם מִלְמָ֑עְלָה וְכׇל־אֲחֹרֵיהֶ֖ם בָּֽיְתָה׃
verses.translit: 'vmd 'lshnym 'shr bqr shlshh pnym  tspvnh vshlvshh pnym  ymh vshlshh  pnym ngbh vshlshh pnym mzrchh vhym 'lyhm mlm'lh vkhl'chryhm byth
verses.translation: It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east; and the sea was set upon them above, and all their hinder parts were inward.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעׇבְי֣וֹ טֶ֔פַח וּשְׂפָתוֹ֙ כְּמַעֲשֵׂ֣ה שְׂפַת־כּ֔וֹס פֶּ֖רַח שׁוֹשַׁנָּ֑ה מַחֲזִ֣יק בַּתִּ֔ים שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֖ים יָכִֽיל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'byv tpch vshptv khm'shh shptkhvs prch shvshnh mchzyq btym shlsht 'lpym ykhyl {s}
verses.translation: And it was a handbreadth thick; and the brim thereof was wrought like the brim of a cup, like the flower of a lily: it received and held three thousand baths.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ כִּיּוֹרִים֮ עֲשָׂרָה֒ וַ֠יִּתֵּ֠ן חֲמִשָּׁ֨ה מִיָּמִ֜ין וַחֲמִשָּׁ֤ה מִשְּׂמֹאול֙ לְרׇחְצָ֣ה בָהֶ֔ם אֶת־מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה הָעוֹלָ֖ה יָדִ֣יחוּ בָ֑ם וְהַיָּ֕ם לְרׇחְצָ֥ה לַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים בּֽוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vy'sh khyvrym 'shrh vytn chmshh mymyn vchmshh mshm'vl lrchtsh bhm 'tm'shh h'vlh ydychv bm vhym lrchtsh lkhhnym bv {s}
verses.translation: He made also ten lavers, and put five on the right hand, and five on the left, to wash in them; such things as belonged to the burnt-offering they washed in them; but the sea was for the priests to wash in.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֠יַּ֠עַשׂ אֶת־מְנֹר֧וֹת הַזָּהָ֛ב עֶ֖שֶׂר כְּמִשְׁפָּטָ֑ם וַיִּתֵּן֙ בַּֽהֵיכָ֔ל חָמֵ֥שׁ מִיָּמִ֖ין וְחָמֵ֥שׁ מִשְּׂמֹֽאול׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vy'sh 'tmnrvt hzhb 'shr khmshptm vytn bhykhl chmsh mymyn vchmsh mshm'vl {s}
verses.translation: And he made the ten candlesticks of gold according to the ordinance concerning them; and he set them in the temple, five on the right hand, and five on the left.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ שֻׁלְחָנוֹת֮ עֲשָׂרָה֒ וַיַּנַּח֙ בַּהֵיכָ֔ל חֲמִשָּׁ֥ה מִיָּמִ֖ין וַחֲמִשָּׁ֣ה מִשְּׂמֹ֑אול וַיַּ֛עַשׂ מִזְרְקֵ֥י זָהָ֖ב מֵאָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vy'sh shlchnvt 'shrh vynch bhykhl chmshh mymyn vchmshh mshm'vl vy'sh mzrqy zhb m'h {s}
verses.translation: He made also ten tables, and placed them in the temple, five on the right side, and five on the left. And he made a hundred basins of gold.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֙עַשׂ֙ חֲצַ֣ר הַכֹּהֲנִ֔ים וְהָעֲזָרָ֖ה הַגְּדוֹלָ֑ה וּדְלָת֧וֹת לָעֲזָרָ֛ה וְדַלְתוֹתֵיהֶ֖ם צִפָּ֥ה נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃
verses.translit: vy'sh chtsr hkhhnym vh'zrh hgdvlh vdltvt l'zrh vdltvtyhm tsph nchsht
verses.translation: Furthermore he made the court of the priests, and the great court, and doors for the court, and overlaid the doors of them with brass.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־הַיָּ֗ם נָתַ֞ן מִכֶּ֧תֶף הַיְמָנִ֛ית קֵ֖דְמָה מִמּ֥וּל נֶֽגְבָּה׃
verses.translit: v'thym ntn mkhtf hymnyt qdmh mmvl ngbh
verses.translation: And he set the sea on the right side [of the house] eastward, toward the south.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ חוּרָ֔ם אֶ֨ת־הַסִּיר֔וֹת וְאֶת־הַיָּעִ֖ים וְאֶת־הַמִּזְרָק֑וֹת וַיְכַ֣ל (חירם) [חוּרָ֗ם] לַעֲשׂוֹת֙ אֶת־הַמְּלָאכָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֛ה לַמֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה בְּבֵ֥ית הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: vy'sh chvrm 'thsyrvt v'thy'ym v'thmzrqvt vykhl (chyrm) [chvrm] l'shvt 'thml'khh 'shr 'shh lmlkh shlmh bbyt h'lhym
verses.translation: And Huram made the pots, and the shovels, and the basins. So Huram made an end of doing the work that he wrought for king Solomon in the house of God:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַמּוּדִ֣ים שְׁנַ֔יִם וְהַגֻּלּ֧וֹת וְהַכֹּתָר֛וֹת עַל־רֹ֥אשׁ הָעַמּוּדִ֖ים שְׁתָּ֑יִם וְהַשְּׂבָכ֣וֹת שְׁתַּ֔יִם לְכַסּ֗וֹת אֶת־שְׁתֵּי֙ גֻּלּ֣וֹת הַכֹּתָר֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־רֹ֥אשׁ הָעַמּוּדִֽים׃
verses.translit: 'mvdym shnym vhglvt vhkhtrvt 'lr'sh h'mvdym shtym vhshbkhvt shtym lkhsvt 'tshty glvt hkhtrvt 'shr 'lr'sh h'mvdym
verses.translation: the two pillars, and the bowls, and the two capitals which were on the top of the pillars; and the two networks to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the top of the pillars;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־הָרִמּוֹנִ֛ים אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת לִשְׁתֵּ֣י הַשְּׂבָכ֑וֹת שְׁנַ֨יִם טוּרִ֤ים רִמּוֹנִים֙ לַשְּׂבָכָ֣ה הָאֶחָ֔ת לְכַסּ֗וֹת אֶת־שְׁתֵּי֙ גֻּלּ֣וֹת הַכֹּתָר֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־פְּנֵ֥י הָעַמּוּדִֽים׃
verses.translit: v'thrmvnym 'rb' m'vt lshty hshbkhvt shnym tvrym rmvnym lshbkhh h'cht lkhsvt 'tshty glvt hkhtrvt 'shr 'lpny h'mvdym
verses.translation: and the four hundred pomegranates for the two networks: two rows of pomegranates for each network, to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were upon the top of the pillars.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־הַמְּכֹנ֖וֹת עָשָׂ֑ה וְאֶת־הַכִּיֹּר֥וֹת עָשָׂ֖ה עַל־הַמְּכֹנֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: v'thmkhnvt 'shh v'thkhyrvt 'shh 'lhmkhnvt
verses.translation: He made also the bases, and the lavers made he upon the bases;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶת־הַיָּ֖ם אֶחָ֑ד וְאֶת־הַבָּקָ֥ר שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂ֖ר תַּחְתָּֽיו׃
verses.translit: 'thym 'chd v'thbqr shnym'shr tchtyv
verses.translation: one sea, and the twelve oxen under it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־הַ֠סִּיר֠וֹת וְאֶת־הַיָּעִ֤ים וְאֶת־הַמִּזְלָגוֹת֙ וְאֶת־כׇּל־כְּלֵיהֶ֔ם עָשָׂ֞ה חוּרָ֥ם אָבִ֛יו לַמֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה לְבֵ֣ית יְהֹוָ֑ה נְחֹ֖שֶׁת מָרֽוּק׃
verses.translit: v'thsyrvt v'thy'ym v'thmzlgvt v'tkhlkhlyhm 'shh chvrm 'byv lmlkh shlmh lbyt yhvh nchsht mrvq
verses.translation: The pots also, and the shovels, and the flesh-hooks, and all the vessels thereof, did Huram his master craftsman make for king Solomon for the house of the LORD of bright brass.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּכִכַּ֤ר הַיַּרְדֵּן֙ יְצָקָ֣ם הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ בַּעֲבִ֖י הָאֲדָמָ֑ה בֵּ֥ין סֻכּ֖וֹת וּבֵ֥ין צְרֵדָֽתָה׃
verses.translit: bkhkhr hyrdn ytsqm hmlkh b'by h'dmh byn skhvt vbyn tsrdth
verses.translation: In the plain of the Jordan did the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֧עַשׂ שְׁלֹמֹ֛ה כׇּל־הַכֵּלִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה לָרֹ֣ב מְאֹ֑ד כִּ֛י לֹ֥א נֶחְקַ֖ר מִשְׁקַ֥ל הַנְּחֹֽשֶׁת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vy'sh shlmh khlhkhlym h'lh lrb m'd khy l' nchqr mshql hnchsht {s}
verses.translation: Thus Solomon made all these vessels in great abundance; for the weight of the brass could not be found out.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה אֵ֚ת כׇּל־הַכֵּלִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר בֵּ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְאֵת֙ מִזְבַּ֣ח הַזָּהָ֔ב וְאֶ֨ת־הַשֻּׁלְחָנ֔וֹת וַעֲלֵיהֶ֖ם לֶ֥חֶם הַפָּנִֽים׃
verses.translit: vy'sh shlmh 't khlhkhlym 'shr byt h'lhym v't mzbch hzhb v'thshlchnvt v'lyhm lchm hpnym
verses.translation: And Solomon made all the vessels that were in the house of God, the golden altar also, and the tables whereon was the showbread;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־הַמְּנֹר֞וֹת וְנֵרֹֽתֵיהֶ֗ם לְבַעֲרָ֧ם כַּמִּשְׁפָּ֛ט לִפְנֵ֥י הַדְּבִ֖יר זָהָ֥ב סָגֽוּר׃
verses.translit: v'thmnrvt vnrtyhm lb'rm khmshpt lpny hdbyr zhb sgvr
verses.translation: and the candlesticks with their lamps, that they should burn according to the ordinance before the Sanctuary, of pure gold;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַפֶּ֧רַח וְהַנֵּר֛וֹת וְהַמֶּלְקַחַ֖יִם זָהָ֑ב ה֖וּא מִכְל֥וֹת זָהָֽב׃
verses.translit: vhprch vhnrvt vhmlqchym zhb hv' mkhlvt zhb
verses.translation: and the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs, of gold, and that perfect gold;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַֽמְזַמְּר֧וֹת וְהַמִּזְרָק֛וֹת וְהַכַּפּ֥וֹת וְהַמַּחְתּ֖וֹת זָהָ֣ב סָג֑וּר וּפֶ֣תַח הַ֠בַּ֠יִת דַּלְתוֹתָ֨יו הַפְּנִימִיּ֜וֹת לְקֹ֣דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁ֗ים וְדַלְתֵ֥י הַבַּ֛יִת לַֽהֵיכָ֖ל זָהָֽב׃
verses.translit: vhmzmrvt vhmzrqvt vhkhpvt vhmchtvt zhb sgvr vptch hbyt dltvtyv hpnymyvt lqdsh hqdshym vdlty hbyt lhykhl zhb
verses.translation: and the snuffers, and the basins, and the pans, and the fire-pans, of pure gold. And as for the entry of the house, the inner doors thereof for the most holy place, and the doors of the house, that is, of the temple, were of gold.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּשְׁלַם֙ כׇּל־הַמְּלָאכָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂ֥ה שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה לְבֵ֣ית יְהֹוָ֑ה {ס} וַיָּבֵ֨א שְׁלֹמֹ֜ה אֶת־קׇדְשֵׁ֣י  דָּוִ֣יד אָבִ֗יו וְאֶת־הַכֶּ֤סֶף וְאֶת־הַזָּהָב֙ וְאֶת־כׇּל־הַכֵּלִ֔ים נָתַ֕ן בְּאֹצְר֖וֹת בֵּ֥ית הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vtshlm khlhml'khh 'shr'shh shlmh lbyt yhvh {s} vyb' shlmh 'tqdshy  dvyd 'byv v'thkhsf v'thzhb v'tkhlhkhlym ntn b'tsrvt byt h'lhym {p}
verses.translation: Thus all the work that Solomon wrought for the house of the LORD was finished. And Solomon brought in the things that David his father had hallowed; even the silver, and the gold, and all the vessels, and put them in the treasuries of the house of God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָז֩ יַקְהֵ֨יל שְׁלֹמֹ֜ה אֶת־זִקְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְאֶת־כׇּל־רָאשֵׁ֨י הַמַּטּ֜וֹת נְשִׂיאֵ֧י הָאָב֛וֹת לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶל־יְרוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם לְֽהַעֲל֞וֹת אֶת־אֲר֧וֹן בְּרִית־יְהֹוָ֛ה מֵעִ֥יר דָּוִ֖יד הִ֥יא צִיּֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: 'z yqhyl shlmh 'tzqny yshr'l v'tkhlr'shy hmtvt nshy'y h'bvt lbny yshr'l 'lyrvshl͏m lh'lvt 't'rvn brytyhvh m'yr dvyd hy' tsyvn
verses.translation: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel, and all the heads of the tribes, the princes of the fathers’houses of the children of Israel, unto Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of the city of David, which is Zion.
