verses.translation: ’Speak unto Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all Israel in Judah and Benjamin, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֡ה לֹא־תַעֲלוּ֩ וְלֹא־תִלָּ֨חֲמ֜וּ עִם־אֲחֵיכֶ֗ם שׁ֚וּבוּ אִ֣ישׁ לְבֵית֔וֹ כִּ֧י מֵאִתִּ֛י נִֽהְיָ֖ה הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֑ה וַֽיִּשְׁמְעוּ֙ אֶת־דִּבְרֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה וַיָּשֻׁ֖בוּ מִלֶּ֥כֶת אֶל־יָרׇבְעָֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh l't'lv vl'tlchmv 'm'chykhm shvbv 'ysh lbytv khy m'ty nhyh hdbr hzh vyshm'v 'tdbry yhvh vyshbv mlkht 'lyrb'm {p}
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD: Ye shall not go up, nor fight against your brethren; return every man to his house, for this thing is of Me.’ So they hearkened unto the words of the LORD, and returned from going against Jeroboam.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב רְחַבְעָ֖ם בִּירוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם וַיִּ֧בֶן עָרִ֛ים לְמָצ֖וֹר בִּיהוּדָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyshb rchb'm byrvshl͏m vybn 'rym lmtsvr byhvdh
verses.translation: And Rehoboam dwelt in Jerusalem, and built cities for defence in Judah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּ֧בֶן אֶת־בֵּֽית־לֶ֛חֶם וְאֶת־עֵיטָ֖ם וְאֶת־תְּקֽוֹעַ׃
verses.translit: vybn 'tbytlchm v't'ytm v'ttqv'
verses.translation: He built even Beth-lehem, and Etam, and Tekoa,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־בֵּֽית־צ֥וּר וְאֶת־שׂוֹכ֖וֹ וְאֶת־עֲדֻלָּֽם׃
verses.translit: v'tbyttsvr v'tshvkhv v't'dlm
verses.translation: and Beth-zur, and Soco, and Adullam,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־גַּ֥ת וְאֶת־מָרֵשָׁ֖ה וְאֶת־זִֽיף׃
verses.translit: v'tgt v'tmrshh v'tzyf
verses.translation: and Gath, and Mareshah, and Ziph,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־אֲדוֹרַ֥יִם וְאֶת־לָכִ֖ישׁ וְאֶת־עֲזֵקָֽה׃
verses.translit: v't'dvrym v'tlkhysh v't'zqh
verses.translation: and Adoraim, and Lachish, and Azekah,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־צׇרְעָה֙ וְאֶת־אַיָּל֔וֹן וְאֶ֨ת־חֶבְר֔וֹן אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּֽיהוּדָ֖ה וּבְבִנְיָמִ֑ן עָרֵ֖י מְצֻרֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: v'ttsr'h v't'ylvn v'tchbrvn 'shr byhvdh vbbnymn 'ry mtsrvt
verses.translation: and Zorah, and Aijalon, and Hebron, which are in Judah and in Benjamin, fortified cities.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְחַזֵּ֖ק אֶת־הַמְּצוּר֑וֹת וַיִּתֵּ֤ן בָּהֶם֙ נְגִידִ֔ים וְאֹצְר֥וֹת מַאֲכָ֖ל וְשֶׁ֥מֶן וָיָֽיִן׃
verses.translit: vychzq 'thmtsvrvt vytn bhm ngydym v'tsrvt m'khl vshmn vyyn
verses.translation: And he fortified the strongholds, and put captains in them, and store of victual, and oil and wine.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְכׇל־עִ֤יר וָעִיר֙ צִנּ֣וֹת וּרְמָחִ֔ים וַֽיְחַזְּקֵ֖ם לְהַרְבֵּ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד וַֽיְהִי־ל֖וֹ יְהוּדָ֥ה וּבִנְיָמִֽן׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vbkhl'yr v'yr tsnvt vrmchym vychzqm lhrbh m'd vyhylv yhvdh vbnymn {s}
verses.translation: And in every city he put shields and spears, and made them exceeding strong. And Judah and Benjamin adhered to him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ וְהַלְוִיִּ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּכׇל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הִֽתְיַצְּב֥וּ עָלָ֖יו מִכׇּל־גְּבוּלָֽם׃
verses.translit: vhkhhnym vhlvym 'shr bkhlyshr'l htytsbv 'lyv mkhlgbvlm
verses.translation: And the priests and the Levites that were in all Israel presented themselves to him out of all their border.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־עָזְב֣וּ הַלְוִיִּ֗ם אֶת־מִגְרְשֵׁיהֶם֙ וַאֲחֻזָּתָ֔ם וַיֵּלְכ֥וּ לִֽיהוּדָ֖ה וְלִירוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם כִּֽי־הִזְנִיחָ֤ם יָֽרׇבְעָם֙ וּבָנָ֔יו מִכַּהֵ֖ן לַיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: khy'zbv hlvym 'tmgrshyhm v'chztm vylkhv lyhvdh vlyrvshl͏m khyhznychm yrb'm vbnyv mkhhn lyhvh
verses.translation: For the Levites left their open land and their possession, and came to Judah and Jerusalem; for Jeroboam and his sons cast them off, that they should not execute the priest’s office unto the LORD;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּֽעֲמֶד־לוֹ֙ כֹּֽהֲנִ֔ים לַבָּמ֖וֹת וְלַשְּׂעִירִ֑ים וְלָעֲגָלִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָֽׂה׃
verses.translit: vy'mdlv khhnym lbmvt vlsh'yrym vl'glym 'shr 'shh
verses.translation: and he appointed him priests for the high places, and for the satyrs, and for the calves which he had made.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַֽחֲרֵיהֶ֗ם מִכֹּל֙ שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הַנֹּֽתְנִים֙ אֶת־לְבָבָ֔ם לְבַקֵּ֕שׁ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בָּ֚אוּ יְר֣וּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם לִזְבּ֕וֹחַ לַֽיהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v'chryhm mkhl shbty yshr'l hntnym 'tlbbm lbqsh 'tyhvh 'lhy yshr'l b'v yrvshl͏m lzbvch lyhvh 'lhy 'bvtyhm
verses.translation: And after them, out of all the tribes of Israel, such as set their hearts to seek the LORD, the God of Israel, came to Jerusalem to sacrifice unto the LORD, the God of their fathers.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְחַזְּקוּ֙ אֶת־מַלְכ֣וּת יְהוּדָ֔ה וַֽיְאַמְּצ֛וּ אֶת־רְחַבְעָ֥ם בֶּן־שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה לְשָׁנִ֣ים שָׁל֑וֹשׁ כִּ֣י הָלְכ֗וּ בְּדֶ֧רֶךְ דָּוִ֛יד וּשְׁלֹמֹ֖ה לְשָׁנִ֥ים שָׁלֽוֹשׁ׃
verses.translit: vychzqv 'tmlkhvt yhvdh vy'mtsv 'trchb'm bnshlmh lshnym shlvsh khy hlkhv bdrkh dvyd vshlmh lshnym shlvsh
verses.translation: So they strengthened the kingdom of Judah, and made Rehoboam the son of Solomon strong, three years; for they walked three years in the way of David and Solomon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּֽקַּֽח־ל֤וֹ רְחַבְעָם֙ אִשָּׁ֔ה אֶת־מָ֣חֲלַ֔ת (בן) [בַּת־]יְרִימ֖וֹת בֶּן־דָּוִ֑יד אֲבִיהַ֕יִל בַּת־אֱלִיאָ֖ב בֶּן־יִשָֽׁי׃
verses.translit: vyqchlv rchb'm 'shh 'tmchlt (bn) [bt]yrymvt bndvyd 'byhyl bt'ly'b bnyshy
verses.translation: And Rehoboam took him a wife, Mahalath the daughter of Jerimoth the son of David, and of Abihail the daughter of Eliab the son of Jesse;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֵּ֥לֶד ל֖וֹ בָּנִ֑ים אֶת־יְע֥וּשׁ וְאֶת־שְׁמַרְיָ֖ה וְאֶת־זָֽהַם׃
verses.translit: vtld lv bnym 'ty'vsh v'tshmryh v'tzhm
verses.translation: and she bore him sons: Jeush, and Shemariah, and Zaham.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַחֲרֶ֣יהָ לָקַ֔ח אֶֽת־מַעֲכָ֖ה בַּת־אַבְשָׁל֑וֹם וַתֵּ֣לֶד ל֗וֹ אֶת־אֲבִיָּה֙ וְאֶת־עַתַּ֔י וְאֶת־זִיזָ֖א וְאֶת־שְׁלֹמִֽית׃
verses.translit: v'chryh lqch 'tm'khh bt'bshlvm vtld lv 't'byh v't'ty v'tzyz' v'tshlmyt
verses.translation: And after her he took Maacah the daughter of Absalom; and she bore him Abijah, and Attai, and Ziza, and Shelomith.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֶּאֱהַ֨ב רְחַבְעָ֜ם אֶת־מַעֲכָ֣ה בַת־אַבְשָׁל֗וֹם מִכׇּל־נָשָׁיו֙ וּפִ֣ילַגְשָׁ֔יו כִּ֠י נָשִׁ֤ים שְׁמוֹנֶֽה־עֶשְׂרֵה֙ נָשָׂ֔א וּפִֽילַגְשִׁ֖ים שִׁשִּׁ֑ים וַיּ֗וֹלֶד עֶשְׂרִ֧ים וּשְׁמוֹנָ֛ה בָּנִ֖ים וְשִׁשִּׁ֥ים בָּנֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vy'hb rchb'm 'tm'khh bt'bshlvm mkhlnshyv vpylgshyv khy nshym shmvnh'shrh nsh' vpylgshym shshym vyvld 'shrym vshmvnh bnym vshshym bnvt
verses.translation: And Rehoboam loved Maacah the daughter of Absalom above all his wives and his concubines—for he took eighteen wives, and threescore concubines, and begot twenty and eight sons and threescore daughters.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּעֲמֵ֨ד לָרֹ֧אשׁ רְחַבְעָ֛ם אֶת־אֲבִיָּ֥ה בֶֽן־מַעֲכָ֖ה לְנָגִ֣יד בְּאֶחָ֑יו כִּ֖י לְהַמְלִיכֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vy'md lr'sh rchb'm 't'byh bnm'khh lngyd b'chyv khy lhmlykhv
verses.translation: And Rehoboam appointed Abijah the son of Maacah to be chief, even the prince among his brethren; for he was minded to make him king.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֩בֶן֩ וַיִּפְרֹ֨ץ מִכׇּל־בָּנָ֜יו לְֽכׇל־אַרְצ֧וֹת יְהוּדָ֣ה וּבִנְיָמִ֗ן לְכֹל֙ עָרֵ֣י הַמְּצֻר֔וֹת וַיִּתֵּ֥ן לָהֶ֛ם הַמָּז֖וֹן לָרֹ֑ב וַיִּשְׁאַ֖ל הֲמ֥וֹן נָשִֽׁים׃
verses.translit: vybn vyprts mkhlbnyv lkhl'rtsvt yhvdh vbnymn lkhl 'ry hmtsrvt vytn lhm hmzvn lrb vysh'l hmvn nshym
verses.translation: And he dealt wisely, and dispersed of all his sons throughout all the lands of Judah and Benjamin, unto every fortified city; and he gave them victual in abundance. And he sought for them many wives.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י כְּהָכִ֞ין מַלְכ֤וּת רְחַבְעָם֙ וּכְחֶזְקָת֔וֹ עָזַ֖ב אֶת־תּוֹרַ֣ת יְהֹוָ֑ה וְכׇל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עִמּֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyhy khhkhyn mlkhvt rchb'm vkhchzqtv 'zb 'ttvrt yhvh vkhlyshr'l 'mv {p}
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when the kingdom of Rehoboam was established, and he was strong, that he forsook the law of the LORD, and all Israel with him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֞י בַּשָּׁנָ֤ה הַֽחֲמִישִׁית֙ לַמֶּ֣לֶךְ רְחַבְעָ֔ם עָלָ֛ה שִׁישַׁ֥ק מֶלֶךְ־מִצְרַ֖יִם עַל־יְרוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם כִּ֥י מָעֲל֖וּ בַּיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyhy bshnh hchmyshyt lmlkh rchb'm 'lh shyshq mlkhmtsrym 'lyrvshl͏m khy m'lv byhvh
verses.translation: And it came to pass in the fifth year of king Rehoboam, that Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, because they had dealt treacherously with the LORD,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּאֶ֤לֶף וּמָאתַ֙יִם֙ רֶ֔כֶב וּבְשִׁשִּׁ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף פָּרָשִׁ֑ים וְאֵ֣ין מִסְפָּ֗ר לָעָ֞ם אֲשֶׁר־בָּ֤אוּ עִמּוֹ֙ מִמִּצְרַ֔יִם לוּבִ֥ים סֻכִּיִּ֖ים וְכוּשִֽׁים׃
verses.translit: b'lf vm'tym rkhb vbshshym 'lf prshym v'yn mspr l'm 'shrb'v 'mv mmtsrym lvbym skhyym vkhvshym
verses.translation: with twelve hundred chariots, and threescore thousand horsemen; and the people were without number that came with him out of Egypt; the Lubim, the Sukkiim, and the Ethiopians.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּלְכֹּ֛ד אֶת־עָרֵ֥י הַמְּצֻר֖וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר לִיהוּדָ֑ה וַיָּבֹ֖א עַד־יְרוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vylkhd 't'ry hmtsrvt 'shr lyhvdh vyb' 'dyrvshl͏m {s}
verses.translation: And he took the fortified cities which pertained to Judah, and came unto Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּֽשְׁמַעְיָ֤ה הַנָּבִיא֙ בָּ֣א אֶל־רְחַבְעָ֔ם וְשָׂרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־נֶאֶסְפ֥וּ אֶל־יְרוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם מִפְּנֵ֣י שִׁישָׁ֑ק וַיֹּ֨אמֶר לָהֶ֜ם כֹּה־אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֗ה אַתֶּם֙ עֲזַבְתֶּ֣ם אֹתִ֔י וְאַף־אֲנִ֛י עָזַ֥בְתִּי אֶתְכֶ֖ם בְּיַד־שִׁישָֽׁק׃
verses.translit: vshm'yh hnby' b' 'lrchb'm vshry yhvdh 'shrn'spv 'lyrvshl͏m mpny shyshq vy'mr lhm khh'mr yhvh 'tm 'zbtm 'ty v'f'ny 'zbty 'tkhm bydshyshq
verses.translation: Now Shemaiah the prophet came to Rehoboam, and to the princes of Judah, that were gathered together to Jerusalem because of Shishak, and said unto them: ‘Thus saith the LORD: Ye have forsaken Me, therefore have I also left you in the hand of Shishak.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּכָּנְע֥וּ שָׂרֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְהַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ צַדִּ֥יק ׀ יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vykhn'v shryyshr'l vhmlkh vy'mrv tsdyq  yhvh
verses.translation: Then the princes of Israel and the king humbled themselves; and they said: ‘The LORD is righteous.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבִרְא֤וֹת יְהֹוָה֙ כִּ֣י נִכְנָ֔עוּ הָיָה֩ דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֨ה אֶל־שְׁמַעְיָ֧ה ׀ לֵאמֹ֛ר נִכְנְע֖וּ לֹ֣א אַשְׁחִיתֵ֑ם וְנָתַתִּ֨י לָהֶ֤ם כִּמְעַט֙ לִפְלֵיטָ֔ה וְלֹא־תִתַּ֧ךְ חֲמָתִ֛י בִּירוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם בְּיַד־שִׁישָֽׁק׃
verses.translit: vbr'vt yhvh khy nkhn'v hyh dbryhvh 'lshm'yh  l'mr nkhn'v l' 'shchytm vntty lhm khm't lplyth vl'ttkh chmty byrvshl͏m bydshyshq
verses.translation: And when the LORD saw that they humbled themselves, the word of the LORD came to Shemaiah, saying: ‘They have humbled themselves; I will not destroy them; but I will grant them some deliverance, and My wrath shall not be poured out upon Jerusalem by the hand of Shishak.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֥י יִֽהְיוּ־ל֖וֹ לַעֲבָדִ֑ים וְיֵֽדְעוּ֙ עֲב֣וֹדָתִ֔י וַעֲבוֹדַ֖ת מַמְלְכ֥וֹת הָאֲרָצֽוֹת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khy yhyvlv l'bdym vyd'v 'bvdty v'bvdt mmlkhvt h'rtsvt {s}
verses.translation: Nevertheless they shall be his servants; that they may know My service, and the service of the kingdoms of the countries.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֨עַל שִׁישַׁ֥ק מֶלֶךְ־מִצְרַ֘יִם֮ עַל־יְרוּשָׁלַ֒͏ִם֒ וַיִּקַּ֞ח אֶת־אֹצְר֣וֹת בֵּית־יְהֹוָ֗ה וְאֶת־אֹֽצְרוֹת֙ בֵּ֣ית הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ אֶת־הַכֹּ֖ל לָקָ֑ח וַיִּקַּח֙ אֶת־מָגִנֵּ֣י הַזָּהָ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה שְׁלֹמֹֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'l shyshq mlkhmtsrym 'lyrvshl͏m vyqch 't'tsrvt bytyhvh v't'tsrvt byt hmlkh 'thkhl lqch vyqch 'tmgny hzhb 'shr 'shh shlmh
verses.translation: So Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, and took away the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king’s house; he took all away; he took away also the shields of gold which Solomon had made.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֨עַשׂ הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ רְחַבְעָם֙ תַּחְתֵּיהֶ֔ם מָגִנֵּ֖י נְחֹ֑שֶׁת וְהִפְקִ֗יד עַל־יַד֙ שָׂרֵ֣י הָרָצִ֔ים הַשֹּׁ֣מְרִ֔ים פֶּ֖תַח בֵּ֥ית הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.translit: vy'sh hmlkh rchb'm tchtyhm mgny nchsht vhpqyd 'lyd shry hrtsym hshmrym ptch byt hmlkh
verses.translation: And king Rehoboam made in their stead shields of brass, and committed them to the hands of the captains of the guard, that kept the door of the king’s house.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֛י מִדֵּי־ב֥וֹא הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ בֵּ֣ית יְהֹוָ֑ה בָּ֤אוּ הָֽרָצִים֙ וּנְשָׂא֔וּם וֶהֱשִׁב֖וּם אֶל־תָּ֥א הָרָצִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyhy mdybv' hmlkh byt yhvh b'v hrtsym vnsh'vm vhshbvm 'lt' hrtsym
verses.translation: And it was so, that as oft as the king entered into the house of the LORD, the guard came and bore them, and brought them back into the guard-chamber.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְהִכָּֽנְע֗וֹ שָׁ֤ב מִמֶּ֙נּוּ֙ אַף־יְהֹוָ֔ה וְלֹ֥א לְהַשְׁחִ֖ית לְכָלָ֑ה וְגַם֙ בִּֽיהוּדָ֔ה הָיָ֖ה דְּבָרִ֥ים טוֹבִֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vbhkhn'v shb mmnv 'fyhvh vl' lhshchyt lkhlh vgm byhvdh hyh dbrym tvbym {s}
verses.translation: And when he humbled himself, the anger of the LORD turned from him, that He would not destroy him altogether; and moreover in Judah there were good things found.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתְחַזֵּ֞ק הַמֶּ֧לֶךְ רְחַבְעָ֛ם בִּירוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם וַיִּמְלֹ֑ךְ כִּ֣י בֶן־אַרְבָּעִ֣ים וְאַחַ֣ת שָׁנָה֩ רְחַבְעָ֨ם בְּמׇלְכ֜וֹ וּֽשְׁבַ֨ע עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה שָׁנָ֣ה  מָלַ֣ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלַ֗͏ִם הָ֠עִ֠יר אֲשֶׁר־בָּחַ֨ר יְהֹוָ֜ה לָשׂ֨וּם אֶת־שְׁמ֥וֹ שָׁם֙ מִכֹּל֙ שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְשֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔וֹ נַעֲמָ֖ה הָעַמֹּנִֽית׃
verses.translit: vytchzq hmlkh rchb'm byrvshl͏m vymlkh khy bn'rb'ym v'cht shnh rchb'm bmlkhv vshb' 'shrh shnh  mlkh byrvshl͏m h'yr 'shrbchr yhvh lshvm 'tshmv shm mkhl shbty yshr'l vshm 'mv n'mh h'mnyt
verses.translation: So king Rehoboam strengthened himself in Jerusalem, and reigned; for Rehoboam was forty and one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the LORD had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, to put His name there; and his mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonitess.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֖עַשׂ הָרָ֑ע כִּ֣י לֹ֤א הֵכִין֙ לִבּ֔וֹ לִדְר֖וֹשׁ אֶת־יְהֹוָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vy'sh hr' khy l' hkhyn lbv ldrvsh 'tyhvh {s}
verses.translation: And he did that which was evil, because he set not his heart to seek the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְדִבְרֵ֣י רְחַבְעָ֗ם הָרִֽאשֹׁנִים֙ וְהָאַ֣חֲרוֹנִ֔ים הֲלֹא־הֵ֨ם כְּתוּבִ֜ים בְּדִבְרֵ֨י שְׁמַעְיָ֧ה הַנָּבִ֛יא וְעִדּ֥וֹ הַחֹזֶ֖ה לְהִתְיַחֵ֑שׂ וּמִלְחֲמ֧וֹת רְחַבְעָ֛ם וְיָרׇבְעָ֖ם כׇּל־הַיָּמִֽים׃
verses.translit: vdbry rchb'm hr'shnym vh'chrvnym hl'hm khtvbym bdbry shm'yh hnby' v'dv hchzh lhtychsh vmlchmvt rchb'm vyrb'm khlhymym
verses.translation: Now the acts of Rehoboam, first and last, are they not written in the histories of Shemaiah the prophet and of Iddo the seer, after the manner of genealogies? And there were wars between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֤ב רְחַבְעָם֙ עִם־אֲבֹתָ֔יו וַיִּקָּבֵ֖ר בְּעִ֣יר דָּוִ֑יד וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ אֲבִיָּ֥ה בְנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyshkhb rchb'm 'm'btyv vyqbr b'yr dvyd vymlkh 'byh bnv tchtyv {p}
verses.translation: And Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David; and Abijah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּשְׁנַ֛ת שְׁמוֹנֶ֥ה עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה לַמֶּ֣לֶךְ יָרׇבְעָ֑ם וַיִּמְלֹ֥ךְ אֲבִיָּ֖ה עַל־יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.translit: bshnt shmvnh 'shrh lmlkh yrb'm vymlkh 'byh 'lyhvdh
verses.translation: In the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam began Abijah to reign over Judah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁל֣וֹשׁ שָׁנִ֗ים מָלַךְ֙ בִּיר֣וּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם וְשֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔וֹ מִיכָיָ֥הוּ בַת־אוּרִיאֵ֖ל מִן־גִּבְעָ֑ה וּמִלְחָמָ֥ה הָֽיְתָ֛ה בֵּ֥ין אֲבִיָּ֖ה וּבֵ֥ין יָרׇבְעָֽם׃
verses.translit: shlvsh shnym mlkh byrvshl͏m vshm 'mv mykhyhv bt'vry'l mngb'h vmlchmh hyth byn 'byh vbyn yrb'm
verses.translation: Three years reigned he in Jerusalem; and his mother’s name was Micaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. And there was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֶּאְסֹ֨ר אֲבִיָּ֜ה אֶת־הַמִּלְחָמָ֗ה בְּחַ֙יִל֙ גִּבּוֹרֵ֣י מִלְחָמָ֔ה אַרְבַּע־מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֖לֶף אִ֣ישׁ בָּח֑וּר {ס} וְיָרׇבְעָ֗ם עָרַ֤ךְ עִמּוֹ֙ מִלְחָמָ֔ה בִּשְׁמוֹנֶ֨ה מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֛לֶף אִ֥ישׁ בָּח֖וּר גִּבּ֥וֹר חָֽיִל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vy'sr 'byh 'thmlchmh bchyl gbvry mlchmh 'rb'm'vt 'lf 'ysh bchvr {s} vyrb'm 'rkh 'mv mlchmh bshmvnh m'vt 'lf 'ysh bchvr gbvr chyl {s}
verses.translation: And Abijah joined battle with an army of valiant men of war, even four hundred thousand chosen men; and Jeroboam set the battle in array against him with eight hundred thousand chosen men, who were mighty men of valour.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֣קׇם אֲבִיָּ֗ה מֵעַל֙ לְהַ֣ר צְמָרַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּהַ֣ר אֶפְרָ֑יִם וַיֹּ֕אמֶר שְׁמָע֖וּנִי יָרׇבְעָ֥ם וְכׇל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vyqm 'byh m'l lhr tsmrym 'shr bhr 'prym vy'mr shm'vny yrb'm vkhlyshr'l
verses.translation: And Abijah stood up upon mount Zemaraim, which is in the hill-country of Ephraim, and said: ‘Hear me, O Jeroboam and all Israel;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲלֹ֤א לָכֶם֙ לָדַ֔עַת כִּ֞י יְהֹוָ֣ה  אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל נָתַ֨ן מַמְלָכָ֧ה לְדָוִ֛יד עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְעוֹלָ֑ם ל֥וֹ וּלְבָנָ֖יו בְּרִ֥ית מֶֽלַח׃ {פ}
verses.translit: hl' lkhm ld't khy yhvh  'lhy yshr'l ntn mmlkhh ldvyd 'lyshr'l l'vlm lv vlbnyv bryt mlch {p}
verses.translation: ought ye not to know that the LORD, the God of Israel, gave the kingdom over Israel to David for ever, even to him and to his sons by a covenant of salt?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֙קׇם֙ יָרׇבְעָ֣ם בֶּן־נְבָ֔ט עֶ֖בֶד שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בֶן־דָּוִ֑יד וַיִּמְרֹ֖ד עַל־אֲדֹנָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vyqm yrb'm bnnbt 'bd shlmh bndvyd vymrd 'l'dnyv
verses.translation: Yet Jeroboam the son of Nebat, the servant of Solomon the son of David, rose up, and rebelled against his lord.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקָּבְצ֣וּ עָלָ֗יו אֲנָשִׁ֤ים רֵקִים֙ בְּנֵ֣י בְלִיַּ֔עַל וַיִּֽתְאַמְּצ֖וּ עַל־רְחַבְעָ֣ם בֶּן־שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה וּרְחַבְעָ֗ם הָ֤יָֽה נַ֙עַר֙ וְרַךְ־לֵבָ֔ב וְלֹ֥א הִתְחַזַּ֖ק לִפְנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vyqbtsv 'lyv 'nshym rqym bny bly'l vyt'mtsv 'lrchb'm bnshlmh vrchb'm hyh n'r vrkhlbb vl' htchzq lpnyhm
verses.translation: And there were gathered unto him vain men, base fellows that strengthened themselves against Rehoboam the son of Solomon, when Rehoboam was young and faint-hearted, and could not withstand them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֣ה  אַתֶּ֣ם אֹמְרִ֗ים לְהִתְחַזֵּק֙ לִפְנֵי֙ מַמְלֶ֣כֶת יְהֹוָ֔ה בְּיַ֖ד בְּנֵ֣י דָוִ֑יד וְאַתֶּם֙ הָמ֣וֹן רָ֔ב וְעִמָּכֶם֙ עֶגְלֵ֣י זָהָ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֥ה לָכֶ֛ם יָרׇבְעָ֖ם לֵאלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: v'th  'tm 'mrym lhtchzq lpny mmlkht yhvh byd bny dvyd v'tm hmvn rb v'mkhm 'gly zhb 'shr 'shh lkhm yrb'm l'lhym
verses.translation: And now ye think to withstand the kingdom of the LORD in the hand of the sons of David; and ye are a great multitude, and there are with you the golden calves which Jeroboam made you for gods.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲלֹ֤א הִדַּחְתֶּם֙ אֶת־כֹּהֲנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה אֶת־בְּנֵ֥י אַהֲרֹ֖ן וְהַלְוִיִּ֑ם וַתַּעֲשׂ֨וּ לָכֶ֤ם כֹּֽהֲנִים֙ כְּעַמֵּ֣י הָאֲרָצ֔וֹת כׇּל־הַבָּ֗א לְמַלֵּ֨א יָד֜וֹ בְּפַ֤ר בֶּן־בָּקָר֙ וְאֵילִ֣ם שִׁבְעָ֔ה וְהָיָ֥ה כֹהֵ֖ן לְלֹ֥א אֱלֹהִֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hl' hdchtm 'tkhhny yhvh 'tbny 'hrn vhlvym vt'shv lkhm khhnym kh'my h'rtsvt khlhb' lml' ydv bpr bnbqr v'ylm shb'h vhyh khhn ll' 'lhym {s}
verses.translation: Have ye not driven out the priests of the LORD, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites, and have made you priests after the manner of the peoples of other lands? so that whosoever cometh to consecrate himself with a young bullock and seven rams, the same becometh a priest of them that are no gods.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲנַ֛חְנוּ יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ וְלֹ֣א עֲזַבְנֻ֑הוּ וְכֹ֨הֲנִ֜ים מְשָׁרְתִ֤ים לַֽיהֹוָה֙ בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֔ן וְהַלְוִיִּ֖ם בַּמְלָֽאכֶת׃
verses.translit: v'nchnv yhvh 'lhynv vl' 'zbnhv vkhhnym mshrtym lyhvh bny 'hrn vhlvym bml'kht
verses.translation: But as for us, the LORD is our God, and we have not forsaken Him; and we have priests ministering unto the LORD, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites in their work;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמַקְטִרִ֣ים לַיהֹוָ֡ה עֹל֣וֹת בַּבֹּֽקֶר־בַּבֹּ֣קֶר וּבָעֶֽרֶב־בָּעֶ֣רֶב וּקְטֹֽרֶת־סַמִּים֩ וּמַעֲרֶ֨כֶת לֶ֜חֶם עַל־הַשֻּׁלְחָ֣ן הַטָּה֗וֹר וּמְנוֹרַ֨ת הַזָּהָ֤ב וְנֵרֹתֶ֙יהָ֙ לְבָעֵר֙ בָּעֶ֣רֶב בָּעֶ֔רֶב כִּֽי־שֹׁמְרִ֣ים אֲנַ֔חְנוּ אֶת־מִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ וְאַתֶּ֖ם עֲזַבְתֶּ֥ם אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vmqtrym lyhvh 'lvt bbqrbbqr vb'rbb'rb vqtrtsmym vm'rkht lchm 'lhshlchn hthvr vmnvrt hzhb vnrtyh lb'r b'rb b'rb khyshmrym 'nchnv 'tmshmrt yhvh 'lhynv v'tm 'zbtm 'tv
verses.translation: and they burn unto the LORD every morning and every evening burnt-offerings and sweet incense; the showbread also set they in order upon the pure table; and the candlestick of gold with the lamps thereof, to burn every evening; for we keep the charge of the LORD our God; but ye have forsaken Him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִנֵּה֩ עִמָּ֨נוּ בָרֹ֜אשׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֧ים ׀ וְכֹהֲנָ֛יו וַחֲצֹצְר֥וֹת הַתְּרוּעָ֖ה לְהָרִ֣יעַ עֲלֵיכֶ֑ם בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אַל־תִּלָּ֥חֲמ֛וּ עִם־יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי־אֲבֹתֵיכֶ֖ם כִּי־לֹ֥א תַצְלִֽיחוּ׃
verses.translit: vhnh 'mnv br'sh h'lhym  vkhhnyv vchtstsrvt htrv'h lhry' 'lykhm bny yshr'l 'ltlchmv 'myhvh 'lhy'btykhm khyl' ttslychv
verses.translation: And, behold, God is with us at our head, and His priests with the trumpets of alarm to sound an alarm against you. O children of Israel, fight ye not against the LORD, the God of your fathers; for ye shall not prosper.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָרׇבְעָ֗ם הֵסֵב֙ אֶת־הַמַּאְרָ֔ב לָב֖וֹא מֵאַחֲרֵיהֶ֑ם וַיִּֽהְיוּ֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וְהַמַּאְרָ֖ב מֵאַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vyrb'm hsb 'thm'rb lbv' m'chryhm vyhyv lpny yhvdh vhm'rb m'chryhm
verses.translation: But Jeroboam caused an ambushment to come about behind them; so they were before Judah, and the ambushment was behind them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּפְנ֣וּ יְהוּדָ֗ה וְהִנֵּ֨ה לָהֶ֤ם הַמִּלְחָמָה֙ פָּנִ֣ים וְאָח֔וֹר וַֽיִּצְעֲק֖וּ לַיהֹוָ֑ה וְהַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים (מחצצרים) [מַחְצְרִ֖ים] בַּחֲצֹצְרֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vypnv yhvdh vhnh lhm hmlchmh pnym v'chvr vyts'qv lyhvh vhkhhnym (mchtstsrym) [mchtsrym] bchtstsrvt
verses.translation: And when Judah looked back, behold, the battle was before and behind them; and they cried unto the LORD, and the priests sounded with the trumpets.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּרִ֖יעוּ אִ֣ישׁ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַיְהִ֗י בְּהָרִ֙יעַ֙ אִ֣ישׁ יְהוּדָ֔ה וְהָאֱלֹהִ֗ים נָגַ֤ף אֶת־יָֽרׇבְעָם֙ וְכׇל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לִפְנֵ֥י אֲבִיָּ֖ה וִיהוּדָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyry'v 'ysh yhvdh vyhy bhry' 'ysh yhvdh vh'lhym ngf 'tyrb'm vkhlyshr'l lpny 'byh vyhvdh
verses.translation: Then the men of Judah gave a shout; and as the men of Judah shouted, it came to pass, that God smote Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּנ֥וּסוּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִפְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה וַיִּתְּנֵ֥ם אֱלֹהִ֖ים בְּיָדָֽם׃
verses.translit: vynvsv bnyyshr'l mpny yhvdh vytnm 'lhym bydm
verses.translation: And the children of Israel fled before Judah; and God delivered them into their hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּכּ֥וּ בָהֶ֛ם אֲבִיָּ֥ה וְעַמּ֖וֹ מַכָּ֣ה רַבָּ֑ה וַיִּפְּל֤וּ חֲלָלִים֙ מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֔ל חֲמֵשׁ־מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֖לֶף אִ֥ישׁ בָּחֽוּר׃
verses.translit: vykhv bhm 'byh v'mv mkhh rbh vyplv chllym myshr'l chmshm'vt 'lf 'ysh bchvr
verses.translation: And Abijah and his people slew them with a great slaughter; so there fell down slain of Israel five hundred thousand chosen men.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּכָּנְע֥וּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֑יא וַיֶּֽאֶמְצוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה כִּ֣י נִשְׁעֲנ֔וּ עַל־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vykhn'v bnyyshr'l b't hhy' vy'mtsv bny yhvdh khy nsh'nv 'lyhvh 'lhy 'bvtyhm
verses.translation: Thus the children of Israel were brought under at that time, and the children of Judah prevailed, because they relied upon the LORD, the God of their fathers.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּרְדֹּ֣ף אֲבִיָּה֮ אַחֲרֵ֣י יָרׇבְעָם֒ וַיִּלְכֹּ֤ד מִמֶּ֙נּוּ֙ עָרִ֔ים אֶת־בֵּֽית־אֵל֙ וְאֶת־בְּנוֹתֶ֔יהָ וְאֶת־יְשָׁנָ֖ה וְאֶת־בְּנוֹתֶ֑יהָ וְאֶת־(עפרון) [עֶפְרַ֖יִן] וּבְנֹתֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: vyrdf 'byh 'chry yrb'm vylkhd mmnv 'rym 'tbyt'l v'tbnvtyh v'tyshnh v'tbnvtyh v't('prvn) ['pryn] vbntyh
verses.translation: And Abijah pursued after Jeroboam, and took cities from him, Bethel with the towns thereof, and Jeshanah with the towns thereof, and Ephrain with the towns thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־עָצַ֧ר כֹּֽחַ־יָרׇבְעָ֛ם ע֖וֹד בִּימֵ֣י אֲבִיָּ֑הוּ וַיִּגְּפֵ֥הוּ יְהֹוָ֖ה וַיָּמֹֽת׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vl''tsr khchyrb'm 'vd bymy 'byhv vygphv yhvh vymt {p}
verses.translation: Neither did Jeroboam recover strength again in the days of Abijah; and the LORD smote him, and he died.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתְחַזֵּ֣ק אֲבִיָּ֔הוּ וַיִּ֨שָּׂא־ל֔וֹ נָשִׁ֖ים אַרְבַּ֣ע עֶשְׂרֵ֑ה וַיּ֗וֹלֶד עֶשְׂרִ֤ים וּשְׁנַ֙יִם֙ בָּנִ֔ים וְשֵׁ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה בָּנֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vytchzq 'byhv vysh'lv nshym 'rb' 'shrh vyvld 'shrym vshnym bnym vshsh 'shrh bnvt
verses.translation: But Abijah waxed mighty, and took unto himself fourteen wives, and begot twenty and two sons, and sixteen daughters.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיֶ֙תֶר֙ דִּבְרֵ֣י אֲבִיָּ֔ה וּדְרָכָ֖יו וּדְבָרָ֑יו כְּתוּבִ֕ים בְּמִדְרַ֖שׁ הַנָּבִ֥יא עִדּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vytr dbry 'byh vdrkhyv vdbryv khtvbym bmdrsh hnby' 'dv
verses.translation: And the rest of the acts of Abijah, and his ways, and his sayings, are written in the commentary of the prophet Iddo.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֨ב אֲבִיָּ֜ה עִם־אֲבֹתָ֗יו וַיִּקְבְּר֤וּ אֹתוֹ֙ בְּעִ֣יר דָּוִ֔יד וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ אָסָ֥א בְנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּ֑יו בְּיָמָ֛יו שָׁקְטָ֥ה הָאָ֖רֶץ עֶ֥שֶׂר שָׁנִֽים׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyshkhb 'byh 'm'btyv vyqbrv 'tv b'yr dvyd vymlkh 's' bnv tchtyv bymyv shqth h'rts 'shr shnym {p}
verses.translation: So Abijah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David, and Asa his son reigned in his stead; in his days the land was quiet ten years.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֤עַשׂ אָסָא֙ הַטּ֣וֹב וְהַיָּשָׁ֔ר בְּעֵינֵ֖י יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vy'sh 's' htvb vhyshr b'yny yhvh 'lhyv
verses.translation: And Asa did that which was good and right in the eyes of the LORD his God;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֛סַר אֶת־מִזְבְּח֥וֹת הַנֵּכָ֖ר וְהַבָּמ֑וֹת וַיְשַׁבֵּר֙ אֶת־הַמַּצֵּב֔וֹת וַיְגַדַּ֖ע אֶת־הָאֲשֵׁרִֽים׃
verses.translit: vysr 'tmzbchvt hnkhr vhbmvt vyshbr 'thmtsbvt vygd' 'th'shrym
verses.translation: for he took away the strange altars, and the high places, and broke down the pillars, and hewed down the Asherim;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ לִֽיהוּדָ֔ה לִדְר֕וֹשׁ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבוֹתֵיהֶ֑ם וְלַעֲשׂ֖וֹת הַתּוֹרָ֥ה וְהַמִּצְוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr lyhvdh ldrvsh 'tyhvh 'lhy 'bvtyhm vl'shvt htvrh vhmtsvh
verses.translation: and commanded Judah to seek the LORD, the God of their fathers, and to do the law and the commandment. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֙סַר֙ מִכׇּל־עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה אֶת־הַבָּמ֖וֹת וְאֶת־הַחַמָּנִ֑ים וַתִּשְׁקֹ֥ט הַמַּמְלָכָ֖ה לְפָנָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vysr mkhl'ry yhvdh 'thbmvt v'thchmnym vtshqt hmmlkhh lpnyv
verses.translation: Also he took away out of all the cities of Judah the high places and the sun-images; and the kingdom was quiet before him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּ֛בֶן עָרֵ֥י מְצוּרָ֖ה בִּֽיהוּדָ֑ה כִּֽי־שָׁקְטָ֣ה הָאָ֗רֶץ וְאֵין־עִמּ֤וֹ מִלְחָמָה֙ בַּשָּׁנִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה כִּֽי־הֵנִ֥יחַ יְהֹוָ֖ה לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vybn 'ry mtsvrh byhvdh khyshqth h'rts v'yn'mv mlchmh bshnym h'lh khyhnych yhvh lv
verses.translation: And he built fortified cities in Judah; for the land was quiet, and he had no war in those years; because the LORD had given him rest.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר לִיהוּדָ֜ה נִבְנֶ֣ה  אֶת־הֶעָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֗לֶּה וְנָסֵ֨ב חוֹמָ֣ה וּמִגְדָּלִים֮ דְּלָתַ֣יִם וּבְרִיחִים֒ עוֹדֶ֨נּוּ הָאָ֜רֶץ לְפָנֵ֗ינוּ כִּ֤י דָרַ֙שְׁנוּ֙ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ דָּרַ֕שְׁנוּ וַיָּ֥נַֽח־לָ֖נוּ מִסָּבִ֑יב וַיִּבְנ֖וּ וַיַּצְלִֽיחוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vy'mr lyhvdh nbnh  'th'rym h'lh vnsb chvmh vmgdlym dltym vbrychym 'vdnv h'rts lpnynv khy drshnv 'tyhvh 'lhynv drshnv vynchlnv msbyb vybnv vytslychv {p}
verses.translation: For he said unto Judah: ‘Let us build these cities, and make about them walls, and towers, gates, and bars; the land is yet before us, because we have sought the LORD our God; we have sought Him, and He hath given us rest on every side.’ So they built and prospered.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י לְאָסָ֗א חַ֘יִל֮ נֹשֵׂ֣א צִנָּ֣ה וָרֹ֒מַח֒ מִֽיהוּדָה֙ שְׁלֹ֣שׁ מֵא֣וֹת אֶ֔לֶף {ס} וּמִבִּנְיָמִ֗ן נֹשְׂאֵ֤י מָגֵן֙ וְדֹ֣רְכֵי קֶ֔שֶׁת מָאתַ֥יִם וּשְׁמוֹנִ֖ים אָ֑לֶף כׇּל־אֵ֖לֶּה גִּבּ֥וֹרֵי חָֽיִל׃
verses.translit: vyhy l's' chyl nsh' tsnh vrmch myhvdh shlsh m'vt 'lf {s} vmbnymn nsh'y mgn vdrkhy qsht m'tym vshmvnym 'lf khl'lh gbvry chyl
verses.translation: And Asa had an army that bore bucklers and spears, out of Judah three hundred thousand; and out of Benjamin, that bore shields and drew bows, two hundred and fourscore thousand; all these were mighty men of valour.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֨א אֲלֵיהֶ֜ם זֶ֣רַח הַכּוּשִׁ֗י בְּחַ֙יִל֙ אֶ֣לֶף אֲלָפִ֔ים וּמַרְכָּב֖וֹת שְׁלֹ֣שׁ מֵא֑וֹת וַיָּבֹ֖א עַד־מָרֵשָֽׁה׃
verses.translit: vyts' 'lyhm zrch hkhvshy bchyl 'lf 'lpym vmrkhbvt shlsh m'vt vyb' 'dmrshh
verses.translation: And there came out against them Zerah the Ethiopian with an army of a thousand thousand, and three hundred chariots; and he came unto Mareshah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֥א אָסָ֖א לְפָנָ֑יו וַיַּֽעַרְכוּ֙ מִלְחָמָ֔ה בְּגֵ֥יא צְפַ֖תָה לְמָרֵשָֽׁה׃
verses.translit: vyts' 's' lpnyv vy'rkhv mlchmh bgy' tspth lmrshh
verses.translation: Then Asa went out to meet him, and they set the battle in array in the valley of Zephath at Mareshah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֨א אָסָ֜א אֶל־יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָיו֮ וַיֹּאמַר֒ יְהֹוָ֗ה אֵֽין־עִמְּךָ֤ לַעְזֹר֙ בֵּ֥ין רַב֙ לְאֵ֣ין כֹּ֔חַ עׇזְרֵ֜נוּ יְהֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֙ינוּ֙ כִּֽי־עָלֶ֣יךָ נִשְׁעַ֔נּוּ וּבְשִׁמְךָ֣ בָ֔אנוּ עַל־הֶהָמ֖וֹן הַזֶּ֑ה יְהֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֙ינוּ֙ אַ֔תָּה אַל־יַעְצֹ֥ר עִמְּךָ֖ אֱנֽוֹשׁ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyqr' 's' 'lyhvh 'lhyv vy'mr yhvh 'yn'mkh l'zr byn rb l'yn khch 'zrnv yhvh 'lhynv khy'lykh nsh'nv vbshmkh b'nv 'lhhmvn hzh yhvh 'lhynv 'th 'ly'tsr 'mkh 'nvsh {s}
verses.translation: And Asa cried unto the LORD his God, and said: ‘LORD, there is none beside Thee to help, between the mighty and him that hath no strength; help us, O LORD our God; for we rely on Thee, and in Thy name are we come against this multitude. Thou art the LORD our God; let not man prevail against Thee.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּגֹּ֤ף יְהֹוָה֙ אֶת־הַכּוּשִׁ֔ים לִפְנֵ֥י אָסָ֖א וְלִפְנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה וַיָּנֻ֖סוּ הַכּוּשִֽׁים׃
verses.translit: vygf yhvh 'thkhvshym lpny 's' vlpny yhvdh vynsv hkhvshym
verses.translation: So the LORD smote the Ethiopians before Asa, and before Judah; and the Ethiopians fled.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּרְדְּפֵ֨ם אָסָ֜א וְהָעָ֣ם אֲשֶׁר־עִמּוֹ֮ עַד־לִגְרָר֒ וַיִּפֹּ֤ל מִכּוּשִׁים֙ לְאֵ֣ין לָהֶ֣ם מִֽחְיָ֔ה כִּֽי־נִשְׁבְּר֥וּ לִפְנֵי־יְהֹוָ֖ה וְלִפְנֵ֣י מַחֲנֵ֑הוּ וַיִּשְׂא֥וּ שָׁלָ֖ל הַרְבֵּ֥ה מְאֹֽד׃
verses.translit: vyrdpm 's' vh'm 'shr'mv 'dlgrr vypl mkhvshym l'yn lhm mchyh khynshbrv lpnyyhvh vlpny mchnhv vysh'v shll hrbh m'd
verses.translation: And Asa and the people that were with him pursued them unto Gerar; and there fell of the Ethiopians so that none remained alive; for they were shattered before the LORD, and before His host; and they carried away very much booty.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּכּ֗וּ אֵ֤ת כׇּל־הֶעָרִים֙ סְבִיב֣וֹת גְּרָ֔ר כִּי־הָיָ֥ה פַחַד־יְהֹוָ֖ה עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם וַיָּבֹ֙זּוּ֙ אֶת־כׇּל־הֶ֣עָרִ֔ים כִּֽי־בִזָּ֥ה רַבָּ֖ה הָיְתָ֥ה בָהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vykhv 't khlh'rym sbybvt grr khyhyh pchdyhvh 'lyhm vybzv 'tkhlh'rym khybzh rbh hyth bhm
verses.translation: And they smote all the cities round about Gerar; for a terror from the LORD came upon them; and they spoiled all the cities; for there was much spoil in them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגַם־אׇהֳלֵ֥י מִקְנֶ֖ה הִכּ֑וּ וַיִּשְׁבּ֨וּ צֹ֤אן לָרֹב֙ וּגְמַלִּ֔ים וַיָּשֻׁ֖בוּ יְרוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vgm'hly mqnh hkhv vyshbv ts'n lrb vgmlym vyshbv yrvshl͏m {s}
verses.translation: They smote also the tents of cattle, and carried away sheep in abundance and camels, and returned to Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַעֲזַרְיָ֙הוּ֙ בֶּן־עוֹדֵ֔ד הָיְתָ֥ה עָלָ֖יו ר֥וּחַ אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: v'zryhv bn'vdd hyth 'lyv rvch 'lhym
verses.translation: And the spirit of God came upon Azariah the son of Oded;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵא֮ לִפְנֵ֣י אָסָא֒ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֔וֹ שְׁמָע֕וּנִי אָסָ֖א וְכׇל־יְהוּדָ֣ה וּבִנְיָמִ֑ן יְהֹוָ֤ה עִמָּכֶם֙ בִּֽהְיוֹתְכֶ֣ם עִמּ֔וֹ וְאִֽם־תִּדְרְשֻׁ֙הוּ֙ יִמָּצֵ֣א לָכֶ֔ם וְאִם־תַּעַזְבֻ֖הוּ יַעֲזֹ֥ב אֶתְכֶֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyts' lpny 's' vy'mr lv shm'vny 's' vkhlyhvdh vbnymn yhvh 'mkhm bhyvtkhm 'mv v'mtdrshhv ymts' lkhm v'mt'zbhv y'zb 'tkhm {s}
verses.translation: and he went out to meet Asa, and said unto him: ‘Hear ye me, Asa, and all Judah and Benjamin: the LORD is with you, while ye are with Him; and if ye seek Him, He will be found of you; but if ye forsake Him, He will forsake you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָמִ֥ים רַבִּ֖ים לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לְלֹ֣א  אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֱמֶ֗ת וּלְלֹ֛א כֹּהֵ֥ן מוֹרֶ֖ה וּלְלֹ֥א תוֹרָֽה׃
verses.translit: vymym rbym lyshr'l ll'  'lhy 'mt vll' khhn mvrh vll' tvrh
verses.translation: Now for long seasons Israel was without the true God, and without a teaching priest, and without law;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֙שׇׁב֙ בַּצַּר־ל֔וֹ עַל־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיְבַקְשֻׁ֖הוּ וַיִּמָּצֵ֥א לָהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vyshb btsrlv 'lyhvh 'lhy yshr'l vybqshhv vymts' lhm
verses.translation: but when in their distress they turned unto the LORD, the God of Israel, and sought Him, He was found of them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבָעִתִּ֣ים הָהֵ֔ם אֵ֥ין שָׁל֖וֹם לַיּוֹצֵ֣א וְלַבָּ֑א כִּ֚י מְהוּמֹ֣ת רַבּ֔וֹת עַ֥ל כׇּל־יֹשְׁבֵ֖י הָאֲרָצֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vb'tym hhm 'yn shlvm lyvts' vlb' khy mhvmt rbvt 'l khlyshby h'rtsvt
verses.translation: And in those times there was no peace to him that went out, nor to him that came in, but great discomfitures were upon all the inhabitants of the lands.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכֻתְּת֥וּ גוֹי־בְּג֖וֹי וְעִ֣יר בְּעִ֑יר כִּֽי־אֱלֹהִ֥ים הֲמָמָ֖ם בְּכׇל־צָרָֽה׃
verses.translit: vkhttv gvybgvy v'yr b'yr khy'lhym hmmm bkhltsrh
verses.translation: And they were broken in pieces, nation against nation, and city against city; for God did discomfit them with all manner of adversity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתֶּ֣ם חִזְק֔וּ וְאַל־יִרְפּ֖וּ יְדֵיכֶ֑ם כִּ֛י יֵ֥שׁ שָׂכָ֖ר לִפְעֻלַּתְכֶֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'tm chzqv v'lyrpv ydykhm khy ysh shkhr lp'ltkhm {s}
verses.translation: But be ye strong, and let not your hands be slack; for your work shall be rewarded.’ .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכִשְׁמֹ֨עַ אָסָ֜א הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֗לֶּה וְהַנְּבוּאָה֮ עֹדֵ֣ד הַנָּבִיא֒ הִתְחַזַּ֗ק וַיַּעֲבֵ֤ר הַשִּׁקּוּצִים֙ מִכׇּל־אֶ֤רֶץ יְהוּדָה֙ וּבִנְיָמִ֔ן וּמִן־הֶ֣עָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לָכַ֖ד מֵהַ֣ר אֶפְרָ֑יִם וַיְחַדֵּשׁ֙ אֶת־מִזְבַּ֣ח יְהֹוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֕ר לִפְנֵ֖י אוּלָ֥ם יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vkhshm' 's' hdbrym h'lh vhnbv'h 'dd hnby' htchzq vy'br hshqvtsym mkhl'rts yhvdh vbnymn vmnh'rym 'shr lkhd mhr 'prym vychdsh 'tmzbch yhvh 'shr lpny 'vlm yhvh
verses.translation: And when Asa heard these words, even the prophecy of Oded the prophet, he took courage, and put away the detestable things out of all the land of Judah and Benjamin, and out of the cities which he had taken from the hill-country of Ephraim; and he renewed the altar of the LORD, that was before the porch of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְבֹּ֗ץ אֶת־כׇּל־יְהוּדָה֙ וּבִנְיָמִ֔ן וְהַגָּרִים֙ עִמָּהֶ֔ם מֵאֶפְרַ֥יִם וּמְנַשֶּׁ֖ה וּמִשִּׁמְע֑וֹן כִּֽי־נָפְל֨וּ עָלָ֤יו מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל֙ לָרֹ֔ב בִּרְאֹתָ֕ם כִּֽי־יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָ֖יו עִמּֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyqbts 'tkhlyhvdh vbnymn vhgrym 'mhm m'prym vmnshh vmshm'vn khynplv 'lyv myshr'l lrb br'tm khyyhvh 'lhyv 'mv {p}
verses.translation: And he gathered all Judah and Benjamin, and them that sojourned with them out of Ephraim and Manasseh, and out of Simeon; for they fell to him out of Israel in abundance, when they saw that the LORD his God was with him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקָּבְצ֥וּ יְרוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם בַּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשְּׁלִשִׁ֑י לִשְׁנַ֥ת חֲמֵשׁ־עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה לְמַלְכ֥וּת אָסָֽא׃
verses.translit: vyqbtsv yrvshl͏m bchdsh hshlshy lshnt chmsh'shrh lmlkhvt 's'
verses.translation: So they gathered themselves together at Jerusalem in the third month, in the fifteenth year of the reign of Asa.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּזְבְּח֤וּ לַֽיהֹוָה֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא מִן־הַשָּׁלָ֖ל הֵבִ֑יאוּ בָּקָר֙ שְׁבַ֣ע מֵא֔וֹת וְצֹ֖אן שִׁבְעַ֥ת אֲלָפִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyzbchv lyhvh byvm hhv' mnhshll hby'v bqr shb' m'vt vts'n shb't 'lpym
verses.translation: And they sacrificed unto the LORD in that day, of the spoil which they had brought, seven hundred oxen and seven thousand sheep.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֣אוּ בַבְּרִ֔ית לִדְר֕וֹשׁ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבוֹתֵיהֶ֑ם בְּכׇל־לְבָבָ֖ם וּבְכׇל־נַפְשָֽׁם׃
verses.translit: vyb'v bbryt ldrvsh 'tyhvh 'lhy 'bvtyhm bkhllbbm vbkhlnpshm
verses.translation: And they entered into the covenant to seek the LORD, the God of their fathers, with all their heart and with all their soul;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכֹ֨ל אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹֽא־יִדְרֹ֛שׁ לַיהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל יוּמָ֑ת לְמִן־קָטֹן֙ וְעַד־גָּד֔וֹל לְמֵאִ֖ישׁ וְעַד־אִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.translit: vkhl 'shr l'ydrsh lyhvh 'lhyyshr'l yvmt lmnqtn v'dgdvl lm'ysh v'd'shh
verses.translation: and that whosoever would not seek the LORD, the God of Israel, should be put to death, whether small or great, whether man or woman.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשָּֽׁבְעוּ֙ לַֽיהֹוָ֔ה בְּק֥וֹל גָּד֖וֹל וּבִתְרוּעָ֑ה וּבַחֲצֹצְר֖וֹת וּבְשׁוֹפָרֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vyshb'v lyhvh bqvl gdvl vbtrv'h vbchtstsrvt vbshvprvt
verses.translation: And they swore unto the LORD with a loud voice, and with shouting, and with trumpets, and with horns.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׂמְח֨וּ כׇל־יְהוּדָ֜ה עַל־הַשְּׁבוּעָ֗ה כִּ֤י בְכׇל־לְבָבָם֙ נִשְׁבָּ֔עוּ וּבְכׇל־רְצוֹנָ֣ם בִּקְשֻׁ֔הוּ וַיִּמָּצֵ֖א לָהֶ֑ם וַיָּ֧נַח יְהֹוָ֛ה לָהֶ֖ם מִסָּבִֽיב׃
verses.translit: vyshmchv khlyhvdh 'lhshbv'h khy bkhllbbm nshb'v vbkhlrtsvnm bqshhv vymts' lhm vynch yhvh lhm msbyb
verses.translation: And all Judah rejoiced at the oath; for they had sworn with all their heart, and sought Him with their whole desire; and He was found of them; and the LORD gave them rest round about.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגַֽם־מַעֲכָ֞ה אֵ֣ם  אָסָ֣א הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ הֱסִירָהּ֙ מִגְּבִירָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־עָשְׂתָ֥ה לָאֲשֵׁרָ֖ה מִפְלָ֑צֶת וַיִּכְרֹ֤ת אָסָא֙ אֶת־מִפְלַצְתָּ֔הּ וַיָּ֕דֶק וַיִּשְׂרֹ֖ף בְּנַ֥חַל קִדְרֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: vgmm'khh 'm  's' hmlkh hsyrh mgbyrh 'shr'shth l'shrh mpltst vykhrt 's' 'tmpltsth vydq vyshrf bnchl qdrvn
verses.translation: And also Maacah the mother of Asa the king, he removed her from being queen, because she had made an abominable image for an Asherah; and Asa cut down her image, and made dust of it, and burnt it at the brook Kidron.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַ֨בָּמ֔וֹת לֹא־סָ֖רוּ מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֑ל רַ֧ק לְבַב־אָסָ֛א הָיָ֥ה שָׁלֵ֖ם כׇּל־יָמָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vhbmvt l'srv myshr'l rq lbb's' hyh shlm khlymyv
verses.translation: But the high places were not taken away out of Israel; nevertheless the heart of Asa was whole all his days.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֵ֞א אֶת־קׇדְשֵׁ֥י אָבִ֛יו וְקׇדָשָׁ֖יו בֵּ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים כֶּ֥סֶף וְזָהָ֖ב וְכֵלִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyb' 'tqdshy 'byv vqdshyv byt h'lhym khsf vzhb vkhlym
verses.translation: And he brought into the house of God the things that his father had hallowed, and that he himself had hallowed, silver, and gold, and vessels.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִלְחָמָ֖ה לֹ֣א הָיָ֑תָה עַ֛ד שְׁנַת־שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וְחָמֵ֖שׁ לְמַלְכ֥וּת אָסָֽא׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vmlchmh l' hyth 'd shntshlshym vchmsh lmlkhvt 's' {p}
verses.translation: And there was no more war unto the five and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּשְׁנַ֨ת שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים וָשֵׁשׁ֙ לְמַלְכ֣וּת אָסָ֔א עָלָ֞ה בַּעְשָׁ֤א מֶֽלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ עַל־יְהוּדָ֔ה וַיִּ֖בֶן אֶת־הָרָמָ֑ה לְבִלְתִּ֗י תֵּ֚ת יוֹצֵ֣א וָבָ֔א לְאָסָ֖א מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.translit: bshnt shlshym vshsh lmlkhvt 's' 'lh b'sh' mlkhyshr'l 'lyhvdh vybn 'thrmh lblty tt yvts' vb' l's' mlkh yhvdh
verses.translation: In the six and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa, Baasa king of Israel went up against Judah, and built Ramah, that he might not suffer any to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּצֵ֨א אָסָ֜א כֶּ֣סֶף וְזָהָ֗ב מֵאֹ֥צְר֛וֹת בֵּ֥ית יְהֹוָ֖ה וּבֵ֣ית הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַיִּשְׁלַ֗ח אֶל־בֶּן־הֲדַד֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אֲרָ֔ם הַיּוֹשֵׁ֥ב בְּדַרְמֶ֖שֶׂק לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyts' 's' khsf vzhb m'tsrvt byt yhvh vbyt hmlkh vyshlch 'lbnhdd mlkh 'rm hyvshb bdrmshq l'mr
verses.translation: Then Asa brought out silver and gold out of the treasures of the house of the LORD and of the king’s house, and sent to Ben-hadad king of Aram, that dwelt at Damascus, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּרִית֙ בֵּינִ֣י וּבֵינֶ֔ךָ וּבֵ֥ין אָבִ֖י וּבֵ֣ין אָבִ֑יךָ הִנֵּ֨ה שָׁלַ֤חְתִּֽי לְךָ֙ כֶּ֣סֶף וְזָהָ֔ב לֵ֞ךְ הָפֵ֣ר בְּרִֽיתְךָ֗ אֶת־בַּעְשָׁא֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְיַעֲלֶ֖ה מֵעָלָֽי׃
verses.translit: bryt byny vbynkh vbyn 'by vbyn 'bykh hnh shlchty lkh khsf vzhb lkh hpr brytkh 'tb'sh' mlkh yshr'l vy'lh m'ly
verses.translation: ’There is a league between me and thee, as there was between my father and thy father; behold, I have sent thee silver and gold; go, break thy league with Baasa king of Israel, that he may depart from me.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֨ע בֶּן־הֲדַ֜ד אֶל־הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ אָסָ֗א וַ֠יִּשְׁלַ֠ח אֶת־שָׂרֵ֨י הַחֲיָלִ֤ים אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ֙ אֶל־עָרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיַּכּוּ֙ אֶת־עִיּ֣וֹן וְאֶת־דָּ֔ן וְאֵ֖ת אָבֵ֣ל מָ֑יִם וְאֵ֥ת כׇּֽל־מִסְכְּנ֖וֹת עָרֵ֥י נַפְתָּלִֽי׃
verses.translit: vyshm' bnhdd 'lhmlkh 's' vyshlch 'tshry hchylym 'shrlv 'l'ry yshr'l vykhv 't'yvn v'tdn v't 'bl mym v't khlmskhnvt 'ry nptly
verses.translation: And Ben-hadad hearkened unto king Asa, and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Israel; and they smote Ijon, and Dan, and Abelmaim, and all the store-cities of Naphtali.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ כִּשְׁמֹ֣עַ בַּעְשָׁ֔א וַיֶּחְדַּ֕ל מִבְּנ֖וֹת אֶת־הָרָמָ֑ה וַיַּשְׁבֵּ֖ת אֶת־מְלַאכְתּֽוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyhy khshm' b'sh' vychdl mbnvt 'thrmh vyshbt 'tml'khtv {s}
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when Baasa heard
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָסָ֣א הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ לָקַח֙ אֶת־כׇּל־יְהוּדָ֔ה וַיִּשְׂא֞וּ אֶת־אַבְנֵ֤י הָרָמָה֙ וְאֶת־עֵצֶ֔יהָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּנָ֖ה בַּעְשָׁ֑א וַיִּ֣בֶן בָּהֶ֔ם אֶת־גֶּ֖בַע וְאֶת־הַמִּצְפָּֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v's' hmlkh lqch 'tkhlyhvdh vysh'v 't'bny hrmh v't'tsyh 'shr bnh b'sh' vybn bhm 'tgb' v'thmtsph {s}
verses.translation: Then Asa the king took all Judah; and they carried away the stones of Ramah, and the timber thereof, wherewith Baasa had builded; and he built therewith Geba and Mizpah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבָעֵ֣ת הַהִ֗יא בָּ֚א חֲנָ֣נִי הָרֹאֶ֔ה אֶל־אָסָ֖א מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֗יו בְּהִשָּׁ֨עֶנְךָ֜ עַל־מֶ֤לֶךְ אֲרָם֙ וְלֹ֤א נִשְׁעַ֙נְתָּ֙ עַל־יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ עַל־כֵּ֗ן נִמְלַ֛ט חֵ֥יל מֶלֶךְ־אֲרָ֖ם מִיָּדֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: vb't hhy' b' chnny hr'h 'l's' mlkh yhvdh vy'mr 'lyv bhsh'nkh 'lmlkh 'rm vl' nsh'nt 'lyhvh 'lhykh 'lkhn nmlt chyl mlkh'rm mydkh
verses.translation: And at that time Hanani the seer came to Asa king of Judah, and said unto him: ‘Because thou hast relied on the king of Aram, and hast not relied on the LORD thy God, therefore is the host of the king of Aram escaped out of thy hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲלֹ֧א הַכּוּשִׁ֣ים וְהַלּוּבִ֗ים הָי֨וּ לְחַ֧יִל ׀ לָרֹ֛ב לְרֶ֥כֶב וּלְפָרָשִׁ֖ים לְהַרְבֵּ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד וּבְהִשָּׁעֶנְךָ֥ עַל־יְהֹוָ֖ה נְתָנָ֥ם בְּיָדֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: hl' hkhvshym vhlvbym hyv lchyl  lrb lrkhb vlprshym lhrbh m'd vbhsh'nkh 'lyhvh ntnm bydkh
verses.translation: Were not the Ethiopians and the Lubim a huge host, with chariots and horsemen exceeding many? yet, because thou didst rely on the LORD, He delivered them into thy hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י יְהֹוָ֗ה עֵינָ֞יו מְשֹׁטְט֤וֹת בְּכׇל־הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ לְ֠הִתְחַזֵּ֠ק עִם־לְבָבָ֥ם שָׁלֵ֛ם אֵלָ֖יו נִסְכַּ֣לְתָּ עַל־זֹ֑את כִּ֣י מֵעַ֔תָּה יֵ֥שׁ עִמְּךָ֖ מִלְחָמֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: khy yhvh 'ynyv mshttvt bkhlh'rts lhtchzq 'mlbbm shlm 'lyv nskhlt 'lz't khy m'th ysh 'mkh mlchmvt
verses.translation: For the eyes of the LORD run to and fro throughout the whole earth, to show Himself strong in the behalf of them whose heart is whole toward Him. Herein thou hast done foolishly; for from henceforth thou shalt have wars.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּכְעַ֨ס אָסָ֜א אֶל־הָרֹאֶ֗ה וַֽיִּתְּנֵ֙הוּ֙ בֵּ֣ית הַמַּהְפֶּ֔כֶת כִּֽי־בְזַ֥עַף עִמּ֖וֹ עַל־זֹ֑את וַיְרַצֵּ֥ץ אָסָ֛א מִן־הָעָ֖ם בָּעֵ֥ת הַהִֽיא׃
verses.translit: vykh's 's' 'lhr'h vytnhv byt hmhpkht khybz'f 'mv 'lz't vyrtsts 's' mnh'm b't hhy'
verses.translation: Then Asa was wroth with the seer, and put him in the prison-house; for he was in a rage with him because of this thing. And Asa oppressed some of the people the same time.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִנֵּה֙ דִּבְרֵ֣י אָסָ֔א הָרִאשׁוֹנִ֖ים וְהָאַחֲרוֹנִ֑ים הִנָּ֤ם כְּתוּבִים֙ עַל־סֵ֣פֶר הַמְּלָכִ֔ים לִיהוּדָ֖ה וְיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vhnh dbry 's' hr'shvnym vh'chrvnym hnm khtvbym 'lspr hmlkhym lyhvdh vyshr'l
verses.translation: And, behold, the acts of Asa, first and last, lo, they are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֶּחֱלֶ֣א אָסָ֡א בִּשְׁנַת֩ שְׁלוֹשִׁ֨ים וָתֵ֤שַׁע לְמַלְכוּתוֹ֙ בְּרַגְלָ֔יו עַד־לְמַ֖עְלָה חׇלְי֑וֹ וְגַם־בְּחׇלְיוֹ֙ לֹא־דָרַ֣שׁ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֔ה כִּ֖י בָּרֹפְאִֽים׃
verses.translit: vychl' 's' bshnt shlvshym vtsh' lmlkhvtv brglyv 'dlm'lh chlyv vgmbchlyv l'drsh 'tyhvh khy brp'ym
verses.translation: And in the thirty and ninth year of his reign Asa was diseased in his feet; his disease was exceeding great; yet in his disease he sought not to the LORD, but to the physicians.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֥ב אָסָ֖א עִם־אֲבֹתָ֑יו וַיָּ֕מׇת בִּשְׁנַ֛ת אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וְאַחַ֖ת לְמׇלְכֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyshkhb 's' 'm'btyv vymt bshnt 'rb'ym v'cht lmlkhv
verses.translation: And Asa slept with his fathers, and died in the one and fortieth year of his reign.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְבְּרֻ֣הוּ בְקִבְרֹתָ֗יו אֲשֶׁ֣ר כָּרָה־לוֹ֮ בְּעִ֣יר דָּוִיד֒ וַיַּשְׁכִּיבֻ֗הוּ בַּמִּשְׁכָּב֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר מִלֵּא֙ בְּשָׂמִ֣ים וּזְנִ֔ים מְרֻקָּחִ֖ים בְּמִרְקַ֣חַת מַעֲשֶׂ֑ה וַיִּשְׂרְפוּ־ל֥וֹ שְׂרֵפָ֖ה גְּדוֹלָ֥ה עַד־לִמְאֹֽד׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyqbrhv bqbrtyv 'shr khrhlv b'yr dvyd vyshkhybhv bmshkhb 'shr ml' bshmym vznym mrqchym bmrqcht m'shh vyshrpvlv shrph gdvlh 'dlm'd {p}
verses.translation: And they buried him in his own sepulchres, which he had hewn out for himself in the city of David, and laid him in the bed which was filled with sweet odours and divers kinds [of spices] prepared by the perfumers’art; and they made a very great burning for him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ יְהוֹשָׁפָ֥ט בְּנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּ֑יו וַיִּתְחַזֵּ֖ק עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vymlkh yhvshpt bnv tchtyv vytchzq 'lyshr'l
verses.translation: And Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead, and strengthened himself against Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּ֨תֶּן־חַ֔יִל בְּכׇל־עָרֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה הַבְּצֻר֑וֹת וַיִּתֵּ֤ן נְצִיבִים֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ יְהוּדָ֔ה וּבְעָרֵ֣י אֶפְרַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֥ר לָכַ֖ד אָסָ֥א אָבִֽיו׃
verses.translit: vytnchyl bkhl'ry yhvdh hbtsrvt vytn ntsybym b'rts yhvdh vb'ry 'prym 'shr lkhd 's' 'byv
verses.translation: And he placed forces in all the fortified cities of Judah, and set garrisons in the land of Judah, and in the cities of Ephraim, which Asa his father had taken.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה עִם־יְהוֹשָׁפָ֑ט כִּ֣י הָלַ֗ךְ בְּדַרְכֵ֞י דָּוִ֤יד אָבִיו֙ הָרִ֣אשֹׁנִ֔ים וְלֹ֥א דָרַ֖שׁ לַבְּעָלִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyhy yhvh 'myhvshpt khy hlkh bdrkhy dvyd 'byv hr'shnym vl' drsh lb'lym
verses.translation: And the LORD was with Jehoshaphat, because he walked in the first ways of his father David, and sought not unto the Baalim;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֠י לֵאלֹהֵ֤י אָבִיו֙ דָּרָ֔שׁ וּבְמִצְוֺתָ֖יו הָלָ֑ךְ וְלֹ֖א כְּמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: khy l'lhy 'byv drsh vbmtsvtyv hlkh vl' khm'shh yshr'l
verses.translation: but sought to the God of his father, and walked in His commandments, and not after the doings of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֨כֶן יְהֹוָ֤ה אֶת־הַמַּמְלָכָה֙ בְּיָד֔וֹ וַיִּתְּנ֧וּ כׇל־יְהוּדָ֛ה מִנְחָ֖ה לִיהֽוֹשָׁפָ֑ט וַיְהִי־ל֥וֹ עֹשֶׁר־וְכָב֖וֹד לָרֹֽב׃
verses.translit: vykhn yhvh 'thmmlkhh bydv vytnv khlyhvdh mnchh lyhvshpt vyhylv 'shrvkhbvd lrb
verses.translation: Therefore the LORD established the kingdom in his hand; and all Judah brought to Jehoshaphat presents; and he had riches and honour in abundance.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּגְבַּ֥הּ לִבּ֖וֹ בְּדַרְכֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה וְע֗וֹד הֵסִ֛יר אֶת־הַבָּמ֥וֹת וְאֶת־הָאֲשֵׁרִ֖ים מִיהוּדָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vygbh lbv bdrkhy yhvh v'vd hsyr 'thbmvt v'th'shrym myhvdh {p}
verses.translation: And his heart was lifted up in the ways of the LORD; and furthermore he took away the high places and the Asherim out of Judah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבִשְׁנַ֨ת שָׁל֜וֹשׁ לְמׇלְכ֗וֹ שָׁלַ֤ח לְשָׂרָיו֙ לְבֶן־חַ֙יִל֙ וּלְעֹבַדְיָ֣ה וְלִזְכַרְיָ֔ה וְלִנְתַנְאֵ֖ל וּלְמִיכָיָ֑הוּ לְלַמֵּ֖ד בְּעָרֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.translit: vbshnt shlvsh lmlkhv shlch lshryv lbnchyl vl'bdyh vlzkhryh vlntn'l vlmykhyhv llmd b'ry yhvdh
verses.translation: Also in the third year of his reign he sent his princes, even Ben-hail, and Obadiah, and Zechariah, and Nethanel, and Micaiah, to teach in the cities of Judah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעִמָּהֶ֣ם הַלְוִיִּ֗ם שְֽׁמַעְיָ֡הוּ וּנְתַנְיָ֡הוּ וּזְבַדְיָ֡הוּ וַעֲשָׂהאֵ֡ל (ושמרימות) [וּשְׁמִירָמ֡וֹת] וִיהוֹנָתָן֩ וַאֲדֹ֨נִיָּ֧הוּ וְטוֹבִיָּ֛הוּ וְט֥וֹב אֲדוֹנִיָּ֖ה הַלְוִיִּ֑ם וְעִמָּהֶ֛ם אֱלִישָׁמָ֥ע וִיהוֹרָ֖ם הַכֹּהֲנִֽים׃
verses.translit: v'mhm hlvym shm'yhv vntnyhv vzbdyhv v'shh'l (vshmrymvt) [vshmyrmvt] vyhvntn v'dnyhv vtvbyhv vtvb 'dvnyh hlvym v'mhm 'lyshm' vyhvrm hkhhnym
verses.translation: and with them the Levites, even Shemaiah, and Nethaniah, and Zebadiah, and Asahel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehonathan, and Adonijah, and Tobijah, and Tob-adonijah, the Levites; and with them Elishama and Jehoram, the priests.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְלַמְּדוּ֙ בִּיהוּדָ֔ה וְעִ֨מָּהֶ֔ם סֵ֖פֶר תּוֹרַ֣ת יְהֹוָ֑ה וַיָּסֹ֙בּוּ֙ בְּכׇל־עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וַֽיְלַמְּד֖וּ בָּעָֽם׃
verses.translit: vylmdv byhvdh v'mhm spr tvrt yhvh vysbv bkhl'ry yhvdh vylmdv b'm
verses.translation: And they taught in Judah, having the book of the Law of the LORD with them; and they went about throughout all the cities of Judah, and taught among the people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י  פַּ֣חַד יְהֹוָ֗ה עַ֚ל כׇּל־מַמְלְכ֣וֹת הָאֲרָצ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֖ר סְבִיב֣וֹת יְהוּדָ֑ה וְלֹ֥א נִלְחֲמ֖וּ עִם־יְהוֹשָׁפָֽט׃
verses.translit: vyhy  pchd yhvh 'l khlmmlkhvt h'rtsvt 'shr sbybvt yhvdh vl' nlchmv 'myhvshpt
verses.translation: And a terror from the LORD fell upon all the kingdoms of the lands that were round about Judah, so that they made no war against Jehoshaphat.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִן־פְּלִשְׁתִּ֗ים מְבִיאִ֧ים לִיהוֹשָׁפָ֛ט מִנְחָ֖ה וְכֶ֣סֶף מַשָּׂ֑א גַּ֣ם הָעַרְבִיאִ֗ים מְבִיאִ֥ים לוֹ֙ צֹ֕אן אֵילִ֗ים שִׁבְעַ֤ת אֲלָפִים֙ וּשְׁבַ֣ע מֵא֔וֹת וּתְיָשִׁ֕ים שִׁבְעַ֥ת אֲלָפִ֖ים וּשְׁבַ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vmnplshtym mby'ym lyhvshpt mnchh vkhsf msh' gm h'rby'ym mby'ym lv ts'n 'ylym shb't 'lpym vshb' m'vt vtyshym shb't 'lpym vshb' m'vt {p}
verses.translation: And some of the Philistines brought Jehoshaphat presents, and silver for tribute; the Arabians also brought him flocks, seven thousand and seven hundred rams, and seven thousand and seven hundred he-goats.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֧י יְהוֹשָׁפָ֛ט הֹלֵ֥ךְ וְגָדֵ֖ל עַד־לְמָ֑עְלָה וַיִּ֧בֶן בִּיהוּדָ֛ה בִּירָנִיּ֖וֹת וְעָרֵ֥י מִסְכְּנֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vyhy yhvshpt hlkh vgdl 'dlm'lh vybn byhvdh byrnyvt v'ry mskhnvt
verses.translation: And Jehoshaphat waxed great exceedingly; and he built in Judah castles and cities of store.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמְלָאכָ֥ה רַבָּ֛ה הָ֥יָה ל֖וֹ בְּעָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה וְאַנְשֵׁ֧י מִלְחָמָ֛ה גִּבּ֥וֹרֵי חַ֖יִל בִּירוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: vml'khh rbh hyh lv b'ry yhvdh v'nshy mlchmh gbvry chyl byrvshl͏m
verses.translation: And he had many works in the cities of Judah; and men of war, mighty men of valour, in Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֥לֶּה פְקֻדָּתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבוֹתֵיהֶ֑ם לִֽיהוּדָה֙ שָׂרֵ֣י אֲלָפִ֔ים {ס} עַדְנָ֣ה הַשָּׂ֔ר וְעִמּוֹ֙ גִּבּ֣וֹרֵי חַ֔יִל שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת אָֽלֶף׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'lh pqdtm lbyt 'bvtyhm lyhvdh shry 'lpym {s} 'dnh hshr v'mv gbvry chyl shlsh m'vt 'lf {s}
verses.translation: And this was the numbering of them according to their fathers’houses: of Judah, the captains of thousands: Adnah the captain, and with him mighty men of valour three hundred thousand;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַל־יָד֖וֹ יְהוֹחָנָ֣ן הַשָּׂ֑ר וְעִמּ֕וֹ מָאתַ֥יִם וּשְׁמוֹנִ֖ים אָֽלֶף׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'lydv yhvchnn hshr v'mv m'tym vshmvnym 'lf {s}
verses.translation: and next to him Jehohanan the captain, and with him two hundred and fourscore thousand;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַל־יָדוֹ֙ עֲמַסְיָ֣ה בֶן־זִכְרִ֔י הַמִּתְנַדֵּ֖ב לַיהֹוָ֑ה וְעִמּ֛וֹ מָאתַ֥יִם אֶ֖לֶף גִּבּ֥וֹר חָֽיִל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'lydv 'msyh bnzkhry hmtndb lyhvh v'mv m'tym 'lf gbvr chyl {s}
verses.translation: and next to him Amasiah the son of Zichri, who willingly offered himself unto the LORD, and with him two hundred thousand mighty men of valour;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִ֨ן־בִּנְיָמִ֔ן גִּבּ֥וֹר חַ֖יִל אֶלְיָדָ֑ע וְעִמּ֛וֹ נֹשְׁקֵי־קֶ֥שֶׁת וּמָגֵ֖ן מָאתַ֥יִם אָֽלֶף׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vmnbnymn gbvr chyl 'lyd' v'mv nshqyqsht vmgn m'tym 'lf {s}
verses.translation: and of Benjamin: Eliada a mighty man of valour, and with him two hundred thousand armed with bow and shield;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַל־יָד֖וֹ יְהוֹזָבָ֑ד וְעִמּ֛וֹ מֵאָה־וּשְׁמוֹנִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף חֲלוּצֵ֥י צָבָֽא׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'lydv yhvzbd v'mv m'hvshmvnym 'lf chlvtsy tsb' {s}
verses.translation: and next to him Jehozabad, and with him a hundred and fourscore thousand ready prepared for war.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֖לֶּה הַמְשָׁרְתִ֣ים אֶת־הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ מִלְּבַ֞ד אֲשֶׁר־נָתַ֥ן הַמֶּ֛לֶךְ בְּעָרֵ֥י הַמִּבְצָ֖ר בְּכׇל־יְהוּדָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'lh hmshrtym 'thmlkh mlbd 'shrntn hmlkh b'ry hmbtsr bkhlyhvdh {p}
verses.translation: These were they that waited on the king beside those whom the king put in the fortified cities throughout all Judah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֧י לִיהוֹשָׁפָ֛ט עֹ֥שֶׁר וְכָב֖וֹד לָרֹ֑ב וַיִּתְחַתֵּ֖ן לְאַחְאָֽב׃
verses.translit: vyhy lyhvshpt 'shr vkhbvd lrb vytchtn l'ch'b
verses.translation: Now Jehoshaphat had riches and honour in abundance; and he allied himself with Ahab by marriage.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֩רֶד֩ לְקֵ֨ץ שָׁנִ֤ים אֶל־אַחְאָב֙ לְשֹׁ֣מְר֔וֹן וַיִּֽזְבַּֽח־ל֨וֹ אַחְאָ֜ב צֹ֤אן וּבָקָר֙ לָרֹ֔ב וְלָעָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר עִמּ֑וֹ וַיְסִיתֵ֕הוּ לַעֲל֖וֹת אֶל־רָמֹ֥ת גִּלְעָֽד׃
verses.translit: vyrd lqts shnym 'l'ch'b lshmrvn vyzbchlv 'ch'b ts'n vbqr lrb vl'm 'shr 'mv vysythv l'lvt 'lrmt gl'd
verses.translation: And after a lapse of years he went down to Ahab to Samaria. And Ahab killed sheep and oxen for him in abundance, and for the people that were with him, and persuaded him to go up with him to Ramoth-gilead.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֜אמֶר אַחְאָ֣ב מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֶל־יְהֽוֹשָׁפָט֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה הֲתֵלֵ֥ךְ עִמִּ֖י רָמֹ֣ת גִּלְעָ֑ד וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗וֹ כָּמ֤וֹנִי כָמ֙וֹךָ֙ וּכְעַמְּךָ֣ עַמִּ֔י וְעִמְּךָ֖ בַּמִּלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ch'b mlkhyshr'l 'lyhvshpt mlkh yhvdh htlkh 'my rmt gl'd vy'mr lv khmvny khmvkh vkh'mkh 'my v'mkh bmlchmh
verses.translation: And Ahab king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat king of Judah: ‘Wilt thou go with me to Ramoth-gilead?’ And he answered him: ‘I am as thou art, and my people as thy people; and we will be with thee in the war.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוֹשָׁפָ֖ט אֶל־מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל דְּרׇשׁ־נָ֥א כַיּ֖וֹם אֶת־דְּבַ֥ר יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvshpt 'lmlkh yshr'l drshn' khyvm 'tdbr yhvh
verses.translation: And Jehoshaphat said unto the king of Israel: ‘Inquire, I pray thee, at the word of the LORD today.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְבֹּ֨ץ מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל אֶֽת־הַנְּבִאִים֮ אַרְבַּ֣ע מֵא֣וֹת אִישׁ֒ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֗ם הֲנֵלֵ֞ךְ אֶל־רָמֹ֥ת גִּלְעָ֛ד לַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה אִם־אֶחְדָּ֑ל וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ עֲלֵ֔ה וְיִתֵּ֥ן הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים בְּיַ֥ד הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.translit: vyqbts mlkhyshr'l 'thnb'ym 'rb' m'vt 'ysh vy'mr 'lhm hnlkh 'lrmt gl'd lmlchmh 'm'chdl vy'mrv 'lh vytn h'lhym byd hmlkh
verses.translation: Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together, four hundred men, and said unto them: ‘Shall we go to Ramoth-gilead to battle, or shall I forbear?’ And they said: ‘Go up; for God will deliver it into the hand of the king.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ יְה֣וֹשָׁפָ֔ט הַאֵ֨ין פֹּ֥ה נָבִ֛יא לַיהֹוָ֖ה ע֑וֹד וְנִדְרְשָׁ֖ה מֵאֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvshpt h'yn ph nby' lyhvh 'vd vndrshh m'tv
verses.translation: But Jehoshaphat said: ‘Is there not here besides a prophet of the LORD, that we might inquire of him?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל ׀ אֶֽל־יְהוֹשָׁפָ֡ט ע֣וֹד אִישׁ־אֶחָ֡ד לִדְרוֹשׁ֩ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֨ה מֵאֹת֜וֹ וַאֲנִ֣י שְׂנֵאתִ֗יהוּ כִּֽי־אֵ֠ינֶ֠נּוּ מִתְנַבֵּ֨א עָלַ֤י לְטוֹבָה֙ כִּ֣י כׇל־יָמָ֣יו לְרָעָ֔ה ה֖וּא מִיכָ֣יְהוּ בֶן־יִמְלָ֑א וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ יְה֣וֹשָׁפָ֔ט אַל־יֹאמַ֥ר הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ כֵּֽן׃
verses.translit: vy'mr mlkhyshr'l  'lyhvshpt 'vd 'ysh'chd ldrvsh 'tyhvh m'tv v'ny shn'tyhv khy'ynnv mtnb' 'ly ltvbh khy khlymyv lr'h hv' mykhyhv bnyml' vy'mr yhvshpt 'ly'mr hmlkh khn
verses.translation: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat: ‘There is yet one man by whom we may inquire of the LORD; but I hate him; for he never prophesieth good concerning me, but always evil; the same is Micaiah the son of Imla.’ And Jehoshaphat said: ‘Let not the king say so.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָא֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶל־סָרִ֖יס אֶחָ֑ד וַיֹּ֕אמֶר מַהֵ֖ר (מיכהו) [מִיכָ֥יְהוּ] בֶן־יִמְלָֽא׃
verses.translit: vyqr' mlkh yshr'l 'lsrys 'chd vy'mr mhr (mykhhv) [mykhyhv] bnyml'
verses.translation: Then the king of Israel called an officer, and said: ‘Fetch quickly Micaiah the son of Imla.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֡ל וִיהוֹשָׁפָ֣ט מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָ֡ה יוֹשְׁבִים֩ אִ֨ישׁ עַל־כִּסְא֜וֹ מְלֻבָּשִׁ֤ים בְּגָדִים֙ וְיֹשְׁבִ֣ים בְּגֹ֔רֶן פֶּ֖תַח שַׁ֣עַר שֹׁמְר֑וֹן וְכׇ֨ל־הַנְּבִיאִ֔ים מִֽתְנַבְּאִ֖ים לִפְנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vmlkh yshr'l vyhvshpt mlkhyhvdh yvshbym 'ysh 'lkhs'v mlbshym bgdym vyshbym bgrn ptch sh'r shmrvn vkhlhnby'ym mtnb'ym lpnyhm
verses.translation: Now the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah sat each on his throne, arrayed in their robes, and they sat in a threshing-floor at the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets were prophesying before them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ ל֛וֹ צִדְקִיָּ֥הוּ בֶֽן־כְּנַעֲנָ֖ה קַרְנֵ֣י בַרְזֶ֑ל וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ כֹּֽה־אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה בְּאֵ֛לֶּה תְּנַגַּ֥ח אֶת־אֲרָ֖ם עַד־כַּלּוֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'sh lv tsdqyhv bnkhn'nh qrny brzl vy'mr khh'mr yhvh b'lh tngch 't'rm 'dkhlvtm
verses.translation: And Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made him horns of iron, and said: ‘Thus saith the LORD: With these shalt thou gore the Arameans, until they be consumed.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכׇ֨ל־הַנְּבִאִ֔ים נִבְּאִ֥ים כֵּ֖ן לֵאמֹ֑ר עֲלֵ֞ה רָמֹ֤ת גִּלְעָד֙ וְהַצְלַ֔ח וְנָתַ֥ן יְהֹוָ֖ה בְּיַ֥ד הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.translit: vkhlhnb'ym nb'ym khn l'mr 'lh rmt gl'd vhtslch vntn yhvh byd hmlkh
verses.translation: And all the prophets prophesied so, saying: ‘Go up to Ramoth-gilead, and prosper; for the LORD will deliver it into the hand of the king.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַמַּלְאָ֞ךְ אֲשֶׁר־הָלַ֣ךְ  לִקְרֹ֣א לְמִיכָ֗יְהוּ דִּבֶּ֤ר אֵלָיו֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הִנֵּ֞ה דִּבְרֵ֧י הַנְּבִאִ֛ים פֶּה־אֶחָ֥ד ט֖וֹב אֶל־הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וִיהִי־נָ֧א דְבָרְךָ֛ כְּאַחַ֥ד מֵהֶ֖ם וְדִבַּ֥רְתָּ טּֽוֹב׃
verses.translit: vhml'kh 'shrhlkh  lqr' lmykhyhv dbr 'lyv l'mr hnh dbry hnb'ym ph'chd tvb 'lhmlkh vyhyn' dbrkh kh'chd mhm vdbrt tvb
verses.translation: And the messenger that went to call Micaiah spoke to him, saying: ‘Behold, the words of the prophets declare good to the king with one mouth; let thy word therefore, I pray thee, be like one of theirs, and speak thou good.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר מִיכָ֑יְהוּ חַי־יְהֹוָ֕ה כִּ֛י אֶת־אֲשֶׁר־יֹאמַ֥ר אֱלֹהַ֖י אֹת֥וֹ אֲדַבֵּֽר׃
verses.translit: vy'mr mykhyhv chyyhvh khy 't'shry'mr 'lhy 'tv 'dbr
verses.translation: And Micaiah said: ‘As the LORD liveth, what my God saith, that will I speak.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹא֮ אֶל־הַמֶּ֒לֶךְ֒ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ אֵלָ֗יו מִיכָה֙ הֲנֵלֵ֞ךְ אֶל־רָמֹ֥ת גִּלְעָ֛ד לַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה אִם־אֶחְדָּ֑ל וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ עֲל֣וּ וְהַצְלִ֔יחוּ וְיִנָּתְנ֖וּ בְּיֶדְכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vyb' 'lhmlkh vy'mr hmlkh 'lyv mykhh hnlkh 'lrmt gl'd lmlchmh 'm'chdl vy'mr 'lv vhtslychv vyntnv bydkhm
verses.translation: And when he was come to the king, the king said unto him: ‘aMicaiah, shall we go to Ramoth-gilead to battle, or shall I forbear?’ And he said: ‘Go ye up, and prosper; and they shall be delivered into your hand.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָיו֙ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ עַד־כַּמֶּ֥ה פְעָמִ֖ים אֲנִ֣י מַשְׁבִּיעֶ֑ךָ אֲ֠שֶׁ֠ר לֹֽא־תְדַבֵּ֥ר אֵלַ֛י רַק־אֱמֶ֖ת בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv hmlkh 'dkhmh p'mym 'ny mshby'kh 'shr l'tdbr 'ly rq'mt bshm yhvh
verses.translation: And the king said to him: ‘How many times shall I adjure thee that thou speak unto me nothing but the truth in the name of the LORD.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר רָאִ֤יתִי אֶת־כׇּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ נְפוֹצִ֣ים עַל־הֶהָרִ֔ים כַּצֹּ֕אן אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֵין־לָהֶ֖ן רֹעֶ֑ה וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהֹוָה֙ לֹֽא־אֲדֹנִ֣ים לָאֵ֔לֶּה יָשׁ֥וּבוּ אִישׁ־לְבֵית֖וֹ בְּשָׁלֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr r'yty 'tkhlyshr'l npvtsym 'lhhrym khts'n 'shr 'ynlhn r'h vy'mr yhvh l''dnym l'lh yshvbv 'yshlbytv bshlvm
verses.translation: And he said: ‘I saw all Israel scattered upon the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd; and the LORD said: These have no master, let them return every man to his house in peace.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶל־יְהוֹשָׁפָ֑ט הֲלֹא֙ אָמַ֣רְתִּי אֵלֶ֔יךָ לֹא־יִתְנַבֵּ֥א עָלַ֛י ט֖וֹב כִּ֥י אִם־לְרָֽע׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vy'mr mlkhyshr'l 'lyhvshpt hl' 'mrty 'lykh l'ytnb' 'ly tvb khy 'mlr' {s}
verses.translation: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat: ‘Did I not tell thee that he would not prophesy good concerning me, but evil?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר לָכֵ֖ן שִׁמְע֣וּ דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֑ה רָאִ֤יתִי אֶת־יְהֹוָה֙ יוֹשֵׁ֣ב עַל־כִּסְא֔וֹ וְכׇל־צְבָ֤א הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ עֹמְדִ֔ים עַל־יְמִינ֖וֹ וּשְׂמֹאלֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr lkhn shm'v dbryhvh r'yty 'tyhvh yvshb 'lkhs'v vkhltsb' hshmym 'mdym 'lymynv vshm'lv
verses.translation: And he said: ‘Therefore hear ye the word of the LORD: I saw the LORD sitting upon His throne, and all the host of heaven standing on His right hand and on His left.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהֹוָ֗ה מִ֤י יְפַתֶּה֙ אֶת־אַחְאָ֣ב מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְיַ֕עַל וְיִפֹּ֖ל בְּרָמ֣וֹת גִּלְעָ֑ד וַיֹּ֕אמֶר זֶ֚ה אֹמֵ֣ר כָּ֔כָה וְזֶ֖ה אֹמֵ֥ר כָּֽכָה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh my ypth 't'ch'b mlkhyshr'l vy'l vypl brmvt gl'd vy'mr zh 'mr khkhh vzh 'mr khkhh
verses.translation: And the LORD said: who shall entice Ahab king of Israel, that he may go up and fall at Ramoth-gilead? And one spoke saying after this manner, and another saying after that manner.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֣א הָר֗וּחַ וַֽיַּעֲמֹד֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אֲנִ֣י אֲפַתֶּ֑נּוּ וַיֹּ֧אמֶר יְהֹוָ֛ה אֵלָ֖יו בַּמָּֽה׃
verses.translit: vyts' hrvch vy'md lpny yhvh vy'mr 'ny 'ptnv vy'mr yhvh 'lyv bmh
verses.translation: And there came forth the spirit, and stood before the LORD, and said: I will entice him. And the LORD said unto him: Wherewith?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר אֵצֵא֙ וְהָיִ֙יתִי֙ לְר֣וּחַ שֶׁ֔קֶר בְּפִ֖י כׇּל־נְבִיאָ֑יו וַיֹּ֗אמֶר תְּפַתֶּה֙ וְגַם־תּוּכָ֔ל צֵ֖א וַעֲשֵׂה־כֵֽן׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ts' vhyyty lrvch shqr bpy khlnby'yv vy'mr tpth vgmtvkhl ts' v'shhkhn
verses.translation: And he said: I will go forth, and will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets. And He said: Thou shalt entice him, and shalt prevail also; go forth, and do so.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה הִנֵּ֨ה נָתַ֤ן יְהֹוָה֙ ר֣וּחַ שֶׁ֔קֶר בְּפִ֖י נְבִיאֶ֣יךָ אֵ֑לֶּה וַֽיהֹוָ֔ה דִּבֶּ֥ר עָלֶ֖יךָ רָעָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'th hnh ntn yhvh rvch shqr bpy nby'ykh 'lh vyhvh dbr 'lykh r'h {s}
verses.translation: Now therefore, behold, the LORD hath put a lying spirit in the mouth of these thy prophets; and the LORD hath spoken evil concerning thee.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּגַּשׁ֙ צִדְקִיָּ֣הוּ בֶֽן־כְּנַעֲנָ֔ה וַיַּ֥ךְ אֶת־מִיכָ֖יְהוּ עַל־הַלֶּ֑חִי וַיֹּ֗אמֶר אֵ֣י זֶ֤ה הַדֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ עָבַ֧ר רוּחַ־יְהֹוָ֛ה מֵאִתִּ֖י לְדַבֵּ֥ר אֹתָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vygsh tsdqyhv bnkhn'nh vykh 'tmykhyhv 'lhlchy vy'mr 'y zh hdrkh 'br rvchyhvh m'ty ldbr 'tkh
verses.translation: Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah came near, and smote Micaiah upon the check, and said: ‘Which way went the spirit of the LORD from me to speak unto thee?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מִיכָ֔יְהוּ הִנְּךָ֥ רֹאֶ֖ה בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא אֲשֶׁ֥ר תָּב֛וֹא חֶ֥דֶר בְּחֶ֖דֶר לְהֵחָבֵֽא׃
verses.translit: vy'mr mykhyhv hnkh r'h byvm hhv' 'shr tbv' chdr bchdr lhchb'
verses.translation: And Micaiah said: ‘Behold, thou shalt see on that day, when thou shalt go into an inner chamber to hide thyself.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל קְחוּ֙ אֶת־מִיכָ֔יְהוּ וַהֲשִׁיבֻ֖הוּ אֶל־אָמ֣וֹן שַׂר־הָעִ֑יר וְאֶל־יוֹאָ֖שׁ בֶּן־הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr mlkh yshr'l qchv 'tmykhyhv vhshybhv 'l'mvn shrh'yr v'lyv'sh bnhmlkh
verses.translation: And the king of Israel said: ‘Take ye Micaiah; and carry him back unto Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king’s son;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֗ם כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ שִׂ֥ימוּ זֶ֖ה בֵּ֣ית הַכֶּ֑לֶא וְהַאֲכִלֻ֜הוּ לֶ֤חֶם לַ֙חַץ֙ וּמַ֣יִם לַ֔חַץ עַ֖ד שׁוּבִ֥י בְשָׁלֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: v'mrtm khh 'mr hmlkh shymv zh byt hkhl' vh'khlhv lchm lchts vmym lchts 'd shvby bshlvm
verses.translation: and say: Thus saith the king: Put this fellow in the prison, and feed him with scant bread and with scant water, until I return in peace.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מִיכָ֔יְהוּ אִם־שׁ֤וֹב תָּשׁוּב֙ בְּשָׁל֔וֹם לֹא־דִבֶּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה בִּ֑י וַיֹּ֕אמֶר שִׁמְע֖וּ עַמִּ֥ים כֻּלָּֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr mykhyhv 'mshvb tshvb bshlvm l'dbr yhvh by vy'mr shm'v 'mym khlm
verses.translation: And Micaiah said: ‘If thou return at all in peace, the LORD hath not spoken by me.’ And he said: ‘Hear, ye peoples, all of you.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֧עַל מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל וִיהוֹשָׁפָ֥ט מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָ֖ה אֶל־רָמֹ֥ת גִּלְעָֽד׃
verses.translit: vy'l mlkhyshr'l vyhvshpt mlkhyhvdh 'lrmt gl'd
verses.translation: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the kind of Judah went up to Ramoth-gilead.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֩אמֶר֩ מֶ֨לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אֶל־יְהוֹשָׁפָ֗ט הִתְחַפֵּשׂ֙ וָב֣וֹא בַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה וְאַתָּ֖ה לְבַ֣שׁ בְּגָדֶ֑יךָ וַיִּתְחַפֵּשׂ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ בַּמִּלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr mlkh yshr'l 'lyhvshpt htchpsh vbv' bmlchmh v'th lbsh bgdykh vytchpsh mlkh yshr'l vyb'v bmlchmh
verses.translation: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat: ‘I will disguise myself, and go into the battle; but put thou on thy robes.’ So the king of Israel disguised himself; and they went into the battle.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמֶ֣לֶךְ אֲרָ֡ם צִוָּה֩ אֶת־שָׂרֵ֨י הָרֶ֤כֶב אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לֹ֚א תִּלָּ֣חֲמ֔וּ אֶת־הַקָּטֹ֖ן אֶת־הַגָּד֑וֹל כִּ֛י אִֽם־אֶת־מֶ֥לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְבַדּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vmlkh 'rm tsvh 'tshry hrkhb 'shrlv l'mr l' tlchmv 'thqtn 'thgdvl khy 'm'tmlkh yshr'l lbdv
verses.translation: Now the king of Aram had commanded the captains of his chariots, saying: ‘Fight neither with small nor great, save only with the king of Israel.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֡י כִּרְאוֹת֩ שָׂרֵ֨י הָרֶ֜כֶב אֶת־יְהוֹשָׁפָ֗ט וְהֵ֤מָּה אָֽמְרוּ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל ה֔וּא וַיָּסֹ֥בּוּ עָלָ֖יו לְהִלָּחֵ֑ם וַיִּזְעַ֤ק יְהֽוֹשָׁפָט֙ וַיהֹוָ֣ה עֲזָר֔וֹ וַיְסִיתֵ֥ם אֱלֹהִ֖ים מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: vyhy khr'vt shry hrkhb 'tyhvshpt vhmh 'mrv mlkh yshr'l hv' vysbv 'lyv lhlchm vyz'q yhvshpt vyhvh 'zrv vysytm 'lhym mmnv
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, that they said: ‘It is the king of Israel.’ Therefore they turned about to fight against him; but Jehoshaphat cried out, and the LORD helped him; and God moved them to depart from him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י כִּרְאוֹת֙ שָׂרֵ֣י הָרֶ֔כֶב כִּ֥י לֹֽא־הָיָ֖ה מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיָּשׁ֖וּבוּ מֵאַחֲרָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vyhy khr'vt shry hrkhb khy l'hyh mlkh yshr'l vyshvbv m'chryv
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots saw that it was not the king of Israel, that they turned back from pursuing him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֗ישׁ מָשַׁ֤ךְ בַּקֶּ֙שֶׁת֙ לְתֻמּ֔וֹ וַיַּךְ֙ אֶת־מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בֵּ֥ין הַדְּבָקִ֖ים וּבֵ֣ין הַשִּׁרְיָ֑ן וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לָרַכָּ֗ב הֲפֹ֧ךְ (ידיך) [יָדְךָ֛] וְהוֹצֵאתַ֥נִי מִן־הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֖ה כִּ֥י הׇֽחֳלֵֽיתִי׃
verses.translit: v'ysh mshkh bqsht ltmv vykh 'tmlkh yshr'l byn hdbqym vbyn hshryn vy'mr lrkhb hpkh (ydykh) [ydkh] vhvts'tny mnhmchnh khy hchlyty
