verses.original: וּבְנֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל וִיהוּדָ֗ה הַיּוֹשְׁבִים֮ בְּעָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָה֒ גַּם־הֵ֗ם מַעְשַׂ֤ר בָּקָר֙ וָצֹ֔אן וּמַעְשַׂ֣ר קׇֽדָשִׁ֔ים הַמְקֻדָּשִׁ֖ים לַיהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֑ם הֵבִ֕יאוּ וַֽיִּתְּנ֖וּ עֲרֵמ֥וֹת עֲרֵמֽוֹת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vbny yshr'l vyhvdh hyvshbym b'ry yhvdh gmhm m'shr bqr vts'n vm'shr qdshym hmqdshym lyhvh 'lhyhm hby'v vytnv 'rmvt 'rmvt {s}
verses.translation: And the children of Israel and Judah, that dwelt in the cities of Judah, they also brought in the tithe of oxen and sheep, and the tithe of hallowed things which were hallowed unto the LORD their God, and laid them by heaps.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּחֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ הַשְּׁלִשִׁ֔י הֵחֵ֥לּוּ הָעֲרֵמ֖וֹת לְיִסּ֑וֹד וּבַחֹ֥דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֖י כִּלּֽוּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bchdsh hshlshy hchlv h'rmvt lysvd vbchdsh hshby'y khlv {s}
verses.translation: In the third month they began to lay the foundation of the heaps, and finished them in the seventh month.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ יְחִזְקִיָּ֣הוּ וְהַשָּׂרִ֔ים וַיִּרְא֖וּ אֶת־הָעֲרֵמ֑וֹת וַֽיְבָרְכוּ֙ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֔ה וְאֵ֖ת עַמּ֥וֹ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyb'v ychzqyhv vhshrym vyr'v 'th'rmvt vybrkhv 'tyhvh v't 'mv yshr'l {p}
verses.translation: And when Hezekiah and the princes came and saw the heaps, they blessed the LORD, and His people Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּדְרֹ֣שׁ יְחִזְקִיָּ֗הוּ עַל־הַכֹּ֥הֲנִ֛ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֖ם עַל־הָעֲרֵמֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vydrsh ychzqyhv 'lhkhhnym vhlvym 'lh'rmvt
verses.translation: Then Hezekiah questioned the priests and the Levites concerning the heaps.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֗יו עֲזַרְיָ֧הוּ הַכֹּהֵ֛ן הָרֹ֖אשׁ לְבֵ֣ית צָד֑וֹק וַ֠יֹּ֠אמֶר מֵהָחֵ֨ל הַתְּרוּמָ֜ה לָבִ֣יא בֵית־יְהֹוָ֗ה אָכ֨וֹל וְשָׂב֤וֹעַ וְהוֹתֵר֙ עַד־לָר֔וֹב כִּ֤י יְהֹוָה֙ בֵּרַ֣ךְ אֶת־עַמּ֔וֹ וְהַנּוֹתָ֖ר אֶת־הֶהָמ֥וֹן הַזֶּֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv 'zryhv hkhhn hr'sh lbyt tsdvq vy'mr mhchl htrvmh lby' bytyhvh 'khvl vshbv' vhvtr 'dlrvb khy yhvh brkh 't'mv vhnvtr 'thhmvn hzh {s}
verses.translation: And Azariah the chief priest, of the house of Zadok, answered him and said: ‘Since the people began to bring the offerings into the house of the LORD, we have eaten and had enough, and have left plenty; for the LORD hath blessed His people; and that which is left is this great store.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְחִזְקִיָּ֗הוּ לְהָכִ֧ין לְשָׁכ֛וֹת בְּבֵ֥ית יְהֹוָ֖ה וַיָּכִֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr ychzqyhv lhkhyn lshkhvt bbyt yhvh vykhynv
verses.translation: Then Hezekiah commanded to prepare chambers in the house of the LORD; and they prepared them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבִ֨יאוּ אֶת־הַתְּרוּמָ֧ה וְהַֽמַּעֲשֵׂ֛ר וְהַקֳּדָשִׁ֖ים בֶּאֱמוּנָ֑ה וַעֲלֵיהֶ֤ם נָגִיד֙ (כונניהו) [כׇּֽנַנְיָ֣הוּ] הַלֵּוִ֔י וְשִׁמְעִ֥י אָחִ֖יהוּ מִשְׁנֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vyby'v 'thtrvmh vhm'shr vhqdshym b'mvnh v'lyhm ngyd (khvnnyhv) [khnnyhv] hlvy vshm'y 'chyhv mshnh
verses.translation: And they brought in the offerings and the tithes and the hallowed things faithfully; and over them Conaniah the Levite was ruler, and Shimei his brother was second.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וִיחִיאֵ֡ל וַ֠עֲזַזְיָ֠הוּ וְנַ֨חַת וַעֲשָׂהאֵ֜ל וִירִימ֤וֹת וְיֽוֹזָבָד֙ וֶאֱלִיאֵ֣ל וְיִסְמַכְיָ֔הוּ וּמַ֖חַת וּבְנָיָ֑הוּ פְּקִידִ֗ים מִיַּ֤ד (כונניהו) [כׇּֽנַנְיָ֙הוּ֙] וְשִׁמְעִ֣י אָחִ֔יו בְּמִפְקַד֙ יְחִזְקִיָּ֣הוּ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וַעֲזַרְיָ֖הוּ נְגִ֥יד בֵּית־הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: vychy'l v'zzyhv vncht v'shh'l vyrymvt vyvzbd v'ly'l vysmkhyhv vmcht vbnyhv pqydym myd (khvnnyhv) [khnnyhv] vshm'y 'chyv bmpqd ychzqyhv hmlkh v'zryhv ngyd byth'lhym
verses.translation: And Jehiel, and Azaziah, and Nahath, and Asahel, and Jerimoth, and Jozabad, and Eliel, and Ismachiah, and Mahath, and Benaiah, were overseers under the hand of Conaniah and Shimei his brother, by the appointment of Hezekiah the king, and Azariah the ruler of the house of God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְקוֹרֵ֨א בֶן־יִמְנָ֤ה הַלֵּוִי֙ הַשּׁוֹעֵ֣ר לַמִּזְרָ֔חָה עַ֖ל נִדְב֣וֹת הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים לָתֵת֙ תְּרוּמַ֣ת יְהֹוָ֔ה וְקׇדְשֵׁ֖י הַקֳּדָשִֽׁים׃
verses.translit: vqvr' bnymnh hlvy hshv'r lmzrchh 'l ndbvt h'lhym ltt trvmt yhvh vqdshy hqdshym
verses.translation: And Kore the son of Imnah the Levite, the porter at the east gate, was over the freewill-offerings of God, to distribute the offerings of the LORD, and the most holy things.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַל־יָד֡וֹ עֵ֣דֶן וּ֠מִנְיָמִ֠ן וְיֵשׁ֨וּעַ וּֽשְׁמַעְיָ֜הוּ אֲמַרְיָ֧הוּ וּשְׁכַנְיָ֛הוּ בְּעָרֵ֥י הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים בֶּאֱמוּנָ֑ה לָתֵ֤ת לַֽאֲחֵיהֶם֙ בְּמַחְלְק֔וֹת כַּגָּד֖וֹל כַּקָּטָֽן׃
verses.translit: v'lydv 'dn vmnymn vyshv' vshm'yhv 'mryhv vshkhnyhv b'ry hkhhnym b'mvnh ltt l'chyhm bmchlqvt khgdvl khqtn
verses.translation: And under him were Eden, and Miniamin, and Jeshua, and Shemaiah, Amariah, and Shecaniah, in the cities of the priests, in their office of trust, to give to their brethren by courses, as well to the great as to the small;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִלְּבַ֞ד הִתְיַחְשָׂ֣ם לִזְכָרִ֗ים מִבֶּ֨ן שָׁל֤וֹשׁ שָׁנִים֙ וּלְמַ֔עְלָה לְכׇל־הַבָּ֥א לְבֵית־יְהֹוָ֖ה לִדְבַר־י֣וֹם בְּיוֹמ֑וֹ לַעֲב֣וֹדָתָ֔ם בְּמִשְׁמְרוֹתָ֖ם כְּמַחְלְקוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: mlbd htychshm lzkhrym mbn shlvsh shnym vlm'lh lkhlhb' lbytyhvh ldbryvm byvmv l'bvdtm bmshmrvtm khmchlqvtyhm
verses.translation: beside them that were reckoned by genealogy of males, from three years old and upward, even every one that entered into the house of the LORD, for his daily portion, for their service in their charges according to their courses;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֨ת הִתְיַחֵ֤שׂ הַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ לְבֵ֣ית אֲבוֹתֵיהֶ֔ם וְהַ֨לְוִיִּ֔ם מִבֶּ֛ן עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וּלְמָ֑עְלָה בְּמִשְׁמְרוֹתֵיהֶ֖ם בְּמַחְלְקוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v't htychsh hkhhnym lbyt 'bvtyhm vhlvym mbn 'shrym shnh vlm'lh bmshmrvtyhm bmchlqvtyhm
verses.translation: and them that were reckoned by genealogy of the priests by their fathers’houses, and the Levites from twenty years old and upward, in their charges by their courses;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְהִתְיַחֵ֗שׂ בְּכׇל־טַפָּ֛ם נְשֵׁיהֶ֛ם וּבְנֵיהֶ֥ם וּבְנוֹתֵיהֶ֖ם לְכׇל־קָהָ֑ל כִּ֥י בֶאֱמוּנָתָ֖ם יִתְקַדְּשׁוּ־קֹֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: vlhtychsh bkhltpm nshyhm vbnyhm vbnvtyhm lkhlqhl khy b'mvntm ytqdshvqdsh
verses.translation: even to give to them that were reckoned by genealogy of all their little ones, their wives, and their sons, and their daughters, through all the congregation; for in their office of trust they administered the sacred gifts;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלִבְנֵי֩ אַהֲרֹ֨ן הַכֹּהֲנִ֜ים בִּשְׂדֵ֨י מִגְרַ֤שׁ עָֽרֵיהֶם֙ בְּכׇל־עִ֣יר וָעִ֔יר אֲנָשִׁ֕ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִקְּב֖וּ בְּשֵׁמ֑וֹת לָתֵ֣ת מָנ֗וֹת לְכׇל־זָכָר֙ בַּכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים וּלְכׇל־הִתְיַחֵ֖שׂ בַּלְוִיִּֽם׃
verses.translit: vlbny 'hrn hkhhnym bshdy mgrsh 'ryhm bkhl'yr v'yr 'nshym 'shr nqbv bshmvt ltt mnvt lkhlzkhr bkhhnym vlkhlhtychsh blvym
verses.translation: also for the sons of Aaron the priests, that were in the fields of the open land about their cities, in every city, there were men that were mentioned by name, to give portions to all the males among the priests, and to all that were reckoned by genealogy among the Levites.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֧עַשׂ כָּזֹ֛את יְחִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ בְּכׇל־יְהוּדָ֑ה וַיַּ֨עַשׂ הַטּ֤וֹב וְהַיָּשָׁר֙ וְהָ֣אֱמֶ֔ת לִפְנֵ֖י יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vy'sh khz't ychzqyhv bkhlyhvdh vy'sh htvb vhyshr vh'mt lpny yhvh 'lhyv
verses.translation: And thus did Hezekiah throughout all Judah; and he wrought that which was good and right and faithful before the LORD his God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְכׇֽל־מַעֲשֶׂ֞ה אֲשֶׁר־הֵחֵ֣ל  בַּעֲבוֹדַ֣ת בֵּית־הָאֱלֹהִ֗ים וּבַתּוֹרָה֙ וּבַמִּצְוָ֔ה לִדְרֹ֖שׁ לֵאלֹהָ֑יו בְּכׇל־לְבָב֥וֹ עָשָׂ֖ה וְהִצְלִֽיחַ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vbkhlm'shh 'shrhchl  b'bvdt byth'lhym vbtvrh vbmtsvh ldrsh l'lhyv bkhllbbv 'shh vhtslych {p}
verses.translation: And in every work that he began in the service of the house of God, and in the law, and in the commandments, to seek his God, he did it with all his heart, and prospered.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַחֲרֵ֨י הַדְּבָרִ֤ים וְהָֽאֱמֶת֙ הָאֵ֔לֶּה בָּ֖א סַנְחֵרִ֣יב מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁ֑וּר וַיָּבֹ֣א בִיהוּדָ֗ה וַיִּ֙חַן֙ עַל־הֶעָרִ֣ים הַבְּצֻר֔וֹת וַיֹּ֖אמֶר לְבִקְעָ֥ם אֵלָֽיו׃
verses.translit: 'chry hdbrym vh'mt h'lh b' snchryb mlkh'shvr vyb' byhvdh vychn 'lh'rym hbtsrvt vy'mr lbq'm 'lyv
verses.translation: After these things, and this faithfulness, Sennacherib king of Assyria came, and entered into Judah, and encamped against the fortified cities, and thought to make a breach therein for himself.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּרְא֙ יְחִזְקִיָּ֔הוּ כִּי־בָ֖א סַנְחֵרִ֑יב וּפָנָ֕יו לַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה עַל־יְרוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: vyr' ychzqyhv khyb' snchryb vpnyv lmlchmh 'lyrvshl͏m
verses.translation: And when Hezekiah saw that Sennacherib was come, and that he was purposed to fight against Jerusalem,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּוָּעַ֗ץ עִם־שָׂרָיו֙ וְגִבֹּרָ֔יו לִסְתּוֹם֙ אֶת־מֵימֵ֣י הָעֲיָנ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֖ר מִח֣וּץ לָעִ֑יר וַֽיַּעְזְרֽוּהוּ׃
verses.translit: vyv'ts 'mshryv vgbryv lstvm 'tmymy h'ynvt 'shr mchvts l'yr vy'zrvhv
verses.translation: he took counsel with his princes and his mighty men to stop the waters of the fountains which were without the city; and they helped him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקָּבְצ֣וּ עַם־רָ֔ב וַֽיִּסְתְּמוּ֙ אֶת־כׇּל־הַמַּעְיָנ֔וֹת וְאֶת־הַנַּ֛חַל הַשּׁוֹטֵ֥ף בְּתוֹךְ־הָאָ֖רֶץ לֵאמֹ֑ר לָ֤מָּה יָב֙וֹאוּ֙ מַלְכֵ֣י אַשּׁ֔וּר וּמָצְא֖וּ מַ֥יִם רַבִּֽים׃
verses.translit: vyqbtsv 'mrb vystmv 'tkhlhm'ynvt v'thnchl hshvtf btvkhh'rts l'mr lmh ybv'v mlkhy 'shvr vmts'v mym rbym
verses.translation: So there was gathered much people together, and they stopped all the fountains, and the brook that flowed through the midst of the land, saying: ‘Why should the kings of Assyria come, and find much water?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתְחַזַּ֡ק וַיִּ֩בֶן֩ אֶת־כׇּל־הַחוֹמָ֨ה הַפְּרוּצָ֜ה וַיַּ֣עַל עַל־הַמִּגְדָּל֗וֹת וְלַח֙וּצָה֙ הַחוֹמָ֣ה אַחֶ֔רֶת וַיְחַזֵּ֥ק אֶת־הַמִּלּ֖וֹא עִ֣יר דָּוִ֑יד וַיַּ֥עַשׂ שֶׁ֛לַח לָרֹ֖ב וּמָגִנִּֽים׃
verses.translit: vytchzq vybn 'tkhlhchvmh hprvtsh vy'l 'lhmgdlvt vlchvtsh hchvmh 'chrt vychzq 'thmlv' 'yr dvyd vy'sh shlch lrb vmgnym
verses.translation: And he took courage, and built up all the wall that was broken down, and raised it up to the towers, and another wall without, and strengthened Millo in the city of David, and made weapons and shields in abundance.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֛ן שָׂרֵ֥י מִלְחָמ֖וֹת עַל־הָעָ֑ם וַיִּקְבְּצֵ֣ם אֵלָ֗יו אֶל־רְחוֹב֙ שַׁ֣עַר הָעִ֔יר וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר עַל־לְבָבָ֖ם לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vytn shry mlchmvt 'lh'm vyqbtsm 'lyv 'lrchvb sh'r h'yr vydbr 'llbbm l'mr
verses.translation: And he set captains of war over the people, and gathered them together to him in the broad place at the gate of the city, and spoke encouragingly to them, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חִזְק֣וּ וְאִמְצ֔וּ אַל־תִּֽירְא֣וּ וְאַל־תֵּחַ֗תּוּ מִפְּנֵי֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר וּמִלִּפְנֵ֖י כׇּל־הֶהָמ֣וֹן אֲשֶׁר־עִמּ֑וֹ כִּֽי־עִמָּ֥נוּ רַ֖ב מֵֽעִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: chzqv v'mtsv 'ltyr'v v'ltchtv mpny mlkh 'shvr vmlpny khlhhmvn 'shr'mv khy'mnv rb m'mv
verses.translation: ’Be strong and of good courage, be not afraid nor dismayed for the king of Assyria, nor for all the multitude that is with him; for there is a Greater with us than with him:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עִמּוֹ֙ זְר֣וֹעַ בָּשָׂ֔ר וְעִמָּ֜נוּ יְהֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֙ינוּ֙ לְעׇזְרֵ֔נוּ וּלְהִלָּחֵ֖ם מִלְחֲמֹתֵ֑נוּ וַיִּסָּמְכ֣וּ הָעָ֔ם עַל־דִּבְרֵ֖י יְחִזְקִיָּ֥הוּ מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'mv zrv' bshr v'mnv yhvh 'lhynv l'zrnv vlhlchm mlchmtnv vysmkhv h'm 'ldbry ychzqyhv mlkhyhvdh {p}
verses.translation: with him is an arm of flesh; but with us is the LORD our God to help us, and to fight our battles.’ And the people rested themselves upon the words of Hezekiah king of Judah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֣חַר זֶ֗ה שָׁ֠לַ֠ח סַנְחֵרִ֨יב מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁ֤וּר עֲבָדָיו֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלַ֔יְמָה וְהוּא֙ עַל־לָכִ֔ישׁ וְכׇל־מֶמְשַׁלְתּ֖וֹ עִמּ֑וֹ עַל־יְחִזְקִיָּ֙הוּ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה וְעַל־כׇּל־יְהוּדָ֛ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּירוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: 'chr zh shlch snchryb mlkh'shvr 'bdyv yrvshlymh vhv' 'llkhysh vkhlmmshltv 'mv 'lychzqyhv mlkh yhvdh v'lkhlyhvdh 'shr byrvshl͏m l'mr
verses.translation: After this did Sennacherib king of Assyria send his servants to Jerusalem—now he was before Lachish, and all his power with him—unto Hezekiah king of Judah, and unto all Judah that were at Jerusalem, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה אָמַ֔ר סַנְחֵרִ֖יב מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֑וּר עַל־מָה֙ אַתֶּ֣ם בֹּטְחִ֔ים וְיֹשְׁבִ֥ים בְּמָצ֖וֹר בִּירוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: khh 'mr snchryb mlkh 'shvr 'lmh 'tm btchym vyshbym bmtsvr byrvshl͏m
verses.translation: ’Thus saith Sennacherib king of Assyria: Whereon do ye trust, that ye abide the siege in Jerusalem?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲלֹ֤א יְחִזְקִיָּ֙הוּ֙ מַסִּ֣ית אֶתְכֶ֔ם לָתֵ֣ת אֶתְכֶ֔ם לָמ֛וּת בְּרָעָ֥ב וּבְצָמָ֖א לֵאמֹ֑ר יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ יַצִּילֵ֕נוּ מִכַּ֖ף מֶ֥לֶךְ אַשּֽׁוּר׃
verses.translit: hl' ychzqyhv msyt 'tkhm ltt 'tkhm lmvt br'b vbtsm' l'mr yhvh 'lhynv ytsylnv mkhf mlkh 'shvr
verses.translation: Doth not Hezekiah persuade you, to give you over to die by famine and by thirst, saying: The LORD our God will deliver us out of the hand of the king of Assyria?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲלֹא־הוּא֙ יְחִזְקִיָּ֔הוּ הֵסִ֥יר אֶת־בָּמֹתָ֖יו וְאֶת־מִזְבְּחֹתָ֑יו וַיֹּ֨אמֶר לִיהוּדָ֤ה וְלִירוּשָׁלַ֙͏ִם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לִפְנֵ֨י מִזְבֵּ֧חַ אֶחָ֛ד תִּֽשְׁתַּחֲו֖וּ וְעָלָ֥יו תַּקְטִֽירוּ׃
verses.translit: hl'hv' ychzqyhv hsyr 'tbmtyv v'tmzbchtyv vy'mr lyhvdh vlyrvshl͏m l'mr lpny mzbch 'chd tshtchvv v'lyv tqtyrv
verses.translation: Hath not the same Hezekiah taken away His high places and His altars, and commanded Judah and Jerusalem, saying: Ye shall worship before one altar, and upon it shall ye offer?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲלֹ֣א תֵדְע֗וּ מֶ֤ה עָשִׂ֙יתִי֙ אֲנִ֣י וַאֲבוֹתַ֔י לְכֹ֖ל עַמֵּ֣י הָאֲרָצ֑וֹת הֲיָכ֣וֹל יָֽכְל֗וּ אֱלֹהֵי֙ גּוֹיֵ֣ הָאֲרָצ֔וֹת לְהַצִּ֥יל אֶת־אַרְצָ֖ם מִיָּדִֽי׃
verses.translit: hl' td'v mh 'shyty 'ny v'bvty lkhl 'my h'rtsvt hykhvl ykhlv 'lhy gvy h'rtsvt lhtsyl 't'rtsm mydy
verses.translation: Know ye not what I and my fathers have done unto all the peoples of the lands? Were the gods of the nations of the lands in any wise able to deliver their land out of my hand?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִ֠י בְּֽכׇל־אֱלֹהֵ֞י הַגּוֹיִ֤ם הָאֵ֙לֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֶחֱרִ֣ימוּ אֲבוֹתַ֔י אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָכ֔וֹל לְהַצִּ֥יל אֶת־עַמּ֖וֹ מִיָּדִ֑י כִּ֤י יוּכַל֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵיכֶ֔ם לְהַצִּ֥יל אֶתְכֶ֖ם מִיָּדִֽי׃
verses.translit: my bkhl'lhy hgvym h'lh 'shr hchrymv 'bvty 'shr ykhvl lhtsyl 't'mv mydy khy yvkhl 'lhykhm lhtsyl 'tkhm mydy
verses.translation: Who was there among all the gods of those nations which my fathers utterly destroyed, that could deliver his people out of my hand, that your God should be able to deliver you out of my hand?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֡ה אַל־יַשִּׁיא֩ אֶתְכֶ֨ם חִזְקִיָּ֜הוּ וְאַל־יַסִּ֨ית אֶתְכֶ֣ם כָּזֹאת֮ וְאַל־תַּאֲמִ֣ינוּ לוֹ֒ כִּֽי־לֹ֣א יוּכַ֗ל כׇּל־אֱל֙וֹהַּ֙ כׇּל־גּ֣וֹי וּמַמְלָכָ֔ה לְהַצִּ֥יל עַמּ֛וֹ מִיָּדִ֖י וּמִיַּ֣ד אֲבוֹתָ֑י אַ֚ף כִּ֣י אֱֽלֹהֵיכֶ֔ם לֹא־יַצִּ֥ילוּ אֶתְכֶ֖ם מִיָּדִֽי׃
verses.translit: v'th 'lyshy' 'tkhm chzqyhv v'lysyt 'tkhm khz't v'lt'mynv lv khyl' yvkhl khl'lvh khlgvy vmmlkhh lhtsyl 'mv mydy vmyd 'bvty 'f khy 'lhykhm l'ytsylv 'tkhm mydy
verses.translation: Now therefore let not Hezekiah beguile you, nor persuade you after this manner, neither believe ye him; for no god of any nation or kingdom was able to deliver his people out of my hand, and out of the hand of my fathers; how much less shall your God deliver you out of my hand?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעוֹד֙ דִּבְּר֣וּ עֲבָדָ֔יו עַל־יְהֹוָ֖ה הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְעַ֖ל יְחִזְקִיָּ֥הוּ עַבְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'vd dbrv 'bdyv 'lyhvh h'lhym v'l ychzqyhv 'bdv
verses.translation: And his servants spoke yet more against the LORD God, and against His servant Hezekiah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּסְפָרִ֣ים כָּתַ֔ב לְחָרֵ֕ף לַיהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְלֵאמֹ֨ר עָלָ֜יו לֵאמֹ֗ר כֵּאלֹהֵ֞י גּוֹיֵ֤י הָֽאֲרָצוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא־הִצִּ֤ילוּ עַמָּם֙ מִיָּדִ֔י כֵּ֣ן לֹֽא־יַצִּ֞יל אֱלֹהֵ֧י יְחִזְקִיָּ֛הוּ עַמּ֖וֹ מִיָּדִֽי׃
verses.translit: vsprym khtb lchrf lyhvh 'lhy yshr'l vl'mr 'lyv l'mr kh'lhy gvyy h'rtsvt 'shr l'htsylv 'mm mydy khn l'ytsyl 'lhy ychzqyhv 'mv mydy
verses.translation: He wrote also a letter, to taunt the LORD, the God of Israel, and to speak against Him, saying: ‘As the gods of the nations of the lands, which have not delivered their people out of my hand, so shall not the God of Hezekiah deliver His people out of my hand.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְרְא֨וּ בְקוֹל־גָּד֜וֹל יְהוּדִ֗ית עַל־עַ֤ם יְרוּשָׁלַ֙͏ִם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־הַחוֹמָ֔ה לְיָֽרְאָ֖ם וּֽלְבַהֲלָ֑ם לְמַ֖עַן יִלְכְּד֥וּ אֶת־הָעִֽיר׃
verses.translit: vyqr'v bqvlgdvl yhvdyt 'l'm yrvshl͏m 'shr 'lhchvmh lyr'm vlbhlm lm'n ylkhdv 'th'yr
verses.translation: And they cried with a loud voice in the Jews’language unto the people of Jerusalem that were on the wall, to terrify them, and to affright them; that they might take the city.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְדַבְּר֔וּ אֶל־אֱלֹהֵ֖י יְרוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם כְּעַ֗ל אֱלֹהֵי֙ עַמֵּ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה יְדֵ֥י הָאָדָֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vydbrv 'l'lhy yrvshl͏m kh'l 'lhy 'my h'rts m'shh ydy h'dm {s}
verses.translation: And they spoke of the God of Jerusalem, as of the gods of the peoples of the earth, which are the work of men’s hands.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתְפַּלֵּ֞ל יְחִזְקִיָּ֣הוּ הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ וִישַׁעְיָ֧הוּ בֶן־אָמ֛וֹץ הַנָּבִ֖יא עַל־זֹ֑את וַֽיִּזְעֲק֖וּ הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vytpll ychzqyhv hmlkh vysh'yhv bn'mvts hnby' 'lz't vyz'qv hshmym {s}
verses.translation: And Hezekiah the king, and Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz, prayed because of this, and cried to heaven.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח יְהֹוָה֙ מַלְאָ֔ךְ וַיַּכְחֵ֞ד כׇּל־גִּבּ֥וֹר חַ֙יִל֙ וְנָגִ֣יד וְשָׂ֔ר בְּמַחֲנֵ֖ה מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֑וּר וַיָּ֩שׇׁב֩ בְּבֹ֨שֶׁת פָּנִ֜ים לְאַרְצ֗וֹ וַיָּבֹא֙ בֵּ֣ית אֱלֹהָ֔יו (ומיציאו) [וּמִיצִיאֵ֣י] מֵעָ֔יו שָׁ֖ם הִפִּילֻ֥הוּ בֶחָֽרֶב׃
verses.translit: vyshlch yhvh ml'kh vykhchd khlgbvr chyl vngyd vshr bmchnh mlkh 'shvr vyshb bbsht pnym l'rtsv vyb' byt 'lhyv (vmytsy'v) [vmytsy'y] m'yv shm hpylhv bchrb
verses.translation: And the LORD sent an angel, who cut off all the mighty men of valour, and the leaders and captains, in the camp of the king of Assyria. So he returned with shame of face to his own land. And when he was come into the house of his god, they that came forth of his own bowels slew him there with the sword.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיּ֩וֹשַׁע֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה אֶת־יְחִזְקִיָּ֜הוּ וְאֵ֣ת  יֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלַ֗͏ִם מִיַּ֛ד סַנְחֵרִ֥יב מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁ֖וּר וּמִיַּד־כֹּ֑ל וַֽיְנַהֲלֵ֖ם מִסָּבִֽיב׃
verses.translit: vyvsh' yhvh 'tychzqyhv v't  yshby yrvshl͏m myd snchryb mlkh'shvr vmydkhl vynhlm msbyb
verses.translation: Thus the LORD saved Hezekiah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem from the hand of Sennacherib the king of Assyria, and from the hand of all, and guided them on every side.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֠רַבִּ֠ים מְבִיאִ֨ים מִנְחָ֤ה לַֽיהֹוָה֙ לִיר֣וּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם וּמִ֨גְדָּנ֔וֹת לִֽיחִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַיִּנַּשֵּׂ֛א לְעֵינֵ֥י כׇל־הַגּוֹיִ֖ם מֵאַחֲרֵי־כֵֽן׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vrbym mby'ym mnchh lyhvh lyrvshl͏m vmgdnvt lychzqyhv mlkh yhvdh vynsh' l'yny khlhgvym m'chrykhn {p}
verses.translation: And many brought gifts unto the LORD to Jerusalem, and precious things to Hezekiah king of Judah; so that he was exalted in the sight of all nations from thenceforth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵ֔ם חָלָ֥ה יְחִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ עַד־לָמ֑וּת וַיִּתְפַּלֵּל֙ אֶל־יְהֹוָ֔ה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֔וֹ וּמוֹפֵ֖ת נָ֥תַן לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: bymym hhm chlh ychzqyhv 'dlmvt vytpll 'lyhvh vy'mr lv vmvpt ntn lv
verses.translation: In those days Hezekiah was sick even unto death; and he prayed unto the LORD; and He spoke unto him, and gave him a sign.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־כִגְמֻ֤ל עָלָיו֙ הֵשִׁ֣יב יְחִזְקִיָּ֔הוּ כִּ֥י גָבַ֖הּ לִבּ֑וֹ וַֽיְהִ֤י עָלָיו֙ קֶ֔צֶף וְעַל־יְהוּדָ֖ה וִירוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: vl'khgml 'lyv hshyb ychzqyhv khy gbh lbv vyhy 'lyv qtsf v'lyhvdh vyrvshl͏m
verses.translation: But Hezekiah rendered not according to the benefit done unto him; for his heart was lifted up; therefore there was wrath upon him, and upon Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּכָּנַ֤ע יְחִזְקִיָּ֙הוּ֙ בְּגֹ֣בַהּ לִבּ֔וֹ ה֖וּא וְיוֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם וְלֹא־בָ֤א עֲלֵיהֶם֙ קֶ֣צֶף יְהֹוָ֔ה בִּימֵ֖י יְחִזְקִיָּֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: vykhn' ychzqyhv bgbh lbv hv' vyvshby yrvshl͏m vl'b' 'lyhm qtsf yhvh bymy ychzqyhv
verses.translation: Notwithstanding Hezekiah humbled himself for the pride of his heart, both he and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, so that the wrath of the LORD came not upon them in the days of Hezekiah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֧י לִיחִזְקִיָּ֛הוּ עֹ֥שֶׁר וְכָב֖וֹד הַרְבֵּ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד וְאֹצָר֣וֹת עָֽשָׂה־ל֠וֹ לְכֶ֨סֶף וּלְזָהָ֜ב וּלְאֶ֣בֶן יְקָרָ֗ה וְלִבְשָׂמִים֙ וּלְמָ֣גִנִּ֔ים וּלְכֹ֖ל כְּלֵ֥י חֶמְדָּֽה׃
verses.translit: vyhy lychzqyhv 'shr vkhbvd hrbh m'd v'tsrvt 'shhlv lkhsf vlzhb vl'bn yqrh vlbshmym vlmgnym vlkhl khly chmdh
verses.translation: And Hezekiah had exceeding much riches and honour; and he provided him treasuries for silver, and for gold, and for precious stones, and for spices, and for shields, and for all manner of goodly vessels;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִ֨סְכְּנ֔וֹת לִתְבוּאַ֥ת דָּגָ֖ן וְתִיר֣וֹשׁ וְיִצְהָ֑ר וְאֻֽרָוֺת֙ לְכׇל־בְּהֵמָ֣ה וּבְהֵמָ֔ה וַעֲדָרִ֖ים לָאֲוֵרֹֽת׃
verses.translit: vmskhnvt ltbv't dgn vtyrvsh vytshr v'rvt lkhlbhmh vbhmh v'drym l'vrt
verses.translation: store-houses also for the increase of corn, and wine, and oil; and stalls for all manner of beasts, and flocks in folds.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָרִים֙ עָ֣שָׂה ל֔וֹ וּמִקְנֵה־צֹ֥אן וּבָקָ֖ר לָרֹ֑ב כִּ֤י נָֽתַן־לוֹ֙ אֱלֹהִ֔ים רְכ֖וּשׁ רַ֥ב מְאֹֽד׃
verses.translit: v'rym 'shh lv vmqnhts'n vbqr lrb khy ntnlv 'lhym rkhvsh rb m'd
verses.translation: Moreover he provided him cities, and possessions of flocks and herds in abundance; for God had given him very much substance.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְה֣וּא יְחִזְקִיָּ֗הוּ סָתַם֙ אֶת־מוֹצָ֞א מֵימֵ֤י גִיחוֹן֙ הָֽעֶלְי֔וֹן וַֽיַּישְּׁרֵ֥ם לְמַֽטָּה־מַּעְרָ֖בָה לְעִ֣יר דָּוִ֑יד וַיַּצְלַ֥ח יְחִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ בְּכׇֽל־מַעֲשֵֽׂהוּ׃
verses.translit: vhv' ychzqyhv stm 'tmvts' mymy gychvn h'lyvn vyyshrm lmthm'rbh l'yr dvyd vytslch ychzqyhv bkhlm'shhv
verses.translation: This same Hezekiah also stopped the upper spring of the waters of Gihon, and brought them straight down on the west side of the city of David. And Hezekiah prospered in all his works.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכֵ֞ן בִּמְלִיצֵ֣י  שָׂרֵ֣י בָבֶ֗ל הַֽמְשַׁלְּחִ֤ים עָלָיו֙ לִדְרֹ֗שׁ הַמּוֹפֵת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיָ֣ה בָאָ֔רֶץ עֲזָב֖וֹ הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים לְנַ֨סּוֹת֔וֹ לָדַ֖עַת כׇּל־בִּלְבָבֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vkhn bmlytsy  shry bbl hmshlchym 'lyv ldrsh hmvpt 'shr hyh b'rts 'zbv h'lhym lnsvtv ld't khlblbbv
verses.translation: Howbeit in the business of the ambassadors of the princes of Babylon, who sent unto him to inquire of the wonder that was done in the land, God left him, to try him, that He might know all that was in his heart.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיֶ֛תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י יְחִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ וַחֲסָדָ֑יו הִנָּ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים בַּחֲז֞וֹן יְשַׁעְיָ֤הוּ בֶן־אָמוֹץ֙ הַנָּבִ֔יא עַל־סֵ֥פֶר מַלְכֵֽי־יְהוּדָ֖ה וְיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vytr dbry ychzqyhv vchsdyv hnm khtvbym bchzvn ysh'yhv bn'mvts hnby' 'lspr mlkhyyhvdh vyshr'l
verses.translation: Now the rest of the acts of Hezekiah, and his good deeds, behold, they are written in the vision of Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz, and in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֨ב יְחִזְקִיָּ֜הוּ עִם־אֲבֹתָ֗יו וַֽיִּקְבְּרֻ֘הוּ֮ בְּֽמַעֲלֵה֮ קִבְרֵ֣י בְנֵי־דָוִיד֒ וְכָבוֹד֙ עָשׂוּ־ל֣וֹ בְמוֹת֔וֹ כׇּל־יְהוּדָ֖ה וְיֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ מְנַשֶּׁ֥ה בְנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyshkhb ychzqyhv 'm'btyv vyqbrhv bm'lh qbry bnydvyd vkhbvd 'shvlv bmvtv khlyhvdh vyshby yrvshl͏m vymlkh mnshh bnv tchtyv {p}
verses.translation: And Hezekiah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the ascent of the sepulchres of the sons of David; and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem did him honour at his death. And Manasseh his son reigned in his stead.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֶּן־שְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵ֛ה שָׁנָ֖ה מְנַשֶּׁ֣ה בְמׇלְכ֑וֹ וַחֲמִשִּׁ֤ים וְחָמֵשׁ֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: bnshtym 'shrh shnh mnshh bmlkhv vchmshym vchmsh shnh mlkh byrvshl͏m
verses.translation: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign; and he reigned fifty and five years in Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה כְּתֽוֹעֲבוֹת֙ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר֙ הוֹרִ֣ישׁ יְהֹוָ֔ה מִפְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vy'sh hr' b'yny yhvh khtv'bvt hgvym 'shr hvrysh yhvh mpny bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, after the abominations of the nations, whom the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֗שׇׁב וַיִּ֙בֶן֙ אֶת־הַבָּמ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִתַּ֖ץ יְחִזְקִיָּ֣הוּ אָבִ֑יו וַיָּ֨קֶם מִזְבְּח֤וֹת לַבְּעָלִים֙ וַיַּ֣עַשׂ אֲשֵׁר֔וֹת וַיִּשְׁתַּ֙חוּ֙ לְכׇל־צְבָ֣א הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וַֽיַּעֲבֹ֖ד אֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: vyshb vybn 'thbmvt 'shr ntts ychzqyhv 'byv vyqm mzbchvt lb'lym vy'sh 'shrvt vyshtchv lkhltsb' hshmym vy'bd 'tm
verses.translation: For he built again the high places which Hezekiah his father had broken down; and he reared up altars for the Baalim, and made Asheroth, and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבָנָ֥ה מִזְבְּח֖וֹת בְּבֵ֣ית יְהֹוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁר֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה בִּירוּשָׁלַ֥͏ִם יִֽהְיֶה־שְּׁמִ֖י לְעוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: vbnh mzbchvt bbyt yhvh 'shr 'mr yhvh byrvshl͏m yhyhshmy l'vlm
verses.translation: And he built altars in the house of the LORD, whereof the LORD said: ‘In Jerusalem shall My name be for ever.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּ֥בֶן מִזְבְּח֖וֹת לְכׇל־צְבָ֣א הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם בִּשְׁתֵּ֖י חַצְר֥וֹת בֵּית־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vybn mzbchvt lkhltsb' hshmym bshty chtsrvt bytyhvh
verses.translation: And he built altars for all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהוּא֩ הֶעֱבִ֨יר אֶת־בָּנָ֤יו בָּאֵשׁ֙ בְּגֵ֣י בֶן־הִנֹּ֔ם וְעוֹנֵ֤ן וְנִחֵשׁ֙ וְֽכִשֵּׁ֔ף וְעָ֥שָׂה א֖וֹב וְיִדְּעוֹנִ֑י הִרְבָּ֗ה לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת הָרַ֛ע בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה לְהַכְעִיסֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vhv' h'byr 'tbnyv b'sh bgy bnhnm v'vnn vnchsh vkhshf v'shh 'vb vyd'vny hrbh l'shvt hr' b'yny yhvh lhkh'ysv
verses.translation: He also made his children to pass through the fire in the valley of the son of Hinnom; and he practised soothsaying, and used enchantments, and practised sorcery, and appointed them that divined by a ghost or a familiar spirit; he wrought much evil in the sight of the LORD, to provoke Him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֕שֶׂם אֶת־פֶּ֥סֶל הַסֶּ֖מֶל אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה בְּבֵ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָמַ֤ר אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶל־דָּוִיד֙ וְאֶל־שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בְנ֔וֹ בַּבַּ֨יִת הַזֶּ֜ה וּבִירוּשָׁלַ֗͏ִם אֲשֶׁ֤ר בָּחַ֙רְתִּי֙ מִכֹּל֙ שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אָשִׂ֥ים אֶת־שְׁמִ֖י לְעֵילֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: vyshm 'tpsl hsml 'shr 'shh bbyt h'lhym 'shr 'mr 'lhym 'ldvyd v'lshlmh bnv bbyt hzh vbyrvshl͏m 'shr bchrty mkhl shbty yshr'l 'shym 'tshmy l'ylvm
verses.translation: And he set the graven image of the idol, which he had made, in the house of God, of which God said to David and to Solomon his son: ‘In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, will I put My name for ever;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹ֣א אֹסִ֗יף לְהָסִיר֙ אֶת־רֶ֣גֶל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מֵעַל֙ הָֽאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶעֱמַ֖דְתִּי לַאֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם רַ֣ק  אִם־יִשְׁמְר֣וּ לַעֲשׂ֗וֹת אֵ֚ת כׇּל־אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוִּיתִ֔ים לְכׇל־הַתּוֹרָ֛ה וְהַחֻקִּ֥ים וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֖ים בְּיַד־מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.translit: vl' 'syf lhsyr 'trgl yshr'l m'l h'dmh 'shr h'mdty l'bvtykhm rq  'myshmrv l'shvt 't khl'shr tsvytym lkhlhtvrh vhchqym vhmshptym bydmshh
verses.translation: neither will I any more remove the foot of Israel from off the land which I have appointed for your fathers; if only they will observe to do all that I have commanded them, even all the law and the statutes and the ordinances by the hand of Moses.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֶּ֣תַע מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה אֶת־יְהוּדָ֖ה וְיֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת רָ֔ע מִ֨ן־הַגּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר֙ הִשְׁמִ֣יד יְהֹוָ֔ה מִפְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyt' mnshh 'tyhvdh vyshby yrvshl͏m l'shvt r' mnhgvym 'shr hshmyd yhvh mpny bny yshr'l {p}
verses.translation: And Manasseh made Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to err, so that they did evil more than did the nations, whom the LORD destroyed before the children of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֧ר יְהֹוָ֛ה אֶל־מְנַשֶּׁ֥ה וְאֶל־עַמּ֖וֹ וְלֹ֥א הִקְשִֽׁיבוּ׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmnshh v'l'mv vl' hqshybv
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke to Manasseh, and to his people; but they gave no heed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֵ֨א יְהֹוָ֜ה עֲלֵיהֶ֗ם אֶת־שָׂרֵ֤י הַצָּבָא֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ לְמֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר וַיִּלְכְּד֥וּ אֶת־מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה בַּחֹחִ֑ים וַיַּאַסְרֻ֙הוּ֙ בַּֽנְחֻשְׁתַּ֔יִם וַיּוֹלִיכֻ֖הוּ בָּבֶֽלָה׃
verses.translit: vyb' yhvh 'lyhm 'tshry htsb' 'shr lmlkh 'shvr vylkhdv 'tmnshh bchchym vy'srhv bnchshtym vyvlykhhv bblh
verses.translation: Wherefore the LORD brought upon them the captains of the host of the king of Assyria, who took Manasseh with hooks, and bound him with fetters, and carried him to Babylon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּכְהָצֵ֣ר ל֔וֹ חִלָּ֕ה אֶת־פְּנֵ֖י יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑יו וַיִּכָּנַ֣ע מְאֹ֔ד מִלִּפְנֵ֖י אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבֹתָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vkhhtsr lv chlh 'tpny yhvh 'lhyv vykhn' m'd mlpny 'lhy 'btyv
verses.translation: And when he was in distress, he besought the LORD his God, and humbled himself greatly before the God of his fathers.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתְפַּלֵּ֣ל אֵלָ֗יו וַיֵּעָ֤תֶר לוֹ֙ וַיִּשְׁמַ֣ע תְּחִנָּת֔וֹ וַיְשִׁיבֵ֥הוּ יְרוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם לְמַלְכוּת֑וֹ וַיֵּ֣דַע מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה כִּ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה ה֥וּא הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: vytpll 'lyv vy'tr lv vyshm' tchntv vyshybhv yrvshl͏m lmlkhvtv vyd' mnshh khy yhvh hv' h'lhym
verses.translation: And he prayed unto Him; and He was entreated of him, and heard his supplication, and brought him back to Jerusalem into his kingdom. Then Manasseh knew that the LORD He was God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַחֲרֵי־כֵ֡ן בָּנָ֣ה חוֹמָ֣ה חִיצוֹנָ֣ה ׀ לְעִיר־דָּוִ֡יד מַעְרָ֩בָה֩ לְגִיח֨וֹן בַּנַּ֜חַל וְלָב֨וֹא בְשַׁ֤עַר הַדָּגִים֙ וְסָבַ֣ב לָעֹ֔פֶל וַיַּגְבִּיהֶ֖הָ מְאֹ֑ד וַיָּ֧שֶׂם שָׂרֵי־חַ֛יִל בְּכׇל־הֶעָרִ֥ים הַבְּצֻר֖וֹת בִּיהוּדָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'chrykhn bnh chvmh chytsvnh  l'yrdvyd m'rbh lgychvn bnchl vlbv' bsh'r hdgym vsbb l'pl vygbyhh m'd vyshm shrychyl bkhlh'rym hbtsrvt byhvdh
verses.translation: Now after this he built an outer wall to the city of David, on the west side of Gihon, in the valley, even to the entrance at the fish gate; and he compassed about Ophel, and raised it up a very great height; and he put captains of the army in all the fortified cities of Judah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֠יָּ֠סַר אֶת־אֱלֹהֵ֨י הַנֵּכָ֤ר וְאֶת־הַסֶּ֙מֶל֙ מִבֵּ֣ית יְהֹוָ֔ה וְכׇל־הַֽמִּזְבְּח֗וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּנָ֛ה בְּהַ֥ר בֵּית־יְהֹוָ֖ה וּבִירוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם וַיַּשְׁלֵ֖ךְ ח֥וּצָה לָעִֽיר׃
verses.translit: vysr 't'lhy hnkhr v'thsml mbyt yhvh vkhlhmzbchvt 'shr bnh bhr bytyhvh vbyrvshl͏m vyshlkh chvtsh l'yr
verses.translation: And he took away the strange gods, and the idol out of the house of the LORD, and all the altars that he had built in the mount of the house of the LORD, and in Jerusalem, and cast them out of the city.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (ויכן) [וַיִּ֙בֶן֙] אֶת־מִזְבַּ֣ח יְהֹוָ֔ה וַיִּזְבַּ֣ח עָלָ֔יו זִבְחֵ֥י שְׁלָמִ֖ים וְתוֹדָ֑ה וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ לִיהוּדָ֔ה לַעֲב֕וֹד אֶת־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: (vykhn) [vybn] 'tmzbch yhvh vyzbch 'lyv zbchy shlmym vtvdh vy'mr lyhvdh l'bvd 'tyhvh 'lhy yshr'l
verses.translation: And he built up the altar of the LORD, and offered thereon sacrifices of peace-offerings and of thanksgiving, and commanded Judah to serve the LORD, the God of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲבָל֙ ע֣וֹד הָעָ֔ם זֹבְחִ֖ים בַּבָּמ֑וֹת רַ֖ק לַיהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: 'bl 'vd h'm zbchym bbmvt rq lyhvh 'lhyhm
verses.translation: Nevertheless the people did sacrifice still in the high places, but only unto the LORD their God. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיֶ֨תֶר דִּבְרֵ֣י מְנַשֶּׁה֮ וּתְפִלָּת֣וֹ אֶל־אֱלֹהָיו֒ וְדִבְרֵי֙ הַחֹזִ֔ים הַֽמְדַבְּרִ֣ים אֵלָ֔יו בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הִנָּ֕ם עַל־דִּבְרֵ֖י מַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vytr dbry mnshh vtpltv 'l'lhyv vdbry hchzym hmdbrym 'lyv bshm yhvh 'lhy yshr'l hnm 'ldbry mlkhy yshr'l
verses.translation: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and his prayer unto his God, and the words of the seers that spoke to him in the name of the LORD, the God of Israel, behold, they are written among the acts of the kings of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּתְפִלָּת֣וֹ וְהֵעָתֶר־לוֹ֮ וְכׇל־חַטָּאת֣וֹ וּמַעְלוֹ֒ וְהַמְּקֹמ֗וֹת אֲשֶׁר֩ בָּנָ֨ה בָהֶ֤ם בָּמוֹת֙ וְהֶֽעֱמִיד֙ הָאֲשֵׁרִ֣ים וְהַפְּסִלִ֔ים לִפְנֵ֖י הִכָּֽנְע֑וֹ הִנָּ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֔ים עַ֖ל דִּבְרֵ֥י חוֹזָֽי׃
verses.translit: vtpltv vh'trlv vkhlcht'tv vm'lv vhmqmvt 'shr bnh bhm bmvt vh'myd h'shrym vhpslym lpny hkhn'v hnm khtvbym 'l dbry chvzy
verses.translation: His prayer also, and how [God] was entreated of him, and all his sin and his transgression, and the places wherein he built high places, and set up the Asherim and the graven images, before he humbled himself; behold, they are written in the history of the seers.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֤ב מְנַשֶּׁה֙ עִם־אֲבֹתָ֔יו וַֽיִּקְבְּרֻ֖הוּ בֵּית֑וֹ וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ אָמ֥וֹן בְּנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyshkhb mnshh 'm'btyv vyqbrhv bytv vymlkh 'mvn bnv tchtyv {p}
verses.translation: So Manasseh slept with his fathers, and they buried him in his own house; and Amon his son reigned in his stead.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֶּן־עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁתַּ֛יִם שָׁנָ֖ה אָמ֣וֹן בְּמׇלְכ֑וֹ וּשְׁתַּ֣יִם שָׁנִ֔ים מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירֽוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: bn'shrym vshtym shnh 'mvn bmlkhv vshtym shnym mlkh byrvshl͏m
verses.translation: Amon was twenty and two years old when he began to reign; and he reigned two years in Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֤עַשׂ הָרַע֙ בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה מְנַשֶּׁ֣ה אָבִ֑יו וּלְכׇל־הַפְּסִילִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשָׂה֙ מְנַשֶּׁ֣ה אָבִ֔יו זִבַּ֥ח אָמ֖וֹן וַיַּעַבְדֵֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'sh hr' b'yny yhvh kh'shr 'shh mnshh 'byv vlkhlhpsylym 'shr 'shh mnshh 'byv zbch 'mvn vy'bdm
verses.translation: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, as did Manasseh his father; and Amon sacrificed unto all the graven images which Manasseh his father had made, and served them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹ֤א נִכְנַע֙ מִלִּפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה כְּהִכָּנַ֖ע מְנַשֶּׁ֣ה אָבִ֑יו כִּ֛י ה֥וּא אָמ֖וֹן הִרְבָּ֥ה אַשְׁמָֽה׃
verses.translit: vl' nkhn' mlpny yhvh khhkhn' mnshh 'byv khy hv' 'mvn hrbh 'shmh
verses.translation: And he humbled not himself before the LORD, as Manasseh his father had humbled himself; but this same Amon became guilty more and more.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְשְׁר֤וּ עָלָיו֙ עֲבָדָ֔יו וַיְמִיתֻ֖הוּ בְּבֵיתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyqshrv 'lyv 'bdyv vymythv bbytv
verses.translation: And his servants conspired against him, and put him to death in his own house.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּכּוּ֙ עַם־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֵ֥ת כׇּל־הַקֹּשְׁרִ֖ים עַל־הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ אָמ֑וֹן וַיַּמְלִ֧יכוּ עַם־הָאָ֛רֶץ אֶת־יֹאשִׁיָּ֥הוּ בְנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vykhv 'mh'rts 't khlhqshrym 'lhmlkh 'mvn vymlykhv 'mh'rts 'ty'shyhv bnv tchtyv {p}
verses.translation: But the people of the land slew all them that had conspired against king Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his stead.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֶּן־שְׁמוֹנֶ֥ה שָׁנִ֖ים יֹאשִׁיָּ֣הוּ בְמׇלְכ֑וֹ וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים וְאַחַת֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: bnshmvnh shnym y'shyhv bmlkhv vshlshym v'cht shnh mlkh byrvshl͏m
verses.translation: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign; and he reigned thirty and one years in Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הַיָּשָׁ֖ר בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה וַיֵּ֗לֶךְ בְּדַרְכֵי֙ דָּוִ֣יד אָבִ֔יו וְלֹא־סָ֖ר יָמִ֥ין וּשְׂמֹֽאול׃
verses.translit: vy'sh hyshr b'yny yhvh vylkh bdrkhy dvyd 'byv vl'sr ymyn vshm'vl
verses.translation: And he did that which was right in the eyes of the LORD, and walked in the ways of David his father, and turned not aside to the right hand or to the left.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבִשְׁמוֹנֶ֨ה שָׁנִ֜ים לְמׇלְכ֗וֹ וְהוּא֙ עוֹדֶ֣נּוּ נַ֔עַר הֵחֵ֕ל לִדְר֕וֹשׁ לֵאלֹהֵ֖י דָּוִ֣יד אָבִ֑יו וּבִשְׁתֵּ֧ים עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֗ה הֵחֵל֙ לְטַהֵ֗ר אֶת־יְהוּדָה֙ וִיר֣וּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם מִן־הַבָּמוֹת֙ וְהָ֣אֲשֵׁרִ֔ים וְהַפְּסִלִ֖ים וְהַמַּסֵּכֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vbshmvnh shnym lmlkhv vhv' 'vdnv n'r hchl ldrvsh l'lhy dvyd 'byv vbshtym 'shrh shnh hchl lthr 'tyhvdh vyrvshl͏m mnhbmvt vh'shrym vhpslym vhmskhvt
verses.translation: For in the eighth year of his reign, while he was yet young, he began to seek after the God of David his father; and in the twelfth year he began to purge Judah and Jerusalem from the high places, and the Asherim, and the graven images, and the molten images.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְנַתְּצ֣וּ לְפָנָ֗יו אֵ֚ת מִזְבְּח֣וֹת הַבְּעָלִ֔ים וְהַחַמָּנִ֛ים אֲשֶׁר־לְמַ֥עְלָה מֵעֲלֵיהֶ֖ם גִּדֵּ֑עַ וְ֠הָאֲשֵׁרִ֠ים וְהַפְּסִלִ֤ים וְהַמַּסֵּכוֹת֙ שִׁבַּ֣ר וְהֵדַ֔ק וַיִּזְרֹק֙ עַל־פְּנֵ֣י הַקְּבָרִ֔ים הַזֹּבְחִ֖ים לָהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vynttsv lpnyv 't mzbchvt hb'lym vhchmnym 'shrlm'lh m'lyhm gd' vh'shrym vhpslym vhmskhvt shbr vhdq vyzrq 'lpny hqbrym hzbchym lhm
verses.translation: And they broke down the altars of the Baalim in his presence; and the sun-images, that were on high above them, he hewed down; and the Asherim, and the graven images, and the molten images, he broke in pieces, and made dust of them, and strewed it upon the graves of them that had sacrificed unto them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַצְמוֹת֙ כֹּֽהֲנִ֔ים שָׂרַ֖ף עַל־[מִזְבְּחוֹתָ֑ם] (מזבחותים) וַיְטַהֵ֥ר אֶת־יְהוּדָ֖ה וְאֶת־יְרוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: v'tsmvt khhnym shrf 'l[mzbchvtm] (mzbchvtym) vythr 'tyhvdh v'tyrvshl͏m
verses.translation: And he burnt the bones of the priests upon their altars, and purged Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְעָרֵ֨י מְנַשֶּׁ֧ה וְאֶפְרַ֛יִם וְשִׁמְע֖וֹן וְעַד־נַפְתָּלִ֑י (בחר בתיהם) [בְּחַרְבֹתֵיהֶ֖ם] סָבִֽיב׃
verses.translit: vb'ry mnshh v'prym vshm'vn v'dnptly (bchr btyhm) [bchrbtyhm] sbyb
verses.translation: And so did he in the cities of Manasseh and Ephraim and Simeon, even unto Naphtali, with their axes round about.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְנַתֵּ֣ץ אֶת־הַֽמִּזְבְּח֗וֹת וְאֶת־הָאֲשֵׁרִ֤ים וְהַפְּסִלִים֙ כִּתַּ֣ת לְהֵדַ֔ק וְכׇל־הַחַמָּנִ֥ים גִּדַּ֖ע בְּכׇל־אֶ֣רֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיָּ֖שׇׁב לִירוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyntts 'thmzbchvt v'th'shrym vhpslym khtt lhdq vkhlhchmnym gd' bkhl'rts yshr'l vyshb lyrvshl͏m {p}
verses.translation: And he broke down the altars, and beat the Asherim and the graven images into powder, and hewed down all the sun-images throughout all the land of Israel, and returned to Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבִשְׁנַ֨ת שְׁמוֹנֶ֤ה עֶשְׂרֵה֙ לְמׇלְכ֔וֹ לְטַהֵ֥ר הָאָ֖רֶץ וְהַבָּ֑יִת שָׁ֠לַ֠ח אֶת־שָׁפָ֨ן בֶּן־אֲצַלְיָ֜הוּ וְאֶת־מַעֲשֵׂיָ֣הוּ שַׂר־הָעִ֗יר וְ֠אֵ֠ת יוֹאָ֤ח בֶּן־יֽוֹאָחָז֙ הַמַּזְכִּ֔יר לְחַזֵּ֕ק אֶת־בֵּ֖ית יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vbshnt shmvnh 'shrh lmlkhv lthr h'rts vhbyt shlch 'tshpn bn'tslyhv v'tm'shyhv shrh'yr v't yv'ch bnyv'chz hmzkhyr lchzq 'tbyt yhvh 'lhyv
verses.translation: Now in the eighteenth year of his reign, when he had purged the land, and the house, he sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah, and Maaseiah the governor of the city, and Joah the son of Joahaz the recorder, to repair the house of the LORD his God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֜אוּ אֶל־חִלְקִיָּ֣הוּ  הַכֹּהֵ֣ן הַגָּד֗וֹל וַֽיִּתְּנוּ֮ אֶת־הַכֶּ֘סֶף֮ הַמּוּבָ֣א בֵית־אֱלֹהִים֒ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָסְפֽוּ־הַלְוִיִּם֩ שֹׁמְרֵ֨י הַסַּ֜ף מִיַּ֧ד מְנַשֶּׁ֣ה וְאֶפְרַ֗יִם וּמִכֹּל֙ שְׁאֵרִ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וּמִכׇּל־יְהוּדָ֖ה וּבִנְיָמִ֑ן (וישבי) [וַיָּשׁ֖וּבוּ] יְרוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: vyb'v 'lchlqyhv  hkhhn hgdvl vytnv 'thkhsf hmvb' byt'lhym 'shr 'spvhlvym shmry hsf myd mnshh v'prym vmkhl sh'ryt yshr'l vmkhlyhvdh vbnymn (vyshby) [vyshvbv] yrvshl͏m
verses.translation: And they came to Hilkiah the high priest, and delivered the money that was brought into the house of God, which the Levites, the keepers of the door, had gathered of the hand of Manasseh and Ephraim, and of all the remnant of Israel, and of all Judah and Benjamin, and they returned to Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיִּתְּנ֗וּ עַל־יַד֙ עֹשֵׂ֣ה הַמְּלָאכָ֔ה הַמֻּפְקָדִ֖ים בְּבֵ֣ית יְהֹוָ֑ה וַיִּתְּנ֨וּ אֹת֜וֹ עוֹשֵׂ֣י הַמְּלָאכָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר עֹשִׂים֙ בְּבֵ֣ית יְהֹוָ֔ה לִבְדּ֥וֹק וּלְחַזֵּ֖ק הַבָּֽיִת׃
verses.translit: vytnv 'lyd 'shh hml'khh hmpqdym bbyt yhvh vytnv 'tv 'vshy hml'khh 'shr 'shym bbyt yhvh lbdvq vlchzq hbyt
verses.translation: And they delivered it into the hand of the workmen that had the oversight of the house of the LORD; and the workmen that wrought in the house of the LORD gave it to mend and repair the house;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיִּתְּנ֗וּ לֶחָֽרָשִׁים֙ וְלַבֹּנִ֔ים לִקְנוֹת֙ אַבְנֵ֣י מַחְצֵ֔ב וְעֵצִ֖ים לַֽמְחַבְּר֑וֹת וּלְקָרוֹת֙ אֶת־הַבָּ֣תִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִשְׁחִ֖יתוּ מַלְכֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vytnv lchrshym vlbnym lqnvt 'bny mchtsb v'tsym lmchbrvt vlqrvt 'thbtym 'shr hshchytv mlkhy yhvdh {s}
verses.translation: even to the carpenters and to the builders gave they it, to buy hewn stone, and timber for couplings, and to make beams for the houses which the kings of Judah had destroyed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָאֲנָשִׁים֩ עֹשִׂ֨ים בֶּאֱמוּנָ֜ה בַּמְּלָאכָ֗ה וַעֲלֵיהֶ֣ם ׀ מֻ֠פְקָדִ֠ים יַ֣חַת וְעֹבַדְיָ֤הוּ הַלְוִיִּם֙ מִן־בְּנֵ֣י מְרָרִ֔י וּזְכַרְיָ֧ה וּמְשֻׁלָּ֛ם מִן־בְּנֵ֥י הַקְּהָתִ֖ים לְנַצֵּ֑חַ וְהַ֨לְוִיִּ֔ם כׇּל־מֵבִ֖ין בִּכְלֵי־שִֽׁיר׃
verses.translit: vh'nshym 'shym b'mvnh bml'khh v'lyhm  mpqdym ycht v'bdyhv hlvym mnbny mrry vzkhryh vmshlm mnbny hqhtym lntsch vhlvym khlmbyn bkhlyshyr
verses.translation: And the men did the work faithfully; and the overseers of them were Jahath and Obadiah, the Levites, of the sons of Merari; and Zechariah and Meshullam, of the sons of the Kohathites, to preside over it; and other of the Levites, all that had skill with instruments of music.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַ֣ל הַסַּבָּלִ֗ים וּֽמְנַצְּחִים֙ לְכֹל֙ עֹשֵׂ֣ה מְלָאכָ֔ה לַעֲבוֹדָ֖ה וַעֲבוֹדָ֑ה וּמֵֽהַלְוִיִּ֔ם סוֹפְרִ֥ים וְשֹׁטְרִ֖ים וְשׁוֹעֲרִֽים׃
verses.translit: v'l hsblym vmntschym lkhl 'shh ml'khh l'bvdh v'bvdh vmhlvym svprym vshtrym vshv'rym
verses.translation: Also they were over the bearers of burdens, and presided over all that did the work in every manner of service; and of the Levites there were scribes, and officers, and porters.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְהוֹצִיאָ֣ם אֶת־הַכֶּ֔סֶף הַמּוּבָ֖א בֵּ֣ית יְהֹוָ֑ה מָצָא֙ חִלְקִיָּ֣הוּ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן אֶת־סֵ֥פֶר תּוֹרַת־יְהֹוָ֖ה בְּיַד־מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.translit: vbhvtsy'm 'thkhsf hmvb' byt yhvh mts' chlqyhv hkhhn 'tspr tvrtyhvh bydmshh
verses.translation: And when they brought out the money that was brought into the house of the LORD, Hilkiah the priest found the book of the Law of the LORD given by Moses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַן חִלְקִיָּ֗הוּ וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־שָׁפָ֣ן הַסּוֹפֵ֔ר סֵ֧פֶר הַתּוֹרָ֛ה מָצָ֖אתִי בְּבֵ֣ית יְהֹוָ֑ה וַיִּתֵּ֧ן חִלְקִיָּ֛הוּ אֶת־הַסֵּ֖פֶר אֶל־שָׁפָֽן׃
verses.translit: vy'n chlqyhv vy'mr 'lshpn hsvpr spr htvrh mts'ty bbyt yhvh vytn chlqyhv 'thspr 'lshpn
verses.translation: and Hilkiah answered and said to Shaphan the scribe: ‘I have found the book of the Law in the house of the LORD.’ And Hilkiah delivered the book to Shaphan.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֵ֨א שָׁפָ֤ן אֶת־הַסֵּ֙פֶר֙ אֶל־הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וַיָּ֨שֶׁב ע֧וֹד אֶת־הַמֶּ֛לֶךְ דָּבָ֖ר לֵאמֹ֑ר כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־נִתַּ֥ן בְּיַד־עֲבָדֶ֖יךָ הֵ֥ם עֹשִֽׂים׃
verses.translit: vyb' shpn 'thspr 'lhmlkh vyshb 'vd 'thmlkh dbr l'mr khl 'shrntn byd'bdykh hm 'shym
verses.translation: And Shaphan carried the book to the king, and moreover brought back word unto the king, saying: ‘All that was committed to thy servants, they do it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּתִּ֕יכוּ אֶת־הַכֶּ֖סֶף הַנִּמְצָ֣א בְּבֵית־יְהֹוָ֑ה וַֽיִּתְּנ֗וּהוּ עַל־יַד֙ הַמֻּפְקָדִ֔ים וְעַל־יַ֖ד עוֹשֵׂ֥י הַמְּלָאכָֽה׃
verses.translit: vytykhv 'thkhsf hnmts' bbytyhvh vytnvhv 'lyd hmpqdym v'lyd 'vshy hml'khh
verses.translation: And they have poured out the money that was found in the house of the LORD, and have delivered it into the hand of the overseers, and into the hand of the workmen.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּגֵּ֞ד שָׁפָ֤ן הַסּוֹפֵר֙ לַמֶּ֣לֶךְ לֵאמֹ֔ר סֵ֚פֶר נָ֣תַן לִ֔י חִלְקִיָּ֖הוּ הַכֹּהֵ֑ן וַיִּקְרָא־ב֥וֹ שָׁפָ֖ן לִפְנֵ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.translit: vygd shpn hsvpr lmlkh l'mr spr ntn ly chlqyhv hkhhn vyqr'bv shpn lpny hmlkh
verses.translation: And Shaphan the scribe told the king, saying: ‘Hilkiah the priest hath delivered me a book.’ And Shaphan read therein before the king.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ כִּשְׁמֹ֣עַ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ אֵ֖ת דִּבְרֵ֣י הַתּוֹרָ֑ה וַיִּקְרַ֖ע אֶת־בְּגָדָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vyhy khshm' hmlkh 't dbry htvrh vyqr' 'tbgdyv
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when the king had heard the words of the Law, that he rent his clothes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְצַ֣ו הַמֶּ֡לֶךְ אֶת־חִלְקִיָּ֡הוּ וְאֶת־אֲחִיקָ֣ם בֶּן־שָׁ֠פָ֠ן וְאֶת־עַבְדּ֨וֹן בֶּן־מִיכָ֜ה וְאֵ֣ת  שָׁפָ֣ן הַסּוֹפֵ֗ר וְאֵ֛ת עֲשָׂיָ֥ה עֶֽבֶד־הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vytsv hmlkh 'tchlqyhv v't'chyqm bnshpn v't'bdvn bnmykhh v't  shpn hsvpr v't 'shyh 'bdhmlkh l'mr
verses.translation: And the king commanded Hilkiah, and Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Abdon the son of Micah, and Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah the king’s servant, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְכוּ֩ דִרְשׁ֨וּ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֜ה בַּעֲדִ֗י וּבְעַד֙ הַנִּשְׁאָר֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל וּבִיהוּדָ֔ה עַל־דִּבְרֵ֥י הַסֵּ֖פֶר אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִמְצָ֑א כִּֽי־גְדוֹלָ֤ה חֲמַת־יְהֹוָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִתְּכָ֣ה בָ֔נוּ עַל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא־שָׁמְר֤וּ אֲבוֹתֵ֙ינוּ֙ אֶת־דְּבַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה לַעֲשׂ֕וֹת כְּכׇל־הַכָּת֖וּב עַל־הַסֵּ֥פֶר הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: lkhv drshv 'tyhvh b'dy vb'd hnsh'r byshr'l vbyhvdh 'ldbry hspr 'shr nmts' khygdvlh chmtyhvh 'shr ntkhh bnv 'l 'shr l'shmrv 'bvtynv 'tdbr yhvh l'shvt khkhlhkhtvb 'lhspr hzh
verses.translation: ’Go ye, inquire of the LORD for me, and for them that are left in Israel and in Judah, concerning the words of the book that is found; for great is the wrath of the LORD that is poured out upon us, because our fathers have not kept the word of the LORD, to do according unto all that is written in this book.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֨לֶךְ חִלְקִיָּ֜הוּ וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ אֶל־חֻלְדָּ֨ה הַנְּבִיאָ֜ה אֵ֣שֶׁת  שַׁלֻּ֣ם בֶּן־[תׇּקְהַ֗ת] (תוקהת) בֶּן־חַסְרָה֙ שׁוֹמֵ֣ר הַבְּגָדִ֔ים וְהִ֛יא יוֹשֶׁ֥בֶת בִּירוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם בַּמִּשְׁנֶ֑ה וַיְדַבְּר֥וּ אֵלֶ֖יהָ כָּזֹֽאת׃
verses.translit: vylkh chlqyhv v'shr hmlkh 'lchldh hnby'h 'sht  shlm bn[tqht] (tvqht) bnchsrh shvmr hbgdym vhy' yvshbt byrvshl͏m bmshnh vydbrv 'lyh khz't
verses.translation: So Hilkiah, and they whom the king [had commanded], went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tokhath, the son of Hasrah, keeper of the wardrobe—now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the second quarter—and they spoke to her to that effect.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֹּ֣אמֶר לָהֶ֔ם כֹּֽה־אָמַ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אִמְר֣וּ לָאִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־שָׁלַ֥ח אֶתְכֶ֖ם אֵלָֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vt'mr lhm khh'mr yhvh 'lhy yshr'l 'mrv l'ysh 'shrshlch 'tkhm 'ly {s}
verses.translation: And she said unto them: ‘Thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel: Tell ye the man that sent you unto me:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה הִנְנִ֨י מֵבִ֥יא רָעָ֛ה עַל־הַמָּק֥וֹם הַזֶּ֖ה וְעַל־יֽוֹשְׁבָ֑יו אֵ֤ת כׇּל־הָֽאָלוֹת֙ הַכְּתוּב֣וֹת עַל־הַסֵּ֔פֶר אֲשֶׁ֣ר קָֽרְא֔וּ לִפְנֵ֖י מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh hnny mby' r'h 'lhmqvm hzh v'lyvshbyv 't khlh'lvt hkhtvbvt 'lhspr 'shr qr'v lpny mlkh yhvdh
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD: Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, and upon the inhabitants thereof, even all the curses that are written in the book which they have read before the king of Judah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תַּ֣חַת  אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲזָב֗וּנִי (ויקטירו) [וַֽיְקַטְּרוּ֙] לֵאלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים לְמַ֙עַן֙ הַכְעִיסֵ֔נִי בְּכֹ֖ל מַעֲשֵׂ֣י יְדֵיהֶ֑ם וְתִתַּ֧ךְ חֲמָתִ֛י בַּמָּק֥וֹם הַזֶּ֖ה וְלֹ֥א תִכְבֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: tcht  'shr 'zbvny (vyqtyrv) [vyqtrv] l'lhym 'chrym lm'n hkh'ysny bkhl m'shy ydyhm vttkh chmty bmqvm hzh vl' tkhbh
verses.translation: because they have forsaken Me, and have offered unto other gods, that they might provoke Me with all the works of their hands; therefore is My wrath poured out upon this place, and it shall not be quenched.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶל־מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֗ה הַשֹּׁלֵ֤חַ אֶתְכֶם֙ לִדְר֣וֹשׁ בַּיהֹוָ֔ה כֹּ֥ה תֹאמְר֖וּ אֵלָ֑יו {ס} כֹּֽה־אָמַ֤ר יְהֹוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הַדְּבָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁמָֽעְתָּ׃
verses.translit: v'lmlkh yhvdh hshlch 'tkhm ldrvsh byhvh khh t'mrv 'lyv {s} khh'mr yhvh 'lhy yshr'l hdbrym 'shr shm't
verses.translation: But unto the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of the LORD, thus shall ye say to him: Thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel: As touching the words which thou hast heard,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַ֠עַן רַךְ־לְבָ֨בְךָ֜ וַתִּכָּנַ֣ע  מִלִּפְנֵ֣י אֱלֹהִ֗ים בְּשׇׁמְעֲךָ֤ אֶת־דְּבָרָיו֙ עַל־הַמָּק֤וֹם הַזֶּה֙ וְעַל־יֹ֣שְׁבָ֔יו וַתִּכָּנַ֣ע לְפָנַ֔י וַתִּקְרַ֥ע אֶת־בְּגָדֶ֖יךָ וַתֵּ֣בְךְּ לְפָנָ֑י וְגַם־אֲנִ֥י שָׁמַ֖עְתִּי נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: y'n rkhlbbkh vtkhn'  mlpny 'lhym bshm'kh 'tdbryv 'lhmqvm hzh v'lyshbyv vtkhn' lpny vtqr' 'tbgdykh vtbkh lpny vgm'ny shm'ty n'myhvh
verses.translation: because thy heart was tender, and thou didst humble thyself before God, when thou heardest His words against this place, and against the inhabitants thereof, and hast humbled thyself before Me, and hast rent thy clothes, and wept before Me; I also have heard thee, saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנְנִ֨י אֹסִפְךָ֜ אֶל־אֲבֹתֶ֗יךָ וְנֶאֱסַפְתָּ֣ אֶל־קִבְרוֹתֶ֘יךָ֮ בְּשָׁלוֹם֒ וְלֹא־תִרְאֶ֣ינָה עֵינֶ֔יךָ בְּכֹל֙ הָרָעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲנִ֥י מֵבִ֛יא עַל־הַמָּק֥וֹם הַזֶּ֖ה וְעַל־יֹֽשְׁבָ֑יו וַיָּשִׁ֥יבוּ אֶת־הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ דָּבָֽר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hnny 'spkh 'l'btykh vn'spt 'lqbrvtykh bshlvm vl'tr'ynh 'ynykh bkhl hr'h 'shr 'ny mby' 'lhmqvm hzh v'lyshbyv vyshybv 'thmlkh dbr {s}
verses.translation: Behold, I will gather thee to thy fathers, and thou shalt be gathered to thy grave in peace, neither shall thine eyes see all the evil that I will bring upon this place, and upon the inhabitants thereof.’ And they brought back word unto the king.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֖ח הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַיֶּאֱסֹ֕ף אֶת־כׇּל־זִקְנֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה וִירוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: vyshlch hmlkh vy'sf 'tkhlzqny yhvdh vyrvshl͏m
verses.translation: Then the king sent and gathered together all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַל הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ בֵּית־יְ֠הֹוָ֠ה וְכׇל־אִ֨ישׁ יְהוּדָ֜ה וְיֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלַ֗͏ִם וְהַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ וְהַלְוִיִּ֔ם וְכׇל־הָעָ֖ם מִגָּד֣וֹל וְעַד־קָטָ֑ן וַיִּקְרָ֣א בְאׇזְנֵיהֶ֗ם אֶת־כׇּל־דִּבְרֵי֙ סֵ֣פֶר הַבְּרִ֔ית הַנִּמְצָ֖א בֵּ֥ית יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'l hmlkh bytyhvh vkhl'ysh yhvdh vyshby yrvshl͏m vhkhhnym vhlvym vkhlh'm mgdvl v'dqtn vyqr' b'znyhm 'tkhldbry spr hbryt hnmts' byt yhvh
verses.translation: And the king went up to the house of the LORD, and all the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and the priests, and the Levites, and all the people, both great and small; and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant that was found in the house of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּעֲמֹ֨ד הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ עַל־עׇמְד֗וֹ וַיִּכְרֹ֣ת אֶֽת־הַבְּרִית֮ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָה֒ לָלֶ֜כֶת אַחֲרֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֗ה וְלִשְׁמ֤וֹר אֶת־מִצְוֺתָיו֙ וְעֵדְוֺתָ֣יו וְחֻקָּ֔יו בְּכׇל־לְבָב֖וֹ וּבְכׇל־נַפְשׁ֑וֹ לַעֲשׂוֹת֙ אֶת־דִּבְרֵ֣י הַבְּרִ֔ית הַכְּתוּבִ֖ים עַל־הַסֵּ֥פֶר הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'md hmlkh 'l'mdv vykhrt 'thbryt lpny yhvh llkht 'chry yhvh vlshmvr 'tmtsvtyv v'dvtyv vchqyv bkhllbbv vbkhlnpshv l'shvt 'tdbry hbryt hkhtvbym 'lhspr hzh
verses.translation: And the king stood in his place, and made a covenant before the LORD, to walk after the LORD, and to keep His commandments, and His testimonies, and His statutes, with all his heart, and with all his soul, to perform the words of the covenant that were written in this book.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּעֲמֵ֕ד אֵ֛ת כׇּל־הַנִּמְצָ֥א בִירוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם וּבִנְיָמִ֑ן וַֽיַּעֲשׂוּ֙ יוֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם כִּבְרִ֥ית אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'md 't khlhnmts' byrvshl͏m vbnymn vy'shv yvshby yrvshl͏m khbryt 'lhym 'lhy 'bvtyhm
verses.translation: And he caused all that were found in Jerusalem and Benjamin to stand to it. And the inhabitants of Jerusalem did according to the covenant of God, the God of their fathers.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֨סַר יֹאשִׁיָּ֜הוּ אֶת־כׇּל־הַתֹּעֵב֗וֹת מִֽכׇּל־הָאֲרָצוֹת֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וַֽיַּעֲבֵ֗ד אֵ֤ת כׇּל־הַנִּמְצָא֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לַעֲב֖וֹד אֶת־יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֑ם כׇּל־יָמָ֕יו לֹ֣א סָ֔רוּ מֵאַחֲרֵ֕י יְהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vysr y'shyhv 'tkhlht'bvt mkhlh'rtsvt 'shr lbny yshr'l vy'bd 't khlhnmts' byshr'l l'bvd 'tyhvh 'lhyhm khlymyv l' srv m'chry yhvh 'lhy 'bvtyhm {s}
verses.translation: And Josiah took away all the abominations out of all the countries that pertained to the children of Israel, and made all that were found in Israel to serve, even to serve the LORD their God. All his days they departed not from following the LORD, the God of their fathers.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֨עַשׂ יֹאשִׁיָּ֧הוּ בִירוּשָׁלַ֛͏ִם פֶּ֖סַח לַיהֹוָ֑ה וַיִּשְׁחֲט֣וּ הַפֶּ֔סַח בְּאַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר לַחֹ֥דֶשׁ הָרִאשֽׁוֹן׃
verses.translit: vy'sh y'shyhv byrvshl͏m psch lyhvh vyshchtv hpsch b'rb'h 'shr lchdsh hr'shvn
verses.translation: And Josiah kept a passover unto the LORD in Jerusalem; and they killed the passover lamb on the fourteenth day of the first month.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּעֲמֵ֥ד הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים עַל־מִשְׁמְרוֹתָ֑ם וַֽיְחַזְּקֵ֔ם לַעֲבוֹדַ֖ת בֵּ֥ית יְהֹוָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vy'md hkhhnym 'lmshmrvtm vychzqm l'bvdt byt yhvh {s}
verses.translation: And he set the priests in their charges, and encouraged them to the service of the house of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לַ֠לְוִיִּ֠ם (המבונים) [הַמְּבִינִ֨ים] לְכׇל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל הַקְּדוֹשִׁ֣ים לַיהֹוָ֗ה תְּנ֤וּ אֶת־אֲרוֹן־הַקֹּ֙דֶשׁ֙ בַּ֠בַּ֠יִת אֲשֶׁ֨ר בָּנָ֜ה שְׁלֹמֹ֤ה בֶן־דָּוִיד֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֵין־לָכֶ֥ם מַשָּׂ֖א בַּכָּתֵ֑ף עַתָּ֗ה עִבְדוּ֙ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֔ם וְאֵ֖ת עַמּ֥וֹ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vy'mr llvym (hmbvnym) [hmbynym] lkhlyshr'l hqdvshym lyhvh tnv 't'rvnhqdsh bbyt 'shr bnh shlmh bndvyd mlkh yshr'l 'ynlkhm msh' bkhtf 'th 'bdv 'tyhvh 'lhykhm v't 'mv yshr'l
verses.translation: And he said unto the Levites that taught all Israel, that were holy unto the LORD: ‘Put the holy ark in the house which Solomon the son of David king of Israel did build; there shall no more be a burden upon your shoulders; now serve the LORD your God, and His people Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (והכונו) [וְהָכִ֥ינוּ] לְבֵית־אֲבוֹתֵיכֶ֖ם כְּמַחְלְקוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם בִּכְתָ֗ב דָּוִיד֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וּבְמִכְתַּ֖ב שְׁלֹמֹ֥ה בְנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: (vhkhvnv) [vhkhynv] lbyt'bvtykhm khmchlqvtykhm bkhtb dvyd mlkh yshr'l vbmkhtb shlmh bnv
verses.translation: And prepare ye after your fathers’houses by your courses, according to the writing of David king of Israel, and according to the writing of Solomon his son.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעִמְד֣וּ בַקֹּ֗דֶשׁ לִפְלוּגֹּת֙ בֵּ֣ית הָאָב֔וֹת לַאֲחֵיכֶ֖ם בְּנֵ֣י הָעָ֑ם וַחֲלֻקַּ֥ת בֵּֽית־אָ֖ב לַלְוִיִּֽם׃
verses.translit: v'mdv bqdsh lplvgt byt h'bvt l'chykhm bny h'm vchlqt byt'b llvym
verses.translation: And stand in the holy place according to the divisions of the fathers’houses of your brethren the children of the people, and [let there be for each] a portion of a father’s house of the Levites.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשַׁחֲט֖וּ הַפָּ֑סַח וְהִֽתְקַדְּשׁוּ֙ וְהָכִ֣ינוּ לַאֲחֵיכֶ֔ם לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת כִּדְבַר־יְהֹוָ֖ה בְּיַד־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vshchtv hpsch vhtqdshv vhkhynv l'chykhm l'shvt khdbryhvh bydmshh {p}
verses.translation: And kill the passover lamb, and sanctify yourselves, and prepare for your brethren, to do according to the word of the LORD by the hand of Moses.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֣רֶם יֹאשִׁיָּ֣הוּ לִבְנֵ֪י הָעָ֟ם צֹ֞אן כְּבָשִׂ֣ים וּבְנֵי־עִזִּים֮ הַכֹּ֣ל לַפְּסָחִים֒ לְכׇל־הַנִּמְצָ֗א לְמִסְפַּר֙ שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים אֶ֔לֶף וּבָקָ֖ר שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֑ים אֵ֖לֶּה מֵרְכ֥וּשׁ הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyrm y'shyhv lbny h'm ts'n khbshym vbny'zym hkhl lpschym lkhlhnmts' lmspr shlshym 'lf vbqr shlsht 'lpym 'lh mrkhvsh hmlkh {s}
verses.translation: And Josiah gave to the children of the people, of the flock, lambs and kids, all of them for the passover-offerings, unto all that were present, to the number of thirty thousand, and three thousand bullocks; these were of the king’s substance.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׂרָ֞יו לִנְדָבָ֥ה לָעָ֛ם לַכֹּהֲנִ֥ים וְלַלְוִיִּ֖ם הֵרִ֑ימוּ חִלְקִיָּ֨ה וּזְכַרְיָ֜הוּ וִיחִיאֵ֗ל נְגִידֵי֙ בֵּ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים לַכֹּהֲנִ֞ים נָתְנ֣וּ לַפְּסָחִ֗ים אַלְפַּ֙יִם֙ וְשֵׁ֣שׁ מֵא֔וֹת וּבָקָ֖ר שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vshryv lndbh l'm lkhhnym vllvym hrymv chlqyh vzkhryhv vychy'l ngydy byt h'lhym lkhhnym ntnv lpschym 'lpym vshsh m'vt vbqr shlsh m'vt
verses.translation: And his princes gave willingly unto the people, to the priests, and to the Levites. Hilkiah and Zechariah and Jehiel, the rulers of the house of God, gave unto the priests for the passover-offerings two thousand and six hundred [small cattle], and three hundred oxen.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (וכונניהו) [וְ֠כׇֽנַנְיָ֠הוּ] וּשְׁמַעְיָ֨הוּ וּנְתַנְאֵ֜ל אֶחָ֗יו וַחֲשַׁבְיָ֧הוּ וִיעִיאֵ֛ל וְיוֹזָבָ֖ד שָׂרֵ֣י הַלְוִיִּ֑ם הֵרִ֨ימוּ לַלְוִיִּ֤ם לַפְּסָחִים֙ חֲמֵ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֔ים וּבָקָ֖ר חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: (vkhvnnyhv) [vkhnnyhv] vshm'yhv vntn'l 'chyv vchshbyhv vy'y'l vyvzbd shry hlvym hrymv llvym lpschym chmsht 'lpym vbqr chmsh m'vt
verses.translation: Conaniah also, and Shemaiah and Nethanel, his brethren, and Hashabiah and Jeiel and Jozabad, the chiefs of the Levites, gave unto the Levites for the passover-offerings five thousand [small cattle], and five hundred oxen.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּכּ֖וֹן הָעֲבוֹדָ֑ה וַיַּעַמְד֨וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֧ים עַל־עׇמְדָ֛ם וְהַלְוִיִּ֥ם עַל־מַחְלְקוֹתָ֖ם כְּמִצְוַ֥ת הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.translit: vtkhvn h'bvdh vy'mdv hkhhnym 'l'mdm vhlvym 'lmchlqvtm khmtsvt hmlkh
verses.translation: So the service was prepared, and the priests stood in their place, and the Levites by their courses, according to the king’s commandment.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיִּשְׁחֲט֖וּ הַפָּ֑סַח וַיִּזְרְק֤וּ הַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ מִיָּדָ֔ם וְהַלְוִיִּ֖ם מַפְשִׁיטִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyshchtv hpsch vyzrqv hkhhnym mydm vhlvym mpshytym
verses.translation: And they killed the passover lamb, and the priests dashed [the blood, which they received] of their hand, and the Levites flayed them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּסִ֨ירוּ הָעֹלָ֜ה לְ֠תִתָּ֠ם לְמִפְלַגּ֤וֹת לְבֵית־אָבוֹת֙ לִבְנֵ֣י הָעָ֔ם לְהַקְרִיב֙ לַֽיהֹוָ֔ה כַּכָּת֖וּב בְּסֵ֣פֶר מֹשֶׁ֑ה וְכֵ֖ן לַבָּקָֽר׃
verses.translit: vysyrv h'lh lttm lmplgvt lbyt'bvt lbny h'm lhqryb lyhvh khkhtvb bspr mshh vkhn lbqr
verses.translation: And they removed the portions that were to be burnt, that they might give them to the divisions of the fathers’houses of the children of the people, to present unto the LORD, as it is written in the book of Moses. And so did they with the oxen.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְבַשְּׁל֥וּ הַפֶּ֛סַח בָּאֵ֖שׁ כַּמִּשְׁפָּ֑ט וְהַקֳּדָשִׁ֣ים בִּשְּׁל֗וּ בַּסִּיר֤וֹת וּבַדְּוָדִים֙ וּבַצֵּ֣לָח֔וֹת וַיָּרִ֖יצוּ לְכׇל־בְּנֵ֥י הָעָֽם׃
verses.translit: vybshlv hpsch b'sh khmshpt vhqdshym bshlv bsyrvt vbdvdym vbtslchvt vyrytsv lkhlbny h'm
verses.translation: And they roasted the passover with fire according to the ordinance; and the holy offerings sod they in pots, and in caldrons, and in pans, and carried them quickly to all the children of the people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַחַ֗ר הֵכִ֤ינוּ לָהֶם֙ וְלַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים כִּ֤י הַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֔ן בְּהַעֲל֛וֹת הָעוֹלָ֥ה וְהַחֲלָבִ֖ים עַד־לָ֑יְלָה וְהַלְוִיִּם֙ הֵכִ֣ינוּ לָהֶ֔ם וְלַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים בְּנֵ֥י אַהֲרֹֽן׃
verses.translit: v'chr hkhynv lhm vlkhhnym khy hkhhnym bny 'hrn bh'lvt h'vlh vhchlbym 'dlylh vhlvym hkhynv lhm vlkhhnym bny 'hrn
verses.translation: And afterward they prepared for themselves, and for the priests; because the priests the sons of Aaron were busied in offering the portions that were to be burnt and the fat until night; therefore the Levites prepared for themselves, and for the priests the sons of Aaron.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַמְשֹׁרְרִ֨ים בְּנֵי־אָסָ֜ף עַל־מַעֲמָדָ֗ם כְּמִצְוַ֤ת דָּוִיד֙ וְאָסָ֞ף וְהֵימָ֤ן וִֽידֻתוּן֙ חוֹזֵ֣ה הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וְהַשֹּׁעֲרִ֖ים לְשַׁ֣עַר וָשָׁ֑עַר אֵ֣ין לָהֶ֗ם לָסוּר֙ מֵעַ֣ל עֲבֹֽדָתָ֔ם כִּֽי־אֲחֵיהֶ֥ם הַלְוִיִּ֖ם הֵכִ֥ינוּ לָהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vhmshrrym bny'sf 'lm'mdm khmtsvt dvyd v'sf vhymn vydtvn chvzh hmlkh vhsh'rym lsh'r vsh'r 'yn lhm lsvr m'l 'bdtm khy'chyhm hlvym hkhynv lhm
verses.translation: And the singers the sons of Asaph were in their place, according to the commandment of David, and Asaph, and Heman, and Jeduthun the king’s seer; and the porters were at every gate; they needed not to depart from their service, for their brethren the Levites prepared for them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֠תִּכּ֠וֹן כׇּל־עֲבוֹדַ֨ת יְהֹוָ֜ה בַּיּ֤וֹם הַהוּא֙ לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת הַפֶּ֔סַח וְהַעֲל֣וֹת עֹל֔וֹת עַ֖ל מִזְבַּ֣ח יְהֹוָ֑ה כְּמִצְוַ֖ת הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ יֹאשִׁיָּֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: vtkhvn khl'bvdt yhvh byvm hhv' l'shvt hpsch vh'lvt 'lvt 'l mzbch yhvh khmtsvt hmlkh y'shyhv
verses.translation: So all the service of the LORD was prepared the same day, to keep the passover, and to offer burnt-offerings upon the altar of the LORD, according to the commandment of king Josiah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּעֲשׂ֨וּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל הַֽנִּמְצְאִ֛ים אֶת־הַפֶּ֖סַח בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֑יא וְאֶת־חַ֥ג הַמַּצּ֖וֹת שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים׃
verses.translit: vy'shv bnyyshr'l hnmts'ym 'thpsch b't hhy' v'tchg hmtsvt shb't ymym
verses.translation: And the children of Israel that were present kept the passover at that time, and the feast of unleavened bread seven days.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹא־נַעֲשָׂ֨ה פֶ֤סַח כָּמֹ֙הוּ֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִימֵ֖י שְׁמוּאֵ֣ל הַנָּבִ֑יא וְכׇל־מַלְכֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל ׀ לֹֽא־עָשׂ֡וּ כַּפֶּ֣סַח אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂ֣ה יֹ֠אשִׁיָּ֠הוּ וְהַכֹּהֲנִ֨ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֤ם וְכׇל־יְהוּדָה֙ וְיִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל הַנִּמְצָ֔א וְיוֹשְׁבֵ֖י יְרוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vl'n'shh psch khmhv byshr'l mymy shmv'l hnby' vkhlmlkhy yshr'l  l''shv khpsch 'shr'shh y'shyhv vhkhhnym vhlvym vkhlyhvdh vyshr'l hnmts' vyvshby yrvshl͏m {s}
verses.translation: And there was no passover like to that kept in Israel from the days of Samuel the prophet; neither did any of the kings of Israel keep such a passover as Josiah kept, and the priests, and the Levites, and all Judah and Israel that were present, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּשְׁמוֹנֶ֤ה עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה לְמַלְכ֖וּת יֹאשִׁיָּ֑הוּ נַעֲשָׂ֖ה הַפֶּ֥סַח הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: bshmvnh 'shrh shnh lmlkhvt y'shyhv n'shh hpsch hzh
verses.translation: In the eighteenth year of the reign of Josiah was this passover kept.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַחֲרֵ֣י כׇל־זֹ֗את אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֵכִ֤ין יֹאשִׁיָּ֙הוּ֙ אֶת־הַבַּ֔יִת עָלָ֞ה נְכ֧וֹ מֶלֶךְ־מִצְרַ֛יִם לְהִלָּחֵ֥ם בְּכַרְכְּמִ֖ישׁ עַל־פְּרָ֑ת וַיֵּצֵ֥א לִקְרָאת֖וֹ יֹאשִׁיָּֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: 'chry khlz't 'shr hkhyn y'shyhv 'thbyt 'lh nkhv mlkhmtsrym lhlchm bkhrkhmysh 'lprt vyts' lqr'tv y'shyhv
verses.translation: After all this, when Josiah had prepared the temple, Neco king of Egypt went up to fight against Carchemish by the Euphrates; and Josiah went out against him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח אֵלָ֣יו מַלְאָכִ֣ים ׀ לֵאמֹר֩ ׀ מַה־לִּ֨י וָלָ֜ךְ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֗ה לֹא־עָלֶ֨יךָ אַתָּ֤ה הַיּוֹם֙ כִּ֚י אֶל־בֵּ֣ית מִלְחַמְתִּ֔י וֵאלֹהִ֖ים אָמַ֣ר לְבַהֲלֵ֑נִי חֲדַל־לְךָ֛ מֵאֱלֹהִ֥ים אֲשֶׁר־עִמִּ֖י וְאַל־יַשְׁחִיתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: vyshlch 'lyv ml'khym  l'mr  mhly vlkh mlkh yhvdh l''lykh 'th hyvm khy 'lbyt mlchmty v'lhym 'mr lbhlny chdllkh m'lhym 'shr'my v'lyshchytkh
verses.translation: But he sent ambassadors to him, saying: ‘What have I to do with thee, thou king of Judah? I come not against thee this day, but against the house wherewith I have war; and God hath given command to speed me; forbear thee from meddling with God, who is with me, that He destroy thee not.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹא־הֵסֵב֩ יֹאשִׁיָּ֨הוּ פָנָ֜יו מִמֶּ֗נּוּ כִּ֤י לְהִלָּחֵֽם־בּוֹ֙ הִתְחַפֵּ֔שׂ וְלֹ֥א שָׁמַ֛ע אֶל־דִּבְרֵ֥י נְכ֖וֹ מִפִּ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים וַיָּבֹ֕א לְהִלָּחֵ֖ם בְּבִקְעַ֥ת מְגִדּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vl'hsb y'shyhv pnyv mmnv khy lhlchmbv htchpsh vl' shm' 'ldbry nkhv mpy 'lhym vyb' lhlchm bbq't mgdv
verses.translation: Nevertheless Josiah would not turn his face from him, but disguised himself, that he might fight with him, and hearkened not unto the words of Neco, from the mouth of God, and came to fight in the valley of Megiddo.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּרוּ֙ הַיֹּרִ֔ים לַמֶּ֖לֶךְ יֹאשִׁיָּ֑הוּ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ לַעֲבָדָיו֙ הַעֲבִיר֔וּנִי כִּ֥י הׇחֳלֵ֖יתִי מְאֹֽד׃
verses.translit: vyrv hyrym lmlkh y'shyhv vy'mr hmlkh l'bdyv h'byrvny khy hchlyty m'd
verses.translation: And the archers shot at king Josiah; and the king said to his servants: ‘Have me away; for I am sore wounded.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּעֲבִירֻ֨הוּ עֲבָדָ֜יו מִן־הַמֶּרְכָּבָ֗ה וַֽיַּרְכִּיבֻ֘הוּ֮ עַ֣ל רֶ֣כֶב הַמִּשְׁנֶה֮ אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ֒ וַיּוֹלִיכֻ֙הוּ֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם וַיָּ֕מׇת וַיִּקָּבֵ֖ר בְּקִבְר֣וֹת אֲבֹתָ֑יו וְכׇל־יְהוּדָה֙ וִיר֣וּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם מִֽתְאַבְּלִ֖ים עַל־יֹאשִׁיָּֽהוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vy'byrhv 'bdyv mnhmrkhbh vyrkhybhv 'l rkhb hmshnh 'shrlv vyvlykhhv yrvshl͏m vymt vyqbr bqbrvt 'btyv vkhlyhvdh vyrvshl͏m mt'blym 'ly'shyhv {p}
verses.translation: So his servants took him out of the chariot, and put him in the second chariot that he had, and brought him to Jerusalem; and he died, and was buried in the sepulchres of his fathers. And all Judah and Jerusalem mourned for Josiah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְקוֹנֵ֣ן יִרְמְיָ֘הוּ֮ עַל־יֹאשִׁיָּ֒הוּ֒ וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ כׇֽל־הַשָּׁרִ֣ים ׀ וְ֠הַשָּׁר֠וֹת בְּקִינ֨וֹתֵיהֶ֤ם עַל־יֹאשִׁיָּ֙הוּ֙ עַד־הַיּ֔וֹם וַיִּתְּנ֥וּם לְחֹ֖ק עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְהִנָּ֥ם כְּתוּבִ֖ים עַל־הַקִּינֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vyqvnn yrmyhv 'ly'shyhv vy'mrv khlhshrym  vhshrvt bqynvtyhm 'ly'shyhv 'dhyvm vytnvm lchq 'lyshr'l vhnm khtvbym 'lhqynvt
verses.translation: And Jeremiah lamented for Josiah; and all the singing men and singing women spoke of Josiah in their lamentations, unto this day; and they made them an ordinance in Israel; and, behold, they are written in the lamentations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיֶ֛תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י יֹאשִׁיָּ֖הוּ וַחֲסָדָ֑יו כַּכָּת֖וּב בְּתוֹרַ֥ת יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vytr dbry y'shyhv vchsdyv khkhtvb btvrt yhvh
verses.translation: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and his good deeds, according to that which is written in the Law of the LORD,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּדְבָרָ֕יו הָרִאשֹׁנִ֖ים וְהָאַחֲרֹנִ֑ים הִנָּ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֔ים עַל־סֵ֥פֶר מַלְכֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וִיהוּדָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vdbryv hr'shnym vh'chrnym hnm khtvbym 'lspr mlkhyyshr'l vyhvdh {p}
verses.translation: and his acts, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְחוּ֙ עַם־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֶת־יְהוֹאָחָ֖ז בֶּן־יֹאשִׁיָּ֑הוּ וַיַּמְלִיכֻ֥הוּ תַֽחַת־אָבִ֖יו בִּירוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: vyqchv 'mh'rts 'tyhv'chz bny'shyhv vymlykhhv tcht'byv byrvshl͏m
verses.translation: Then the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and made him king in his father’s stead in Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֶּן־שָׁל֧וֹשׁ וְעֶשְׂרִ֛ים שָׁנָ֖ה יוֹאָחָ֣ז בְּמׇלְכ֑וֹ וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה חֳדָשִׁ֔ים מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: bnshlvsh v'shrym shnh yv'chz bmlkhv vshlshh chdshym mlkh byrvshl͏m
verses.translation: Joahaz was twenty and three years old when he began to reign; and he reigned three months in Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְסִירֵ֥הוּ מֶלֶךְ־מִצְרַ֖יִם בִּירוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם וַֽיַּעֲנֹשׁ֙ אֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ מֵאָ֥ה כִכַּר־כֶּ֖סֶף וְכִכַּ֥ר זָהָֽב׃
verses.translit: vysyrhv mlkhmtsrym byrvshl͏m vy'nsh 'th'rts m'h khkhrkhsf vkhkhr zhb
verses.translation: And the king of Egypt deposed him at Jerusalem, and fined the land a hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּמְלֵ֨ךְ מֶלֶךְ־מִצְרַ֜יִם אֶת־אֶלְיָקִ֣ים אָחִ֗יו עַל־יְהוּדָה֙ וִיר֣וּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם וַיַּסֵּ֥ב אֶת־שְׁמ֖וֹ יְהוֹיָקִ֑ים וְאֶת־יוֹאָחָ֤ז אָחִיו֙ לָקַ֣ח נְכ֔וֹ וַיְבִיאֵ֖הוּ מִצְרָֽיְמָה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vymlkh mlkhmtsrym 't'lyqym 'chyv 'lyhvdh vyrvshl͏m vysb 'tshmv yhvyqym v'tyv'chz 'chyv lqch nkhv vyby'hv mtsrymh {p}
verses.translation: And the king of Egypt made Eliakim his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem, and changed his name to Jehoiakim. And Neco took Joahaz his brother, and carried him to Egypt.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֶּן־עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְחָמֵ֤שׁ שָׁנָה֙ יְהוֹיָקִ֣ים בְּמׇלְכ֔וֹ וְאַחַ֤ת עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם וַיַּ֣עַשׂ הָרַ֔ע בְּעֵינֵ֖י יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽיו׃
verses.translit: bn'shrym vchmsh shnh yhvyqym bmlkhv v'cht 'shrh shnh mlkh byrvshl͏m vy'sh hr' b'yny yhvh 'lhyv
verses.translation: Jehoiakim was twenty and five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem; and he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD his God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָלָ֣יו עָלָ֔ה נְבוּכַדְנֶאצַּ֖ר מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֑ל וַיַּאַסְרֵ֙הוּ֙ בַּֽנְחֻשְׁתַּ֔יִם לְהֹלִיכ֖וֹ בָּבֶֽלָה׃
verses.translit: 'lyv 'lh nbvkhdn'tsr mlkh bbl vy'srhv bnchshtym lhlykhv bblh
verses.translation: Against him came up Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and bound him in fetters, to carry him to Babylon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִכְּלֵי֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהֹוָ֔ה הֵבִ֥יא נְבוּכַדְנֶאצַּ֖ר לְבָבֶ֑ל וַיִּתְּנֵ֥ם בְּהֵיכָל֖וֹ בְּבָבֶֽל׃
verses.translit: vmkhly byt yhvh hby' nbvkhdn'tsr lbbl vytnm bhykhlv bbbl
verses.translation: Nebuchadnezzar also carried of the vessels of the house of the LORD to Babylon, and put them in his temple at Babylon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיֶ֩תֶר֩ דִּבְרֵ֨י יְהוֹיָקִ֜ים וְתֹעֲבֹתָ֤יו אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה֙ וְהַנִּמְצָ֣א עָלָ֔יו הִנָּ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־סֵ֛פֶר מַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וִיהוּדָ֑ה וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ יְהוֹיָכִ֥ין בְּנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃ {פ}
